title: A new Bolitoglossa (Amphibia, Caudata, Plethodontidae) from the Cordillera Oriental of Colombia
readScope: Bolitoglossa muisca type material, diagnosis, distribution and natural history; no figures reproduced
sections: morphology
Type material and a larger measured sample
模式材料与较大的测量样本

The 2023 description designated a female holotype and eight paratypes (three females and five males). Its comparative diagnosis reports snout–vent lengths of 33.0–72.1 mm across 22 measured B. muisca specimens; this measured sample is distinct from the nine-specimen type series. The authors described a broad head, mostly smooth skin, moderate webbing and a short, robust tail. The reported range is a study measurement, not a universal size boundary.
2023 年描述指定一件雌性正模及八件副模（三雌、五雄）。比较鉴别描述报告 22 件 B. muisca 测量标本的吻肛长为 33.0–72.1 毫米；这一测量样本与九件模式系列不同。作者描述了宽头、主要光滑的皮肤、适度蹼及短而粗壮的尾。这是研究中的测量范围，不是普遍体长界限。
distribution
Cloud-forest records in Cundinamarca
昆迪纳马卡的云雾林记录

The study recorded B. muisca from small cloud-forest remnants on the western slopes of Colombia’s Cordillera Oriental, in Bojacá, Granada, San Antonio del Tequendama, Silvania and Soacha municipalities. Collected specimens came from 2390–2700 m elevation. These records describe the study’s geographic sample; they do not establish physiological altitude limits or complete present-day occupancy.
研究记录来自哥伦比亚东科迪勒拉山脉西坡的云雾林小片残存生境，涉及 Bojacá、Granada、San Antonio del Tequendama、Silvania 与 Soacha 五个市镇。采集标本的海拔为 2390–2700 米。这些记录描述研究的地理样本，不能确立生理海拔极限或完整的当代占据范围。
ecology
Different resting and active sites
活动与休息地点

At Bojacá, salamanders were regularly observed at night around fern bases and leaves; at San Antonio del Tequendama, most were active at night on small shrub branches, usually away from streams. A few daytime observations found inactive individuals inside bromeliads below 2 m height. Handled individuals released a sticky whitish secretion, which the authors interpreted as a possible predator defence; its effectiveness was not demonstrated by these observations.
在 Bojacá，研究者经常于夜间在蕨类基部与叶片附近观察到个体；在 San Antonio del Tequendama，多数个体夜间在小灌木枝上活动，通常远离溪流。少数白天观察发现个体在高度不足 2 米的凤梨科植物内静止休息。受触碰个体释放黏稠白色分泌物，作者将其解释为可能的捕食者防御，但这些观察没有证明其防御效果。

title: Three new species of torrent treefrogs (Anura, Hylidae) of the Hyloscirtus bogotensis group from the eastern Andean slopes and the biogeographic history of the genus
readScope: Hyloscirtus albopunctulatus distribution and natural-history account; own factual synthesis of article, no dataset republication or figures
sections: distribution
Seven reported Ecuadorian localities
七个厄瓜多尔记录地点

The 2025 account reported seven localities in northern to central eastern Ecuador, at 389–1391 m elevation. These records belong to the taxonomic concept used in that account and describe observed geography rather than complete occupancy or physiological altitude limits.
2025 年物种记述报告厄瓜多尔东部北段至中段的七个地点，海拔 389–1391 米。这些记录属于该记述采用的分类概念，描述所记录的地理范围，不能确立完整占据情况或生理海拔极限。
ecology
Calling sites and resting sites
鸣叫与栖息地点

The account describes nocturnal frogs associated with streams and ravines. Males called beneath rocks or in sheltered sites such as crevices, caves and leaf litter. Some individuals perched on vegetation up to 2.5 m high without being observed calling there. Perching and calling observations therefore have separate scopes in this study.
记述描述本种夜间活动并与溪流、沟谷相联系。雄性在岩石下或裂隙、洞穴、落叶层等隐蔽地点鸣叫。部分个体栖于高达 2.5 米的植被上，但研究未在那里观察到鸣叫。因此该研究中的栖息与鸣叫观察具有不同范围。

title: Three new species of torrent treefrogs (Anura, Hylidae) of the Hyloscirtus bogotensis group from the eastern Andean slopes and the biogeographic history of the genus
readScope: Hyloscirtus elbakyanae distribution and natural-history account; own factual synthesis of article, no dataset republication or figures
sections: distribution
The recorded low-elevation sample
已记录的低海拔样本

The original account reported seven localities near Comunidad Shaime in Morona Santiago, Ecuador, at 214–622 m elevation. This is the article’s locality sample and does not establish an exhaustive present-day range or the species’ altitude tolerance.
原始记述报告厄瓜多尔 Morona Santiago 的 Comunidad Shaime 附近七个地点，海拔 214–622 米。这是论文的地点样本，不能确立穷尽的当代分布或本种海拔耐受范围。
ecology
Sheltered nocturnal calling
夜间隐蔽地点的鸣叫

The study described hillside forest with varying human disturbance, and nocturnal observations along ravines beside rivers and streams. Frogs called beneath rocks in streams with little water and in cracks. The account had no records of individuals perched on riparian vegetation; that observational absence does not prove that such perching never occurs.
研究描述了受到不同程度人为干扰的山坡森林，以及河流、溪流旁沟谷中的夜间观察。个体在水量较小溪流的石下及裂隙中鸣叫。记述没有个体栖于河岸植被的记录；观察记录缺失不能证明此类栖息从不发生。

title: Three new species of torrent treefrogs (Anura, Hylidae) of the Hyloscirtus bogotensis group from the eastern Andean slopes and the biogeographic history of the genus
readScope: Hyloscirtus dispersus distribution and natural-history account; own factual synthesis of article, no dataset republication or figures
sections: distribution
More than 25 reported localities
二十五个以上的记录地点

The 2025 description reported more than 25 localities along Ecuador’s eastern Andean slopes, from north to south, at 879–1807 m elevation. Possible occurrence in neighbouring countries mentioned in the name’s explanation is not treated here as a confirmed record.
2025 年描述报告厄瓜多尔安第斯东坡从北到南二十五个以上的地点，海拔 879–1807 米。名称解释中提及邻国可能存在本种，此处不将这种可能性作为已确认记录。
ecology
Calling from streamside vegetation
溪边植被上的鸣叫

The account described nocturnal frogs in hillside forest, including secondary forest and artificial open areas, associated with running streams and ravines. Males called on riparian vegetation up to 2.5 m above ground. These observations document habitat use; they do not measure the consequences of disturbance or establish habitat preferences experimentally.
记述描述本种在山坡森林夜间活动，包括次生林与人为开放区域，并与流水溪流、沟谷相联系。雄性在离地高达 2.5 米的河岸植被上鸣叫。这些观察记录生境使用，不能测定干扰后果或通过实验确立生境偏好。

title: Three new species of torrent treefrogs (Anura, Hylidae) of the Hyloscirtus bogotensis group from the eastern Andean slopes and the biogeographic history of the genus
readScope: Hyloscirtus maycu definition, distribution and natural-history account; own factual synthesis of article, no dataset republication or figures
sections: morphology
Five adults in the diagnostic sample
鉴别样本中的五只成年个体

The description’s diagnostic sample contained three adult males with snout–vent lengths of 31.9–34.2 mm and two adult females measuring 41.7–43.7 mm. These small-sample ranges describe measured specimens, rather than all males and females throughout the species range.
原始描述的鉴别样本包括三只成年雄性，吻肛长 31.9–34.2 毫米，以及两只成年雌性，41.7–43.7 毫米。这些小样本范围描述所测个体，而非整个物种分布区的全部雄性与雌性。
distribution
Two recorded localities
两个已记录地点

The account reported the type locality in Morona Santiago and another locality in Zamora Chinchipe, Ecuador, approximately 32 km apart, at 882–1183 m elevation. Frogs were associated with ravines and streams in primary and secondary forest. These observations establish the article’s recorded sample without implying continuous occupation between localities.
记述报告厄瓜多尔 Morona Santiago 的模式地点及 Zamora Chinchipe 的另一地点，两地相距约 32 千米，记录海拔为 882–1183 米。个体与原生林及次生林中的沟谷、溪流相联系。这些观察确立论文的记录样本，不能推断两地之间连续占据。
reproduction
A tadpole and a metamorph near streams
溪流附近的蝌蚪与变态个体

The authors recorded a tadpole, QCAZ 67083, in a pool beside a stream in February and a metamorph on a rock island within a stream in March. They inferred stream development of larvae from these observations. This inference does not establish every larval microhabitat, a complete developmental sequence or the annual breeding season.
作者于二月在溪旁水池记录到蝌蚪 QCAZ 67083，于三月在溪中岩石小岛记录到变态个体，并据此推测幼体在溪流中发育。这一推断不能确立所有幼体微生境、完整发育过程或年度繁殖季节。

name: Amolops gudao
sections: ecology
July observations beside swift streams
七月急流旁的观察

The 2025 description knew the species only from Baihualing, Longyang, Yunnan. During July surveys between 21:00 and midnight, frogs were observed on large stream rocks or banks beside wide, swift mountain streams bordered by broadleaf and bamboo forest. Disturbed individuals jumped into water. These observations describe the sampled sites and nights, without establishing an exclusive habitat requirement.
2025 年描述当时仅从云南隆阳百花岭了解本种。七月 21:00 至午夜的调查在宽阔急流中的大石或岸边观察到个体，溪流两侧为阔叶林与竹林；受到惊扰的个体跳入水中。这些观察描述所调查地点与夜晚，不能确立排他的生境要求。
reproduction
An inferred July–August season
推测的七至八月繁殖期

The authors found tadpoles on 8 July and adults on 19 July; collected males had nuptial pads and females carried eggs. They proposed breeding around July–August. The proposal remains an inference from these observations, rather than a demonstrated complete annual breeding season.
作者于七月八日发现蝌蚪，十九日发现成年个体；采集雄性有婚垫，雌性怀卵。作者据此提出可能在七至八月繁殖。这仍是基于这些观察的推测，并非已证实的完整年度繁殖季节。
title: A new species of the genus Amolops ( Anura , Ranidae ) from the Gaoligong Mountains, China
readScope: Amolops gudao distribution, ecology and natural-history account; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

name: Blommersia nataliae
sections: distribution
Two surveyed Mayotte mountains
马约特两座山的调查记录

The description recorded frogs in forest and bamboo on Mont M’Sapere at 235–409 m and on Mont Bénara at a 317 m site in Mayotte. These are dated survey records from 2012, 2014 and 2019; unsuccessful searches elsewhere do not prove complete absence from every other locality.
原始描述记录了马约特 Mont M’Sapere 海拔 235–409 米的森林、竹林个体，以及 Mont Bénara 一个 317 米地点的个体。这是 2012、2014 与 2019 年的调查记录；其他地方未找到个体，不能证明所有其他地点均完全不存在本种。
reproduction
Eggs above water in cut bamboo
截断竹筒水面上方的卵

Three clutches counted at Mont M’Sapere in November 2012 contained 42, 43 and 22 eggs, placed on inner bamboo walls above water. Only some appeared fertilized. Eggs and tadpoles were observed during wet periods in November–December 2012 and April 2014. Suggested provisioning of unfertilized eggs to tadpoles remained a hypothesis needing further work. Failure to hear calls during the observations does not establish that the species never calls.
2012 年十一月在 Mont M’Sapere 计数的三窝卵分别含 42、43 与 22 枚，置于竹筒内壁的水面上方；仅部分看似受精。研究在 2012 年十一至十二月及 2014 年四月的湿润时期观察到卵和蝌蚪。未受精卵可能为蝌蚪供食的解释仍是待研究的假说。观察中未听见鸣叫，不能确立本种从不鸣叫。
title: Hidden in plain sight: a new frog species of the genus Blommersia from the oceanic island of Mayotte, Comoros archipelago
readScope: Blommersia nataliae distribution, ecology and natural-history account; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

name: Boulenophrys daxuemontis
sections: distribution
Daxue Mountain survey records
大雪山调查记录

The description reported specimens at 1400–1500 m on Daxue Mountain near the Sichuan–Yunnan border. Its distribution paragraph once uses the different spelling daxueshanensis; that internal spelling is retained as a source discrepancy rather than a separate biological assignment. The field records do not establish total population size.
原始描述报告四川、云南交界附近大雪山海拔 1400–1500 米的标本。分布段落有一次使用不同拼写 daxueshanensis；此处将其保留为原文差异，不另作生物学归属。野外记录不能确立种群总量。
ecology
Rainy-night stream observations
雨夜溪流观察

During an overcast rainy-night survey from 20:00 to 22:00, frogs were frequently found on stream stones surrounded by evergreen broadleaf forest. Survey air temperature was about 16 °C and relative humidity 85–95%; these are observation conditions, not physiological limits. No usable call recordings or tadpoles were obtained, so those facets remain unresolved.
在阴雨夜晚 20:00—22:00 的调查中，个体经常出现在常绿阔叶林围绕的溪流石上。调查气温约 16 摄氏度、相对湿度 85%—95%；这是观察条件，不是生理极限。研究未取得可用的鸣声记录或蝌蚪，这些主题仍未解决。
title: A new species of the genus Boulenophrys ( Anura , Megophryidae ) from Southwest China
readScope: Boulenophrys daxuemontis distribution, ecology and natural-history account; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

name: Boulenophrys lichun
sections: distribution
Coastal hills of eastern Fujian
福建东部沿海丘陵

The description knew the species from the coastal hills of Ningde, eastern Fujian, China, at 150–510 m elevation. This recorded range reflects the study’s sites, rather than a complete contemporary distribution or altitude tolerance.
原始描述当时从中国福建东部宁德沿海丘陵海拔 150–510 米了解本种。这一记录范围反映研究地点，不是完整当代分布或海拔耐受范围。
ecology
Seeps, litter and calling crevices
渗流、落叶与鸣叫裂隙

Frogs inhabited flowing mountain seeps and nearby forest floor and leaf litter, surrounded by secondary forest mixed with bamboo. Males were heard calling in rock crevices from February to May. Those calling observations do not establish egg-laying dates, larval development or the full annual reproductive cycle.
个体栖于流动的山地渗流及附近林地表面、落叶层，周围为混有竹林的次生林。二月至五月听到雄性在岩石裂隙中鸣叫。这些鸣叫观察不能确立产卵日期、幼体发育或完整年度繁殖周期。
title: A new Boulenophrys species ( Anura , Megophryidae ) from the coastal hills of eastern Fujian Province, China
readScope: Boulenophrys lichun distribution, ecology and natural-history account; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

name: Brachytarsophrys qiannanensis
sections: distribution
The Libo type-locality sample
荔波模式地点的样本

The original description recorded the species at its type locality in Libo County, Guizhou, China, at 1100–1200 m elevation. These type-locality records do not establish the full geographic range or an altitude limit.
原始描述记录中国贵州荔波县模式地点海拔 1100–1200 米的本种。这些模式地点记录不能确立完整地理分布或海拔极限。
ecology
Calling beneath stream rocks
溪流岩石下的鸣叫

The described habitat was a mountain stream beneath evergreen broadleaf forest, with little surface water. Males were heard calling beneath rocks at night, and females were frequently found near large rocks. These observations document local habitat use and calling sites, without establishing egg deposition or tadpole requirements.
描述的生境为常绿阔叶林下表面水量较小的山溪。夜间听到雄性在岩石下鸣叫，雌性经常见于大石附近。这些观察记录地方生境使用与鸣叫地点，不能确立产卵方式或蝌蚪所需条件。
title: A new toad species of the genus Brachytarsophrys Tian & Hu, 1983 ( Anura , Megophryidae ) from Guizhou Province, China
readScope: Brachytarsophrys qiannanensis distribution, ecology and natural-history account; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

name: Breviceps ombelanonga
sections: distribution
Three genetically supported Angolan areas
安哥拉三个遗传证据支持地区

The study confirmed records from Kissama National Park in western Angola, central Bié and river-source areas in Moxico. Reported elevations ranged from near sea level to above 1400 m. Other Angolan Breviceps records were left uncertain pending additional sampling and genetics; they are not automatically assigned to this species.
研究确认了安哥拉西部基萨马国家公园、中部比耶及莫希科河源地区的记录。报告海拔从接近海平面到超过 1400 米。其他安哥拉 Breviceps 记录因仍需采样与遗传证据而保持不确定，此处不自动归入本种。
ecology
Rain-associated collections and food records
雨后采集与食物记录

The type series was collected after gentle rain in habitats spanning sandy savanna and wetter miombo woodland. The holotype was observed eating small unidentified ants. Remains were also reported from two snake stomachs. These local records identify observed feeding and predation events, not the complete diet; egg sites and clutch sizes were unknown in the description.
模式系列在小雨后采集，所描述生境涉及沙质稀树草原及较湿润的米翁博林地。观察到正模摄食无法进一步鉴定的小蚂蚁，并在两种蛇的胃内报告了本种残体。这些地方记录识别所观察的摄食、被捕食事件，不是完整食谱；原始描述尚不知道卵的位置与每窝卵数。
title: A new species of Rain Frog ( Brevicipitidae , Breviceps ) endemic to Angola
readScope: Breviceps ombelanonga distribution, ecology and natural-history account; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

name: Bufo rubroventromaculatus
readScope: Bufo rubroventromaculatus: Species distribution account; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sections: distribution
Confirmed and unresolved records
确认与未解决的记录

The 2024 supplementary account confirmed the species from central and northern Vietnam, Wenshan in Yunnan and Baise in Guangxi, China. It explicitly left occurrence in Guizhou uncertain. The confirmed localities and the disputed provincial attribution are kept separate; the article does not establish continuous occupancy between them.
2024 年补充记述确认本种记录涉及越南中部及北部、中国云南文山与广西百色，并明确保留贵州分布的不确定性。已确认地点与存疑的省级归属分别保留；论文不能确立这些地点之间连续占据。
title: First confirmed record of Bufo rubroventromaculatus Orlov, Ananjeva, Ermakov, Lukonina, Ninh & Nguyen, 2024 ( Anura , Bufonidae ) from China, with supplementary description of this species

name: Dendropsophus bilobatus
readScope: Dendropsophus bilobatus: Distribution and natural-history account; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sections: distribution
The upper Madeira east-bank records
马德拉河上游东岸记录

The research team sampled more than 150 permanent sites around the upper Madeira and Purus–Madeira region but reported this species only from east-bank lowland open rainforest. The authors expected possible occurrence across the nearby Bolivian border; that expectation is not recorded here as a confirmed Bolivian locality.
研究团队在马德拉河上游及普鲁斯—马德拉地区调查了超过 150 个固定地点，但仅在东岸低地开放雨林报告本种。作者预期本种可能跨越附近玻利维亚边界；这一预期不作为已确认的玻利维亚地点记录。
reproduction
Wet-season choruses with unresolved endpoints
湿季合鸣及尚不明确的终点

The account observed frogs during the rainy season from early November to late March. Males called in choruses in river-connected flooded areas, perched from just above water to about 2 m high. Calling began around dusk and continued at least until midnight; its nightly endpoint was unknown. Amplexus was not observed, so these calling records do not establish mating or egg-laying behaviour.
记述在十一月初至三月底的雨季观察到个体。雄性在与河流连接的积水区域合鸣，栖息高度从略高于水面到约 2 米。鸣叫约于黄昏开始，至少持续到午夜，夜间何时结束尚不明确。研究未观察到抱对，因此这些鸣叫记录不能确立交配或产卵行为。
title: A new species of Dendropsophus ( Anura , Hylidae ) from southwestern Amazonia with a green bilobate vocal sac

name: Epipedobates currulao
readScope: Epipedobates currulao: Distribution and ecology accounts; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sections: distribution
Observed Colombian lowland localities
哥伦比亚低地的观察地点

The description reported Pacific-lowland records in Valle del Cauca, including the Buenaventura area and upper Anchicayá basin, at 0–260 m elevation. A proposed extension to Timbiquí based on photographs depended on consistent colour traits and required further investigation. It is retained as a conditional lead rather than a confirmed extension or a reassignment of every older E. boulengeri record.
原始描述报告考卡山谷省太平洋低地的记录，包括 Buenaventura 地区及 Anchicayá 上游流域，海拔 0–260 米。根据照片提出的 Timbiquí 扩展依赖颜色性状一致性的假设，仍需进一步调查。此处将其保留为有条件线索，不作为已确认扩展，也不重新归属所有历史 E. boulengeri 记录。
ecology
Daytime activity near slow water
缓流水体附近的白天活动

The researchers observed terrestrial frogs by day in agroforestry, secondary-forest edges and disturbed fragments near marshes or slow streams. Individuals moved through grass and litter and called at water edges, with greater calling activity in morning and late afternoon than during warmer sunny periods. These are local observations, not experimental proof of habitat preference, disturbance tolerance or temperature limits.
研究者白天在农林复合区域、次生林边缘及受扰动林片的沼泽或缓流附近观察到地面活动个体。个体穿行草丛、落叶并在水边鸣叫，清晨和傍晚鸣叫活动高于更暖、更晴的时段。这是地方观察，不是生境偏好、干扰耐受或温度极限的实验证明。
title: Honoring the Afro-Colombian musical culture with the naming of Epipedobates currulao sp. nov. ( Anura , Dendrobatidae ), a frog from the Pacific rainforests

name: Gracixalus truongi
readScope: Gracixalus truongi: Diagnosis, distribution and ecological notes; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sections: morphology
Lengths in the diagnostic material
鉴别材料中的体长

The diagnosis reported male snout–vent lengths of 32.2–33.1 mm and female lengths of 37.6–39.3 mm. It described smooth dorsal skin, absent vomerine teeth and male nuptial pads on the first finger. These observations describe the diagnostic material and are insufficient alone for identifying every population.

Adults were found on dead leaves or soft forest-floor soil, away from ponds and streams at the type locality. The description reported fifteen adult males at 18.2–20.6 mm snout–vent length, with mean ± standard error of 19.52 ± 0.17 mm, and three females at 21.1–24.2 mm with mean 22.87 mm. These small sample summaries are not universal adult bounds or a population-wide statistical assessment of sexual size differences.

morphology
Live colour distinguished from preservative markings
区分活体颜色与保存斑纹

The live-colour paragraph described a tan to beige upper body depending on environmental lighting and a lighter underside. The separate preservative paragraph described variable dark dorsal markings and a large round black groin ocellus, while the diagnosis emphasized the ocellus and finger/toe proportions. Males were described with slit-like vocal-sac openings on both sides of the tongue and without dorsal spinules, nuptial pads or arm glands. sections: distribution
The Machay Reserve type locality
Machay 保护区模式地点

The account knew the species only from Machay Reserve in Tungurahua, Ecuador, at 2940 m. The locality was montane cloud forest with abundant epiphytes and a bromeliad-rich understorey. This type-locality record does not establish the full modern range or physiological elevation limits.
记述当时仅从厄瓜多尔 Tungurahua 的 Machay 保护区海拔 2940 米了解本种。地点为附生植物丰富、林下凤梨科植物密集的山地云雾林。这一模式地点记录不能确立完整现代分布或生理海拔极限。
ecology
Hidden at bromeliad leaf bases
隐蔽于凤梨科叶基

All specimens in the account were found hiding at the bases of bromeliad leaves in the lower forest layer. The observation documents the collection microhabitat, without proving that the species never uses other perches or establishing its egg site, diet or complete activity cycle.
记述中的所有标本均发现于下层林中凤梨科植物叶片基部的隐蔽处。这一观察记录采集微生境，不能证明本种从不使用其他栖息位置，或确立卵的位置、食谱与完整活动周期。
morphology
Six type specimens and two locality elevations
六件模式标本及两个地点海拔

Adult female holotype DHMECN 14479 was collected in Machay Reserve on 2 March 2018 at 2970 m; five paratypes comprise two females and three males. Its snout–vent length was 22.63 mm, while the diagnosis reports males at 16.61–17.45 mm and females at 20.81–27.03 mm. These intervals describe the published material, not universal size limits or a population-level dimorphism test. The natural-history account places the type locality at 2940 m, distinct from the material-examined entry’s 2970 m; the discrepancy is not silently harmonized into one value.

成年雌性正模 DHMECN 14479 于 2018 年三月二日采自 Machay 保护区，海拔 2970 米；五件副模含两只雌性及三只雄性。正模吻肛长 22.63 毫米，鉴别报告雄性 16.61—17.45 毫米、雌性 20.81—27.03 毫米。这些区间描述发表材料，不是通用体型极限或种群层面的两性异形检验。自然史记述将模式地点置于 2940 米，与材料条目的 2970 米分开保留，不静默调和成一个值。
morphology
Conflicting head and tympanum measurements remain traceable
保持可追溯的头部及鼓膜测量冲突

The holotype measurement list gives head length 8.68 mm and width 7.36 mm but later calls the head wider than long using 12.8 versus 11.7 mm. It lists eye diameter 4.7 mm and tympanum diameter 2.5 mm, yet later states tympanum diameter as 35% of eye diameter; the diagnosis instead says 25%. These printed values and incompatible proportional summaries are retained as unresolved source conflicts. The account’s presence of a visible tympanum and weak male nuptial pads is anatomical evidence, not a hearing-performance measurement or an observation of mating success.
正模测量清单给头长 8.68 毫米、头宽 7.36 毫米，后文却用 12.8 对 11.7 毫米称头宽于长。清单给眼径 4.7 毫米及鼓膜直径 2.5 毫米，后文却称鼓膜为眼径 35%，鉴别则为 25%。保留这些印出数值及不相容比例综合为未解决来源冲突。记述鼓膜可见及雄性婚垫弱是解剖证据，不是听觉表现测量或交配成功观察。
morphology
Red hidden surfaces in a banded live holotype
带纹活体正模中的红色隐蔽面

The live holotype account described dark-brown dorsal surfaces with irregular lighter marks and bands extending to flanks and limbs. Shanks and hidden groin and armpit surfaces were red; other ventral areas were light brown with dark markings, and the iris reddish-brown. The separate 70% ethanol account retained some red regions but described brown, grey and pale banding differently, and other specimens varied in brown tones and thin middorsal lines. The authors compared this colour combination and tubercles with other regional frogs. These observed colours do not alone certify identification, toxicity, signalling or adaptive function.
活体正模记述背面深棕，较浅不规则纹及带延至体侧和四肢。胫及腹股沟、腋的隐蔽面红，其余腹面浅棕具暗纹，虹膜红棕。单列的 70% 乙醇记述保留部分红区，但棕、灰及浅色带描述不同；其他标本的棕色调及细背中线也变化。作者将此颜色组合及疣与区域其他蛙比较。这些观察颜色本身不认证鉴定、毒性、信号或适应功能。

Supported Panamanian records and a border possibility

Three egg-guarding females
三只守卵雌性

Three females were observed guarding egg clutches for at least four nights in bromeliads or on moss-covered branches. Males also called during rainy-season observations. The guarding duration is a minimum observation interval, not total care duration, and the records do not establish every population’s reproductive season or offspring survival.

Loja and nearby confirmed records
Loja 及附近确认记录

The study reported the species around Loja, southern Ecuador, and several nearby localities confirmed by DNA or call recordings, at 1937–2782 m. These named records retain their evidence scope rather than assigning the species throughout the entire city or elevation interval.

sections: distribution
The Vizcaya type-locality sample
Vizcaya 模式地点样本

The description knew the species only from Naturetek Vizcaya Reserve in Tungurahua, Ecuador, at 2400 m in mature montane cloud forest. This published locality is a sampled record, not a complete contemporary range or an elevation tolerance measurement.
原始描述当时仅从厄瓜多尔 Tungurahua 的 Naturetek Vizcaya 保护区海拔 2400 米成熟山地云雾林了解本种。这一发表地点是采样记录，不是完整当代分布或海拔耐受测量。
ecology
Five individuals in the lower forest layer
下层林中的五只个体

The five known specimens were reported from low forest vegetation, with leaf perches 60–160 cm above ground. One was found in leaf litter by day; the others were found on fern leaves at night. These individual records do not establish a strictly nocturnal pattern, exclusive fern use or the species’ full daily activity cycle.
五件已知标本报告来自下层林植被，叶片栖息位置离地 60–160 厘米。一只白天发现于落叶层，其余夜间发现于蕨叶上。这些个体记录不能确立严格夜行模式、专一使用蕨类或本种完整每日活动周期。
morphology
Type-series labels and size endpoints with unresolved conflicts
模式系列标签及体型端点中的未解决冲突

The 2022 description identifies adult male holotype DHMECN 14454, collected at Naturetrek Vizcaya on 26 February 2018 at 2404 m, and four paratypes. The paratype heading says one female and three males, but its individual entries include two adult males and a juvenile. The diagnosis gives male snout–vent length 17.61–17.8 mm and one female at 21.06 mm, whereas the holotype paragraph gives 17.86 mm. These conflicts are retained; the juvenile is not silently promoted to an adult male, nor is the holotype excluded or rounded to fit the diagnostic interval. The natural-history account’s 2400-m locality is retained separately from the 2404-m collection entry.

2022 年描述确定成年雄性正模 DHMECN 14454，于 2018 年二月二十六日采自 Naturetrek Vizcaya 海拔 2404 米，并有四件副模。副模标题称一只雌性及三只雄性，但逐件条目含两只成年雄性及一只幼体。鉴别给雄性吻肛长 17.61—17.8 毫米、单只雌性 21.06 毫米，正模段却为 17.86 毫米。保留这些冲突，不静默把幼体升为成年雄性，也不排除或四舍五入正模以适应鉴别区间。自然史记述的 2400 米地点与 2404 米采集条目分开保留。
morphology
A skin-covered ear region is not a test of hearing
皮肤覆盖的耳区不是听觉测试

The diagnosis describes a hidden tympanic region with the annulus visible beneath skin and no male vocal slits or nuptial pads. The holotype account similarly describes an undifferentiated membrane but gives annulus diameter as 33.61% of eye diameter, versus 25% in the diagnosis. It also describes toe fringes and an inner tarsal fold, whereas the diagnosis lists both as absent. These disagreements remain source-level uncertainties. A hidden external tympanum or absent vocal slit does not establish deafness, silence or a measured reproductive behaviour.
鉴别描述隐蔽鼓膜区、鼓环在皮下可见，雄性无声裂或婚垫。正模记述同样描述膜不与周围皮肤分化，但给鼓环直径为眼径 33.61%，鉴别则为 25%。正模也描述趾缘及内跗褶，鉴别却将两者列为无。这些不一致保留为来源层面不确定性。外部鼓膜隐蔽或声裂缺失不能确定失聪、无鸣声或经测量的繁殖行为。
morphology
Live browns and coppery eyes become a grey preserved pattern
活体棕色及铜色眼转为保存后的灰色纹理

The live male holotype was described as light to dark brown with dark markings outlined by golden reticulations, banded limbs and a coppery-yellow iris with black reticulation. name: Tylototriton ngoclinhensis
readScope: Tylototriton ngoclinhensis: Retained earlier individually read species anatomy, type, colour, ecology, distribution and dated conservation paragraphs; additionally read mitochondrial ND2 methods and selected raw-XML phylogenetic results, with weak placement retained; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sections: distribution
Ngoc Linh records with a reserve-boundary wording difference
Ngoc Linh 记录及保护区边界措辞差异

The 2023 distribution paragraph reported the species only from Ngoc Linh Nature Reserve, Kon Tum, while the discussion said individuals were found both inside and outside the reserve. These statements retain their different scopes rather than restricting every record to the protected boundary. The discussion anticipated other Kon Tum Plateau localities, which remain predictions. Neither paragraph supplies complete contemporary occupancy or proof that other highland forests lack the species.
2023 年分布段仅报告 Kon Tum、Ngoc Linh 自然保护区，而讨论说个体于保护区内外均发现。保留两陈述不同范围，不将每条记录限于受保护边界。讨论预期 Kon Tum 高原其他地点存在，仍为预测。两段均未提供完整当代占据或其他高地森林无本种证明。
ecology
Daytime forest-floor and shelter collections
日间林地面与庇护处采集

All study specimens were collected by day on the forest floor, beneath rotten trees or moss, near a small rocky stream. The type-locality surroundings were primary montane evergreen broadleaf forest at 1800–2300 m. Daytime collection and stream proximity do not establish diurnal surface activity, stream breeding or physiological elevation limits.
全部研究标本日间采自小岩石溪流附近林地面、腐木下或苔藓下。模式地点周围为海拔 1800—2300 米的原生山地常绿阔叶林。日间采集与靠近溪流不能确立日间表面活动、溪流繁殖或生理海拔极限。
morphology
Six types with different collection dates
采集日期不同的六件模式

Male holotype IEBR A.5130 was collected on 22 May 2022 in montane evergreen forest of Ngoc Linh, Dak Glei, Kon Tum. Five paratypes comprised two males and three females; female IEBR A.5135 was separately dated 20 May. The material paragraph printed the holotype elevation as 1.854 m, while the ecological paragraph gave surrounding forest at 1800–2300 m and the discussion said above 1800 m. The punctuation difference remains explicit; the original 1.854 notation is not presented as a literal lowland altitude or silently substituted with a separately verified point elevation.
雄性正模 IEBR A.5130 于 2022 年五月二十二日采自 Kon Tum、Dak Glei、Ngoc Linh 山地常绿林。五副模含两雄三雌，雌性 IEBR A.5135 单列五月二十日。材料段正模海拔印为 1.854 米，而生态段给周围森林 1800—2300 米、讨论称超过 1800 米。明确保留标点差异，原 1.854 记法不当作字面低地海拔，也不静默替换成另行核实点海拔。
morphology
Sexed size ranges and a ridged holotype
分性别体型范围及具脊正模

The diagnosis reported male SVL 60.8–66.5 mm and tail length 57.6–61.8 mm, and female SVL 72.5–75.6 mm with tail 62.9–67.9 mm. The holotype itself measured SVL 66.5 mm and tail 59.5 mm. It had enlarged backward-projecting parotoids, a high segmented glandular vertebral ridge and fourteen isolated rib nodules on each side. Adpressed limbs overlapped and digits lacked webbing. These are sampled anatomy and sizes, not universal adult boundaries, a measured climbing-performance result or proof that the ridges have a particular defensive function.
鉴别报告雄 SVL 60.8—66.5 毫米、尾 57.6—61.8 毫米，雌 SVL 72.5—75.6 毫米、尾 62.9—67.9 毫米。正模本身 SVL 66.5 毫米、尾 59.5 毫米，具扩大向后耳后腺、高分节腺性脊椎脊及每侧十四独立肋结节。贴体肢重叠，指趾无蹼。这是采样解剖及尺寸，不是通用成体边界、测量攀爬表现结果或脊具特定防御功能证明。
morphology
Live orange markings and a small-sample sex comparison
活体橙纹及小样本性别比较

Live ground colour was black with orange on parts of the head, rib nodules, vertebral ridge, cloacal periphery and ventral tail edge; finger and toe tips and elbows were orange-brown. Preservation changed the background to blackish-brown and faded orange to pale yellow. The authors described males as probably smaller than females but explicitly requested confirmation because of the small sample. Male inner cloacal papillae and a longer slit were contrasted with the female short slit lacking papillae. These observations remain sample-specific, not a quantified mating mechanism or universally established size dimorphism.
活体背景黑，部分头、肋结节、脊椎脊、泄殖腔周缘及尾腹缘橙，指趾尖及肘橙棕。保存后背景黑棕、橙褪浅黄。作者称雄很可能小于雌，但明确因样本少而要求确认。雄内泄殖腔乳突及长裂隙对比雌短裂隙、无乳突。观察保持样本特定，不是量化交配机制或普遍确定体型异形。

A dated southernmost-record claim and geographic distance
有日期最南记录声明及地理距离

The authors called this the first Central Highlands crocodile-newt record and the southernmost known genus record at publication. They estimated approximately 370 air kilometres to the nearest T. notialis population in Laos and predicted other Kon Tum Plateau sites. Air distance is not travelled dispersal distance, and a geographical gap does not establish a measured reproductive barrier or species age. The regional climate values and Ngoc Linh summit height in the discussion are environmental context rather than critical thermal limits or the elevation of every collected newt.
作者称这是发表时首个中部高原鳄螈记录及属最南已知记录，估计至 Laos 最近 T. notialis 种群约 370 直线千米，预测 Kon Tum 高原其他地点。直线距离不是实际扩散路程，地理空缺不确定测量生殖屏障或物种年龄。讨论的区域气候值及 Ngoc Linh 峰高为环境背景，不是临界温度极限或每只采集螈海拔。
ecology
A provisional Endangered recommendation from 2023
2023 年暂定濒危建议

The paper proposed Endangered under B1ab(i,iii), estimating extent of occurrence below 500 km² and citing habitat degradation from forest-product exploitation, tourism and agriculture, plus potential collector interest in the colourful animal. These are attributed threats and a dated proposal; EOO is not area of occupancy or a population census. The paragraph cited trade and Vietnamese regulations as of its publication. That historical legal statement is not an independently verified current regulatory determination, and occurrence in a reserve does not prove every population is protected or secure.
论文按 B1ab(i,iii) 提议濒危，估计分布范围面积低于 500 平方千米，援引林产品利用、旅游、农业生境退化及彩色动物可能吸引采集者。这是归属威胁及有日期提议，分布范围面积不是占据面积或种群普查。该段引述发表时贸易及越南法规，历史法律陈述不是独立核实当前法规判定，位于保护区不证明每个种群受保护或安全。
taxonomy
ND2 separation does not fully resolve the nearest sampled relationships
ND2 分离未完全解决最近受采亲缘关系

The 2023 study used mitochondrial ND2 and an alignment of 1,035 positions, comparing the Kon Tum population with thirty-three examined Tylototriton species. Reported uncorrected distances span 6.77% to panhai and 12.36% to ngarsuensis. These are marker-specific sample comparisons, not a universal species threshold or nuclear-genomic isolation test. The population clusters with panhai and vietnamensis in clade B, but the authors explicitly report nonsignificant support, printing 0.83 and 60%; later calling panhai a sister species does not resolve that weak placement. The 2025 corrigendum changes three deposited-sequence accession identifiers, not an independently reanalysed tree or newly measured distance. The reader links the correction separately and retains the original study’s uncertainty.

Under its 2019 species treatment, the review described records across western, central and eastern Europe at 0–810 m. It included southern Scandinavian and Baltic coastal records, northern Italian populations particularly in the Po Valley, and isolated populations in central France and western Bulgaria. The eastern contact with P. vespertinus was described from Russia’s Kursk region toward the Black Sea. These boundaries belong to the review’s taxonomic and geographic synthesis; previously pooled conservation assessments and cited declines are not treated as a current species-specific status evaluation.
在其 2019 年物种处理中，综述描述欧洲西部、中部及东部海拔 0—810 米记录，包括斯堪的纳维亚南部及波罗的海沿岸、意大利北部尤其波河谷种群，以及法国中部、保加利亚西部孤立种群。与 P. vespertinus 的东部接触带被描述为从俄罗斯 Kursk 地区向黑海延伸。这些界限属于该综述的分类及地理综合；此前合并物种的保护评估及引用的衰退不作为当前本种专属状态评估。

sections: reproduction
Young retained in the male vocal sac until metamorphosis
雄性声囊内保留至变态的幼体

The 2013 paper summarized earlier observations of male parental care: developing young are incubated in the vocal sac and released after metamorphosis. It contrasted this with R. rufum, whose larvae are released into water before metamorphosis. This life-history comparison is cited background, rather than a new breeding experiment in the survey.

distribution
Presence evidence from the 2008–2012 surveys
2008—2012 年调查的存在证据

Surveys across Chile and Argentina from October 2008 to March 2012 found this frog at 36 sites grouped into 26 areas. The authors grouped sites less than 2 km apart as subpopulations, using a working distance rule based on other amphibians. Ten additional areas had a single encounter or reliable outside information and were excluded from abundance analysis because population status was uncertain. These are dated detections and study grouping rules, not independently verified present occupancy or genetic population boundaries.
2008 年十月至 2012 年三月智利及阿根廷调查在 36 个地点发现此蛙，并将其归为 26 个区域。作者依据其他两栖动物研究采用工作距离规则，把相距不足 2 公里的地点归作亚种群。另有十个区域仅有单次遭遇或可靠外部信息，由于种群状况不确定而未纳入数量分析。这些是有年代限定的检出及研究分组规则，不是独立验证的当代占据或遗传种群边界。
ecology
Forest mosaics and near-ground measurements
森林镶嵌环境与近地面测量

The study found frogs both in small forest openings and in some sites with at least 90% mature forest cover. Monitored microhabitats combined native forest with short vegetation, moss or woody debris. Daytime measurements during austral spring and summer, taken 1–2 cm above ground, recorded relative humidity above 70% and air temperature below 22 °C. The authors proposed habitat requirements from these observations, but the readings are field conditions rather than experimentally established minimum humidity or maximum temperature limits.
研究在小型林间开地及一些成熟林覆盖至少 90% 的地点发现蛙。监测微生境结合原生林与低矮植被、苔藓或木质残体。南半球春夏白天在离地 1—2 厘米处测量，记录相对湿度超过 70%、气温低于 22 °C。作者据此提出生境要求，但这些读数属于野外条件，而非实验确立的最低湿度或最高温度极限。
conservation
The study’s decline inference and remaining uncertainty
研究的衰退推断及剩余不确定性

The authors inferred decline from range contraction, anecdotal abundance changes and local disappearances, including protected sites. They explicitly lacked earlier abundance measurements, so the magnitude of population decline could not be accurately calculated. Their proposed 2013 reassessment to at least Endangered was a recommendation; it is not presented here as a current IUCN listing or proof of a single cause of decline.
作者根据分布收缩、数量变化的轶事信息及包括保护地在内的地方消失推断衰退。文中明确缺少此前数量测量，因而无法准确计算种群下降幅度。作者在 2013 年提出至少重新评为濒危的建议；此处不将其作为当前 IUCN 名录或单一衰退原因的证明。
title: The Population Decline and Extinction of Darwin’s Frogs

sections: reproduction

The paper’s cited life-history comparison described males incubating young in the vocal sac, then releasing larvae into water before metamorphosis. R. darwinii instead retains its young until metamorphosis. This is a synthesis of earlier observations, and the 2008–2012 survey did not observe breeding by R. rufum.

conservation
No detections during a dated historical-range search
有年代限定的历史分布区搜索未检出

The study surveyed 223 sites across the two Darwin’s frogs’ historical ranges, including 46 in the range of R. rufum alone and 20 in their overlap. It neither saw nor heard R. rufum. Daylight searches were conducted in October–March; the study classified a site as absent only after at least two visits in different years, each lasting at least five hours. This effort supports the reported nondetection, without turning it into proof of global extinction or present-day absence.
研究在两种达尔文蛙历史分布区共调查 223 个地点，其中 46 个仅属于 R. rufum 历史分布、20 个位于重叠区。研究未看见或听到 R. rufum。白天搜索安排于十月至三月；研究仅在不同年份至少两次访问、每次至少五小时后才将地点归为缺失。这些投入支持所报告的未检出，不能转化为全球灭绝或当代不存在的证明。
conservation
A 2013 possibly-extinct recommendation
2013 年可能灭绝的评估建议

The discussion reported the last recorded detection as 1980 and considered surviving populations still possible somewhere in the historical range. It recommended consideration as Critically Endangered (Possibly Extinct). Both the last-record date and the recommendation are the paper’s 2013 evidence and interpretation; no later search outcome or current conservation assessment is asserted here.
讨论报告最后一次记录检出为 1980 年，并认为历史分布区某处仍可能有存活种群。作者建议考虑极危（可能灭绝）。末次记录日期及建议均属于论文在 2013 年的证据与解释；此处未断言后续搜索结果或当前保护评估。

Two males above a roadside puddle
路旁水洼上方的两只雄性

On 12 March 2023, the authors recorded two males at San Pablo, Cañar, Ecuador, at 420 m elevation. They perched on a branch 120–190 cm above a puddle beside a secondary road. Vouchers ZSFQ5182 and ZSFQ5183 measured 64 and 62 mm snout–vent length. The survey found them at that road edge rather than in the lightly disturbed forest it searched; this local contrast does not demonstrate a general preference for roads or an egg-laying site.
2023 年 3 月 12 日，作者在厄瓜多尔 Cañar 的 San Pablo 海拔 420 米记录两只雄性。个体停栖于次级道路旁水洼上方 120—190 厘米的枝条。凭证 ZSFQ5182、ZSFQ5183 吻肛长分别为 64、62 毫米。调查在该路缘发现个体，而非所搜索的轻度扰动林地；这一当地对比不能证明一般道路偏好或产卵地点。

A locality inside a reported information gap
报告信息缺口内的一个地点

The authors described the new Cañar record as filling a 328 km information gap along Ecuador’s western Andean foothills, between nearby records 189 km to the north and 159 km to the south. methods
Non-systematic records have explicit timing and measurement limits
非系统记录有明确时间与测量限制

The article uses free, unrestricted visual searches and manual captures rather than equal-effort detection sampling. Methods describe January2014–December2023 expeditions, but the species accounts also contain a2008 alytolylax and February2024 muricatus record; those dates remain visible instead of being forced into the stated window. GPS elevations are encounter values, distinct from camp elevations. Small-animal SVLs are said to be rounded to0.1 mm, while many printed records contain two decimals; they are retained as reported without certifying finer precision. Tissue collection and deposited vouchers are provenance claims, not independently inspected specimens or newly reported genetic identifications.

A tiny terrestrial frog known from Maharira
从 Maharira 已知的微小地栖蛙

The 2019 description knew this terrestrial frog only from Maharira in Ranomafana National Park, Madagascar. Its single known specimen was an adult male collected on 25 January 2004 at a campsite at about 1248 m elevation and measured 11.3 mm snout–vent length. That measurement describes one male, not a sampled adult size range. The authors explicitly reported very little natural-history information and recommended Data Deficient while more range and ecological data were needed.

Calls recorded at 08:45 on 26 January 2004 in primary-rainforest litter at Maharira were tentatively assigned to this species. The holotype had been found where similar calls were heard and had an apparently partly inflated vocal sac, but the recorded caller was unidentified. The calls followed cyclonic rainfall and retreating flooding. The authors emphasized similarity to Stumpffia miery and the need for confirmation; these recordings therefore are not presented as securely identified species calls or evidence of a fixed rain-triggered behavior.

Community differences associated with previous land use
与此前土地利用相关的群落差异

Across the sampled A. cafetalera, skin bacterial communities differed between the two former land-use categories using both unweighted and weighted UniFrac comparisons. Overall alpha-diversity tests were reported as showing no category difference. These are observational microbial associations, not a controlled demonstration that land use caused altered disease resistance. Some stratified alpha-diversity wording and the figure caption do not agree clearly with the printed statistics, so a categorical conclusion for those subsets is withheld.

health

The paper reported four Bd-positive samples from A. cafetalera. Its total of five positives among 111 swabbed salamanders pooled six species, with the other positive from Parvimolge townsendi. The pooled denominator is not used to calculate an A. cafetalera infection prevalence, and a positive sample is not by itself evidence of clinical disease or mortality.

The monograph reported records across the Wanyang, Jiuling and Mufu mountains near the Jiangxi–Hunan border at 400–1200 m. Examined material included Jinggang, Wugong, Meiling, Jiuling and other mountain localities; the female holotype SYS a001430 came from Jinggang at 845 m. The geographic summary concerns that study’s material and taxonomic treatment, without proving continuous occupancy or a present population-density pattern.

Reported diagnostic measurements with sex and sample size

The diagnosis reported 49 adult males at 33.9–48.9 mm snout–vent length and 21 females at 38.4–52.6 mm. It described an unnotched tongue, distinct tympanum, weak vomerine ridges with teeth, dorsal granules and tubercles with short irregular ridges, and rudimentary toe webbing with narrow fringes. These are the printed diagnostic sample totals, not an independently recounted voucher census or population-wide size limits.

taxonomy
A conspecificity decision after competing lineage interpretations

The authors discussed earlier molecular suggestions that Jiuling and Meiling populations could be cryptic species distinct from Jinggang topotypes. The cited ABGD analysis instead grouped the three populations. The monograph found no distinguishing morphological characters across its examined localities and treated them as B. jinggangensis. This is an attributed taxonomic conclusion under that study, without independent certification of current concept equivalence or absence of reproductive isolation.

Breeding males were described with a subgular vocal sac but without nuptial pads or spines. These characters and measurements concern the examined series; no female measurement was supplied in this diagnosis.
检查模式系列含十只成年雄性，鉴别吻肛长为 30.5—37.3 毫米。鉴别描述背部皮肤粗糙、背面断续 X 形棱、趾基部退化蹼及狭窄趾侧缘。繁殖雄性被描述为具有咽下声囊而无婚垫或婚刺。这些特征与测量对应检查系列；本段鉴别未提供雌性测量。
taxonomy
Conflicting delimitation evidence kept visible
保留存在分歧的物种界定证据

The remarks reported that Liu and colleagues (2018) proposed the Jiangxi and Guangdong populations, labelled M. sp6 and M. sp7, as possible cryptic species, although their ABGD analysis grouped them together. Further morphological examination found no distinguishing characters, and Wang and colleagues (2019) treated them as conspecific. The monograph reports this reasoning; it does not provide an independent demonstration of reproductive compatibility.
备注报告 Liu 等（2018）曾将标记为 M. sp6、M. sp7 的江西及广东种群提出为可能的隐存种，尽管其 ABGD 分析将二者归为同种。后续形态检查未找到可区分特征，Wang 等（2019）遂将其处理为同种。专著记录了这套推理，但未独立证明其生殖相容性。
title: Generic classification of Asian horned toads (Anura: Megophryidae: Megophryinae) and monograph of Chinese species

name: Boulenophrys obesa

sections: distribution
Heishiding type-locality records
黑石顶模式地点记录

Male holotype SYS a002275 was recorded from Heishiding Nature Reserve, Fengkai, Guangdong, at 399.2 m. Citing Li and colleagues (2014), the monograph knew the species only from that type locality at 399–435 m. This is the locality knowledge reported by the treatment, not proof of absence elsewhere or a physiological elevation limit.
雄性正模 SYS a002275 记录于广东封开黑石顶自然保护区海拔 399.2 米。专著引用 Li 等（2014），仅从该模式地点海拔 399—435 米已知本种。这是该处理报告的地点知识，不能证明其他地点缺失或确定生理海拔极限。
morphology
Measurements retain the uneven sex sample
测量保留不均衡的性别样本

The examined type material consisted of one adult male and six adult females. The male measured 35.6 mm snout–vent length; females measured 37.5–41.2 mm. The single male value is not a male size range, and this small, uneven sample does not establish a population-wide distribution of body size or a statistical estimate of sexual dimorphism.
检查模式材料含一只成年雄性及六只成年雌性。雄性吻肛长为 35.6 毫米，雌性为 37.5—41.2 毫米。单只雄性数值不是雄性体型范围，这组小且不均衡的样本也不能确定种群体型分布或两性异形的统计估计。
morphology
Diagnostic limbs, skin and oral characters
四肢、皮肤及口腔鉴别特征

The diagnosis reported vomerine ridges without vomerine teeth and a smooth dorsum with scattered granules, tubercles and an interrupted X-shaped ridge. Hindlimbs were robust; the heels did not meet when the hindlimbs were folded. Toes had rudimentary basal webbing without lateral fringes. The collected male had a subgular vocal sac and lacked nuptial pads or spines. These are anatomical descriptions, not evidence of locomotor performance or breeding behaviour.
鉴别报告有犁骨棱而无犁骨齿，背面光滑，散有颗粒、疣粒及断续 X 形棱。后肢粗壮，折叠后肢时两跟不相接。趾基部有退化蹼而无侧缘。采集雄性具有咽下声囊，无婚垫或婚刺。这些是解剖描述，不能据此确定运动表现或繁殖行为。
title: Generic classification of Asian horned toads (Anura: Megophryidae: Megophryinae) and monograph of Chinese species

name: Boulenophrys ombrophila
readScope: Boulenophrys ombrophila: Named species type material, examined specimens, distribution, diagnosis and remarks; no source figures or supplements reproduced; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

RESULTS > Boulenophrys ombrophila; Holotype including Paratypes, Specimens examined and Diagnosis character 1; reading-sections index 66, section s03.82
RESULTS > Boulenophrys ombrophila; Diagnosis characters 4, 5, 9 and 11; reading-sections index 66, section s03.82
RESULTS > Boulenophrys ombrophila; Remarks; reading-sections index 66, section s03.82
sections: distribution
Separated regional locality sets
分开的区域地点组

Male holotype WUYI 2014101 came from a bamboo plantation outside Guadun Village, Mount Wuyi, Fujian, at 1242 m. The distribution summary separated the Jiangxi–Guangdong–Hunan border localities, including Jiulian, Gaoping Reservoir, Tianjing, Nanshui Reservoir and Mangshan at 400–990 m, from the isolated Wuyi locality at 1125–1350 m. One holotype in a bamboo plantation does not establish a species-wide habitat preference, and these locality sets do not demonstrate a continuous range.
雄性正模 WUYI 2014101 来自福建武夷山挂墩村外竹林，海拔 1242 米。分布综合分别列出江西、广东及湖南交界地点，包括九连山、高坪水库、天井山、南水水库及莽山海拔 400—990 米，以及分离的武夷山地点海拔 1125—1350 米。一只竹林正模不能确定全种栖息地偏好，这些地点组也不能证明连续分布。
morphology
Examined measurements distinguished from type counts
区分检查测量与模式标本计数

The diagnosis for the examined series reported 27 adult males at 28.4–37.0 mm snout–vent length and one adult female at 42.1 mm. These were specimens from Jiulian, Gaoping, Tianjing and Nanshui. The separately listed Wuyi type material comprised the male holotype, four male and four female paratypes, and a road-killed paratype of unknown sex. That unknown-sex specimen is not added to either sex denominator, and the diagnostic measurements are not presented as measurements of every listed type.
检查系列鉴别报告 27 只成年雄性吻肛长 28.4—37.0 毫米、一只成年雌性 42.1 毫米，标本来自九连山、高坪、天井山及南水。另列武夷山模式材料包括雄性正模、四只雄性及四只雌性副模，还有一只性别未知的路杀副模。性别未知标本不加入任一性别分母，鉴别测量也不作为所有所列模式标本的测量。
morphology
Unwebbed toes and male nuptial spines
无蹼趾与雄性婚刺

The diagnosis described neither vomerine ridges nor vomerine teeth, a relatively rough dorsum with interrupted V-shaped or X-shaped ridges, and toes without webbing or lateral fringes. Breeding adult males had nuptial spines on the dorsal bases of fingers I and II and a subgular vocal sac. These sampled diagnostic traits do not supply a breeding season, mating-system description or measured functional explanation for the spines.
鉴别描述无犁骨棱及犁骨齿，背面较粗糙，具有断续 V 形或 X 形棱，趾无蹼及侧缘。繁殖成年雄性第一及第二指基部背侧具有婚刺，并有咽下声囊。这些样本鉴别特征未提供繁殖季节、交配制度描述或经测量的婚刺功能解释。
taxonomy
Conspecificity interpretation with acoustic disagreement
存在声学分歧的同种解释

The remarks traced the Longnan and Renhua populations labelled M. sp8 and M. sp9 from a possible cryptic-species interpretation to a conspecific treatment. The authors cited small genetic divergences and found no distinguishing morphology from the Wuyi type series, despite the separated distributions. They also retained a reported acoustic difference between M. sp9 and B. ombrophila. Limited data or geographic isolation were suggested explanations for that disagreement; neither explanation was established as a cause, and the acoustic conflict remains part of the evidence.
备注追溯标记为 M. sp8、M. sp9 的龙南及仁化种群由可能隐存种解释转为同种处理的过程。作者引用较小遗传分歧，并未发现与武夷山模式系列可区分的形态，尽管分布彼此分离。文中同时保留 M. sp9 与 B. ombrophila 的已报告声学差异。数据有限或地理隔离是对该分歧提出的可能解释，均未确定为原因；声学冲突仍是证据的一部分。
title: Generic classification of Asian horned toads (Anura: Megophryidae: Megophryinae) and monograph of Chinese species

Longkeng type-locality records
龙坑模式地点记录

Male holotype SYS a005770 came from Longkeng Village, Daping, Puning, Guangdong, at approximately 120 m. The monograph cited Wang and colleagues (2022) for records only from the Puning type locality at 120–300 m. These dated locality records do not establish absence elsewhere or a measured elevation tolerance.

morphology
Six examined adults
六只检查成体

Four adult males and two adult females formed the examined type material. Diagnostic snout–vent lengths were 31.7–34.6 mm for males and 37.8–38.3 mm for females. These measurements retain the reported sample counts and do not define universal size limits or a statistical estimate of differences between sexes.
检查模式材料由四只成年雄性及两只成年雌性组成。鉴别吻肛长为雄性 31.7—34.6 毫米、雌性 37.8—38.3 毫米。这些测量保留报告样本计数，不能定义通用体型极限或两性差异的统计估计。
morphology
Spiny tubercles and male nuptial pads
具刺疣粒与雄性婚垫

The diagnosis described vomerine ridges and teeth, rough granular dorsal skin with conical tubercles, and large ventral tubercles. Tubercles on the posterior belly, ventral thighs and around the cloaca bore tiny spines. Toes had rudimentary basal webbing without lateral fringes. Breeding males had nuptial pads carrying fine, dense black spines on the dorsal bases of fingers I and II and a subgular vocal sac. These are sampled anatomical characters; their functional effects and breeding season were not established in this treatment.
鉴别描述有犁骨棱及齿，背部皮肤粗糙呈颗粒状并具锥形疣粒，腹面有大疣粒。腹后部、股腹面及泄殖腔周围疣粒带微小刺。趾基部有退化蹼而无侧缘。繁殖雄性第一及第二指基部背侧婚垫带细密黑刺，并有咽下声囊。这些为样本解剖特征；该处理未确定其功能效应或繁殖季节。

sections: distribution
Locality list and elevation-summary discrepancy
地点列表与海拔综合差异

Male holotype SYS a002498 came from Longqi Mountain, Jiangle, Fujian, at about 700 m. The broader summary described hilly localities in Fujian, Jiangxi and Guangdong at 500–1250 m. However, the examined-specimen list explicitly included six males from Emeifeng, Taining, at about 1500 m. The higher specimen locality is retained separately rather than silently forced inside the narrower summary; the treatment does not resolve this discrepancy or prove continuous occupancy.
雄性正模 SYS a002498 来自福建将乐龙栖山约 700 米。较广分布综合描述福建、江西及广东丘陵地点海拔 500—1250 米。然而检查标本列表明确包括泰宁峨嵋峰约 1500 米的六只雄性。较高标本地点单独保留，不将其默默塞入较窄综合范围；该处理未解决此差异或证明连续占据。
morphology
Reported adult measurements and toe fringes
报告成体测量与趾侧缘

The diagnosis reported 26 adult males at 26.4–32.4 mm snout–vent length and two adult females at 29.5–34.7 mm. It described neither vomerine ridges nor teeth, rudimentary basal toe webbing with wide lateral fringes, and male nuptial spines on the dorsal bases of fingers I and II, with a subgular vocal sac. These diagnostic sample counts and characters do not establish population-wide size limits or reproductive timing.
鉴别报告 26 只成年雄性吻肛长 26.4—32.4 毫米、两只成年雌性 29.5—34.7 毫米。描述无犁骨棱及齿，趾基部有退化蹼且具宽侧缘，雄性第一及第二指基部背侧具有婚刺，并有咽下声囊。这些鉴别样本计数及特征不能确定整个种群体型极限或繁殖时间。
taxonomy
Adult evidence added to an earlier tadpole comparison
为早期蝌蚪比较增加成体证据

The remarks reported earlier possible cryptic-species labels M. sp15 for Sanming and M. sp16 for Chaozhou, although ABGD grouped them together. The 2021 description included Chaozhou in the distribution but had only two Chaozhou tadpoles available. The monograph added Chaozhou adults and found no distinguishing morphology from Sanming, Longyan and Fuzhou material, treating these populations as conspecific. This is the authors’ evidence-based interpretation, not an independent reproductive-compatibility test.
备注报告三明及潮州种群曾分别被标记为可能隐存种 M. sp15、M. sp16，尽管 ABGD 将其归为同种。2021 年描述把潮州列入分布，但当时仅有两只潮州蝌蚪。专著增加潮州成体，未发现可与三明、龙岩及抚州材料区分的形态，遂将这些种群处理为同种。这是作者依据证据作出的解释，不是独立的生殖相容性测试。

Northern Guangdong and southern Hunan localities
广东北部及湖南最南部地点

Male holotype SYS a004710 came from Shimentai Nature Reserve, Yingde, Guangdong, at approximately 370 m. The examined series also included Nanling material at about 1160 m and a Tianjing female at about 990 m. The distribution summary included Shimentai, Luokeng and Nanling in northern Guangdong and Mangshan in southernmost Hunan at 210–1200 m. The examined specimens and the wider summary are separate evidence sets and do not demonstrate occupancy at every intervening elevation.

morphology
Twenty males and one female
二十只雄性及一只雌性

The monograph examined twelve male types, eight additional Nanling males and one Tianjing female. The diagnosis reported male snout–vent lengths of 25.8–30.6 mm (n=20) and one female at 34.5 mm. The single female value is retained as one measurement, not a female range or a population estimate of sexual size differences.
专著检查十二只雄性模式标本、另外八只南岭雄性及一只天井山雌性。鉴别报告雄性吻肛长 25.8—30.6 毫米（n=20），单只雌性为 34.5 毫米。单只雌性数值保留为一次测量，不作为雌性范围或种群两性体型差异估计。
morphology
Tiny skin spines and population-marking differences
细小皮肤刺与种群斑纹差异

The diagnosis described tiny dark spines across the dorsum, flanks, dorsal limbs, cloacal region and rear of the hindlimbs, with rudimentary basal toe webbing and narrow lateral fringes. It distinguished dark upper-eyelid stripes in the Yingde population from an incomplete interorbital triangular marking in the Ruyuan population. Breeding males had weak nuptial pads with densely arranged olive-coloured spines on fingers I and II and a subgular vocal sac. The reported marking variation is preserved within this treatment; it is not converted into a species-delimitation conclusion.
鉴别描述背面、体侧、四肢背面、泄殖腔周围及后肢后部具有细小深色刺，趾基部有退化蹼及狭窄侧缘。文中区分英德种群上眼睑深色条纹与乳源种群眼间不完整三角斑。繁殖雄性第一及第二指具有较弱婚垫及密集橄榄色婚刺，并有咽下声囊。所报告斑纹变异保留在该处理范围内，不转化为物种界定结论。

morphology
Guangxi measurements kept separate from the type list
广西测量与模式列表分开保留

morphology
Reported dorsal and breeding-male characters
报告背部及繁殖雄性特征

The diagnosis described no vomerine ridges or teeth, a mostly smooth dorsum with scattered granules and tubercles, and rudimentary basal toe webbing without lateral fringes. Breeding males had nuptial pads bearing tiny, dense spines on the dorsal bases of fingers I and II and a subgular vocal sac. These anatomical observations do not establish reproductive timing or the functional performance of the limbs or spines.

sections: distribution
Pingxi type-locality knowledge
平溪模式地点知识

Male holotype SYS a003228 came from Pingxi on Tongbo Mountain, Guangfeng, Jiangxi, at approximately 1100 m. That narrow reported interval is not a measured physiological limit or evidence that other elevations lack the species.

morphology
Five males with unwebbed toes

The examined type series contained five adult males with diagnostic snout–vent lengths of 26.5–31.5 mm. Collected males had a subgular vocal sac but no nuptial pads or spines. No female measurement was supplied in this diagnosis; the male sample does not establish female morphology or population-wide size limits.
检查模式系列含五只成年雄性，鉴别吻肛长为 26.5—31.5 毫米。鉴别描述鼓膜可见但前缘不清，有犁骨棱及齿，趾无蹼及侧缘。采集雄性有咽下声囊而无婚垫或婚刺。本段鉴别未提供雌性测量；雄性样本不能确定雌性形态或整个种群体型极限。

sections: distribution
Two mountain localities in northwestern Hunan
湖南西北部的两个山地地点

The monograph listed male holotype HNNU 03080902 from Tianzishan Nature Reserve, Sangzhi, Hunan, at 1130 m, and newly examined male SYS a004310 from Tianping Mountain at approximately 1380 m. It summarized known distribution as Tianzishan and Tianping at 1000–1380 m, citing earlier work and its own specimen. This dated locality summary is not a population census or proof of continuous occupancy.
专著列雄性正模 HNNU 03080902 来自湖南桑植天子山自然保护区海拔 1130 米，新检查雄性 SYS a004310 来自天平山约 1380 米。综合已知分布为天子山及天平山海拔 1000—1380 米，引用既往工作及自身标本。此有年代限定的地点综合不是种群普查或连续占据证明。
morphology
A newly examined male exceeds the earlier sample range
新检查雄性超过早期样本范围

The diagnosis separately reported earlier male snout–vent lengths of 33.2–40.3 mm for nine individuals, attributed to Fei and Ye (2016), and a 44.0 mm male examined in this study. The earlier female value was 50.5 mm for one individual. The 44.0 mm observation is not removed to fit the earlier range; the samples remain separate rather than being presented as one uniformly measured series or a universal size bound.
鉴别分别报告归于 Fei 与 Ye（2016）的九只早期雄性吻肛长 33.2—40.3 毫米，以及本研究检查的一只 44.0 毫米雄性。早期雌性数值为单只 50.5 毫米。44.0 毫米观察不为符合早期范围而被删除；样本分别保留，不作为统一测量系列或通用体型界限。
morphology
Diagnostic skin characters and collection-name changes
皮肤鉴别特征及馆藏名称变更

The diagnosis combined previous descriptions and examined material, describing no vomerine ridges or teeth, granular dorsal skin with weak or absent interrupted X-shaped ridges, and rudimentary basal toe webbing without lateral fringes. Breeding males were described with black nuptial spines on finger I and II pads and a subgular vocal sac. The remarks changed the collection abbreviation from HNUL to HNNU, attributing this to personal communication, and adjusted the epithet to tuberogranulata. These nomenclatural changes are not new specimens or biological discoveries.
鉴别结合既往描述与检查材料，描述无犁骨棱及齿，背面皮肤呈颗粒状，断续 X 形棱较弱或缺失，趾基部具有退化蹼而无侧缘。繁殖雄性第一及第二指婚垫带黑色婚刺，并有咽下声囊。备注将馆藏缩写从 HNUL 改为 HNNU，注明依据个人通信，并把种加词调整为 tuberogranulata。这些命名变化不是新增标本或生物学发现。

sections: distribution
Wugongshan and neighbouring mountain records
武功山及邻近山地记录

The male holotype was recorded from Yangshimu Scenic Area, Luxi, Jiangxi, at 550 m. The monograph summarized Wugongshan, neighbouring Yangshimu, Dawei and Mufu mountain records along the Hunan–Jiangxi border at 550–1200 m. These recorded mountain localities do not establish continuous occupancy between them or a physiological elevation range.
雄性正模记录于江西芦溪羊狮慕景区海拔 550 米。专著综合湖南及江西交界武功山、邻近羊狮慕、大围山及幕阜山记录，海拔 550—1200 米。这些已记录山地地点不能确定其间连续占据或生理海拔范围。
morphology
Examined adult measurements and rough dorsal skin
检查成体测量与粗糙背部皮肤

The diagnosis reported eight adult males at 30.9–34.1 mm snout–vent length and nine adult females at 38.5–42.8 mm. The examined series combined the type material with additional Dawei and Mufu males. It described weak vomerine ridges without teeth, rough densely granular dorsal skin with an interrupted X-shaped ridge, and rudimentary basal toe webbing without lateral fringes. These sample measurements and anatomical descriptions are not population-wide size limits or measures of locomotor performance.
鉴别报告八只成年雄性吻肛长 30.9—34.1 毫米、九只成年雌性 38.5—42.8 毫米。检查系列结合模式材料及另外的大围山、幕阜山雄性。描述犁骨棱较弱而无齿，背面皮肤粗糙、颗粒密集并有断续 X 形棱，趾基部具有退化蹼而无侧缘。这些样本测量及解剖描述不是种群体型极限或运动表现测量。
morphology
Revision of contradictory nuptial-pad statements
修订相互矛盾的婚垫表述

The remarks identified contradictory statements in the original description: a comparison referred to male nuptial pads and spines, while its habits discussion said they were not visible and that the breeding season remained unknown. After re-examining types and newly collected specimens, the monograph revised the character to dark nuptial pads with dense spines on the dorsal bases of fingers I and II in breeding males. Males also had a subgular vocal sac. This attributed anatomical revision does not by itself determine a breeding-season calendar.
备注指出原始描述中相互矛盾的表述：比较段提及雄性婚垫及婚刺，习性讨论却称未见这些结构、繁殖季节仍未知。重新检查模式及新采集标本后，专著将特征修订为繁殖雄性第一及第二指基部背侧有深色婚垫及密集婚刺。雄性也有咽下声囊。这项注明归属的解剖修订本身不能确定繁殖季节日历。

sections: distribution
Wushan and Daba mountain locality knowledge
巫山及大巴山地点知识

The monograph listed male holotype CIB 98012, formerly CIB 571991, from Miaotang, now Wulipo Nature Reserve, Wushan, at 1200 m, retaining the historical Sichuan attribution and current Chongqing administration. It examined five males from Wenshui Forest Station, Shennongjia, Hubei, at about 1490 m. Its broader summary included Wushan and Daba mountain localities along Hubei, Chongqing, Sichuan, Shaanxi and Gansu borders at 900–1500 m; this is a locality summary, not a census or continuous-range demonstration.
专著列雄性正模 CIB 98012（原 CIB 571991）来自巫山庙堂、现五里坡自然保护区海拔 1200 米，保留历史四川归属及现重庆行政区划。检查湖北神农架温水林场约 1490 米的五只雄性。更广综合包括湖北、重庆、四川、陕西及甘肃交界巫山与大巴山地点海拔 900—1500 米；这是地点综合，而非普查或连续分布证明。
morphology
Historical and newly examined measurements
历史及新检查测量

The diagnosis attributed male snout–vent lengths of 30.4–35.5 mm (n=10) and one female at 38.4 mm to Ye and Fei (1995). The five males examined in the monograph measured 31.4–32.9 mm. Historical and newly examined samples remain separate, and the single female value is not expanded into a female range or treated as a population-level estimate.
鉴别将雄性吻肛长 30.4—35.5 毫米（n=10）及单只雌性 38.4 毫米归于 Ye 与 Fei（1995）。专著检查的五只雄性为 31.4—32.9 毫米。历史与新检查样本分别保留，单只雌性数值不扩展为雌性范围或作为种群层面的估计。
morphology
Toe-fringe differences require more females
趾侧缘差异需要更多雌性材料

Earlier descriptions reported rudimentary basal webbing and relatively wide toe fringes in males but neither character in females. The monograph noted that only one female, the allotype, supported the female comparison and treated that observation as variation rather than a diagnosis, requesting further female specimens. Its male diagnosis retained brown nuptial spines on fingers I and II and a subgular vocal sac. The one-female comparison does not establish a general sex-specific toe difference.
早期描述报告雄性趾基部具有退化蹼及较宽侧缘，而雌性二者均无。专著指出雌性比较仅由一只异模支持，将该观察视为变异而非鉴别，并要求更多雌性标本。雄性鉴别保留第一及第二指棕色婚刺及咽下声囊。单只雌性比较不能确定普遍的性别专属趾差异。

sections: distribution
Hunan–Guangxi records with a conflicting remarks label
湖南及广西记录与备注地名冲突

Male holotype SYS a002875 came from Yangming Mountain, Shuangpai, Hunan, at about 1360 m. The distribution paragraph placed multiple localities along the Hunan–Guangxi border at 500–1600 m, including Jiuyi, Yangming, Mao’er, Haiyang, Dupangling and Xiling. In contrast, one remarks sentence referred to the Hunan–Jiangxi border. That wording conflicts with the named distribution and examined-locality context and is retained as an unresolved source discrepancy rather than adding Jiangxi to the range.
雄性正模 SYS a002875 来自湖南双牌阳明山约 1360 米。分布段将多个地点列于湖南及广西交界海拔 500—1600 米，包括九嶷山、阳明山、猫儿山、海洋山、都庞岭及西岭。相较之下，备注一句提到湖南及江西交界。该措辞与具名分布及检查地点语境冲突，保留为未解决的来源差异，不据此把江西加入分布。
morphology
Sample sizes and correction of a nuptial-pad typo
样本数量与婚垫笔误修订

The diagnosis reported 25 adult males at 33.3–42.1 mm snout–vent length and one adult female at 44.4 mm. Males had a subgular vocal sac but lacked nuptial pads or spines. The remarks explicitly attributed the original description’s assertion of male finger pads to a typographical error and corrected it to absence. This is the monograph’s attributed correction; the female value remains a single measurement, and pad absence does not determine breeding timing.
鉴别报告 25 只成年雄性吻肛长 33.3—42.1 毫米、单只成年雌性 44.4 毫米。雄性有咽下声囊而无婚垫或婚刺。备注明确将原始描述声称雄性指部有婚垫归为笔误，并修订为缺失。这是注明归属的专著修订；雌性数值仍为单次测量，婚垫缺失也不能确定繁殖时间。
taxonomy
Conspecificity and geographic-isolation hypotheses
同种处理与地理隔离假说

The remarks reported earlier possible cryptic-species interpretations for Guanyang, Shuangpai and Fuchuan populations labelled M. sp1, M. sp2 and M. sp3. The monograph found no distinguishing morphology and treated them as B. xiangnanensis. It described relatively large differences among populations in three mitochondrial segments and proposed geographic isolation and a wider distribution as possible explanations. These are attributed delimitation and causal hypotheses, not independent tests of reproductive compatibility or proven causes of genetic divergence.
备注报告灌阳、双牌及富川种群曾被分别标记为 M. sp1、M. sp2、M. sp3，并解释为可能隐存种。专著未发现可区分形态，遂处理为 B. xiangnanensis。文中描述三段线粒体序列的种群间差异相对较大，并提出地理隔离及较广分布可能解释这些差异。这些是注明归属的物种界定及因果假说，不是独立生殖相容性测试或已证明的遗传分歧原因。

sections: distribution
Zhejiang locality records
浙江地点记录

Male holotype CIB XJ190503 came from Shenxianju Scenic Area, Xianju, Zhejiang, at 350 m. The monograph examined additional material from Dapan Mountain, Pan’an, at about 860 m and summarized records from Shenxianju, Dapan and Longmen Mountain, Fuyang, at 320–900 m. This is the treatment’s reported locality scope rather than evidence for occupancy at every intervening elevation or a physiological range.
雄性正模 CIB XJ190503 来自浙江仙居神仙居景区海拔 350 米。专著检查磐安大盘山约 860 米的额外材料，并综合神仙居、大盘山及富阳龙门山记录，海拔 320—900 米。这是该处理报告的地点范围，不能证明所有中间海拔均被占据或确定生理范围。
morphology
Dapan sample measurements and anatomical characters
大盘山样本测量与解剖特征

The examined Dapan series contained four adult males with snout–vent lengths of 33.0–34.8 mm and two females at 42.8–45.3 mm. The diagnosis described a slightly concealed tympanum, vomerine ridges without teeth, and rudimentary basal toe webbing with narrow lateral fringes. Breeding males had black nuptial spines on finger I and II pads and a subgular vocal sac. These measurements concern the examined sample rather than all separately listed types or every population.
检查大盘山系列含四只成年雄性，吻肛长 33.0—34.8 毫米，以及两只雌性 42.8—45.3 毫米。鉴别描述鼓膜略隐蔽，有犁骨棱而无齿，趾基部具有退化蹼及狭窄侧缘。繁殖雄性第一及第二指婚垫具黑色婚刺，并有咽下声囊。这些测量对应检查样本，而非所有另列模式标本或每个种群。
taxonomy
Missing measurement does not remove a designated paratype
测量缺失不移除已指定副模

The remarks noted that the original designation listed seven male paratypes, but its measurement tables included only six. The monograph retained CIB 20180514007 as a paratype because it was explicitly designated, despite missing measurement data. It also reported that an arc-shaped swelling above the anal region, mentioned for the holotype, was not observed in its examined material and suggested individual variation. These are attributed nomenclatural and morphological interpretations; the omitted measurement is not reconstructed and the swelling is not presented as a universal diagnostic character.
备注指出原始指定列出七只雄性副模，测量表却仅含六只。专著保留 CIB 20180514007 为副模，因其被明确指定，尽管缺少测量数据。文中还报告正模描述提到的肛门区域上方弧形隆起未见于自身检查材料，并提出个体变异解释。这些是注明归属的命名及形态解释；缺失测量不予重建，隆起也不作为普遍鉴别特征。

sections: distribution
The 2023 description and Xuefeng mountain localities
2023 年描述与雪峰山地点

The monograph described this species as new in 2023. Male holotype SYS a007226 was collected on 15 June 2018 from Xuefeng Mountain, Hongjiang, Hunan, at about 1280 m; the paratypes shared its collection data. The name refers to that type locality. The distribution statement included Xuefeng and Yunshan Mountain, Wugang, at 1200–1300 m in western Hunan. One June collection date is not a breeding-season calendar, and the named localities do not establish continuous occupancy.
专著于 2023 年将本种描述为新种。雄性正模 SYS a007226 于 2018 年 6 月 15 日采自湖南洪江雪峰山约 1280 米，副模具有相同采集数据。种名指向该模式地点。分布表述包括湖南西部雪峰山及武冈云山海拔 1200—1300 米。一次六月采集日期不是繁殖季节日历，具名地点也不能确定连续占据。
morphology
Eight type adults with unwebbed toes
八只模式成体与无蹼趾

The diagnosis reported six adult males at 37.0–38.3 mm snout–vent length and two females at 45.3–48.9 mm. It described no vomerine ridges or teeth and no toe webbing or lateral fringes. Breeding males bore dense black nuptial spines on the dorsal bases of fingers I and II and a subgular vocal sac. These are diagnostic observations of the small type sample, not universal size bounds, a population sex ratio or evidence for the functional effects of the toe or finger structures.
鉴别报告六只成年雄性吻肛长 37.0—38.3 毫米、两只雌性 45.3—48.9 毫米。描述无犁骨棱及齿，趾无蹼及侧缘。繁殖雄性第一及第二指基部背侧具有密集黑色婚刺，并有咽下声囊。这些是小型模式样本的鉴别观察，而非通用体型界限、种群性比或趾指结构功能效应的证据。
title: Generic classification of Asian horned toads (Anura: Megophryidae: Megophryinae) and monograph of Chinese species

Yangming type locality without an invented upper elevation
阳明山模式地点与未编造的海拔上限

Male holotype SYS a002887 came from Yangming Mountain, Shuangpai, Hunan, at approximately 1360 m. Citing Lyu and colleagues (2020), the monograph knew this species only from the type locality above 1300 m. That statement supplies no upper elevation bound and is retained without inventing one; it is not proof of absence outside the mountain.

morphology
Seven male types and one female
七只雄性模式标本及一只雌性

The examined type material comprised seven adult males at 33.2–37.1 mm snout–vent length and one adult female at 45.2 mm. Breeding males had villiform black nuptial spines on the dorsal bases of fingers I and II and a subgular vocal sac. 检查模式材料含七只成年雄性，吻肛长 33.2—37.1 毫米，以及一只成年雌性 45.2 毫米。鉴别描述犁骨棱较弱而无齿，趾基部有退化蹼及狭窄侧缘。繁殖雄性第一及第二指基部背侧具有绒状黑色婚刺，并有咽下声囊。雌性测量仍为一次观察，而非体型范围；这些解剖特征不能确定繁殖时间。

sections: distribution
Corrected type coordinates and discrepant elevations
修订模式坐标与存在差异的海拔

The monograph listed male holotype SYS a002189 from Dayaoshan Nature Reserve, Jinxiu, Guangxi. It explicitly attributed a correction to Qi and colleagues (2022), replacing the originally reported coordinates and approximately 845 m elevation with 24.1602° N, 110.2304° E and approximately 1200 m. Its distribution summary included Jinxiu, Mengshan and Guiping in the Dayao Mountains at 1200–1300 m. Separately listed paratypes included a Xianglu Mountain female at approximately 1305 m and a male from west of Jinxiu at approximately 1115 m. These specimen elevations remain separate from the narrower summary; no unreported correction or continuous occupancy is inferred.

专著列雄性正模 SYS a002189 来自广西金秀大瑶山自然保护区，明确将修订归于 Qi 等（2022），以北纬 24.1602°、东经 110.2304°、约 1200 米替代原报告坐标及约 845 米海拔。分布综合包括大瑶山地区金秀、蒙山及桂平，海拔 1200—1300 米。另列副模包括香炉山约 1305 米的一只雌性，以及金秀以西约 1115 米的一只雄性。这些标本海拔与较窄综合范围分别保留，不推断未报告的修正或连续占据。
morphology
Eight examined types and male finger pads
八只检查模式标本与雄性指部婚垫

The examined type material comprised six adult males with snout–vent lengths of 32.5–42.6 mm and two adult females at 46.6–47.4 mm. The diagnosis described weak vomerine ridges without teeth and rudimentary basal toe webbing without lateral fringes. Breeding males had fine, dense black spines on the dorsal bases of finger I and II nuptial pads and a subgular vocal sac. These are sample measurements and anatomical characters; they do not establish a breeding season or population-wide size limits.
检查模式材料含六只成年雄性，吻肛长 32.5—42.6 毫米，以及两只成年雌性 46.6—47.4 毫米。鉴别描述犁骨棱较弱而无齿，趾基部有退化蹼而无侧缘。繁殖雄性第一及第二指基部背侧婚垫带细密黑刺，并有咽下声囊。这些是样本测量及解剖特征，不能确定繁殖季节或整个种群体型极限。

Shimentai type-locality records

Male holotype SYS a002099 came from Shimentai Nature Reserve, Yingde, Guangdong, at approximately 357 m. Citing Qi and colleagues (2021), the monograph knew the species only from this type locality at 300–400 m. This is a dated account of known localities, not proof of absence elsewhere or a physiological elevation tolerance.

Nine adult types and oral diagnostic characters

Four adult males and five adult females formed the examined type material. Diagnostic snout–vent lengths were 33.2–35.3 mm in males and 36.3–45.8 mm in females. The diagnosis described prominent vomerine ridges with teeth, smooth dorsal skin with small granules, and rudimentary basal toe webbing without lateral fringes. Breeding males had fine, dense black nuptial spines on fingers I and II and a subgular vocal sac. The small sample does not establish population-level sexual size differences, and the oral characters do not identify a diet.
检查模式材料由四只成年雄性及五只成年雌性组成。鉴别吻肛长为雄性 33.2—35.3 毫米、雌性 36.3—45.8 毫米。描述犁骨棱明显且有齿，背面皮肤光滑并具小颗粒，趾基部有退化蹼而无侧缘。繁殖雄性第一及第二指具有细密黑色婚刺，并有咽下声囊。小样本不能确定种群层面的两性体型差异，口腔特征也不能确定食性。

Yunkaishan type-locality knowledge

The monograph cited Qi and colleagues (2021) for records only from the type locality at 900–1400 m. These known collection elevations are not a demonstrated physiological range or evidence that the species is absent outside the reserve.

Nine adults with sampled spiny skin characters

The examined type series contained six adult males at 35.3–40.0 mm snout–vent length and three adult females at 45.3–46.1 mm. The diagnosis described rough dorsal skin, dense tubercles on the ventral thighs, spiny tubercles around the cloaca, and rudimentary basal toe webbing without lateral fringes. Adult males were described with tiny spines on the upper lip, upper eyelid and loreal and temporal regions, excluding the tympanum. Breeding males also had fine, dense black nuptial spines on finger I and II pads and a subgular vocal sac. These sampled structures do not establish their functional effects or breeding-season timing.
检查模式系列含六只成年雄性，吻肛长 35.3—40.0 毫米，以及三只成年雌性 45.3—46.1 毫米。鉴别描述背面皮肤粗糙，股腹面疣粒密集，泄殖腔周围有具刺疣粒，趾基部有退化蹼而无侧缘。成年雄性上唇、上眼睑、颊部及颞部有微小刺，但鼓膜不具刺。繁殖雄性第一及第二指婚垫另有细密黑色婚刺，并有咽下声囊。这些样本结构不能确定其功能效应或繁殖季节时间。

Yingjiang locality records

Citing Yang and colleagues (2018), the monograph summarized known distribution as the vicinity of the Yingjiang type locality at 700–1200 m. These are recorded localities and a cited summary, not a complete range survey or physiological elevation limits.

morphology
Adult measurements exclude the listed juvenile
成体测量排除另列幼体

The diagnosis reported twelve adult males at 24.2–28.1 mm snout–vent length and two females at 28.8–38.9 mm. A separately examined juvenile is not included in those adult denominators. Diagnostic characters included absence of vomerine ridges, vomerine teeth and subarticular tubercles, and rudimentary basal toe webbing with moderate lateral fringes. Breeding males had a subgular vocal sac without nuptial pads or spines. These sampled anatomical observations do not establish population-wide size bounds or a breeding calendar.
鉴别报告十二只成年雄性吻肛长 24.2—28.1 毫米、两只雌性 28.8—38.9 毫米。另行检查的一只幼体不加入这些成体分母。鉴别特征包括无犁骨棱、犁骨齿及关节下瘤，趾基部有退化蹼及中等宽度侧缘。繁殖雄性有咽下声囊而无婚垫或婚刺。这些样本解剖观察不能确定整个种群体型界限或繁殖日历。

sections: distribution
Medog records after removing attributed misidentifications
剔除被指出的误鉴定后的墨脱记录

Male holotype NWIPB 770650 came from Gelin, Medog, Xizang, at 1530 m. The monograph recognized records from several Medog localities at 1530–2003 m. Its remarks attributed some specimens previously assigned to this species to misidentifications reallocated to J. yeae using morphological and molecular evidence. The revised locality account is tied to that taxonomic interpretation; excluded records are not proof of ecological absence.
雄性正模 NWIPB 770650 来自西藏墨脱格林海拔 1530 米。专著认可墨脱数个地点海拔 1530—2003 米的记录。备注依据形态及分子证据，将部分先前归于本种的标本解释为误鉴定并重新归入 J. yeae。修订地点记录与该分类解释相联系；排除的记录不是生态缺失证明。
morphology
Cited measurements rather than a new examined series
引用测量而非新检查系列

The diagnosis was explicitly based on previous descriptions, reporting seven adult males at 33.6–36.6 mm snout–vent length and five females at 35.8–42.8 mm. It described vomerine ridges and teeth, rudimentary basal toe webbing with narrow fringes, and a grey pad with dense nuptial spines on the dorsal base of finger I in breeding males, with a subgular vocal sac. These are the monograph’s synthesis of earlier material, not a newly measured twelve-specimen series or measurements of only the three original types.
鉴别明确依据既往描述，报告七只成年雄性吻肛长 33.6—36.6 毫米、五只雌性 35.8—42.8 毫米。描述有犁骨棱及齿，趾基部有退化蹼及狭窄侧缘，繁殖雄性第一指基部背侧有带密集婚刺的灰色婚垫，并有咽下声囊。这些是专著对早期材料的综合，不是新测量的十二标本系列，也不是仅三只原始模式标本的测量。
taxonomy
Bari and Renqingbeng population interpretation
巴日及仁青崩种群解释

The remarks discussed a population previously labelled M. cf. pachyproctus from Bari and Renqingbeng Temple, about 20 km from Gelin. Earlier proposed differences concerned the postcloacal protrusion, inner metatarsal tubercle and osteology. The monograph regarded the external characters as individually variable, noting possible preservation changes, and cautioned that the osteological comparison relied on one individual. It therefore treated that population as J. pachyproctus. This is an attributed conspecificity interpretation; the account does not independently test reproductive compatibility or demonstrate a preservation effect in every specimen.
备注讨论格林约 20 千米外巴日及仁青崩寺先前标记为 M. cf. pachyproctus 的种群。早期提出的差异涉及泄殖腔后隆起、内跖突及骨骼。专著将外部特征视为个体间可变，并指出可能受保存影响，同时提醒骨骼比较仅依据一只个体。因而将该种群处理为 J. pachyproctus。这是注明归属的同种解释；该记录未独立测试生殖相容性，也未证明每只标本均出现保存效应。

Seven adults in the new-species diagnosis

专著列雄性正模 BNHS 6050 来自西藏山南错那县海拔 370 米。分布综合引用 Mahony 等（2018），包括错那及墨脱海拔 375—410 米。370 米正模数值与略窄综合分别保留，不作默默修正。这些地点海拔不是生理极限或连续占据证明。
morphology
The attributed correction from seven males to six
注明归属的七只至六只雄性修订

Based on the original description, the diagnosis reported six adult males at 68.0–73.5 mm snout–vent length and one female at 83.9 mm. The remarks explained that one holotype, four paratypes and one referred male agreed with six measurement entries, while a comparison paragraph had stated seven males. The monograph followed the designation and measurements and used n=6. This is its documented resolution of inconsistent source counts; the female remains one measurement, not a range.
依据原始描述，鉴别报告六只成年雄性吻肛长 68.0—73.5 毫米、单只雌性 83.9 毫米。备注说明一只正模、四只副模及一只另列雄性与六条测量一致，而比较段却写七只雄性。专著遵循指定及测量，使用 n=6。这是对来源计数不一致有记录的处理；雌性仍为一次测量，而非范围。
morphology
Oral, toe and breeding-male characters
口腔、趾部及繁殖雄性特征

The cited diagnosis described vomerine ridges and teeth, a mostly smooth dorsum, and small black or white dermal asperities on the lower jaw. Subarticular tubercles were absent; toes had rudimentary basal webbing without lateral fringes. Breeding males had finger I and II nuptial pads with black spines and a subgular vocal sac. These are anatomical observations rather than measured feeding or locomotor performance, and they do not identify a breeding season.
引用鉴别描述有犁骨棱及齿，背面大部分光滑，下颌有小型黑色或白色皮肤粗突。无关节下瘤，趾基部具有退化蹼而无侧缘。繁殖雄性第一及第二指婚垫具黑刺，并有咽下声囊。这些是解剖观察，而非测量的摄食或运动表现，也不能确定繁殖季节。
