Nanling and Dayao mountain records
南岭及大瑶山记录

Female holotype CIB 66000, formerly CIB 75I0689, came from Mangshan Nature Reserve, Yizhang, Hunan, at 1000 m. The examined material included localities in Guangdong and Guangxi, from Shimentai at about 370 m to Dayaoshan at about 1200 m. The broader summary placed the species in Nanling and Dayao mountain localities along Jiangxi, Hunan, Guangdong and Guangxi at 350–1200 m. Although the paper described it as common, it supplied no population census in this treatment; the locality summary is not a quantified abundance estimate.
雌性正模 CIB 66000（原 CIB 75I0689）来自湖南宜章莽山自然保护区海拔 1000 米。检查材料包括广东及广西地点，从石门台约 370 米到大瑶山约 1200 米。更广综合将本种列于江西、湖南、广东及广西一带的南岭与大瑶山地点海拔 350—1200 米。论文虽称其常见，该处理未提供种群普查；地点综合不是量化丰度估计。
morphology
Fifteen examined adults with unwebbed toes
十五只检查成体与无蹼趾

The diagnosis reported ten adult males at 60.4–71.6 mm snout–vent length and five females at 62.0–77.9 mm. It described vomerine ridges and teeth, smooth dorsal skin with sparse granules, small black lower-jaw asperities, and toes without webbing or lateral fringes. Breeding males had dense brown nuptial spines on the dorsal bases of fingers I and II and a subgular vocal sac. The measurements concern the examined sample, not every population or the separately listed historical types.
鉴别报告十只成年雄性吻肛长 60.4—71.6 毫米、五只雌性 62.0—77.9 毫米。描述有犁骨棱及齿，背面皮肤光滑并散有颗粒，下颌有小型黑色粗突，趾无蹼及侧缘。繁殖雄性第一及第二指基部背侧具密集棕色婚刺，并有咽下声囊。这些测量对应检查样本，而非每个种群或另列历史模式标本。

Examined Medog localities and the wider cited account

Its wider cited distribution account covered multiple Medog localities at 600–2200 m. These newly examined sites and the wider account remain separate; the word common in the summary is not a quantified density or population trend.

morphology
Eight measured adults are not the large historical type series
八只测量成体不等于大型历史模式系列

The examined diagnosis reported six adult males at 56.1–62.4 mm snout–vent length and two females at 73.8–79.6 mm. The separately listed historical paratypes included 160 adult males, a juvenile and tadpoles without supplied voucher numbers; none is silently added to those measured adult denominators. Diagnostic anatomy included vomerine ridges and teeth, rudimentary basal toe webbing without fringes, and dense black nuptial spines on fingers I and II in breeding males with a subgular vocal sac. These descriptions do not establish diet or breeding-season timing.
检查鉴别报告六只成年雄性吻肛长 56.1—62.4 毫米、两只雌性 73.8—79.6 毫米。另列历史副模包括 160 只成年雄性、一只幼体及蝌蚪，但未提供凭证编号；这些材料不默默加入所测成体分母。鉴别解剖包括犁骨棱及齿、无侧缘的趾基部退化蹼，以及繁殖雄性第一及第二指密集黑色婚刺和咽下声囊。这些描述不能确定食性或繁殖季节时间。

sections: distribution
Southeastern Xizang and northwestern Yunnan records
西藏东南部与云南西北部记录

Male holotype BNHS 6055 came from Medog, Xizang, at 450 m; the type list also included Cona material at 1110 m. The monograph cited Mahony and colleagues (2018) and Shi and colleagues (2020) for distribution in Cona, Medog and Gongshan, Yunnan, at 260–2236 m. These recorded localities and cited elevation summary do not demonstrate continuous occupancy or physiological tolerances across the interval.
雄性正模 BNHS 6055 来自西藏墨脱海拔 450 米，模式列表另含错那 1110 米材料。专著引用 Mahony 等（2018）及 Shi 等（2020），记录分布于错那、墨脱及云南贡山海拔 260—2236 米。这些记录地点及引用海拔综合不能证明该区间连续占据或生理耐受范围。
morphology
Original-description adult measurements
原始描述成体测量

The diagnosis based on the original description reported twelve adult males at 71.3–93.8 mm snout–vent length and one adult female at 112.0 mm. The cited diagnostic denominator is not treated as a new measurement series in this monograph. Characters included vomerine ridges and teeth, small lower-jaw asperities, and rudimentary basal toe webbing with absent or indistinct narrow fringes. Breeding males had black or brown nuptial spines on finger I and II pads and a subgular vocal sac. The female value is one observation, not a female range or a population sex-size estimate.
依据原始描述的鉴别报告十二只成年雄性吻肛长 71.3—93.8 毫米、单只成年雌性 112.0 毫米。引用鉴别分母不作为本专著的新测量系列。特征包括犁骨棱及齿、下颌小型粗突，以及趾基部退化蹼，侧缘缺失或狭窄而不明显。繁殖雄性第一及第二指婚垫具黑色或棕色婚刺，并有咽下声囊。雌性数值是一次观察，而非雌性范围或种群两性体型估计。

name: Xenophrys zhangi
readScope: Xenophrys zhangi: Named species types, examined material, diagnosis, distribution and applicable remarks; no source figures or supplements reproduced; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

sections: distribution
Reassessed elevations without converting predictions to records
重新评估海拔且不把预测转为记录

The monograph flagged the original Zhangmu type elevations of 700–1000 m as erroneous and proposed altimeter error as a possible explanation. It examined Lixin, Zhangmu, specimens at about 2180 m. Its distribution paragraph stated 1800–2100 m, while the remarks explicitly gave 1800–2180 m based on earlier and current information. These differing endpoints and the attributed reassessment remain visible rather than silently harmonized. Neighbouring Nepal and India were expected areas in this account, not confirmed localities supplied by this treatment.
专著将原始樟木模式海拔 700—1000 米标记为错误，并提出高度计误差为可能解释。检查樟木立新约 2180 米标本。分布段写 1800—2100 米，备注则依据早期及当前信息明确给出 1800—2180 米。这些不同端点及注明归属的重新评估分别保留，不作默默统一。该记录预期出现于邻近尼泊尔及印度，但该处理未提供这些区域的确认地点。
morphology
Separate historical male and newly examined adult samples
分别保留历史雄性及新检查成体样本

The diagnosis cited seven historical males at 32.5–40.0 mm snout–vent length and separately reported its own single male at 39.5 mm and two females at 44.5–50.2 mm. It described vomerine ridges and teeth, toes without webbing but with narrow lateral fringes, and dense grey nuptial spines on the dorsal bases of fingers I and II in breeding males, with a subgular vocal sac. The historical and current measurements are not pooled into one uniformly measured series, and the single new male is not a range.
鉴别引用七只历史雄性吻肛长 32.5—40.0 毫米，另报自身单只雄性 39.5 毫米及两只雌性 44.5—50.2 毫米。描述有犁骨棱及齿，趾无蹼但具狭窄侧缘，繁殖雄性第一及第二指基部背侧具密集灰色婚刺，并有咽下声囊。历史及当前测量不合并为统一测量系列，新检查单只雄性也不是范围。
taxonomy
Mitochondrial and nuclear relationships require broader sampling
线粒体及核基因关系需要更广采样

The remarks placed X. zhangi close to the mid-elevation X. monticola population in the cited analyses, with minor mitochondrial divergence but distinct nuclear divergence. That grouping differed from the high-elevation X. monticola population. Available molecular data came only from near the two type localities, more than 230 km apart; the authors called for population genetics across all relevant populations in three countries and retained the two species. These are attributed phylogenetic results and a provisional taxonomic decision, not a resolved assessment of every population or evidence of reproductive compatibility.
备注在所述分析中将 X. zhangi 与中海拔 X. monticola 种群置为近缘，线粒体分歧较小而核基因分歧明显。该组与高海拔 X. monticola 种群不同。可用分子数据仅来自相距超过 230 千米的两个模式地点附近；作者要求覆盖三国全部相关种群的群体遗传研究，并保留二种现有地位。这些是注明归属的系统发育结果及暂时分类决定，不是对每个种群已解决的评估或生殖相容性证据。

sections: distribution
Southern Sichuan Basin locality account
四川盆地南缘地点记录

Male holotype CIB CS20190518031 came from Chishui Nature Reserve, Guizhou, at about 460 m. The monograph examined Chishui females and Sichuan material from Emei at about 1600 m, Wawu at about 1560 m and Laojun at about 1500 m. Its broader interpreted distribution covered hilly localities along the southern Sichuan Basin edge in southeastern Sichuan, southwestern Chongqing, northwestern Guizhou and northeastern Yunnan at 270–1600 m. This wider account incorporates reassigned historical records rather than only newly examined vouchers.
雄性正模 CIB CS20190518031 来自贵州赤水自然保护区约 460 米。专著检查赤水雌性及四川峨眉山约 1600 米、瓦屋山约 1560 米和老君山约 1500 米材料。较广解释分布覆盖四川盆地南缘丘陵地点，包括四川东南部、重庆西南部、贵州西北部及云南东北部海拔 270—1600 米。该较广记录纳入重新归类的历史记录，而非仅新检查凭证。
morphology
Twenty-three examined adults
二十三只检查成体

The revised diagnosis reported fifteen adult males at 33.8–41.2 mm snout–vent length and eight females at 43.8–54.1 mm. It described no vomerine ridges or teeth, rough dorsal skin with numerous granules and tubercles, and rudimentary basal toe webbing with narrow lateral fringes. Breeding males had tiny, dense black nuptial spines on finger I and II pads and a subgular vocal sac. These observations concern the examined multi-locality sample, not universal adult size limits or independently established species boundaries.
修订鉴别报告十五只成年雄性吻肛长 33.8—41.2 毫米、八只雌性 43.8—54.1 毫米。描述无犁骨棱及齿，背部皮肤粗糙并具大量颗粒及疣粒，趾基部有退化蹼及狭窄侧缘。繁殖雄性第一及第二指婚垫有细小密集黑色婚刺，并有咽下声囊。这些观察对应检查的多地点样本，而非通用成年体型极限或独立确定的物种边界。
taxonomy
Revision of the long-used Emeishan identification
修订长期沿用的峨眉山鉴定

The remarks traced the Emeishan population’s historical treatment as B. minor and cited later evidence distinguishing it from topotypic B. minor at Dujiangyan. They explained that the Chishui description compared Chishui and Emeishan morphology despite earlier work treating those populations as conspecific, making that comparison problematic. The monograph revised the diagnosis and reassigned historical B. minor records from Emeishan, Gulin, Hejiang and Weixin to B. chishuiensis on biogeographic grounds. This attribution is preserved; the historical records are not relabelled as newly molecularly verified vouchers.
备注追溯峨眉山种群历史上作为 B. minor 的处理，并引用后期证据将其与都江堰模式地点 B. minor 区分。文中解释赤水描述比较了赤水及峨眉山形态，尽管早期工作已将这些种群处理为同种，使该比较存在问题。专著修订鉴别，并基于生物地理依据将峨眉山、古蔺、合江及威信历史 B. minor 记录重新归为 B. chishuiensis。保留该归属，不将历史记录改称新经分子验证的凭证。

morphology
Historical and examined adult samples
历史及检查成体样本

The diagnosis cited Liu and colleagues (2020) for nine adult males at 34.4–39.2 mm snout–vent length and two females at 39.5–40.4 mm. The monograph’s own eight males measured 34.5–38.6 mm. sections: distribution
Type mountain and the broader regional interpretation
模式山地与更广区域解释

Male holotype CIB 98008, formerly CIB 580768, came from Jizu Mountain, Binchuan, Yunnan, at 1920 m. The monograph examined additional adults from Yumen, Yanbian, Sichuan, at about 1730 m. Its distribution summary placed the species in hilly areas along northern Yunnan and southernmost Sichuan at 1700–2800 m. This wider interpretation includes revised historical identifications; it is not a survey proving every locality or elevation is occupied.
雄性正模 CIB 98008（原 CIB 580768）来自云南宾川鸡足山海拔 1920 米。专著检查四川盐边渔门约 1730 米的额外成体。分布综合将本种列于云南北部及四川最南部一带丘陵海拔 1700—2800 米。该较广解释纳入历史鉴定修订，不是证明每个地点或海拔均被占据的调查。
morphology
Five examined Sichuan adults
五只检查四川成体

The examined diagnosis reported two adult males at 34.4–36.3 mm snout–vent length and three females at 39.4–46.2 mm. These are measurements of the Yumen sample rather than all historically listed types. It described no vomerine ridges or teeth, rudimentary basal toe webbing with narrow lateral fringes, and brown nuptial spines on the dorsal bases of fingers I and II in breeding males, with a subgular vocal sac. The small sample does not establish population-wide size limits or statistical sexual size differences.
检查鉴别报告两只成年雄性吻肛长 34.4—36.3 毫米、三只雌性 39.4—46.2 毫米。这些是渔门样本测量，而非所有历史所列模式标本。描述无犁骨棱及齿、趾基部有退化蹼及狭窄侧缘，繁殖雄性第一及第二指基部背侧有棕色婚刺，并有咽下声囊。小样本不能确定种群体型极限或两性体型差异的统计估计。
taxonomy
Historical minor records proposed for reassignment
提出重分配的历史 minor 记录

The remarks traced the original subspecies designation and subsequent recognition as a species. They assigned the Yanbian population formerly recorded as B. minor to B. binchuanensis and proposed revising historical B. minor records from Wuding and Qiaojia in Yunnan and Huili, Jiulong and Muli in Sichuan on biogeographic grounds. These proposals retain the monograph’s attribution and rationale. They do not certify new molecular evidence for every reassigned historical voucher.
备注追溯原始亚种指定及随后提升为种的过程。文中将先前记录为 B. minor 的盐边种群归为 B. binchuanensis，并基于生物地理依据提出修订云南武定、巧家及四川会理、九龙、木里的历史 B. minor 记录。保留专著对这些提议的归属及理由，不据此认证每只重分配历史凭证均有新分子证据。

sections: distribution
Bingling and nearby Wawu material
炳灵及邻近瓦屋山材料

Male holotype CIB 950263 came from Bingling, Wawushan, Hongya, Sichuan, at 1480 m. The monograph examined one male and one female from Gufuping on Wawu Mountain at about 1560 m and summarized known distribution as the vicinity of the Hongya type locality at 1480–1560 m. These localities are not evidence of absence elsewhere or a measured elevation tolerance.
雄性正模 CIB 950263 来自四川洪雅瓦屋山镇炳灵海拔 1480 米。专著检查瓦屋山古佛坪约 1560 米的一只雄性及一只雌性，并将已知分布综合为洪雅模式地点附近海拔 1480—1560 米。这些地点不能证明其他地点缺失或确定测量的海拔耐受范围。
morphology
Two newly measured adults and an unresolved printed unit
两只新测量成体与未解决的打印单位

The newly examined male measured 44.8 mm snout–vent length and the female 59.2 mm. The same diagnostic sentence cited an earlier three-male value of 45.1–51.0 without printing its unit beside those endpoints; this page does not silently certify the missing unit. Diagnostic anatomy included weak vomerine ridges without teeth, a distinct subarticular tubercle at finger I but absent on other fingers, rudimentary basal toe webbing with narrow fringes, and tiny dense black nuptial spines on fingers I and II in breeding males, with a subgular vocal sac.
新检查雄性吻肛长为 44.8 毫米，雌性为 59.2 毫米。同一句鉴别引用早期三只雄性数值 45.1—51.0，但端点旁未打印单位；本页不默默认证该缺失单位。鉴别解剖包括犁骨棱较弱而无齿，第一指关节下瘤明显而其他指缺失，趾基部有退化蹼及狭窄侧缘，繁殖雄性第一及第二指具细小密集黑色婚刺，并有咽下声囊。
taxonomy
Corrected locality transliteration preserves the species epithet
修正地点转写并保留种加词

The remarks identified inconsistent Binling and Bingling spellings for the type locality in the original description. The monograph treated Bingling as the correct pinyin transliteration and revised the English common name accordingly, while preserving the originally published epithet binlingensis under its cited nomenclatural rules. This is an attributed spelling treatment, not a change of type locality or evidence of another species.
备注指出原始描述对模式地点同时使用 Binling 及 Bingling。专著将 Bingling 视为正确拼音转写并据此修订英文俗名，同时依据所引用命名规则保留原发表种加词 binlingensis。这是注明归属的拼写处理，不是模式地点改变或另一个物种的证据。

China–Vietnam border locality account
中国及越南边界地点记录

Male holotype KIZ 93088 came from Dawei Mountain, Pingbian, Yunnan, at 1900 m. The monograph recognized Pingbian and Xichou in Yunnan and neighbouring Lao Cai in northern Vietnam, citing previous work and giving an approximate elevation of 1900 m. This approximate locality account is not an exact species-wide elevation range or a demonstration of continuous occupancy across the border.
雄性正模 KIZ 93088 来自云南屏边大围山海拔 1900 米。专著引用既往工作，认可云南屏边、西畴及邻近越南北部老街记录，并给出约 1900 米海拔。该近似地点记录不是精确的全种海拔范围，也不能证明跨境连续占据。
morphology
Original-description adult sample
原始描述成体样本

Based on Rao and Yang (1997), the diagnosis reported eighteen adult males at 34–37 mm snout–vent length and three females at 40–46 mm. It described vomerine ridges and teeth, smooth dorsal skin with a weak interrupted V-shaped ridge, unwebbed toes, and a subgular vocal sac in males. These cited measurements concern the original sample, not a newly examined series in this monograph. The vocal-sac statement alone does not supply a breeding season or a call measurement.
鉴别依据 Rao 与 Yang（1997），报告十八只成年雄性吻肛长 34—37 毫米、三只雌性 40—46 毫米。描述有犁骨棱及齿，背面皮肤光滑并具较弱断续 V 形棱，趾无蹼，雄性有咽下声囊。这些引用测量对应原始样本，而非本专著新检查系列。单凭声囊表述不能确定繁殖季节或鸣声测量。

sections: distribution
Fanjing and Youyang records with a provisional Xiushan assignment
梵净山、酉阳记录与暂定秀山归属

Male holotype TRU trxy01 came from Heiwanhe, Fanjing Mountain, Guizhou, at 900 m. The monograph examined Heiwanhe material at about 860 m and recognized Fanjing and Youyang, Chongqing, at 800–950 m. It suggested that historical B. spinata records from Xiushan might belong here on biogeographic grounds, explicitly requiring additional vouchers with molecular data. That suggestion remains distinct from the recognized locality set.
雄性正模 TRU trxy01 来自贵州梵净山黑湾河海拔 900 米。专著检查黑湾河约 860 米材料，并认可梵净山及重庆酉阳海拔 800—950 米记录。文中基于生物地理依据提出秀山历史 B. spinata 记录可能归于本种，明确要求额外凭证及分子数据。该提议与认可地点组分开保留。
morphology
Eight examined adults and partial toe webbing
八只检查成体与部分趾蹼

The diagnosis reported four adult males at 58.2–63.6 mm snout–vent length and four females at 62.8–72.2 mm. Characters included weak vomerine ridges without teeth, one-third toe webbing with wide lateral fringes, and sparse tiny black nuptial spines on the dorsal bases of fingers I and II in breeding males, with a subgular vocal sac. These are sample measurements and qualitative anatomical descriptions, not population-wide size bounds or measured swimming performance.
鉴别报告四只成年雄性吻肛长 58.2—63.6 毫米、四只雌性 62.8—72.2 毫米。特征包括犁骨棱较弱而无齿，趾具三分之一蹼及宽侧缘，繁殖雄性第一及第二指基部背侧有稀疏微小黑色婚刺，并有咽下声囊。这些是样本测量及定性解剖描述，而非种群体型界限或测量的游泳表现。
taxonomy
A previously overlooked subspecies elevated in the monograph
专著提升先前被忽略的亚种

The remarks traced conflicting treatments of the large Fanjing horned toads as B. spinata and as the subspecies Megophrys binlingensis fanjingmontis. Some checklists listed both names for what the monograph interpreted as the same regional frog. Citing earlier molecular delimitation and its detailed morphology, the authors elevated fanjingmontis to a full species distinct from B. spinata and B. binlingensis. The history and elevation decision are attributed to the paper rather than independently certified as a complete review of all regional populations.

备注追溯梵净山大型角蟾被分别处理为 B. spinata 及亚种 Megophrys binlingensis fanjingmontis 的冲突历史。部分名录同时列二名，而专著解释其对应同一区域蛙类。作者引用早期分子界定及自身详细形态，将 fanjingmontis 提升为独立于 B. spinata 和 B. binlingensis 的种。该历史及提升决定注明论文归属，不独立认证为对所有区域种群的完整审查。

sections: distribution
A low examined locality outside the summary interval
位于综合区间之外的较低检查地点

Male holotype CIB 24345, formerly CIB 583007, came from Jingdong, Yunnan, at 2060 m. The examined material spanned several Yunnan localities and Cenwanglaoshan, Guangxi. It explicitly included Huanglian Mountain, Lyuchun, at about 800 m, while the distribution summary gave southern Yunnan, northwestern Guangxi and neighbouring northern Vietnam at 1150–2400 m. The 800 m examined locality remains visible separately from that narrower summary; neither endpoint is silently corrected.
雄性正模 CIB 24345（原 CIB 583007）来自云南景东海拔 2060 米。检查材料覆盖云南多个地点及广西岑王老山，明确包括绿春黄连山约 800 米，而分布综合给出云南南部、广西西北部及邻近越南北部海拔 1150—2400 米。800 米检查地点与较窄综合分别保留，不默默修正任一端点。
morphology
Twenty-seven examined adults with half-webbed toes
二十七只检查成体与半蹼趾

The diagnosis reported twenty-four adult males at 48.3–62.5 mm snout–vent length and three females at 58.6–68.2 mm. It described vomerine ridges and teeth, toes with half webbing and wide lateral fringes, and dense black nuptial spines on the dorsal bases of fingers I and II in breeding males, with a subgular vocal sac. The reported measurements concern the examined series. The toe description is not a measurement of locomotor ability, and the finger characters do not supply breeding-season dates.
鉴别报告二十四只成年雄性吻肛长 48.3—62.5 毫米、三只雌性 58.6—68.2 毫米。描述有犁骨棱及齿，趾具半蹼及宽侧缘，繁殖雄性第一及第二指基部背侧有密集黑色婚刺，并有咽下声囊。报告测量对应检查系列。趾部描述不是运动能力测量，指部特征也未提供繁殖季节日期。

sections: distribution
Western Yunnan locality account
云南西部地点记录

Male holotype CIB YN201909290 came from Gutan River, Luzhang, Lushui, Yunnan, at approximately 2358 m. Examined material included Linjiapu, Dahaoping and Zizhi in Tengchong at approximately 2090–2210 m. The monograph summarized known Lushui, Tengchong, Yingjiang and Longchuan localities at 1900–2400 m along the China–Myanmar border region. This locality account does not establish occurrence across the border in Myanmar or continuous occupancy throughout the interval.
雄性正模 CIB YN201909290 来自云南泸水鲁掌古炭河约 2358 米。检查材料包括腾冲林家铺、大蒿坪及自治，约 2090—2210 米。专著将中国及缅甸边境地区已知泸水、腾冲、盈江及陇川地点综合为海拔 1900—2400 米。该地点记录不能确定缅甸境内出现或整个区间连续占据。
morphology
Thirty-three examined Tengchong adults
三十三只检查腾冲成体

The diagnosis reported thirteen adult males at 32.3–38.0 mm snout–vent length and twenty females at 37.8–47.4 mm. These are the examined Tengchong measurements; separately listed juvenile male paratypes are excluded from adult denominators. Diagnostic anatomy included weak vomerine ridges without teeth, a prominent horn-like eyelid tubercle, rudimentary basal toe webbing with narrow fringes, and tiny dense nuptial spines on finger I and II pads in breeding males, with a subgular vocal sac. These anatomical observations do not supply a breeding calendar or functional measurements.
鉴别报告十三只成年雄性吻肛长 32.3—38.0 毫米、二十只雌性 37.8—47.4 毫米。这些是检查腾冲材料的测量；另列幼年雄性副模不加入成体分母。鉴别解剖包括犁骨棱较弱而无齿、明显角状眼睑疣粒、趾基部退化蹼及狭窄侧缘，以及繁殖雄性第一及第二指婚垫细小密集婚刺和咽下声囊。这些解剖观察未提供繁殖日历或功能测量。
taxonomy
Previously separate candidate lineages treated as one species
先前分列候选谱系的同种处理

The remarks traced earlier candidate labels M. sp2, M. sp39 and M. sp40 and noted that the original Lushui description had not included those earlier datasets. The monograph analysed them together, reported a monophyletic lineage with B. lushuiensis, and found no distinguishing morphology between northern and southern Tengchong material and the Lushui types. It treated them as conspecific and proposed geographic isolation as a possible explanation for genetic divergence. The taxonomic decision and geographic hypothesis remain attributed, not independent evidence of reproductive compatibility or a proven cause of divergence.
备注追溯早期候选标记 M. sp2、M. sp39、M. sp40，并指出原始泸水描述未纳入这些早期数据集。专著合并分析，报告其与 B. lushuiensis 构成单系谱系，并未找到腾冲北部、南部材料与泸水模式可区分的形态，遂处理为同种，并提出地理隔离可能解释遗传分歧。分类决定及地理假说保留归属，不作为独立生殖相容性证据或已证明的分歧原因。

sections: distribution
Southern Sichuan Basin localities
四川盆地南缘地点

Male holotype FMNH 49406 came from Mount Omei, now written Emei, Sichuan. Examined adults came from Emei, Wawu, Laojun, Zihuai, Simian and Chishui, including Chishui at approximately 580 m and Emei at approximately 1600 m. The wider summary covered hilly areas of southeastern Sichuan, southwestern Chongqing, northwestern Guizhou and northeastern Yunnan at 400–1600 m. Those examined sites and the wider cited account remain distinct rather than proving continuous distribution.
雄性正模 FMNH 49406 来自四川峨眉山，原文拼写 Omei。检查成体来自峨眉山、瓦屋山、老君山、自怀、四面山及赤水，包括赤水约 580 米及峨眉山约 1600 米。更广综合覆盖四川东南部、重庆西南部、贵州西北部及云南东北部丘陵海拔 400—1600 米。这些检查地点与更广引用记录分别保留，不能证明连续分布。
morphology
Seventeen examined adults
十七只检查成体

The diagnosis reported ten adult males at 52.1–62.0 mm snout–vent length and seven females at 65.7–71.2 mm. It described vomerine ridges and teeth, rudimentary basal toe webbing with narrow lateral fringes, and dense black nuptial spines on the dorsal bases of fingers I and II in breeding males, with a subgular vocal sac. These are measurements and anatomical descriptions of the examined sample, not universal adult size limits or measurements of the separately listed historical types.
鉴别报告十只成年雄性吻肛长 52.1—62.0 毫米、七只雌性 65.7—71.2 毫米。描述有犁骨棱及齿、趾基部退化蹼及狭窄侧缘，繁殖雄性第一及第二指基部背侧具密集黑色婚刺，并有咽下声囊。这些是检查样本的测量及解剖描述，而非通用成年体型极限或另列历史模式标本的测量。

sections: distribution
Border-region records and Vietnamese syntypes
边境记录与越南合模

The monograph listed syntypes MNHN 1948.114–116 from Chapa, now Sa Pa, Lao Cai, northern Vietnam, at 1500 m. Its cited distribution included Hekou and Lyuchun in Yunnan, Jingxi in Guangxi, northern Vietnam and northeastern Laos at 1100–2070 m. This is the treatment’s regional locality account. The description of relatively rare Chinese records is not a quantified abundance estimate or a current population trend.
专著列合模 MNHN 1948.114—116 来自越南北部老街 Chapa、现沙巴海拔 1500 米。引用分布包括云南河口及绿春、广西靖西、越南北部及老挝东北部海拔 1100—2070 米。这是该处理的区域地点记录。中国记录相对少见的描述不是量化丰度估计或当前种群趋势。
morphology
A corrected two-male Hekou diagnosis
修订的河口两只雄性鉴别

The diagnosis relied on earlier descriptions of Bozhujing, Hekou, material and reported two adult males at 36.2–38.0 mm snout–vent length. The remarks attributed revisions of the earlier one-male/one-female interpretation to two males, and of paired vocal sacs to a subgular vocal sac, to Fei and colleagues (2009). Anatomy included vomerine ridges and teeth, rough tuberculate skin, several prominent eyelid tubercles, half-webbed toes with wide fringes, and dense brown nuptial spines on fingers I and II. The grey-brown dorsal colour was explicitly described in preservative, not certified as live colour.
鉴别依据河口薄竹箐材料的早期描述，报告两只成年雄性吻肛长 36.2—38.0 毫米。备注将早期一雄一雌改为两只雄性、成对声囊改为咽下声囊的修订归于 Fei 等（2009）。解剖包括犁骨棱及齿、粗糙具疣皮肤、数个明显眼睑疣粒、半蹼趾及宽侧缘，以及第一、第二指密集棕色婚刺。灰褐背色明确为保存状态描述，不认证为活体颜色。
taxonomy
Guangdong record rejected by voucher-image interpretation
依据凭证图像解释排除的广东记录

The monograph reviewed a published Tianjing Mountain, Guangdong, record far from the main regional distribution. Interpreting the earlier voucher figure, its authors reassigned that record to B. shimentaina and removed Guangdong from their B. palpebralespinosa account. This is an attributed identification decision based on the published image, not a newly examined Guangdong specimen or proof that B. palpebralespinosa cannot occur there.
专著审查远离主要区域分布的一条广东天井山发表记录。作者解释早期凭证图像，将该记录重新归为 B. shimentaina，并从其 B. palpebralespinosa 记录中排除广东。这是依据发表图像作出且注明归属的鉴定决定，不是新检查的广东标本，也不能证明 B. palpebralespinosa 不可能出现于当地。

sections: distribution
Northern Guizhou records and a corrected paratype locality
贵州北部记录与副模地点修订

Male holotype CIB TZ20190608017 came from Huanglian Nature Reserve, Tongzi, Guizhou, at about 1500 m. The monograph recognized Tongzi and Suiyang in the Dalou Mountains at 1500–1600 m and examined Taiyangshan material at about 1600 m. It explicitly described the original Kuankuoshui locality attribution for four named paratypes as a typographical error; those paratypes were listed with the holotype locality in this treatment. This is an attributed locality correction, not an independently re-collected type series.
雄性正模 CIB TZ20190608017 来自贵州桐梓黄连自然保护区约 1500 米。专著认可大娄山地区桐梓及绥阳海拔 1500—1600 米记录，并检查太阳山约 1600 米材料。文中明确将四只具名副模原始宽阔水地点归属称为笔误，在该处理中将其列于与正模相同地点。这是注明归属的地点修订，不是独立重新采集的模式系列。
taxonomy
Wider spinata records remain proposed assignments
更广 spinata 记录仍属拟议归属

The distribution discussion proposed assigning historical B. spinata records from northwestern Guizhou, southeastern Sichuan and western Chongqing to B. qianbeiensis on biogeographic grounds. It explicitly required additional vouchers with molecular data. Those proposed assignments therefore remain separate from the recognized Tongzi and Suiyang records and are not presented as newly genetically verified occurrences.
分布讨论基于生物地理依据提出，将贵州西北部、四川东南部及重庆西部历史 B. spinata 记录归于 B. qianbeiensis，并明确要求额外凭证及分子数据。这些拟议归属因此与认可的桐梓及绥阳记录分别保留，不作为新经遗传验证的出现记录。
morphology
Four examined adults with conical male spines
四只检查成体与雄性锥形婚刺

The diagnosis reported three adult males at 50.5–53.7 mm snout–vent length and one female at 65.2 mm. It described vomerine ridges and teeth, rough skin with dense spiny granules, and one-third toe webbing with wide fringes. Breeding males had large, sparse black conical nuptial spines on the dorsal bases of fingers I and II and a subgular vocal sac. The female is one measurement, not a range, and these structures are not measurements of mating performance or swimming ability.
鉴别报告三只成年雄性吻肛长 50.5—53.7 毫米、单只雌性 65.2 毫米。描述有犁骨棱及齿，皮肤粗糙并密生具刺颗粒，趾具三分之一蹼及宽侧缘。繁殖雄性第一及第二指基部背侧有大型、稀疏黑色锥形婚刺，并有咽下声囊。雌性为一次测量而非范围，这些结构也不是交配表现或游泳能力测量。
title: Generic classification of Asian horned toads (Anura: Megophryidae: Megophryinae) and monograph of Chinese species

name: Boulenophrys rubrimera
readScope: Boulenophrys rubrimera: Named species types, examined specimens, diagnosis, distribution and applicable remarks; no source figures or supplements reproduced; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sectionLocators: RESULTS > Boulenophrys rubrimera; Holotype, Paratypes and Distribution; reading-sections index 36, section s03.52
RESULTS > Boulenophrys rubrimera; Diagnosis characters 1, 5, 9, 10 and 11; reading-sections index 36, section s03.52
sections: distribution
Vietnamese type locality and Chinese border records
越南模式地点与中国边境记录

Male holotype VNMN 2017.002 came from Sa Pa, Lao Cai, Vietnam, at 1708 m, with male paratypes from nearby sites at 1400–1722 m. The monograph’s cited account also included Maandi, Jinping, Yunnan, and neighbouring northern Vietnam. These type elevations and the wider cited locality account do not establish a physiological range or continuous cross-border occupancy.
雄性正模 VNMN 2017.002 来自越南老街沙巴海拔 1708 米，雄性副模来自邻近海拔 1400—1722 米地点。专著引用记录还包括云南金平马鞍底及邻近越南北部。这些模式海拔及更广引用地点记录不能确定生理范围或跨境连续占据。
morphology
Seven original males and red-orange thigh markings
七只原始雄性与红橙股部斑纹

The diagnosis based on Tapley and colleagues (2017) reported seven adult males at 26.7–30.5 mm snout–vent length. It described dark-spined tubercles on the dorsum, flanks and dorsal limbs, unwebbed toes with narrow lateral fringes, and red-orange colour on the posterior flank and anterior thigh near the groin. Breeding males had dense nuptial spines on the dorsal base of finger II and a subgular vocal sac. No female measurement was supplied in this diagnosis; the male finger-II character is not expanded to finger I or a breeding calendar.
鉴别依据 Tapley 等（2017），报告七只成年雄性吻肛长 26.7—30.5 毫米。描述背面、体侧及四肢背面有带深色刺的疣粒，趾无蹼而具狭窄侧缘，体侧后部及近腹股沟股前部呈红橙色。繁殖雄性第二指基部背侧具密集婚刺，并有咽下声囊。本段鉴别未提供雌性测量；雄性第二指特征不扩展至第一指或繁殖日历。
title: Generic classification of Asian horned toads (Anura: Megophryidae: Megophryinae) and monograph of Chinese species

name: Boulenophrys sangzhiensis
readScope: Boulenophrys sangzhiensis: Named species types, examined specimens, diagnosis, distribution and applicable remarks; no source figures or supplements reproduced; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

RESULTS > Boulenophrys sangzhiensis; Diagnosis characters 1, 4, 7, 9 and 11; reading-sections index 37, section s03.53
sections: distribution
Tianping and Huping mountain records
天平山及壶瓶山记录

Male holotype CIB 200078 came from Tianping Mountain, Sangzhi, Hunan, at 1300 m. The monograph examined additional Tianping adults at about 1380 m and summarized known Tianping and Huping localities in northwestern Hunan at 1300–1400 m. These reported localities and sample elevations are not a complete range survey or evidence of absence elsewhere.
雄性正模 CIB 200078 来自湖南桑植天平山海拔 1300 米。专著检查天平山约 1380 米的额外成体，并将湖南西北部已知天平山及壶瓶山地点综合为海拔 1300—1400 米。这些报告地点及样本海拔不是完整分布调查或其他地点缺失的证据。
morphology
Six examined adults with finger-specific tubercles
六只检查成体与指位专属关节下瘤

The diagnosis reported two adult males at 55.7–62.2 mm snout–vent length and four females at 62.2–76.3 mm. It described weak vomerine ridges without teeth, distinct subarticular tubercles at fingers I and II but absent on the other fingers, and rudimentary basal toe webbing without fringes. Breeding males had sparse tiny black nuptial spines on the dorsal bases of fingers I and II and a subgular vocal sac. These sampled characters and measurements are not universal adult size bounds or measured functional performance.
鉴别报告两只成年雄性吻肛长 55.7—62.2 毫米、四只雌性 62.2—76.3 毫米。描述犁骨棱较弱而无齿，第一及第二指关节下瘤明显而其他指缺失，趾基部具退化蹼而无侧缘。繁殖雄性第一及第二指基部背侧有稀疏微小黑色婚刺，并有咽下声囊。这些样本特征及测量不是通用成年体型界限或测量的功能表现。
title: Generic classification of Asian horned toads (Anura: Megophryidae: Megophryinae) and monograph of Chinese species

name: Boulenophrys spinata
readScope: Boulenophrys spinata: Named species types, examined specimens, diagnosis, distribution and applicable remarks; no source figures or supplements reproduced; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sectionLocators: RESULTS > Boulenophrys spinata; Holotype, Specimens examined and Distribution; reading-sections index 38, section s03.54
RESULTS > Boulenophrys spinata; Diagnosis characters 1, 5, 9 and 11; reading-sections index 38, section s03.54
RESULTS > Boulenophrys spinata; Remarks, together with qianbeiensis and fanjingmontis Distribution caveats at indices 35 and 30; reading-sections index 38, section s03.54
sections: distribution
Leishan locality account after taxonomic restriction
分类限制后的雷山地点记录

Male holotype CIB 24339, formerly CIB 63II0615, came from Getou, Fangxiang, Leishan, Guizhou, at 1100 m. The monograph examined two males from Leigong Mountain at approximately 1620 m and restricted its recognized distribution to Leishan at 800–1800 m. This is the paper’s taxonomically revised locality account, not a demonstration of continuous occupancy or physiological elevation limits.
雄性正模 CIB 24339（原 CIB 63II0615）来自贵州雷山方祥格头海拔 1100 米。专著检查雷公山约 1620 米的两只雄性，并将认可分布限制为雷山海拔 800—1800 米。这是论文经过分类修订的地点记录，不是连续占据或生理海拔极限证明。
morphology
New male measurements and unit gaps in cited values
新雄性测量与引用数值的单位缺口

The two newly examined males measured 49.6–51.6 mm snout–vent length. The diagnosis also cited historical values of 47.2–54.4 for eighteen males and 54.0–55.0 for two females without printing units beside those endpoints; their unit remains uncertified here rather than silently supplied. Anatomical descriptions included spiny dorsal granules, one-third toe webbing with wide fringes, and large sparse black conical nuptial spines on fingers I and II in breeding males, with a subgular vocal sac. Historical samples are not combined with the new two-male series.
两只新检查雄性吻肛长为 49.6—51.6 毫米。鉴别另引十八只历史雄性 47.2—54.4 及两只雌性 54.0—55.0，但端点旁未打印单位；此处不默默补单位，仍标为未认证。解剖描述包括具刺背部颗粒、三分之一趾蹼及宽侧缘，以及繁殖雄性第一、第二指大型稀疏黑色锥形婚刺和咽下声囊。历史样本不与新两只雄性系列合并。
taxonomy
Former broad records divided among unresolved and named lineages
先前广域记录分配至已命名及未解决谱系

The remarks cited molecular evidence that the formerly broad B. spinata populations were paraphyletic. The monograph assigned northern regional records to B. qianbeiensis and northeastern Guizhou/southeastern Chongqing records to B. fanjingmontis, while restricting B. spinata to Leishan using voucher and molecular evidence. The corresponding qianbeiensis and fanjingmontis accounts still required further molecular vouchers for some historical assignments. A separate Guangxi lineage remained taxonomically unresolved because vouchers were unavailable. These reassignment decisions and unresolved cases are retained with their evidence limits, not converted into new species names or verified records.

备注引用分子证据，指出先前广域 B. spinata 种群构成并系。专著将北部区域记录归于 B. qianbeiensis、贵州东北部及重庆东南部记录归于 B. fanjingmontis，并依据凭证及分子证据将 B. spinata 限于雷山。对应 qianbeiensis、fanjingmontis 条目仍要求部分历史归属有更多分子凭证。单独广西谱系因缺少凭证而分类地位未解决。这些重分配决定及未解决项连同证据限制保留，不转为新增种名或已验证记录。
title: Generic classification of Asian horned toads (Anura: Megophryidae: Megophryinae) and monograph of Chinese species

name: Boulenophrys wuliangshanensis
readScope: Boulenophrys wuliangshanensis: Named species types, examined specimens, diagnosis, distribution and applicable remarks; no source figures or supplements reproduced; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

sections: distribution
Type elevation and examined sites outside the summary
模式海拔与位于综合之外的检查地点

Male holotype CIB 98010, formerly CIB 890126, came from Xinmin, Wuliang Mountain, Jingdong, Yunnan, at 1200 m. The monograph explicitly corrected the printed longitude minutes from 75 to 45. It examined Huangcaoling material at about 2400 m and Ailao material at about 1980 m, while its wider southwestern Yunnan distribution summary gave 2000–2400 m. Both the 1200 m type elevation and 1980 m examined locality remain separate from that narrower summary; no unexplained correction is invented.
雄性正模 CIB 98010（原 CIB 890126）来自云南景东无量山新民海拔 1200 米。专著明确将打印经度分数从 75 修订为 45。检查黄草岭约 2400 米及哀牢山约 1980 米材料，而云南西南部更广分布综合给出 2000—2400 米。1200 米模式海拔及 1980 米检查地点均与较窄综合分别保留，不编造无解释的修正。
morphology
Nine measured adults with unwebbed toes
九只测量成体与无蹼趾

The examined diagnosis reported four adult males at 25.9–28.5 mm snout–vent length and five females at 32.1–38.0 mm. The separately listed historical type series included juveniles and tadpoles, which are not added to these measured adult denominators. Anatomy included no vomerine ridges or teeth, toes without webbing or lateral fringes, and brown nuptial spines on the dorsal bases of fingers I and II in breeding males, with a subgular vocal sac. These observations do not establish population-wide size limits or breeding-season dates.
检查鉴别报告四只成年雄性吻肛长 25.9—28.5 毫米、五只雌性 32.1—38.0 毫米。另列历史模式系列包括幼体及蝌蚪，不加入这些所测成体分母。解剖包括无犁骨棱及齿、趾无蹼及侧缘，以及繁殖雄性第一及第二指基部背侧棕色婚刺和咽下声囊。这些观察不能确定整个种群体型极限或繁殖季节日期。
title: Generic classification of Asian horned toads (Anura: Megophryidae: Megophryinae) and monograph of Chinese species

name: Boulenophrys shuichengensis
readScope: Boulenophrys shuichengensis: The 2023 species treatment: historical types, cited diagnosis, distribution and both remarks paragraphs; dated interpretation kept separate from the already authored 2026 study; no source figures or supplements reproduced; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

RESULTS > Boulenophrys shuichengensis; Diagnosis characters 1, 4, 9 and 11 and first Remarks paragraph; reading-sections index 70, section s03.86
RESULTS > Boulenophrys shuichengensis; first Remarks paragraph and Paratypes; reading-sections index 70, section s03.86
RESULTS > Boulenophrys shuichengensis; second Remarks paragraph; reading-sections index 70, section s03.86
sections: distribution
The restricted locality account published in 2023
2023 年发表的受限地点记录

The 2023 monograph listed female holotype LTHC 944001 from Fenghuang, Liupanshui, Guizhou, at 1850 m, noting the change from historical Shuicheng County to Zhongshan District. It then recognized the type-locality area at 1800–1870 m and considered a northern Guizhou Suiyang record suspect because associated voucher numbers were absent. This is explicitly the 2023 assessment; it does not replace the separately authored 2026 account of Yunnan adults and Guizhou larvae or establish absence at other sites.
2023 年专著列雌性正模 LTHC 944001 来自贵州六盘水凤凰海拔 1850 米，并注明历史水城县至钟山区的区划变化。当时认可模式地点区域海拔 1800—1870 米，并因缺少相关凭证编号而将贵州北部绥阳记录视为可疑。此处明确为 2023 年评估，不替代另行编写的 2026 年云南成体及贵州幼体记录，也不能确定其他地点缺失。
morphology
Cited adult sizes and contradictory vocal-sac descriptions
引用成体体型与声囊描述冲突

The 2023 diagnosis synthesized earlier descriptions, reporting eight males at 102.0–118.3 mm snout–vent length and seven females at 99.8–115.6 mm. These are cited diagnostic samples rather than newly measured adults in that treatment. Anatomy included vomerine ridges without teeth and one-third webbing of the fourth toe with wide lateral fringes. The diagnosis stated that collected males lacked nuptial pads or spines and subgular vocal sacs; the remarks retained the conflict between an earlier report of a vocal sac and a later revision to absence. That historical conflict is not resolved by assigning the 2026 handling-associated sounds as advertisement calls.
2023 年鉴别综合早期描述，报告八只雄性吻肛长 102.0—118.3 毫米、七只雌性 99.8—115.6 毫米。这些是引用鉴别样本，而非该处理新测量成体。解剖包括犁骨棱而无齿，第四趾具三分之一蹼及宽侧缘。鉴别称采集雄性无婚垫、婚刺及咽下声囊；备注保留早期报告有声囊与后期修订为缺失之间的冲突。该历史冲突不能通过把 2026 年手持时声音指定为广告鸣声来解决。
taxonomy
Unresolved type-series counts in the 2023 review
2023 年审查中未解决的模式系列计数

The remarks compared an original designation of seven male, three female and thirty-four tadpole paratypes with a measurement table listing a male allotype and only five male paratypes. The monograph regarded the allotype designation as invalid and kept the male paratype count uncertain because voucher numbers were unavailable and later re-designation did not settle it. It also described the 2000 use of the same holotype for another new-species description as creating an objective synonym. These are attributed nomenclatural interpretations; missing voucher identities and counts are not reconstructed.
备注比较原始指定的七只雄性、三只雌性及三十四只蝌蚪副模，与测量表所列一只雄性异模及仅五只雄性副模。专著将异模指定视为无效，并因缺少凭证编号且后续重新指定未解决问题，而保留雄性副模计数不确定。文中还将 2000 年使用同一正模再次描述新种解释为产生客观异名。这些是注明归属的命名解释，不重建缺失凭证身份及计数。
evolution
The evidence boundary of the 2023 group placement
2023 年种组归属的证据边界

The 2023 remarks stated that available molecular data were lacking and the phylogenetic placement was uncertain. Placement in Boulenophrys relied on morphological similarity, while its assignment to the boettgeri group followed two anonymous reviewers’ unpublished phylogenetic suggestions of affinity with B. caudoprocta. This records the basis of that dated decision; unpublished reviewer information is not presented as a publicly reproducible sequence analysis, and the 2023 lack-of-data statement is not asserted as a complete assessment of later research.
2023 年备注称当时缺少可用分子数据，系统发育位置不确定。归入 Boulenophrys 依据形态相似性，而归入 boettgeri 种组则遵循两位匿名审稿者关于与 B. caudoprocta 近缘的未发表系统发育建议。这里记录该有年代限定决定的依据；未发表审稿信息不作为公开可重复的序列分析，2023 年缺数据表述也不作为对后期研究的完整评估。
title: Generic classification of Asian horned toads (Anura: Megophryidae: Megophryinae) and monograph of Chinese species

name: Boulenophrys dupanglingensis
readScope: Boulenophrys dupanglingensis: Species treatment holotype, paratypes, diagnosis, live/preserved coloration, sexual size dimorphism and Distribution and habitats; sample discrepancy retained; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

sections: ecology
Low-elevation forest-litter records at Dupangling
都庞岭低海拔林地落叶记录

The 2025 description placed male holotype HUNU 22SA01 at Dajiangyuan, Daoxian, Hunan, at 380 m, collected on 20 April 2022. Female paratypes came from Daguyuan, Jiangyong, at recorded elevations of 442 and 451 m. The account knew the species only from Dupangling National Nature Reserve and observed frogs in leaf litter of evergreen secondary forest, typically near mountain streams, at 380–451 m. These surveyed localities and substrates do not establish the complete current range or an obligatory habitat requirement.
2025 年描述将雄性正模 HUNU 22SA01 列于湖南道县大江源海拔 380 米，采集日期为 2022 年 4 月 20 日。雌性副模来自江永大古源，记录海拔为 442 及 451 米。记述当时仅从都庞岭国家级自然保护区了解本种，在海拔 380—451 米常绿次生林落叶层观察到个体，通常邻近山溪。这些调查地点及基质不能确定完整当前范围或必需栖息条件。
morphology
Diagnostic measurements and a separate six-male comparison
鉴别测量与单独六只雄性比较

The diagnosis reported seven adult males at 37.6–40.2 mm snout–vent length and three females at 41.8–45.9 mm. Its male mean was 38.9 with an accompanying ±1.3 value, whereas the sexual-size paragraph used six males with mean 38.8 and ±0.9 and called females larger. These different male denominators and summaries are retained rather than pooled; the error-statistic type is not certified from these paragraphs. Anatomy included a vomerine ridge without teeth, a rounded unnotched tongue margin, and rudimentary toe webbing without lateral fringes. The description’s dimorphism conclusion remains attributed to this small type sample.
鉴别报告七只成年雄性吻肛长 37.6—40.2 毫米、三只雌性 41.8—45.9 毫米。雄性鉴别均值为 38.9，伴随 ±1.3 数值，而两性体型段采用六只雄性，均值 38.8、伴随 ±0.9，并称雌性更大。这些不同雄性分母及综合分别保留，不作合并；仅从这些段落不认证误差统计类型。解剖包括有犁骨棱而无齿、舌缘圆且后部无缺刻，以及无侧缘的退化趾蹼。描述的两性体型结论注明归属并限于此小型模式样本。
morphology
Holotype colour before and after preservation
正模保存前后的颜色

The live holotype account described red-orange groin colour, a light-salmon throat, chest and ventral body with dark-brown patches, and a yellowish-brown iris. The preservative account described dorsal fading to greyish brown, an interorbital triangular marking and dorsal V mark, and ventral fading to greyish white with markings becoming indistinct. These are observations of the holotype under different conditions, not interchangeable live-colour descriptions or a quantified species-wide colour distribution.
活体正模记述描述腹股沟红橙色，喉、胸及腹面浅鲑色并有深褐斑，虹膜黄褐色。保存状态记述描述背部褪为灰褐色，眼间三角斑及背部 V 形斑，腹面褪为灰白色且斑纹变得不明显。这些是正模在不同状态下的观察，不是可互换的活体颜色描述或量化全种颜色分布。
reproduction
Calls and mature eggs support a dated breeding inference
鸣声及成熟卵支持有年代限定的繁殖推测

The authors recorded male calls between April and June and found mature creamy-white eggs in females collected during that period. They suggested that breeding includes those months; the observations do not establish its complete beginning or end. Adult males had a single internal subgular vocal sac and developed prominent black nuptial spines at the dorsal bases of fingers I and II during breeding condition. No tadpoles were encountered, so the account did not establish larval habitat or development.
作者在四月至六月记录雄性鸣声，并在该期间采集雌性中发现成熟乳白色卵，因而推测繁殖包括这些月份；观察未确定完整起始或结束。成年雄性有单个内部咽下声囊，繁殖状态时第一及第二指基部背侧出现明显黑色婚刺。未遇到蝌蚪，因此该记述未确定幼体栖息地或发育过程。
title: A New Species of the Genus Boulenophrys (Anura, Megophryidae) from Southern Hunan Province, Central China †

readScope: Brachycephalus coloratus: Named species holotype, type-series variation, live/preserved coloration, habitat/distribution and applicable remarks; no figures or source CT images reproduced; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

sections: morphology
Nine type adults with sex-specific size summaries
九只模式成体的分性别体型综合

The 2017 description reported five adult males with snout–vent lengths of 10.3–10.6 mm, mean ± standard deviation 10.4 ± 0.1 mm, and four females at 12.2–13.3 mm, mean ± standard deviation 12.9 ± 0.5 mm. Male holotype MHNCI 10273 measured 10.3 mm. The paper’s broader adult diagnostic interval of 10.3–13.3 mm combines these sex samples; it does not establish universal size limits or a population-level estimate of sexual dimorphism.
2017 年描述报告五只成年雄性吻肛长 10.3—10.6 毫米，均值 ± 标准差 10.4 ± 0.1 毫米；四只雌性为 12.2—13.3 毫米，均值 ± 标准差 12.9 ± 0.5 毫米。雄性正模 MHNCI 10273 为 10.3 毫米。论文较广成体鉴别区间 10.3—13.3 毫米结合这些性别样本，不确定通用体型极限或种群层面的两性异形估计。
morphology
Three main live colours change after preservation
保存后改变的三种主要活体颜色

The live holotype had a pale-red dorsum from head to pelvic region, yellowish-green body sides and dorsal thighs, yellow chin and ventral limbs, and a black iris. In preservative the reddish region became caramel and the greenish regions became dark brown. The diagnosis combined live coloration with a smooth dorsum and absence of osteoderms. These are the description’s observed diagnostic traits, not interchangeable live and preserved colours or a stand-alone identification test for every population.
活体正模从头至骨盆区域背面浅红，体侧及股背面黄绿，颏及四肢腹面黄，虹膜黑。保存后红色区域变为焦糖色，绿色区域变为深褐色。鉴别将活体颜色与背面光滑、无皮骨结合。这些是描述观察的鉴别特征，不是可互换的活体及保存颜色，也不是适用于每个种群的独立鉴定测试。
ecology
Type-locality leaf litter and neighbouring nondetections
模式地点落叶层与邻近未检出记录

The male holotype came from Estância Hidroclimática Recreio da Serra in Serra da Baitaca, Piraquara, Paraná, Brazil, at 1144 m. The account knew the species from that locality, on the ground beneath leaf litter in high-elevation forest with montane elements below about 1180 m. Visits to neighbouring Pão de Ló, 4.96 km away, in October 2015 and January 2016 found no evidence of the species. Those nondetections belong to the reported visits and do not establish permanent absence or a complete present-day range.

雄性正模来自巴西巴拉那州 Piraquara、Serra da Baitaca 的 Estância Hidroclimática Recreio da Serra，海拔 1144 米。记述当时仅从该地点了解本种，见于高海拔林地面落叶下，约 1180 米以下混有山地林成分。2015 年十月及 2016 年一月访问直线相距 4.96 千米的邻近 Pão de Ló 未发现本种证据。这些未检出限定于报告访问，不能确定永久缺失或完整当前范围。
conservation
Road-development concern and a dated assessment proposal
道路开发担忧与有年代限定的评估建议

The authors raised concern about a planned road in the type-locality development, while reporting a resident’s statement that land above 1000 m would not be occupied. A frog record 130 m from the Serra da Baitaca State Park boundary motivated a recommendation to search the park. They proposed Data Deficient status because available information was limited. These are the 2017 paper’s development information and assessment proposal, not a verified current road plan, a confirmed park occurrence or an official current IUCN listing.
作者对模式地点开发项目拟建道路提出担忧，同时报告居民称 1000 米以上土地不会被占用。一条距 Serra da Baitaca 州立公园边界 130 米的蛙记录促使作者建议调查公园。因可用信息有限，作者提出数据缺乏等级。这些是 2017 年论文的开发信息及评估建议，不是已验证当前道路计划、已确认公园出现或官方当前 IUCN 列级。
title: Two new species of the Brachycephalus pernix group (Anura: Brachycephalidae) from the state of Paraná, southern Brazil

sections: morphology
Fourteen adult measurements in the type series
模式系列中的十四只成体测量

Male holotype MHNCI 10280 came from Serra do Salto, São José dos Pinhais, Paraná, Brazil, at 1120 m and measured 9.7 mm snout–vent length. Ten male measurements had mean ± standard deviation 9.9 ± 0.7 mm and range 8.9–10.7 mm; four females had mean ± standard deviation 10.1 ± 1.7 mm and range 8.3–12.3 mm. Most individuals were dark brown, with some small ventral yellow dots described. These sample summaries do not establish universal size limits or statistically demonstrated population-level sexual dimorphism.

雄性正模 MHNCI 10280 来自巴西巴拉那州 São José dos Pinhais、Serra do Salto 海拔 1120 米，吻肛长 9.7 毫米。十只雄性测量均值 ± 标准差为 9.9 ± 0.7 毫米，范围 8.9—10.7 毫米；四只雌性均值 ± 标准差为 10.1 ± 1.7 毫米，范围 8.3—12.3 毫米。多数个体深褐，部分描述有腹面小黄点。这些样本综合不能确定通用体型极限或统计证明的种群层面两性异形。
ecology
Patchy local records and habitat-associated density estimates
斑块状地方记录与生境相关密度估计

The 2017 account knew the species from the type locality in montane, transitional high-elevation and secondary forest, often with Chusquea bamboo. Along approximately 700 m of transect, records were patchy. The authors estimated one individual per about 2–3 m² in bamboo-dominated areas, compared with one per about 6–7 or 15–16 m² where bamboo was less common, and hypothesized a role for litter quality, vegetation and slope. These are local estimates and an attributed hypothesis, not a range-wide census or a demonstrated causal bamboo effect. The cited extent-of-occurrence estimate of 2211 ha is not the area actually occupied by frogs.

2017 年记述当时仅从模式地点了解本种，涉及山地林、向高海拔林过渡的林地及次生林，常见 Chusquea 竹。约 700 米样带上的记录呈斑块状。作者估计竹占优势区域约每 2—3 平方米一只，竹较少区域约每 6—7 或 15—16 平方米一只，并假设落叶质量、植被及坡度可能起作用。这些是地方估计及注明归属的假说，而非全分布区普查或已证明的竹类因果效应。所引分布范围估计 2211 公顷不是蛙实际占据面积。
reproduction
Daytime calling does not make capture rate a density measure
日间鸣声不把捕获率变成密度测量

Males called beneath leaf litter throughout the day, with stronger activity in the morning and late day and reduced activity during warmer periods around 11:00–16:00. Despite describing the frog as locally abundant, the researchers reported capture success of about 0.5 specimen per researcher per field day and difficulty locating calls in cryptically coloured litter. That effort-based capture rate is not converted to population density, and the daily calling pattern does not establish a complete annual breeding season.
雄性白天在落叶下鸣叫，早晨及较晚时段活动更强，约 11:00—16:00 较暖时段活动减弱。研究者虽称蛙在当地较多，却报告每位研究者每野外日约捕获 0.5 只，并描述落叶中隐蔽颜色及鸣声定位困难。这种按努力量计算的捕获率不转为种群密度，日内鸣声模式也不能确定完整年度繁殖季节。
ecology
One stomach observation and an attributed relationship
一次胃内观察与注明归属的近缘关系

A CT scan of paratype MHNCI 10285 revealed one large isopod in its stomach. This documents one consumed prey item, not a fixed species diet. The remarks cited prior molecular delimitation as consistent with the diagnosis and placed B. curupira closest to B. izecksohni among described species, although the brown B. brunneus looked more similar. This illustrates the paper’s distinction between morphological resemblance and cited phylogenetic affinity; it is not a new independent phylogenetic analysis of every population.
副模 MHNCI 10285 的 CT 扫描显示胃内一只大型等足类。这记录一个已摄食项目，而非固定物种食谱。备注引用早期分子界定与鉴别一致，并将 B. curupira 列为已描述种中最接近 B. izecksohni，尽管棕色 B. brunneus 外观更相似。这体现论文对形态相似与引用系统发育近缘的区分，不是对每个种群的新独立系统发育分析。
title: Two new species of the Brachycephalus pernix group (Anura: Brachycephalidae) from the state of Paraná, southern Brazil

sections: morphology
Orange adults and fluorescence under ultraviolet excitation
橙色成体与紫外激发下的荧光

The 2021 diagnosis reported adult male snout–vent lengths of 13.46–15.92 mm and female lengths of 16.04–17.69 mm, without sample counts in that paragraph. Its combination of traits included an orange, bufoniform body and spotted skull and postcranial plates forming a trapezoidal bony shield, while explicitly reporting no osteoderms. The live-colour account described black eyes and fluorescence seen using a 395-nm ultraviolet flashlight. These are the reported measurements and observations under excitation; they do not establish population size limits, visibility to predators, a signalling function or toxicity.
2021 年鉴别报告成年雄性吻肛长 13.46—15.92 毫米，雌性 16.04—17.69 毫米，该段未提供样本数。特征组合包括橙色、蟾蜍状体形，带斑点的颅骨及颅后骨板组成梯形骨盾，同时明确记为无皮骨。活体颜色记述眼黑，并用 395 纳米紫外手电观察到荧光。这些是报告测量及激发条件下的观察，不能确定种群体型极限、捕食者可见性、信号功能或毒性。
reproduction
Pulsed calls with notes and males kept as different denominators
脉冲鸣声中分开的音符与雄性样本量

The bioacoustic methods state that five males were recorded. The results described five call series containing 408 notes, interpreted as advertisement calls, with a note equivalent to one call. The longest series exceeded 265 notes but its beginning was not recorded. Detailed results give note durations of 0.13–0.24 s from 204 measured notes, intervals of 0.11–0.22 s from 198 intervals, 8–13 pulses per note and dominant frequencies of 2.84–4.52 kHz. Notes, intervals, series and frogs are different sampling units. The diagnosis instead prints a duration interval of “0.13–014 s”; that malformed endpoint is retained as a source conflict and is not silently corrected or substituted for the detailed result.

声学方法称录制了五只雄性。结果描述五组鸣声序列含 408 个音符，作者解释为广告鸣声，单个音符相当于一次鸣声。最长序列超过 265 个音符，但未录到起始部分。详细结果给出 204 个测量音符时长 0.13—0.24 秒、198 个间隔时长 0.11—0.22 秒、每音符 8—13 个脉冲及主频 2.84—4.52 千赫。音符、间隔、序列及蛙是不同抽样单位。鉴别却印出时长区间“0.13–014 s”；保留这个格式异常端点为来源冲突，不静默纠正，也不替代详细结果。
ecology
Two forest sites with different litter and perch settings
落叶及停栖环境不同的两处林地

At Projeto Dacnis, 842 m, the account described a small slow stream, wet or swampy ground and neighbouring slopes with bushes, roots, branches and variable canopy. Frogs were commonly found on slopes and low vegetation, and during drier conditions more often beneath litter. Reserva das Araucárias, 1299 m, was described as flatter forest with dense canopy, deep litter, muddy soil, moss, rocks and fallen wood. At both sites most observed perches were at or below 30 cm; one male perched at 140 cm, and both sexes perched. These observations describe sampled microhabitats, not a complete elevational range, a required perch height or a measured causal effect of vegetation.

Projeto Dacnis 海拔 842 米，记述有小型缓流溪、潮湿或沼泽地面，以及带灌丛、根、枝条及变化林冠的邻近坡地。蛙常见于坡地及低矮植被，较干条件下更常藏于落叶下。Reserva das Araucárias 海拔 1299 米，描述为较平坦林地，林冠密、落叶厚，具泥地、苔藓、岩石及倒木。两地多数观察停栖处在 30 厘米及以下，一只雄性停在 140 厘米，雌雄均有停栖。这些观察描述所采样微生境，不是完整海拔范围、必需停栖高度或已测量的植被因果效应。
ecology
Rainfall association across 370 observations
370 次观察中的降雨关联

The activity account used 370 observations and reported a positive association between monthly abundance observations and rainfall, R² = 0.25 and p = 0.005. Frogs were found through the year except May–July in that study, with a September–February peak; one rainy September 2019 survey found 38 specimens. Persistent drizzle could coincide with activity despite low monthly precipitation, so the discussion of months below 200 mm is not treated as a hard physiological threshold. Soil humidity was not measured. Activity below 16 °C during drizzle likewise records field conditions, not a laboratory critical thermal endpoint. Observation counts do not certify 370 unique individuals or population size.

活动记述使用 370 次观察，并报告月度数量观察与降雨正相关，R² = 0.25、p = 0.005。该研究除五月至七月外全年发现蛙，九月至二月为高峰；2019 年九月一次雨期调查发现 38 只。月降水较低时持续细雨也可能伴随活动，因此不把关于低于 200 毫米月份的讨论当作严格生理阈值。土壤湿度未测。细雨时低于 16 摄氏度仍活动同样记录野外条件，而非实验室临界热端点。观察次数不能证明 370 只独立个体或种群大小。
reproduction
Daytime calling and limited night observations
日间鸣叫与有限夜间观察

Seven of the 370 observations occurred at night, when the frogs were inactive beneath litter and no calls were heard. The remaining observations were in daylight, including late afternoon; calls and amplexus were observed in the morning and afternoon. The authors did not measure an activity profile for individual daytime hours. This evidence supports the reported predominance of daytime activity at the surveyed sites; it does not prove absence of every nocturnal behaviour, identify a complete breeding season or quantify reproductive success.
370 次观察中七次发生在夜间，蛙在落叶下不活动，未听到鸣声。其余观察在日间，包括下午较晚时段；早晨及下午观察到鸣叫与抱对。作者未测量各日间小时的活动曲线。这支持调查地点报告的日间活动占优势，不能证明所有夜间行为缺失、确定完整繁殖季节或量化繁殖成功。
ecology
Gaping observations and clay models do not establish predation
张口观察与黏土模型不确定实际捕食

Three handled specimens gaped, and the account also described escape responses. In a clay-model trial, a slaty-breasted wood-rail, Aramides saracura, grasped and moved a yellow frog model. The authors could not be sure that the bird recognized it as Brachycephalus, and they observed no predation on actual frogs. Suggestions that orange colours could resemble forest objects or that yellow failed to warn this bird remain interpretations. Handling responses and model interactions do not establish a natural predator list, toxicity or experimentally demonstrated camouflage.
三只被处理个体张口，记述也描述逃逸反应。在黏土模型试验中，一只 Aramides saracura 秧鸡抓取并移动黄色蛙模型。作者不能确定鸟是否将它认作 Brachycephalus，且未观察到对真实蛙的捕食。橙色可能类似林地物体、或黄色未能警告这只鸟的建议仍属解释。处理反应及模型互动不能确定自然捕食者名录、毒性或经实验证明的伪装。
conservation
A dated wild-boar concern requiring direct evidence
需要直接证据的有年代限定的野猪担忧

The 2021 paper reported increasing invasive wild boar, Sus scrofa, in São Francisco Xavier and proposed that their foraging through soil and litter could damage the frog’s microhabitat. It explicitly acknowledged that scientific evidence for this effect was unavailable and called for further studies. The statement is retained as a dated concern and research hypothesis, not a demonstrated decline in B. rotenbergae, a quantified present-day boar trend or an official conservation assessment.
2021 年论文报告 São Francisco Xavier 的入侵野猪 Sus scrofa 增加，并提出其在土壤及落叶中的觅食可能损害蛙微生境。论文明确承认当时缺乏这一效应的科学证据，呼吁进一步研究。该陈述保留为有年代限定的担忧及研究假说，不是 B. rotenbergae 已证明的下降、已量化当前野猪趋势或官方保护评估。
title: Hidden by the name: A new fluorescent pumpkin toadlet from the Brachycephalus ephippium group (Anura: Brachycephalidae)

name: Brachycephalus sulfuratus
readScope: Brachycephalus sulfuratus: Methods, diagnosis, geographical occurrence records and Conclusions; original-description claims distinguished from reviewed evidence; no tables, figures or audio reproduced; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

Materials and Methods; reading-sections index 0, paragraph 3; Results > Diagnosis; index 1, paragraphs 2–5

Results > Geographical occurrence records; reading-sections index 2, paragraphs 1–2; Conclusions, index 4, paragraph 1
Conclusions; reading-sections index 4, paragraph 3; Materials and Methods, index 0, paragraph 5
sections: morphology
Variable yellow blotches limit visual identification
变化的黄色斑块限制外观鉴定

The 2021 review found that the yellow ventral blotches proposed in the original description varied in location and amount and could be virtually absent. Of three specimens collected near the Jurupará dam, two lacked yellow ventral spots but were assigned to B. sulfuratus using advertisement calls. The review also found that the proposed inverted-V and M-shaped cloacal marks were variable or shared. Its authors reported no unique morphological character separating the two species in either live or preserved material. They used live yellow blotches as supporting evidence for B. sulfuratus, while absence of yellow left identity unresolved between it and B. hermogenesi; preservation altered the useful colours.

2021 年复核发现，原描述提出的腹面黄色斑块位置及数量变化，且可近乎缺失。Jurupará 水坝附近采集的三只标本中，两只无腹面黄斑，但用广告鸣声归为 B. sulfuratus。复核也发现所提泄殖腔倒 V 形及 M 形标记变化或共享。作者报告活体或保存材料中均无区分这两种的独有形态特征。他们以活体黄斑支持 B. sulfuratus 鉴定，而无黄色则不能解决它与 B. hermogenesi 的身份区分；保存会改变有用颜色。
reproduction
A diagnosis depends on the definition of a call
依赖鸣声定义的鉴别

Under the review’s note-centred approach, a continuous sequence of notes forms a call. B. sulfuratus had at most eight notes per call, all isolated, compared with at least 24 notes and both isolated notes and note groups in B. hermogenesi. The authors found 2–14 pulses per B. sulfuratus note, broader than the original description’s 7–11. Previously reported frequency intervals overlapped, so frequency alone was not the proposed distinction. If each note is instead called a whole call, these call-level note counts cannot be transferred unchanged. The reported limits are the review’s diagnostic sample summaries, not universal experimentally established limits for all populations.

复核采用以音符为中心的方法，连续音符序列组成一次鸣声。B. sulfuratus 每次至多八个音符，均独立；B. hermogenesi 则至少 24 个音符，并有独立音符及音符组。作者发现 B. sulfuratus 每音符 2—14 个脉冲，比原描述 7—11 更广。先前报告频率区间重叠，因此频率本身不是所提区别。若改将每个音符称为完整一次鸣声，这些鸣声层级音符数量不能原样转用。所报极值是复核的鉴别样本综合，不是针对所有种群经实验确定的通用极限。
ecology
Reviewed vouchers and acoustic records revise occurrence assignments
复核凭证及声学记录修订出现归属

The review reassigned vouchered records previously labelled Brachycephalus sp. nov. 1 using live yellow spots and call structure. Unvouchered records generally remained Brachycephalus sp., with B. sulfuratus considered probable; Castelo dos Bugres was an exception because later collected specimens confirmed identity. The Salto Morato reserve record was assigned using call MHNCI 133, and the authors extended that assignment to other historical records at the reserve. Separately, Paraná specimen ZUEC 16602 was left as Brachycephalus sp., probably B. sulfuratus, because reliable live-colour evidence was uncertain. These are different evidence strengths, not equally verified occurrences.

复核利用活体黄斑及鸣声结构，将先前标为 Brachycephalus sp. nov. 1 的有凭证记录重新归属。无凭证记录通常仍留为 Brachycephalus sp.，认为可能是 B. sulfuratus；Castelo dos Bugres 例外，因为后来采得标本确认身份。Salto Morato 保护区记录用鸣声 MHNCI 133 归属，作者进一步将该归属用于区内其他历史记录。另外，巴拉那州标本 ZUEC 16602 因可靠活体颜色证据不确定，保留为 Brachycephalus sp.、可能是 B. sulfuratus。这些证据强度不同，不能作为同等已验证出现记录。
ecology
Unresolved São Paulo records are not a certified range union
未解决的圣保罗记录不构成已认证范围并集

For several historical São Paulo records called B. hermogenesi, the review found insufficient details for reassessment and proposed reverting them to Brachycephalus sp., potentially either species. A Piedade genetic record was interpreted as possibly B. sulfuratus, not a universally resolved identity. Six localities listed as B. hermogenesi in the original sulfuratus description were also proposed to remain unidentified because preserved material might not distinguish them. The paper concluded that B. sulfuratus extended farther north than previously thought and proposed investigating possible contact southeast of São Paulo city. These dated interpretations do not convert all uncertain historical sites into confirmed B. sulfuratus localities or demonstrate sympatry of the two named species.

对于若干历史称为 B. hermogenesi 的圣保罗记录，复核发现细节不足，建议退回 Brachycephalus sp.，可能属于任一种。Piedade 遗传记录被解释为可能是 B. sulfuratus，而非普遍已解决身份。sulfuratus 原描述中列为 B. hermogenesi 的六个地点也被建议保留未定，因为保存材料可能无法区分。论文结论认为 B. sulfuratus 比先前认识向北更远，并建议调查圣保罗市东南可能接触。这些有年代限定的解释不把所有不确定历史地点转换为已确认 B. sulfuratus 地点，也不证明两个命名种同域。
evolution
Similar calls do not certify a single species across the range
相似鸣声不认证全范围仅有一个物种

Using available mitochondrial 12S and 16S sequences in a concatenated, midpoint-rooted analysis, the authors interpreted B. sulfuratus as probably including more than one species under the name. They nevertheless reported a similar calling pattern across its reviewed range from southeastern São Paulo to Santa Catarina. This is an attributed 2021 taxonomic hypothesis: similarity of advertisement calls does not independently certify concept equivalence or remove the need for voucher, population and taxonomic revision work. No unnamed lineage is added here as an accepted species.
作者将可用线粒体 12S 及 16S 序列连接，作中点定根分析，并解释 B. sulfuratus 名下可能包含不止一个物种。同时，他们报告从圣保罗东南至圣卡塔琳娜的复核范围中鸣声模式相似。这是注明作者归属的 2021 年分类假说：广告鸣声相似不能独立认证概念等同，也不能免除凭证、种群及分类修订工作。这里不将未命名谱系加入为接受物种。

sections: reproduction
Isolated notes and note groups in the reviewed calls
复核鸣声中的独立音符与音符组

The 2021 review diagnosed B. hermogenesi by at least 24 notes per call, with isolated notes and groups, using a note-centred definition of a call. Its own groups contained 2–6 notes, compared with the previously reported 2–7; notes had 1–3 pulses in the review. Weak preceding notes provisionally termed attenuated notes were detected in only three calls, MHNCI 167, 183 and 215, and were not counted as part of the note groups. These counts describe the reviewed acoustic evidence, not a number of frogs or universal call limits; frequencies alone overlapped those previously reported for B. sulfuratus.

2021 年复核以每次鸣声至少 24 个音符、含独立音符及音符组鉴别 B. hermogenesi，采用以音符为中心的鸣声定义。其自有样本音符组含 2—6 个音符，先前报告为 2—7；复核中每音符 1—3 个脉冲。暂称衰减音符的弱前置音符仅在三次鸣声 MHNCI 167、183 及 215 检出，未计入音符组。这些数量描述复核声学证据，不是蛙数量或通用鸣声极限；先前报告的频率与 B. sulfuratus 重叠。
taxonomy
A possible second species in part of the type series
部分模式系列中可能存在第二个物种

Calls at Trilha do Corisco and part of Corcovado were attributed to an unidentified third flea toad, with groups usually of two notes, occasionally three, and up to 16 pulses per note. The review reported that this unnamed form and B. hermogenesi occurred together at Corcovado. Its conclusion suggested that the hermogenesi type series could include a second species associated with a paratype locality, probably not the holotype locality, and did not infer that the name was a synonym of another species. These are the authors’ dated assignments and uncertainty; the unnamed form is not treated as an accepted taxon or confused with B. sulfuratus.

Trilha do Corisco 及部分 Corcovado 鸣声被归于未鉴定的第三种微型蛙，音符组通常两个音符、偶为三个，每音符至多 16 个脉冲。复核报告该未命名形式与 B. hermogenesi 在 Corcovado 同处。结论提出 hermogenesi 模式系列可能含与副模地点关联的第二种，可能不涉及正模地点，未据此推断名称是另一种的异名。这些是作者有年代限定的归属及不确定性；未命名形式不作为接受分类单元，也不与 B. sulfuratus 混淆。
ecology
Historical names require locality-specific reassessment
历史名称需要逐地点复核

The review retained several São Paulo records formerly called B. hermogenesi as Brachycephalus sp. because adequate diagnostic evidence was unavailable. It proposed that previous southern-Brazil records instead belonged to B. sulfuratus, while its individual-record discussion explicitly retained uncertain or unvouchered records. Available mitochondrial evidence placed the Paraibuna specimen with hermogenesi specimens from the type locality, but did not certify every historical population. A coherent calling pattern across reviewed localities likewise did not establish that the name contained only one biological species. Range summaries should therefore preserve these record-level and dated taxonomic limits.

复核因缺乏充分鉴别证据，将若干先前称 B. hermogenesi 的圣保罗记录保留为 Brachycephalus sp.。它提出以往巴西南部记录应属 B. sulfuratus，同时逐记录讨论明确保留不确定及无凭证记录。可用线粒体证据将 Paraibuna 标本与模式地点 hermogenesi 标本放在一起，却不认证每个历史种群。复核地点间一致鸣声模式同样不确定名称下只有一个生物学物种。因此范围综合应保留这些逐记录及有年代限定的分类边界。

Three females and one juvenile in the Machay sample
Machay 样本的三只雌性及一只幼体

The 2022 account recorded adult females DHMECN 14412–14414 with reported body sizes of 26.58–33.57 mm and juvenile DHMECN 14415 at 12.38 mm. It described Toes IV and V as longer than I–III, a short rounded snout with a small rostral papilla and conical flank pustules. The juvenile is separate from the adult interval, and this local female sample does not establish a universal size range or sexual dimorphism.
2022 年记述记录成年雌性 DHMECN 14412—14414，所报体长 26.58—33.57 毫米，幼体 DHMECN 14415 为 12.38 毫米。记述描述第四及第五趾长于第一至第三趾、短圆吻具小吻乳突及体侧锥形疣。幼体与成体区间分开，这个地方雌性样本不能确定通用体型范围或两性异形。

Night perches and a dated third-locality report
夜间停栖与有年代限定的第三地点报告

The adult females were collected at night on bromeliad, palm and Neurolepis leaves 40–170 cm above ground; the juvenile was in a bromeliad at 20 cm. The Machay montane forest records were at 2430–2490 m, with low trees, bryophytes and bromeliads. The authors called Machay the third Ecuadorian locality relative to earlier knowledge. Under handling they observed slow escape movements and falling in a ball-like position. These records do not establish exclusive perch use, a complete modern range or effectiveness of the handling response against natural predators.
成年雌性夜间采于离地 40—170 厘米的凤梨科、棕榈及 Neurolepis 叶片；幼体在 20 厘米高凤梨科植物中。Machay 山地林记录海拔 2430—2490 米，具低矮树、苔藓及凤梨科植物。相对先前知识，作者称 Machay 为厄瓜多尔第三地点。处理时观察到缓慢逃逸及蜷球状下落。这些记录不确定专一停栖使用、完整现代范围或处理反应对自然捕食者的有效性。

A cited resurrection of the Philippine name

The 2016 account attributed to Zug’s 2015 revision the restoration of Kalophrynus sinensis for Philippine populations formerly included in the widespread K. pleurostigma. That revision treated Samar’s acutirostris and Basilan’s stellatus as junior synonyms, while allowing that future genetic evidence could require further name restorations. 漂浮于临时积水时鸣叫

The 2016 account described K. picta as distributed throughout the Philippines and formerly often encountered in dense rainy-season aggregations in rice fields and temporary water bodies. sections: ecology
A cited open-Cerrado habitat account
引用的开阔 Cerrado 生境记述

The 2025 species account described this small nocturnal treefrog as occurring in open Cerrado environments and perching on low vegetation near permanent standing water, drawing on cited earlier sources. This background differs from the study’s new acoustic and specimen comparisons; it is not presented as newly measured nocturnal activity or a demonstrated requirement for permanent water at every breeding site. The paragraph supplies no numerical perch-height distribution or annual breeding season.
2025 年物种记述引用早期来源，描述这种小型夜行树蛙见于开阔 Cerrado 环境，在永久静水附近低植被停栖。此背景与研究新增声学及标本比较分开，不作为新测量夜间活动或每个繁殖地点必须永久水体的已证明要求。该段不提供数值停栖高度分布或年度繁殖季节。

Acoustic agreement and a first Pará record
声学一致与首次 Pará 记录

Vocalizations in the study agreed in most spectral and temporal attributes with the cited description of Tocantins topotypes. The authors combined that acoustic evidence with morphology and interpreted the records as the first for Pará, approximately 163 km west of Nova Olinda, the nearest previously known locality. “Most attributes” is retained rather than changed to complete acoustic identity. The distance is a locality comparison, not a measured movement rate, and the account does not provide quantitative call parameters in this paragraph.
研究鸣声在多数频谱及时间属性上与引用 Tocantins 模式地点标本描述一致。作者结合声学证据及形态，将记录解释为首次 Pará 出现，距最近此前已知地点 Nova Olinda 约向西 163 千米。保留“多数属性”，不改为完全声学同一。距离是地点比较，不是测量移动速率，该段不提供量化鸣声参数。

A similar overall colour pattern was reported, but no invariant colour or universal body-size range is established.

sections: ecology
A cited leaf-underside calling habit with identification limits
带鉴定限制的引用叶背鸣叫习性

The 2025 account summarized earlier records of night calling from leaf undersides in lower forest strata along forested streams. It described large irregular dorsal iridophore spots as useful even in preserved specimens, but explicitly noted that H. tricolor and H. mesai could not be separated by external morphology. This is cited habitat and diagnostic background, not a new measured activity profile or proof that the spots alone identify every specimen. Geographical expectations do not replace independent examination of potentially similar taxa.

They interpreted these as the second Pará record and the easternmost records then known, comparing distances of about 742, 784 and 962 km with three prior localities. These are the study’s museum assignments and dated comparisons; they do not measure recent dispersal, establish intervening occupancy or certify the complete present-day range.

The study found 12 individuals in March 2022 at Conceição do Araguaia, 217 m, on soaked soil between a forest patch and seasonally flooded open vegetation. Several were located by calls. sections: morphology
A male holotype and three male paratypes
雄性正模及三只雄性副模

Adult male holotype MZFZ 4505 was collected at Rancho El Pinal, Temascaltepec, State of México, on 27 June 2022 at 2428 m. Two male paratypes came from the same locality; a third, MZFZ 4506, came from Hotel Las Piñas Avándaro at 1982 m on the same date. The holotype measured 24.638 mm snout–vent length, head width 9.599 mm and tibia length 10.154 mm, with vocal slits present. These are individual and type-series records, not a population size interval, female description or statistical dimorphism result.

成年雄性正模 MZFZ 4505 于 2022 年六月二十七日采自墨西哥州 Temascaltepec、Rancho El Pinal，海拔 2428 米。两只雄性副模来自同地点，第三只 MZFZ 4506 同日来自 Hotel Las Piñas Avándaro，海拔 1982 米。正模吻肛长 24.638 毫米、头宽 9.599 毫米及胫长 10.154 毫米，具声裂。这些是个体及模式系列记录，不是种群体型区间、雌性描述或统计两性异形结果。
morphology
Live orange surfaces fade in preservative
活体橙色面在保存后褪色

The live account described a brownish-tan dorsum, a paler unmarked snout, irregular dark flank blotches and a black-and-white inguinal gland pattern. Hidden posterior thigh and upper-arm surfaces were suffused with orange. In preservative the dorsum became grey and the orange faded to pale yellowish grey; dorsal tubercles could become difficult to see. The authors compared longer, more slender fingers with E. maurus but explicitly considered their sample sizes too small for robust population comparisons. Colour and comparative anatomy are kept within that sample scope, not interpreted as toxicity or measured locomotor performance.
活体记述描述棕褐背面、较浅无纹吻、不规则暗色体侧斑及黑白腹股沟腺纹。股后及上臂隐蔽面泛橙。保存后背面变灰，橙色褪为浅黄灰，背疣可能难见。作者与 E. maurus 比较较长纤细指，但明确认为样本太小，不能稳健比较种群。颜色及比较解剖保留该样本范围，不解释为毒性或测量运动表现。
reproduction
Calls from three males compared with four maurus males
三只雄性鸣声与四只 maurus 雄性比较

The methods recorded three E. humboldti males and four E. maurus males, filtering background noise and selecting stabilized calling portions for analysis. Both calls were classified as pulsatile, meaning poorly defined energy bursts without intermittent silence. In the sampled comparison, humboldti had longer calls, intercall intervals and rise times and lower dominant frequency. These are relative acoustic results with male sample sizes retained; the paragraph provides no numerical frequency interval, and repeated calls are not treated as additional independent frogs.
方法录制三只 E. humboldti 及四只 E. maurus 雄性，过滤背景噪音并选稳定鸣叫片段分析。两者均分类为能量爆发界定不清、无间歇静音的 pulsatile 鸣声。在采样比较中，humboldti 鸣声、鸣声间隔及上升时间较长，主频较低。这是保留雄性样本量的相对声学结果；该段不提供数值频率区间，重复鸣声不作为更多独立蛙。
ecology
Thunderstorm encounters in a disturbed pine–oak clearing
受扰松栎林空地的雷雨遭遇

The description knew three localities in the Valle de Bravo volcanic field. Its type series was collected during a thunderstorm between 21:00 and midnight at ambient air temperatures of 9–11 °C in a disturbed pine–oak clearing. Frogs called from vegetation below 1.5 m, often within dense non-native grass. These encounter conditions do not establish a critical thermal limit, obligatory storm dependence, a complete breeding season or successful reproduction in every disturbed clearing.
描述当时知 Valle de Bravo 火山区三个地点。模式系列在雷雨期间 21:00 至午夜采集，环境气温 9—11 摄氏度，生境为受扰松栎林空地。蛙在低于 1.5 米植被鸣叫，常在密集非本地草丛内。这些遭遇条件不确定临界热极限、必须依赖雷雨、完整繁殖季节或每处受扰空地均繁殖成功。
evolution
A mitochondrial sister relationship within the sampled analysis
采样分析中的线粒体姐妹关系

The authors reported approximately 3% 16S divergence from E. maurus and ultrafast-bootstrap support of 96 for the pair’s sister relationship in their tree. They combined genetic, morphological and advertisement-call differences in describing humboldti. These are the 2023 study’s evidence and support statistic, not a universal 3% species threshold, an independent nuclear-genome analysis or certification of every population across the range.
作者报告与 E. maurus 的 16S 分歧约 3%，树中两者姐妹关系的超快速自助法支持值为 96，并结合遗传、形态及广告鸣声差异描述 humboldti。这些是 2023 年研究证据及支持统计，不是通用 3% 物种阈值、独立核基因组分析或范围内每个种群认证。
title: Two new species of Eleutherodactylus from western and central Mexico ( Eleutherodactylus jamesdixoni sp. nov., Eleutherodactylus humboldti sp. nov.)

sections: morphology
Three male type specimens from Sinaloa
Sinaloa 的三只雄性模式标本

Adult male holotype IBH 34852 and male paratypes IBH 34849 and 34851 were collected west of El Palmito on the Concordia–Durango highway, Sinaloa, on 26 July 2011 at 1992 m. The holotype measured 21.961 mm snout–vent length, head width 8.785 mm and tibia length 8.709 mm; vocal slits were present. These measurements belong to one male, not a population range or a female size estimate. Collection date and elevation are locality metadata, not evidence of a complete annual breeding season or altitude tolerance.

成年雄性正模 IBH 34852 及雄性副模 IBH 34849、34851 于 2011 年七月二十六日采自 Sinaloa、Concordia—Durango 公路 El Palmito 以西，海拔 1992 米。正模吻肛长 21.961 毫米、头宽 8.785 毫米及胫长 8.709 毫米，具声裂。这些测量属于一只雄性，不是种群范围或雌性体型估计。采集日期及海拔是地点元数据，不是完整年度繁殖季节或海拔耐受证据。
morphology
Mottled ventral pattern in the topotype comparison
模式地点比较中的斑驳腹面纹理

The diagnosis compared jamesdixoni with topotypic E. nitidus. It described contrasting dark-green and tan to pale yellow-orange dorsal markings, a pale interorbital line, dark-and-white mottling on the belly and ventral limbs and a dark chin. The compared nitidus belly was pale and unmarked, although other traits and hidden orange surfaces were similar. The authors used this combination rather than a single colour. These sampled diagnostic differences do not independently establish invariant traits in every population, toxin production or camouflage function.
鉴别与模式地点 E. nitidus 比较，描述深绿与棕褐至浅黄橙对比背纹、浅色眶间线、腹部及四肢腹面暗白斑驳和暗颏。所比较 nitidus 腹面浅而无纹，但其他特征及隐蔽橙色面相似。作者用此组合而非单一颜色。这些采样鉴别差异不独立确定每个种群不变特征、产毒或伪装功能。
reproduction
Pulsed calls distinguished from a pulsatile comparison
与 pulsatile 对象区分的有脉冲鸣声

The study recorded three jamesdixoni males and four E. nitidus males. It classified jamesdixoni calls as pulsed, with well-defined energy bursts, and nitidus calls as pulsatile, with poorly defined bursts without intermittent silence. Jamesdixoni calls were longer in that comparison, while dominant and fundamental frequencies were similar. Male denominators and the qualitative call definitions remain separate from numbers of recorded calls; the result does not establish an identical frequency in all individuals or a complete reproductive schedule.
研究录制三只 jamesdixoni 及四只 E. nitidus 雄性，将 jamesdixoni 分类为能量爆发清楚的有脉冲鸣声，将 nitidus 分类为爆发界定不清、无间歇静音的 pulsatile 鸣声。比较中 jamesdixoni 鸣声较长，而主频及基频相似。雄性样本量及定性鸣声定义与录制鸣声数量分开，结果不确定所有个体频率完全相同或完整繁殖时表。
ecology
Late-night low-vegetation calls at 15 degrees Celsius
15 摄氏度下低植被的较晚夜间鸣叫

The type series was collected in pine–oak woodland between 21:30 and 23:50 at 15 °C, with calling frogs perched about 0.5 m above ground. The authors reported E. saxatilis in the same type locality but associated it with rock outcrops. These are local encounter and coexistence observations, not an experimentally demonstrated substrate partition, a critical thermal endpoint or proof that jamesdixoni never uses rocks. The broader distribution summary remains the 2023 account’s reported geographic knowledge.
模式系列在松栎林 21:30—23:50、15 摄氏度下采集，鸣叫蛙约停在离地 0.5 米。作者报告同模式地点 E. saxatilis，但将其关联岩露头。这些是地方遭遇及共存观察，不是经实验证明的基质分割、临界热端点或 jamesdixoni 从不使用岩石的证明。较广分布综合仍是 2023 年记述报告的地理知识。
evolution
A sister relationship with its reported support value
保留所报支持值的姐妹关系

The study reported about 3% 16S divergence from E. nitidus and ultrafast-bootstrap support of 78 for the sister pair, lower than the corresponding humboldti–maurus value of 96. It used call and morphological evidence alongside mitochondrial data to describe jamesdixoni. These statistics retain their particular analysis scope; they are not interchangeable with a posterior probability, a universal species threshold or independent genome-wide proof of reproductive isolation.
研究报告与 E. nitidus 的 16S 分歧约 3%，姐妹对超快速自助法支持值为 78，低于相应 humboldti—maurus 的 96。它结合鸣声、形态证据及线粒体数据描述 jamesdixoni。这些统计保留特定分析范围，不能与后验概率、通用物种阈值或独立全基因组生殖隔离证明互换。
title: Two new species of Eleutherodactylus from western and central Mexico ( Eleutherodactylus jamesdixoni sp. nov., Eleutherodactylus humboldti sp. nov.)
