sections: morphology
Four male types and a single larger female
四只雄性模式标本及单只较大雌性

Male holotype BEI 01010 and three male and one female paratypes were collected on Phou Samsoum Mountain, northeastern Laos, on 16 July 2020 at 2066 m. The holotype measured 35.0 mm snout–vent length; the male type interval was 34.4–36.3 mm and the single female measured 53.7 mm. The male comparison included nuptial pads, an external subgular vocal sac and greyish throat. A single female is not a female size range, and these types do not establish universal size limits or a statistically tested population dimorphism.
雄性正模 BEI 01010、三只雄性及一只雌性副模于 2020 年七月十六日采自老挝东北 Phou Samsoum Mountain，海拔 2066 米。正模吻肛长 35.0 毫米，雄性模式区间 34.4—36.3 毫米，单只雌性 53.7 毫米。雄性比较包括婚垫、外部喉下声囊及灰喉。单只雌性不是雌性体型范围，这些模式标本也不确定通用体型极限或经统计检验的种群两性异形。
morphology
Printed proportions and descriptive wording disagree
印出的比例与描述措辞不一致

The holotype account calls the head much longer than wide but gives HW/HL = 0.98. It also calls the tibia slightly over half the snout–vent length but gives TL/SVL = 0.42. These printed ratios and qualitative statements are kept together as unresolved source inconsistencies; no corrected ratio is invented. Other holotype observations include finger discs with circumferential grooves and moderate finger and toe webbing, which are anatomy rather than measured climbing or swimming performance.
正模记述称头显著长于宽，却给 HW/HL = 0.98；又称胫略超过吻肛长一半，却给 TL/SVL = 0.42。印出的比例及定性陈述共同保留为未解决来源不一致，不编造修正比例。其他正模观察包括具环缘沟的指盘及中等指趾蹼，这是解剖特征而非测量攀爬或游泳表现。
morphology
Green live colours turn blue-grey in ethanol
活体绿色在乙醇中变蓝灰

The live account describes a grass-green dorsum, white-cream flank and hidden-limb regions with irregular black markings, an unspotted cream chest and belly and a reddish-orange iris. After two years in ethanol the green became blue-grey while contrasting black flank markings remained visible. The single female was darker bottle-green, and the authors observed lighter dorsal colours at night than by day. These states retain preservation, individual and observation context; they are not invariant colours or experimentally demonstrated signalling, camouflage or toxicity.
活体记述描述草绿背面、白奶油色体侧及隐蔽肢面具不规则黑纹、奶油色胸腹无斑及红橙虹膜。乙醇两年后绿色变蓝灰，而对比黑色体侧纹仍可见。单只雌性较暗瓶绿，作者观察夜间背色比日间浅。这些状态保留保存、个体及观察语境，不是不变颜色或经实验确立的信号、伪装或毒性。
morphology
Stage-35 larvae with one sequenced specimen
有一件测序个体的第 35 阶段幼体

Three tadpoles were listed as referred material under ZMMU A-7783. The larval paragraph assigns Gosner stage-35 tadpoles using a partial 16S sequence obtained from one specimen and gives the diagnostic keratodont-row formula as 1:5+5/1+1:2. Only that molecular denominator is certified by the read paragraph; the three tadpoles are not all claimed to have been sequenced. Detailed larval measurements and anatomy were delegated to unread supplements and are not reconstructed here or interpreted as an adult trait.
三只蝌蚪以 ZMMU A-7783 列为参考材料。幼体段使用一件标本部分 16S 序列归属 Gosner 第 35 阶段蝌蚪，给鉴别角齿行式 1:5+5/1+1:2。已读段仅支持该分子样本量，不声称三只均已测序。详细幼体测量及解剖在未读补充材料中，不在此重建，也不解释为成体特征。
reproduction
Six call recordings from two identified males
来自两只确定雄性的六次鸣声录制

The call description used six calls from holotype BEI 01010 and paratype ZMMU A-7781. Fifty measured notes lasted 0.24–0.30 s and contained 2–3 pulses; 40 inter-note intervals lasted 0.48–0.85 s. Dominant frequency ranged from 3040–3280 Hz, summarized as about 3.14 kHz. The authors reported shorter first pulses. Calls, notes, intervals and males remain different sampling units, and mean-plus-error summaries are not labelled as standard deviation without reading the supplement’s definitions. The frequency summary is not treated as an identical frequency in every note.
鸣声描述使用正模 BEI 01010 及副模 ZMMU A-7781 的六次鸣声。五十个测量音符时长 0.24—0.30 秒，含 2—3 脉冲；四十个音符间隔为 0.48—0.85 秒。主频范围 3040—3280 赫，综合约 3.14 千赫，作者报告首脉冲较短。鸣声、音符、间隔及雄性保留为不同抽样单位，未读补充定义时不将均值加误差标为标准差。频率综合不当作每个音符完全同频。
ecology
Rainy-night leaves and temporary-puddle breeding observations
雨夜叶位与临时水坑繁殖观察

At 2000–2200 m, specimens were found during rain between 19:00 and 22:00, mostly on leaves 1.5–3.0 m above ground in undisturbed montane evergreen forest with dense canopy and undergrowth. The authors inferred forest specialization. They reported breeding observations from April to July; in July males called from grass or at and within temporary puddles, where tadpoles were also recorded. These observations do not demonstrate absolute exclusion from disturbed forest, a complete annual season or an egg-site observation for every puddle.
海拔 2000—2200 米，标本在雨中 19:00—22:00 发现，多在未受扰山地常绿林离地 1.5—3.0 米叶片上，林冠及林下密，作者推断森林专化。其报告四月至七月繁殖观察，七月雄性在草中或临时水坑边缘及内部鸣叫，同水坑也记录蝌蚪。这些观察不证明完全排除受扰林、完整年度季节或每个水坑产卵观察。
conservation
A dated single-mountain range and Data Deficient proposal
有年代限定的单山范围及数据缺乏建议

In 2023 the authors knew only the Phou Samsoum type locality and anticipated possible records on other Lao mountains and adjacent Vietnam. Those anticipated sites are not confirmed occurrences. They described the locality as within the newly designated Yod Nam Mo–Phou Samsoum protected area, 98873 ha, and proposed Data Deficient while calling for distribution, population and trend research. The protected-area size is not frog occupancy, and the dated designation and assessment proposal are not independently checked current official statuses.
2023 年作者仅知 Phou Samsoum 模式地点，并预期老挝其他山地及邻接越南可能有记录。预期地点不是确认出现。他们描述地点位于新指定 Yod Nam Mo—Phou Samsoum 保护地，98873 公顷，提出数据缺乏并呼吁分布、种群及趋势研究。保护地面积不是蛙占据面积，有年代限定的指定及评估建议也不是独立核查当前官方状态。
evolution
Mitochondrial genealogy with separate bootstrap and posterior support
自助法及后验支持分开的线粒体谱系

The study combined partial 16S and COI mitochondrial sequences to infer a maternal genealogy using maximum likelihood and Bayesian approaches. It recovered the Phou Samsoum lineage as sister to Z. nigropunctatus with reported support 100 ultrafast bootstrap and 1.0 posterior probability. Uncorrected 16S divergence from compared congeners was 3.4–8.8%, with the lowest to nigropunctatus. Those support types and distance comparisons are distinct; they are not a nuclear-genome species tree, proof that a universal 3% cutoff defines species or a diagnosis of reproductive isolation.

研究结合部分 16S 及 COI 线粒体序列，以最大似然及贝叶斯方法推断母系谱系，将 Phou Samsoum 谱系恢复为 Z. nigropunctatus 姐妹，所报支持为超快速自助法 100 及后验概率 1.0。与比较同属种的未校正 16S 分歧 3.4%—8.8%，最低对应 nigropunctatus。支持类型及距离比较不同，不是核基因组物种树、通用 3% 截点定义物种的证明或生殖隔离鉴别。
title: Mountain jade: A new high-elevation microendemic species of the genus Zhangixalus (Amphibia: Anura: Rhacophoridae) from Laos

sections: morphology
Fourteen types and an explicitly defined length endpoint
十四件模式标本及明确的体长端点

Female holotype IBH 24708 was collected south of Valle Nacional on Highway 175, Oaxaca, on 26 October 2010 at 676 m. Thirteen paratypes comprised seven females and six males. The holotype’s snout-to-posterior-vent length was 37.2 mm; its separate snout-to-anterior-vent measurement was 34.2 mm. Those endpoints are not interchangeable. The female measured head width 5.6 mm, forelimb 8.8 mm and hindlimb 8.3 mm, and the type series is not a universal population size interval.
雌性正模 IBH 24708 于 2010 年十月二十六日采自 Oaxaca、Valle Nacional 以南 175 公路，海拔 676 米。十三件副模含七只雌性及六只雄性。正模吻至泄殖腔后端长 37.2 毫米，另列吻至泄殖腔前角长 34.2 毫米，两端点不互换。该雌性头宽 5.6 毫米、前肢 8.8 毫米及后肢 8.3 毫米，模式系列不是通用种群体型区间。
morphology
Pad-like webbed feet and holotype tooth counts
垫状有蹼足及正模齿数

The holotype had strongly webbed hands and feet with poorly individualized digits except near their tips, and adpressed limbs separated by about two costal folds. Its counts were 40 maxillary, six premaxillary and 29 vomerine teeth. The diagnosis combined a robust body, webbed feet and comparative tooth and proportional differences. These are individual and sampled comparative anatomical observations, not invariant counts or an experimentally demonstrated climbing adaptation.
正模手足强烈具蹼，除近端尖外指趾分化不清，贴体肢间隔约两个肋褶。齿数为上颌四十、前颌六及犁骨二十九。鉴别结合粗壮身体、有蹼足及比较齿数和比例差异。这些是个体及采样比较解剖观察，不是不变齿数或经实验证明的攀爬适应。
morphology
An unresolved tail-ratio label in the holotype account
正模记述中未解决的尾比例标签

The description calls the tail relatively short and prints SVL/TAL = 0.78. The measurement list instead gives SVL 37.2 mm and tail length 29.2 mm, whose tail/body relation is compatible with a ratio near 0.78 in the opposite direction. The printed ratio label is retained as inconsistent with the listed lengths rather than silently rewritten. The two directly reported lengths remain individual measurements; they do not establish allometric or locomotor performance.
描述称尾相对短，印出 SVL/TAL = 0.78；测量清单却给 SVL 37.2 毫米及尾长 29.2 毫米，其尾/体关系才与约 0.78 的反向比例相容。保留印出标签与所列长度不一致，不静默改写。两个直接报告长度仍是个体测量，不确定异速关系或运动表现。
morphology
Live orange-brown and preserved golden-brown descriptions
活体橙棕及保存后金棕描述

The live holotype was described with an almost uniform orange-brown dorsum, darker specks, a darker triangle behind the eyes, a coppery iris and pale-brown ventral surfaces with fine cream mottling. In alcohol its dorsum and tail were dark golden-brown and body sides grey-brown; other preserved specimens varied in greys and browns. These source-specific live and preserved states are separate. No single colour is treated as an invariant diagnostic test, toxicity indication or demonstrated camouflage mechanism.
活体正模描述背面近均匀橙棕，具较暗点、眼后暗三角、铜色虹膜，腹面浅棕具细奶油色斑驳。酒精中背及尾为暗金棕，体侧灰棕；其他保存标本的灰棕色也变化。来源特定活体及保存状态分开，不将单一颜色当作不变鉴别测试、毒性指示或已证明伪装机制。
ecology
Daytime banana axils and night vegetation encounters
日间香蕉叶腋及夜间植被遭遇

All specimens with encounter information were collected in banana-plant axils by day or on vegetation by night. The authors inferred an arboreal habit by comparison with other Nanotriton salamanders. These collection substrates do not establish obligatory banana use, a quantified day–night activity budget, an egg site or a species diet. The presumed arboreal interpretation remains attributed rather than promoted to an experimental result.
有遭遇信息的所有标本白天采于香蕉植株叶腋，或夜间采于植被。作者通过与其他 Nanotriton 蝾螈比较推断树栖。采集基质不确定必须使用香蕉、量化昼夜活动分配、产卵位置或物种食谱。推定树栖解释保留作者归属，不升为实验结果。
distribution
Known mountain localities and anticipated intervening occupancy
已知山地地点与预期中间占据

The 2012 account reported Sierra de Juárez localities along Highway 175 between the type site and Vista Hermosa, approximately 1500 m, and Sierra Mixe near Santiago Zacatepec. It compared the mountain locality areas as about 70 km apart and presumed occurrence between them and possibly farther in Sierra Mixe. That presumption is not a confirmed corridor. The discussion’s roughly 255-km² polygon among three localities is an extent-of-occurrence estimate, not occupied habitat area or a measured population size.

2012 年记述报告 Sierra de Juárez 沿 175 公路从模式地点至 Vista Hermosa、约 1500 米的地点，以及 Santiago Zacatepec 附近 Sierra Mixe。它比较两个山地地点区约相距 70 千米，并推定中间及 Sierra Mixe 更远可能出现。推定不是确认廊道。讨论中三个地点围成约 255 平方千米多边形是分布范围估计，不是占据生境面积或测量种群大小。
evolution
A mitochondrial sister relationship and model-based distances
线粒体姐妹关系与基于模型的距离

The maximum-likelihood analysis used mitochondrial 16S and cytochrome-b sequences and placed chinanteca as sister to B. occidentalis with bootstrap support 99. GTR distances from sympatric B. rufescens were 0.08 for 16S and 0.21 for cytochrome b, whereas the two chinanteca samples from the type locality and Sierra Mixe had 16S GTR distance 0.004. These model-based distances are not uncorrected p-distances or universal species thresholds. The sampled maternal gene tree is not an independent nuclear-genome species tree.

最大似然分析用线粒体 16S 及细胞色素 b 序列，将 chinanteca 置为 B. occidentalis 姐妹，自助法支持 99。与同地 B. rufescens 的 GTR 距离为 16S 的 0.08 及细胞色素 b 的 0.21，模式地点与 Sierra Mixe 两份 chinanteca 的 16S GTR 距离为 0.004。基于模型的距离不是未校正 p 距离或通用物种阈值。采样母系基因树不是独立核基因组物种树。
conservation
Near Threatened as the authors’ 2012 proposal
作为作者 2012 年建议的近危

The authors explicitly lacked population-size and status information, although the type locality yielded individuals on two recent visits. They discussed how a small estimated range plus demonstrated habitat-driven decline might satisfy a threatened criterion, but did not regard the available evidence as establishing that decline. Banana encounters at the forest edge suggested possible disturbance tolerance, leaving forest dependence unresolved. They proposed Near Threatened. This dated interpretation is not an official current listing, a measured declining trend or proof that forest removal is harmless.
作者明确缺乏种群大小及状态信息，虽在模式地点两次近期访问发现个体。他们讨论小估计范围加已证明的生境引起下降可能满足受威胁标准，却未认为可用证据已确立该下降。林缘香蕉遭遇提示可能耐受干扰，森林依赖仍未解决，并提出近危。此有年代限定解释不是官方当前列级、测量下降趋势或砍林无害证明。
title: A new species of Bolitoglossa (Amphibia, Caudata) from the Sierra de Juárez, Oaxaca, Mexico

name: Bolitoglossa nympha
readScope: Bolitoglossa nympha: Main article comparative methods, results and discussion; tentative population assignments retained; no tables or figures reproduced; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sectionLocators: Reading-sections index 1, Materials and methods, paragraph 1
Reading-sections index 2, Results, paragraphs 0–1; index 5, Discussion, paragraph 0
sections: taxonomy
Three populations assigned only tentatively
仅暂定归属的三个种群

The 2012 authors noted that the original nympha diagnosis relied largely on molecular characters and that comparable data were unavailable for most populations of the rufescens complex. They tentatively assigned Finca El Volcán in Guatemala and the San Pedro Sula and Santa Rosa del Copán areas in Honduras using proximity to the type locality and an earlier allozyme clustering result. These three population assignments remain tentative, rather than becoming independently confirmed contemporary nympha occurrences or additions to a certified range.
2012 年作者指出原 nympha 鉴别主要依赖分子特征，而 rufescens 复合体多数种群缺少可比数据。他们利用与模式地点接近及早期同工酶聚类结果，将危地马拉 Finca El Volcán、洪都拉斯 San Pedro Sula 及 Santa Rosa del Copán 地区暂定归属。这三个种群归属仍属暂定，不成为独立确认当代 nympha 出现或认证范围新增。
morphology
Comparative statistics retain uncertain population identity
保留种群身份不确定性的比较统计

Within the study’s assigned samples, males and females differed significantly in many measured dimensions and vomerine tooth counts. In the female analysis using three principal components, five of 14 nympha individuals were classified as occidentalis. The authors emphasized external resemblance among these small salamanders. These are results for the study’s operational groups, which included tentative populations; they do not establish universally separable morphology, a validated field identification rule or a false-identification rate for independently collected future specimens.
在研究归属样本内，雌雄在多项测量尺寸及犁骨齿数上有显著差异。用三个主成分的雌性分析中，十四只 nympha 有五只被分类为 occidentalis。作者强调这些小蝾螈外部相似。这些是包含暂定种群的研究操作分组结果，不确定普遍可分形态、经验证野外鉴定规则或独立未来采集标本的错误鉴定率。
title: A new species of Bolitoglossa (Amphibia, Caudata) from the Sierra de Juárez, Oaxaca, Mexico

name: Bolitoglossa occidentalis
readScope: Bolitoglossa occidentalis: Main article comparative methods, results and discussion; tentative population assignments retained; no tables or figures reproduced; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sectionLocators: Reading-sections index 1, Materials and methods, paragraph 5; index 2, Results, paragraph 2
Reading-sections index 2, Results, paragraphs 0–1; index 5, Discussion, paragraph 0
sections: evolution
One named mitochondrial voucher in the chinanteca comparison
chinanteca 比较中的一件确定线粒体凭证

The methods sequenced occidentalis specimen MVZ 194259 for mitochondrial 16S and cytochrome b and compared it with other Nanotriton samples. The maximum-likelihood analysis recovered occidentalis and the newly described chinanteca as sisters with bootstrap support 99. This is a sampled maternal-gene relationship, not an independent genome-wide species tree, a test of all occidentalis populations or proof of current range-wide concept equivalence.
方法对 occidentalis 标本 MVZ 194259 的线粒体 16S 及细胞色素 b 测序，与其他 Nanotriton 样本比较。最大似然分析恢复 occidentalis 与新描述 chinanteca 为姐妹，自助法支持 99。这是采样母系基因关系，不是独立全基因组物种树、所有 occidentalis 种群检验或当前全范围概念等同证明。
morphology
A high misclassification count in one reduced analysis
一项降维分析中的较高误分类数量

In the female discriminant analysis based on three principal components, 23 of 46 assigned occidentalis individuals were classified as other groups: 12 as nympha and 11 as rufescens. The study also reported male–female differences in selected body measures and maxillary tooth counts. These sample results illustrate overlap under that analysis; they do not mean that 23 museum vouchers were formally reidentified or establish a universal diagnostic error rate. The name assignments retain the study’s geographical and prior-allozyme basis.
在基于三个主成分的雌性判别分析中，四十六只归属 occidentalis 个体有二十三只分类为其他组：十二只为 nympha、十一只为 rufescens。研究亦报告所选体型测量及上颌齿数的雌雄差异。这些样本结果说明该分析下重叠，不意味二十三件博物馆凭证正式重新鉴定，也不确定通用鉴别错误率。名称归属保留研究地理及早期同工酶依据。

name: Bolitoglossa rufescens
readScope: Bolitoglossa rufescens: Main article comparative methods, results and discussion; tentative population assignments retained; no tables or figures reproduced; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sectionLocators: Reading-sections index 1, Materials and methods, paragraph 5; index 2, Results, paragraph 2; index 5, Discussion, paragraph 0
Reading-sections index 2, Results, paragraphs 0–1; index 5, Discussion, paragraph 0
sections: evolution
A sympatric sequenced specimen distinct from chinanteca
与 chinanteca 同地且测序的不同标本

The study sequenced rufescens specimen IBH 22536 from the chinanteca type locality and included an earlier GenBank comparison from MVZ 194254. Its reported GTR distances between rufescens and chinanteca were 0.08 for 16S and 0.21 for cytochrome b. The authors treated their local co-occurrence as additional support for recognizing chinanteca. Co-occurrence and mitochondrial divergence are retained as different evidence; they do not by themselves demonstrate mating incompatibility or molecularly verify every historical rufescens population.

研究对 chinanteca 模式地点的 rufescens 标本 IBH 22536 测序，并纳入 MVZ 194254 的早期 GenBank 比较。所报 rufescens 与 chinanteca 的 GTR 距离为 16S 的 0.08 及细胞色素 b 的 0.21。作者将地方共存作为承认 chinanteca 的额外支持。共存及线粒体分歧保留为不同证据，本身不证明交配不相容或分子验证每个历史 rufescens 种群。
morphology
Overlapping external traits in the study samples
研究样本中重叠的外部特征

The authors described strong external resemblance to occidentalis and nympha and noted variation in traits such as presence of maxillary teeth within the broader complex. In the female three-component discriminant analysis, 19 of 36 assigned rufescens individuals were classified elsewhere: one as chinanteca, eight as nympha and ten as occidentalis. These analytical classifications are not formal taxonomic reassignment of those vouchers. The result retains sample and model scope rather than implying that external morphology is always sufficient or always useless for identification.
作者描述与 occidentalis、nympha 外部强烈相似，并指出较广复合体内上颌齿存在等特征变化。雌性三主成分判别分析中，三十六只归属 rufescens 个体有十九只分类至别处：一只 chinanteca、八只 nympha、十只 occidentalis。这些分析分类不是凭证正式分类学重新归属。结果保留样本及模型范围，不暗示外部形态始终足够或始终无法鉴定。

name: Chiropterotriton ceronorum
sections: morphology
A dated holotype and separate diagnostic sample sizes
有日期的正模及单列鉴别样本量

Male holotype USNM 224212 was collected near Santa Cruz Texmalaquilla on the southern Pico de Orizaba slope on 3 September 1975 at 3110 m. Twenty paratypes were listed, ten males and ten females. The diagnosis summarized ten adult males with mean snout–vent length 33.9 mm and range 30.6–36.2 mm, and ten adult females with mean 34.9 mm and range 33.3–38.4 mm. The male diagnostic count is not silently equated with the holotype plus ten male paratypes. These are the 2020 description’s material and summaries, not universal adult size limits.

雄性正模 USNM 224212 于 1975 年九月三日采自 Pico de Orizaba 南坡 Santa Cruz Texmalaquilla 附近，海拔 3110 米。列二十件副模，雄雌各十。鉴别综合十只成年雄性，平均吻肛长 33.9 毫米、范围 30.6—36.2 毫米，十只成年雌性均值 34.9 毫米、范围 33.3—38.4 毫米。不静默将雄性鉴别数量等同于正模加十只雄性副模。这些是 2020 年描述材料及综合，不是通用成体体型极限。
morphology
Sexed tooth counts and a defined limb interval
分性别齿数及明确的肢间隔

The diagnosis reported male maxillary teeth averaging 11.0, range 7–18, and females averaging 47.7, range 36–56. Mean tail/SVL ratios were 1.0 in males and 0.97 in females. Adpressed-limb interval was expressed in costal folds, averaging 0.0 in males and 1.5 in females; negative values denote overlap rather than a negative anatomical length. Digits were discrete with basal webbing and subterminal pads. These sampled anatomical differences do not demonstrate a mating function, a universal tooth count or measured climbing performance.
鉴别报告雄性上颌齿均值 11.0、范围 7—18，雌性均值 47.7、范围 36—56。尾长/SVL 均值雄性 1.0、雌性 0.97。贴体肢间隔以肋褶表示，雄性平均 0.0、雌性 1.5；负值表示重叠，而非负解剖长度。指趾分化，具基部蹼及亚端垫。这些采样解剖差异不证明交配功能、通用齿数或测量攀爬表现。
morphology
Variable live bands from photographs and preserved types
来自照片的变化活体带纹及保存模式标本

Live-colour notes used one photographed Xometla specimen and nine near Texmalaquilla. The Xometla animal lacked a dorsal stripe; Texmalaquilla animals usually bore bands varying from reddish or orange-brown to salmon and clay colours. The preserved holotype was uniformly dark tannish-brown dorsally and pale cream below, while paratypes could be striped or unstriped. The photographs are not assumed to show the holotype alive, and neither colour state is promoted to an invariant identification test or demonstrated camouflage.
活体颜色笔记使用一只 Xometla 摄影个体及九只 Texmalaquilla 附近个体。Xometla 个体无背带，Texmalaquilla 通常具带，变化从红、橙棕至鲑色及泥色。保存正模背面均匀暗棕褐、腹面浅奶油，副模可有带或无带。不假定照片显示活体正模，也不将任何颜色状态升为不变鉴定测试或已证明伪装。
ecology
Bromeliads and terrestrial cover on southern Orizaba
Orizaba 南坡的凤梨科植物及地面覆盖物

The 2020 account reported southern Pico de Orizaba localities in Puebla and Veracruz at 2600 to approximately 3100 m, with specimens in arboreal bromeliads and under terrestrial cover objects. The holotype’s 3110-m entry remains distinct from that approximate summary. These encounters document more than one substrate; they do not establish exclusive arboreality, a full contemporary range, a measured elevation tolerance or the species’ egg site and diet.
2020 年记述报告 Puebla 及 Veracruz 的 Pico de Orizaba 南坡地点，海拔 2600 至约 3100 米，标本见于树上凤梨科植物及地面覆盖物下。正模 3110 米条目与近似综合分开保留。遭遇记录不止一种基质，不确定专一树栖、完整当代范围、测量海拔耐受或物种产卵位置及食谱。

name: Chiropterotriton perotensis
sections: morphology
Twenty types and a female locality with kilometre-scale uncertainty
二十件模式标本及具有千米级不确定性的雌性地点

Female holotype MVZ 200693 was collected at Valle Alegre on 26 August 1982 at 3020 m. Its coordinate estimate had a maximum error distance of 1.142 km. Nineteen paratypes comprised twelve males and seven females. The diagnosis gave twelve adult males mean SVL 29.7 mm, range 26.5–32.8 mm, and eight adult females mean 31.7 mm, range 27.4–34.3 mm. The point is not presented as more precise than its recorded uncertainty, and the adult sample does not establish species-wide size limits.
雌性正模 MVZ 200693 于 1982 年八月二十六日采自 Valle Alegre，海拔 3020 米，坐标估计最大误差距离 1.142 千米。十九件副模含十二雄、七雌。鉴别给十二成年雄性 SVL 均值 29.7 毫米、范围 26.5—32.8 毫米，八成年雌性均值 31.7 毫米、范围 27.4—34.3 毫米。地点不展示为比所记不确定性更精确，成体样本不确定全物种体型极限。
morphology
Short limbs and relatively small hands and feet
短肢及相对小手足

The diagnosis described a stout body, short snout, small eyes and small hands and feet with little or no webbing. Adpressed limbs never overlapped in the measured sample: male limb interval averaged 2.5 costal folds and female interval 3.3. Male maxillary teeth averaged 7.2, range 2–17, and females 27.9, range 19–36. The male mental gland was oval but not especially prominent. These are sampled anatomical summaries, not a measured reproductive role, universal tooth number or locomotor-performance experiment.
鉴别描述粗壮体、短吻、小眼及少蹼或无蹼的小手足。测量样本贴体肢从不重叠，雄性肢间隔平均 2.5 肋褶、雌性 3.3。雄性上颌齿均值 7.2、范围 2—17，雌性 27.9、范围 19—36。雄性颏腺卵圆且不特别明显。这些是采样解剖综合，不是测量生殖作用、通用齿数或运动表现实验。
morphology
Live colours from referred specimens, not the type series
来自参考标本而非模式系列的活体颜色

No live-colour notes were available for the type series. Referred specimens were dark, sometimes with reddish-brown or obscure brown-grey dorsal stripes; adults could be nearly black, while juveniles had less distinct bands. The preserved holotype was uniformly dark brown with a paler venter and blackish-brown tail. The provenance and life stage of these colour observations remain separate; live type colours are not invented, and colour variation alone does not certify every historical identification.
模式系列无可用活体颜色笔记。参考标本色暗，部分有红棕或不明显棕灰背带，成体可近黑，幼体带较不明显。保存正模均匀深棕，腹面较浅，尾黑棕。颜色观察来源及生命阶段分开，不编造活体模式颜色，颜色变化本身也不认证每个历史鉴定。
ecology
Cofre de Perote from forest to the summit
Cofre de Perote 从森林至山顶

The account reported pine-and-fir forest and tree-line-to-summit localities on Cofre de Perote, Veracruz, at 2950–4015 m. Specimens occurred under terrestrial objects and were active on road banks and boulders at night; several other named salamanders occurred sympatrically. These are locality and encounter observations, not a critical cold threshold, proof of exclusive nocturnality, evidence of road dependence or an experimentally demonstrated partition of resources among species.
记述报告 Veracruz、Cofre de Perote 的松冷杉林及林线上至山顶地点，海拔 2950—4015 米。标本见于地面物下，夜间在路岸及巨石活动，并有其他命名蝾螈同域。这些是地点及遭遇观察，不是临界低温阈值、专一夜行证明、依赖道路证据或物种间经实验证明资源分割。

name: Chiropterotriton totonacus
sections: morphology
Twenty types with a broad locality-error estimate
具有较大地点误差估计的二十件模式标本

Female holotype MVZ 163945 was collected west of Las Vigas de Ramírez on 25 July 1979 at 2420 m; the coordinate estimate recorded a maximum error distance of 5.71 km. Nineteen paratypes comprised ten males and nine females. The diagnosis summarized ten males with mean SVL 35.7 mm, range 32.0–38.6 mm, and ten females with mean 35.5 mm, range 31.8–38.3 mm. The locality is not treated as a precisely located point, and these similar sample means do not by themselves establish absence of population-level sexual dimorphism.

雌性正模 MVZ 163945 于 1979 年七月二十五日采自 Las Vigas de Ramírez 以西，海拔 2420 米，坐标估计最大误差距离 5.71 千米。十九件副模含十雄九雌。鉴别综合十只雄性 SVL 均值 35.7 毫米、范围 32.0—38.6 毫米，十只雌性均值 35.5 毫米、范围 31.8—38.3 毫米。地点不当作精确定位点，相似样本均值本身也不确定种群层面无两性异形。
morphology
Long tails, expanded tips and overlapping limbs
长尾、扩展端尖及重叠肢

Mean tail/SVL ratios were 1.16 in males and 1.20 in females. The diagnosis described wide hands and feet, expanded digital tips and webbing extending to the base of the terminal phalanx. Adpressed limbs closely approached or overlapped, with mean interval −0.6 costal folds in males and 0.0 in females. Male maxillary teeth averaged 32.9, range 18–48, and females 52.6, range 45–60. These are sampled anatomy and ratios rather than tail-performance measurements or universal tooth counts.
尾长/SVL 均值雄性 1.16、雌性 1.20。鉴别描述宽手足、扩展指趾尖及延至末节骨基部的蹼。贴体肢接近或重叠，间隔均值雄性 −0.6 肋褶、雌性 0.0。雄性上颌齿均值 32.9、范围 18—48，雌性 52.6、范围 45—60。这些是采样解剖及比例，不是尾表现实验或通用齿数。
morphology
Three photographed live animals and separate preserved types
三只拍摄活体与单列保存模式标本

Live-colour description came from photos of IBH 31030, 31031 and 30998 because no live type-series information was available. Their reddish-brown dorsal bands could be regular, broken or absent against dark brown-grey backgrounds, with dark golden-brown irises. The preserved holotype was medium brown with an obscure stripe, and other preserved types varied. The later photographed animals are not conflated with the live holotype, and neither bands nor their absence form an invariant standalone diagnosis.
模式系列无活体信息，因此活体颜色描述来自 IBH 31030、31031 及 30998 照片。深棕灰背景上的红棕背带可规则、破断或缺失，虹膜暗金棕。保存正模中棕具不明显带，其他保存模式颜色变化。不将后采拍摄动物与活体正模混淆，带纹及其缺失均不是不变独立鉴别。
ecology
Under logs in disturbed mossy pine forest
受扰多苔松林枯木下

The account knew ridge localities between Cruz Blanca and Las Vigas at 2200–2450 m and La Joya at 2000 m in Veracruz. It described the species as terrestrial in mossy pine forest and reported recently collected specimens beneath logs in disturbed pine forest. The lower La Joya record remains separate from the ridge interval. Such encounters show use of surveyed disturbed habitat, not universal disturbance tolerance, an egg site beneath every log or a complete current range.
记述知 Veracruz、Cruz Blanca 与 Las Vigas 间脊岭海拔 2200—2450 米及 La Joya 的 2000 米地点，描述本种在多苔松林地栖，并报告近期标本于受扰松林枯木下采得。较低 La Joya 记录与脊岭区间分开。遭遇显示使用所调查受扰生境，不是普遍干扰耐受、每根枯木下产卵位置或完整当前范围。

name: Chiropterotriton melipona
sections: morphology
Type material and a separately counted adult sample
模式材料与单列成体样本

Male holotype MVZ 200726 was collected near Xicotepec de Juárez, Puebla, on 8 December 1983 at 1080 m; the estimated location carried a maximum error distance of 1.0 km. Seven paratypes comprised four males and three females, with two further referred specimens from Cuetzalan. The diagnosis summarized four adult males, mean SVL 29.2 mm and range 26.4–31.4 mm, and three females, mean 28.5 mm and range 27.1–29.8 mm. Its four-male diagnostic count is retained separately from the holotype plus four male paratypes. These sample ranges are not species-wide size limits.

雄性正模 MVZ 200726 于 1983 年十二月八日采自 Puebla、Xicotepec de Juárez 附近，海拔 1080 米，估计地点最大误差距离 1.0 千米。七件副模含四雄三雌，另有两件 Cuetzalan 参考标本。鉴别综合四成年雄性，SVL 均值 29.2 毫米、范围 26.4—31.4 毫米，以及三雌性，均值 28.5 毫米、范围 27.1—29.8 毫米。四雄鉴别数量与正模加四雄副模分开保留，样本范围不是全物种体型极限。
morphology
Long tails and a comparison-text conflict
长尾及比较文字冲突

The diagnosis reported complete tails longer than SVL, with mean tail/SVL 1.16 in males and 1.11 in females. Adpressed limbs remained separated, averaging 2.3 and 1.8 costal folds respectively; digits were slender with small subterminal pads and little or no webbing. Several comparison paragraphs call the tail shorter than those of C. ceronorum, C. perotensis or C. orculus while printing larger ratios for C. melipona. The numerical diagnosis is recorded with this wording conflict; the comparison adjectives are not silently corrected or presented as a resolved diagnosis.
鉴别报告完整尾长超过 SVL，雄性尾长/SVL 均值 1.16、雌性 1.11。贴体肢保持分离，间隔分别平均 2.3、1.8 肋褶；指趾细，具小亚端垫，少蹼或无蹼。部分比较段称尾比 C. ceronorum、C. perotensis 或 C. orculus 更短，却列出本种更大的比例。记录数值鉴别并保留文字冲突，不静默修正比较形容词或当作已解决鉴别。
morphology
A photographed referred animal and faded preserved types
拍摄参考个体及褪色保存模式标本

No live-colour notes were available for the type series. The account instead used a photograph of referred specimen IBH 30112, describing a dark brown head with pale grey specks, an orange-brown dorsal band continuing along the tail, and a coppery iris. The faded preserved holotype was yellowish tan with a bright yellow dorsal stripe and very pale venter. These are different specimens and preservation states; yellow preserved colours are not substituted for the unrecorded live holotype colour.
模式系列无活体颜色笔记，记述改用参考标本 IBH 30112 照片，描述深棕头具浅灰斑点、橙棕背带延至尾及铜色虹膜。褪色保存正模黄褐，具明黄背带及极浅腹面。这是不同标本及保存状态，不能以保存黄色替代未记录的活体正模颜色。
morphology
One CT specimen with an explicit maturity caveat
一件 CT 标本及明确成熟度保留

The osteological account examined the anterior skeleton of male MVZ 178706, SVL 28.5 mm, and warned that it might be sexually immature and not represent adult conditions. Its delicate skull had thin roofing bones and a relatively large frontoparietal fontanel. The hand phalangeal formula was 1–2–3–2 on each side; mesopodial cartilages were not mineralized. These observations belong to this scanned specimen. They do not establish invariant adult skull architecture, developmental timing or measured mechanical weakness throughout the species.
骨学记述检查雄性 MVZ 178706 的前部骨骼，SVL 28.5 毫米，并警告其可能性未成熟、不代表成体状态。其纤细头骨具薄顶骨及相对大额顶囟。两侧手指指骨式均 1—2—3—2，腕部软骨未矿化。这些观察属于该扫描标本，不确定全物种不变成体头骨结构、发育时间或测量机械弱度。
ecology
Northern Puebla plant encounters and a dated conservation proposal
Puebla 北部植物遭遇及有日期保护提议

The 2020 account reported Sierra Norte localities near Cuetzalan, Xocoyolo and Xicotepec de Juárez at 690–1420 m, with collections from banana plants and bromeliads and sympatry with Aquiloeurycea quetzalanensis. Occurrence between known localities was a prediction. The authors reported mature-forest loss and recent encounters in small forest patches, secondary vegetation and coffee plantations, recommending Endangered under B1ab(iii). This is their dated proposal, not a verified current Red List category. The observations do not establish an occupied continuous range, a diet linked to bananas or breeding in bromeliads.

2020 年记述报告 Sierra Norte、Cuetzalan、Xocoyolo 及 Xicotepec de Juárez 附近地点，海拔 690—1420 米，采自香蕉植株及凤梨科植物，与 Aquiloeurycea quetzalanensis 同域。已知地点间存在是预测。作者报告成熟森林损失及近期在小林块、次生植被和咖啡种植地遭遇，提议按 B1ab(iii) 列濒危。这是有日期的作者提议，不是已核实当前红色名录等级。观察不确定连续占据范围、与香蕉相关食谱或凤梨中繁殖。

title: Descriptions of five new species of the salamander genus Chiropterotriton (Caudata: Plethodontidae) from eastern Mexico and the status of three currently recognized taxa

name: Chiropterotriton casasi
sections: morphology
A 1969 holotype and one measured female
1969 年正模及一只测量雌性

Male holotype MVZ 92874 was collected southwest of Tlapacoyan, Veracruz, on 26 December 1969 at an estimated 1450–1550 m; the location had a maximum error distance of 2 km. Four male and one female paratypes came from the same locality. The diagnosis summarized four adult males, mean SVL 37.8 mm and range 34.5–42.0 mm, and one female at 40.9 mm. The holotype itself measured 42.0 mm. The diagnostic male count remains separate from the five listed male types, and a single female value is not a population mean or proof of sexual size dimorphism.

雄性正模 MVZ 92874 于 1969 年十二月二十六日采自 Veracruz、Tlapacoyan 西南，估计海拔 1450—1550 米，地点最大误差距离 2 千米。四雄一雌副模来自同地。鉴别综合四成年雄性，SVL 均值 37.8 毫米、范围 34.5—42.0 毫米，以及一雌性 40.9 毫米；正模本身 42.0 毫米。鉴别雄数与列出五件雄性模式分开，单只雌性数值不是种群均值或两性体型异形证明。
morphology
Tooth counts, webbing and unresolved tail ratios
齿数、蹼及未解决尾比例

Male maxillary teeth averaged 9.0, range 6–13; the single female had 30. The diagnosis described slender digits with subterminal pads, webbing reaching the penultimate phalanx of the third toe and a short first digit contained within the webbing. Male tail/SVL was printed as mean 1.0, range 0.90–1.15, whereas some comparison paragraphs printed 1.04. The only female had a broken tail. These differing printed summaries are retained without silently choosing one, and the incomplete female tail cannot provide a full female ratio.
雄性上颌齿平均 9.0、范围 6—13，单只雌性 30。鉴别描述细指趾具亚端垫，蹼达第三趾倒数第二节骨，短第一趾包含在蹼中。鉴别列雄尾长/SVL 均值 1.0、范围 0.90—1.15，部分比较段列 1.04。唯一雌性尾断。保留不同印刷综合，不静默选定其一，不完整雌尾无法提供完整雌性比例。
morphology
Preserved mottling with no recorded live colour
保存斑驳及未记录活体颜色

The live-colour entry explicitly stated that no data were available. Preserved specimens were faded brown with paler venters. The holotype lacked an evident dorsal stripe, while female paratype MVZ 92876 had strong mottling and an irregular light stripe on the anterior tail; some paratypes bore a pale bar between the eyes. These preserved differences do not recover live colour, establish a universal stripe pattern or demonstrate a camouflage function.
活体颜色条目明确无数据。保存标本褪色棕，腹面更浅。正模无明显背带，而雌性副模 MVZ 92876 斑驳强、尾前部具不规则浅带，部分副模具眼间浅横带。这些保存差异不能恢复活体颜色、确定通用带纹或证明伪装功能。
morphology
A robust scanned skull and different tooth observations
健壮扫描头骨及不同齿观察

CT examination of the anterior skeleton of holotype MVZ 92874 described a robust skull, complete frontal–parietal articulation without a frontoparietal fontanel and a well-developed braincase. Hand phalangeal formula was 1–2–3–2 on both sides and mesopodial cartilages were not mineralized. The external holotype description counted maxillary teeth 4–4 and premaxillary teeth four, while the osteology reported five maxillary teeth per side and three premaxillary teeth. Both descriptions concern the same voucher; their differing counts remain unresolved rather than being combined into a single definitive count.
正模 MVZ 92874 前部骨骼 CT 检查描述健壮头骨、额顶骨完整关节无额顶囟及发达脑颅。两侧手指指骨式 1—2—3—2，腕部软骨未矿化。正模外部描述列上颌齿 4—4、前颌齿四，而骨学报告每侧上颌齿五及前颌齿三。两项描述属于同凭证标本，不同计数保留为未解决，不合并成一个确定齿数。
ecology
A single known locality and a proposed former forest
一个已知地点及推测昔日森林

The 2020 account knew the species only from the type locality. Vegetation there was described as secondary forest and thicket, with former cloud forest considered likely. Wider occurrence was suggested as possible, but little intact forest remained nearby. The former habitat and wider range are hypotheses, separate from the known collection site. This paragraph supplies no demonstrated diet, egg site, contemporary population estimate or measured tolerance of habitat disturbance.
2020 年记述仅知模式地点，描述当地植被为次生林及灌丛，认为昔日很可能云雾林。更广存在被建议为可能，但附近剩余完整森林少。昔日生境及更广范围是推测，与已知采集地分开。本段未提供已证明食谱、产卵位置、当代种群估计或测量生境干扰耐受。

title: Descriptions of five new species of the salamander genus Chiropterotriton (Caudata: Plethodontidae) from eastern Mexico and the status of three currently recognized taxa

name: Chiropterotriton chiropterus
sections: morphology
A designated neotype and sexed diagnostic measurements
指定新模及分性别鉴别测量

The 2020 revision designated adult male MVZ 85590 as neotype, collected near Huatusco, Veracruz, on 16 January 1969 at an estimated 1400 m. Its location error was printed as a maximum distance of 1.202 miles. Twelve additional specimens comprised eight males and four females. The diagnosis reported eight males with mean SVL 37.5 mm, range 36.1–38.8 mm, and four females with mean 33.5 mm, range 30.7–36.7 mm. Mean tail/SVL was 1.25 in males and 1.19 in females; mean maxillary tooth counts were 12.6 and 48.0. The diagnostic male count remains separate from the neotype plus eight additional males; measurements describe the revision sample, not universal size or tooth limits.

2020 年修订指定成年雄性 MVZ 85590 为新模，1969 年一月十六日采自 Veracruz、Huatusco 附近，估计海拔 1400 米。地点最大误差距离原文为 1.202 英里。另检查十二件标本，八雄四雌。鉴别报告八雄 SVL 均值 37.5 毫米、范围 36.1—38.8 毫米，四雌均值 33.5 毫米、范围 30.7—36.7 毫米。尾长/SVL 均值雄 1.25、雌 1.19，上颌齿均值分别 12.6、48.0。鉴别雄数与新模加八件其他雄性分开，测量描述修订样本，不是通用体型或齿数极限。
morphology
Seven photographed animals with variable dorsal bands
七只摄影个体及变化背带

Live-colour notes came from slides of seven Huatusco specimens. Many had bright tan-to-yellow dorsal colours, sometimes with orange on the snout and a band continuing onto the tail; darker specimens could lack an obvious stripe. Preserved animals were pale brown, sometimes with an indistinct broad stripe, and pale tan below. The photograph series is not automatically identified with the live neotype. Variation prevents treating a yellow dorsal band as an invariant standalone identification feature, and preservation colours remain distinct from life colours.
活体颜色笔记来自七件 Huatusco 标本幻灯片，许多个体背色明亮褐黄，有时吻橙、带纹延至尾，暗色个体可无明显带。保存动物浅棕，部分具不明显宽带，腹浅褐。不自动将照片系列视为活体新模。变化使黄色背带不能成为不变独立鉴定特征，保存颜色与活体颜色保持分开。
ecology
A dated Veracruz–Oaxaca range summary
有日期的 Veracruz—Oaxaca 范围综合

The 2020 account placed the species from near Huatusco, Veracruz, south to Sierra de Juárez, Oaxaca, at 1400–2170 m, reporting higher elevations in Oaxaca than Veracruz. It listed C. orculus, C. perotensis, C. ceronorum and C. lavae as geographically associated species. Geographic association is not proof that every species shared each collecting site or partitioned resources experimentally. The dated range summary is not a verified current census, an occupied continuous polygon or a measured elevation tolerance.

2020 年记述将本种范围列为 Veracruz、Huatusco 附近向南至 Oaxaca、Sierra de Juárez，海拔 1400—2170 米，报告 Oaxaca 海拔比 Veracruz 高。列 C. orculus、C. perotensis、C. ceronorum、C. lavae 为地理关联物种。地理关联不证明所有物种共享每个采集点或经过实验的资源分割。有日期范围综合不是已核实当代普查、连续占据多边形或测量海拔耐受。

title: Descriptions of five new species of the salamander genus Chiropterotriton (Caudata: Plethodontidae) from eastern Mexico and the status of three currently recognized taxa

name: Chiropterotriton orculus
sections: morphology
A volcanic-ridge neotype and twenty measured adults
火山脊岭新模及二十只测量成体

The revision designated male MVZ 138783 as neotype, collected on the ridge between Popocatépetl and Iztaccíhuatl on 26 July 1976 at 3300 m. Nineteen additional specimens comprised nine males and ten females. The diagnosis summarized ten males, mean SVL 35.9 mm and range 33.6–38.9 mm, and ten females, mean 39.0 mm and range 34.9–43.0 mm. Mean tail/SVL was 1.02 in both sexes; mean maxillary teeth were 8.2 in males and 28.8 in females. Adpressed-limb intervals averaged 1.9 and 2.9 costal folds respectively. These sexed sample summaries are not species-wide anatomical limits or a population-level test of sexual dimorphism.

修订指定雄性 MVZ 138783 为新模，1976 年七月二十六日采自 Popocatépetl 与 Iztaccíhuatl 间脊岭，海拔 3300 米。另十九件标本含九雄十雌。鉴别综合十雄 SVL 均值 35.9 毫米、范围 33.6—38.9 毫米，十雌均值 39.0 毫米、范围 34.9—43.0 毫米。两性尾长/SVL 均为 1.02，上颌齿均值雄 8.2、雌 28.8。贴体肢间隔分别平均 1.9、2.9 肋褶。分性别样本综合不是全物种解剖极限或种群层面的两性异形检验。
morphology
Live photographs from a different locality
来自另一地点的活体照片

No live-colour information was available for the neotype or individuals from its locality. The account used photographs from Lagunas de Zempoala: dark grey backgrounds commonly carried reddish-brown, tan or golden-brown dorsal bands, but some animals lacked bands; irises were coppery. Preserved specimens were medium brown above and tan to pale brown below. These locality-specific photographs do not supply missing live neotype colours or certify the identity of every historical animal with a similar band.
新模及其地点个体无可用活体颜色信息。记述使用 Lagunas de Zempoala 照片，深灰背景通常具红棕、褐或金棕背带，但部分无带，虹膜铜色。保存标本上方中棕，下方褐至浅棕。这些特定地点照片不能补出缺失活体新模颜色，也不认证每只带纹相似历史动物的身份。
ecology
Logs in pine and fir forest across the volcanic belt
火山带松冷杉林枯木

The 2020 account placed the species in the central and eastern Trans-Mexican Volcanic Belt, listing La Marquesa, Desierto de los Leones, Ajusco, Lagunas de Zempoala, Iztaccíhuatl, Popocatépetl, Río Frío and La Malinche. It described terrestrial encounters in pine and fir forest, typically under log bark or inside rotting logs, at 2500–3500 m. These are reported localities and substrates. They do not establish breeding inside logs, a wood-based diet, universal forest-disturbance tolerance or a verified complete contemporary range.

2020 年记述列本种于墨西哥横贯火山带中东部，地点含 La Marquesa、Desierto de los Leones、Ajusco、Lagunas de Zempoala、Iztaccíhuatl、Popocatépetl、Río Frío、La Malinche。描述松冷杉林地面遭遇，通常在枯木树皮下或腐木内部，海拔 2500—3500 米。这些是所报告地点及基质，不确定枯木内繁殖、木材食谱、普遍森林干扰耐受或核实完整当代范围。

title: Descriptions of five new species of the salamander genus Chiropterotriton (Caudata: Plethodontidae) from eastern Mexico and the status of three currently recognized taxa

name: Chiropterotriton lavae
sections: morphology
A historical holotype and a separate nineteen-animal revision sample
历史正模及单列十九只修订样本

The account retained historical holotype EHT-HMS 28937, now FMNH 100118, with type locality two miles west of La Joya, Veracruz. The 2020 examined series comprised ten males and nine females from La Joya. Male mean SVL was 32.4 mm, range 31.1–33.8 mm; female mean was 31.6 mm, range 27.9–34.9 mm. Mean tail/SVL was 1.19 and 1.02 respectively, and mean maxillary teeth 7.0 and 20.8. Male adpressed limbs overlapped or approached closely, averaging −0.60 costal folds; females averaged 0.6. The historical holotype is not conflated with this later sampled series, and a negative fold interval denotes overlap rather than negative limb length.

记述保留历史正模 EHT-HMS 28937，现 FMNH 100118，模式地点 Veracruz、La Joya 以西两英里。2020 年检查系列为 La Joya 十雄九雌。雄 SVL 均值 32.4 毫米、范围 31.1—33.8 毫米，雌均值 31.6 毫米、范围 27.9—34.9 毫米。尾长/SVL 均值分别 1.19、1.02，上颌齿均值 7.0、20.8。雄贴体肢重叠或接近，肋褶间隔平均 −0.60，雌平均 0.6。历史正模不与后来样本系列混同，负肋褶间隔表示重叠而非负肢长。
morphology
Variable live bands and separate preserved colours
变化活体带纹及单列保存颜色

The live account described dark brown backgrounds with dorsal bands varying from yellow to reddish-, orange- or pale brown. Bands could be continuous, broken into blotches or streaks, or absent; irises were golden-brown and venters dark to pale grey, sometimes white-speckled. Preserved animals ranged from pale to dark brown, often with a paler broad dorsal band and tan-to-pale-brown venter. Variation and preservation state remain explicit; no single band colour is elevated to an invariant identification test or demonstrated adaptive function.
活体记述描述深棕背景，背带可黄、红棕、橙棕或浅棕，连续、分成斑或纹、或缺失。虹膜金棕，腹深至浅灰，部分白斑。保存动物浅至深棕，常具浅宽背带及褐至浅棕腹面。明确保留变化及保存状态，不将单一带色升为不变鉴定测试或已证明适应功能。
ecology
Cloud-forest bromeliads near La Joya
La Joya 附近云雾林凤梨科植物

The 2020 account knew the species from forested areas between Toxtlacoaya and La Joya along the Perote–Xalapa road, Veracruz, at 2000–2200 m. It reported occurrence in cloud-forest bromeliads and encounters in somewhat disturbed habitat in and around La Joya. These records identify sampled habitat and a dated narrow known range. They do not demonstrate obligate bromeliad breeding, road dependence, a full disturbance-tolerance experiment or the absence of populations outside the surveyed localities.
2020 年记述知本种于 Veracruz、Perote—Xalapa 道路沿线 Toxtlacoaya 与 La Joya 间森林区，海拔 2000—2200 米。报告见于云雾林凤梨科植物及 La Joya 内外部分受扰生境。这些记录确定采样生境及有日期狭窄已知范围，不证明专性凤梨繁殖、依赖道路、完整干扰耐受实验或调查地点外无种群。

title: Descriptions of five new species of the salamander genus Chiropterotriton (Caudata: Plethodontidae) from eastern Mexico and the status of three currently recognized taxa

name: Thorius pinicola
sections: morphology
Minute adults measured to the posterior vent angle
量至泄殖腔后角的微小成体

Female holotype MVZ 185344 was collected north of San Miguel Suchixtepec, Oaxaca, on 16 July 1976 at 2700 m. Its standard length, defined as snout to posterior angle of the vent, was 25.5 mm; length to the anterior angle was separately 23.6 mm, and tail length 22.9 mm. The variation sample comprised eight males, mean SL 25.7 mm and range 23.5–29.6 mm, and nine females, mean 26.5 mm and range 25.5–28.2 mm. Maxillary teeth were absent in the examined sample; mean vomerine counts were 4.8 in males and 5.7 in females. Posterior-vent SL is not silently equated with an anterior-vent measurement or a differently defined dataset length.

雌性正模 MVZ 185344 于 1976 年七月十六日采自 Oaxaca、San Miguel Suchixtepec 以北，海拔 2700 米。标准长定义为吻至泄殖腔后角，为 25.5 毫米；至前角长度单列 23.6 毫米，尾长 22.9 毫米。变异样本含八雄，SL 均值 25.7 毫米、范围 23.5—29.6 毫米，九雌均值 26.5 毫米、范围 25.5—28.2 毫米。检查样本无上颌齿，犁骨齿均值雄 4.8、雌 5.7。后角 SL 不静默等同前角测量或定义不同的数据集长度。
morphology
Dated live notes and fading in preserved specimens
有日期活体笔记及保存标本褪色

Live-colour notes from July 1976 and January 2001 described black flanks with fine white speckling and a broad brassy-copper dorsal band with thin black lines, occasional dark blotches and no conspicuous chevrons. The venter was pale and lightly speckled. Older preserved specimens had lightened, with a more obscure dorsal band and sometimes a herringbone pattern; the band was more prominent in life. The distinct observations are retained by preservation state rather than turning either band pattern into a universal identification criterion or demonstrated camouflage.
1976 年七月及 2001 年一月活体笔记描述黑体侧具细白斑、宽黄铜铜色背带具细黑线，偶有暗斑而无显著人字纹，腹浅具轻微斑点。较老保存标本变浅、背带较不明显，有时呈鱼骨纹，活体带更显著。按保存状态保留不同观察，不将任一种带纹变为通用鉴定标准或已证明伪装。
ecology
Moist log refuges and conflicting elevation summaries
湿润枯木庇护及冲突海拔综合

The distribution paragraph reported localities near San Miguel Suchixtepec and eastward in the Sierra Madre del Sur, with elevations 2490–2700 m. Its paratype list also contained eastward localities at 2870–2995 m and 3000 m; those entries remain explicit rather than being forced into the lower summary interval. July 1976 collections were under charred logs and nearby litter. In January 2001, three specimens occupied moist spaces beneath logs, loose bark or stump bark in an otherwise dry, logged pine-dominated slope. These are encounters, not proof of dependence on fire or logging, or of breeding under bark.

分布段报告 San Miguel Suchixtepec 附近及向东 Sierra Madre del Sur 地点，海拔 2490—2700 米；副模表另含向东地点 2870—2995 米及 3000 米。明确保留这些条目，不硬塞进较低综合区间。1976 年七月采于烧焦枯木下及邻近枯落物；2001 年一月三件标本位于其余部分干燥、经伐木的松为主坡地的枯木下、松脱树皮或树桩皮间湿隙。这是遭遇，不证明依赖火或伐木、或树皮下繁殖。
ecology
A 2016 Critically Endangered recommendation
2016 年极危提议

The authors recommended Critically Endangered in 2016, reporting drastic declines at the few known localities over 30–40 years, thought likely to exceed 80%, a known extent of occurrence much below 100 km² and continuing loss of montane-forest extent and quality. They said the decline was unexplained and further population and range surveys were urgently needed. The estimated decline is not a directly counted species-wide mortality rate; extent of occurrence is not occupied area, and this dated recommendation is not a verified current Red List assessment.
作者于 2016 年提议极危，报告少数已知地点在三十至四十年间剧烈下降，认为很可能超过 80%，已知分布范围面积远低于 100 平方千米，高山森林面积及质量持续下降。说明下降原因不明，急需种群及范围调查。估计下降不是直接计数全物种死亡率，分布范围面积不是占据面积，有日期提议不是已核实当前红色名录评估。

title: Biology of tiny animals: three new species of minute salamanders (Plethodontidae: Thorius ) from Oaxaca, Mexico

name: Thorius longicaudus
sections: morphology
Long tails, a defined standard length and different size scopes
长尾、明确标准长及不同体型范围

Female holotype MCZ A-137819 was collected south of Sola de Vega on 18 November 1974 at 2200 m. Snout-to-posterior-vent SL was 27.7 mm, anterior-vent length 25.1 mm and tail length 39.2 mm. The variation sample of ten males had mean SL 25.0 mm, range 23.6–28.3 mm; ten females averaged 25.5 mm, range 24.4–27.7 mm. Mean SL/tail ratios were 0.69 and 0.76, not tail/SL. The comparison cited a smallest adult male at 22.9 mm despite the diagnosis saying male SL exceeded 23.5 mm; live notes also recorded a gravid female at 22 mm. These different scopes and printed values are retained without presenting the diagnostic threshold as universal.

雌性正模 MCZ A-137819 于 1974 年十一月十八日采自 Sola de Vega 以南，海拔 2200 米。吻至泄殖腔后角 SL 27.7 毫米，至前角 25.1 毫米，尾长 39.2 毫米。变异样本十雄 SL 均值 25.0 毫米、范围 23.6—28.3 毫米，十雌均值 25.5 毫米、范围 24.4—27.7 毫米。SL/尾长均值 0.69、0.76，不是尾长/SL。比较列最小成年雄 22.9 毫米，而鉴别称雄 SL 超 23.5 毫米；活体笔记另记怀卵雌 22 毫米。保留不同范围及印刷数值，不将鉴别阈值当作普遍极限。
morphology
Colour notes from a gravid female and other specimens
来自怀卵雌性及其他标本的颜色笔记

October 1997 field notes for gravid female IBH 13998, with a partly regenerated tail, described a tan-reddish stripe with coppery-brassy highlights, whitish lateral markings and a reddish-brown iris. Separate July 1976 notes described dark venters with whitish flecks. Preserved animals had a paler dorsal band sometimes interrupted by herringbone marks or a thin median dark line. These notes describe their named specimens and dates; a regenerated tail is not an intact-tail measurement and the observed pregnancy does not supply egg number, laying site or breeding season.
1997 年十月针对怀卵雌性 IBH 13998 的野外笔记描述其部分再生尾、褐红带具铜黄铜光泽、体侧白纹及红棕虹膜。单列 1976 年七月笔记描述暗腹具白斑。保存动物具浅背带，有时被鱼骨纹或细中线打断。笔记描述所列标本及日期，再生尾不是完整尾测量，观察怀卵不提供卵数、产卵位置或繁殖季。
ecology
Two areas and effort-bound changes in encounters
两个地区及受搜索努力限定的遭遇变化

The 2016 account knew areas near Sola de Vega and San Vicente Lachixio, about 40 km apart. The first area was summarized as roughly 2100–2200 m, with later type-locality readings as low as 2085 m; separate Lachixio vouchers included 2615–2730 m. At the type locality, approximately 300 animals were seen in road-bank cracks in November 1974, 75 were found in about two hours in July 1976, and one was found after over two hours in October 1997. Later visits through June 2014 found none. Substrates and search conditions differed, so the counts are not standardized densities, and nondetection does not prove extinction. The stated last live field sighting was March 1998 at Lachixio, a historical endpoint rather than a present-day claim.

2016 年记述知 Sola de Vega 及 San Vicente Lachixio 附近两区，相距约 40 千米。第一区综合约 2100—2200 米，后来模式地点读数低至 2085 米；单列 Lachixio 凭证海拔含 2615—2730 米。模式地 1974 年十一月路岸裂隙约见三百只，1976 年七月约两小时找到七十五只，1997 年十月超两小时仅一只。后来至 2014 年六月访问未发现。基质及搜索条件不同，计数不是标准化密度，未检出不证明灭绝。所述最后野外活体目击为 Lachixio 的 1998 年三月，是历史端点而非当前声明。
ecology
A proposed threat category with unknown total range
整体范围未知的威胁等级提议

The 2016 authors recommended Critically Endangered, citing drastic, unexplained declines likely exceeding 80% over 30–40 years and continuing deterioration of montane forest. They explicitly said the full extent of occurrence was unknown despite two known areas around 40 km apart, and suggested occupied area might be very small. Neither the separation distance nor surveyed sites yield a measured occupied polygon. The recommendation and uncertainty remain dated; the reported habitat changes do not alone establish the causal mechanism of population decline.
2016 年作者提议极危，援引三十至四十年间剧烈、原因不明且很可能超过 80% 的下降及高山森林持续恶化。明确说即使已知两区相隔约 40 千米，完整分布范围面积仍未知，并认为占据面积可能很小。间距或调查点不产生测量占据多边形。提议及不确定性保留日期，报告的生境变化本身不确定种群下降因果机制。

title: Biology of tiny animals: three new species of minute salamanders (Plethodontidae: Thorius ) from Oaxaca, Mexico

name: Thorius tlaxiacus
sections: morphology
Prolate nostrils and a holotype with a missing tail tip
长椭球形鼻孔及尾尖缺失正模

Female holotype MCZ 148746 was collected southeast of Tlaxiaco, Oaxaca, on 22 July 1999 at 2855 m. Posterior-vent SL was 29.0 mm and anterior-vent length 27.9 mm; tail length 21.0 mm explicitly lacked its tip and is not a complete-tail ratio. Seven males averaged SL 28.0 mm, range 21.1–30.2 mm, and four females 27.7 mm, range 22.6–31.0 mm. Mean nostril major/minor-axis ratios were 2.1 and 2.3. Maxillary teeth were absent in the sample. Tail ratios used only five males and two females, a smaller denominator than the size sample; these observations do not define universal adult dimensions.

雌性正模 MCZ 148746 于 1999 年七月二十二日采自 Oaxaca、Tlaxiaco 东南，海拔 2855 米。后角 SL 29.0 毫米，前角长度 27.9 毫米；尾长 21.0 毫米明确缺尾尖，不能形成完整尾比例。七雄 SL 均值 28.0 毫米、范围 21.1—30.2 毫米，四雌 27.7 毫米、范围 22.6—31.0 毫米。鼻孔长短轴比均值分别 2.1、2.3，样本无上颌齿。尾比例仅用五雄两雌，分母小于体型样本；观察不定义通用成体尺寸。
morphology
Voucher-specific live notes and damaged preserved material
凭证特定活体笔记及受损保存材料

Live-colour notes dated 26 July 1999 described MCZ 148746 with a dark brown background, a chestnut nuchal spot, brown dorsal stripe and fine white lateral spotting. MCZ A-148745 had a brighter reddish-brown stripe with dark chevron-like interruptions. Most preserved type-series animals had tissue removed for genetic analysis, limiting colour descriptions. The holotype collection date was separately 22 July; note date and collection date are not silently merged. Colour differences belong to named specimens, not invariant identification rules.
1999 年七月二十六日活体颜色笔记描述 MCZ 148746 深棕背景、栗色颈斑、棕背带及细白体侧斑，MCZ A-148745 较亮红棕带具暗人字状打断。多数保存模式标本取组织作遗传分析，限制颜色描述。正模采集日期另为七月二十二日，不静默合并笔记及采集日期。颜色差异属于命名标本，不是不变鉴定规则。
ecology
Two forest areas, sympatry and provisional assignments
两个森林地区、同域及暂定鉴定

The account reported Tlaxiaco-area elevations 2665–3080 m and San Vicente Lachixio elevations 2720–2730 m, about 80 km apart. In December 1978, animals were abundant inside fragmenting fallen logs in partly disturbed pine-oak slopes; ten or twelve could share one crevice. Much forest had been cleared by July 1999, when only three were seen; July 2014 searches found none. Named sympatric Thorius were T. narisovalis at Tlaxiaco and T. longicaudus at Lachixio. Some additional Tlaxiaco specimens were assigned provisionally from external morphology, distinct from genetic assignments. Aggregation does not establish a breeding group, and nondetection does not certify extinction.

记述报告 Tlaxiaco 区海拔 2665—3080 米、San Vicente Lachixio 2720—2730 米，两区约隔 80 千米。1978 年十二月部分受扰松栎坡地的碎裂枯木内丰富，一裂隙可同有十或十二只。至 1999 年七月大量森林被清理，仅见三只；2014 年七月搜索未发现。命名同域 Thorius 为 Tlaxiaco 的 T. narisovalis 及 Lachixio 的 T. longicaudus。部分额外 Tlaxiaco 标本仅依据外形暂定，区别于遗传鉴定。聚集不确定繁殖群，未检出不认证灭绝。
ecology
A dated decline estimate and explicitly unknown extent
有日期下降估计及明确未知分布面积

The 2016 authors recommended Critically Endangered because of drastic declines thought likely to exceed 80% over 30–40 years and continuing montane-forest deterioration. They described the cause as unexplained and the full extent of occurrence as unknown, despite two known areas about 80 km apart; occupied area might be very small. The distance between areas is not itself extent or area of occupancy. This recommendation is attributed to the publication rather than presented as a verified current assessment or a measured species-wide survival probability.
2016 年作者因三十至四十年间剧烈、认为很可能超 80% 的下降及高山森林持续恶化而提议极危。说明原因未解释，虽然已知两区相距约 80 千米，完整分布范围面积仍未知，占据面积可能很小。地区间距本身不是分布或占据面积。提议归于该出版物，不当作核实当前评估或测量全物种生存概率。

title: Biology of tiny animals: three new species of minute salamanders (Plethodontidae: Thorius ) from Oaxaca, Mexico

name: Thorius minutissimus
sections: morphology
A small female sample and posterior-vent standard length
小型雌性样本及后角标准长

The redescription retained female holotype AMNH 52673, collected at Santo Tomás Tecpan, Oaxaca, on 3 March 1946, and examined two additional females IBH 23011–12 from near Santo Tomás Teipan. Female mean standard length was 23.0 mm, range 22.3–23.6 mm; the diagnosis said the only known adult male was 19 mm. Standard length follows the paper’s snout-to-posterior-vent definition. The female summary reported no maxillary teeth, mean seven vomerine teeth with range 5–9, and mean SL/tail ratio 1.03. These sparse sex-specific observations do not establish a population-level dimorphism test or universal body-size limits.

再描述保留雌性正模 AMNH 52673，1946 年三月三日采自 Oaxaca、Santo Tomás Tecpan，另检查 Santo Tomás Teipan 附近两雌性 IBH 23011—12。雌性标准长均值 23.0 毫米、范围 22.3—23.6 毫米，鉴别说唯一已知成年雄性 19 毫米。标准长沿用论文吻至泄殖腔后角定义。雌性综合无上颌齿，犁骨齿平均七、范围 5—9，SL/尾长均值 1.03。稀少分性别观察不确定种群层面两性异形检验或通用体型极限。
morphology
Life and preservative colours from two named females
两只命名雌性的活体及保存颜色

Live notes dated 23 January 2001 for IBH 23011–12 described dark blackish-brown flanks, a dark brown dorsal stripe with regular herringbone interruptions and an obscure reddish nuchal spot. Preserved females were dark blackish-grey with an obscure paler stripe and numerous pale ventral spots, especially on the throat. The diagnosis’s reddish-stripe wording and the detailed dark-brown notes retain their separate scopes. The live-note date remains distinct from the distribution paragraph’s 25 January field-note date; neither is silently substituted for the other.
针对 IBH 23011—12 的 2001 年一月二十三日活体笔记描述暗黑棕体侧、深棕背带具规则鱼骨状打断及不明显红颈斑。保存雌性暗黑灰，具不明显较浅带，腹面众多浅斑，尤其喉部。鉴别的红带措辞与详细深棕笔记保留各自范围。活体笔记日期与分布段一月二十五日野外笔记日期分开，不静默替代。
morphology
Two skeleton preparations and specimen-level tooth differences
两种骨骼制备及标本层面齿差异

Osteology used CT-scanned female IBH 23011 and cleared-and-stained female IBH 23012. Skulls were weakly ossified apart from developed otic capsules. The external summary reported one premaxillary tooth per female, whereas skeletal examination found none in IBH 23012 and one mature plus two unerupted teeth in IBH 23011; these different observations remain explicit. The reported phalangeal formulae were 1–2–3–2 in the hand and 1–2–3–2–1 in the foot, and the described left and right ankles differed in fusion pattern. This limited material does not establish invariant adult skeletal architecture or developmental timing.
骨学使用雌性 IBH 23011 的 CT 及雌性 IBH 23012 的透明染色制备。除发达耳囊，头骨骨化弱。外部综合列每雌一前颌齿，而骨骼检查于 IBH 23012 未见、IBH 23011 有一成熟及两未萌齿，明确保留不同观察。报告手指骨式 1—2—3—2、足 1—2—3—2—1，所描述左右踝融合型不同。有限材料不确定不变成体骨骼结构或发育时间。
ecology
Two evening road-bank captures near the type locality
模式地点附近两次傍晚路岸捕获

The 2016 account knew the species only near its type locality. Two specimens at 2458 m were taken from a road bank in an oak-forest patch near Santo Tomás Teipan, in the early evening between 19:00 and 20:00: one partly emerged from a hole and the other was obtained by digging. No salamander was found in adjacent forest during the day; one individual was later reported in an April 2009 assessment. These observations do not prove obligate road-bank dwelling, exclusive nocturnality or absence in the forest. Nearby Bolitoglossa zapoteca records were not reported as confirmed sympatric captures.
2016 年记述仅知本种于模式地点附近。两件海拔 2458 米标本采自 Santo Tomás Teipan 附近栎林片的路岸，傍晚 19 至 20 时，一只从孔部分露出，另一只挖得。白天邻近林未发现蝾螈，2009 年四月评估另报告一只。这些观察不证明专性路岸居住、专一夜行或森林无分布。附近 Bolitoglossa zapoteca 记录未报告为确认同域捕获。
evolution
A name historically applied to several other species
历史上曾用于其他数种的名称

The authors explained that minutissimus had been misapplied to populations representing several species. In particular, animals called T. minutissimus in cited 1982–1985 cranial and limb studies belonged instead to T. longicaudus. Damaged historical specimens were assigned partly from resemblance and the single known regional Thorius, an evidence boundary that remains distinct from genetic confirmation. The account cited a Critically Endangered assessment as of 2016 and requested further locality surveys. Historical results under the misapplied name are not automatically transferred to this reader, and the dated threat category is not a verified current assessment.

作者解释 minutissimus 曾误用于代表多个物种的种群。特别是所引 1982—1985 年头骨及肢研究中称 T. minutissimus 的动物实际属于 T. longicaudus。受损历史标本部分依据相似及当地仅知一种 Thorius 而归类，该证据边界与遗传确认不同。记述引述截至 2016 年极危评估并要求进一步地点调查。不自动将误用名称下历史结果转入本页，有日期威胁等级不是核实当前评估。

title: Biology of tiny animals: three new species of minute salamanders (Plethodontidae: Thorius ) from Oaxaca, Mexico

name: Thorius narisovalis
sections: morphology
Sexed adult sizes and a tooth-count boundary conflict
分性别成体体型及齿数边界冲突

Female holotype FMNH 100089, formerly EHT-HMS 17859, was collected on Cerro San Felipe in August 1938. The 2016 variation sample comprised ten males with mean SL 25.2 mm, range 22.2–28.4 mm, and ten females with mean 27.8 mm, range 26.3–29.9 mm. SL means snout to posterior vent angle. Mean SL/tail ratios were 0.85 in five males and 0.82 in eight females, smaller tail-sample denominators. Maxillary teeth were absent. The diagnosis said fewer than seven vomerine teeth, while variation ranges reached seven in both sexes; the conflict is retained rather than treating the diagnostic boundary as universal.

雌性正模 FMNH 100089，旧 EHT-HMS 17859，于 1938 年八月采自 Cerro San Felipe。2016 年变异样本十雄 SL 均值 25.2 毫米、范围 22.2—28.4 毫米，十雌 27.8 毫米、范围 26.3—29.9 毫米。SL 为吻至泄殖腔后角。SL/尾长均值五雄 0.85、八雌 0.82，尾样本分母较小。无上颌齿。鉴别称犁骨齿少于七，但两性变异范围均达七，保留冲突，不将鉴别边界当作普遍极限。
morphology
Variable stripes and an often unspotted belly
变化带纹及通常无斑腹部

July 1976 live notes described brick-red or tan-brown dorsal stripes, occasional melanistic animals and dark venters lacking conspicuous white flecks in most specimens. Separate October 1997 notes described an entirely dark gravid female with black iris and no white spots. Preserved specimens could have white spots on the throat and lower flanks while the belly remained unspotted. The regions and observation dates matter: an unspotted belly does not mean every body surface lacked spots, and a single gravid animal does not establish egg number or a breeding season.
1976 年七月活体笔记描述砖红或褐棕背带、偶黑化个体及多数腹暗无显著白斑。单列 1997 年十月笔记描述全暗怀卵雌性、黑虹膜且无白斑。保存标本喉及下体侧可有白斑而腹无斑。部位及观察日期重要，无斑腹不等于所有身体表面无斑，单一怀卵个体不确定卵数或繁殖季。
morphology
Variable skeletal formulae and an inconsistent vertebral summary
变化骨骼式及不一致椎骨综合

The osteological account described variable skull-bone contacts and presence or absence of premaxillary teeth, while maxillary teeth were absent in all examined specimens. The modal foot phalangeal formula was 1–2–3–3–1 at 71%, with several alternatives, so it is not invariant. The caudal-vertebra summary printed a female mean of 36.8 with range 31–36 in five females, an internally inconsistent combination because the mean exceeds the stated maximum. It is preserved as an unresolved source error and not used as a definitive female vertebral count or silently repaired.
骨学描述头骨接触变化及前颌齿存在或缺失，而所有检查标本无上颌齿。足指骨众数式 1—2—3—3—1 占 71%，有多个替代型，故非不变。尾椎综合列五雌均值 36.8、范围 31—36，均值超所列最大值而内部矛盾。保留为未解决来源错误，不用作确定雌性椎骨数或静默修补。
ecology
Oaxaca forest records and dated low encounter counts
Oaxaca 森林记录及有日期低遭遇数

The 2016 account reported central and western Oaxaca mountain ranges including Cerro San Felipe, Cuajimoloyas, west of Zaachila and southeast of Tlaxiaco. The distribution paragraph gave 2780–3185 m, while the material list also contained Zaachila specimens at 2590 m; these differing entries remain separate. Animals were often encountered among exposed cover in disturbed pine-oak forest. Cerro San Felipe counts were one in October 1997 and, on five later visits from 2008–2015, one, sixteen, one, one and two. These dated observations document sparse encounters without standardized density or a present-day population census; they do not prove dependence on disturbance.

2016 年记述报告 Oaxaca 中西山地，包括 Cerro San Felipe、Cuajimoloyas、Zaachila 以西及 Tlaxiaco 东南。分布段列 2780—3185 米，而材料表另含 Zaachila 的 2590 米标本，分开保留不同条目。动物常遭遇于受扰松栎林裸露覆盖物中。Cerro San Felipe 1997 年十月计一只，2008—2015 年五次后来访问分别一、十六、一、一、二只。有日期观察记录稀少遭遇，不提供标准化密度或当前种群普查，也不证明依赖干扰。
ecology
A 2016 account of Critically Endangered status
2016 年极危状态记述

The paper cited Critically Endangered status in 2016, associating it with declines exceeding 80% over 30–40 years, severely fragmented distribution, an extent of occurrence thought probably below 100 km² and continuing forest deterioration. The probability wording for extent remains explicit. It is not area of occupancy or a fully mapped occupied range. The statement is attributed to the dated publication and cited assessments, not presented as a verified current Red List category or a quantified causal effect of forest loss.
论文引述 2016 年极危状态，联系三十至四十年间超过 80% 的下降、严重破碎分布、认为很可能小于 100 平方千米的分布范围面积及森林持续恶化。明确保留面积可能性措辞，不等于占据面积或完整绘制占据范围。陈述归于有日期出版物及所引评估，不当作核实当前红色名录等级或森林损失量化因果效应。

title: Biology of tiny animals: three new species of minute salamanders (Plethodontidae: Thorius ) from Oaxaca, Mexico

name: Bolitoglossa muisca
sections: morphology
Nine types and a separate referred-material count conflict
九件模式及单列参考材料数量冲突

Female holotype IAvH-Am-17413 was collected at Finca La Esmeralda, Bojacá, on 4 February 2021 at 2630 m. Eight paratypes comprised three females and five males from Bojacá and Soacha. The referred-material heading stated 36 specimens, including seven females and 29 juveniles or subadults, while the range ICN 58245–58268 was described as a batch of 23. That inclusive range comprises 24 numbers, so range, batch count and aggregate total are retained as unresolved rather than silently harmonized. The type series and larger comparative samples remain different denominators.

雌性正模 IAvH-Am-17413 于 2021 年二月四日采自 Bojacá、Finca La Esmeralda，海拔 2630 米。八副模含三雌五雄，来自 Bojacá 及 Soacha。参考材料标题列三十六件，七雌及二十九幼或亚成体，而 ICN 58245—58268 区间称一批二十三件。含端点区间含二十四个号码，故区间、批数量及合计保留为未解决，不静默统一。模式系列及更大比较样本分母不同。
morphology
One female holotype with an incomplete tail
尾不完整的一件雌性正模

The holotype description gave SVL 61.3 mm, head width/SVL 0.16, 33 maxillary teeth, 25 vomerine teeth and thirteen costal grooves. It printed tail/SVL 0.93 while explicitly saying the tail tip was missing and the apparent abruptly widened, rounded tail ending was artefactual. That ratio is not a complete-tail limit or proof of a natural rounded terminal shape. The same paragraph includes a male premaxillary-tooth statement within the female description and ambiguous digit-order expressions; neither is assigned uncritically as a measured female trait or repaired into an inferred ranking.
正模描述给 SVL 61.3 毫米、头宽/SVL 0.16、上颌齿三十三、犁骨齿二十五及十三肋沟。列尾长/SVL 0.93，同时明确尾尖缺失，突然加宽且圆末端的外观是人为造成。该比例不是完整尾极限，也不证明天然圆尾末端。同段在雌性描述内含雄性前颌齿陈述及不清晰指趾排序式，不无条件当作测量雌性性状或修补成推测排名。
morphology
A day-after-capture photograph and five months in ethanol
捕获次日照片及五个月乙醇保存

Live holotype colour was described from a photograph taken the day after capture: brown dorsal surfaces with salmon-coloured speckling, thin irregular white markings, and a light sky-blue iris with reddish reticulations. After approximately five months in 70% ethanol, stripes and ventral surfaces were smoke-grey and the iris amber with orange-rufous reticulations. Other specimens varied in orange-rufous or salmon background and brown markings. These dated preservation conditions are explicit; preserved iris colour does not replace life colour, and no single pattern is an invariant identity test.
活体正模颜色来自捕获次日照片：棕背面具鲑色斑点、细不规则白纹，虹膜浅天蓝具红色网纹。约五个月 70% 乙醇保存后，带及腹面烟灰，虹膜琥珀具橙红棕网纹。其他标本橙红棕或鲑色背景及棕纹变化。明确保留保存时间及条件，保存虹膜不替代活体颜色，单一纹样不是不变身份测试。
evolution
A sampled sister lineage and a corrected museum number
采样姊妹谱系及修正馆藏号码

The study analysed a 2070-bp concatenated matrix for 67 ingroup terminals, using 16S, cyt b and RAG1 with different sequence-sample counts. The new-species clade had ultrafast bootstrap 100 and Bayesian posterior probability 1.0; its sister relationship to sampled B. adspersa from Bogotá and surroundings had support 98 and 0.99. These are distinct support measures, not percentages of reproductive isolation. The authors corrected an El Soche GenBank voucher formerly labelled MVZ 167947 to MVZ 167997 from the museum catalogue. Pairwise mitochondrial distances and delimitation results support the attributed study hypothesis; they do not certify all contemporary concepts or universal species thresholds.

研究分析六十七个内群端点的 2070 碱基拼接矩阵，使用 16S、cyt b 及 RAG1，各序列样本数不同。新种支超快速自展 100、贝叶斯后验概率 1.0；与 Bogotá 及附近所采 B. adspersa 的姊妹关系支持 98、0.99。这是不同支持量，不是生殖隔离百分比。作者根据馆藏目录将曾标 MVZ 167947 的 El Soche GenBank 凭证修正为 MVZ 167997。线粒体两两距离及界定结果支持所归属研究假说，不认证全部当代概念或通用物种阈值。
ecology
Estimated extent of occurrence and a protected type locality
估计分布范围面积及受保护模式地点

The authors calculated extent of occurrence as 102 km² from known localities using GeoCAT. They placed the type locality within the Cerro Manjui–Salto del Tequendama regional protected area and described deforestation, logging and forest clearing as habitat threats. They proposed Endangered under the criterion printed as B1b(iii) and called for monitoring. Extent of occurrence is not occupied area, and protected-area placement does not demonstrate population security. The criterion and proposal are retained as the authors’ 2023 statement, not silently amended or represented as an independently verified current Red List assessment.
作者以 GeoCAT 根据已知地点计算分布范围面积 102 平方千米，列模式地点于 Cerro Manjui—Salto del Tequendama 区域保护区内，描述毁林、伐木及森林清理为生境威胁。提议按原文 B1b(iii) 列濒危并要求监测。分布范围面积不是占据面积，位于保护区不证明种群安全。标准及提议保留为作者 2023 年陈述，不静默修订或当作独立核实当前红色名录评估。

name: Bolitoglossa adspersa
sections: morphology
A comparative series in the 2023 muisca description
2023 年 muisca 描述中的比较系列

The B. muisca description compared 26 B. adspersa specimens with SVL range 30.7–66.3 mm and mean 45.0 mm. It described moderate webbing, but less than in its sampled B. muisca, with digit tips extending beyond the web margin, and a relatively thin, long tail. The printed uncertainty term is not labelled here as standard deviation without confirming its definition. These comparative observations concern the study’s assigned specimens, not a complete adspersa redescription, species-wide range or independently certified reconciliation of all historical identifications.
B. muisca 描述比较二十六件 B. adspersa，SVL 范围 30.7—66.3 毫米、均值 45.0 毫米。描述适度蹼、但少于所采 B. muisca，指趾尖超出蹼缘，尾相对细长。未确认定义前不将印刷误差项标为标准差。比较观察属于研究所归类标本，不是完整 adspersa 再描述、全物种范围或全部历史鉴定独立核对。
evolution
Bogotá samples as the sister lineage of muisca
Bogotá 样本作为 muisca 姊妹谱系

In the study’s multilocus tree, B. adspersa samples from Bogotá, its type locality, and surroundings formed the sister lineage of B. muisca with ultrafast bootstrap 98 and posterior probability 0.99. Reported uncorrected mitochondrial distances between the two lineages were 2.1% for 16S and 7.0% for cyt b. These quantities refer to sampled markers and lineages, not genome-wide divergence, elapsed speciation time or measured reproductive isolation. The supported separation does not resolve every historical population previously called adspersa.
研究多位点树中，来自模式地点 Bogotá 及附近的 B. adspersa 样本形成 B. muisca 姊妹谱系，超快速自展 98、后验概率 0.99。报告两谱系未校正线粒体距离为 16S 的 2.1%、cyt b 的 7.0%。量值属于所采标记及谱系，不是全基因组分化、成种时间或测量生殖隔离。支持分离不解决每个历史称 adspersa 的种群。

name: Bolitoglossa capitana
sections: morphology
Five comparative specimens and distinct measurement denominators
五件比较标本及单列测量分母

The 2023 B. muisca description compared five B. capitana with mean SVL 75.2 mm, range 59.2–85.5 mm, mean maxillary teeth 30.4, range 22–37, and mean vomerine teeth 66.4, range 46–87. It described almost fully webbed hands and feet and a large, thick, conspicuous gular fold, in contrast to its sampled B. muisca. These are comparative sample summaries; tooth values are counts, not dimensions, and they do not establish universal adult size, dietary performance, breeding function or a full current species account.
2023 年 B. muisca 描述比较五件 B. capitana，SVL 均值 75.2 毫米、范围 59.2—85.5 毫米，上颌齿均值 30.4、范围 22—37，犁骨齿均值 66.4、范围 46—87。描述手足近全蹼及大、厚、显著喉褶，对比所采 B. muisca。这是比较样本综合，齿值为计数而非尺寸，不确定通用成体体型、食性表现、繁殖功能或完整当前物种记述。

name: Bolitoglossa pandi
sections: morphology
Twelve comparative animals with coarse skin and pointed digits
十二只比较动物的粗皮肤及尖指趾

The B. muisca description reported twelve B. pandi with mean SVL 44.0 mm, range 35.9–52 mm. It described coarse rather than mostly smooth skin, triangular pointed outlines of the third finger and toe tips, and a tail tapering gradually from broad anteriorly to slender posteriorly. These features are attributed to the comparison in the 2023 paper, not treated as a complete redescription or an invariant identification test for every age and population. The passage does not provide measured climbing performance, diet, breeding site or a verified present-day range.
B. muisca 描述报告十二只 B. pandi，SVL 均值 44.0 毫米、范围 35.9—52 毫米。描述粗而非主要光滑皮肤，第三指趾尖轮廓三角尖形，尾从前宽向后细逐渐收缩。特征归于 2023 年论文比较，不当作完整再描述或所有年龄种群不变鉴定测试。本段不提供测量攀爬表现、食谱、繁殖地或核实当前范围。

name: Hynobius kunibiki
sections: morphology
A dated male holotype and specimen-level measurements
有日期雄性正模及标本层面测量

The 2021 description designated a male from Nishinomura, Matsue, Shimane, collected on 20 December 2019 at 100 m, and two paratypes: a female from the same site and date and a male from Unnan at 90 m in January 2021. The holotype measured SVL 60.0 mm, tail 49.7 mm, head length 13.6 mm and head width 10.4 mm, with four fingers, five toes, no interdigital webbing and thirteen costal grooves. These are one specimen’s dimensions. The printed measurement list repeats RUEL with different values; that ambiguous abbreviation is not silently reassigned to eyelid width or used as a resolved trait.

2021 年描述指定 Shimane、Matsue、Nishinomura 的雄性为正模，2019 年十二月二十日采于海拔 100 米；两副模为同地同日雌性及 2021 年一月 Unnan、90 米雄性。正模 SVL 60.0 毫米、尾 49.7 毫米、头长 13.6 毫米、头宽 10.4 毫米，四指五趾、无指趾蹼、十三肋沟。这是一标本尺寸。印刷测量表重复 RUEL 并给不同数值，不静默改赋为眼睑宽或当作已解决性状。
morphology
Yellow tail edges and variable markings in sampled adults
采样成体黄色尾缘及变化纹样

The diagnosis reported mean SVL 58.9 mm in males and 58.2 mm in females, with yellow stripes on both dorsal and ventral tail edges and a fifth hind toe. Both-sex tail stripes and fifth toes occurred in all sampled animals in the comparison, not a guarantee for every future individual. Dorsal colour varied from yellowish-brown to blackish-brown; distinct black dorsal spots or white lateral spots were usually absent but sometimes present. Preserved dorsums tended to fade to dark grey. Frequencies retain sex and study scope, and live colours remain distinct from faded preserved colours.
鉴别报告雄性 SVL 均值 58.9 毫米、雌性 58.2 毫米，尾背腹缘有黄带且后足具第五趾。比较样本两性尾带及第五趾均出现，不保证未来每个个体。背色黄棕至黑棕，明显黑背斑或白体侧斑通常无、但部分有；保存背面趋于褪为暗灰。频率保留性别及研究范围，活体颜色与褪色保存颜色分开。
reproduction
Still-water breeding, coiled sacs and early larval balancers
静水繁殖、盘绕卵囊及早期幼体平衡器

The species account described breeding in still waters at forest edges in mixed Castanopsis and Quercus woodland. Adults came to ponds between December and March; the account mentioned attachment to fallen branches or leaves in still water. Egg sacs were coil-shaped. Early larvae had one pair of balancers and black dots along the lateral tail; claws were absent from finger and toe tips. These observations describe reported sites and stages, not clutch size, incubation duration, breeding at all months or survival rates. The text does not justify converting adult attachment wording into a quantified egg-substrate experiment.
物种记述描述在 Castanopsis 与 Quercus 混交林边缘静水繁殖。成体十二月至三月到池塘，原文提及附在静水中的落枝或叶。卵囊盘绕。早期幼体具一对平衡器及尾侧黑点，指趾尖无爪。观察描述所报告地点及阶段，不是窝卵数、孵化时间、全年繁殖或生存率。文本不支持将成体附着措辞改作量化卵基质实验。
ecology
Shimane localities and a disputed isolated record
Shimane 地点及有争议孤立记录

The 2021 distribution account listed Oda, Yasugi, Matsue, Izumo and Unnan municipalities in Shimane Prefecture. The discussion treated a previously sampled Iinan haplotype assignment cautiously: the locality was isolated, voucher details were unavailable, and the authors’ Iinan samples did not support occurrence of the new species there. Thus the listed municipalities and uncertain Iinan lead are not merged into an occupied continuous range. Their proposed northeastern restriction is a study interpretation, not a verified present-day census or physiological altitude limit.
2021 年分布记述列 Shimane 的 Oda、Yasugi、Matsue、Izumo、Unnan 市镇。讨论谨慎处理此前 Iinan 单倍型归类：地点孤立，凭证细节不可用，作者 Iinan 样本未支持新种存在。因此所列市镇与不确定 Iinan 线索不合并成连续占据范围。提出的东北部限制是研究解释，不是核实当前普查或生理海拔极限。
evolution
The Izumo lineage and marker-bounded taxonomic evidence
Izumo 谱系及受标记限定的分类证据

Cytochrome-b Bayesian and maximum-likelihood trees did not group the former Izumo lineage and the other sampled H. utsunomiyaorum as a single clade; the Izumo lineage grouped with H. akiensis. The authors combined this with morphological differences to describe H. kunibiki. They discussed earlier SNP-based lumping and cited allozyme evidence, retaining disagreement among evidence sets. A mitochondrial tree is not a complete nuclear genealogy or a measured reproductive-isolation test, and the authors’ separation does not automatically certify every historically assigned population.
cytochrome-b 的贝叶斯及最大似然树未将原 Izumo 谱系与其他所采 H. utsunomiyaorum 合成单支，Izumo 谱系与 H. akiensis 成组。作者结合外形差异描述 H. kunibiki，讨论此前 SNP 合并并引述等位酶证据，保留证据集间分歧。线粒体树不是完整核基因谱系或测量生殖隔离检验，作者分离不自动认证每个历史归类种群。
ecology
A call for conservation reassessment in 2021
2021 年保护重新评估呼吁

The authors called for reassessment of H. kunibiki conservation status and national or regional management against overcollection. They linked the concern to release of detailed locality information and cited overcollection of H. utsunomiyaorum; that cited event is not transferred as a measured kunibiki harvest rate. They did not provide a current Red List category or quantified extinction probability in this paragraph. The management request remains a dated recommendation rather than proof that regulations or monitoring were subsequently implemented.
作者呼吁重新评估 H. kunibiki 保护状态并制定国家或区域管理以防过度采集，联系详细地点发布并引述 H. utsunomiyaorum 过采；该引用事件不转为测量 kunibiki 采集率。本段未提供当前红色名录等级或量化灭绝概率。管理请求保留为有日期建议，不证明其后已落实法规或监测。

name: Hynobius setoi
sections: evolution
A geographically sampled haplotype boundary
地理采样单倍型边界

The 2021 study found H. setoi cytochrome-b haplotypes from western Hyogo through Tottori to easternmost Shimane, but did not detect them around northeastern Shimane. The authors questioned some earlier setoi assignments there as potentially combining two species. Those are marker results and a taxonomic interpretation, not proof that every unsampled site lacked setoi or that each historical voucher has been formally reassigned. The study’s separate lineage from H. kunibiki remains bounded by its sampled animals and marker.
2021 年研究于 Hyogo 西部，经 Tottori 至 Shimane 最东部发现 H. setoi 的 cytochrome-b 单倍型，但东北 Shimane 周围未检出。作者质疑部分先前 setoi 归类可能合并两种。这是标记结果及分类解释，不证明每个未采样地点无 setoi 或每件历史凭证已正式重归类。与 H. kunibiki 的独立谱系受所采动物及标记限定。
morphology
Tail stripes do not alone distinguish setoi from kunibiki

The authors found no significant difference in the previously proposed mean SVL or forelimb/SVL and hindlimb/SVL ratios, while some other sex-specific measurements differed.
