name: Hynobius oni
sections: morphology
Twelve types and a separately measured male series
十二件模式及单列雄性测量系列

Male holotype KUHE 62785 was collected on Mt. Yatsuzura, Uwajima, Ehime, on 24 April 2021 at 1000 m. Eleven paratypes comprised ten males and one female, with six further referred specimens including five juveniles. The holotype measured SVL 82.7 mm, tail 66.3 mm, head length 18.6 mm and head width 13.6 mm. The diagnosis gave male adult SVL 73.6–87.5 mm; the variation comparison used twelve males and a single female at 84.6 mm. Type, juvenile and measurement denominators remain distinct. The female tail-dimension list repeats BTAH and MTAH with differing values, so the ambiguous assignments are not silently repaired.

雄性正模 KUHE 62785 于 2021 年四月二十四日采自 Ehime、Uwajima、Mt. Yatsuzura，海拔 1000 米。十一副模含十雄一雌，另六件参考标本含五幼体。正模 SVL 82.7 毫米、尾 66.3 毫米、头长 18.6 毫米、头宽 13.6 毫米。鉴别列雄成体 SVL 73.6—87.5 毫米，变异比较使用十二雄及一雌 84.6 毫米。模式、幼体及测量分母分开。雌性尾尺寸表重复 BTAH、MTAH 并列不同值，不静默修补模糊赋值。
morphology
Adult plain colours and spotted young
成体素色及有斑幼年个体

Adults were described as uniformly dark reddish-brown dorsally, sometimes darker and less reddish, with a lighter underside and dark brown iris. Young animals had white dorsal dots. Preserved adult dorsums faded towards grey-brown; larval gold tail-fin dots faded to white. Age and preservation states are separate: white juvenile dots do not contradict the attributed plain-adult description, and preserved colours do not recover live appearance. The account does not demonstrate a colour-signalling, toxicity or camouflage function.
成体描述背面均匀暗红棕，有时更暗、红更少，腹较浅，虹膜深棕。幼年个体背有白点。保存成体背面褪向灰棕，幼体金色尾鳍点褪白。年龄及保存状态分开，幼年白点不抵触所归属素色成体描述，保存色不能恢复活体外观。记述未证明颜色信号、毒性或伪装功能。
reproduction
Crescent sacs and separate clutch and sac samples
新月形卵囊及单列窝卵、卵囊样本

The description reported mean clutch size 23.5, range 16–36, for 21 observations. Fifteen egg sacs supplied mean length 176.8 mm and width 17.0 mm, with a distinct free-end whiptail extension averaging 35.2 mm. Eggs were cream-coloured at both poles, with stated oval diameter 4.9–5.9 mm, arranged in one or two rows per sac. The printed uncertainty terms are not labelled as standard deviations without confirming their definition. Clutch observations are not assumed to be fifteen sacs or twenty-one distinct mothers, and these measurements do not provide incubation time, fertilization success or survival.
描述报告二十一次观察窝卵数均值 23.5、范围 16—36。十五卵囊提供长度均值 176.8 毫米、宽 17.0 毫米，自由端明显鞭尾延伸平均 35.2 毫米。卵两极奶油色，所列卵直径 4.9—5.9 毫米，每囊一或两排。未确认定义前不将印刷误差项标为标准差。窝卵观察不假定等于十五囊或二十一不同母体，测量未提供孵化时间、受精成功或生存率。
lifeHistory
Stage-specific larvae and one overwintering encounter
特定阶段幼体及一次越冬遭遇

Using the Iwasawa–Yamashita staging system, three stage-63 larvae averaged SVL 21.7 mm; one stage-64 larva at metamorphosis onset in late July measured 20.6 mm. Larvae had developed external gills, a high tail fin and no finger or toe claws. Across three night surveys dated in 2019 and 2022, only one overwintered larva, total length 71 mm, was found in an open stream. These small samples do not establish universal metamorphic size, a fixed larval duration or absence of overwintering. Total length is not SVL, and this staging system is not silently substituted with an anuran Gosner stage.
依 Iwasawa—Yamashita 分期，三只第 63 期幼体 SVL 平均 21.7 毫米，一只七月下旬变态开始的第 64 期幼体为 20.6 毫米。幼体具发达外鳃、高尾鳍、指趾无爪。2019 及 2022 年所列三夜调查中，开放溪流仅发现一只越冬幼体，全长 71 毫米。小样本不确定通用变态体型、固定幼期时长或无越冬。全长不是 SVL，该分期不静默替换为无尾类 Gosner 期。
ecology
Southwestern Shikoku streams and an inferred late-April season
Shikoku 西南溪流及推断晚四月季节

The account knew the species from the Onigajo and Sasayama Mountains in Ehime and Kochi, southwestern Shikoku. Animals occurred around mountain streams with partly exposed bedrock. Eggs, females with eggs and males were observed in water on 29 April 2019; twelve adult males and egg sacs were beneath submerged stones on 24 April 2021. From these observations the authors presumed late-April breeding. Nonbreeding adults and juveniles were under nearby stones, rotten wood and debris. The dated inference is not proof that reproduction is confined to those dates, and lack of observed sympatric hynobiids does not prove their regional absence.
记述知本种于 Shikoku 西南 Ehime、Kochi 的 Onigajo 及 Sasayama 山地，动物见于部分裸露基岩的山溪周围。2019 年四月二十九日水中见卵、带卵雌及雄，2021 年四月二十四日水下石下见十二成年雄及卵囊，据此作者推断晚四月繁殖。非繁殖成体及幼年个体见邻近石、腐木及碎屑下。有日期推断不证明繁殖仅限那些日期，未观察到同域小鲵不证明区域不存在。

The Nanyo lineage and a different unresolved hybrid boundary
Nanyo 谱系及另一未解决杂交边界

The study separated the Nanyo group as H. oni using nuclear SNP structure and morphology. The SNP analysis detected 716 loci and examined clustering at different K values; Tsurugi and Central groups formed a clinal transition and were treated together for morphology, while Nanyo was distinct at K = 3. The authors said Tsurugi–Central species status remained unresolved pending hybrid-zone research. Clustering supports their sampled lineage interpretation, not complete reproductive isolation at every locality, and an unresolved boundary elsewhere is not promoted to additional named species.
研究以核 SNP 结构及外形将 Nanyo 组分为 H. oni。SNP 分析检出 716 位点并检查不同 K 的聚类，Tsurugi 与 Central 组形成渐变过渡、外形中合并处理，Nanyo 于 K＝3 独立。作者说 Tsurugi—Central 物种状态须杂交带研究、仍未解决。聚类支持所采谱系解释，不证明每地完整生殖隔离，其他未解决边界不升为额外命名物种。
ecology
Threat concerns and preliminary explanations of small adult size
威胁关注及较小成体的初步解释

The authors called for protection against habitat degradation and private collecting in the small known mountain range. Their discussion hypothesized that shallow or unstable streams and fewer overwintering larvae could contribute to smaller metamorphosing and adult size. Those were preliminary field interpretations and analogies with other species, not a causal growth experiment. They also requested reassessment of H. hirosei after the split; previously cited local categories for hirosei sensu lato are not automatically assigned to oni. The recommendation is dated 2022 and supplies no verified current Red List status.
作者呼吁在小已知山地范围保护本种免受生境退化及私人采集。讨论假设浅或不稳定溪流及较少越冬幼体可能促成较小变态及成体体型。这是初步野外解释及其他物种类比，不是因果生长实验。另要求分离后重评 H. hirosei，所引旧广义 hirosei 地方等级不自动赋给 oni。建议日期为 2022 年，未提供核实当前红色名录状态。

name: Hynobius hirosei
sections: evolution
A narrowed name after removal of the Nanyo lineage
移除 Nanyo 谱系后的较窄名称

The 2022 study used H. hirosei sensu stricto for samples remaining after recognition of Nanyo as H. oni, including Mt. Ishizuchi topotypes. Tsurugi and Central nuclear groups formed a clinal transition; the authors deferred whether they were separate species until further hybrid-zone analysis. The narrower name therefore is tied to this taxonomic treatment, not applied uncritically to every older hirosei record. The reported transition does not provide a quantified present-day migration rate or settle species limits independently.

reproduction
Previously published clutch samples from two mountain areas
两个山地此前发表的窝卵样本

For comparison with H. oni, the paper cited mean clutch size 34.3 and range 25–59 from 81 observations on Mt. Ibuki, and mean 31.0 with range 15–52 from nine observations in the Tsurugi Mountains. These were attributed to 2004 and 2012 publications, not newly collected unified samples. Mountain, date, denominator and original uncertainty definitions remain distinct. The two summaries do not establish a species-wide fecundity constant, egg survival or a fixed number for every breeding female.
为与 H. oni 比较，论文引述 Mt. Ibuki 八十一次观察窝卵均值 34.3、范围 25—59，以及 Tsurugi 山九次观察均值 31.0、范围 15—52，分别归于 2004、2012 年出版物，不是新采统一样本。山地、日期、分母及原误差定义分开。两综合不确定全物种繁殖力常数、卵生存或每只繁殖雌固定数量。
ecology
Syntopic species and a requested conservation reassessment
同地物种及所要求的保护重评

The discussion reported H. hirosei sensu stricto syntopic with H. kuishiensis, H. tsurugiensis and Onychodactylus kinneburi, proposing body-size differences as a possible explanation for coexistence. This interpretation does not demonstrate measured diet partitioning or exclude other mechanisms. After separating H. oni, the authors requested immediate reassessment of hirosei conservation status; the Near Threatened category they cited was from 2014, while local Red Data Book statements used the broader name. Neither is silently converted into a verified current national status for the narrowed concept.
讨论报告狭义 H. hirosei 与 H. kuishiensis、H. tsurugiensis、Onychodactylus kinneburi 同地，提出体型差异可能解释共存。该解释不证明测量食谱分割或排除其他机制。分离 H. oni 后，作者要求立即重评 hirosei 保护状态，所引近危等级来自 2014 年，地方红皮书陈述使用较广名称。二者均不静默转为核实较窄概念当前全国等级。

name: Hynobius notialis
sections: morphology

These voucher identities and dates anchor the named material; the species-account paragraphs do not specify their sex, so sex is not invented. Holotype measurements are referred to a table rather than inferred from collecting locality or the group’s comparative size description.

Overlapping measurements in a geographically bounded comparison
地理限定比较中的重叠测量

reproduction
Natural history pooled across three species
三种合并的自然史

The authors explicitly pooled natural history for H. notialis, H. geojeensis and H. perplicatus because separate breeding ecology was poorly known. They described still-water reproduction in roadside or field ditches and fallow rice paddies, earliest breeding in late January, a late-February to early-March peak and some late-March spawning. An estimated range threshold and a dated Endangered proposal
估计范围阈值及有日期濒危提议

作者因各自繁殖生态少知，明确合并 H. notialis、H. geojeensis、H. perplicatus 自然史。描述道路或田边沟及休耕稻田静水繁殖，最早晚一月、峰晚二月至早三月，部分晚三月产卵。雌通常产两弯卵囊，可环回或近直，附着依地点变化。幼体形成成对平衡器，于随后冬季前变态，尚不知幼体越冬。合并观察不是各物种独立测量日程、窝卵数或发育时长。

An island-area proxy and a misplaced species name in the assessment

The conservation paragraph estimated geojeensis extent of occurrence below 500 km² and area of occupancy below 100 km² using island area as a proxy, but its concluding Critically Endangered sentence printed the name notialis. The discussion separately identified geojeensis as the species needing strong protection and described no more than five known localities. The name mismatch is explicit; the paragraph is not silently corrected or used to assign a current category. Island area is not directly surveyed occupancy, and the dated concern does not quantify population size.

name: Hynobius perplicatus
sections: morphology
Four dated types from Uiryeong
Uiryeong 四件有日期模式标本

Adult holotype CGRB15895, field ID mms4082, and three adult paratypes CGRB15893, 15894 and 15896 were collected at Yongdeok-myeon, Uiryeong, on 22 March 2012. Their sex is not stated in the treatment paragraphs and is not inferred. The published voucher series establishes the source material for the name, not a full population sample or an independently verified current locality record.
成年正模 CGRB15895，野外号 mms4082，及三成年副模 CGRB15893、15894、15896 于 2012 年三月二十二日采自 Uiryeong、Yongdeok-myeon。记述段未明性别、不推断。发表凭证系列建立名称来源材料，不是完整种群样本或独立核实当前地点记录。
morphology
A cryptic large-bodied comparison and repeated abbreviation
隐蔽大体型比较及重复缩写

The paper knew perplicatus from limited parts of Hapcheon, Sancheong and Uiryeong, with all known populations reported sympatric with notialis. It called the species the largest Korean Hynobius in its comparison, while acknowledging overlap and no discrete known morphological character. Its threshold sentence repeated HL with different cutoffs, 15.81 and 4.39 mm; the second is not silently relabelled as another dimension. The glaciation explanation for its range appeared as an unresolved hypothesis in the etymology, not established biogeographic history.
论文知 perplicatus 于 Hapcheon、Sancheong、Uiryeong 有限区域，报告全部已知种群与 notialis 同域。在比较中称韩国 Hynobius 最大，同时承认重叠及无已知离散外形性状。阈值句重复 HL 并列 15.81、4.39 毫米不同界值，不静默将第二项改标另一尺寸。名称说明中的冰期范围解释是未解决假说，不是确定生物地理历史。
reproduction
Natural history pooled across three species
三种合并的自然史

The authors explicitly pooled natural history for H. notialis, H. geojeensis and H. perplicatus because separate breeding ecology was poorly known. They described still-water reproduction in roadside or field ditches and fallow rice paddies, earliest breeding in late January, a late-February to early-March peak and some late-March spawning. Females generally deposited two curved sacs, sometimes looped or nearly straight, and attachment varied with the site. Larvae developed paired balancers and metamorphosed before the following winter; larval overwintering was not known. These pooled observations are not independently measured schedules, clutch sizes or developmental durations for each species.
作者因各自繁殖生态少知，明确合并 H. notialis、H. geojeensis、H. perplicatus 自然史。描述道路或田边沟及休耕稻田静水繁殖，最早晚一月、峰晚二月至早三月，部分晚三月产卵。雌通常产两弯卵囊，可环回或近直，附着依地点变化。幼体形成成对平衡器，于随后冬季前变态，尚不知幼体越冬。合并观察不是各物种独立测量日程、窝卵数或发育时长。
ecology
Two connected sites and a threshold-based conservation proposal
两个相连地点及基于阈值的保护提议

The authors estimated perplicatus extent of occurrence below 1000 km² because landscape-use and presence data were unavailable. They described two connected sites and possible occurrence in linked valleys, proposing Endangered under B1ab(i,ii,iii,iv,v) in 2021. Possible valleys are not confirmed additional populations; the range threshold is not measured area of occupancy. Unknown population sizes precluded precise demographic analysis, and the proposal is not a verified current assessment.
作者因景观使用及存在数据不可用，估计 perplicatus 分布范围面积低于 1000 平方千米，描述两个相连地点及可能存在相连谷地，2021 年按 B1ab(i,ii,iii,iv,v) 提议濒危。可能谷地不是确认额外种群，范围阈值不是测量占据面积。种群大小未知，无法精确人口统计分析，提议不是核实当前评估。

name: Tylototriton kachinorum
sections: morphology
Ten adult types from a dated forest-clearing collection
有日期森林空地采集的十件成体模式

Male holotype ZMMU A5953 was collected at 21:00 on 18 July 2018 in a swamp in a forest clearing on Ingyin Taung Mountain near Indawgyi Lake, Kachin, Myanmar, at 1000 m. Nine paratypes comprised seven males and two females from the same collection. The diagnosis gave male SVL 62.3–74.1 mm and female SVL 72.5–84.8 mm; the holotype measured SVL 67.2 mm and tail 77.3 mm. Two male paratypes had shortened regenerating tail tips, so their tails do not define intact-tail minima. These type-series ranges are not universal adult limits or a population-level dimorphism test.

雄性正模 ZMMU A5953 于 2018 年七月十八日 21 时采自 Myanmar、Kachin、Indawgyi Lake 附近 Ingyin Taung 山森林空地沼泽，海拔 1000 米。九副模含七雄两雌，来自同次采集。鉴别列雄 SVL 62.3—74.1 毫米、雌 72.5—84.8 毫米；正模 SVL 67.2 毫米、尾 77.3 毫米。两雄副模尾尖再生而较短，其尾不定义完整尾下限。模式范围不是通用成体极限或种群层面异形检验。
morphology
Head ridges and a conflict in labelled limb measurements
头脊及标注肢测量冲突

The holotype had protruding broad supratemporal ridges, a weak sagittal ridge, a wide nonsegmented vertebral ridge and fourteen rib nodules on each side. Fingers and toes lacked webbing and the adpressed limbs overlapped. The body description labelled forelimb/SVL and hindlimb/SVL as 26.2% and 28.0%, but the holotype list repeated RFLL 26.2 and RHLL 28.0 under a heading saying all measurements were in millimetres. These incompatible unit presentations are explicit; the ratios are not silently converted into measured 26.2-mm and 28.0-mm limbs. Tooth counts of 93 upper-jaw, 110 lower-jaw and 95 vomerine teeth belong to this specimen.
正模具突起宽颞上脊、弱矢状脊、宽不分节脊椎脊及每侧十四肋结节。指趾无蹼，贴体肢重叠。身体描述将前肢/SVL、后肢/SVL 列为 26.2%、28.0%，但正模表于“全部毫米”标题下重复 RFLL 26.2、RHLL 28.0。明确保留不兼容单位呈现，不静默将比例转成测量 26.2、28.0 毫米肢。上颌九十三、下颌一百一十、犁骨九十五齿属于该标本。
morphology
Dull live markings and six-month ethanol fading
暗淡活体斑纹及六个月乙醇褪色

The live holotype had dark brown head and trunk, dull yellowish- to orange-brown ridges and nodules, lighter limbs and a brown iris with tiny bronze speckles. After six months in ethanol, yellow and orange tones faded to light brownish-grey. Other types varied from lighter yellow-orange to darker, duller brown. These observations retain specimen and preservation state; subtle nodules or dull markings are not demonstrated camouflage, toxicity or an invariant colour test for every population.
活体正模头及躯干深棕，脊及结节暗淡黄棕至橙棕，肢较浅，棕虹膜具细青铜斑。六个月乙醇后黄橙调褪为浅棕灰。其他模式由较浅黄橙至较暗淡棕变化。观察保留标本及保存状态，不明显结节或暗淡纹不是已证明伪装、毒性或所有种群不变颜色测试。
reproduction
Five ovarian eggs and observed July courtship
五枚卵巢卵及观察七月求偶

Clutch size was explicitly unknown. Five ripe ovarian eggs from female paratype ZMMU A5956 had diameters 1.6–1.7 mm, mean 1.7 mm, with dark brown animal poles and cream-coloured remaining surfaces. These are eggs within one ovary-bearing female, not five mothers, deposited clutch counts or fertilized embryos. Male courtship was observed in July. Neither observation establishes a full breeding season, egg-laying substrate, incubation duration, offspring survival or successful fertilization.
明确窝卵数未知。雌性副模 ZMMU A5956 的五枚卵巢成熟卵直径 1.6—1.7 毫米、均值 1.7 毫米，动物极深棕，其余奶油色。这是同一雌性卵巢内卵，不是五母体、已产窝数或受精胚胎。七月观察雄性求偶，两项观察均不确定完整繁殖季、产卵基质、孵化时长、后代生存或成功受精。
lifeHistory
One stage-40 larva with a developing fifth toe
第五趾发育中的一只第 40 期幼体

Larval description used single voucher ZMMU A5957 at Grosse (2013) stage 40. It measured SVL 10.5 mm and tail 9.7 mm, with developed external gills, four developed fingers and four developed toes plus a fifth-toe nub. Its skin was smooth, unlike the granular adult skin, and no yolk remains were seen. Live background was ochre-golden with translucent pinkish ventral surfaces and darker tail pigmentation. A stage-specific specimen does not establish hatchling or metamorphic size, developmental duration, universal larval colour or an anuran Gosner stage.
幼体描述使用单一凭证 ZMMU A5957，Grosse（2013）第 40 期。SVL 10.5 毫米、尾 9.7 毫米，具发达外鳃、四发达指及四发达趾加第五趾芽。皮光滑，与成体颗粒皮不同，未见残余卵黄。活体背景赭金、腹半透明粉，尾较暗。特定阶段标本不确定出膜或变态体型、发育时长、通用幼体颜色或无尾类 Gosner 期。
ecology
Direct aquatic encounters and separate local reports
直接水中遭遇及单列当地报告

The 2019 account knew one Ingyin Taung locality at 900–1050 m and predicted possible occurrence on adjacent mountains. Adults were encountered after 19:00 in shallow slow streams and artificial cattle-watering ponds surrounded by secondary bamboo and mixed evergreen forest. Males moved on clay bottoms in 20–40 cm water; females and the larva were netted among vegetation in 60–100 cm water. Farmers separately reported animals far from water after rain and in wells. Direct observations and reported knowledge remain distinct; predicted mountains are not confirmed populations. A tentative Vulnerable proposal accompanied explicit unknown range, trends and threats, not a verified current assessment.
2019 年记述仅知 Ingyin Taung 一地点，海拔 900—1050 米，预测邻山可能存在。19 时后于次生竹林及混交常绿林围绕的浅缓溪及人工牲畜饮水池遭遇成体。雄在 20—40 厘米水的黏土底移动，雌及幼体于 60—100 厘米水植被中网得。农民另报告雨后远水及井内动物。直接观察与报告知识分开，预测山地不是确认种群。暂定易危提议同时明确范围、趋势及威胁未知，不是核实当前评估。
evolution
Two mitochondrial markers and inconsistent distance labels
两个线粒体标记及不一致距离标签

The study placed kachinorum with sampled Myanmar species and Himalayan himalayanus using ND2 and 16S mitochondrial sequences. The opening result and diagnosis gave comparison minima of 5.3% for ND2 and 2.4% for 16S, while a later genealogy paragraph labelled a 5.3–14.6% range as 16S. The differing marker labels are retained as an unresolved source conflict rather than selecting one distance table interpretation without inspection. Marker genealogy and morphological concordance support the authors’ species hypothesis, not a complete nuclear genealogy or universal divergence threshold.
研究用 ND2、16S 线粒体序列将 kachinorum 与所采 Myanmar 物种及喜马拉雅 himalayanus 成组。开头结果及鉴别给比较最小值 ND2 的 5.3%、16S 的 2.4%，而后来谱系段将 5.3—14.6% 区间标为 16S。不同标记标签保留为未解决来源冲突，不在未查表时选定一种距离解释。标记谱系及外形一致支持作者物种假说，不是完整核谱系或通用分化阈值。

name: Tylototriton himalayanus
sections: morphology
A Nepalese comparison with prominent nodules and tail grooves
尼泊尔比较的显著结节及尾沟

The kachinorum description characterized its Nepalese himalayanus comparator by sixteen large prominent rib nodules, distinct lateral tail grooves and relatively rougher skin. Light markings were described as absent from the head and rib nodules and confined to ventral surfaces on the limbs, in contrast to kachinorum. name: Chiropterotriton magnipes
sections: ecology
A cave-associated species and limits of accessible searches
洞穴关联物种及可到达搜索限制

The 2020 study described magnipes as an obligate cave-dwelling Neotropical salamander, with large fully webbed feet, protruding eyes and mostly unpigmented skin. Known historical caves were in Querétaro and San Luis Potosí; the study also surveyed Hidalgo sites. Searchers scanned accessible walls, ceilings and floors, but inaccessible passages and deeper areas remained unsearched. The attributed cave specialization is not proof that every cave in the wider karst is occupied or empty, and large webbed feet do not establish measured adhesion or swimming performance.
2020 年研究将 magnipes 描述为专性洞居新热带蝾螈，具大全蹼足、突眼及主要无色素皮。已知历史洞穴于 Querétaro、San Luis Potosí，研究另查 Hidalgo 地点。搜索扫描可到达壁、顶、地面，无法到达通道及深处未查。所归属洞居特化不证明较广喀斯特每洞均有或无分布，大全蹼足不确定测量黏附或游泳表现。
ecology
Positive skin swabs with repeated individuals possible
可能重复个体的阳性皮肤拭子

Live swabs were collected in 2017–2018 without marking animals, so minimum distinct-individual counts were inferred from age and sex. Six magnipes encounters at El Coni represented at least five individuals and nine at La Trinidad at least six. The discussion reported Bd-positive swabs 2/6 and 2/9 respectively. Samples are not automatically unique animals. The results’ aggregate site denominators, 24 and nine, do not sum to the stated total 29 swabs and remain unresolved. No dead animals or skin lesions were observed; fourteen tested salamanders were Bsal-negative, which does not prove regional absence or resistance.
2017—2018 年采活体拭子但未标记，依年龄性别推最少不同个体。El Coni 六次 magnipes 遭遇至少五个体，La Trinidad 九次至少六。讨论报告 Bd 阳性拭子分别 2/6、2/9，样本不自动等于独特动物。结果综合地点分母二十四及九与总二十九拭子不相加一致，保持未解决。未见死体或皮肤损伤，十四受测蝾螈 Bsal 阴性，不证明区域不存在或抗性。
evolution
One modern pathogen genotype and uncertain historical causation
一份现代病原基因型及不确定历史因果

One successfully genotyped contemporary Bd-positive sample belonged to the Global Panzootic Lineage. Historical positives could not be genotyped, so the older fungus is not certified as the same lineage. Museum detections began in 1969 after earlier negatives, but the authors could not exclude historical false negatives or jar cross-contamination. They found timing consistent with a role in decline, while lacking susceptibility trials or direct evidence connecting infection and mortality. Detection, lineage assignment, chronology and causal interpretation therefore remain separate.
一份成功分型现代 Bd 阳性样本属全球大流行谱系。历史阳性未能分型，故不认证旧真菌同谱系。馆藏检出起于 1969 年、此前阴性，但作者无法排除历史假阴或同罐交叉污染。认为时间与参与下降一致，却缺易感试验或感染与死亡直接证据。因此检测、谱系归类、时序及因果解释分开。
ecology
Sparse encounters do not certify extinction at old sites
稀少遭遇不认证旧地点灭绝

The study found extant magnipes at two surveyed sites and none at historical sites, but explicitly noted that some caves were visited only once and detection was imperfect even where animals remained present. Museum collections were not precise historical abundance estimates because not every seen animal was collected. Habitat degradation and historical collecting were discussed as possible additional contributors. Low contemporary counts are not standardized population density, and old-site nondetection is not definitive extinction. The account’s survey-site totals also differ between the methods and results and are not silently harmonized.
研究于两个调查点发现现存 magnipes、历史点未见，但明确部分洞仅访一次，即使仍有动物处检测也不完美。馆藏非精确历史丰度，因为非每只所见均采集。讨论生境退化及历史采集为可能额外因素。低当代计数不是标准化种群密度，旧点未检出不是确定灭绝。方法与结果的调查地点总数亦不同，不静默统一。
ecology
Monitoring proposed for apparently healthy infected populations
针对外观健康感染种群提出监测

The authors described the two known extant populations as Bd-positive but apparently healthy and relatively constant at low encounter abundance since discovery. They called for repeated host and pathogen monitoring to resolve whether infection had reached an enzootic state or still affected survival, and protection of cave habitat from human impacts. These were 2020 interpretations and recommendations, not verified current population stability, measured survival probabilities or proof that monitoring was subsequently implemented.
作者描述两个已知现存种群 Bd 阳性但外观健康，自发现后低遭遇丰度相对稳定，要求重复监测宿主及病原以解决感染是否地方流行稳定态或仍影响生存，并保护洞穴免人类影响。这是 2020 年解释及建议，不是核实当前种群稳定、测量生存概率或其后落实监测证明。

Aquiloeurycea cafetalera was one of six Mexican plethodontid species contributing 111 newly generated skin-microbiome samples to the 2023 comparative study. The methods identify these six species as sampled from wild populations; 111 is their pooled total, not a count for this species. Its aquatic or terrestrial habitat labels refer to where and when an animal was sampled, rather than a complete species life-history classification. Twenty-two newly generated Ambystoma mexicanum samples in the 2023 analysis came from simulated outdoor environments, described as mesocosms in the former native range at Xochimilco Lake. The 2023 study ranked Bolitoglossa yucatana highest for genetic diversity estimated from its ddRAD loci among the sampled bolitoglossine species. The study deliberately sequenced one individual per species and estimated diversity only at loci containing at least one heterozygous site, using the median across loci. Low coverage could miss one allele and rare variants, and the authors considered ddRAD diversity likely underestimated. This ranking is therefore specific to the sampled individual, loci and comparison set. It is not a population-wide allele-frequency estimate, a ranking across all salamanders, a measured adaptation rate or evidence of present demographic security. sections: reproduction
An amplectant pair inside an abandoned termite nest
废弃白蚁巢内的抱对

At 02:16 on 3 June 2022, observers found a Pristimantis chocoensis pair already in amplexus inside a degraded abandoned termite nest attached to a fallen trunk in Río Canandé Reserve, Esmeraldas, Ecuador, at 350 m elevation. The nest had a large upper opening and loose soil. The pair occupied a depression for nearly two hours before observed egg and sperm release at 04:02. Because amplexus had begun before discovery, the observers could not determine whether either adult had dug the depression. This is one observed site and event, not proof that termite nests are obligatory breeding sites, an annual breeding calendar or a measured altitude limit.

2022 年 6 月 3 日 02:16，观察者于厄瓜多尔 Esmeraldas、Río Canandé 保护区海拔 350 米发现已抱对的 Pristimantis chocoensis，位于倒木所附、退化废弃的白蚁巢内。巢上部有大开口，内有松土。抱对于凹处停留近两小时，04:02 观察到排卵及排精。因发现前已开始抱对，无法确定凹处是否由任一成体挖成。这是一次地点和事件观察，不证明白蚁巢是必需繁殖处、年度繁殖日历或实测海拔极限。
behavior
Egg rotation followed by active covering with soil
转卵后主动覆土

The female released at least twenty eggs, a lower-bound observation rather than an exact or species-typical clutch size. For approximately an hour she remained over the eggs, rotated her body and used alternating hind-leg scrambling movements to mix and coat them with soil. At 05:14 she was seen pulling surrounding loose soil underneath her body until the eggs were completely buried in a mound. The activity continued at least until 06:10; its exact end was not recorded. The male stayed nearby, immobile and not calling during this process. Apparent additional egg release and abdominal contractions were interpreted by the observers, without a measured fertilization-success result.
雌排出至少二十卵，为观察下限，不是精确或物种典型窝卵数。约一小时内雌留于卵上、转动身体，以交替后肢扒动使卵混合并沾土。05:14 见其把周围松土拉至身下，直至卵完全埋入土丘。活动至少持续至 06:10，未记录精确停止时刻。雄此时留近处、不动且不鸣。似乎再次排卵及腹部收缩为观察者解释，未提供实测受精成功结果。
behavior
Short female attendance and uncertain male guarding
短期雌留守及不确定雄护卵

At 15:00 on the same day both adults rested near their earlier positions, with the female on the egg mound. On the second night the male was no longer visible at or immediately around the site, while the female remained on the mound; neither adult was seen there during the following seven nights. The authors summarized attendance as approximately twenty-four hours for the female and twelve for the male, interpreting the female as guarding but explicitly unable to confirm whether the male’s proximity was intended care or incidental. These observations do not document continuous monitoring, hatching success, survival of the buried eggs or a universal duration of parental care.
当日 15:00 两成体在近原位置休息，雌在卵丘上。第二夜雄不见于产卵处或紧邻周围，雌仍在土丘；其后七夜均未在该处见两成体。作者总结雌留守约二十四小时、雄约十二小时，将雌解释为护卵，却明确无法确认雄近留是有意照护还是偶然。这些观察不记录持续监控、孵化成功、埋卵存活或普遍亲代照护时长。
evolution
Proposed functions of burying remain hypotheses
埋卵所提功能仍为假说

The report interpreted egg burying and brief female attendance in the context of direct development and terrestrial reproduction. It proposed that rotation could distribute sperm across the clutch, and discussed concealment and ultraviolet protection as potential benefits of soil covering. It also suggested an allocation shift toward intense brief nest care rather than prolonged guarding. No sperm-distribution measurement, predator-exclusion experiment, ultraviolet exposure assay or comparison of hatchling survival was performed for this observed event. The behavioural record supports that the female actively buried eggs; its adaptive functions and generality within the species require further study.
报告在直接发育及陆地繁殖背景下解释埋卵与雌短留，提出转卵可能使精子在卵窝中分布，并讨论覆土潜在隐蔽及紫外防护益处。还提出照护分配可能转向短期高强度营巢，而非长时护卵。对此事件未进行精子分布测量、排除捕食者实验、紫外暴露检测或幼蛙存活比较。行为记录支持雌主动埋卵，适应功能及本种中普遍程度仍需研究。

A termite-dominated local stomach sample

Stomach flushing of 26 heymonsi in April and July 2025 yielded 501 food items from Coleoptera, Hymenoptera and Isoptera. Mean items per stomach were 19.27 ± 15.57 SD, range 1–60. Abundance and volume ANOSIM comparisons were not significant for the two Microhyla but significant for mukhlesuri versus lingnanica. This describes the sampled trophic axis, not identical whole-species niches or direct evidence of competition. Nonsignificance does not prove biological equivalence, and the lower overlap does not show that competition is impossible. The study did not manipulate food resources or measure changes in survival caused by the other frog species.

name: Occidozyga lingnanica
sections: morphology
Local sex-specific body size and a fully webbed voucher

The Kim Bang lingnanica sample included 33 males with SVL 19.0–27.8 mm (mean ± SD 23.65 ± 2.77), and fifteen females at 26.6–32.5 mm (28.97 ± 1.54). The sex ranges overlap and remain local summaries. The described male voucher had no vomerine teeth, unwebbed fingers, fully webbed toes with expanded round tips, a nuptial pad and tuberculate dorsal skin. A 557-bp mitochondrial sequence from HUS 2026 A.03 was 98.91% similar to a lingnanica sequence from Zhuhai, Guangdong. These are identification data, not a measured swimming advantage, a universal diagnostic sequence cutoff or a reconstruction of connectivity between the sampled regions.

Beetles, aquatic prey and a sample-denominator boundary
甲虫、水生猎物及样本分母边界

Forty-eight lingnanica yielded 280 stomach items, averaging 5.83 ± 4.42 SD per stomach, range 1–19. The sample contained eight insect orders as well as decapods, isopods, gastropods, spiders and Gobiiformes fish. Coleoptera had the highest reported IRI, 47.2%, and standardized niche breadth was 0.33, higher than the two Microhyla in this sample. Stomach-volume results instead used n = 47; the account does not explain the one-sample difference, so it is not silently harmonized. These recovered prey and modelled volumes do not establish daily intake, prey preference independent of availability, fish specialization or annual trophic breadth.

Encounters at the stream edge rather than a measured preference
溪缘遭遇而非实测偏好

The local survey reported lingnanica on the ground (36), in leaf litter (9), and muddy areas (3), approximately 0–1 m from the water edge. The authors often saw feeding searches along streams and linked that setting to aquatic prey in stomachs. The secondary forest contained small hardwoods, lianas and shrubs; frogs were hand-collected at night during April and July 2025. These detections are not an availability-corrected preference, a population-density estimate, proof of obligate stream breeding or a complete habitat description across the species range. The feeding-site interpretation remains local to this observational sample.
地方调查报告 lingnanica 在地面 36、落叶层 9、泥地 3，距水缘约 0—1 米。作者常见其沿溪搜食，并把此环境与胃中水生猎物联系。次生林含小硬木、藤及灌木；蛙于 2025 年四月及七月夜间手采。这些检出不是按可用环境校正偏好、种群密度估计、专性溪流繁殖证明或全分布完整生境描述。觅食地点解释限定于此地方观察样本。
ecology
Diet differences and an unconfirmed body-size explanation
食谱差异及未证实的体型解释

Pianka overlap was 49% with heymonsi and 47% with mukhlesuri, with significant abundance and volume ANOSIM differences from both. The discussion suggested that lingnanica’s larger body size might account for larger prey, but the reported SVL–stomach-content-volume correlation for lingnanica was not significant. A higher sample mean does not establish larger stomach contents in every individual: the reported sample means were 40.8 mm³ for lingnanica, 32.42 for heymonsi and 22.86 for mukhlesuri, with substantial variation. These results do not establish a causal size mechanism, prey-item size equivalence with total stomach volume or competitive release.

name: Anodonthyla pollicaris
sections: reproduction
Captive water-filled holes and male attendance
饲养水填孔洞及雄留守

At Mitsinjo’s facility, frogs identified morphologically as Anodonthyla pollicaris laid eggs in water-filled cavities, especially bamboo tubes and also film canisters. Males remained with eggs and larvae through metamorphosis. The discussion reported breeding mainly during December–May under ambient seasonal conditions in Andasibe, rather than a temperature-manipulation experiment. The authors observed guarding but did not demonstrate additional care behaviours or isolate its effect on survival. These are captive observations, not proof that every wild breeding event uses bamboo, that the species has no other season elsewhere, or that every founder’s identity was genetically verified.
Mitsinjo 设施内形态鉴定为 Anodonthyla pollicaris 的蛙在水填孔洞产卵，主要竹管，也用胶卷盒；雄随卵及幼体留至变态。讨论报告 Andasibe 环境季节条件下主要十二月至五月繁殖，不是温度操纵实验。作者观察护卵，但未证明额外照护行为或分离其存活效果。这是饲养观察，不证明每个野外繁殖事件用竹、别处无其他季节或每个创始个体均遗传验证。

Nonfeeding larvae and an observed twenty-day minimum
不外源摄食幼体及观察二十日下限

The study treated pollicaris larvae as endotrophic, relying on yolk rather than supplied external food, and allowed them to develop in the adult enclosure. The shortest reported interval from egg laying to completed metamorphosis was twenty days. This minimum is not a mean, a universal schedule or a developmental thermal limit. Many egg masses were culled for facility capacity, so the study’s retained-development observations do not constitute unrestricted survival estimates for every clutch. Founder identification was morphological only; the general absence of genetic checks remains a boundary on assigning the captive observations to a certified contemporary concept.

name: Platypelis barbouri
sections: reproduction
Eggs and attending males in artificial cavities
人工孔洞内卵及留守雄

Frogs identified as Platypelis barbouri bred exclusively in water-filled holes in the reported captive study, using bamboo and film canisters among the offered structures. Eggs were laid in the water, and males stayed with eggs and larvae through metamorphosis. Artificial cavity use documents behaviour under the enclosure choices; it does not establish that only those materials are used in nature or quantify wild cavity availability. The authors interpreted attendance as egg guarding but did not test additional parental feeding or experimentally measure the protective effect of male presence. The founders were not genetically verified.
所报告饲养研究中鉴定为 Platypelis barbouri 的蛙只在水填孔洞繁殖，采用提供结构中的竹及胶卷盒。卵产水中，雄随卵和幼体留至变态。人工孔使用记录箱内选项下行为，不确定自然只用这些材料，也不量化野外孔洞可得量。作者将留守解释为护卵，但未测试额外亲代喂食或实验测雄存在的保护效应。创始个体未遗传验证。

A seventeen-day observed minimum to metamorphosis
观察至变态最短十七日

Barbouri larvae were classified as nonfeeding endotrophic tadpoles and developed in the adult enclosures without external larval food. Completed metamorphosis occurred as early as seventeen days after egg laying, the shortest interval cited for this species in the study. This is an observed minimum under captive conditions, not a typical field duration or guaranteed survival time. The study’s interpretation that rapid development could reduce drying risk was not a desiccation experiment for barbouri. Morphology-only founder assignment and selective retention of clutches remain limits on the species concept and survival inference.
barbouri 幼体分类为不外源摄食的内源营养蝌蚪，于成体箱发育且未供外源幼体食物。产卵后最快十七日完成变态，为研究引述本种最短间隔。这是饲养条件观察下限，不是典型野外时长或保证存活时间。快速发育可能降低干燥风险的解释并非 barbouri 脱水实验。仅形态创始归属及选择保留卵窝仍限定物种概念和存活推论。

name: Plethodontohyla mihanika
sections: reproduction
Captive guarding with an explicit identification uncertainty
具明确鉴定不确定性的饲养护卵

The frogs maintained as Plethodontohyla mihanika laid eggs in water-filled captive cavities, and males stayed with the eggs and larvae through metamorphosis. The authors explicitly warned that separating live mihanika from notosticta by forward-bent hind-leg reach was difficult; founder identification was morphological rather than genetic. These are observations attributed to the maintained label, not certified evidence that every individual belonged to mihanika or an equivalent record for notosticta. Guarding was observed, while additional care functions and their effects on survival were not tested.
作为 Plethodontohyla mihanika 饲养的蛙在水填人工孔洞产卵，雄随卵和幼体留至变态。作者明确警告：以向前弯后肢到达位置区分活体 mihanika 与 notosticta 困难；创始鉴定形态而非遗传。这些观察归于所维持标签，不认证每个个体均属 mihanika，也不等价成为 notosticta 记录。已观察护卵，但未测试额外照护功能及存活影响。
development
Yolk-supported larvae and captive development timing
卵黄支持幼体及饲养发育时序

The study described the maintained mihanika tadpoles as endotrophic and did not supply external larval food. They developed in the adult enclosures, with the minimum reported egg-laying-to-metamorphosis interval twenty days. This interval is not a hatching-only time, a mean development duration or a measured thermal optimum. It is conditional on captive care and the morphology-based species assignment. Rapid development was discussed as potentially useful in drying-prone habitats, but the experiment did not quantify dehydration tolerance or establish the development schedule of genetically confirmed wild mihanika populations.

name: Gephyromantis mitsinjo
sections: reproduction
Terrestrial eggs with larvae remaining in jelly
陆地产卵及留胶幼体

Frogs maintained as Gephyromantis mitsinjo deposited most captive egg masses on land beneath dried leaves or other refugia, including flowerpot pieces and half-cut plastic pipes. The observed nonfeeding tadpoles hatched but remained within egg jelly on land, rather than entering a free-swimming aquatic phase. Staff moved discovered eggs onto gravel and moist sphagnum in a cup for continued development. This observed larval phase should not be erased by calling the event simply direct development without qualification. Artificial refugia use and transferred clutches do not establish all natural oviposition sites or undisturbed parental attendance.
作为 Gephyromantis mitsinjo 维持的蛙多数饲养卵窝产于干叶或其他掩体下陆地，包括花盆碎及半剖塑料管。观察不外源摄食蝌蚪孵化后留陆地卵胶，不进入自由游泳水生阶段。人员将所发现卵移至杯内砾石及湿泥炭藓继续发育。不能无条件只称直接发育而抹去已观察幼体阶段。人工掩体使用及转移卵窝不确定全部自然产卵处或不受干扰亲代留守。

Small relative clutch size and a twenty-two-day minimum
相对小卵窝及最短二十二日

Mitsinjo had the smallest mean egg-mass size among the eleven maintained species according to the study’s comparison. The minimum reported interval to completed development was twenty-two days, without an aquatic larval phase. The narrative does not supply an exact mean clutch count here, so no number is inferred from the comparison or figures. These are retained captive observations; most recorded clutches across the study were culled to limit facility populations. The relative clutch ranking and minimum time do not estimate wild fecundity, survival, generation length or a population-wide development limit.
按研究比较，mitsinjo 在十一维持种中平均卵窝最小。报告完成发育最短二十二日，无水生幼体阶段。该叙述处未给精确平均卵数，故不从比较或图推数值。这是保留饲养观察；研究整体多数记录卵窝为限制设施种群而淘汰。相对卵窝排名及最短时间不估野外繁殖力、存活、世代长或全种群发育极限。
conservation
Related-species conservation suggestions are analogies
近缘种保护建议属于类比

The authors used mitsinjo’s terrestrial, jelly-associated larval development to suggest possible vulnerability of related Gephyromantis to drying and altered rainfall. They did not directly observe the same mode in every named relative or experimentally measure climatic survival thresholds. Founder identification for the study was morphological only. The captive record can inform hypotheses and planning, while contemporary concept checks, wild breeding observations and species-specific demographic evidence remain necessary before treating it as a certified fecundity estimate or projecting outcomes for another species.
作者以 mitsinjo 的陆地胶内幼体发育提出近缘 Gephyromantis 可能易受干燥及降雨改变影响。未直接观察每个具名近缘种同模式，也未实验测气候存活阈值。研究创始鉴定仅形态。饲养记录可支持假说和规划，但认证繁殖力估计或预测他种结果前仍需现行概念核查、野外繁殖观察及物种特定种群证据。

Leaf-attached egg masses and excluded large counts

Externally feeding tadpoles in nonflowing-water care

name: Boophis bottae
sections: reproduction
One captive spawning event in the warm rainy season
暖雨季一次饲养产卵

Bottae spawned only once in the recorded captive study, during the warm rainy season, and laid eggs in water. A single spawning event does not establish a complete annual breeding calendar, repeatability of the husbandry method, typical egg count or the absence of reproduction in cooler conditions. The founders were collected at Analamazaotra in February 2016 and identified by morphology, without genetic verification. Broader seasonal associations across the eleven-species study are not independent temperature-trigger experiments for bottae.
记录的饲养研究中 bottae 仅产卵一次，处暖雨季，卵产水中。单事件不确定完整年度繁殖日历、饲养方法可重复性、典型卵数或冷条件不繁殖。创始于 2016 年二月采 Analamazaotra，以形态鉴定、无遗传验证。十一种研究中的较广季节关联不是 bottae 独立温度触发实验。
development
Feeding larvae in filtered aquarium conditions
过滤水族箱条件中的摄食幼体

The study classified bottae tadpoles as externally feeding and supplied a prepared food mixture. Its stream-breeding Boophis larvae were maintained in filtered glass aquaria; water typically ranged 16–22 °C seasonally. These are captive-care conditions, not an experimentally determined developmental optimum, critical thermal limit or measured stream temperature across the wild range. name: Guibemantis ambakoana
sections: reproduction

More than half of the maintained ambakoana egg masses were found on the terrarium floor under leaf litter rather than on the supplied plants. All but one mass were infertile; the single fertile clutch was laid in a plastic artificial bromeliad’s leaf axil. A few infertile masses occurred during June–September. These observations do not demonstrate successful year-round reproduction, a natural preference for plastic plants or a survival rate for the whole species. The authors suggested that the offered enclosure structures may not have provided adequate laying sites, rather than experimentally identifying the cause of infertility.

name: Guibemantis pulcher

A founder egg mass and one infertile captive spawning are different records

The founder count is not the size of the later captive mass or a mean clutch size. The one infertile event is not a successful captive generation, proof of sterility across the species or an annual breeding-frequency estimate.

Artificial oviposition-site use does not replace Pandanus ecology

A captive glass-bottom event does not establish a wild terrestrial-breeding mode, habitual avoidance of Pandanus or a measured substrate preference. name: Heterixalus betsileo
sections: reproduction
One fertile spawning after introduction of a rain chamber

After six years without breeding success, staff placed the maintained betsileo in a rain chamber and soon recorded fertile eggs. This was the species’ single spawning event in the reported study, during the warm rainy season, with eggs deposited in water. The sequence supports a possible response to added environmental cues but is not a randomized isolation of rainfall effects or proof that wild breeding always requires artificial rain. The later discussion misspells the name as bestileo; the maintained-species account and pinned reader remain betsileo, without creating a separate taxon.

development
Feeding larvae and the limits of captive-care evidence
摄食幼体及饲养照护证据限制

The study classified betsileo tadpoles as exotrophic and supplied an external food mixture. The general care paragraph reports seasonally varying water typically at 16–22 °C and regular water changes, but does not independently supply a betsileo-specific thermal optimum or minimum metamorphic interval. The one fertile spawning cannot establish repeatable annual production or survival of all offspring. Founder identification was morphological only; the captive observations remain a useful breeding record with unverified genetic concept equivalence, rather than a complete life-history account across the natural range.

name: Mantidactylus betsileanus
sections: reproduction
Year-round captive breeding with possible female misidentification
可能雌误鉴的全年饲养繁殖

Frogs maintained as betsileanus bred in every month and contributed 86.7% of all recorded egg masses in the eleven-species study. Most eggs were laid on land beneath refugia. This pooled share is not a fecundity rate per female or a natural abundance estimate. The authors explicitly warned that some captive females could have been katae, because separation relied on femoral gland size and call and the founders lacked genetic verification. The breeding record remains assigned to the maintained label, not a certified species-pure colony or equivalent evidence of year-round katae reproduction.
作为 betsileanus 维持的蛙每月均繁殖，占十一种研究记录卵窝的 86.7%；多数卵产掩体下陆地。合计份额不是每雌繁殖力率或自然丰度估计。作者明确警告部分饲养雌可能为 katae，因为区分依股腺大小及鸣声，且创始无遗传验证。繁殖记录归维持标签，不是认证纯种群，也不等价证明 katae 全年繁殖。

Long development and explicit exclusions from the summary

Most retained betsileanus tadpoles completed metamorphosis in less than four months, while some required nearly 300 days. The authors excluded tadpoles from a pilot captive-diet study in which several took more than a year, and also excluded ten infertile masses below eight eggs from clutch summaries because they might be remnants of earlier spawning. Those exclusions delimit the reported distributions; they do not prove that longer development or smaller apparent counts are biologically impossible. The tadpoles received external food, and the observed timings are conditional on captive treatment and uncertain founder identity, not a species-wide field schedule.

Four Ha Giang vouchers and condition-dependent nuptial spines

The Ha Giang comparison examined two males with SVL 33.2–33.6 mm and two females at 42.2–43.8 mm. The males were smaller than the original diagnostic male range, showing why a description’s sample bounds should not be treated as universal limits. The local vouchers had expanded digital discs, unwebbed fingers, fully webbed toes, vomerine teeth and no dorsolateral folds. Male nuptial-pad spines were less distinct than in the Chinese type series; the authors suggested different sampling months, August versus June, as a possible explanation rather than a demonstrated seasonal mechanism. Live olive-brown dorsal colours were recorded separately from ethanol-preserved material.

A dated addition in Ha Giang rather than a complete range

The May 2023 paper reported the species’ first Ha Giang provincial record from an August 2022 survey in Lung Vai Village, Phuong Do Commune, Tay Con Linh Nature Reserve. It cited earlier Vietnamese records in Lao Cai, Cao Bang and Vinh Phuc and southern Chinese records. This establishes the study’s named locality addition, not continuous occupation between provinces, every present locality or a current range boundary. “First record” concerns documentation in the paper rather than a demonstrated arrival in 2022 or range expansion measured through repeated occupancy surveys.

Prey dimensions retain inconsistent printed ranges
猎物尺寸保留不一致印刷范围

The combined-sex diet paragraph gives prey width 1.00–40.00 mm, while its following sex-specific paragraph gives males 0.40–10.00 mm and females 0.40–7.00 mm. The combined range therefore conflicts with the sex-specific bounds and is not silently corrected or used as a species feeding limit. Prey volume was estimated as a prolate spheroid from measured length and width, rather than direct displacement or energetic intake. Reported comparisons between sexes apply to this one August sample; diet-size correlations do not establish active choice independent of available prey or a universal maximum gape.
合并性别食谱段给猎物宽 1.00—40.00 毫米，随后分性别段给雄 0.40—10.00、雌 0.40—7.00 毫米。合并范围与分性别边界冲突，不静默修正或作物种摄食极限。猎物体积由实测长宽按长旋转椭球估计，不是直接排水或能量摄入。性别比较限定此次八月样本；食物大小相关不确定独立于可得猎物的主动选择或普遍最大口裂。

Diet-category totals and diversity formula require caution
食谱类别总数及多样性公式需要谨慎

One results paragraph reports sixteen male and nineteen female prey categories, while the next gives twenty-four and twenty-six respectively. The account supplies no reconciled category hierarchy, so these are not merged into an invented species-specific total. It reports greater than 65% dietary overlap between sexes, which is an index rather than the proportion of identical meals. The printed Simpson calculation includes a leading negative sign while reporting positive reciprocal diversity; no reconstructed corrected index is presented here. These numerical issues leave the observed prey records useful but restrict quantitative comparisons beyond the original sample.

sections: reproduction
Two inferred population breeding windows at one cave
一洞穴种群的两个推定繁殖窗口

The 2026 study combined twenty-nine fortnightly surveys from April 2024 to June 2025 in Hwanseongul Cave with water eDNA analysis. Breeding adults, including females with visible eggs and females without visible eggs interpreted as post-oviposition, emerged mainly in late spring and early winter. Together with egg observations and DNA signals, the authors inferred population breeding windows in April–June and November–December. This is a site- and period-specific synthesis; it does not prove that every koreanus population follows identical months, that all eDNA peaks mark spawning, or that the same female breeds twice annually. Females were classified from appearance rather than continuously observed through each laying event.

2026 年研究结合 Hwanseongul 洞 2024 年四月至 2025 年六月二十九次两周间隔调查及水 eDNA 分析。繁殖成体包括可见卵雌及无可见卵、解释为产后雌，主要于晚春和初冬出现。连同卵观察及 DNA 信号，作者推定种群繁殖窗口四月至六月、十一月至十二月。这是地点及期间限定综合，不证明每个 koreanus 种群月份相同、所有 eDNA 峰代表产卵或同一雌每年两次繁殖。雌依外观分类，非逐次连续观察排卵。
reproduction
Winter clutches and a differing July visit date
冬季卵窝及不同七月访问日期

On 23 December 2024 researchers found three clutches, one unfertilized; the other two contained fifteen and fourteen eggs split between paired sacs. The eggs hatched on 2 May 2025. The results report 110 clutches on 28 July 2025, whereas the methods date the extra egg-check visit to 29 July; that date conflict remains unresolved. Ten examined summer clutches had mean ± SD 16.6 ± 1.1 eggs, range 15–18, rather than a count applicable to every recorded clutch. Neither two winter clutches nor the summer subsample defines a species-wide clutch-size limit, female annual output or survival of every embryo.
2024 年十二月二十三日发现三窝，一未受精；另外两窝分别十五及十四卵，分于成对卵囊。卵于 2025 年五月二日孵化。结果报告 2025 年七月二十八日 110 窝，方法却将额外查卵访问定为七月二十九日，日期冲突未解决。十个检查夏窝均值±标准差 16.6±1.1 卵，范围 15—18，不适用于每个记录窝。两冬窝及夏子样本不定义全种窝卵极限、雌年度产量或每胚存活。
evolution
Individual seasonal participation and isolation remain open questions
个体季节参与及隔离仍为未解决问题

The authors distinguished two population breeding seasons from the untested possibility that one female reproduces in both. They considered repeated annual spawning by the same female unlikely on energetic and egg-development grounds, but did not mark and follow females to test that prediction. Proposed nutritional and temperature windows, or genetic differentiation between seasonal breeders, were explanations for future work. The reported seasonal pattern therefore does not establish two reproductively isolated lineages, sympatric speciation, a measured recovery interval or an individual female’s lifelong schedule.
作者将两个种群繁殖季与未测同一雌参与两季的可能分开。依据能量及卵发育认为同雌年内重复产卵不太可能，但未标记追踪雌检验预测。所提营养和温度窗口，或季节繁殖者间遗传分化，是未来研究解释。因此季节模式不确定两个生殖隔离谱系、同域成种、实测恢复间隔或个雌终身日程。
ecology
Water DNA signals are conditional indicators rather than animal counts
水 DNA 信号是有条件指标而非动物计数

The cave-outlet sampling site had more eDNA detections than the upstream sampling point. Only upstream DNA quantity correlated significantly with observed breeding adults; it did not significantly correlate with larval counts. Larvae remained present during some summer visits without positive DNA detection. Later winter peaks occurred without observed adults, and decomposition of sixteen dead larvae was discussed as a possible contribution. Site hydrology, DNA shedding and degradation can therefore affect the signal. Copies per microlitre, sample-positive proportions and PCR replicate counts are not interchangeable population densities, and nondetection is not demonstrated absence.

The 2020 description associated giorgii with a shagreen dorsum, basal toe webbing and digital fringes, a discoidal fold, and a belly usually smooth centrally but granular laterally. Forest fragments and seasonal calling positions

During the rainy season males were described calling from vegetation at about two metres height; in the dry season frogs were found in leaf litter. These are dated locality and seasonal observations, not a complete current range, a measured optimum calling height or proof that disturbed fragments provide equivalent survival to intact forest. Calling activity does not independently document egg substrates, clutch size or the full reproductive calendar.

Four to five pulsed notes with an overlapping diagnostic range

远离已知繁殖渗泉的落叶遭遇

Several Balease individuals were collected hundreds of metres from the identified breeding seep in open forest leaf litter. That seep flowed for roughly fifty metres before disappearing, with no known continuous stream within 1.5 km. Other breeding records involved leaves or mossy rocks over slow water, but some attended nests were beside a wider faster stream or a nearly still pool. The authors inferred a largely terrestrial ecomorph and concern over mature lowland forest scarcity; these observations do not quantify competition, prey use, survival in villages or strict avoidance of every larger stream. Different-quality known sites remain exceptions to a simple pristine-only claim.
若干 Balease 个体于开阔林落叶采得，距确认繁殖渗泉数百米。泉流约五十米后消失，1.5 千米内无已知连续溪。其他繁殖记录为缓水上叶或苔石，但部分留守巢在较宽快溪旁或近静池。作者推主要陆地生态形态并担忧成熟低地林稀少；观察不量化竞争、猎物使用、村落存活或严格避每条大溪。不同质量已知点保持例外，不能简单只称原始林。
behavior
Sixteen calls from three males rather than sixteen independent animals
三雄十六鸣声而非十六独立动物

Sixteen phyllofolia calls from three males were analysed. Calls were rapid clicks with 11–54 notes, duration 0.596–2.86 seconds and pulse rate 16.78–19.44 notes per second. Dominant frequency ranged 1,142.70–2,818.89 Hz. Duration and frequency overlap the arathooni comparison, while the sampled note counts and pulse rates were more distinct; no single frequency threshold is supplied as a universal key. Repeated calls from a male are not separate animals, and multivariate differences in this small recording sample do not demonstrate female preference, mate rejection or all-population acoustic invariance.
分析三只 phyllofolia 雄的十六鸣声，快速点击声，11—54 音符、时长 0.596—2.86 秒、脉冲率每秒 16.78—19.44 音符，主频 1,142.70—2,818.89 赫兹。时长及频率与 arathooni 比较重叠，所采音符数和脉冲率较分明；不提供单频阈值为普遍检索表。雄重复鸣声不是不同动物，小录音样本多变量差异不证明雌偏好、配偶拒绝或全部种群声学不变。

name: Limnonectes arathooni
sections: morphology
Overlapping body sizes in a syntopic comparison
同地比较中重叠的体长

The phyllofolia study reported arathooni in syntopy at Bontomaranu and gave its comparison SVL range 29.47–44.3 mm, average 35.23. This overlaps the upper end of the phyllofolia sample, which reached 30.13 mm, so size alone cannot reliably separate every animal. Multivariate morphological differences supported the study’s comparison but are not a complete field key or a guarantee for unsampled populations. Reduced webbing and a postorbital groove were attributed to both species in cited descriptions and should not be treated as uniquely phyllofolia characters.
phyllofolia 研究报告 arathooni 于 Bontomaranu 同地，比较吻肛长 29.47—44.3 毫米、平均 35.23。与 phyllofolia 至 30.13 毫米样本上端重叠，不能仅体长可靠分每动物。多变量形态差异支持研究比较，不是完整野外检索或未采种群保证。减蹼及眼后沟在引用描述归两种，不能视仅 phyllofolia 性状。
behavior
Ten chirping calls from five males
五雄十个啁啾鸣声

The study analysed ten arathooni advertisement calls from five males, including one non-vouchered animal. Calls contained 2–7 notes, lasted 0.355–3.537 seconds and had pulse rates 0.57–6.13 notes per second. Their high-pitched chirping differed from the sampled phyllofolia clicks, but dominant-frequency ranges overlapped: arathooni was 1,751.40–2,813.67 Hz. These are recording-sample statistics, not species-wide bounds or experimentally tested recognition cues. Ten calls do not represent ten independent males, and the non-vouchered record retains a different identity-evidence level.
研究分析五只 arathooni 雄的十个广告鸣声，含一无凭证动物。2—7 音符、0.355—3.537 秒、脉冲率每秒 0.57—6.13 音符。高调啁啾与所采 phyllofolia 点击声不同，但主频重叠，arathooni 为 1,751.40—2,813.67 赫兹。为录音样本统计，不是全种边界或实验检验识别线索。十鸣声不代表十独立雄，无凭证记录保持不同身份依据等级。

name: Limnonectes microtympanum
sections: evolution
Syntopy and one mitochondrial comparison
同地及一线粒体比较

The study recorded microtympanum with phyllofolia at Bontomaranu and Bontosiri; arathooni was also collected at Bontomaranu. In a 510-bp mitochondrial 16S comparison it reported minimum pairwise distances of 3.85% between microtympanum and arathooni and 6.9% between microtympanum and phyllofolia. These are marker- and sample-specific minima, not genome-wide distances, divergence dates or universal species cutoffs. Shared collection sites do not establish identical microhabitats, competition or absence of hybridization. The study’s phyllofolia nesting observations are not transferred to microtympanum.

研究于 Bontomaranu、Bontosiri 共记 microtympanum 与 phyllofolia，Bontomaranu 亦采 arathooni。510 碱基线粒体 16S 比较报告 microtympanum—arathooni 最小成对距离 3.85%，microtympanum—phyllofolia 6.9%。是标记及样本特定最小值，不是全基因组距离、分化年代或普遍物种阈值。同采点不确定同微生境、竞争或无杂交。研究 phyllofolia 营巢观察不转给 microtympanum。

sections: ecology
A two-season invasive-population diet study
两季入侵种群食谱研究

Researchers sampled tigerinus at three Andaman sites from February to July 2017 across agriculture, plantation, logged forest and less-disturbed forest plots. Sampling covered subadults and adults, not newly metamorphosed frogs; stomachs were flushed after evening capture and recaptures were marked. Pooled comparator identities were limited to Limnonectes and Fejervarya genera because taxonomy was unresolved. Those pooled prey or diet results are not assigned here to individual accepted species. The sites had established invasions, so the sample does not describe initial colonization or the full native-range diet.
研究者于 2017 年二月至七月在安达曼三点采 tigerinus，涉农业、种植、伐林及较少受扰林样方。采样亚成体和成体，不含新变态蛙；傍晚捕后洗胃，重捕有标记。因分类未解决，合并比较身份限 Limnonectes 和 Fejervarya 属，不将合并猎物或食谱结果赋各接受物种。地点入侵已建立，样本不描述初殖或完整原生范围食谱。
ecology
Prey-number and prey-volume proportions differ
猎物数与猎物体积比例不同

The tigerinus sample contained 687 recovered prey items across twenty-nine taxonomic categories. Vertebrates accounted for 2.62% by number but 58.03% of estimated prey volume, demonstrating why the two metrics must be distinguished. Coleoptera and Orthoptera were prominent by the study’s relative-importance index. Volumes were modelled from prey dimensions; fragmented items lacking measurements received an order-level median volume. These are local sampled diet estimates, not daily energy intake, a constant vertebrate percentage throughout the species or a direct measure of prey-population losses.
tigerinus 样本含二十九分类类别的 687 项回收猎物。脊椎猎物按数占 2.62%，按估计猎物体积 58.03%，需区分两指标。研究相对重要性指数中鞘翅目和直翅目突出。体积由尺寸模型得，缺测碎片赋同目中位体积。为地方样本食谱估计，不是每日能量摄入、全物种恒定脊椎比例或猎物种群损失直接测量。
ecology
Consumed vertebrates establish predation records rather than demographic impact
所食脊椎动物确定捕食记录而非种群影响

Recovered prey included amphibians, reptiles and a rodent, with several Andaman-endemic prey labels. The results documented four Limnonectes and two frogs identified as Microhyla chakrapani, among other vertebrates. Limnonectes identity stayed genus-level, and the Microhyla spelling requires reconciliation with the pinned catalogue before a canonical prey-species assignment. These records demonstrate sampled consumption, not a quantified decline, extinction probability or stable trophic position. Poultry and stream-fish accounts discussed elsewhere were attributed reports rather than these recovered stomach observations.
回收猎物含两栖、爬行和一啮齿动物，若干标签属安达曼特有。结果记录四 Limnonectes、二只鉴定为 Microhyla chakrapani 的蛙及其他脊椎动物。Limnonectes 保持属级，Microhyla 拼写需与固定目录协调后才赋标准猎物物种。这证明采样摄食，不量化下降、灭绝概率或稳定营养位置。另讨论的家禽和溪鱼账户为归属报告，不是这些回收胃观察。
ecology
High overlap is potential competition under limited resources
高重叠是资源受限下的潜在竞争

The results gave tigerinus–Limnonectes dietary overlap Ojk = 0.87, while the discussion described 86%; this small reporting difference is retained. Overlap with Fejervarya was not significant in the null-model comparison. The authors proposed possible competition when prey is limited but did not measure reductions in growth, survival or population size caused by the invader. Newly metamorphosed tigerinus were not sampled, so suggested juvenile competition is extrapolation rather than observed juvenile diet. Overlap does not by itself prove competition or ecological equivalence.
结果给 tigerinus—Limnonectes 食谱重叠 Ojk=0.87，讨论称 86%，保留小报告差异。与 Fejervarya 的重叠在零模型比较不显著。作者提出猎物受限时可能竞争，未测入侵者导致生长、存活或种群量降低。新变态 tigerinus 未采，所提幼体竞争为外推而非观察幼体食谱。重叠本身不证明竞争或生态等价。
behavior
Electivity and an inferred ambush strategy have sampling limits
选择性及推定伏击策略有采样限制

Prey electivity compared consumed terrestrial invertebrates with pitfall catches, excluding flying evasive insects and vertebrates from availability estimates. Tigerinus electivity analyses were restricted to agriculture and plantations and adequately sampled prey categories. The authors inferred mostly ambush foraging from evasive prey in the diet, rather than tracking every capture sequence. Positive associations of predator size and prey volume do not establish active choice for all prey types, and pitfalls can overrepresent social insects. The inferred strategy is not a measured fixed behavioural repertoire across habitats.
猎物选择性比较所食陆地无脊椎与陷阱捕获，可得量估计排飞行逃逸昆虫及脊椎。tigerinus 选择性分析限农业和种植地及足够样本猎物类别。作者由食谱逃逸猎物推主要伏击觅食，非追踪每次捕获。捕食者体型和猎物体积正关联不确定全部猎物类型主动选择，陷阱可高估社会昆虫。推策略不是各生境实测固定行为谱。
conservation
Historical introduction pathways and prospective impact
历史引入路径及前瞻影响

The 2018 paper cited early-2000s introduction to the Andamans and expansion from 2009, with fish-culture contaminants and deliberate releases proposed as pathways. These dated attributed histories are not verified current island occupancy or a new reconstruction of every transfer. Its recovered diet supports concern about predation, while demographic effects and trophic-level consequences were not evaluated. Predictions for Madagascar were extrapolations from the Andaman sample, not Malagasy stomach analyses. A reported pathway, confirmed consumption and measured population-level impact represent different evidence levels.
2018 年论文引述安达曼 2000 年代初引入及自 2009 年扩张，提出鱼养殖夹带和故意释放为路径。有年代归属史不是核实当前各岛占据或每次转移新重建。回收食谱支持捕食担忧，但未评种群效应及营养级后果。对马达加斯加预测为安达曼样本外推，不是当地胃分析。所报路径、确认摄食和实测种群影响是不同证据等级。
title: What’s for dinner? Diet and potential trophic impact of an invasive anuran Hoplobatrachus tigerinus on the Andaman archipelago

Four sampled toads were excluded from the diet comparisons
四只受采蟾被排除食谱比较

The Andaman study captured four toads labelled Duttaphrynus melanostictus but excluded them from the comparative diet analysis because sample size was inadequate. The methods explicitly called their taxonomic and geographic status uncertain. sections: morphology
A small frog diagnosed from several characters together
结合多项特征鉴别的小型蛙

The description measured sixteen males at 17.3–20.1 mm snout–vent length and six females at 23.2–26.5 mm. These type-series ranges describe the measured sample rather than absolute species limits. The diagnosis combines finely roughened dorsal skin, a weakly areolate belly, eyelid tubercles, no heel tubercle or tarsal fold, and a visible tympanum whose membrane is poorly differentiated and annulus only partly visible. Fingers lack lateral fringes, whereas toes III–V have fringes and toes IV–V have basal webbing. Males have vocal slits and a small subgular vocal sac but lack nuptial pads. Identification depends on this combination and comparison with similar species; size or a single colour alone is insufficient.

描述研究测量了十六只雄蛙和六只雌蛙：吻肛长分别为 17.3–20.1 毫米和 23.2–26.5 毫米。这些范围代表所测模式系列，不能当作整个物种的绝对体长界限。鉴别特征包括细密粗糙的背部皮肤、轻度呈网格状的腹面、眼睑结节，以及缺少足跟结节和跗褶。鼓膜可见，但膜的边界不鲜明，鼓环仅部分可见。手指没有侧缘，第三至第五足趾有侧缘，第四与第五趾之间有基部蹼。雄蛙有声裂和小型喉下声囊，但没有婚垫。辨识应结合上述特征并与相似物种比较，不能仅依赖体长或一种颜色。
appearance
Live colour and preserved patterns are different observations
活体体色与保存标本花纹须分别理解

Live frogs ranged from ochre and orange to brown, with dorsal stripes present in some individuals and absent in others. The iris was dichromatic, with pale bronze portions and a mahogany-red median stripe; the lower iris varied among specimens. In the preserved series, irregular dark marks, sharply outlined marks and dark stripes were reported at 68%, 9% and 23%, respectively. Those frequencies concern the studied series, not regional prevalence. Groin and ventral skin appeared darker by day with expanded melanophores and much paler, sometimes almost white, at night. The authors also suggested activity-related variation in skin texture. Neither observation was a controlled experiment demonstrating camouflage function or its physiological mechanism.

活体背色从赭黄、橙色到褐色不等，部分个体有背部条纹，其他个体没有。虹膜呈双色，上下部分带淡青铜色，中间有红褐色横带，下半部的颜色在个体间有所变化。保存标本中，不规则深色斑、边缘清晰的斑和深色条纹分别占 68%、9% 和 23%；这些比例仅适用于研究系列，不代表各地种群的普遍频率。白天腹股沟与腹面随黑色素细胞扩展而较暗，夜间较浅，有时近乎白色。作者还提出皮肤粗糙程度可能随活动状态改变。这些观察没有通过控制实验确定伪装功能或其生理机制。
distribution
Records from two white-sand forest localities
两个白沙林地点的分布记录

The study recorded campinarana at two localities in Iranduba, Amazonas, Brazil, in primary or slightly modified white-sand forest. All observed individuals occurred in campinarana, with canopy below twenty metres; none was found in campina, the more open vegetation with canopy below ten metres and exposed white-sand patches. Locally abundant was a qualitative field description, not a measured density. The authors proposed endemism to the Negro–Solimões interfluve and restriction to white-sand ecosystems because surveys elsewhere had not detected it. This is a geographic hypothesis from available records and non-detections, rather than a complete occupancy survey or a certified boundary for the species.

研究在巴西亚马孙州 Iranduba 的两个地点记录到 campinarana，生境为原生或受到轻度改变的白沙林。所见个体均位于冠层低于二十米的 campinarana 林中；在更开阔、冠层低于十米并有裸露白沙斑块的 campina 植被中没有发现。论文所称当地数量多是定性的野外描述，并非实测密度。依据现有记录和其他调查的未检出结果，作者提出它可能是 Negro–Solimões 河间地区的特有种，且局限于白沙生态系统。这仍是分布假说，不能视为完整占据调查或已经确定的物种分布边界。
reproduction
Rainy-season calling and amplexus, with eggs still unobserved
雨季鸣叫与抱对已有观察，野外卵团仍未发现

Frogs were mainly crepuscular and nocturnal. Calling was observed during the November–February rainy season, usually starting around 18:00, intense until 20:00 and declining by about 22:00, although rainy nights could sustain calling throughout the night. Males generally called around one metre above ground and rarely above three metres; aggregations sometimes contained up to ten callers. Dry-season shelter among terrestrial Guzmania bromeliad leaves was not evidence that eggs were laid there. Three axillary amplexus observations were reported. Four females contained about fourteen to seventeen large oocytes, but no egg clutch was found in situ. Oocyte counts therefore cannot be presented as observed laid-clutch sizes, and the article does not establish a natural egg substrate or nest survival rate.

这些蛙主要在晨昏和夜间活动。十一月至二月的雨季观察到鸣叫，通常约十八时开始，至二十时较活跃，约二十二时逐渐减少；有雨的夜晚可以持续鸣叫。雄蛙通常在离地约一米处鸣叫，很少超过三米，鸣叫聚集有时可达十只。旱季在陆生 Guzmania 凤梨叶间藏身，并不能证明那里是产卵基质。研究报告了三次腋式抱对；四只雌蛙体内各有约十四至十七枚较大的卵母细胞，但没有在野外找到卵团。因此，卵母细胞数量不能写成已观察到的实际每窝产卵数，论文也未确定天然产卵位置或卵团存活率。
behavior
Advertisement calls sampled from nine males
来自九只雄蛙的广告鸣声样本

The acoustic description used twenty-six calls from nine males, so calls are repeated observations rather than twenty-six independent frogs. Calls contained five to ten notes, most often six to eight, and lasted 550–1,061 ms, with mean 694 ms and standard deviation 115 ms. Dominant frequency ranged from 3,295 to 3,919 Hz, with mean 3,587 Hz and standard deviation 204 Hz. The table explicitly defines the reported dispersion as standard deviation. Analyses followed a call-centred approach; inter-call intervals were not measured because microclimate could affect them, and minimum/maximum spectral frequencies were defined relative to the peak. These measurements characterize the sampled advertisement calls, not all vocal behaviours, an invariant species-wide frequency or a demonstrated mate-recognition threshold.

声学描述采用九只雄蛙的二十六次鸣声，因此二十六次记录不是二十六只独立个体。每次鸣声含五至十个音符，最常见为六至八个；持续时间为 550–1,061 毫秒，平均 694 毫秒，标准差 115 毫秒。主频为 3,295–3,919 赫兹，平均 3,587 赫兹，标准差 204 赫兹。表格明确将离散程度定义为标准差。分析以单次鸣声为单位，因微气候可能影响鸣叫间隔而没有测量该间隔，频谱上下界则按相对于峰值的阈值定义。这些数值描述所采广告鸣声，不代表全部发声行为、全物种恒定频率或已经验证的配偶识别阈值。
evolution
Sequence relationships and a tentative west-to-east history
序列亲缘关系与尚待检验的由西向东扩散历史

The phylogenetic work combined mitochondrial 16S and COI with the nuclear marker RAG1; it was not a mitochondrial-only analysis. Campinarana grouped in a strongly supported clade containing matidiktyo and ockendeni, sister to delius plus librarius. Within the sampled campinarana population, mean 16S p-distance was 0.2%, with maximum 0.4%. Mean interspecific distances of 6.1–11.2% were reported across the examined group, not as a universal delimitation threshold or a separate campinarana estimate for every pair. The discussion proposed west-to-east dispersal and changing river barriers, while considering alternative river-crossing explanations. These hypotheses are not a dated reconstruction of a uniquely demonstrated dispersal route, and the sequence tree does not itself certify absence of gene flow.

系统发育研究结合了线粒体 16S、COI 和核基因标记 RAG1，并非仅使用线粒体数据。campinarana 位于一个支持度较高、包含 matidiktyo 与 ockendeni 的支系中，该支系与 delius 加 librarius 互为姐妹群。所采 campinarana 种群内，16S 未校正距离平均为 0.2%，最大为 0.4%。研究群内报告的物种间平均距离为 6.1–11.2%；这个范围不是通用的物种划分阈值，也不是 campinarana 与每个比较种分别计算的距离。讨论提出了由西向东扩散以及河流屏障变化的解释，同时考虑跨河扩散等其他可能。它们仍是待检验的历史假说，不能写成唯一确定且已经定年的迁移路线；序列树本身也不能证明不存在基因流。
conservation
Data Deficient was a proposal based on incomplete knowledge
资料缺乏是基于知识不足提出的评估建议

The authors recommended Data Deficient because the full geographic range and population trends were insufficiently known. That recommendation in a 2023 description is not independent verification of a current IUCN assessment. They emphasized the distinctive white-sand ecosystems in which the species was found and the need to conserve them. Two known localities and qualitative local abundance do not establish a stable total population, secure future habitat or a quantified extinction risk. The proposed habitat restriction remains subject to further surveys, and neither unobserved sites nor potentially suitable forest should automatically be added as confirmed occurrences.
由于完整分布和种群趋势尚不清楚，作者建议按“资料缺乏”处理。这是 2023 年描述论文的建议，不能当作对现行 IUCN 评估结果的独立核实。论文强调已发现该蛙的白沙生态系统具有独特性，需要保护。仅有两个已知地点和定性的当地数量描述，无法确定总种群稳定、未来生境安全或量化灭绝风险。它是否严格局限于该类生境仍需进一步调查；未观察到的地点和潜在适宜林地也不能直接增加为确认分布记录。
title: A new species of Pristimantis (Anura: Strabomantidae) from white-sand forests of central Amazonia, Brazil

name: Odorrana splendida
readScope: Odorrana splendida: Study-species background explicitly attributed to earlier literature; stream field design, qPCR detection, discharge-adjusted flux, seasonal and abundance results, discussion limitations and numerical discrepancy; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sectionLocators: PMC6366209 reading-sections section 0 paragraph 2; section 1 paragraph 0
PMC6366209 XML s2b paragraphs 0–2; reading-sections section 2 paragraphs 1–3; section 3 paragraph 0; XML s4 paragraph 1
PMC6366209 XML s2b paragraph 2; s2d paragraph 0; reading-sections section 3 paragraph 2; XML s4 paragraphs 2–3
