sections: development
A stream larva with a potentially long development period
幼体生活于溪流，发育期可以较长

The 2019 study targeted the tadpoles of splendida, described as endemic to Amami-Oshima Island, Japan. Its study-species background cited earlier work for February–April breeding, eggs placed in rock crevices or water flowing beneath rocky headstreams, larval periods sometimes exceeding two years, and metamorphosis from late June to early September. It also cited tadpoles reaching about 1.85 cm snout–vent length and approximately one gram wet mass. These are attributed background records, not new longitudinal measurements made by this eDNA project, and they do not mean every individual takes more than two years or metamorphoses on identical dates. Snout–vent length excludes the tail; the cited local density and dispersal estimates cannot be generalized to every stream.

2019 年研究以 splendida 的蝌蚪为对象，文中将其描述为日本奄美大岛特有蛙。物种背景引述先前文献：繁殖期为二月至四月，卵产于岩石缝隙或岩石溪源地下流动的水中；幼体期有时超过两年，变态发生在六月下旬至九月上旬。背景还引述蝌蚪吻肛长可达约 1.85 厘米，湿重约一克。这些是明确归属于早期文献的记录，并非本次环境 DNA 项目新完成的个体长期追踪，也不表示每只蝌蚪都发育超过两年或在相同日期变态。吻肛长不包含尾部；引述的局部密度和扩散估计也不能推广到所有溪流。
ecology
Detection in known occupied streams can still miss tadpoles
已知有蝌蚪的溪流也可能未检出环境 DNA

Researchers collected fifty-three water samples at ten previously known occupied headwater streams in 2015 and 2017. Environmental DNA was detected in forty-two samples, or 79.2%, while visual searches within ten metres upstream detected tadpoles in forty-nine samples, or 92.5%. Each water sample had eight qPCR replicates; any positive well made the sample positive. These denominators are samples, not independent populations or an island-wide occupancy estimate. Controls were negative, but a negative environmental sample did not prove absence: thirty tadpoles were counted in one pool without a positive DNA result. The discussion states 22.6% negatives, which differs from eleven out of fifty-three (20.8%) implied by the results; the discrepancy is retained rather than silently corrected in the source account.

研究者于 2015 年和 2017 年，在十条先前已确认有蝌蚪的溪源采集五十三份水样。四十二份检出环境 DNA，检测率为 79.2%；在采样点上游十米内的目视搜索则有四十九次发现蝌蚪，占 92.5%。每份水样进行了八次 qPCR 重复，只要一个反应孔为阳性，该水样就判为阳性。分母是采样次数，不是独立种群数，也不是全岛占据比例。各项对照未出现阳性，但环境水样阴性不能证明物种不存在：一次在同一水潭数到三十只蝌蚪，仍未检出 DNA。讨论写阴性占 22.6%，而结果四十二份阳性对应的十一份阴性占 20.8%；这里保留报告差异，不替论文悄悄统一数值。
ecology
DNA flux correlates with abundance but is not a reliable head count
DNA 通量与数量有关，但不能可靠换算个体数

The study multiplied DNA concentration in copies per litre by stream discharge in litres per second to obtain flux in copies per second. This differs from concentration alone. Combined-site regressions were positive, with r-squared 0.32 for tadpole abundance and 0.29 for estimated biomass, yet the authors concluded that their sampling regime did not accurately estimate abundance. Counts concerned the ten metres upstream; biomass was inferred from photographed snout–vent lengths using an allometric equation based on an earlier, unpublished set of 468 tadpoles, rather than weighing every animal. Similar counts could produce very different fluxes among streams and dates. DNA transport, retention and uneven sampling therefore prevent a universal conversion from a positive signal or a copy number to local frog density.

研究将每升水的 DNA 拷贝浓度乘以每秒流过的水量，得到每秒拷贝数表示的通量，它与浓度本身是不同指标。合并地点的回归关系为正，蝌蚪数量和估计生物量对应的决定系数分别为 0.32 和 0.29，但作者仍认为该采样方案不能准确估计数量。计数范围是采样点上游十米；生物量根据照片中的吻肛长和一组先前未发表的 468 只蝌蚪数据所建立的异速生长公式推算，并非逐只称重。相近的蝌蚪数量在不同溪流或日期可对应明显不同的 DNA 通量。运输、滞留和分布不均使阳性信号或拷贝数无法通过通用比例换算为当地蛙密度。
conservation
Seasonal signal and sampling improvements need local interpretation
季节信号与采样改进需要结合地点解释

Among seven streams used for seasonal comparison, peak DNA flux occurred in May at two sites, July at one and August at four. Sampling was uneven because time constraints and heavy rain prevented access, so the pattern is not a synchronized island-wide reproductive peak or evidence that populations rose and fell in proportion to DNA. The paper suggested greater water volume or more subsamples to improve detection and estimation, while explicitly requiring further validation. A four-sample inhibition check supported low inhibition in those tested samples, not proof that every negative sample was inhibition-free. Habitat degradation and introduced-predator concerns and the Endangered label were cited in the 2019 introduction; this study did not independently reassess current conservation status or quantify predator-caused decline.

用于季节比较的七条溪流中，两处 DNA 通量峰值出现在五月，一处在七月，四处在八月。时间限制和大雨造成部分地点无法进入，采样并不均衡，因此这些结果不是全岛同步的繁殖峰，也不能说明种群数量随 DNA 等比例升降。论文提出增加水样体积或子样本数量，以改善检出和估计，但明确要求进一步验证。对四份阴性样本的抑制检查支持这些受检样本抑制较低，不能证明全部阴性水样均不存在抑制。生境退化、引入捕食者的担忧和“濒危”标签来自 2019 年引言中的引述；本研究没有重新评估现行保护等级，也没有量化捕食者造成的种群下降。
title: Efficacy of environmental DNA to detect and quantify stream tadpoles of Odorrana splendida

name: Raorchestes drutaahu
readScope: Raorchestes drutaahu: New-species diagnostic combination, five-specimen variation, call description, two-locality habitat and phylogenetic placement; no independent current conservation assessment; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sectionLocators: PMC7936570 XML sec11 paragraphs 7, 13
PMC7936570 XML sec11 paragraph 15
PMC7936570 XML sec11 paragraph 14; sec7 paragraph 1
PMC7936570 XML sec11 paragraph 6; sec4 paragraphs 0–2
sections: morphology
A variable brown frog identified by a character combination
结合多项特征辨识的褐色小型蛙

The diagnosis gives male snout–vent length of 20–23 mm and a distinct tympanum about half the eye diameter. Brown to straw-coloured dorsal skin carries horny spinules and ridges, paired concave bands, and a pair of irregular black spots near the groin on the posterior back. Flanks and groin lack contrasting colour blotches; the brown iris has a golden tinge and lighter upper versus darker lower halves. Foot webbing is limited. The five measured specimens showed differences in dorsal colour and markings, including faint versus prominent bands. These sample-based features must be combined with comparisons against related species; a brown dorsum alone does not identify drutaahu, and the measured male range is not a complete female or population size distribution.

鉴别描述给出的雄蛙吻肛长为 20–23 毫米，鼓膜清晰，直径约为眼径的一半。背面从褐色到稻草色不等，有角质细刺和嵴、成对的凹弧形带，以及背部后端靠近腹股沟的一对不规则黑斑。体侧和腹股沟没有反差明显的色块；褐色虹膜带金色光泽，上半部较浅，下半部较深，足趾蹼较少。五只测量标本的背色与斑纹有所不同，弧带可以较淡或明显。这些基于样本的特征须结合近缘种比较使用，单凭褐色背面不能确定 drutaahu；雄性测量范围也不是完整的雌性或种群体长分布。
distribution
Two recorded localities on opposite sides of the Palghat gap
Palghat 山口两侧的两个记录地点

The 2021 description reported drutaahu from Kadalar in Idukki district south of the Palghat gap and Siruvani in Palakkad district north of it, at 1,000–1,450 m above sea level. Frogs occurred in forest at grassland–shola edges or fragmented forest patches near plantations and were located on leaves of short shrubs 0.5–1.5 m high. These are recorded localities and perch observations, not a complete range boundary, evidence of continuous occupancy across the gap or an experimental preference for plantation edges. Leaf perches do not establish the egg-laying substrate, clutch size or parental care. The dated description does not independently verify present occupancy or conservation status.

2021 年描述在两个地点记录 drutaahu：Palghat 山口以南 Idukki 区的 Kadalar，以及山口以北 Palakkad 区的 Siruvani，记录海拔为 1,000–1,450 米。个体出现在草地与 shola 山地林交界的森林，或种植园附近的破碎林斑，在离地 0.5–1.5 米的矮灌木叶上被发现。这些是地点和停栖观察，不是完整分布边界，也不证明山口两侧连续占据或对种植园边缘的实验性偏好。叶片上的停栖不能确定产卵基质、每窝卵数或亲代照料。这份有年代的描述也没有独立核实现今占据及保护等级。
behavior
Short calls with closely packed pulses
短促而脉冲紧密的鸣声

The article described one male call type, delivered singly rather than in call groups, with closely packed pulses. Its typical-call summary gives duration 50.6 ms, six pulses, pulse rate 134.5 per second and a mean dominant frequency of 3.6 kHz. Duration, pulse count and pulse rate are distinct measured acoustic properties and should not be recomputed as though every interval were uniform. The authors warn that their summary values do not account for temperature and social-context effects or all within-individual and among-individual variation. This is a described acoustic sample, not proof that additional call types never occur or that every male has an invariant frequency.

论文描述雄蛙的一种鸣声：单次发出，不组成鸣声组，内部脉冲紧密排列。典型鸣声摘要给出持续 50.6 毫秒、六个脉冲、每秒 134.5 个脉冲和平均主频 3.6 千赫兹。持续时间、脉冲数和脉冲速率是不同的声学指标，不能假定所有间隔相等后自行重算。作者明确说明摘要数值未控制温度、社会情境以及全部个体内和个体间变化。这是所描述的鸣声样本，不能证明其他鸣声类型永远不会出现，也不能将频率视为每只雄蛙都恒定不变的特征。
evolution
A supported relationship to coonoorensis
与 coonoorensis 的亲缘关系获得支持

The study placed drutaahu in the charius species group and recovered a well-supported sister relationship with coonoorensis. Reported mitochondrial 16S divergence from coonoorensis was 4.3–5.2%, with different ranges for other group members. The broader phylogenetic analysis combined mitochondrial and nuclear markers, with tRNA-VAL excluded from the final matrix because many downloaded sequences lacked it. Pairwise 16S distances are not the whole multilocus tree and do not supply a universal species threshold, a divergence date or proof of reproductive isolation. The paper used morphology and acoustics alongside sequence evidence for its integrative description.

研究将 drutaahu 放入 charius 物种组，并恢复了支持度较高的、与 coonoorensis 互为姐妹种的关系。两者报告的线粒体 16S 距离为 4.3–5.2%，与组内其他成员的距离范围不同。整体系统发育分析结合线粒体和核基因标记；许多下载序列缺少 tRNA-VAL，因此最终矩阵排除了该片段。成对的 16S 距离不等于整个多标记系统树，也不能提供通用物种阈值、分化年代或生殖隔离的证明。该综合描述同时使用了形态、鸣声和序列证据。
title: An integrative approach to infer systematic relationships and define species groups in the shrub frog genus Raorchestes , with description of five new species from the Western Ghats, India

name: Raorchestes kakkayamensis
readScope: Raorchestes kakkayamensis: Diagnostic morphology and six-specimen variation, single-locality habitat, typical-call properties and sequence relationship; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sectionLocators: PMC7936570 XML sec11 paragraphs 23, 29
PMC7936570 XML sec11 paragraph 31
PMC7936570 XML sec11 paragraph 30; sec7 paragraph 1

sections: morphology
A small species with a male humeral projection
雄性具有肱骨突起的小型蛙

The diagnosis reports males at 17–19 mm snout–vent length and a female value of 24 mm; the female value is not a population range. Males have a knobbed bony humeral projection visible externally in preserved specimens. Contrasting white blotches occur on grey to dark-grey flanks and groin, dorsal skin has horny spinules and ridges, and finger and toe discs are yellowish-brown. Six measured specimens varied from light to dark brown or reddish-brown, while a light triangular snout region was retained. These features diagnose a combination relative to other species, not a claim that the male-specific structure occurs in females or that live and preserved colours are identical.
鉴别描述报告雄蛙吻肛长 17–19 毫米，雌性数值为 24 毫米；单个雌性数值不能当作种群范围。雄性肱骨有瘤状骨突，在保存标本外表可以看见。灰至深灰的体侧和腹股沟带反差明显的白斑，背部皮肤有角质细刺与嵴，指趾端盘呈黄褐色。六只测量标本的体色从浅褐到深褐或红褐色不等，但吻部浅色三角区仍可见。这些特征应组合后与其他物种比较，不能将雄性专属结构赋予雌性，也不能假定活体与保存后的颜色完全相同。
ecology
Leaf litter and elevated vegetation in the same locality
同一地点的落叶层与较高植被记录

At publication, kakkayamensis was known only from Kakkayam in Kozhikode district, Kerala, north of the Palghat gap. Observations at about 750 m elevation came from a primary forest patch and adjoining secondary forest. Individuals were found on ground leaf litter or vegetation 1–3 m high, showing that records were not confined to one perch stratum. The study did not estimate density, quantify preference between forest types or establish a tolerance threshold for disturbance. Its records do not determine natural egg placement or document a new geographic expansion. Only one known locality at that time is not proof that no other population exists.

发表时，kakkayamensis 仅记录于 Kerala 州 Kozhikode 区的 Kakkayam，位于 Palghat 山口以北。约 750 米海拔的观察来自一块原生林及相邻次生林。个体既在地面落叶层出现，也在离地 1–3 米的植被上出现，说明记录不限于单一高度层。研究没有估算密度、量化两类森林间的偏好，或确定能够耐受的干扰阈值。这些记录也不能确定天然产卵位置或说明近期扩张。彼时仅知道一个地点，并不证明其他种群不存在。
behavior
A short, usually single-pulse call
短促、通常只有一个脉冲的鸣声

Males were described as producing one call type, generally with one pulse and not delivered in groups. The typical-call summary gives 25.3 ms duration, 9.2 ms rise time, 15.9 ms fall time and dominant frequency 3.8 kHz. The qualifier generally matters: it does not establish that every call contains exactly one pulse. The study’s acoustic methods acknowledge effects of temperature, social context and individual variation that these summaries do not incorporate. This description supports comparison of sampled call structure, not a playback-demonstrated recognition barrier, a universal frequency or evidence that females share the recorded male call.

论文将雄蛙鸣声描述为一种类型，通常只有一个脉冲，且不组成鸣声组。典型鸣声摘要给出持续时间 25.3 毫秒、上升时间 9.2 毫秒、下降时间 15.9 毫秒和主频 3.8 千赫兹。“通常”这一限定不能省略，它并不确定每次鸣声都恰有一个脉冲。声学方法承认温度、社会情境与个体变化可能影响鸣声，而这些摘要没有纳入全部变化。该描述可用于比较所采鸣声结构，但不是通过回放实验证明的识别屏障、普遍恒定频率或雌性具有相同鸣声的证据。
evolution
Close sequence affinity does not replace the full diagnosis
序列亲缘接近不能替代完整鉴别

Kakkayamensis was assigned to the bombayensis group, with a well-supported sister relationship to leucolatus. Mitochondrial 16S divergence between them was reported at 2.3–2.4%, lower than its reported distances to several other group members. The wider analysis used both mitochondrial and nuclear markers. A smaller distance does not on its own establish synonymy, recent hybridization or a fixed delimitation threshold; the authors also evaluated diagnostic morphology and call structure. The phylogeny is a sampled relationship estimate and does not date speciation or certify contemporary gene flow between the two species.

研究将 kakkayamensis 归入 bombayensis 组，与 leucolatus 的姐妹关系获得较高支持。两者报告的线粒体 16S 距离为 2.3–2.4%，低于它与若干其他组员的报告距离。整体分析同时使用线粒体和核基因标记。较小距离本身不能确定同物异名、近期杂交或固定物种划分阈值；作者还考察了鉴别形态和鸣声结构。系统树是对所采材料亲缘关系的估计，既没有给出物种形成年代，也没有认证两者之间的现行基因流。
title: An integrative approach to infer systematic relationships and define species groups in the shrub frog genus Raorchestes , with description of five new species from the Western Ghats, India

name: Raorchestes keirasabinae

sections: morphology
Webbed digits and limb fringes in a canopy frog
树冠蛙的指趾蹼与肢体皮缘

The diagnosis gives male snout–vent length of 29–31 mm and combines a vertically outlined snout in lateral view, webbed fingers, nearly fully webbed toes and a distinct dermal fringe along the outer margins of forelimbs and hindlimbs. Morphometric information came from three specimens. Dorsal colour and markings were variable, and spinular projections on the back and flanks appeared more prominent in life. The authors suggested that colour change might help camouflage, but this was not a controlled demonstration of adaptive function. Webbing and skin fringes do not by themselves establish gliding performance, swimming ability or a measured female size range.
鉴别描述给出雄性吻肛长 29–31 毫米，组合特征包括侧面近于垂直的吻部轮廓、指间蹼、接近完整的趾蹼，以及前后肢外侧清晰的皮缘。形态测量来自三只标本。背部颜色和斑纹具有变化，背面与体侧的细刺突起在活体中更明显。作者提出颜色变化可能有助于伪装，但没有通过控制实验确认其适应功能。蹼和皮缘本身也不能确定滑翔表现、游泳能力或雌性的测量体长范围。
distribution
Known canopy records south of the Palghat gap
Palghat 山口以南的树冠分布记录

The description recorded keirasabinae at 100–1,000 m elevation south of the Palghat gap, including Chathankod-Makki, Ponmudi, Peppara and Shendurney in the Agasthyamalai region, and Periyar Tiger Reserve in Kerala. It was described as inhabiting the highest canopy layers and consequently being difficult to locate. A wider range in southern Kerala and neighbouring Tamil Nadu was suggested, not demonstrated with confirmed additional occurrences. Named reserves identify source localities rather than guarantee present habitat security. These canopy observations do not measure population density, define an upper detection limit or identify egg-laying sites.

描述在 Palghat 山口以南、海拔 100–1,000 米记录 keirasabinae，地点包括 Agasthyamalai 地区的 Chathankod-Makki、Ponmudi、Peppara、Shendurney，以及 Kerala 州的 Periyar 老虎保护区。论文称其生活在较高树冠层，因此难以发现。作者推测它可能在 Kerala 南部及相邻 Tamil Nadu 有更广分布，但没有以新增确认地点证明这部分范围。保护区名称用于标识来源地点，不保证现今生境安全。树冠观察也没有测量种群密度、界定检测高度上限或确定产卵位置。
behavior
Vocalisations were not recorded and analysed
研究尚未记录并分析其鸣声

The species account explicitly states that keirasabinae vocalisations had not been recorded and analysed. Acoustic descriptions of other nerostagona-group members therefore cannot be assigned as measured keirasabinae call durations or frequencies. This is a data gap in the 2021 study, not evidence that the frog is silent, cannot call or lacks a role for calls in reproduction. The difficulty of locating canopy individuals offers field context but does not itself explain every missing record. Describing a call repertoire or its temperature dependence will require species-identified recordings rather than transferring a group summary.

物种条目明确说明 keirasabinae 的鸣声尚未被记录并分析。因此，nerostagona 组其他成员的声学描述不能赋为 keirasabinae 的实测鸣声时长或频率。这是 2021 年研究中的资料缺口，不是该蛙沉默、不能鸣叫或繁殖过程不使用鸣声的证据。树冠个体难以找到提供了野外背景，但不能自动解释全部缺失记录。要描述其鸣声类型和温度依赖关系，需要经过物种确认的录音，而不能移用物种组摘要。
evolution
A sister relationship to nerostagona in the sampled tree
所采系统树中与 nerostagona 互为姐妹种

The study placed keirasabinae in the nerostagona group and reported a well-supported sister relationship to nerostagona. Mitochondrial 16S divergence was 3.1–3.7% from nerostagona and 6.1–6.6% from crustai. These are sequence distances, not elapsed time or demonstrated reproductive isolation. The wider tree combined mitochondrial and nuclear markers. The paper contrasted known records south of the Palghat gap with nerostagona records north of it; that dated geographic distinction alone neither proves that the gap caused speciation nor establishes exhaustive present allopatry.

研究将 keirasabinae 放入 nerostagona 组，并报告了支持度较高的、与 nerostagona 互为姐妹种的关系。线粒体 16S 距离分别为：与 nerostagona 3.1–3.7%，与 crustai 6.1–6.6%。这些是序列距离，不是已经过去的时间或已证明的生殖隔离。整体系统树结合了线粒体和核基因标记。论文对比其在 Palghat 山口以南的已知记录与 nerostagona 在山口以北的记录；这种有年代的地理区别本身不能证明山口造成了物种形成，也不能确定两者现今完全异域分布。

sections: morphology
Green dorsal colour with fine spinules and a midline ridge
绿色背面、细刺与背中角质嵴

The diagnosis gives males at 22–24 mm snout–vent length, with uniform green dorsal colour, finely roughened to sparsely granular skin bearing horny spinules, and a horny ridge extending from the snout to the vent. The tongue bears papillae, and flanks and groin are light brown to yellowish. Morphometric data were provided for three specimens including the holotype. These observations describe the sampled diagnostic combination, rather than certifying that colour never changes or that the range applies to females. A green dorsum occurs in other congeners, so identification requires the additional characters and comparative diagnosis.
鉴别描述给出雄性吻肛长 22–24 毫米，背色均匀绿色，皮肤从细密粗糙到疏散颗粒状，具有角质细刺，并有从吻端延伸到泄殖孔附近的背中角质嵴。舌上有乳突，体侧与腹股沟为浅褐至淡黄色。形态测量来自包括正模在内的三只标本。这些观察描述的是所采材料的鉴别组合，不认证体色永不变化，也不能将雄性范围用于雌性。其他同属蛙也可能有绿色背面，因此辨识需要结合其他特征和比较诊断。
ecology
Secondary-forest perches during the breeding season
繁殖季节在次生林植被上的停栖记录

At publication, sanjappai was known only from Periya in Wayanad district, Kerala, north of the Palghat gap, at about 750 m elevation. It was observed in secondary forest, on vegetation up to three metres high during the breeding season. The season qualifier concerns when the observations were made; it does not demonstrate that the perch was a nest or that reproduction was observed on every plant. The study did not quantify dependence on secondary forest, disturbance tolerance, density or the complete annual activity cycle. A single known locality is a limit of recorded knowledge, not a measured extinction risk or confirmation of absence elsewhere.

发表时，sanjappai 仅记录于 Kerala 州 Wayanad 区的 Periya，位于 Palghat 山口以北，海拔约 750 米。研究在繁殖季节于次生林中观察到个体，停栖于最高约三米的植被上。“繁殖季节”说明观察发生的时间，不证明停栖处就是巢，也不表示每株植物上都观察到繁殖。研究没有量化对次生林的依赖、干扰耐受程度、密度或全年活动周期。仅知道一个地点是记录知识的局限，不是实测灭绝风险或其他地方确认不存在的证据。
behavior
Longer calls with widely spaced pulses
脉冲间距较大的较长鸣声

Males were described as producing one pulsatile call type, delivered singly and with widely spaced pulses. The typical-call summary gives duration 411.2 ms, two pulses, pulse rate 2.7 per second and overall dominant frequency 2.4 kHz; the envelope has a relatively long rise and shorter fall. Pulse rate is the source’s acoustic measure and is not replaced here by dividing two pulses by total duration. These summary values do not incorporate all temperature, social-context or individual effects noted in the methods. Call differences can support identification but do not alone demonstrate mate-choice isolation or exclude additional context-dependent vocalisations.

论文将雄性鸣声描述为一种脉冲型鸣声，单次发出，脉冲之间间距较大。典型鸣声摘要给出持续时间 411.2 毫秒、两个脉冲、每秒 2.7 个脉冲及总主频 2.4 千赫兹，振幅包络的上升阶段较长，下降阶段较短。脉冲速率采用来源定义的声学指标，不在这里用两个脉冲除以总时长替换。方法指出温度、社会情境及个体因素可能影响鸣声，这些摘要没有纳入所有变化。鸣声差异可支持辨识，但本身不能证明配偶选择隔离，也不能排除在其他情境中的发声。
evolution
Sequence affinity with vellikkannan
与 vellikkannan 的序列亲缘关系

The study placed sanjappai in the chromasynchysi group and recovered it as sister to vellikkannan. Their reported mitochondrial 16S divergence was 3.1–3.3%; distances to other examined group members differed. The wider phylogenetic analysis used mitochondrial and nuclear markers. This relationship does not make the two species’ colours, webbing, habitats or call observations interchangeable. Pairwise sequence distance supplies neither a universal delimitation cutoff nor evidence that hybridization is absent. The integrative description also relied on species-specific morphology and, for sanjappai, recorded calls.

研究将 sanjappai 归入 chromasynchysi 组，并恢复了它与 vellikkannan 的姐妹关系。两者报告的线粒体 16S 距离为 3.1–3.3%，与其他受检组员的距离不同。整体系统发育分析使用了线粒体和核基因标记。这种关系不能使两种的体色、趾蹼、生境和鸣声观察相互替换。成对序列距离既不是通用划分阈值，也不是不存在杂交的证据。综合描述还依赖各自的形态特征；对 sanjappai 而言，还包含已录制的鸣声。

sections: appearance
A silver-grey iris and yellowish-brown dorsal pattern
银灰虹膜与黄褐色背纹

The diagnosis gives male snout–vent length of 22.2–22.9 mm, yellowish-brown dorsal colour, prominent granules with sharp horny spinules, a weak or discontinuous mid-dorsal ridge, tongue papillae and limited foot webbing. The live holotype had a dark brown X-shaped dorsal mark and scattered spots, dark cross-bands on the limbs, and a silver-grey iris with minute brown speckling. Preserved colours and markings were described separately and were paler in several areas. The holotype appearance is not a population frequency estimate or proof that every individual has an identical X mark. The male diagnostic range does not establish female body size.
鉴别描述给出雄性吻肛长 22.2–22.9 毫米，背面黄褐色，明显颗粒突起上有尖锐角质细刺，背中嵴较弱或不连续，舌有乳突，足趾蹼较少。活体正模背上有深褐色 X 形纹和散斑，四肢带深色横纹，银灰虹膜有细小褐色斑点。保存后的颜色和斑纹另行描述，部分区域变得较浅。正模外观不是种群花纹频率估计，也不证明每个个体都有完全相同的 X 纹。雄性鉴别体长范围不能确定雌性的大小。
distribution
Primary-forest records in the Siruvani and Silent Valley region
Siruvani 与 Silent Valley 地区的原生林记录

The 2021 account recorded vellikkannan from its type locality at Singappara, Siruvani, and surrounding Silent Valley National Park regions in Palakkad district, Kerala, north of the Palghat gap. Individuals were observed inside primary forest on vegetation up to four metres high during the breeding season. This is the observed perch range in the account, not proof that frogs never occur higher, a quantitative preference for primary over secondary forest or an identified egg substrate. The description does not measure population trends or validate a present conservation category. Nearby suitable forest should not be added as a confirmed record without observations.

2021 年条目在 Kerala 州 Palakkad 区记录 vellikkannan，地点为 Siruvani 的模式产地 Singappara，以及 Silent Valley 国家公园周边地区，均位于 Palghat 山口以北。繁殖季节在原生林内观察到个体，停栖于最高约四米的植被。这个高度是条目中的观察记录，不证明它从不在更高处出现，也不是对原生林相对于次生林的定量偏好或已确认的产卵基质。描述没有测量种群趋势或验证现今保护等级。附近潜在适宜森林不能在缺少观察时增列为确认分布。
behavior
The acoustic repertoire remained undescribed
鸣声类型仍缺少描述

The species account explicitly states that vellikkannan vocalisations had not been recorded and analysed. The measured 411.2 ms, two-pulse call of its sister species sanjappai is consequently not a vellikkannan observation. Missing recordings do not demonstrate silence or absence of acoustic communication. Calling heights or call summaries for the larger chromasynchysi group also cannot substitute for species-identified acoustic evidence. A reliable repertoire description would require recordings linked to correctly identified individuals and their environmental context.
物种条目明确说明 vellikkannan 的鸣声尚未记录并分析。因此，其姐妹种 sanjappai 持续 411.2 毫秒、包含两个脉冲的实测鸣声并不是 vellikkannan 的观察结果。缺少录音不证明它沉默或没有声音交流。较大的 chromasynchysi 组的鸣叫高度和声学摘要，也不能替代经过物种确认的声学证据。可靠的鸣声描述需要将录音与正确鉴定的个体及环境情境关联。
evolution
A multilocus context for its sister relationship
多标记分析中的姐妹关系

The study assigned vellikkannan to the chromasynchysi group and recovered a sister relationship to sanjappai. Their mitochondrial 16S divergence was 3.1–3.3%, while reported distances to chromasynchysi, ravii and silentvalley were higher. The larger phylogenetic study included mitochondrial and nuclear markers, rather than treating a single percentage as its complete taxonomic evidence. The tree does not demonstrate reproductive isolation, date the split or establish a unique historical dispersal route. Diagnostic morphology and separate locality records remain necessary, especially because vellikkannan calls were not analysed.

研究将 vellikkannan 归入 chromasynchysi 组，并恢复了它与 sanjappai 的姐妹关系。两者线粒体 16S 距离为 3.1–3.3%；与 chromasynchysi、ravii 和 silentvalley 的报告距离更高。整体系统发育研究包含线粒体和核基因标记，并非把单个百分比作为完整分类证据。系统树不能证明生殖隔离、给出分化时间或确定唯一的历史扩散路线。鉴别形态和独立地点记录仍然必要，尤其因为 vellikkannan 的鸣声没有得到分析。

name: Raorchestes ravii

sections: taxonomy
Topotypic specimens clarify an uncertain historical label
模式产地标本有助于厘清历史标签

Ravii was originally described from two specimens at Naduvattam in the Nilgiris, Tamil Nadu, reported at 1,890 m elevation. The 2021 authors collected two additional topotypic specimens matching the description and type. They distinguished these from older samples labelled aff. ravii or aff. coonoorensis whose localities were unknown and whose assignments differed between papers. The new samples showed 1–1.5% mitochondrial 16S divergence from the older aff. ravii material and 1–2.4% from chromasynchysi. These comparisons do not certify every historical label as a modern ravii record or establish a synonymy. Unknown localities cannot be converted into additional distribution points.

ravii 最初依据 Tamil Nadu 州 Nilgiris 的 Naduvattam 两只标本描述，来源报告海拔为 1,890 米。2021 年作者从模式产地获得了另两只与描述及模式标本相符的个体，并将它们与历史上标为 aff. ravii 或 aff. coonoorensis 的材料区分；那些材料的地点未知，且不同论文的归属不一致。新标本与旧 aff. ravii 材料的线粒体 16S 距离为 1–1.5%，与 chromasynchysi 为 1–2.4%。这些比较不能认证所有历史标签都对应现行 ravii，也不确立同物异名。未知地点不能转化为新增分布点。
morphology
Re-examination found structures absent from the original account
重新检查发现原描述未记载为存在的结构

The 2021 type examination supported placement in the chromasynchysi group through a combination including male snout–vent length 20–23 mm, pointed snout, dorsal horny spinules, ridges between the eyes and along the back, tongue papillae and a golden-brown iris not divided into lighter upper and darker lower halves. The authors specifically reported a ridge and tongue papillae on the holotype even though the original description had stated they were absent. This is a documented disagreement between examinations, not justification to erase either account. Variable brown morphs and dorsal X or H marks in chromasynchysi also make colour-only identification unreliable.

2021 年的模式标本检查以多项特征支持将 ravii 放入 chromasynchysi 组，包括雄性吻肛长 20–23 毫米、尖吻、背部角质细刺、眼间及背中嵴、舌乳突，以及没有明确分成上下浅深两半的金褐色虹膜。作者特别指出在正模上发现了角质嵴和舌乳突，尽管原描述将其记为缺失。这是不同检查间有记录的分歧，不能借此抹去任一来源的表述。chromasynchysi 本身具有多变的褐色型及背部 X 或 H 形纹，也使只凭颜色辨识不可靠。
behavior
A qualitative call account is not a measured spectrum
定性鸣声描述不等于实测频谱

The taxonomic remarks cited the original description’s comparison of the advertisement call to bell-like notes or falling water drops. The 2021 authors interpreted that account as potentially representing a pulsatile call with widely spaced pulses, consistent with the chromasynchysi group. This interpretation is not a new ravii recording, measured pulse interval or numerical dominant frequency. Group-level call properties and measurements of related species cannot fill those missing observations. The qualitative comparison can explain the authors’ grouping argument while remaining separate from direct acoustic measurements.
分类讨论引述原描述对广告鸣声的比喻，称其类似钟声或水滴声。2021 年作者将这段定性记载解释为可能对应脉冲间距较大的脉冲型鸣声，与 chromasynchysi 组相符。这个解释不是新录制的 ravii 鸣声，也不是实测脉冲间隔或主频数值。物种组的声学特征和近缘种的测量不能补足这些缺失观察。定性比喻可以用于解释作者的分组依据，但应与直接声学测量分开。
behavior
A separate table provides temporal measurements
独立表格另提供了时间结构测量

Beyond the qualitative historical call analogy in the taxonomic remarks, Table 2 gives a ravii pulsatile-call summary: duration 499.2 ms, rise time 483.1 ms, fall time 16.1 ms, three widely spaced pulses and pulse rate 4.2 per second, delivered without call groups. Its dominant-frequency cell is blank, so a numerical frequency is not inferred from other group members. Calling height is listed at 0.5–5 m. These table measurements and the original-description analogy are different evidence accounts; neither resolves every uncertain historical specimen label. The table does not establish the full repertoire, environmental variation or an invariant call for all populations.

除了分类讨论中历史性的定性鸣声比喻，表 2 另给出 ravii 的脉冲鸣声摘要：持续 499.2 毫秒、上升 483.1 毫秒、下降 16.1 毫秒、三个间距较大的脉冲，脉冲速率每秒 4.2，鸣声不组成组。主频单元格为空，因此不能从其他组员推填数值。鸣叫高度列为 0.5–5 米。这些表格测量与原描述比喻是不同的证据条目，两者都不能解决所有身份不确定的历史标本标签。表格也不能确定完整鸣声类型、环境变化或所有种群恒定的鸣声。

name: Raorchestes sanctisilvaticus
readScope: Raorchestes sanctisilvaticus: Reported earlier synonymies, unresolved proposed relationship to bombayensis, acoustic-number inconsistency and overlapping mitochondrial distances; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

sections: taxonomy
A proposed broader synonymy was explicitly deferred
更广的同物异名处理被明确暂缓

The article cited earlier work synonymizing similipalensis and terebrans with sanctisilvaticus. Its own comparison then found sanctisilvaticus closely related to bombayensis and discussed possible conspecificity because morphology, calls and mitochondrial distances were difficult to separate. Crucially, the authors explicitly refrained from a new taxonomic action pending comprehensive population sampling across the known ranges. The pinned catalogue retains sanctisilvaticus and bombayensis as separate accepted readers here. The paper’s proposal is therefore recorded as an unresolved source interpretation, not applied as a merge of names, specimens, distributions or species-specific biological evidence.

论文引述较早研究将 similipalensis 和 terebrans 处理为 sanctisilvaticus 的同物异名。本次比较又发现 sanctisilvaticus 与 bombayensis 关系密切，并因形态、鸣声和线粒体距离难以明确区分而讨论两者可能同种。然而，作者明确暂不采取新的分类行动，等待覆盖已知分布的全面种群采样。本项目的固定目录仍将 sanctisilvaticus 和 bombayensis 保留为两个接受物种页面。因此，论文的合并设想只记录为尚未解决的来源解释，不用于合并名称、标本、分布或物种专属生物学证据。
evolution
Shallow distances and similar calls have interpretation limits
浅序列距离与相似鸣声仍有解释边界

The comparison reported 16S distances of 0.8–1.5% between bombayensis samples from northern Karnataka, Goa and Maharashtra and sanctisilvaticus samples from Madhya Pradesh, Odisha, Chhattisgarh and Andhra Pradesh. Each named set had reported internal distances up to 0.8%, touching the lower end of the between-set range. Calls were described as similar and near 3 kHz. The call-duration sentence has an inconsistent ordering of taxon names and four duration values, so it is not used here to assign a precise duration to sanctisilvaticus. Similarity and shallow distance do not themselves certify contemporary gene flow or remove the need for broader concept reconciliation.

比较报告：来自 Karnataka 北部、Goa 和 Maharashtra 的 bombayensis 材料，与来自 Madhya Pradesh、Odisha、Chhattisgarh 和 Andhra Pradesh 的 sanctisilvaticus 材料，16S 距离为 0.8–1.5%。两套名称材料各自内部距离均最高达 0.8%，与组间范围的下界相接。论文将鸣声描述为相似，主频约三千赫兹。关于鸣声时长的句子中，物种顺序与四个数值对应存在不一致，因此这里不用该句为 sanctisilvaticus 指定精确时长。相似性和浅距离本身不能认证现行基因流，也不能免除更全面的物种概念协调。

name: Raorchestes bombayensis
readScope: Raorchestes bombayensis: Comparison with sanctisilvaticus explicitly without taxonomic merger, population-variable morphology and unresolved acoustic-duration attribution; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sectionLocators: PMC7936570 XML sec12 paragraphs 5, 8

sections: taxonomy
The older name was discussed without adopting a merger
讨论较早名称的优先权，但未实施合并

The 2021 discussion considered bombayensis the earliest available name if the examined bombayensis and sanctisilvaticus populations ultimately proved conspecific. It noted weak and variable differences in foot webbing and ventral mottling, but explicitly deferred taxonomic action until comprehensive population studies were available. This conditional priority argument does not establish that every source record under sanctisilvaticus belongs to bombayensis. Both remain separate accepted concepts in the pinned catalogue used here. The historical argument is retained alongside its uncertainty rather than changing the canonical tree or pooling their biological records.

The remarks traced thodai to two original specimens from Ooty in the Nilgiris, reported at 1,980 m elevation. Iris lines, flank/groin colour and dorsal markings overlapped with variation within signatus, leading the authors to suggest thodai was likely a junior subjective synonym of signatus. The study explicitly left Raorchestes echinatus outside its defined species groups because phylogenetic relationships were unresolved and clearly shared diagnostic characters were lacking. Its spinular dorsum, mid-dorsal lines and mottled belly prompted a suggested affinity to the bombayensis group, but the authors did not adopt that placement. Acoustic characters were not studied. Missing calls and superficial resemblance cannot be replaced with relatives’ durations, frequencies or a certified group assignment. The authors identified further acoustic, ecological, reproductive and behavioural evidence as potential ways to resolve the uncertainty.

sections: morphology
Small body size and a frame-like colour pattern
小型体格与框状体色组合

The diagnosis reports males at 15.5–17.6 mm snout–vent length, mean 16.4 mm, and females at 19.5–20.7 mm, mean 20.1 mm. The variation account mentions two females, so the female range is not a broad population estimate. The head is wider than long; the single subgular vocal sac is light yellow in life; shanks bear transverse bars; and an irregular light-brown dorsolateral stripe runs from behind the eye toward the groin, with a similarly coloured triangular loreal mark. Male size overlaps the compared decipiens and haddadi samples, and body form resembles them. Identification therefore requires the full diagnostic combination, calls and sequence context rather than a size cutoff or frame-like pattern alone.

鉴别描述报告雄性吻肛长 15.5–17.6 毫米，平均 16.4 毫米；雌性为 19.5–20.7 毫米，平均 20.1 毫米。变异条目提及两只雌性，因此该雌性范围不是广泛的种群估计。头宽大于头长，单一喉下声囊在活体为淡黄色；胫部有横纹；不规则浅褐色背侧条带从眼后延伸至腹股沟，并有同色的三角形吻侧斑。雄性体长与受比较的 decipiens、haddadi 样本重叠，体形也相近。因此，辨识需要结合完整鉴别组合、鸣声及序列背景，不能只靠体长界限或框状花纹。
appearance
Pigmentation varies and some bars fade in preservation
色素程度多变，部分横纹保存后变淡

Type-series dorsal pigmentation ranged from mostly dark brown to pale yellow with scattered dark spots. The lighter dorsolateral stripe was almost always distinguishable but was not necessarily uniformly pigmented and could be regular rather than irregular. Shank bars varied in thickness and prominence and could disappear in preserved specimens. Some individuals had light spots beneath the eyes; both examined females had more clearly pointed digit discs than males. These sample observations distinguish live and preserved appearance and retain individual variation. They do not demonstrate colour-change mechanisms, the prevalence of each morph across the range or sex differences in every population.
模式系列的背部色素程度从大面积深褐色到带散点的淡黄色不等。较浅的背侧条带几乎总能辨认，但未必均匀着色，形状也可以规则，而非始终不规则。胫部横纹的粗细和明显程度不同，保存后可能消失。部分个体眼下有浅斑；受检的两只雌性指趾端盘比雄性更明显地呈尖形。这些样本观察区分活体与保存外观，并保留个体变化，不能确定变色机制、各色型在完整分布中的频率，或所有种群均具有相同的性别差异。
distribution
Two areas with unequal kinds of identity evidence
两个地区的身份依据并不相同

The account recorded tapacurensis at São Lourenço da Mata, Pernambuco, and Guaramiranga in the Baturité mountains, Ceará, about 590 km northwest of the type locality. The July 2018 type-area work concerned Buchada and Camocim Atlantic Forest fragments at 122 and 131 m elevation. The approximately 1,100 m figure describes the highland forest-enclave region, not the measured height of every Ceará frog. Crucially, the Ceará assignment was based on DNA sequences, and the authors requested morphological and acoustic confirmation. These records do not demonstrate a continuous occupied corridor, a newly observed migration or a fixed present range. Historical rainforest connections were proposed as a biogeographic explanation rather than directly reconstructed for this species.

条目在 Pernambuco 州 São Lourenço da Mata 和 Ceará 州 Baturité 山区的 Guaramiranga 记录 tapacurensis，后者约位于模式产地西北方 590 千米。2018 年七月的模式地区调查位于 Buchada 与 Camocim 大西洋林斑，海拔分别为 122 和 131 米。约 1,100 米的数值描述高地残存森林地区，不是每只 Ceará 蛙的实测发现海拔。尤其需要说明：Ceará 的归属基于 DNA 序列，作者要求后续用形态和鸣声确认。这些记录不证明连续占据的通道、近期观察到的迁移或固定的现今分布。历史雨林连接是提出的生物地理解释，并非对本物种直接完成的历史重建。
reproduction
Leaf egg placement and prolonged rainy-season calling
叶片产卵与持续较长的雨季鸣叫

The diagnosis explicitly states that eggs are laid on leaves overhanging temporary ponds. Natural-history observations found calling frogs on shrubs and marginal vegetation around sandy-bottomed temporary ponds 15–100 cm deep, with males commonly perched 10–150 cm above ground. Calling was heard throughout the reported April–August rainy-season activity period, usually around 18:00–23:00. The broader site-climate description gives a February–September rainy season; these are different scopes rather than interchangeable dates. Calling throughout a season does not mean each female breeds continuously. The text does not quantify clutch size, hatching success or parental attendance, and the recorded perches cannot all be treated as egg-bearing leaves.

鉴别条目明确记载卵产于悬在临时池塘上方的叶片。自然史观察在深 15–100 厘米、沙质池底的临时池周围灌木及边缘植被上发现鸣叫个体，雄性常在离地 10–150 厘米处停栖。报告的四月至八月雨季活动期内持续听到鸣叫，通常约十八时至二十三时。地点气候描述给出二月至九月的雨季，两者范围不同，不能互换。整个季节听到鸣叫不表示每只雌性连续繁殖。文字没有量化每窝卵数、孵化成功率或亲代守护，所记录的停栖叶也不能全部视为有卵的叶片。
behavior
A note-centred description from six males
以音符为单位、来自六只雄蛙的鸣声描述

The call account used six males and described one pulsed note type, generally in series of three to nine notes and rarely isolated. Notes lasted 39–110 ms and contained nine to twenty-nine pulses; reported pulse repetition rate was 143–368 per second and dominant frequency 5,578–6,422 Hz. Eighty-three notes contributed to several summary measures, so that denominator is repeated notes rather than eighty-three frogs. Pulse duration and inter-note interval used different sample counts. The final pulse in a note was longer than preceding pulses. The analysis followed a note-centred approach, and note duration is not the duration of an entire multi-note series. These observations are not a measured complete repertoire or an invariant recognition threshold.

鸣声描述使用六只雄蛙，记载一种脉冲音符，通常以三至九个音符组成序列，极少单独发出。音符持续 39–110 毫秒，包含九至二十九个脉冲；报告的脉冲重复速率为每秒 143–368，主频为 5,578–6,422 赫兹。若干摘要指标使用八十三个音符，分母是重复音符，不是八十三只蛙；脉冲时长和音符间隔采用其他样本数量。每个音符的末次脉冲较前面的脉冲长。分析以音符为中心，因此音符时长不是整段多音符序列的持续时间。这些观察不是完整鸣声类型的测量或恒定的识别阈值。
evolution
Supported affinity to oliveirai with mitochondrial limits
与 oliveirai 的关系获得支持，但证据限于线粒体

Bayesian and maximum-likelihood analyses recovered tapacurensis as sister to oliveirai, with posterior probability 1.0 and bootstrap 87. The dataset was mitochondrial H1, containing ribosomal segments and intervening tRNA, rather than a nuclear genomic assessment. Distances were separately calculated from a trimmed 400-bp 16S alignment: the paper reports at least 8% from examined group congeners and no more than 3% among its assigned tapacurensis populations. These percentages do not certify reproductive isolation or a universal species threshold. Methods contain inconsistent tissue/sequence sample totals, and results versus discussion differ in the stated early branching order of bromeliaceus and berthalutzae. Those discrepancies do not alter the separately reported tapacurensis–oliveirai sister relationship, but they remain unresolved source issues.

贝叶斯与最大似然分析恢复了 tapacurensis 与 oliveirai 的姐妹关系，后验概率为 1.0、自展支持为 87。数据来自含核糖体片段及中间 tRNA 的线粒体 H1 区域，不是核基因组评估。遗传距离另以裁剪后的 400 碱基对 16S 比对计算：论文报告与受检同组其他种至少相差 8%，归为 tapacurensis 的不同种群之间不超过 3%。这些百分比不能认证生殖隔离或通用物种阈值。方法中的组织与序列样本总数不一致，结果和讨论对 bromeliaceus、berthalutzae 的早期分支顺序也表述不同。这些分歧不改变另行报告的 tapacurensis—oliveirai 姐妹关系，但仍是未解决的来源问题。
conservation
Historical haddadi records require renewed identification
历史 haddadi 记录需要重新鉴定

The authors proposed that some Pernambuco and Alagoas records assigned to haddadi by external morphology might represent tapacurensis, while explicitly calling for acoustic and molecular examination. Those possible records are not added here as confirmed tapacurensis occurrences. The paper highlighted fragmented Atlantic Forest remnants and conservation units in the Pernambuco Endemism Center. Its cited estimate of only 11–16% of original Atlantic Forest cover remaining is a regional historical estimate, not a measured percentage loss of this frog population or a current site audit. The study did not certify a present Red List category, population trend or secure status merely because the type area is protected.

作者提出，Pernambuco 和 Alagoas 一些仅凭外部形态归为 haddadi 的历史记录，可能实际属于 tapacurensis，并明确要求声学与分子检查。这些可能记录不在这里增列为确认分布。论文强调 Pernambuco 特有区破碎的大西洋林残存斑块及保护单位的重要性。文中引述仅剩原始大西洋林覆盖 11–16% 的估计，是地区性历史估计，不是本蛙种群损失百分比的测量或现今地点审计。研究没有认证现行红色名录等级、种群趋势，也不能因模式地区受保护就认定状态安全。
title: A new species of the Dendropsophus decipiens Group (Anura: Hylidae) from Northeastern Brazil

The tree recovered haddadi terminals, including topotypic material, among structured decipiens lineages. The authors also found Alagoas sequences labelled haddadi closer to decipiens lineage VII than to topotypic haddadi and questioned several northeastern morphology-only records. This is evidence of unresolved source concepts, not a completed synonymy or permission to assign all those populations to tapacurensis. Specimen labels, topotypic comparisons and proposed reassignment remain separate. The article requested additional morphology, calls and sequence sampling to resolve species limits; this page does not pool every historical record into one contemporary haddadi concept.

The comparison cites earlier haddadi call measurements
比较引用了较早的 haddadi 鸣声测量

The tapacurensis comparison cited haddadi dominant frequencies of 4,312–4,875 Hz, series of one to three notes and note durations of 4–59 ms. These were earlier-source values, not a uniform new acoustic survey of all haddadi populations. The discussion warns that the published haddadi call came from outside the type locality and that morphology-only identification can be uncertain. Consequently the ranges are retained as attributed measurements with a concept limitation, not as universal diagnostic bounds or evidence that every northeastern population has those calls. Reported male size also overlaps tapacurensis, so a single size or frequency value cannot settle identity.

name: Dendropsophus oliveirai
readScope: Dendropsophus oliveirai: Distinct morphology and historically attributed acoustic comparison despite sister relationship to tapacurensis; explicitly source-bounded syntopy; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sectionLocators: PMC8279364 XML sec018 paragraphs 1–2; sec020 paragraph 0; sec022 paragraph 0; sec024 paragraph 1
sections: evolution
Sister relationship does not transfer the new species’ biology
姐妹关系不能移用新种的生物学记录

Oliveirai was recovered as sister to tapacurensis in the mitochondrial analysis, but their sampled morphology and calls differed. The comparison gave oliveirai males at 13.6–15.5 mm snout–vent length, a white rather than light-brown dorsolateral stripe, and earlier-source pulse rates of 56–161 per second with five to fourteen pulses per note. The discussion notes that the published oliveirai call came from outside the type locality. Syntopy with tapacurensis was reported at the study area, but does not prove identical breeding schedules or interaction strength. Neither the sister relationship nor local co-occurrence makes tapacurensis egg counts, calling periods or unmeasured traits oliveirai observations.

线粒体分析恢复了 oliveirai 与 tapacurensis 的姐妹关系，但所比较的形态和鸣声不同。比较给出 oliveirai 雄性吻肛长 13.6–15.5 毫米，背侧条带为白色而非浅褐色，并引述较早来源的脉冲速率每秒 56–161、每音符五至十四个脉冲。讨论说明已发表 oliveirai 鸣声来自模式产地以外。研究地区报告两者同域同生境，但这不能证明繁殖时间相同或确定互动强度。姐妹关系和当地共存都不能将 tapacurensis 的繁殖期或未测特征变成 oliveirai 的观察。
title: A new species of the Dendropsophus decipiens Group (Anura: Hylidae) from Northeastern Brazil

name: Dendropsophus decipiens
readScope: Dendropsophus decipiens: Source-labelled genetically structured lineages and paraphyly, not completed delimitation of accepted species; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sectionLocators: PMC8279364 XML sec020 paragraphs 0–1; sec024 paragraphs 1–2
sections: taxonomy
Ten labelled lineages are not ten certified species
十个标签谱系不等于十个已认证物种

The study added two structured lineages labelled decipiens to eight previously reported ones, calling them IX from Santos Dumont and X from Cananéia. Reported 16S distances across decipiens-labelled lineages ranged from about 2% to 11%, with 6% between two sympatric Aurelino Leal lineages. Haddadi remained embedded in the broader decipiens complex. These results identify unresolved diversity among source-labelled samples; they do not independently describe ten accepted species, demonstrate reproductive barriers or place all sequence labels in one certified contemporary concept. The authors emphasized further morphology and acoustic review, especially because published decipiens calls were not from the type locality.

研究在先前八个标为 decipiens 的结构谱系之外新增两个，称 Santos Dumont 材料为 IX、Cananéia 材料为 X。decipiens 标签谱系间报告的 16S 距离约为 2–11%，Aurelino Leal 两个同域谱系之间为 6%；haddadi 仍嵌于更广的 decipiens 复合群。这些结果识别来源标签材料中的未解决多样性，不是独立描述十个接受物种、证明生殖屏障，或将全部序列标签放入一个已认证现行概念。作者强调需要继续检查形态和鸣声，尤其因为已发表 decipiens 鸣声并非来自模式产地。

name: Dendropsophus berthalutzae
readScope: Dendropsophus berthalutzae: Divergent source-labelled lineage and incompatible historical repertoire descriptions with unverified identity outside type region; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sectionLocators: PMC8279364 XML sec020 paragraphs 0–1; sec024 paragraphs 1–2
sections: taxonomy
Divergent lineages complicate the historical call descriptions
分化谱系使历史鸣声描述更难解释

The study reported a Rio de Janeiro lineage labelled berthalutzae with 9% 16S distance from topotypic São Paulo sequences. It also contrasted two earlier call accounts: one described a single pulsed note type across five populations including topotypes, while another from Fervedouro described two pulsed note types. The authors warned that populations outside São Paulo might represent undescribed taxa. These are incompatible source-labelled repertoire accounts requiring reconciliation, not proof that every accepted berthalutzae has both repertoires. Results and discussion also differ in the early-branching placement relative to bromeliaceus. Neither the genetic percentage nor the call contrast completes species delimitation or a present range revision.

研究报告一个标为 berthalutzae 的 Rio de Janeiro 谱系，与 São Paulo 模式产地序列的 16S 距离为 9%。论文还对比两份较早鸣声记载：一份涵盖包括模式产地在内的五个种群，描述一种脉冲音符；另一份来自 Fervedouro，描述两种脉冲音符。作者警告，São Paulo 以外的种群可能属于未描述类群。这些是需要协调的、不同来源标签下的鸣声记载，不证明所有接受概念下的 berthalutzae 都有两套类型。结果和讨论对它与 bromeliaceus 的早期分支顺序也表述不同。遗传百分比和鸣声对比都没有完成物种划分或现行分布修订。

name: Dendropsophus leucophyllatus
readScope: Dendropsophus leucophyllatus: 2017 restricted concept and neotype, diagnostic sample, photograph-based colour, advertisement/aggressive acoustic accounts, bounded locality/habitat and dated polygon-based conservation recommendation; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sectionLocators: PMC5332023 reading-sections section 7 paragraphs 0–1; section 10 paragraphs 0, 3
PMC5332023 reading-sections section 10 paragraph 4; section 1 paragraphs 0–1
PMC5332023 reading-sections section 10 paragraph 8; section 1 paragraph 1
PMC5332023 reading-sections section 10 paragraphs 11–12; section 1 paragraph 2
PMC5332023 reading-sections section 10 paragraphs 13–14
PMC5332023 reading-sections section 10 paragraph 16; section 1 paragraph 3
PMC5332023 reading-sections section 10 paragraph 16; section 1 paragraph 3
sections: taxonomy
A neotype anchors a narrower use of leucophyllatus
新模标本固定了更窄的 leucophyllatus 用法

The revision could not examine the lost original holotype. It associated leucophyllatus with its clade B using the historical leaf-shaped sacral mark and the original Suriname locality, and designated a male neotype from Sinnamary, French Guiana. This restricted concept differed from earlier accounts that used an hourglass mark and combined material from several other Amazonian clades. Those historical leucophyllatus labels are therefore not automatically records of leucophyllatus sensu stricto. The revision’s name assignment is recorded here, while equivalence of every older specimen or dataset concept still requires specimen-level reconciliation.

修订无法检查已经遗失的原正模。作者依据历史描述中的叶形骶部斑及原始 Suriname 地点，将 leucophyllatus 对应于研究的 B 支系，并指定 French Guiana 的 Sinnamary 一只雄蛙为新模。这个较窄概念不同于早期使用沙漏形斑、混合若干其他亚马孙支系材料的记载。因此，历史 leucophyllatus 标签不能自动视为狭义 leucophyllatus 的记录。本页记录修订中的名称归属，但每件旧标本或数据集概念是否对应，仍需逐标本协调。
morphology
An elongated leaf-shaped sacral mark in the diagnosis
鉴别中的细长叶形骶部斑

The sampled males measured 26.8–32.3 mm snout–vent length, mean 29.7 mm, with twelve males; two females measured 36–39.8 mm, mean 37.9 mm. The diagnostic combination includes an axillary membrane extending halfway toward the elbow, basal finger webbing, toe webbing, a single palmar tubercle and moderate pectoral patches. White or live bright-yellow dorsolateral bands extend toward the snout, and an elliptical, elongated leaf-shaped mark lies over the sacrum. Some individuals show a reticulated pattern. The small female sample and variable patterns prevent treating the ranges or each mark as absolute species limits.
十二只雄性吻肛长为 26.8–32.3 毫米，平均 29.7 毫米；两只雌性为 36–39.8 毫米，平均 37.9 毫米。鉴别组合包括延伸至上臂约一半处的腋膜、指基部蹼、趾蹼、单一掌结节及中等大小胸斑。白色或活体鲜黄色的背侧带向吻端延伸，骶部有椭圆细长、类似叶片的斑；部分个体为网纹型。雌性样本很少，花纹也有变化，不能将测量范围或每种斑纹都当作绝对物种界限。
appearance
Photographs distinguish live colours from preserved marks
照片资料区分活体颜色与保存花纹

Live colour descriptions were derived from digital photographs. Pale areas could be white or bright yellow against brown to dark-brown dorsal surfaces. The account described limb undersides, thigh surfaces and webbing as pink at night and red by day; the vocal sac was yellow, belly creamy white and iris dull to coppery bronze. These are source observations, not a controlled test of daily physiological colour change or camouflage. The diagnosis otherwise treats colours as preserved unless explicitly stated, so preserved white marks should not be assumed to remain white in life.
活体颜色描述来自数码照片。褐至深褐背面的浅色区域可以是白色或鲜黄色。条目将肢体腹面、大腿前后侧及蹼记为夜间粉色、白天红色；声囊黄色，腹部乳白，虹膜为暗青铜至铜青铜色。这些是来源观察，不是日周期生理变色或伪装的控制实验。方法规定，鉴别中的颜色除非特别说明，否则指保存标本；因此，保存后的白斑不能假定活体也始终为白色。
behavior
Advertisement and aggressive calls are separate accounts
广告鸣声与攻击性鸣声分别记录

The advertisement account describes a Type I trill, mean note duration 0.10 s with ten to fourteen pulses, followed by one or two shorter Type II notes. The whole advertisement call averaged 0.17 s and dominant frequency about 2,749 Hz. Calls classified as aggressive contained three to five Type II notes and averaged 0.25 s, with dominant frequency about 2,616 Hz. Note and whole-call durations are different units. The methods include newly recorded and reanalysed historical material and, where available, individual averages from several calls. A reported advertisement-duration standard deviation differs between the two paragraphs (0.02 versus 0.002 s), so it is not silently harmonized. These summaries do not establish invariant functions or a universal recognition threshold.

广告鸣声条目描述一个第一型颤音音符，平均持续 0.10 秒、含十至十四个脉冲，随后有一至两个较短的第二型音符。整次广告鸣声平均 0.17 秒，主频约 2,749 赫兹。归为攻击性鸣声的记录含三至五个第二型音符，平均持续 0.25 秒、主频约 2,616 赫兹。音符时长与整次鸣声时长是不同单位。方法包含新录音和重新分析的历史材料，在资料允许时以多次鸣声计算个体平均。两个段落的广告鸣声时长标准差不同，分别为 0.02 和 0.002 秒，不能悄悄统一。这些摘要不确定恒定功能或通用识别阈值。
ecology
Ponds, coastal swamps and forest-savanna edges
池塘、沿海沼泽与森林稀树草原边缘

Under the revision’s restricted concept, records came from northern Brazilian Amazonia, Suriname, Guyana and French Guiana, with known locality elevations from sea level to 400 m. Specimens occurred at permanent or semipermanent ponds along roads or in pristine forest, large coastal swamps and forest-savanna edges. Perches ranged from a few centimetres above water to several metres. These are locality and perch observations rather than measured breeding substrates, habitat preferences or density. Roadside records do not prove immunity to disturbance, and earlier broad leucophyllatus distributions cannot be added without reconciling identity.

在修订的狭义概念下，记录来自巴西北部亚马孙地区、Suriname、Guyana 和 French Guiana，已知地点海拔从海平面至 400 米。标本出现于路边或原生林内的永久及半永久池塘、大型沿海沼泽和森林稀树草原边缘，停栖位置从水面上数厘米到数米。这些是地点和停栖观察，不是产卵基质、偏好或密度测量。路边记录不证明对干扰不受影响，历史上广义 leucophyllatus 的分布也不能在未协调身份时直接增列。
conservation
A historical range polygon is not occupied habitat
历史分布多边形不是全部已占据生境

The study estimated a minimum-convex distribution polygon of 382,451 square kilometres for this account. The authors noted extensive undisturbed forest and protected areas within that broad polygon. Natural-vegetation estimates used the Amazon Deforestation 2010 layer. A polygon includes intervening space and is not equivalent to occupied area, population size or measured percentage population loss. The paper proposed Least Concern; this dated recommendation is not independent verification of a current Red List assessment. Protection and broad range alone do not demonstrate a stable population or current site security.
研究为该条目估计的最小凸分布多边形面积为 382,451 平方千米。作者指出这一较广多边形内有大面积未受扰森林及保护区。天然植被估计使用 Amazon Deforestation 2010 图层。多边形包含地点之间的空间，不等于已占据面积、种群量或实测种群损失百分比。论文提出“无危”建议；这个有年代的建议不是对现行红色名录评估的独立核实。受保护和分布较广本身不能确定种群稳定或当前地点安全。
title: Systematics of the Dendropsophus leucophyllatus species complex (Anura: Hylidae): Cryptic diversity and the description of two new species

name: Dendropsophus triangulum
readScope: Dendropsophus triangulum: Clade H name assignment versus former clade C labels, diagnostic morphology, photograph-based appearance, two acoustic accounts, locality reassignment limits and historical conservation polygon; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sectionLocators: PMC5332023 reading-sections section 8 paragraphs 0–1
PMC5332023 reading-sections section 11 paragraphs 3, 5
PMC5332023 reading-sections section 11 paragraphs 9–10; section 1 paragraph 2
PMC5332023 reading-sections section 11 paragraphs 11–12
PMC5332023 reading-sections section 11 paragraph 14; section 1 paragraph 3
sections: taxonomy
Triangulum was associated with clade H rather than clade C
triangulum 对应 H 支系，而不是旧用法中的 C 支系

The revision assigned the name triangulum to clade H using the holotype’s large triangular mark and the broadly stated Brazilian type locality. The original holotype was 25 mm snout–vent length and of unknown sex, so it is separate from the later adult male sample range. Many earlier clade C records had been called triangulum; the revision instead associated clade C with reticulatus based on its type and small rounded marks. This nomenclatural review does not certify every old triangulum label, and the paper’s own uncertainty over Nacebe material is retained rather than automatically converting that historical record into a confirmed new locality.

修订依据正模的大三角斑及笼统记为巴西的模式产地，将 triangulum 名称对应于 H 支系。原正模吻肛长为 25 毫米，性别未知，须与后来的成体雄性测量范围分开。许多早期 C 支系记录曾称 triangulum；修订根据模式标本和小圆斑，将 C 支系对应于 reticulatus。这次名称检查不认证每个旧 triangulum 标签；论文对 Nacebe 材料的疑问也予以保留，不自动将该历史记录转为确认新地点。
appearance
An hourglass pattern can be incomplete
沙漏形花纹也可以只出现一半

The diagnosis sampled twenty-six males at 28.6–34.4 mm snout–vent length and five females at 37.5–41.9 mm. It described a white or live bright-yellow dorsum with a dark-brown hourglass mark, sometimes only half present, and variable rounded spots or ovoid bands on limbs; some individuals were reticulated. The axillary membrane, basal finger webbing, toe webbing and single palmar tubercle form part of the combination. Live photographic accounts give yellowish-orange limb undersides and webbing at night and pale orange by day, with a bronze iris. These variations preclude identification from a complete hourglass alone or assuming that a missing half invalidates an otherwise matching specimen.
鉴别样本含二十六只雄性，吻肛长 28.6–34.4 毫米，五只雌性为 37.5–41.9 毫米。描述记载白色或活体鲜黄色背面上的深褐沙漏斑，有时只出现半个，肢体上的圆斑或椭圆带也变化，部分个体有网纹。腋膜、指基部蹼、趾蹼及单一掌结节属于组合特征。活体照片记载肢体腹面和蹼夜间为黄橙色、白天浅橙色，虹膜为青铜色。这些变化说明不能只靠完整沙漏纹辨识，也不能因缺少半个斑就否定其余特征相符的标本。
behavior
Longer advertisement calls with secondary notes
带次级音符的较长广告鸣声

Advertisement calls contained a Type I trill averaging 0.15 s and thirteen to twenty-one pulses, followed by one to three shorter Type II notes. Whole calls averaged 0.26 s, ranged 0.22–0.36 s and had mean dominant frequency about 2,456 Hz. The aggressive-call account described four to five Type II notes, shorter inter-note gaps, mean whole duration 0.24 s and dominant frequency about 2,412 Hz. These are separate source classifications, not pooled note distributions. Several recordings could contribute to an individual average under the study’s methods; summary denominators therefore should not be invented as numbers of independent populations. The measurements do not quantify mate choice or prove reproductive isolation from related species.

广告鸣声含平均 0.15 秒、十三至二十一个脉冲的第一型颤音音符，后接一至三个较短的第二型音符。整次鸣声平均 0.26 秒、范围 0.22–0.36 秒，平均主频约 2,456 赫兹。攻击性鸣声条目记载四至五个第二型音符、更短的音符间隔、平均整次时长 0.24 秒和主频约 2,412 赫兹。这是不同来源分类，不应合并为一套音符分布。研究方法允许多份录音形成个体平均，不能将摘要分母自行写成独立种群数。测量也没有量化配偶选择或证明与近缘种的生殖隔离。
distribution
Amazonian records and a questioned Bolivian report
亚马孙分布与受到质疑的玻利维亚记载

The revision’s confirmed distribution account included Ecuador, Peru and Brazil, with known locality elevations 34–387 m. It questioned a Nacebe, Bolivia report because the described specimens resembled reticulatus; that is a suggested identity rather than a new independently checked occurrence. Frogs were found at night near secondary-forest pools, lakes and swamps, on vegetation 100–420 cm above ground. Regional vegetation descriptions mention much taller forest canopies, which are not frog perch heights. These observations do not establish continuous occupancy, nesting sites or a measured preference for secondary forest over intact habitat.

修订中的确认分布条目包括 Ecuador、Peru 和 Brazil，已知地点海拔 34–387 米。作者因描述标本更像 reticulatus 而质疑 Bolivia 的 Nacebe 记载；这只是身份意见，不是新完成独立检查的分布点。夜间在次生林池塘、湖泊和沼泽附近发现个体，停栖于离地 100–420 厘米的植被。地区植被描述中更高的森林冠层不是蛙的停栖高度。这些观察不能确定连续占据、巢位或对次生林相对于完整生境的实测偏好。
conservation
A historical range polygon is not occupied habitat
历史分布多边形不是全部已占据生境

The study estimated a minimum-convex distribution polygon of 923,514 square kilometres for this account. It reported 52,604 square kilometres (5.7%) degraded by human activities. Natural-vegetation estimates used the Amazon Deforestation 2010 layer. A polygon includes intervening space and is not equivalent to occupied area, population size or measured percentage population loss. The paper proposed Least Concern; this dated recommendation is not independent verification of a current Red List assessment. Protection and broad range alone do not demonstrate a stable population or current site security.

研究为该条目估计的最小凸分布多边形面积为 923,514 平方千米。其中报告 52,604 平方千米（5.7%）受到人类活动退化影响。天然植被估计使用 Amazon Deforestation 2010 图层。多边形包含地点之间的空间，不等于已占据面积、种群量或实测种群损失百分比。论文提出“无危”建议；这个有年代的建议不是对现行红色名录评估的独立核实。受保护和分布较广本身不能确定种群稳定或当前地点安全。
title: Systematics of the Dendropsophus leucophyllatus species complex (Anura: Hylidae): Cryptic diversity and the description of two new species

name: Dendropsophus reticulatus
readScope: Dendropsophus reticulatus: Resurrection of reticulata as reticulatus clade C, large sex-specific diagnostic sample, live/preserved variation, advertisement/aggressive calls, partly contradictory elevation and conservation text; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sectionLocators: PMC5332023 reading-sections section 8 paragraph 1; section 12 paragraphs 0–3, 17
PMC5332023 reading-sections section 12 paragraphs 5, 7
PMC5332023 reading-sections section 12 paragraphs 10–11; section 1 paragraph 2
PMC5332023 reading-sections section 12 paragraphs 12–13
PMC5332023 reading-sections section 12 paragraph 16; section 1 paragraph 3
sections: taxonomy
Reticulata was removed from triangulum synonymy
reticulata 被移出 triangulum 的同物异名

The authors examined the historical reticulata type from the Napo region and associated its small rounded dorsal marks with clade C. They removed Hyla reticulata from triangulum synonymy and used the combination Dendropsophus reticulatus. Historical clade C samples labelled triangulum consequently require reconciliation rather than being treated as evidence for both accepted species. The remarks suggested that Nacebe specimens previously called triangulum resembled reticulatus, based on their published description. This attributed inference does not replace a new specimen examination or certify every older label under the current concept.

作者检查了来自 Napo 地区的历史 reticulata 模式标本，根据背面小圆斑将其对应于 C 支系，移出 triangulum 的同物异名，并采用 Dendropsophus reticulatus 组合。因此，历史上标为 triangulum 的 C 支系样本需要协调，不能同时作为两个接受物种的证据。讨论根据已发表描述提出，先前称 triangulum 的 Nacebe 标本更像 reticulatus。这种归属推断不替代新标本检查，也不认证全部旧标签与现行概念一致。
appearance
Broad colour variation in a relatively large measured series
较大测量系列中的广泛体色变化

The diagnosis includes 185 males at 20–29.6 mm snout–vent length, mean 23.8 mm, and sixty-six females at 28–39.7 mm, mean 33.1 mm. Dorsal colour varied from brown to reddish brown, white or live bright yellow, with or without round dark marks; some individuals were reticulated. An elongated pale band covers the shank, and webbing and ventral surfaces are described as red to salmon pink in life. Photographic accounts give salmon-pink limb and thigh surfaces at night and red by day, with a coppery-bronze iris. Larger sample size does not make every colour pattern universal or establish the physiological mechanism of change.
鉴别包含 185 只雄性，吻肛长 20–29.6 毫米、平均 23.8 毫米；六十六只雌性为 28–39.7 毫米、平均 33.1 毫米。背色从褐色、红褐色到白色或活体鲜黄色不等，圆形深斑可以有或没有，部分个体有网纹。胫部有细长浅色带，活体蹼和腹面描述为红至鲑粉色。照片记载肢体和大腿表面夜间鲑粉色、白天红色，虹膜为铜青铜色。较大样本量也不使每种花纹都普遍存在，或确定颜色变化的生理机制。
behavior
Introductory notes and secondary notes must remain distinct
引导音符与次级音符须分别处理

The advertisement account describes a Type I trill averaging 0.10 s and twelve to seventeen pulses, followed by two to four Type II notes averaging 0.039 s and five to six pulses. A multiple-pulse introductory note occurs in most calls. Whole advertisement calls average 0.35 s and dominant frequency about 2,992 Hz. The aggressive account describes three to five Type II notes, often with an introduction, average whole duration 0.59 s and dominant frequency about 2,832 Hz. A stray seconds unit accompanies an advertisement pulse-count value in that paragraph, so that number is not adopted as a duration. Note durations and total calls cannot be pooled, and absence of an introduction in some calls does not contradict the qualifier most.

广告鸣声条目描述第一型颤音音符平均 0.10 秒、十二至十七个脉冲，后接二至四个第二型音符；第二型平均 0.039 秒、五至六个脉冲。大多数鸣声开始还有多脉冲引导音符。整次广告鸣声平均 0.35 秒，主频约 2,992 赫兹。攻击性条目描述三至五个第二型音符，常带引导部分，整次平均 0.59 秒、主频约 2,832 赫兹。该段的一个广告鸣声脉冲计数误带秒单位，因此不将该数值采用为时长。音符与整次鸣声时长不能混合；部分记录没有引导音符，也不违背“大多数”的限定。
ecology
Forest and clearing records with an elevation-report discrepancy
森林与空地记录及海拔报告差异

The distribution account includes Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru and Bolivia. It states an elevation range of 40–1,037 m but calls Tabatinga at 63 m the lowest locality, an internal discrepancy retained here. Records occurred in terra-firme forest, flooded forest and swamps, generally by streams, lakes or temporary ponds in clearings. Nocturnal perches were 20–100 cm above ground. Occurrence in secondary forest and artificial open areas led the authors to suggest some disturbance tolerance; it was not an experimental tolerance threshold or evidence of equal survival in every habitat. The distribution is a dated set of records rather than a present occupancy audit.

分布条目包括 Brazil、Colombia、Ecuador、Peru 和 Bolivia。它给出海拔范围 40–1,037 米，却又称 63 米的 Tabatinga 为最低地点，这一内部差异保留。记录来自 terra-firme 非洪泛林、洪泛林及沼泽，通常在空地的溪流、湖泊或临时池边。夜间停栖高度为离地 20–100 厘米。次生林和人工开阔地中的出现使作者推测具有一定干扰耐受性，但不是实验确定的耐受阈值，也不能证明所有生境存活率相同。这是有年代的分布记录，不是现今占据审计。
conservation
A historical range polygon is not occupied habitat
历史分布多边形不是全部已占据生境

The study estimated a minimum-convex distribution polygon of 390,082 square kilometres for this account. It reported 11,093 square kilometres (2.8%) degraded by human activities. Natural-vegetation estimates used the Amazon Deforestation 2010 layer. A polygon includes intervening space and is not equivalent to occupied area, population size or measured percentage population loss. The conservation paragraph appears under reticulatus but names triangulum in its concluding Least Concern sentence; that conflicting species attribution is retained, not silently rewritten as a reticulatus assessment. Protection and broad range alone do not demonstrate a stable population or current site security.

研究为该条目估计的最小凸分布多边形面积为 390,082 平方千米。其中报告 11,093 平方千米（2.8%）受到人类活动退化影响。天然植被估计使用 Amazon Deforestation 2010 图层。多边形包含地点之间的空间，不等于已占据面积、种群量或实测种群损失百分比。保护段位于 reticulatus 条目，却在结尾“无危”句中写 triangulum；保留物种归属冲突，不悄悄改成 reticulatus 的评估。受保护和分布较广本身不能确定种群稳定或当前地点安全。
title: Systematics of the Dendropsophus leucophyllatus species complex (Anura: Hylidae): Cryptic diversity and the description of two new species

sectionLocators: PMC5332023 reading-sections section 13 paragraphs 8–9
PMC5332023 reading-sections section 13 paragraph 13; section 1 paragraph 1
PMC5332023 reading-sections section 13 paragraphs 17–18; section 1 paragraph 2

sections: morphology
The diagnosis and holotype give different size bounds
鉴别范围与正模体长并不一致

The diagnosis reports thirteen males at 28–32.4 mm snout–vent length, mean 30 mm, and one female at 33.2 mm. Yet the holotype description gives an adult male at 26.7 mm, below that diagnostic range. The discrepancy is retained rather than broadening a range without knowing which samples were included. Other diagnostic traits include a half-arm axillary membrane, basal finger webbing, toe webbing, single palmar tubercle, moderate pectoral patches and a circular sacral mark with irregular pale dorsolateral bands. One female is not a female population range, and the circular mark alone does not reconcile all historical leucophyllatus-labelled material.

鉴别报告十三只雄性吻肛长 28–32.4 毫米，平均 30 毫米，一只雌性为 33.2 毫米；然而正模描述给出成年雄性为 26.7 毫米，低于该范围。这里保留分歧，不在不知道各统计纳入哪些标本时自行扩展范围。其他特征包括延至上臂约一半的腋膜、指基部蹼、趾蹼、单一掌结节、中等胸斑，以及圆形骶斑和不规则浅色背侧带。一只雌性不是雌性种群范围，圆形斑本身也不能协调全部历史 leucophyllatus 标签材料。
appearance
Reticulated and spotted colour forms occur in the account
条目包含网纹型及斑点型

Live photographic accounts describe brown to dark-brown dorsal surfaces, sometimes white-spotted, with pale bands and circular marks white or bright yellow and often containing scattered brown spots. Reticulated individuals have a brown background with pale network lines. Limb undersides, thigh surfaces and webbing are orange-yellow to pink at night and described as orange by day; the vocal sac is yellow, belly creamy white and iris bronze. These are specimen-linked descriptive observations, not measured frequencies of morphs, proof of colour adaptation or a claim that every individual changes identically. Preserved and live pale areas remain distinct.
活体照片记载背面褐至深褐色，有时带白点；浅色带和圆斑为白或鲜黄色，常夹散在褐点。网纹个体在褐色背景上有浅色网络线。肢体腹面、大腿表面和蹼夜间为橙黄至粉色，白天描述为橙色；声囊黄色，腹乳白，虹膜青铜色。这些是关联到标本的描述观察，不是各色型频率测量、颜色适应的证明，或每只个体相同变色的断言。保存后和活体的浅色区域仍须分开。
behavior
Type II notes are absent from advertisement calls, not all calls
第二型音符不见于广告鸣声，但并非完全缺失

The advertisement account describes a single Type I trill, mean duration 0.19 s, range 0.16–0.23 s, with fifteen to nineteen pulses and mean dominant frequency about 2,655 Hz. Type II notes are absent from that advertisement account. The aggressive-call account nevertheless contains three to four Type II notes, mean note duration 0.035 s, with mean whole-call duration 0.14 s and dominant frequency about 2,669 Hz. Absence must therefore remain specific to the advertisement context. The source classification is retained rather than asserting that all behavioural functions were experimentally established; individual averages and historical reanalyses in the methods also preclude treating each summary as a new independent animal.

广告鸣声条目描述单个第一型颤音，平均持续 0.19 秒、范围 0.16–0.23 秒，含十五至十九个脉冲，平均主频约 2,655 赫兹。该广告鸣声没有第二型音符，但攻击性条目仍含三至四个第二型音符，平均音符时长 0.035 秒、整次平均 0.14 秒、主频约 2,669 赫兹。因此，“缺失”必须限于广告鸣声情境。保留来源分类不等于宣称全部行为功能均经过实验验证；方法中的个体平均和历史重新分析，也不能把每个摘要当作新独立动物。
ecology
Bolivian lowland observations and an attributed spider predation
玻利维亚低地观察与归属明确的蜘蛛捕食记载

The revision recorded arndti in Beni and Santa Cruz, Bolivia, with known elevations 148–529 m, rounded in the prose to about 150–530 m. Nocturnal records came from river shores, forest edges, temporary swamplands and artificial ponds, with perches 0–140 cm above ground or water. That combined reference surface is not an elevation above sea level or a nest measurement. A prior Jansen and Schulze report of Ancylometes spider predation was attributed, not newly observed or quantified in this revision. Regional vegetation categories include savanna, dry forest and Yungas; they do not establish that every specimen used every habitat.

修订在 Bolivia 的 Beni 和 Santa Cruz 记录 arndti，已知海拔 148–529 米，叙述中约整为 150–530 米。夜间记录来自河岸、林缘、临时沼地和人工池塘，停栖于地面或水面上 0–140 厘米。这个合并参考面不是海拔，也不是巢位测量。Ancylometes 蜘蛛捕食来自明确归属于 Jansen 与 Schulze 的较早报道，不是修订中新观察或量化的结果。地区植被类别含稀树草原、干林及 Yungas，但不说明每只标本都使用所有生境。
development
A larval description was cited under an older lineage label
幼体描述以较早谱系标签被引述

The species account points to an earlier tadpole description published under the label Dendropsophus leucophyllatus A. This explains where the authors associated larval information with arndti, but the pointer alone supplies no measured larval duration, Gosner-stage series, diet or metamorphic survival data. Those traits are not imported here from an unread referenced paper or from all frogs once labelled leucophyllatus. Any later use of that larval source must retain its voucher and lineage identity, and verify the underlying measurements before adding biological claims.

物种条目将读者引向一份以 Dendropsophus leucophyllatus A 标签发表的较早蝌蚪描述。这说明作者从哪里关联 arndti 幼体资料，但指向文献本身并未提供实测幼体期、Gosner 分期序列、食谱或变态存活数据。因此，不从尚未读取的引文或所有曾标为 leucophyllatus 的蛙中移入这些特征。后续使用该幼体来源时，仍需保留标本与谱系身份，核对原始测量后再增加生物学主张。
conservation
A historical range polygon is not occupied habitat
历史分布多边形不是全部已占据生境

The study estimated a minimum-convex distribution polygon of 66,397 square kilometres for this account. It reported 3,834 square kilometres (5.8%) degraded by human activities. Natural-vegetation estimates used the Amazon Deforestation 2010 layer. A polygon includes intervening space and is not equivalent to occupied area, population size or measured percentage population loss. The paper proposed Least Concern; this dated recommendation is not independent verification of a current Red List assessment. Protection and broad range alone do not demonstrate a stable population or current site security.

研究为该条目估计的最小凸分布多边形面积为 66,397 平方千米。其中报告 3,834 平方千米（5.8%）受到人类活动退化影响。天然植被估计使用 Amazon Deforestation 2010 图层。多边形包含地点之间的空间，不等于已占据面积、种群量或实测种群损失百分比。论文提出“无危”建议；这个有年代的建议不是对现行红色名录评估的独立核实。受保护和分布较广本身不能确定种群稳定或当前地点安全。

name: Dendropsophus vraemi

sections: morphology
A bifid palmar tubercle in an eight-male diagnosis
八只雄性鉴别中的分叉掌结节

The diagnosis measured eight males at 25.1–27.6 mm snout–vent length, mean 26 mm. It combines a half-arm axillary membrane, basal finger webbing, toe webbing, a bifid palmar tubercle and moderate pectoral patches. Thin pale dorsolateral bands, rounded shank marks and lateral sacral stripes accompany a brown to greyish-brown dorsum; no reticulated dorsal pattern was reported in the diagnosis. This is a sampled male combination, not a measured female range or proof that an unobserved colour form can never occur. Calls measured for other complex members are not vraemi acoustic observations.
鉴别测量八只雄性，吻肛长 25.1–27.6 毫米，平均 26 毫米。组合特征包括延至上臂约一半的腋膜、指基部蹼、趾蹼、分叉掌结节和中等胸斑。褐至灰褐背面具有细浅色背侧带、胫部圆斑和骶部侧条，鉴别未记载网纹背型。这是雄性样本组合，不是雌性体长范围，也不能证明未观察色型永远不会出现。复合群其他成员的鸣声测量不是 vraemi 的声学观察。
appearance
Live holotype colours and preserved variation are separate
活体正模颜色与保存变异分别记录

The live holotype had yellowish head undersides, vocal sac and belly, orange limb undersides, webbing and discs, and a dull-bronze iris. The variation account chiefly concerns preserved specimens: brown to greyish-brown background, thin creamy-white or light-brown bands, and commonly two or four unconnected sacral stripes. Two rounded shank spots were described, near the heel and mid-shank. These accounts cannot be pooled into frequencies for a live population, and the diagnostic grey-bronze versus holotype dull-bronze terminology should remain descriptive rather than treated as distinct species states. Colour alone is not a certified identification criterion.
活体正模的头部腹面、声囊和腹部为淡黄色，肢体腹面、蹼和端盘橙色，虹膜暗青铜色。变异条目主要描述保存标本：褐至灰褐背景、乳白或浅褐细带，以及常见的两条或四条不相连骶部条纹。胫部描述有两个圆斑，分别靠近足跟和中部。这些记载不能混合为活体种群频率；鉴别中的灰青铜与正模的暗青铜用词也应保持描述性质，不能当作不同物种状态。颜色本身不是已认证的辨识标准。
distribution
One recorded locality beside an Apurímac tributary
Apurímac 支流旁的一个记录地点

At publication, vraemi was known from La Mar, Ayacucho, Peru, at 694 m elevation. Individuals were collected at night on pasture vegetation about 50 cm above ground by a small stream flowing into the Apurímac River, near San Antonio. The regional vegetation category was Peruvian Yungas. A single locality and an observation in pasture do not establish a full geographic limit, preference for altered habitat or population tolerance of land-use change. The stream context and low perches do not identify a natural egg substrate, quantify larval development or prove that the frog is restricted to flowing-water breeding.

发表时，vraemi 仅记录于 Peru 的 Ayacucho 地区 La Mar，海拔 694 米。夜间在 San Antonio 附近、流入 Apurímac 河的小溪旁牧草植被上采得个体，离地约 50 厘米，地区植被类别为 Peruvian Yungas。一个地点和牧草中的观察不能确定完整地理边界、对改造生境的偏好或种群对土地利用变化的耐受。溪流背景和低位停栖也不能鉴定天然产卵基质、量化幼体发育或证明仅在流水中繁殖。
conservation
Data Deficient was the authors’ dated recommendation
资料缺乏是作者当年的建议

Given the limited information, the 2017 authors suggested Data Deficient using the IUCN 2001 criteria. This is a published recommendation, not independent confirmation of a current Red List entry. The single locality, eight measured males and absence of a detailed acoustic account constrain available knowledge but do not measure extinction probability, abundance or trend. Nearby forest and other river valleys should not be added as confirmed populations from the species name or apparent habitat suitability. Wider surveys and correctly identified material are needed to evaluate range and conservation status.
鉴于资料有限，2017 年作者依据 IUCN 2001 标准建议按“资料缺乏”处理。这是已发表的建议，不是对现行红色名录条目的独立确认。一个地点、八只测量雄性及缺少详细声学条目限制了现有知识，但不测量灭绝概率、数量或趋势。不能仅凭名称或表面生境适宜性，将附近森林和其他河谷增列为确认种群。评估分布及保护状态仍需更广调查和身份正确的材料。
