sections: morphology
Six males and one female in the diagnostic material
鉴别材料中的六只雄性与一只雌性

The diagnosis reports male snout–vent length 22.9–25.3 mm for six males and 27.2 mm for one female. A green, usually finely white-spotted dorsum, partly translucent belly, reticulated grey-white iris with a brown horizontal stripe, and male humeral spines and vocal slits form part of the combination. Inner fingers lack webbing, while outer fingers and toes have webbing; ulnar and outer tarsal folds are low. The sole known female was larger than the measured males, but that is not a population-wide estimate of sexual size dimorphism. One male was darker and more spiculate than others. Colour terminology varies between the diagnosis and specimen accounts, so identification cannot rest on one hue alone.
鉴别报告六只雄性吻肛长 22.9–25.3 毫米，一只雌性为 27.2 毫米。组合特征包括通常带细小白点的绿色背面、部分透明的腹面、具有褐色横带及网纹的灰白虹膜，以及雄性肱骨刺和声裂。内侧手指之间没有蹼，外侧指和足趾有蹼；尺侧及外跗褶较低。唯一已知雌性比所测雄性大，但这不是种群层面的性别体型差异估计。一只雄性比其他个体更暗且细刺较多。鉴别与标本条目的颜色用词有所变化，不能只凭一种色调辨识。
ecology
Nocturnal records along narrow forest streams
狭窄森林溪流旁的夜间记录

At Las Caucheras, six frogs were found on shrub and fern leaves near a stream and river, 20–250 cm above ground, with five calling. Other records include a male two metres above stream level at Río Pucayacu and a calling individual 230 cm above ground at Chamanapamba. These different reference surfaces are retained. Streams were reported at 100–150 cm width in primary and secondary forest. Only three individuals were found during the cited three-year Yanayacu inventory, leading the authors to suggest rarity; encounter numbers without a detection model are not population density. Occurrence in a paddock or secondary forest does not establish disturbance tolerance or breeding success there.

Las Caucheras 在溪流及河流附近的灌木和蕨叶上发现六只蛙，离地 20–250 厘米，其中五只鸣叫。其他记录包括 Río Pucayacu 水面上约两米的雄蛙，以及 Chamanapamba 离地 230 厘米的鸣叫个体，保留地面与溪流水面参考面的区别。所报溪宽为 100–150 厘米，位于原生及次生林。引述的 Yanayacu 三年调查仅发现三只，作者因此认为可能稀少；没有检测模型的遭遇数量不是种群密度。牧场或次生林中的出现不能确定干扰耐受性或当地繁殖成功。
reproduction
Three clutches on the upper leaf surface
叶片上表面的三团卵

At Chamanapamba, the researchers found three clutches with embryos at Gosner stage 22, attached to the upper side of a leaf approximately 170 cm above a small stream. The clutches contained twenty-eight, twenty-one and forty-seven embryos. An adult male was observed near the eggs. These are three observed embryo counts, not a measured mean laid-clutch size, lifetime fecundity or proof that all clutches are deposited at that height. A male nearby does not by itself demonstrate parentage, continuous guarding or experimentally confirmed benefits of attendance. Hatching success and development duration were not established by this observation.
研究者在 Chamanapamba 发现三团处于 Gosner 第 22 期的胚胎，附在小溪上方约 170 厘米的叶片上表面，分别含二十八、二十一和四十七个胚胎。卵附近观察到一只成年雄蛙。这是三次胚胎数量观察，不是实测平均产卵数、终生繁殖力，也不证明全部卵团都位于该高度。雄蛙在附近本身不能确定亲子关系、持续护卵或陪护的实验性收益。该观察也没有确定孵化成功率及发育时长。
behavior
A two-note field call recorded at ten degrees Celsius
十摄氏度下录得的双音符野外鸣声

The field description used one recording from male ZSFQ 5369 at Yanayacu on 11 March 2023, at 23:19 and 10 °C. Calls contained two pulsed notes, averaged 0.203 s and had mean dominant frequency 3.7 kHz. The first note averaged 0.102 s and 12.3 pulses, while the second averaged 0.045 s with two or three pulses. Inter-call intervals were 13.7–15.0 s and call rate 4.1 per minute. Notes, calls and pulses are distinct units; repeated measurements from one recording do not become independent frogs. This temperature- and individual-specific account is not a complete acoustic range or a universal identification threshold.

野外描述采用雄蛙 ZSFQ 5369 于 2023 年三月十一日在 Yanayacu 的一份录音，时间为 23:19、温度 10 摄氏度。每次鸣声含两个脉冲音符，平均持续 0.203 秒、主频 3.7 千赫兹。第一音符平均 0.102 秒、12.3 个脉冲；第二音符平均 0.045 秒、含二或三个脉冲。鸣声间隔为 13.7–15.0 秒，速率为每分钟 4.1 次。音符、鸣声和脉冲是不同单位，一份录音的重复测量不能变成独立蛙数。这个带温度及个体范围的记载不是完整声学范围或通用辨识阈值。
behavior
Laboratory interaction calls are a separate sample
实验室互动鸣声是另一组样本

The authors also accessed a laboratory recording from another male, QCAZ 26032, during male interaction. Recording quality did not permit precise note and pulse measurements, although frequency, total duration and spacing could be measured. Calls still contained two notes, but intervals were much shorter, 0.343–0.844 s, and call rate was 81.4–89.6 per minute. Reported call duration ranged 0.198–1.284 s and dominant frequency 3.5–4.1 kHz. These values remain separate from the field male and cannot be pooled into an ordinary wild calling rate. Social context may explain differences, but this account does not isolate a causal mechanism through a controlled experiment.

作者还取得另一只雄蛙 QCAZ 26032 在雄性互动时的实验室录音。质量不足以精确测量音符和脉冲，但可以测量频率、整次时长与间隔。鸣声仍含两个音符，间隔却短得多，为 0.343–0.844 秒，速率每分钟 81.4–89.6 次；报告时长为 0.198–1.284 秒、主频 3.5–4.1 千赫兹。这些数值与野外雄蛙分开，不合并成通常的野外鸣叫速率。社会情境可能解释差异，但该记载没有通过控制实验隔离因果机制。
conservation
Four recorded cloud-forest localities and a dated proposal
四个云雾林记录地点与有年代的保护建议

The distribution account named Las Caucheras, Yanayacu, Chamanapamba and Río Pucayaku at Nelson Palacios Reserve, on the eastern Ecuadorian Andes, at 2,100–2,586 m. The authors estimated extent of occurrence below 5,000 square kilometres and proposed Endangered, citing deforestation and fragmentation associated with agriculture and cattle farming. Some records were in private reserves, but that does not establish secure habitat or a stable population. The 2024 proposal is not independent confirmation of a current IUCN listing, and extent of occurrence is neither occupied habitat nor frog density. Four known localities do not prove that no other population exists.

分布条目列出 Ecuador 东安第斯的 Las Caucheras、Yanayacu、Chamanapamba 和 Nelson Palacios 保护区的 Río Pucayaku，海拔 2,100–2,586 米。作者估计分布范围面积低于 5,000 平方千米，引用农业和养牛造成的毁林与破碎化，提出“濒危”建议。部分记录位于私人保护区，并不能确定生境安全或种群稳定。2024 年建议不是对现行 IUCN 名录的独立确认；分布范围面积也不是实际占据生境或蛙密度。四个已知地点不能证明没有其他种群。
evolution
A supported lineage within an unresolved polytomy
具有支持的谱系位于未解决的多分支中

Elisae was recovered as monophyletic, with posterior probability 1 and bootstrap 84. Its broader clade contained an unresolved polytomy with venezuelense and potential unnamed Colombian and northern Ecuadorian lineages. The analyses used mitochondrial 12S and 16S, not nuclear genomic data. An unresolved node cannot be rewritten as a unique sister relationship, and cf. venezuelense is not a certified assignment of every Colombian specimen to that accepted species. Support for the sampled elisae lineage does not prove absence of gene flow or resolve all species boundaries in the complex.

elisae 被恢复为单系，后验概率 1、自展支持 84。更广支系中，它与 venezuelense、潜在未命名的 Colombia 及 Ecuador 北部谱系构成未解决多分支。分析使用线粒体 12S 和 16S，不是核基因组数据。未解决节点不能改写为唯一姐妹关系，cf. venezuelense 也不认证全部 Colombia 标本属于该接受种。受采 elisae 谱系的支持不证明没有基因流，也未解决复合群全部物种界限。
title: Simplifying the Centrolene buckleyi complex (Amphibia: Anura: Centrolenidae): a taxonomic review and description of two new species

name: Centrolene marcoreyesi
readScope: Centrolene marcoreyesi: Six-male diagnosis with unknown females, stream habitat and one egg clutch, historical and modern acoustic context, uncertain tape elevation, four localities, threatened-status proposal and mitochondrial sister relationship; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sectionLocators: PMC11348905 reading-sections section 4 paragraphs 67, 72
PMC11348905 reading-sections section 4 paragraph 76
PMC11348905 reading-sections section 4 paragraph 76
PMC11348905 reading-sections section 4 paragraphs 77–78
PMC11348905 reading-sections section 4 paragraph 79
PMC11348905 reading-sections section 4 paragraphs 81–82; section 8 paragraphs 1, 3
PMC11348905 reading-sections section 4 paragraph 83; section 2 paragraphs 0–1
sections: morphology
Male measurements do not supply the unknown female range
雄性测量不能补填未知雌性范围

The diagnosis gives six adult males at 24.5–27.0 mm snout–vent length and explicitly leaves female size unknown. Dorsal skin is finely roughened, usually with low whitish spots; the anterior two-thirds of the belly are pale and the posterior third translucent. Adult males have humeral spines, vocal sacs and slits, while ulnar and tarsal folds are conspicuous. Live photographs of MUTPL 271 show green dorsal surfaces, pale spots, green bones and a white iris with a lavender tinge and fine brown reticulation. These specimen and sex-specific features are not measurements of females or a certified diagnostic state for every population.
鉴别给出六只成年雄性吻肛长 24.5–27.0 毫米，明确注明雌性体长未知。背部皮肤细密粗糙，通常有低矮白斑；腹面前约三分之二较浅，后三分之一透明。成年雄性有肱骨刺、声囊和声裂，尺褶与跗褶明显。MUTPL 271 活体照片记载绿色背面、浅斑、绿色骨骼，以及略带淡紫色和细褐网纹的白虹膜。这些关联标本及性别的特征不是雌性测量，也不认证全部种群的固定鉴别状态。
ecology
Streamside perches use several reference surfaces
溪边停栖记录采用不同参考面

Males were recorded at night on leaves and herbaceous vegetation by streams, in primary and secondary forest and pasture edges. Abra de Zamora callers were about one metre above water; Podocarpus callers were about two metres above fast streams. Guarumales records included 150–350 cm above ground, with some individuals lower or on ferns, and streams two to eight metres wide. Ground and water height are not interchangeable, and these perch observations do not identify all breeding substrates or measure habitat preference. The sympatric species lists do not establish competition, predation or equivalent ecological niches.
夜间在溪流旁叶片和草本植被上记录雄蛙，涉及原生林、次生林及牧场边缘。Abra de Zamora 鸣叫个体约在水面上一米，Podocarpus 个体约在急流上方两米。Guarumales 有离地 150–350 厘米的记录，也有较低或蕨叶上的个体，溪宽为二至八米。地面与水面高度不能互换，停栖观察不能鉴定全部繁殖基质或测量生境偏好。同域物种列表也不确定竞争、捕食或生态位等价。
reproduction
A male calling near one nineteen-egg clutch
一团十九枚卵附近的鸣叫雄蛙

At Guarumales, male CJ 12631 was observed calling near a clutch containing nineteen eggs, one reported dead. This is one clutch and a nearby calling male, not a mean clutch size, a population hatching rate or proof of continuous parental care. The dead egg cannot be used to infer the eventual survival of the other eighteen. Neither parentage nor duration of attendance was established in the text. Egg evidence from elisae, including its three counts and Gosner stage, belongs to that separate species and is not transferred to marcoreyesi.
在 Guarumales，雄蛙 CJ 12631 在一团十九枚卵附近鸣叫，其中一枚记为死亡。这是一团卵和附近的鸣叫雄蛙，不是平均每窝卵数、种群孵化率或持续亲代照料的证明。死亡的一枚不能用于推断其余十八枚的最终存活。文字未确定亲子关系或陪护持续时间。elisae 的三次卵数及 Gosner 分期属于另一个物种，不移用于 marcoreyesi。
behavior
One-note calls and closely spaced consecutive calls
单音符鸣声与短间隔连续鸣声

The pooled description used three 1975 recordings at 11 °C and two 2017 recordings at 14.5 °C from Abra de Zamora. Regular calls contained one pulsed note, with mean duration 0.085 s, mean dominant frequency 3.3 kHz and mean interval 34.1 s. Two modern males also emitted consecutive calls separated by 0.8–1.7 s; those were still consecutive calls, not the two-note structure described for elisae. The authors proposed an effect of nearby competing males, whose distance was below half a metre, but did not experimentally isolate that cause. Repeated calls do not become additional independent animals.

合并描述使用 Abra de Zamora 的三份 1975 年录音（11 摄氏度）和两份 2017 年录音（14.5 摄氏度）。通常鸣声含一个脉冲音符，平均持续 0.085 秒、主频 3.3 千赫兹、间隔 34.1 秒。两只现代受录雄蛙还发出间隔 0.8–1.7 秒的连续鸣声；这些仍是相继的鸣声，不是 elisae 的双音符结构。作者提出可能受到相距不足半米的竞争雄性影响，但没有实验隔离该原因。重复鸣声不能变成更多独立动物。
behavior
Historical differences are confounded by recording conditions
历史差异受录音条件影响，不能直接解释为演化变化

The 1975 calls lasted 0.098–0.131 s, with pulse rate 58.8–93.4 per second, whereas 2017 calls lasted 0.053–0.081 s with pulse rate 103.3–137.5 per second. The later sample was recorded at a higher temperature, and the authors considered weather and male behaviour as other explanations. These comparisons do not demonstrate evolutionary change over forty-two years. The old tape states elevation 2,850 m, which the authors considered probably incorrect; it is not added as a verified upper distribution record. Historical buckleyi identifications of those recordings require the revision’s specific reassignment, not transfer of every older buckleyi recording.

1975 年鸣声持续 0.098–0.131 秒、脉冲速率每秒 58.8–93.4，2017 年为 0.053–0.081 秒、每秒 103.3–137.5。较晚样本的录音温度更高，作者也考虑天气和雄性行为等解释。比较不能证明四十二年间发生了演化变化。旧磁带标注海拔 2,850 米，作者认为很可能错误，因此不将其增加为核实的分布上限。那些录音的历史 buckleyi 鉴定需要修订中的具体重新归属，不能移用所有旧 buckleyi 录音。
conservation
Four southern Andean localities and threats within protected areas
南安第斯四个地点及保护区内的威胁

The distribution account names San Francisco Scientific Station, Abra de Zamora, Podocarpus and Guarumales on the eastern southern Ecuadorian Andes, at 1,840–2,190 m. The authors estimated extent of occurrence below 100 square kilometres and proposed Endangered. Identified concerns included cattle-driven habitat change, introduced species, fires and legal or illegal mining; protected-area occurrence did not remove those concerns. These are the 2024 paper’s records and assessment proposal, not a fresh audit of each site or confirmation of a current Red List category. Extent of occurrence is not occupied area or population size, and no percentage decline caused by each threat was quantified.

分布条目列出 Ecuador 南部东安第斯的 San Francisco 科学站、Abra de Zamora、Podocarpus 和 Guarumales，海拔 1,840–2,190 米。作者估计分布范围面积低于 100 平方千米，提出“濒危”建议。担忧包括养牛导致的生境改变、引入物种、火灾及合法或非法采矿；保护区记录并未消除这些问题。这是 2024 年论文的记录及评估建议，不是对各地点的新审计或现行红色名录等级确认。分布范围面积不等于占据面积或种群量，论文未量化各威胁造成的下降比例。
evolution
Lineage support and sister-node support differ
本谱系支持度与姐妹节点支持度不同

Marcoreyesi was inferred monophyletic with posterior probability 0.99 and bootstrap 98. Its sister relationship to sabini had posterior probability 0.82 and bootstrap 94, which the authors characterized as moderate rather than equivalent to support for marcoreyesi itself. Analyses used mitochondrial 12S and 16S. These support values are not dates, geographic dispersal probabilities or experimental evidence of reproductive isolation. The relationship does not permit importing sabini morphology, eggs or calls into marcoreyesi, nor does it certify absence of gene flow.
marcoreyesi 被推断为单系，后验概率 0.99、自展支持 98；与 sabini 的姐妹关系后验概率为 0.82、自展支持 94，作者将其称为中等支持，不能与 marcoreyesi 本身的支持等同。分析使用线粒体 12S 和 16S。这些支持值不是年代、地理扩散概率或生殖隔离的实验依据。姐妹关系也不能将 sabini 的形态、卵或鸣声移入 marcoreyesi，或认证没有基因流。
title: Simplifying the Centrolene buckleyi complex (Amphibia: Anura: Centrolenidae): a taxonomic review and description of two new species

name: Centrolene buckleyi
readScope: Centrolene buckleyi: Restricted sensu-stricto diagnostic sample and appearance, uncertain countries and revised historic assignments, two attributed recordings and untested social-call explanation; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sectionLocators: PMC11348905 reading-sections section 4 paragraphs 18, 20, 22
PMC11348905 reading-sections section 4 paragraph 29
PMC11348905 reading-sections section 4 paragraphs 30–31
PMC11348905 reading-sections section 4 paragraph 31
sections: morphology
The amended diagnosis belongs to buckleyi sensu stricto
修订鉴别属于狭义 buckleyi

The amended account gives seventeen males at 26.1–32.5 mm snout–vent length and thirteen females at 24.2–39.8 mm. Although females are described as larger overall, the sampled ranges overlap and some females fall below the male minimum. Green dorsal surfaces, a pale lip and flank line, green bones and a reticulated grey-white iris with brown horizontal stripe form part of the combination. Adult males have humeral spines, vocal slits and sacs, and conspicuous dorsal spicules reported absent in females. These traits describe the restricted examined concept, not every historical population once labelled buckleyi or a fixed sex-based size cutoff.
修订条目给出十七只雄性吻肛长 26.1–32.5 毫米，十三只雌性为 24.2–39.8 毫米。虽然描述称雌性整体较大，样本范围相互重叠，部分雌性低于雄性最小值。组合特征包括绿色背面、浅色唇缘和体侧线、绿色骨骼，以及带褐色横带和网纹的灰白虹膜。成年雄性有肱骨刺、声裂及声囊，明显背部细刺记为雌性缺失。这些描述属于所检查的狭义概念，不是全部曾标为 buckleyi 的历史种群，或固定的性别体长界限。
distribution
Colombian and Peruvian occurrence remained uncertain
Colombia 和 Peru 的出现仍不确定

The revision restricted confirmed buckleyi sensu stricto records to northern and central Ecuadorian Andean ranges, with the distribution account giving 2,677–3,416 m and the neotype at Cuicocha. It explicitly regarded occurrence in Colombia and Peru as uncertain and reassigned Guarumales material to marcoreyesi. Separately, an analysed historical Papallacta recording was labelled 2,660 m, slightly below the distribution paragraph’s lower bound; these source scopes remain distinct. Forest, shrub, páramo and pasture records do not demonstrate complete habitat occupancy or an experimental disturbance threshold. Neither old country lists nor records reassigned to a new species are silently retained as confirmed current buckleyi records.

修订将确认的狭义 buckleyi 记录限于 Ecuador 北部至中部安第斯山系，分布条目给出海拔 2,677–3,416 米，新模来自 Cuicocha。论文明确认为 Colombia 和 Peru 的出现不确定，并将 Guarumales 材料重新归入 marcoreyesi。另有受分析的 Papallacta 历史录音标为 2,660 米，略低于分布段下界，两种来源范围分别保留。森林、灌丛、páramo 高山植被及牧场记录不确定完整生境占据或实验性干扰阈值。不将旧国家名录或已重新归属新种的记录悄悄保留为现行确认 buckleyi 分布。
behavior
Only specifically attributed recordings support this account
只有明确归属的录音支持该条目

The authors distinguished three historical call descriptions and considered only the Oyacachi description attributable to buckleyi sensu stricto. Their analysis used the Oyacachi male recorded in 2012 and a Papallacta recording from 1975, both labelled 10 °C. Regular calls were single pulsed notes, mean duration 0.261 s, mean dominant frequency 2.9 kHz and call rate 1.4–2.8 per minute; mean pulse count was 17.9. These measured summaries do not apply to recordings now assigned to elisae or marcoreyesi. Multiple calls and pulses within a recording are repeated measurements, not additional independent frogs or populations.

作者区分三份历史鸣声描述，认为其中仅 Oyacachi 描述可归于狭义 buckleyi。其分析采用该地点一只雄蛙的 2012 年录音及 Papallacta 的 1975 年录音，两者标注温度均为 10 摄氏度。通常鸣声为单个脉冲音符，平均持续 0.261 秒、主频 2.9 千赫兹，速率每分钟 1.4–2.8 次，平均脉冲数 17.9。这些摘要不用于已归入 elisae 或 marcoreyesi 的录音。一份录音内多个鸣声与脉冲是重复测量，不是更多独立蛙或种群。
behavior
A five-call sequence does not establish its social trigger
五次连续鸣声不能确定社会触发原因

Male MZUTI 0763 also produced a sequence of five consecutive calls with regular-call structure but much shorter intervals, 0.7–0.9 s. The authors proposed nearby females or competing males as likely triggers. That is an interpretation of a calling sequence, not a controlled test distinguishing mate attraction from aggression. The shortened intervals do not turn the sequence into a new two-note call type or a species-wide maximum calling rate. Calls from elisae interacting laboratory males remain a different individual, species and setting.
雄蛙 MZUTI 0763 还发出五次连续鸣声，结构与通常鸣声相同，但间隔缩短至 0.7–0.9 秒。作者提出附近雌性或竞争雄性可能触发。这是对鸣叫序列的解释，不是区分求偶和攻击功能的控制实验。缩短间隔不能将序列变成新的双音符类型，也不确定全物种最大鸣叫速率。elisae 实验室互动雄蛙的鸣声仍属于另一只个体、另一个物种和不同环境。
title: Simplifying the Centrolene buckleyi complex (Amphibia: Anura: Centrolenidae): a taxonomic review and description of two new species

name: Andrias davidianus

sections: ecology
Eight source-labelled captive adults at one breeding base
一个繁殖基地的八只来源标签成体

The study selected four males and four females labelled Andrias davidianus, aged seven to eleven years, with reported body lengths 1.03–1.28 m and masses 6.9–12.6 kg. These are selected captive adult measurements, not wild age limits, species maximum size or snout–vent lengths. The facility was in Sangzhi County, Hunan, at 471 m elevation, with an artificial stream and caves. Monitoring ran from July to October in 2020–2022. The selected subjects do not become twenty-four independent animals simply because three years were covered. The methods do not establish genetic equivalence to every currently recognized Chinese Andrias lineage, so the source label is retained with that identity limitation.

研究选择四只雄性和四只雌性，标签为 Andrias davidianus，年龄七至十一岁，报告体长 1.03–1.28 米、体重 6.9–12.6 千克。这是受选圈养成体的测量，不是野生年龄界限、物种最大尺寸或吻肛长。基地位于湖南桑植县，海拔 471 米，设人工溪流及洞穴；监测覆盖 2020–2022 年七月至十月。覆盖三年不能把八只受选个体变成二十四只独立动物。方法没有确定它们与当前每个中国 Andrias 谱系的遗传等同性，因此保留来源标签及身份限制。
behavior
An ethogram distinguishes postures, actions and settings
行为谱区分姿态、动作及环境

The PAE framework separately coded posture, action and environment. Investigators reviewed one day of video at two-day intervals, then sampled about twenty percent of marked footage for focal analysis. They defined ten postures, thirty-three actions, eleven environmental factors and forty-five behavioural patterns in nine functional categories. These counts refer to different coding levels and cannot be added as independent behaviours, animals or prevalence estimates. A behavioural category can combine several actions and settings. The ethogram describes the monitored captive breeding period; behaviours unrecorded in that sampling regime are not thereby proven absent from wild individuals or other seasons.
PAE 框架分别编码姿态、动作和环境。研究者按两日间隔观察一日视频，再从已标记行为片段中抽取约百分之二十作焦点分析，定义十种姿态、三十三种动作、十一项环境因素和四十五种行为模式，分为九个功能类别。这些数目对应不同编码层级，不能相加为独立行为数、动物数或发生比例。一类行为可结合多种动作与环境。行为谱描述受监测的圈养繁殖期，该采样方案未记录的行为不因此被证明在野生个体或其他季节不存在。
reproduction
The monitored breeding period differs from the spawning peak
受监测繁殖期与产卵高峰不同

The base’s breeding period was described as July–October, including preparation, spawning and subsequent care. Spawning in the study occurred mainly in August. The discussion separately cited earlier July–September reproduction and August–mid-October incubation accounts; those cited background periods are not new longitudinal measurements of all eight subjects. A broad breeding period is not the duration of egg deposition by each female or a universal wild calendar. Comparisons with Japanese giant salamanders and hellbenders in the discussion belong to those separate species and do not enlarge the measured davidianus sample.
基地繁殖期描述为七月至十月，包含准备、产卵和后续照料；本研究产卵主要在八月。讨论另引述较早的七月至九月繁殖期，以及八月至十月中旬孵化期，不能把这些背景资料写成对八只个体新完成的长期测量。较宽的繁殖期不是每只雌性产卵持续时间，也不是普遍野生日历。讨论中日本大鲵及美洲隐鳃鲵的比较属于各自物种，不扩展受测 davidianus 样本。
behavior
Gravel displacement and flowing-water exposure were observed
观察到推移砂砾与接受流水冲淋

Males displaced gravel outward from the cave floor using the head, limbs, body and tail. They also moved toward the water inlet and exposed parts of the body to flowing water, a category called showering. The authors discussed possible nesting-space, water-quality and egg-retention benefits of gravel displacement, and possible reproductive-development effects of showering, drawing partly on earlier literature. Observing these actions does not experimentally prove each proposed benefit or establish that every wild male performs them in the same order. The facility’s water inlet and cave construction constrain the settings in which the recorded actions occurred.
雄性用头、肢体、身体及尾将洞底砂砾向外推移，也移向进水口，让身体各部位接受流水，研究将后一类称为冲淋。作者结合部分早期文献讨论推砂可能增加产卵空间、改善水质及减少卵流失，冲淋可能影响繁殖发育。观察动作并没有通过实验确认每项拟议收益，也不确定所有野生雄性按相同顺序执行。基地进水口和洞穴构造限定了这些动作发生的环境。
reproduction
Physical contact was coded during courtship and oviposition
求偶与产卵期间编码了身体接触

The ethogram grouped following, side-by-side abdominal contact, riding and other contact under courtship, and described intertwining, cloacal investigation and related actions around oviposition. Male ejaculation and female egg release were included in the source account. These are source-defined behavioural categories in a simulated natural breeding setting, not measured genetic mating success or a complete sequence shared by every pair. Discussion of pheromonal effects and reproductive synchronization relies partly on cited literature; the monitored contact footage alone does not isolate a chemical mechanism, quantify hormone changes or demonstrate causation.
行为谱把跟随、并排腹部接触、骑跨等动作归于求偶，并在产卵前后描述交缠、泄殖腔探查及相关动作；来源条目包含雄性排精与雌性排卵。这是在模拟自然繁殖环境中的来源分类，不是遗传交配成功率测量，也不是每对个体共同的完整序列。讨论的信息素作用和繁殖同步部分依赖引文，监测到接触动作本身不能隔离化学机制、量化激素变化或证明因果。
reproduction
Male egg care includes movement and egg consumption
雄性卵照料包含运动及食卵

The source described females leaving the cave after spawning and males attending offspring with tail fanning, agitation, shaking and egg-eating. The discussion proposed that water movement improved oxygen supply and that removal of unfertilized or diseased eggs could reduce contamination, citing earlier work. Those proposed functions are not controlled estimates of survival benefit in this study. The category egg-eating does not imply indiscriminate consumption of every viable egg, but the descriptions also do not provide a measured selection rule or an individual-by-individual hatch-success comparison. Captive care observations are not assumed for all wild or genetically distinct Andrias populations.
来源描述雌性产卵后离洞，雄性通过扇尾、搅动、抖动及食卵照料后代。讨论引述早期研究，提出水体运动可改善供氧，清除未受精或病卵可能减少污染；本研究没有通过控制实验估算这些功能的存活收益。“食卵”类别不表示无差别吞食全部活卵，但描述也没有提供实测选择规则或逐个体孵化成功率比较。圈养照料观察不能推定适用于全部野生或遗传不同的 Andrias 种群。
ecology
Artificial caves describe the study setting, not universal requirements
人工洞穴尺寸描述研究环境，而非普遍需求

The monitored caves were reported at 0.9–1.5 square metres, with entrances 0.25–0.35 m wide and 0.30–0.35 m high. The discussion recommended water depth around 0.3–0.4 m for the facility’s breeding setting. Cave area, entrance dimensions and water depth are distinct measurements and are not natural-range habitat limits. The study did not randomly compare cave sizes to isolate a minimum requirement, a universal optimal depth or protection from enemies. Earlier claims about space and gonadal development were cited background; they cannot be treated as a dose-response experiment performed on these eight subjects.
受监测洞穴报告面积 0.9–1.5 平方米，入口宽 0.25–0.35 米、高 0.30–0.35 米；讨论为该基地繁殖环境建议约 0.3–0.4 米水深。洞面积、入口尺寸与水深是不同测量，不是自然分布的生境界限。研究没有随机比较洞穴尺寸，以隔离最低需求、普遍最优水深或防御效果。空间与性腺发育的较早主张是引述背景，不能当作在八只个体上完成的剂量反应实验。
ecology
Measured water conditions are not thermal or chemical tolerance limits
实测水条件不是温度或化学耐受界限

Water quality was monitored every thirty minutes. During the study, water temperature ranged 16.9–22.8 °C, dissolved oxygen 5.50–9.25 mg/L and pH 6.58–7.70. These describe conditions encountered in the artificial stream, not experimentally determined critical temperatures, lethal limits or a universal optimum. The discussion cited separate temperature recommendations for gonadal development and incubation; those are not interchangeable with the measured environmental range. Successful spawning under the combined conditions does not identify the independent contribution of temperature, oxygen, pH, diet or cave geometry, and does not establish wild-release success.
水质每三十分钟监测一次，研究期间水温为 16.9–22.8 摄氏度，溶解氧 5.50–9.25 毫克每升，pH 为 6.58–7.70。这描述人工溪流中经历的条件，不是实验确定的临界温度、致死界限或普遍最优值。讨论另引述性腺发育和孵化的温度建议，不能与实测环境范围互换。组合条件下成功产卵，也不能确定温度、氧、pH、食物或洞形各自的独立贡献，更不能确定野外放归成功。
title: Ethogram of the Chinese Giant Salamander during the Breeding Period Based on the PAE Coding System

sections: morphology
A pointed snout and flattened head distinguish the examined material
检查材料具有突出尖吻和扁平头部

The revision reports male snout–vent length of 41–45 mm and female length of 51–62 mm. The broad, flattened, fish-like head has a pointed snout projecting 1.75–3.45 mm. Toes are webbed, with 1–1.5 phalanges of toe IV free; a superior lip stripe and obvious inguinal streak are absent in the diagnosis. These are a combination of characters from examined material, not independent identification by size alone. The sex-specific ranges are not total body lengths or measurements of every population.
修订报告雄性吻肛长 41–45 毫米，雌性 51–62 毫米。宽而扁平、呈鱼形的头具有尖吻，突出 1.75–3.45 毫米。趾间有蹼，第四趾有 1–1.5 个指节游离；鉴别记为没有上唇条纹和明显腹股沟条纹。这是检查材料的组合特征，不能仅凭体长独立鉴定。分性别范围不是含尾全长，也不是全部种群的测量。

Water-edge holes and rocks were used by day and night
白昼与夜间利用水边孔穴及岩石

Observations in rainforest and bamboo habitat extended from 09:00 to 00:15. Frogs occupied holes and rock interstices near stagnant water or rivers, with fast streams rarely reported. Rocks and ground were used mainly during the day; no leaf or branch perches were observed, although specimen UADBA 4521 was collected on a root. The account describes semi-aquatic and burrowing behaviour, without establishing obligatory underground nesting or absence from vegetation throughout the species range. Observation times are encounter records, not an experimentally measured daily activity budget.
雨林及竹林中的观察时刻覆盖 09:00–00:15。蛙利用静水或河流附近的孔穴和岩隙，急流记录较少。白天主要见于岩石和地面；未观察到叶片或枝条栖位，但标本 UADBA 4521 采于树根。条目描述半水生及穴居行为，没有确定必须地下筑巢，也不证明全分布范围均不利用植被。时间是遇见记录，不是实验测量的昼夜活动预算。
distribution
The revision places confirmed records in southeastern rainforest
修订将确认记录置于东南部雨林

The distribution account restricts catalai to southeastern Madagascan rainforest at low and middle elevations. It provides no numerical elevation bounds in this paragraph, so low and middle are retained as qualitative source categories. This locality summary is not a mapped area of occupancy, a complete survey of the southeast, or evidence that suitable but unsampled forest is occupied. Records assigned to other Ochthomantis species are not pooled into this distribution.
分布条目将 catalai 限于 Madagascar 东南部低至中海拔雨林。该段没有给出数值海拔界限，因此保留低、中海拔作为来源定性分类。这份地点摘要不是占据面积图、东南部完整调查，也不证明适宜但未采样森林已被占据。不将其他 Ochthomantis 物种记录并入其分布。
taxonomy
Resurrection includes a specific historical sequence reassignment
恢复种名包含特定历史序列的重新归属

Previously treated as a synonym of femoralis, catalai was resurrected after examination of types, morphology and mitochondrial 16S groupings; the resurrection account reports 33 examined specimens. The molecular group includes AY324821, voucher FGMV 2002.173, formerly labelled cf. mocquardi and candidate species 47, alongside material associated with Ambatolahy, Ranomafana. This is a particular voucher reassignment, not permission to relabel all mocquardi records. The revision’s greater-than-3% pairwise 16S distances support its integrative argument; they are not a universal species threshold or whole-genome proof of reproductive isolation.

catalai 曾被视为 femoralis 的异名，修订结合模式材料、形态及线粒体 16S 分组恢复种名；恢复条目报告检查 33 件标本。分子组包含 AY324821，凭证 FGMV 2002.173，过去标为 cf. mocquardi 及候选种 47，并关联 Ambatolahy、Ranomafana 材料。这是特定凭证的重新归属，不能据此重标全部 mocquardi 记录。修订中物种间超过 3% 的 16S 距离支持其综合论证，不是普遍物种阈值或全基因组生殖隔离证明。
title: Revision of the Subgenus Ochthomantis Frogs from Madagascar (Amphibia: Mantellidae) with the Description of Four Species and Resurrection of Mantidactylus catalai and M. poissoni †

sections: morphology
Sex-specific spotting accompanies the diagnostic combination

Males measure 39.7–48.2 mm and females 53–66 mm snout–vent length. The diagnosis gives terminal disc width relative to its base at least 1.70, a dimensionless ratio. Females have one large white spot below the eye, whereas males have numerous white spots. The tibiotarsal articulation reaches the nostril; a continuous pale head/flank line and pale inguinal patch are absent. Spotting and limb reach belong to a combined diagnosis, rather than a colour-only identification rule or a millimetre measurement of the disc ratio.
雄性吻肛长为 39.7–48.2 毫米，雌性为 53–66 毫米。鉴别给出末端趾盘宽与其基部宽之比至少 1.70，这是无量纲比值。雌性眼下有一个大白斑，雄性则有多个白斑。胫跗关节达鼻孔，没有连续浅色头部—体侧线和浅色腹股沟斑。斑纹与肢端位置属于组合鉴别，不能只靠颜色鉴定，也不能把趾盘比值写成毫米。

Encounter positions change between daytime and night records
白天与夜间记录具有不同遇见位置

Frogs were encountered from 16:00 to 21:30 around small rocky streams less than one metre deep. Daytime records were on the ground 5–10 m from banks; night records were 3–5 m from rivers, including leaf perches 50–100 cm high. UADBA 7125 was found on a rock in fast water. The authors interpreted that occurrence as a possible misfortune, which is not proof of an accident or inability to use flowing water. Distances and heights describe reported encounters, without a controlled habitat preference or complete activity census.
在水深不足一米的小型多岩溪流周围，遇见时间为 16:00–21:30。白天记录位于距岸 5–10 米的地面，夜间记录距河 3–5 米，包含高 50–100 厘米的叶片栖位。UADBA 7125 见于急流中的岩石。作者将其解释为可能遭遇意外，这不能证明事故或无法利用流水。距离与高度描述报告的遇见情况，不是控制实验确定的生境偏好或完整活动普查。

Eastern-slope forests are described without numeric elevation limits
东坡森林记录没有数值海拔界限

The source places poissoni in forests on Madagascar’s eastern slope at middle and high elevations. This paragraph supplies no numerical limits, and no elevation range is reconstructed from the qualitative wording. Forest occurrence does not establish continuous occupancy along the eastern slope or abundance within each locality. Historical names require the revision’s specimen-level reassessment before they can be treated as confirmed records of the resurrected species.
来源将 poissoni 置于 Madagascar 东坡中至高海拔森林。该段没有数值界限，不从定性措辞重建海拔范围。森林出现不确定沿东坡连续占据，也不确定各地点丰度。历史名称必须经过修订中的标本层面复核，才能当作恢复物种的确认记录。

Twelve examined specimens include one genetic reference
十二件检查标本中有一个遗传参考

The resurrection account reports twelve examined poissoni specimens, while the species comments identify AMNH A174653, field number RAX 9367, as the sole genetic reference. The revision uses type comparison and mitochondrial evidence to reinstate the species; one genetic reference does not establish variation throughout its range, multilocus population structure or current equivalence of every historic record.
恢复种名条目报告检查十二件 poissoni 标本，而物种评论将 AMNH A174653、野外编号 RAX 9367 列为唯一遗传参考。因此，形态样本数不是独立测序个体数。修订以模式比较及线粒体证据恢复该种；一个遗传参考不能确定全分布范围变异、多位点种群结构或每条历史记录的现行概念等价。

Granular brown colour and a narrow inguinal streak form part of the diagnosis
颗粒状褐色及窄腹股沟条纹属于鉴别组合

The account reports males at 33–42 mm and females at 42–59 mm snout–vent length. Dark brown surfaces carry black granules, with a narrow, sometimes interrupted pale yellow inguinal streak; a continuous lower-flank pale stripe and obvious white eye spot are absent. Toe IV has 1.5–2 inner phalanges free, the reported webbing score is greater than seven, and the tibiotarsal articulation extends beyond the nostril. 条目报告雄性吻肛长 33–42 毫米、雌性 42–59 毫米。深褐表面有黑色颗粒，浅黄色腹股沟条纹窄且有时中断；没有连续下体侧浅色线和明显眼旁白斑。第四趾内侧有 1.5–2 个指节游离，报告的蹼评分大于七，胫跗关节超过鼻孔。趾盘最大宽与基部宽之比低于 1.70。应组合使用这些样本特征，保留来源评分而不将其当作毫米。

River-bank observations include sex-specific perch heights
河岸观察包含分性别栖位高度

The natural-history account records encounters from 10:30 to 23:00, more often at night, at river banks reported at 350–1,580 m. Males were mostly on banks, less often leaves and rarely rocks; females were more often in trees than on rocks. Reported male perch heights are 20–100 cm and female heights 50–300 cm. The authors describe an apparent river association and females often near slow water. These are observational tendencies, not experimental preferences, density estimates or proof that individuals never use other substrates.

Two elevation summaries in the source remain distinct
来源中的两个海拔摘要分别保留

分布段将 danieli 置于 Madagascar 北部及 Sambirano 地区的半湿润至湿润环境，海拔 180–1,200 米；自然史段则给出 350–1,580 米。这是同一研究内不一致的摘要，不将其静默互换，也不合并成新认证的 180–1,580 米范围。区域条目不证明完整占据，也不确定差异原因。仍需逐标本地点核对以协调上下界。

Two older femoralis-labelled sequences belong to this molecular group
两个旧标为 femoralis 的序列属于该分子组

The comments connect danieli with earlier aff. femoralis material from Tsaratanana. Only males provide measured adult size in this description

Six males were measured at 57.9–62.1 mm snout–vent length; the diagnosis rounds their range to 57–62 mm. 雄性遇见记录跨缓溪及急河岩石

北部具名地点具有不同海拔信息

These scattered records do not establish continuous occupancy between forest remnants or a complete northern Madagascan range. 三个遗传凭证未解决更广的亚属归属

Genetic references comprise AMNH A167589 / RAX 2715, UMMZ 201416 / RAN 39170 and UMMZ 213447 / RAN 39125. The diagnosis gives male snout–vent length of 34–40 mm and female length of 45–52 mm. Grey dorsal and flank surfaces bear black granules, with a lip line and V- or Y-shaped dorsal markings. An inguinal yellow streak, broad pale flank marking and white flank spots are absent in the diagnostic account. The inner side of toe IV has one free phalanx, webbing score is below seven, maximum disc width/base width exceeds 1.8, and tibiotarsal reach is between eye and nostril. Ratios and scores are distinct from millimetres; these characters are not a single-feature identification guarantee.
鉴别给出雄性吻肛长 34–40 毫米、雌性 45–52 毫米。灰色背面及体侧有黑色颗粒，具有唇缘线和 V 或 Y 形背部纹。鉴别条目记为没有黄色腹股沟条纹、宽浅色体侧斑和白色体侧点。第四趾内侧一个指节游离，蹼评分低于七，趾盘最大宽与基部宽之比超过 1.8，胫跗关节位置介于眼和鼻孔。比值、评分与毫米不同，这些特征不保证凭单项准确鉴定。

岩底水体及低矮植被提供观察栖位

Encounters around rocky streams and rivers span 10:00–22:30, mainly at night except for juveniles. Females were on rocks at night, with some on leaves 20–50 cm high; males were more often on tree leaves 10–30 cm high. The account describes an association with fast water. This apparent preference is an observational interpretation, not an experimental flow threshold or quantified habitat-selection coefficient. Juvenile daytime records do not establish all juvenile activity, and substrate records do not demonstrate where eggs were deposited.
岩底溪流和河流周围的遇见时刻为 10:00–22:30，除幼体外主要在夜间。夜间雌性见于岩石，部分在高 20–50 厘米叶片；雄性更常见于高 10–30 厘米树叶。条目描述与急水关联。这种似然偏好是观察解释，不是实验流水阈值或量化生境选择系数。幼体白天记录不能确定全部幼体活动，基质记录也不确定产卵位置。

Northern records span 600–1,700 metres in this account
该条目北部记录跨海拔 600–1,700 米

The source lists Ramena in Tsaratanana, Analabe, Andramanalana and northern Sorata, with a reported elevation interval of 600–1,700 m. The interval is a source distribution summary, not an experimentally demonstrated tolerance or complete elevational census. Named areas do not imply that all intervening forest or river systems are occupied. The revision’s concept must be retained when comparing earlier records under other names.
来源列出 Tsaratanana 的 Ramena、Analabe、Andramanalana 和 Sorata 北部，报告海拔区间 600–1,700 米。这是来源分布摘要，不是实验确定的耐受界限或完整海拔普查。具名地区不表示中间全部森林、河系都被占据。比较早期其他名称下记录时，应保留修订使用的物种概念。

Nearby Marojejy lacks confirmed material in this revision
该修订没有确认邻近 Marojejy 材料

The source disagrees about tibiotarsal reach

Males are reported at 35–52 mm and females 42–63 mm snout–vent length. The brown back lacks black granules, a sharp transition separates dark flank from pale ventral surface, and thin pale inguinal and lip stripes are present. Toe IV has 1–1.5 outer free phalanges, toe II none externally, and maximum disc width/base width is at most 1.8. The diagnosis places tibiotarsal reach between eye and nostril, but comparisons with femoralis and danieli say beyond the nostril. This disagreement is not silently resolved into a definitive identification character.
报告雄性吻肛长 35–52 毫米、雌性 42–63 毫米。褐色背部没有黑色颗粒，深色体侧与浅色腹面边界明显，具有细浅色腹股沟及唇缘条纹。第四趾外侧有 1–1.5 个指节游离，第二趾外侧没有游离指节，趾盘最大宽与基部宽之比不高于 1.8。鉴别将胫跗关节置于眼和鼻孔间，与 femoralis、danieli 的比较却写为超过鼻孔。不将这种不一致静默处理成确定鉴别特征。

Adults and juveniles differ in reported encounter timing
成年与幼体的报告遇见时间不同

The account covers rainforest and savannah waters, including streams, rivers, ponds and shallow marshes, with waterfalls excepted. Encounters span 09:30–23:00: adults were mainly nocturnal and juveniles seen during the day. Night perches included rocks and leaves, rarely branches, with incidental aerial-root and Pandanus records. Females appeared more often on rocks than leaves, whereas males showed no stated contrast; male heights were 5–100 cm and female heights 5–150 cm. These encounter tendencies do not experimentally establish preference, breeding substrate or universal avoidance of waterfalls.
条目涵盖雨林及稀树草原水域，包含溪流、河流、池塘和浅沼泽，瀑布除外。遇见时刻为 09:30–23:00：成年主要夜间，幼体见于白天。夜间栖位包括岩石和叶片，枝条罕见，另有偶发气根及 Pandanus 记录。雌性似在岩石较叶片更多，雄性没有报告这种差别；雄性高度 5–100 厘米、雌性 5–150 厘米。这些遇见趋势不能实验确定偏好、繁殖基质或普遍回避瀑布。

The northern distribution summary spans a broad elevation interval
北部分布摘要涵盖较宽海拔区间

The revision gives northern Madagascar and an elevation range of 80–2,450 m for tavaratra. These are reported occurrence bounds, not physiological tolerance limits or evidence that every elevation within the interval is occupied. The breadth of the interval does not determine abundance, habitat continuity or current conservation status. Older mocquardi-labelled records require voucher-level reassignment rather than geographic pooling.
修订给出 tavaratra 分布于 Madagascar 北部，海拔 80–2,450 米。这是报告出现界限，不是生理耐受限，也不证明区间内每个海拔均被占据。区间较宽不能确定丰度、生境连续性或现行保护状态。旧标为 mocquardi 的记录需要凭证层面重新归属，而不能依据地理位置汇总。

Specific former mocquardi vouchers support the revised attribution
特定旧 mocquardi 凭证支持修订归属

The source associates tavaratra with earlier aff. mocquardi material from Marojejy. Its molecular group includes AY324819 / FGMV 2002.824 from Manongarivo and AY324820 / ZSM 643/2001 from Tsaratanana, formerly cf. mocquardi. The comments also track FGMV 2002.824 through later unnamed-candidate usage and mention FGMV 2001.114. These links concern particular vouchers; they do not reassign all mocquardi or unnamed-candidate records. Mitochondrial clustering is not a completed population-genomic audit or certification of every modern catalogue concept.

来源将 tavaratra 与 Marojejy 早期 aff. mocquardi 材料关联。其分子组包含 Manongarivo 的 AY324819 / FGMV 2002.824 和 Tsaratanana 的 AY324820 / ZSM 643/2001，过去标为 cf. mocquardi。评论还追踪 FGMV 2002.824 后续未命名候选使用，并提到 FGMV 2001.114。这些链接针对具体凭证，不重新归属全部 mocquardi 或未命名候选记录。线粒体聚类不是完成的种群基因组审计或每个现代目录概念的认证。

High-elevation February larvae do not establish a thermal trigger

The reproductive discussion reports tavaratra tadpoles at Gosner stage 36 in late February in Tsaratanana, around 2,300 m and 8 °C. Temperature-related triggering and rapid high-elevation metamorphosis are proposed explanations, not experimentally isolated mechanisms or measured critical temperatures. This single seasonal and locality context does not establish year-round reproduction, a species-wide breeding calendar or larval growth rate. Background seasonal observations for other Ochthomantis populations are not transferred to every tavaratra population, and egg-placement accounts for other species remain separate.

繁殖讨论报告 Tsaratanana 约海拔 2,300 米、8 摄氏度环境中，二月下旬 tavaratra 蝌蚪处于 Gosner 36 期。温度相关触发及高海拔快速变态是提出的解释，不是实验隔离机制或实测临界温度。这个季节与地点情境不能确定全年繁殖、全物种繁殖日历或幼体生长速率。不将其他 Ochthomantis 种群的背景季节观察转给每个 tavaratra 种群，其他物种产卵位置条目也分别保留。

The revision reports adult males at 31–43.4 mm and females at 43.0–62.4 mm snout–vent length. The tibiotarsal articulation usually extends beyond the nostrils, rarely between eye and nostril; toe IV has 1.5–2 inner free phalanges, terminal disc width/base width is at least 1.70, and a pale upper lip stripe and prominent yellow inguinal patch are present. A comparison later calls the species at least 33 mm, inconsistent with the male minimum of 31 mm in the same paragraph. The discrepancy and limb variation prevent either value from becoming an absolute identification cutoff.
修订报告成年雄性吻肛长 31–43.4 毫米、雌性 43.0–62.4 毫米。胫跗关节通常超过鼻孔，少数介于眼和鼻孔；第四趾内侧有 1.5–2 个指节游离，末端趾盘宽与基部宽之比至少 1.70，具有浅色上唇线及明显黄色腹股沟斑。同段后续比较又写该种至少 33 毫米，与雄性最小值 31 毫米不一致。保留差异及肢端变异，不能将某个数值变为绝对鉴定界限。

River-bank encounters are mainly nocturnal
河岸遇见主要在夜间

Femoralis is described as semi-aquatic around slow-flowing rainforest streams and rivers, rarely outside rainforest or near relict forest. Encounters span 09:00–23:30, with greater night activity and daytime concealment in holes or rock crevices. Females were generally on streamside shrubs at night; males used river-bank settings except branches and stems in the account. Observed heights reach one metre for males and two for females. The described stream-bed widths of 1–10 m and depths of 10–150 cm are observational habitat associations, not experimentally determined limits or requirements for every population.
femoralis 被描述为雨林缓流水溪河周围的半水生蛙，少数见于雨林外或残存林附近。遇见时间 09:00–23:30，夜间活动较多，白天藏于孔穴或岩隙。夜间雌性通常在溪旁灌木；条目中雄性利用河岸多种位置，但枝条和植物茎除外。雄性观察高度达一米，雌性达两米。所述河床宽 1–10 米、水深 10–150 厘米属于观察生境关联，不是实验界限或每个种群的需求。

Egg placement and larval seasonality have locality-specific scope
产卵位置和幼体季节性具有地点范围

Egg masses are described outside water on a leaf or branch overhanging a stream or river. The account reports cold-season reproduction, for example June–July at Mantadia, and apparent September–October metamorphosis in the Moramanga region. August 2002 larvae at Andranomanamponga occupied calm clear pools protected by rocks, 1–3 square metres and 20–100 cm deep; disturbed larvae retreated into mud, dead leaves or crevices. These locality-specific observations are not a universal calendar, clutch-size estimate, development-rate experiment or proof of parental guarding. Male calls are described only as low and barely audible, without measured acoustic parameters here.

卵团描述为产在水外、悬于溪河之上的叶片或枝条。条目报告冷季繁殖，例如 Mantadia 六至七月，Moramanga 地区似于九至十月变态。Andranomanamponga 的 2002 年八月幼体见于岩石保护的清澈缓水池，面积 1–3 平方米、水深 20–100 厘米；受扰幼体躲入泥、枯叶或岩隙。这些地点观察不是普遍日历、窝卵数估计、发育速率实验或亲代守护证明。该段仅将雄性鸣声描述为低而难听见，没有提供实测声学参数。

Eastern and northern rainforest records extend into the highlands
东部和北部雨林记录延伸至高地

The source distribution summary covers eastern and northern rainforest, including Madagascan highlands, at 230–1,600 m. It extends from the Sambirano region, about 14° S, to the Anosy Mountains, about 25° S. These are summarized records under the revision’s femoralis concept, not continuous occupancy between endpoints or physiological limits. The geographic span does not establish current abundance, population connectivity or confirmed assignment of every older femoralis-labelled voucher.
来源分布摘要涵盖东部和北部雨林及 Madagascar 高地，海拔 230–1,600 米，北至约南纬 14 度的 Sambirano 地区，南至约南纬 25 度的 Anosy 山。这是修订 femoralis 概念下的记录摘要，不是两端间连续占据或生理界限。地理跨度不能确定现行丰度、种群连通性或每件旧 femoralis 凭证的确认归属。

修订保留 flavicrus 为次异名

The authors match their morphology with previously illustrated Antoetra material and cluster their molecular samples with earlier femoralis references, including AY324815 / FGMV 2001.155 and AY324817 / FGMV 2002.56. They retain flavicrus, whose type locality was given only as Madagascar, as a junior synonym. This is the revision’s taxonomic conclusion, not a newly certified equivalence for every historical occurrence. The paragraph also prints a malformed later HQ accession range; it is not silently repaired into a set of new sequence bindings. Earlier vouchers reassigned to danieli remain outside this account.

作者将形态与此前图示的 Antoetra 材料对应，并把其分子样本与旧 femoralis 参考聚类，包含 AY324815 / FGMV 2001.155 和 AY324817 / FGMV 2002.56。保留模式地点仅写 Madagascar 的 flavicrus 为次异名。这是修订的分类结论，不是每条历史出现记录的新认证等价。该段还印有格式异常的后续 HQ 登录号范围，不静默修复为一组新序列绑定。已重新归入 danieli 的旧凭证不纳入本条目。

Streamside perches differ between day and night encounters
溪边栖位在昼夜遇见记录中不同

The semi-aquatic forest account associates ambreensis with flowing streams or rivers and rocks, with encounters from 09:00–23:00 and mainly nocturnal activity. Females at night were on leaves rather than branches; daytime records sometimes were on river banks and rarely on ground. Males were on banks by day and leaves or occasionally rocks at night. Reported male heights are 10–200 cm and female heights 100–200 cm. A river association and irrigation-canal occurrence at Station les Roussettes are observations, not experimental preferences or demonstrated dependence on artificial channels.
半水生森林条目将 ambreensis 与流水溪河及岩石关联，遇见时间 09:00–23:00，主要夜间活动。夜间雌性在叶片而非枝条，白天有时在河岸、地面罕见；雄性白天在岸边，夜间在叶片或偶尔岩石。报告雄性高度 10–200 厘米、雌性 100–200 厘米。与河流关联及 Station les Roussettes 灌渠出现是观察，不是实验偏好或对人工渠道的依赖证明。

一窝岩缘卵及引述三月鸣声记录是不同证据

A call occurrence gives no measured duration or frequency and does not extend this single clutch observation to all months or populations.

The revision extends the concept beyond Montagne d’Ambre
修订将该概念扩展至 Montagne d’Ambre 之外

The distribution account gives northwestern and northern Madagascan forests at 200–1,150 m, including Montagne d’Ambre, Manongarivo, Tsaratanana, Andramanalana and Sorata, extending to Irony River and Ambohibola Forest at the northern High Plateau limit. These ambreensis records are not interchangeable with morphologically attributed ambony records, despite similar stripes and overlapping regions.

分布条目给出 Madagascar 西北及北部海拔 200–1,150 米森林，包含 Montagne d’Ambre、Manongarivo、Tsaratanana、Andramanalana 和 Sorata，并延至北部高原边界的 Irony 河及 Ambohibola 森林。这是来源记录摘要，不是完整调查覆盖或连续占据证明。即使条纹相似、地区重叠，也不能将 ambreensis 记录与依据形态归属的 ambony 记录互换。

A holotype sequence is among the attributed molecular references
归属分子参考中包含正模序列

The authors cluster their ambreensis samples with AY324822 / ZSM 492/2000, HQ610870 / FGMV 2002.1950 and the holotype MNHN 1893.241 sequence MT982173. Explicit holotype attribution strengthens the named connection in this revision, but does not amount to independent contemporary certification of all catalogue or locality records. These references are voucher-specific mitochondrial evidence; repeated accessions and locality labels do not automatically represent additional independently sampled populations.
作者将其 ambreensis 样本与 AY324822 / ZSM 492/2000、HQ610870 / FGMV 2002.1950，以及正模 MNHN 1893.241 序列 MT982173 聚类。明确正模归属加强该修订中的名称关联，但不等于所有目录或地点记录的独立现行认证。这些是凭证特定的线粒体证据；重复登录号和地点标签不自动代表更多独立采样种群。
title: Revision of the Subgenus Ochthomantis Frogs from Madagascar (Amphibia: Mantellidae) with the Description of Four Species and Resurrection of Mantidactylus catalai and M. poissoni †

name: Mantidactylus ambony
readScope: Mantidactylus ambony: Individually read species diagnosis, natural history, distribution and attributed voucher comments in the 2023 Ochthomantis revision; cited prior findings distinguished from new observations; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sectionLocators: PMC10563080 reading-sections section 4 paragraphs 2

PMC10563080 reading-sections section 4 paragraphs 8
sections: morphology
Small adult size and a pale lateral stripe form the diagnosis
小型成年体长和浅色侧纹形成鉴别

The revision gives male snout–vent length of 30.0–31.8 mm and female length of 34.0–37.9 mm. A sharply defined white-to-yellow lateral stripe runs from snout to groin along head and body. The species is distinguished from ambreensis by smaller size and from other compared species by the stripe. These are sample-based diagnostic combinations, not universal size thresholds or proof that striped individuals outside genetically confirmed localities have independently certified identity.
修订给出雄性吻肛长 30.0–31.8 毫米、雌性 34.0–37.9 毫米。清晰白至黄色侧纹从吻沿头部和身体至腹股沟，以较小体型区别 ambreensis，以侧纹区别其他比较物种。这是样本基础的组合鉴别，不是普遍体长阈值，也不证明遗传确认地点以外的条纹个体已经独立身份认证。
ecology
New encounters and cited perch observations remain separate
新遇见记录和引述栖位观察分别保留

The account reports semi-aquatic forest encounters by quiet rocky rivers at 11:00–20:00 and near irrigation canals at Station les Roussettes. It cites the earlier description for flow-associated ecology, frequent terrestrial daytime positions on ground, rocks, wood or lichen, concealment under rocks, and night perches above water, once at two metres. The quiet-river encounters and cited rheophilous description are not averaged into a measured flow preference. A cited maximum perch observation does not determine a height limit, and these substrates do not establish oviposition sites.
条目报告半水生森林蛙在平静多岩河边的遇见时间 11:00–20:00，并在 Station les Roussettes 灌渠旁出现。引用早期描述记录流水关联、白天常在地面、岩石、木材或地衣上、藏于岩下，以及夜间水上栖位，其中一次高两米。平静河流遇见与所引喜流水描述不平均成实测流速偏好。一次较高栖位不确定高度界限，这些基质也不确定产卵位置。
distribution
Broader morphological records contrast with the type-locality statement
较广形态记录与模式地点陈述存在差别

The distribution paragraph reports northwestern and northern forests at 300–1,150 m, from relict deciduous forest south of Maevatanana to humid Montagne d’Ambre. The comments also say the species occurs only at Montagne d’Ambre when citing the earlier work, then explain that outside records in this revision rely on morphology only. The broader distribution is therefore not presented as uniformly genetically confirmed. Both source scopes are retained rather than silently restricting every record to the type area or certifying all outside records by sequence.
分布段报告西北及北部海拔 300–1,150 米森林，从 Maevatanana 南部残存落叶林至湿润 Montagne d’Ambre。评论引用早期研究又称仅在 Montagne d’Ambre 出现，随后说明本修订外部记录仅依据形态。因此不将较广分布写成全部经过遗传确认。分别保留两种来源范围，不把全部记录静默限于模式地区，也不把外部记录都写为序列认证。
taxonomy
The holotype connection does not sequence-certify outside specimens
正模关联不使外部标本自动获得序列认证

The authors group their morphologically and molecularly attributed ambony material with the earlier holotype ZSM 2078/2007, field number FGZC 1039. They explicitly distinguish morphology-only records outside Montagne d’Ambre from their molecular evidence. The type connection is an attributed taxonomic argument; it cannot make unsequenced outside vouchers genetically confirmed. No new population sample count or range-wide genomic equivalence is inferred from the paragraph’s wording about a single molecular result.
作者将依据形态和分子归属的 ambony 材料与早期正模 ZSM 2078/2007、野外编号 FGZC 1039 关联，并明确区分 Montagne d’Ambre 外仅有形态依据的记录与分子证据。模式关联是明确归属的分类论证，不能使未测序外部凭证自动遗传确认。也不从该段关于单个分子结果的措辞推断新增种群样本数或全分布基因组等价。
title: Revision of the Subgenus Ochthomantis Frogs from Madagascar (Amphibia: Mantellidae) with the Description of Four Species and Resurrection of Mantidactylus catalai and M. poissoni †

name: Mantidactylus mocquardi
readScope: Mantidactylus mocquardi: Individually read species diagnosis, natural history, distribution and attributed voucher comments in the 2023 Ochthomantis revision; cited prior findings distinguished from new observations; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sectionLocators: PMC10563080 reading-sections section 5 paragraphs 4

sections: morphology
Dark colour and lip spotting accompany variable limb reach
深色及唇部斑点伴随可变肢端位置

Adult males are reported at 36–48 mm and females at 44–65 mm snout–vent length. The body is dark brown or black, black in preservative, with a few white lateral spots; the paler upper lip has dark brown spotting, denser posteriorly. The snout projects more than 1.75 mm beyond the lower jaw in lateral view. Tibiotarsal reach is between eye and nostril but sometimes beyond the nostril. Preserved colour and variable limb position should remain distinguished from fixed live-colour rules or a single decisive identification character.
报告成年雄性吻肛长 36–48 毫米、雌性 44–65 毫米。身体深褐或黑，保存状态下为黑色，体侧有少数白点；较浅上唇有深褐斑，后部更密。侧视吻端超出下颌超过 1.75 毫米。胫跗关节介于眼和鼻孔，但有时超过鼻孔。保存颜色及可变肢端位置应与固定活体颜色规则或单个决定性鉴别特征区分。
ecology
Daytime and degraded-forest records are observational associations
白天及退化林记录属于观察关联

The semi-aquatic rainforest species was also recorded in open or degraded forest, especially in northern Madagascar. Encounters along banks and streams with different water speeds span 09:00–23:00, and the authors describe it as apparently more diurnal than nocturnal and more often associated with rocky areas than trees. Tree records include leaves and branches. These observations do not quantify disturbance tolerance, survival in cleared land or experimental substrate preferences. Occurrence in degraded forest is not evidence that forest loss has no population cost.
这一半水生雨林种也见于开阔或退化森林，尤其在 Madagascar 北部。不同流速河岸、溪边的遇见时间为 09:00–23:00，作者描述似白天较夜间活动更多，岩石区域较树上更常见；树上记录含叶片和枝条。这些观察不量化干扰耐受、清林地存活或实验基质偏好。在退化林出现不证明森林损失没有种群代价。
distribution
The revised account covers central-eastern and northern rainforest
修订条目涵盖中东部和北部雨林

The distribution account places mocquardi in low-, middle- and high-elevation rainforest of central-eastern and northern Madagascar at 100–1,550 m. These are summarized occurrence bounds under the revised diagnosis, not a thermal tolerance range or continuous occupancy. Historical cf. or aff. mocquardi vouchers assigned elsewhere in the revision to catalai or tavaratra are not silently pooled with this species. The interval alone cannot determine population abundance, connectivity or conservation trend.
分布条目将 mocquardi 置于 Madagascar 中东部和北部低、中、高海拔雨林，海拔 100–1,550 米。这是修订鉴别下的出现界限摘要，不是温度耐受范围或连续占据。修订中已归入 catalai、tavaratra 的历史 cf. 或 aff. mocquardi 凭证，不静默并入本种。区间本身不能确定种群丰度、连通性或保护趋势。
taxonomy
Named vouchers anchor the molecular comparison
具名凭证锚定分子比较

The authors compare their morphology with earlier Andasibe material and group their molecular samples with AF215317 / ZFMK 66668 from Ambato, Masoala, and HQ610861 / ZSM 1846/2007 and HQ610921 / ZCMV 8818 from An’Ala and Mahasoa. These specifically attributed references support the revision’s restricted comparison. They do not certify every older mocquardi-labelled sample, provide range-wide genomic coverage or override voucher-specific reassignments to other species in the same paper.

作者将形态与早期 Andasibe 材料比较，并把分子样本与 Ambato、Masoala 的 AF215317 / ZFMK 66668，以及 An’Ala 和 Mahasoa 的 HQ610861 / ZSM 1846/2007、HQ610921 / ZCMV 8818 聚类。这些明确归属参考支持修订的限定比较，不认证每件旧 mocquardi 样本、不提供全分布基因组覆盖，也不覆盖同篇对其他物种的凭证特定重新归属。
title: Revision of the Subgenus Ochthomantis Frogs from Madagascar (Amphibia: Mantellidae) with the Description of Four Species and Resurrection of Mantidactylus catalai and M. poissoni †

name: Mantidactylus zolitschka
readScope: Mantidactylus zolitschka: Individually read species diagnosis, natural history, distribution and attributed voucher comments in the 2023 Ochthomantis revision; cited prior findings distinguished from new observations; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

sections: morphology
The male reference specimen is smaller than the printed diagnosis range
雄性参考标本小于印出的鉴别范围

The diagnosis gives male snout–vent length of 29.6–30.6 mm and female length of 37.6–37.7 mm, yet the next paragraph describes adult male UADBA 6966 at 27.65 mm. Both statements are retained; the reported diagnostic interval is not a complete adult male limit. Tibiotarsal reach is at least to the nostril, terminal disc width/base width is 1.78, and reduced webbing has a sum of free phalanges above nine, 9.75 in the reference specimen. Absence of a snout-to-groin lateral stripe distinguishes it from ambony in the comparison, without resolving the body-size discrepancy.
鉴别给出雄性吻肛长 29.6–30.6 毫米、雌性 37.6–37.7 毫米，下一段却将成年雄性 UADBA 6966 描述为 27.65 毫米。两种陈述分别保留，所报鉴别区间不是成年雄性完整界限。胫跗关节至少达鼻孔，末端趾盘宽与基部宽之比 1.78；蹼较少、游离指节总数超过九，参考标本为 9.75。比较以缺少吻至腹股沟侧纹区别 ambony，但这不解决体长差异。
appearance
Preserved colour and glands describe one reference male
保存颜色和腺体描述一只参考雄性

UADBA 6966 is described as slender, with a relatively smooth upper surface, slightly granular flanks and smooth ventral surface. In preservative its grey-brown dorsum has irregular light and dark marbling, the tympanic region is dark brown and the lower lip alternates light and dark spots. Two longitudinal throat markings merge into a Y-like pattern. Distinct femoral glands contact the cloacal area and show granular, crater-like patterns. These are reference-male and preservation observations, not a measured live-colour series, universal female pattern or histological test of gland function.
UADBA 6966 描述为纤细，上表面较光滑、体侧略有颗粒、腹面光滑。保存状态下灰褐背部有不规则明暗大理石纹，鼓膜区深褐，下唇明暗斑交替；两条纵向喉纹汇为 Y 形。明显股腺与泄殖腔区域相接，具有颗粒及火山口样纹。这是参考雄性和保存观察，不是实测活体颜色系列、普遍雌性纹或腺功能组织学实验。
reproduction
A cited female contains eggs but does not supply an observed clutch
引述雌性含卵不等于观察到完整窝卵

The habits paragraph cites earlier work for female ZFMK 30116 containing 49 eggs, described with yellow and dark-brown central markings and diameter about 2 mm. Eggs contained in one female are not automatically a deposited clutch count, successful hatch count or population fecundity range. The paragraph places the species near streams in An’Ala rainforest but does not specify an observed egg-placement surface, parental care, breeding calendar or measured incubation period. Those traits remain unreported in this account rather than borrowed from other Ochthomantis species.
习性段引用早期研究，记雌性 ZFMK 30116 含 49 枚卵，描述有黄色及深褐中央斑，直径约两毫米。一只雌性体内含卵数不自动等于已产窝卵数、成功孵化数或种群繁殖力范围。该段将物种置于 An’Ala 雨林溪边，但没有明确观察产卵表面、亲代照料、繁殖日历或实测孵化期。这些特征在本条目仍未报告，不从其他 Ochthomantis 种借用。
distribution
Only An’Ala is named as a confirmed locality here
该条目确认地点仅列 An’Ala

The distribution paragraph states that zolitschka is known only from its type locality, An’Ala, and the habits paragraph describes nearby rainforest streams. No numerical elevation interval is supplied in these paragraphs. A type-locality-only record summary is not proof of absence elsewhere, a calculated area of occupancy or a current conservation category. Potential records outside An’Ala need their own identity evidence; they are not inferred from the distribution of other members of the subgenus.
分布段称 zolitschka 仅知模式地点 An’Ala，习性段描述附近雨林溪流。这些段落没有给出数值海拔区间。只有模式地点的记录摘要不证明其他地区不存在，也不是计算的占据面积或现行保护类别。An’Ala 以外潜在记录需要自己的身份依据，不从同亚属其他物种分布推断。
taxonomy
Two cited genetic references remain voucher-specific
两个引述遗传参考保持凭证特定范围

The revision includes earlier genetic data HQ610866 / ZSM 1768/2007 and HQ610867 / ZSM 1841/2007 for zolitschka. These explicit references are not new sequence measurements performed for this reader and do not establish complete population sampling. Molecular inclusion, the An’Ala distribution statement and the individually described reference specimen retain distinct evidence roles. They do not independently settle the inconsistent adult male size statements or certify every historical occurrence under the species name.
修订纳入 zolitschka 的早期遗传数据 HQ610866 / ZSM 1768/2007 及 HQ610867 / ZSM 1841/2007。这些明确参考不是为本读者页面新完成的序列测量，也不确定完整种群采样。分子纳入、An’Ala 分布陈述及单独描述的参考标本保持不同证据作用，不能独立解决成年雄性体长陈述不一致或认证物种名下每条历史出现记录。

sections: taxonomy
One Guizhou sample adds mitochondrial attribution
一个 Guizhou 样本增加线粒体归属证据

The study collected six adults, three males and three females, and five tadpoles at montane ponds in Zheng’an County, Guizhou, at 1,326 m, on 7 July 2024 and 11 April 2025. These dates and life stages are not eleven adults or independent populations. Mitochondrial 16S and COI comparisons cluster the new material with named type sequences, with reported p-distances 0.000–0.005 and 0.000–0.004 respectively. The threshold cited from previous Nidirana studies is a contextual comparison, not a universal delimitation rule. Two mitochondrial fragments do not independently establish nuclear-genomic identity, range-wide variation or equivalence of every historical record.

研究在 Guizhou 的 Zheng’an 县海拔 1,326 米山地池塘，于 2024 年七月七日和 2025 年四月十一日采集六只成年、雌雄各三只，以及五只蝌蚪。日期与生命阶段不能写成十一只成年或独立种群。线粒体 16S 和 COI 比较将新材料与具名模式序列聚类，报告 p 距离分别 0.000–0.005、0.000–0.004。引用早期 Nidirana 研究的阈值是背景比较，不是普遍划种规则。两个线粒体片段不能独立确定核基因组身份、全分布变异或全部历史记录等价。
morphology
The new males have internal vocal sacs
新检查雄性具有内声囊

Three Guizhou males are reported at 41.1–43.4 mm snout–vent length, with smooth dorsal skin lacking horny spines, dorsolateral folds interrupted posteriorly, and breeding-season protruding suprabrachial glands and one nuptial pad on the dorsal base of finger I. The new account reports internal vocal sacs and explicitly contrasts this with the original type-locality description, proposing an earlier descriptive inaccuracy. The difference remains a source-level revision rather than a demonstrated geographic change or experimental explanation. Tibiotarsal reach varies from eye region to nostril; neither size nor limb reach supplies a fixed sex or identification cutoff.
三只 Guizhou 雄性报告吻肛长 41.1–43.4 毫米，背皮光滑、没有角质刺，背侧褶后部中断；繁殖期有突出的上臂腺及第一指背侧基部一个婚垫。新条目报告内声囊，明确与原模式地点描述比较，提出早期描述可能不准确。差异保留为来源层面的修订，不是已证明的地理变化或实验解释。胫跗关节位置从眼区至鼻孔有变异，体长及肢端位置均不提供固定性别或鉴别界限。
morphology
Female size ranges overlap the measured males
雌性体长范围与实测雄性重叠

The discussion and revised diagnosis give females at 42.2–47.0 mm snout–vent length; the individually described female MT ZA20240707005 is 45.15 mm. Female and male ranges overlap despite the source describing females as slightly larger. This reference female has head length/width 1.07, tympanum/eye diameter 0.89, tibia length 47.6% of SVL and tibiotarsal reach to the anterior eye corner. Live colour includes a brown spotted back, a light middorsal stripe without dark edges, barred limbs and denser reddish-brown throat, chest and ventral-limb spots than males. These individual proportions and sex-associated descriptions are not immutable population-wide patterns.
讨论及修订鉴别给出雌性吻肛长 42.2–47.0 毫米，单独描述的 MT ZA20240707005 为 45.15 毫米。虽然来源称雌性稍大，其范围仍与雄性重叠。参考雌性头长与宽之比 1.07、鼓膜与眼直径之比 0.89、胫长占吻肛长 47.6%，胫跗关节达眼前角。活体有褐色斑背、无深色边缘的浅色背中线、横斑肢体，喉、胸及肢腹面红褐斑较雄性密。这些个体比例及性别关联描述不是全种群不变纹样。
development
Stage-thirty larvae have their own measurement definitions
三十期幼体具有自己的测量定义

Larvae were staged using Gosner and measured from scaled photographs with ImageJ. The revised diagnosis lists stage-30 total length at 47.1–63.7 mm, body length at 14.5–21.5 mm and tail length at 63.5–67.1% of total length. Reference larva MT ZA20250411010 is separately reported with total length 63.66 mm, SVL 21.48 mm and tail length 41.73 mm. Total length, body length and SVL retain the authors’ distinct labels rather than becoming interchangeable adult SVL. The reference has a flattened elliptical body, rounded tail tip and spotted yellow-brown live body with translucent speckled fins. These stage-specific data are not maximum larval size, growth rate or metamorphosis timing.

幼体采用 Gosner 分期，以 ImageJ 从带尺度照片测量。修订鉴别列出三十期全长 47.1–63.7 毫米、体长 14.5–21.5 毫米、尾长占全长 63.5–67.1%。参考幼体 MT ZA20250411010 另报告全长 63.66 毫米、吻肛长 21.48 毫米、尾长 41.73 毫米。全长、体长和吻肛长保留作者不同标签，不互换为成年吻肛长。参考幼体身体扁平椭圆、尾端圆，活体黄褐有斑，透明尾鳍有细点。这些分期数据不是最大幼体尺寸、生长速率或变态时间。
development
The reference larva has a left spiracle and funnel-like oral disc
参考幼体具有左侧呼吸孔和漏斗形口盘

The stage-30 reference has a single left-side spiracle low on the body, with a short tube free at the tip, and a median anal tube attached to the ventral fin. The oral disc is described as terminal and funnel-like; the upper jaw sheath has a median notch and the lower sheath is thin, sickle-shaped and serrated. The labial tooth-row formula is recorded as I:1+1/1+1:II, preserving the source notation. Two upper and three lower submarginal papilla rows are described. These are specimen/stage characters, not an experimentally established diet or universal diagnosis of every ranid larva. The text calls nostrils closer to the eye but prints eye-to-nostril/snout-to-nostril ratio 1.19; that wording/numeric discrepancy is not silently corrected.
三十期参考幼体身体左侧低位有单个呼吸孔，短管末端游离，中央肛管附于腹侧尾鳍。口盘描述为末端漏斗形，上角质颌鞘中央缺口，下鞘薄、镰形且有锯齿。唇齿式按来源记为 I:1+1/1+1:II，保留原记法；描述上方两列、下方三列亚缘乳突。这是标本和分期特征，不是实验确定的食性或每种蛙科幼体普遍鉴别。正文称鼻孔较靠眼，却给眼至鼻孔与吻至鼻孔距离比 1.19；不静默修正这项措辞与数值差异。
distribution
Two coordinates do not support an unchecked northwest extension
两个坐标不能直接支持未经核对的西北扩展

The source lists the type locality at Gaolu Village, Mala Town, Qianjiang, Chongqing (29.24203° N, 108.902202° E; 1,419 m) and the new ponds at Xinzhou Town, Zheng’an, Guizhou (28.77761° N, 107.26797° E; 1,326 m). Its discussion calls the expansion approximately 300 km northwest. The printed new latitude is lower and longitude farther west, so the direction wording does not agree with those coordinates; the distance is not independently certified here. Both locality records and the original claim remain distinguishable. They do not prove continuous occupancy between provinces, an expanded area of occupancy or absence from unsurveyed intervening habitat.

来源列出模式地点 Chongqing 的 Qianjiang、Mala 镇 Gaolu 村，北纬 29.24203、东经 108.902202 度，海拔 1,419 米；新池塘在 Guizhou 的 Zheng’an、Xinzhou 镇，北纬 28.77761、东经 107.26797 度，海拔 1,326 米。讨论称向西北扩展约三百公里。印出的新地点纬度更低、经度更西，因此方向措辞与坐标不合；此处没有独立认证距离。两个地点记录与原主张分别保留，不能证明两省间连续占据、扩大的占据面积或中间未调查生境不存在。
ecology
Circular nests are observed without a complete breeding sequence
观察到圆形巢但没有完整繁殖序列

The new locality consists of montane swamps, ponds and aquatic grassland with dense weeds. Adults hide in weed patches and males call at night; circular nesting structures are reported for this species, while larvae occupy stagnant pools within ponds. The paragraph names sympatric Polypedates megacephalus, Zhangixalus chenfui and Hylarana guentheri, without establishing interactions, competition or predation. Circular nesting observations do not provide clutch counts, guarding duration, reproductive success or a measured construction sequence. Night calling is an occurrence description, not quantified acoustic parameters or a complete daily activity census.

新地点由杂草密集的山地沼泽、池塘和水生草地组成。成年藏于草丛，雄性夜间鸣叫；报告该种具有圆形筑巢结构，幼体利用池塘内静水池。段落列出同域 Polypedates megacephalus、Zhangixalus chenfui 和 Hylarana guentheri，没有确定互作、竞争或捕食。圆巢观察不提供窝卵数、守护时长、繁殖成功或实测建造序列。夜鸣是出现描述，不是量化声学参数或完整昼夜活动普查。
conservation
The paper proposes habitat protection without a current assessment
论文提出生境保护但不提供现行评估

The discussion identifies potential agricultural pollution and fragmentation threats and recommends protecting pond and farmland ecosystems in Chongqing and Guizhou. It describes the Red List status as unassessed while citing IUCN 2022. That is a dated source statement, not a live verification of the species’ current status or a newly assigned threat category. Potential threats are not measured pollutant exposure, experimentally demonstrated reproductive harm or a quantified population decline in these vouchers. Two known localities provide a reason for further surveys rather than a complete range or certified extinction-risk calculation.
讨论提出农业污染及破碎化潜在威胁，建议保护 Chongqing 与 Guizhou 的池塘及农田生态系统。它引用 IUCN 2022，将红色名录状态描述为尚未评估。这是有日期的来源陈述，不是物种现行状态实时核实或新赋威胁类别。潜在威胁不是这些凭证的污染暴露实测、实验确认的繁殖损害或量化种群下降。两个已知地点支持进一步调查，而非完整分布或认证灭绝风险计算。

sections: morphology
The revised male diagnosis uses external and cranial characters
修订雄性鉴别结合外部及颅骨特征

Male snout–vent length is reported as 46.1–53.3 mm, with a head wider than long, elongated thigh glands and axillary glands behind arm insertion. Small toe webbing reaches halfway between the first and second subarticular tubercles beside toe IV. The iris is light grey, sometimes blue-tinged, with a black sclera; the brown venter lacks conspicuous reticulation. Cranial features also enter the diagnosis, including frontoparietals joined at a few midline sites but mostly separated by a narrow fontanelle. These combined examined characters do not establish female size or permit identification by eye colour alone. The final cranial sentence is malformed in the source and is not reconstructed here.
报告雄性吻肛长 46.1–53.3 毫米，头宽大于长，股后腺细长，腋腺位于臂插入后。趾蹼较少，第四趾两侧达第一和第二关节下瘤之间中点。虹膜浅灰、有时带蓝，巩膜黑；褐色腹面没有明显网纹。鉴别还采用颅骨特征，如额顶骨中线少数部位相接，但主要以窄囟间隔。这些检查组合不能确定雌性体长或仅凭眼色鉴定。来源末尾颅骨句格式异常，此处不自行重建。
taxonomy
Mitochondrial separation restricts earlier bompu assignments
线粒体分离限制早期 bompu 归属

The revision places bompu as sister to the newly named mechuka, reporting 16S divergence of 3.6–4.2%, and 4.5–4.7% from somani. Its broader phylogeny uses mitochondrial 12S, tRNA-Val and 16S, not nuclear genome-wide evidence. The Medog material previously labelled bompu is attributed to mechuka elsewhere in the revision; those occurrences are not retained as confirmed bompu records. The new names are absent from the pinned COL26.8 species list and remain pending catalogue mapping, rather than being assigned a fabricated identifier or merged into this species.

修订将 bompu 置为新命名 mechuka 的姐妹，报告 16S 距离 3.6–4.2%，与 somani 为 4.5–4.7%。较广系统树使用线粒体 12S、tRNA-Val 和 16S，不是核基因组证据。修订另一条目将过去标为 bompu 的 Medog 材料归给 mechuka，不保留为确认 bompu 出现。新名称不在固定 COL26.8 物种名册，保留待目录映射，不编造标识或合并入本种。
development
The larval summary refers to Gosner stage thirty-six
幼体摘要针对 Gosner 三十六期

The revision summarizes an earlier stage-36 larval description: a flattened elliptical body, rounded snout, lateral nostrils nearer the snout, dorsolateral eyes, left spiracle and right vent tube. The muscular tail is about two-thirds of total length, with a rounded tip and higher dorsal than ventral fin. A large ventral oral disc has conical marginal papillae, keratodont formula 5(2–5)/5(1–4), and U-shaped upper and V-shaped lower jaw sheaths. These are cited stage-specific morphology, not a newly measured diet, larval growth rate or reproduction experiment. No adult SVL is inferred from the larval proportions.
修订概述早期三十六期幼体描述：扁平椭圆身体、圆吻、侧鼻孔较靠吻端、背侧眼、左呼吸孔和右肛管。肌肉尾约占全长三分之二，尾端圆，背鳍较腹鳍高。大腹侧口盘具有圆锥缘乳突，角质齿式 5(2–5)/5(1–4)，上颌鞘 U 形、下鞘 V 形。这是引述的分期形态，不是新测食性、幼体生长速率或繁殖实验，也不从幼体比例推断成年吻肛长。
behavior
Cited calls are distinct from call groups
引述单次鸣声与鸣声组不同

The cited bompu call account describes groups of two to eight calls. Individual calls last 61–786 ms and contain 9–57 pulses at about 120 pulses/s, often with a longer first call. Mean dominant frequency is 1.53 kHz, reported range 1.16–1.77 kHz, with amplitude modulation but approximately constant frequency. These are the revision’s summary of Sarmah and colleagues’ 2025 work, not newly independent recordings or a count of frogs. Individual-call duration must not be treated as group duration, and the summaries do not apply to Medog calls reassigned to mechuka.
引述 bompu 鸣声条目描述每组二至八次鸣声。单次持续 61–786 毫秒，包含 9–57 个脉冲，约每秒 120 个，首声常较长。平均主频 1.53 千赫兹，报告范围 1.16–1.77 千赫兹，有振幅调制、频率大致恒定。这是修订对 Sarmah 等人 2025 年研究的摘要，不是新增独立录音或蛙数量。不能把单声时长当作组时长，也不用于已归入 mechuka 的 Medog 鸣声。
distribution
Six named Arunachal localities retain individual elevations
六个 Arunachal 地点保留各自海拔

The restricted account lists Bompu in Eaglenest Wildlife Sanctuary at 1,940 m; Pange at 1,810 m and Tasi Biidang at 1,989 m in Tale Valley Wildlife Sanctuary; and Hari at 1,788 m, Sikhe at 1,671 m and Manipolyang at 1,911 m in the Ziro Valley area, Arunachal Pradesh, India. These locality elevations are not experimentally established tolerance bounds or evidence of occupancy at every intervening elevation. The paragraph points to earlier work for detailed breeding notes; it does not supply new clutch or guarding observations. Confirmed localities do not include the former Medog bompu label.

限定条目列出 India、Arunachal Pradesh 的六地：Eaglenest 野生动物保护区 Bompu 海拔 1,940 米；Tale Valley 保护区 Pange 1,810 米、Tasi Biidang 1,989 米；Ziro Valley 地区 Hari 1,788 米、Sikhe 1,671 米、Manipolyang 1,911 米。这些地点海拔不是实验耐受界限，也不证明中间每个海拔占据。段落指向早期研究的详细繁殖笔记，没有提供新窝卵或守护观察；确认地点不包含旧 Medog bompu 标签。

sections: morphology
The male diagnosis retains a malformed head comparison
雄性鉴别保留异常头部比较措辞

The revised male SVL range is 49.0–55.4 mm. Small webbing reaches the first subarticular tubercle beside toe IV; dorsal skin ranges from sparse to prominent granulation, axillary glands are large, and a canthal stripe is present. The iris is black below and orange-red in its upper third, with bright blue sclera. Brown dorsal blotches, grey flanks with dark spots and a reticulated spotted brown venter join the diagnostic combination. The phrase “head narrower than wide” does not identify the compared dimensions, so it is not converted to a head-length/head-width ratio or silently corrected. No female size range is supplied here.
修订雄性吻肛长范围 49.0–55.4 毫米。少量蹼达第四趾两侧第一关节下瘤；背皮从稀疏至明显颗粒，腋腺大，有吻棱条纹。虹膜下部黑，上三分之一橙红，巩膜鲜蓝。褐色背斑、带深点灰色体侧及网纹点状褐腹构成鉴别组合。“头窄于宽”的来源措辞没有明确比较维度，因此不换算头长宽比或静默修正。此处没有提供雌性体长范围。
taxonomy
The sylheticum sister relationship is mitochondrial evidence
与 sylheticum 的姐妹关系属于线粒体证据

The revision places aryatium in the smithi group as sister to sylheticum. Reported 16S distances are 1.8–2.5% from sylheticum, 2.8–4.9% from smithi and 3.6–3.9% from rakhinense. These are marker-specific study comparisons, not universal species thresholds, full genomic reproductive isolation or grounds to pool the species’ biological records. The concatenated mitochondrial analysis contains 120 samples across the wider dataset; that number is not the count of independently sampled aryatium adults or populations.

修订将 aryatium 置于 smithi 组，作为 sylheticum 的姐妹。报告 16S 距离与 sylheticum 为 1.8–2.5%，与 smithi 为 2.8–4.9%，与 rakhinense 为 3.6–3.9%。这是标记特定的研究比较，不是普遍划种阈值、完整基因组生殖隔离或合并生物学记录的依据。串联线粒体分析较广数据集中有 120 个样本，不是 aryatium 独立成年或种群数量。
ecology
Monsoon encounters extend earlier Assam and Meghalaya records
季风期遇见补充 Assam 和 Meghalaya 旧记录

Earlier records came from Garbhanga and adjoining Assam districts and Ri-Bhoi in Meghalaya. The study adds Goalpara at 53 m, Daribokgre in East Garo Hills at 1,117 m and Asanang in West Garo Hills at 486 m. Across tropical moist evergreen, semi-evergreen and moist deciduous settings, the source summarizes occurrence from about 50 m to above 1,100 m. Breeding individuals were encountered in monsoon conditions beneath leaf litter and low vegetation near slow streams. Such encounter substrates do not identify deposited egg sites, measured clutch size or a disturbance threshold; the source’s rounded range remains distinct from exact locality elevations.

旧记录来自 Garbhanga 及邻近 Assam 地区，以及 Meghalaya 的 Ri-Bhoi。研究新增 Goalpara 海拔 53 米、East Garo Hills 的 Daribokgre 1,117 米、West Garo Hills 的 Asanang 486 米。环境跨热带湿常绿、半常绿及湿落叶林，来源概述约 50 米至超过 1,100 米出现。季风期繁殖个体见于缓溪附近枯叶和低植被下。这些遇见基质不确定已产卵地点、实测窝卵数或干扰阈值；取整分布摘要与精确地点海拔分别保留。

sections: morphology
The revised diagnosis combines eye colour and small webbing
修订鉴别结合眼色与少量趾蹼

Males are reported at 50.2–60.9 mm snout–vent length, with a head nearly as long as wide, shagreened to sparsely granular dorsal skin, large axillary glands and a canthal stripe. Toe webbing reaches the first subarticular tubercle beside toe IV. The iris is black below and fire-red in its upper third, with bright blue sclera; brown dorsal blotches and variable blue-tinged, reticulated ventral colour contribute to the combination. The source also includes skull characters, but these external features are not a substitute for the full comparative diagnosis or proof that every red-and-blue-eyed frog has this identity. No female range is established by this paragraph.
报告雄性吻肛长 50.2–60.9 毫米，头长宽近等，背皮细粗糙至稀疏颗粒，腋腺大，有吻棱条纹。第四趾两侧蹼达第一关节下瘤。虹膜下部黑，上三分之一火红，巩膜鲜蓝；褐色背斑及可变蓝调、网纹腹色参与组合。来源还含颅骨特征，这些外部特征不能替代完整比较鉴别，也不证明每只红蓝眼蛙具有该身份。该段不确定雌性范围。
taxonomy
The sampled clade includes aryatium as its sister species
受采支系以 aryatium 为姐妹种

Sylheticum and aryatium form a supported mitochondrial clade, sister to the sampled smithi–rakhinense clade in this revision. The reported 16S comparisons are 1.8–2.5% to aryatium, 2.8–5.2% to smithi and 4.4–4.9% to rakhinense. The relationship describes the analysed mitochondrial dataset and does not independently certify all current catalogue concepts, nuclear-gene histories or every geographically adjacent population. Tentative older smithi assignments in the distribution discussion remain separate from sequenced sylheticum records.

该修订中 sylheticum 与 aryatium 形成有支持的线粒体支系，作为受采 smithi–rakhinense 支系的姐妹。报告 16S 比较与 aryatium 为 1.8–2.5%，与 smithi 为 2.8–5.2%，与 rakhinense 为 4.4–4.9%。关系描述所分析线粒体数据集，不独立认证全部现行目录概念、核基因历史或每个地理邻近种群。分布讨论中暂定的旧 smithi 归属与测序确认 sylheticum 记录分别保留。
behavior
Call and pulse timings contain a source inconsistency
鸣声与脉冲时间含来源不一致

Mawlynnong recordings were made at 19:30–20:00 on 29 June 2023, at dry/wet bulb temperatures 24/23.5 °C, from males under wet leaf litter near a stream. Groups contained two to six calls; the source gives group duration 739.5 ms and a typical individual call duration 136.8 ms. Calls had 19–32 pulses, reported rate 165.2 ± 18.3 pulses/s and mean dominant frequency 1.41 ± 0.03 kHz, range 1.34–1.46. The maximum-amplitude pulse is printed as 7.4 ms long but with rise time 74.7 ms, longer than the pulse itself; that value is not silently repaired or used as a valid pulse measurement. Counts of calls and pulses are not counts of independent males.

Mawlynnong 录音采于 2023 年六月二十九日 19:30–20:00，干湿球温度 24/23.5 摄氏度，雄性在溪旁湿枯叶下。每组二至六次鸣声，来源给出组时长 739.5 毫秒、典型单声 136.8 毫秒。单声有 19–32 个脉冲，报告速率每秒 165.2 ± 18.3 个，平均主频 1.41 ± 0.03 千赫兹，范围 1.34–1.46。最大振幅脉冲印为长 7.4 毫秒，却有 74.7 毫秒上升时间，比脉冲本身更长；不静默修复或用作有效脉冲测量。鸣声和脉冲数不是独立雄性数。
behavior
Terminology limits comparison with the original call description
术语差异限制与原鸣声描述的比较

The authors compare only dominant frequency and pulse rate directly with the 2021 original description because terminology differs between studies. Their mean frequency is 1.41 kHz versus the earlier 1.6 kHz, with ranges 1.34–1.46 versus 1.4–1.9 kHz; those ranges overlap partly, rather than the whole new range falling inside the old range as the source wording suggests. Mean pulse rate is 165.2 versus 124.8 pulses/s, with reported new and old ranges 150.6–197.2 and 64.4–208.3. These comparisons are not an evolutionary trend, controlled temperature effect or permission to equate differently named call/group units.

作者因研究间术语不同，仅直接比较主频和脉冲速率与 2021 年原描述。新平均主频 1.41 千赫兹、旧为 1.6，范围分别 1.34–1.46 和 1.4–1.9 千赫兹；范围部分重叠，而非来源措辞所暗示新范围全在旧范围内。平均脉冲速率新每秒 165.2、旧 124.8，报告范围新 150.6–197.2、旧 64.4–208.3。这不是演化趋势、控制温度效应，也不允许把名称不同的单声及鸣声组单位等同。
distribution
Confirmed records remain separate from proposed nearby assignments
确认记录与拟议邻近归属分别保留

The source reports Bangladesh records from Lawachara and the Sylhet hills and Chittagong Hill Tracts, and genetically confirmed Indian records from Mawlynnong, Manipur, Mizoram and Tripura. Southern Assam records formerly called smithi are proposed as likely sylheticum on geography, and occurrence in Nagaland is only predicted. Neither is promoted to genetic confirmation. The source summarizes roughly 50–600 m elevation and forest types from evergreen to mixed deciduous, with calling males hidden under stream-bank litter at 19:30–23:00 during breeding activity. These observations do not demonstrate continuous occupancy, universal calling times or deposited egg sites.

来源报告 Bangladesh 的 Lawachara、Sylhet 山地及 Chittagong Hill Tracts 记录，以及 India 的 Mawlynnong、Manipur、Mizoram、Tripura 遗传确认记录。南 Assam 旧称 smithi 的记录依据地理被提出可能为 sylheticum，Nagaland 出现仅为预测，均不提升为遗传确认。来源概述海拔约 50–600 米、森林从常绿至混合落叶，繁殖活动时雄性藏于溪岸枯叶，在 19:30–23:00 鸣叫。这些观察不证明连续占据、普遍鸣叫时段或已产卵地点。

Adult and subadult sizes retain a holotype discrepancy

The diagnosis gives two adult males at 20.8–29.12 mm snout–vent length. The holotype description instead prints 20.1 mm, while its measurement list gives 20.8 mm; the referred male is separately reported at 29.1 mm. These source values are not silently reconciled.
