Live markings differ with individual and developmental stage
活体斑纹随个体及发育阶段不同

The live holotype has a beige background with dark brown hourglass-like dorsal marking, black inguinal spots extending onto the thighs, barred hind limbs, grey mottling on throat and chest, a whitish belly and pinkish limbs below. Its iris is gold-reticulated with bluish sclera. Subadult throats are off-white without the adult mottling, while the larger referred male has a darker throat and additional axillary spots. These are described specimen and stage differences, not a fixed female colour or a measured developmental colour trajectory. Preservative fading is not interpreted as natural seasonal change.
活体正模米色背景上有深褐沙漏样背纹，黑腹股沟斑延至股部，后肢横斑，喉胸灰斑，腹白、肢腹面偏粉；虹膜金色网纹、巩膜偏蓝。亚成年喉部米白、缺少成年斑纹，较大的参考雄性喉更暗、腋部额外斑点。这是描述的标本和阶段差异，不是固定雌性颜色或实测发育颜色轨迹；保存褪色也不解释为自然季节变化。
ecology
Sheltered nighttime encounters support only an apparent burrowing habit
隐蔽夜间遇见仅支持似具穴居习性

The holotype came from Kan Pauk near a pagoda at 232 m; the natural-history account describes a dry, sparsely vegetated village setting around a permanent, likely artificial livestock pond. Collections occurred at 19:00–21:00. Subadults hid in bank cracks and the holotype in a stone-fence crevice; the authors consequently call the frog an apparent good burrower. No digging trial, burrowing rate or physiological drought tolerance was measured. During the hot, dry survey animals were inactive in shelters and no calls were recorded. Nearby Shinma Taung’s 514 m summit is not the frog’s collection elevation, and regional climate averages are not body-temperature limits.
正模采于 Kan Pauk 佛塔附近海拔 232 米；自然史条目描述干燥、植被稀疏村落及一座永久、可能人工的牲畜饮水池。采集时刻为 19:00–21:00。亚成年藏于岸裂，正模在石围栏缝；作者因此称似为善掘穴蛙。没有测量挖掘试验、穴居速率或生理耐旱限。炎热干燥调查期间个体藏于遮蔽、未录鸣声。邻近 Shinma Taung 山顶 514 米不是蛙的采集海拔，地区气候平均值也不是体温界限。
distribution
Kan Pauk is confirmed; wider arid-valley occurrence is anticipated
Kan Pauk 已确认，更广干旱河谷出现属预期

The 2019 account confirms only Kan Pauk in Yesagyo Township, Magway, at roughly 230 m, distinct from the holotype’s precise 232 m label. Searches of paddy fields and large water bodies within two kilometres found no additional site, but this local non-detection is not proof of regional absence. Occurrence elsewhere in the Irrawaddy–Chindwin interfluve is anticipated rather than confirmed. The historical rubra record from Moulmein, now Mawlamyine in Mon State, is expressly considered taxonomically unresolved and possibly a different species, not included as a confirmed fodiens locality.

2019 年条目仅确认 Magway 的 Yesagyo Township、Kan Pauk，海拔约 230 米，与正模精确标签 232 米区分。两公里内稻田及大水体搜索未发现额外地点，但局部未检出不证明地区不存在。Irrawaddy–Chindwin 河间其他地区出现属于预期而非确认。历史 Moulmein、现 Mon State 的 Mawlamyine 的 rubra 记录明确分类未解决、可能另种，不纳入确认 fodiens 地点。
taxonomy
Mitochondrial evidence supports a distinct examined lineage
线粒体证据支持受检独立谱系

The 2,481-base mitochondrial 12S–16S genealogy places the sampled frog in the achatina group, with morphological differences supporting its description. The taxonomy paragraph gives divergence of at least 8.8% from sequenced congeners, whereas the diagnosis reports 9.1–12.4%; these differently stated summaries remain separate. They are not nuclear-genomic proof of reproductive isolation or a universal species threshold. Old rubra labels need voucher-level reassessment and are not automatically transferred on geographic grounds.
2,481 碱基线粒体 12S–16S 谱系将受采蛙置于 achatina 组，形态差异支持其描述。分类段给出与已测序近缘种至少 8.8% 差异，鉴别则报告 9.1–12.4%；分别保留这些不同摘要。它们不是核基因组生殖隔离证明或普遍划种阈值。旧 rubra 标签需要凭证层面复核，不能依据地理自动转移。
conservation
Missing biological information underlies the dated Data Deficient proposal
生物学信息缺口支持有日期的数据缺乏建议

The authors explicitly report unknown diet, eggs and larvae and no recorded calling during their survey. Missing recordings do not prove that the species is mute, and unknown larvae do not support direct development. With range and population trends unresolved, the 2019 paper proposes Data Deficient using cited IUCN category guidance. This is an author proposal, not live verification of a current Red List assessment. The single known locality is an evidence limitation, not by itself a quantified population decline, extinction probability or proof that all suitable habitats were surveyed.
作者明确报告食性、卵和幼体未知，调查期间没有录得鸣声。缺录音不证明该种不能鸣叫，幼体未知也不支持直接发育。分布及种群趋势未解决，2019 年论文依据所引 IUCN 类别指引建议数据缺乏。这是作者建议，不是现行红色名录评估实时核实。单个已知地点是证据限制，本身不是量化种群下降、灭绝概率或已调查全部适宜生境证明。
title: On the road to Mandalay: contribution to the Microhyla Tschudi, 1838 (Amphibia: Anura: Microhylidae) fauna of Myanmar with description of two new species

sections: morphology
Seven males and six females have overlapping size ranges
七只雄性和六只雌性体长范围重叠

The type-series account reports seven adult males at 12.3–17.1 mm and six adult females at 16.7–20.9 mm snout–vent length, including the holotype in the male count. Females are generally larger, but the ranges overlap. The very slender frog has granular skin, no dorsolateral fold, well-developed finger I, slightly expanded digit tips without conspicuous discs, almost completely reduced toe webbing and tibiotarsal reach to the eye. Small metatarsal tubercles distinguish the diagnosis from the shovel-shaped condition of fodiens. Sample size and sex ranges are not independent population counts or a fixed sex-identification threshold.
模式系列报告成年雄性七只、吻肛长 12.3–17.1 毫米，成年雌性六只、16.7–20.9 毫米，雄性数包含正模。雌性总体较大但范围重叠。纤细蛙具有颗粒皮、无背侧褶、发达第一指、略扩端但没有明显端盘、几乎完全退化趾蹼、胫跗关节达眼。小跖瘤与 fodiens 的铲形状态区分。样本数和分性别范围不是独立种群数或固定性别鉴定阈值。
appearance
Bright male tubercles and paler female colour vary among vouchers
雄性鲜色颗粒与雌性浅色在凭证间有变异

The live holotype has a yellow-brown dorsum with dark hourglass-like marking, orange to red granules, barred limbs, cream belly and densely grey-mottled throat. The iris has bronze-green to gold reticulation and green-yellow sclera. Female dorsal colour is generally paler and more grey-olive, with fewer bright tubercles; one female’s continuous dorsal motif is replaced by separate blotches. Males have a darker subgular vocal sac. These sex-associated and individual variations do not define immutable colour states, and unpigmented eggs visible through a gravid female’s belly do not establish clutch size or developmental stage.
活体正模黄褐背有深色沙漏样纹，橙至红颗粒，肢有横斑，腹奶油色、喉密灰斑；虹膜铜绿至金网纹，巩膜绿黄。雌性背色通常较浅、偏灰橄榄，鲜色颗粒较少；一只雌性连续背纹变为分离斑块。雄性喉下声囊更深。这些性别关联及个体变异不确定不变色型，怀卵雌性腹部可见未着色卵也不确定窝卵数或发育分期。
behavior
Acoustic sample sizes count calls and pulses
声学样本量计数鸣声和脉冲

The rattling advertisement call is reported at 0.184 ± 0.07 s, range 0.004–0.277 s, from fifty calls. Each contains one to five pulses; pulse duration averages 4 ms, with 194 pulses measured. Interpulse intervals and periods have 144 observations, while pulse-rate summaries use 49 calls, with range 11.89–57.14 pulses/s and reported mean 17.3. Call maximum-amplitude frequency averages 3,780 Hz, range 2,810–4,120; the pulse-level mean is separately 3,700 Hz across 194 pulses. These units are not fifty or 194 independent males, and pulse frequency is not silently substituted for the call-level frequency.

招引鸣声呈 rattling 声，五十次鸣声报告持续 0.184 ± 0.07 秒，范围 0.004–0.277 秒。每声一至五个脉冲；194 个测量脉冲平均长四毫秒。脉冲间隔和周期各有 144 个观察，而脉冲速率摘要使用 49 次鸣声，范围每秒 11.89–57.14 个，报告均值 17.3。单声最大振幅频率均值 3,780 赫兹，范围 2,810–4,120；194 个脉冲层面另有均值 3,700 赫兹。这些单位不是五十或 194 只独立雄性，不把脉冲频率静默替代单声频率。
ecology
Males call from concealed bank hollows
雄性在隐蔽岸穴鸣叫

Observations come from central Myanmar’s dry zone near temporary or permanent pools, paddy fields and reservoirs. Animals were collected at 18:30–21:00; male calling continued roughly 19:00–02:00, so collection times and calling times are distinct. Males usually hid in bank cracks and holes, sometimes buffalo hoofprints; females hid in nearby grass. These encounters describe substrate use without a controlled concealment preference, disturbance tolerance or proof that hoofprints are obligatory breeding habitat. The regional savanna-like climate does not define measured physiological thermal limits.
观察来自 Myanmar 中部干旱区的临时或永久池、稻田及水库附近。采集时刻 18:30–21:00，雄性鸣叫约 19:00–02:00，采集时间和鸣叫时间不同。雄性通常藏于岸裂和孔洞，有时在水牛蹄印；雌性藏附近草中。这些遇见描述基质利用，不是控制隐蔽偏好、干扰耐受或蹄印为必需繁殖生境的证明。地区稀树草原样气候不确定实测生理温度限。
reproduction
Captured-female egg release does not establish natural clutch size
捕获雌性排卵不能确定自然窝卵数

The authors state that clutch size is unknown. Female ZMMU A5972 laid approximately thirty eggs in a plastic bag after capture; that event is not certified as a complete natural clutch. Eggs are described as 0.8–0.9 mm in diameter and yellow-white with a brownish pole, but the printed adjective for the pole is malformed and is not used to infer developmental biology. Larval stages and diet were unknown in the paper. The observation does not establish egg substrate in the wild, fertilization, hatch success, parental care or direct development.
作者明确称窝卵数未知。雌性 ZMMU A5972 捕获后在塑料袋产约三十枚卵，这一事件没有认证为完整自然窝卵。卵描述直径 0.8–0.9 毫米、黄白并有褐色一极，但该极的印出修饰词异常，不据此推断发育生物学。论文中幼体阶段及食性未知。该观察不确定野外产卵基质、受精、孵化成功、亲代照料或直接发育。
distribution
Two confirmed areas remain separate from the Sagaing candidate
两个确认地区与 Sagaing 候选分别保留

The source confirms Pakokku suburbs on the Irrawaddy, type label 59 m, and Kan Pauk vicinity, paratype label 217 m; the distribution summary rounds these to 60–220 m. Kan Pauk is about thirty kilometres north of the type area. A related Chatthin population in Sagaing, designated Microhyla sp. 2, differs by 2.0% and remains explicitly unresolved as conspecific. The genealogy places irrawaddy as sister to that unnamed population and close to kodial, rather than equating all of them. No candidate locality is promoted to confirmed range, and rounded elevations are not tolerance bounds.

来源确认 Irrawaddy 河畔 Pakokku 郊区，模式标签海拔 59 米，以及 Kan Pauk 附近、副模标签 217 米；分布摘要取整为 60–220 米。Kan Pauk 在模式地区以北约三十公里。Sagaing 的 Chatthin 近缘种群称 Microhyla sp. 2，差异 2.0%，是否同种明确未解决。谱系将 irrawaddy 置为该未名种群姐妹且近 kodial，而非等同三者。不将候选地点提升为确认分布，取整海拔也不是耐受界限。
conservation
The 2019 Data Deficient proposal reflects unknown range and trend
2019 年数据缺乏建议反映分布和趋势未知

Because actual range and population trends remained unknown, the authors proposed Data Deficient using the cited IUCN category framework. This is a dated research recommendation, not verification of a current Red List assessment. Two observed areas, calling males and gravid females do not quantify population abundance, long-term recruitment or conservation recovery. Predicted further Irrawaddy Valley sites require independent occurrence and identity evidence; neither their existence nor their absence is established by the proposal.
实际分布与种群趋势仍未知，因此作者依据所引 IUCN 类别框架建议数据缺乏。这是有日期的研究建议，不是现行红色名录评估核实。两个观察地区、鸣叫雄性和怀卵雌性不量化种群丰度、长期补充或保护恢复。预期的其他 Irrawaddy 河谷地点需要独立出现及身份依据，该建议既不确定其存在也不确定不存在。

sections: morphology
Fourteen-point-two millimetres describes one male
14.2 毫米描述一只雄性

The original diagnosis reports the single adult male ZMMU A-5820 at 14.2 mm snout–vent length, not a male or female population range. The stout body has a head about as long as wide, short rounded snout and first finger reduced to a nub, 29.2% of finger II length. Outer metatarsal tubercle is absent and inner tubercle small; digit tips are rounded, only toes III–IV weakly expanded. Posterior dorsal skin is notably warty while the belly is smooth. These features form the source’s comparative diagnosis; a small body alone does not establish species identity, and the unmeasured female size remains unknown here.
原鉴别报告唯一成年雄性 ZMMU A-5820 吻肛长 14.2 毫米，不是雌雄种群范围。粗壮身体具有头长宽近等、短圆吻，第一指退化成小突，长为第二指 29.2%。外跖瘤缺失、内跖瘤小；指趾端圆，只有第三、第四趾略扩。背部后段明显疣状、腹面光滑。这些构成来源比较鉴别，小体型本身不能确定物种身份，此处未测雌性体长仍未知。
appearance
The holotype has grey-beige ventral colour
正模腹面为灰米色

The live holotype has a grey-brown dorsum, lighter and reddish-speckled anteriorly, with darker posterior tubercles and whitish pustule centres. Head sides are dark brown with beige mottling. The grey-beige underside has weak grey marbling, denser on chest, throat and limbs than belly, and the iris is described as uniformly black. These are one male’s live observations, not immutable species-wide colours, sex comparisons or evidence of seasonal change. Preserved appearance and microtomographic skeletal findings are separate evidence and are not reproduced as though observed in a living population.
活体正模背灰褐，前部较浅并有红色细点，后部瘤较暗、疱状突中央偏白；头侧深褐并有米色斑。腹面灰米色、弱灰大理石纹，胸喉和肢体较腹密，虹膜描述为均匀黑色。这是一只雄性活体观察，不是全物种不变颜色、性别比较或季节变化证据。保存外观及微断层骨骼发现是不同证据，不当作活种群观察重复呈现。
ecology
One wet-soil encounter supports a tentative concealed lifestyle
一次湿土遇见支持暂定隐蔽生活解释

At 21:00 on 31 May 2016, during heavy rain, the male was found in wet soil at the bottom of a roughly 20 cm hollow under a turned two-metre rotten log, about seven metres from a cascading stream. Air temperature was 21 °C and humidity 100% in the account. The authors infer semi-fossorial or leaf-litter concealment, without measuring time underground, digging performance or a humidity requirement. Seven further field days produced no additional specimen. This local non-detection does not establish rarity throughout the range, and no recorded calling does not demonstrate inability to call.
2016 年五月三十一日 21:00 大雨中，雄性见于翻开的约两米腐木下、约二十厘米坑底湿土，距跌水溪约七米。条目空气温度 21 摄氏度、湿度 100%。作者推测半穴居或枯叶隐蔽生活，没有测量地下时间、挖掘能力或湿度需求。其后七天野外工作没有额外标本。局部未检出不确定全分布稀有，未录鸣声也不证明不能鸣叫。
distribution
Only Kon Chu Rang is confirmed in this original account
原条目仅确认 Kon Chu Rang

The 2018 paper knows inexpectata only from Kon Chu Rang Nature Reserve, Gia Lai, on the Tay Nguyen Plateau in central Vietnam, at about 1,000 m. It anticipates other similar montane sites in central Vietnam and possibly Laos. Those predicted areas are not confirmed occurrences, continuous occupancy or a mapped range. The one type-locality elevation is not a physiological bound or a complete elevational range. Later discoveries would require their own attributable source and identity evidence before being added as confirmed distribution.
2018 年论文中 inexpectata 仅知 Vietnam 中部 Tay Nguyen 高原、Gia Lai 的 Kon Chu Rang 自然保护区，海拔约 1,000 米。预期 Vietnam 中部其他相似山地及可能 Laos 出现。这些预测地区不是确认记录、连续占据或已绘制分布。一个模式地点海拔不是生理界限或完整海拔范围；后续发现需有自己的可归属来源及身份依据，才纳入确认分布。
conservation
Unknown life history underlies the dated Data Deficient suggestion
未知生活史支持有日期的数据缺乏建议

Diet and reproductive biology were unknown, no calling was recorded, and range and population status remained unresolved. Well-developed testes in the examined male do not establish a breeding calendar, clutch size or developmental mode. The 2018 authors suggest Data Deficient under cited IUCN guidance and request further surveys. This is a dated proposal, not a current Red List verification or measured decline. Their explanation that secretive biology may account for few encounters is a hypothesis, not a corrected abundance estimate.
食性、繁殖生物学未知，没有录得鸣声，分布及种群状态仍未解决。检查雄性发达睾丸不确定繁殖日历、窝卵数或发育模式。2018 年作者依所引 IUCN 指引建议数据缺乏并要求进一步调查。这是有日期建议，不是现行红色名录核实或实测下降。隐蔽生活可能解释少遇见属于假说，不是校正后丰度估计。
taxonomy
Genus placement is a mitochondrial and morphological hypothesis
属级位置属于线粒体及形态假说

The original study places the three named Vietnamophryne species in a supported Asterophryinae lineage and suggests the genus as sister to Siamophryne. Its 12S–16S mitochondrial fragment does not fully resolve every Asterophryinae lineage. The reported placement belongs to the sampled genealogy and comparative morphology, not a nuclear-genomic isolation test or proof that later named genus members share every diagnostic measurement. Single original male proportions, colours and encounter sites remain species-specific rather than being borrowed across the genus.
原研究将三个具名 Vietnamophryne 种置于有支持的 Asterophryinae 谱系，并提出该属为 Siamophryne 姐妹。其 12S–16S 线粒体片段未完全解决每条 Asterophryinae 谱系。位置属于受采谱系及比较形态，不是核基因组隔离试验，也不证明后命名属内成员共享每项鉴别测量。原始单雄性比例、颜色及遇见地点保持物种特定，不跨属内物种借用。
title: A new genus and three new species of miniaturized microhylid frogs from Indochina (Amphibia: Anura: Microhylidae: Asterophryinae)

One male has a longer head and relatively developed first finger
一只雄性头较长且第一指较发达

The diagnosis reports adult male ZMMU A-5821 at 15.4 mm snout–vent length. Head width/length is 86.5%, snout/eye length 141.3%, and first finger length is 47.9% of finger II, contrasting the more reduced first finger of inexpectata. The small rounded tympanum is 5.5% of SVL. Outer metatarsal tubercle is absent, anterior dorsal skin smooth and posterior skin somewhat shagreened with small pustules; the ventral surface is smooth. These are a single male’s diagnostic proportions, not a sex-specific range or a demonstrated developmental trajectory. Female morphology is not established by this account.
鉴别报告成年雄性 ZMMU A-5821 吻肛长 15.4 毫米。头宽长比 86.5%，吻长与眼长比 141.3%，第一指为第二指 47.9%，与 inexpectata 更退化第一指形成比较。小圆鼓膜占吻肛长 5.5%。外跖瘤缺失，前背光滑、后背略粗糙有小疱，腹面光滑。这是一只雄性鉴别比例，不是分性别范围或已证明发育轨迹，本条目未确定雌性形态。
appearance
Lemon-yellow ventral colour belongs to the live holotype
柠檬黄色腹面属于活体正模

The live male has a reddish-brown back, orange-brown anteriorly, densely scattered red speckles and tiny whitish posterior pustules. Narrow pale tubercular lines mark the canthus and upper eyelid. Head sides are dark brown with pale mottling, and the bright lemon-yellow underside has fine dark marbling, denser towards chest and throat. The iris is uniformly dark brown. The account distinguishes this specimen from the other original species by a combination of colours and morphology; it does not document female colour, within-population variation or a toxin-based explanation for the bright underside.
活体雄性背红褐、前部橙褐，密布红细点、后部有小白疱，吻棱及上眼睑有窄浅色瘤线。头侧深褐带浅斑，鲜柠檬黄色腹面有细暗大理石纹，胸喉方向更密。虹膜均匀深褐。条目以颜色和形态组合区别另外两个原描述种，没有记录雌性颜色、种群内变异或鲜腹色的毒素解释。
ecology
The soil refuge was observed once, not a measured burrowing preference
土中隐蔽所见一次，而非实测穴居偏好

The only specimen was found at 23:00 on 9 June 2017 during heavy rain, about ten centimetres underground around fern roots on a steep Phia Oac slope, twenty metres from a cascading stream, at roughly 1,200 m and air temperature 17 °C. The type label calls the plant a tree fern, while the natural-history account tentatively identifies cf. Dicranopteris; that plant identity is not silently unified. Ten field days found no additional frog. Semi-fossorial behaviour is proposed from this encounter, not measured excavation or obligate underground residence. The surrounding forest’s 1,200–1,400 m context is not additional species-occurrence evidence.
唯一标本于 2017 年六月九日 23:00 大雨中见于 Phia Oac 陡坡蕨根周围、地下约十厘米，距跌水溪二十米，海拔约 1,200 米、空气温度 17 摄氏度。模式标签称树蕨，自然史段却暂定 cf. Dicranopteris，不静默统一植物身份。十天野外工作无额外蛙。半穴居依据这次遇见提出，不是实测挖掘或必须地下居住。周围森林 1,200–1,400 米背景不是额外物种出现证据。
distribution
Phia Oac is confirmed while other ridge sites are predicted
Phia Oac 已确认，其他山脊地点为预测

The original account confirms only Phia Oac Mountain in Phia Oac–Phia Den National Park, Cao Bang, northern Vietnam, at about 1,200 m. It considers similar montane forest elsewhere along the Ngan Son–Yen Lac ridge a likely setting for future records. These prospects are not confirmed occupancy across neighbouring provinces or a complete area of occurrence. The known locality is a sampled point under the original diagnosis, not evidence of absence throughout the rest of the ridge or a complete altitude tolerance interval.
原条目仅确认 Vietnam 北部 Cao Bang 的 Phia Oac–Phia Den 国家公园、Phia Oac 山，海拔约 1,200 米。认为 Ngan Son–Yen Lac 山脊其他相似山地林可能提供后续记录。这些预期不是邻省确认占据或完整出现面积。已知地点是原鉴别下采样点，不证明其余山脊不存在或完整海拔耐受区间。
conservation
Diet, reproduction and population status were unresolved
食性、繁殖和种群状态仍未解决

The source reports unknown diet and reproductive biology and no recorded calls during the survey. The male’s testes are described as developed, without observation of eggs, larvae or mating. The authors propose Data Deficient in 2018 and emphasize surveys elsewhere in northeastern Vietnam. This is a research recommendation, not an independently current IUCN category or quantified decline. Possible secretive biology is an encounter explanation, not proof that the population is abundant, secure or fully protected by the park designation.
来源报告食性及繁殖生物学未知，调查期间无录鸣声。雄性睾丸描述为发达，却没有卵、幼体或交配观察。作者在 2018 年建议数据缺乏，强调 Vietnam 东北其他地区调查。这是研究建议，不是独立现行 IUCN 类别或量化下降。可能隐蔽生活解释遇见，不证明种群丰富、安全或由国家公园身份完全保护。
taxonomy
Genus placement is a mitochondrial and morphological hypothesis
属级位置属于线粒体及形态假说

The original study places the three named Vietnamophryne species in a supported Asterophryinae lineage and suggests the genus as sister to Siamophryne. Its 12S–16S mitochondrial fragment does not fully resolve every Asterophryinae lineage. The reported placement belongs to the sampled genealogy and comparative morphology, not a nuclear-genomic isolation test or proof that later named genus members share every diagnostic measurement. Single original male proportions, colours and encounter sites remain species-specific rather than being borrowed across the genus.
原研究将三个具名 Vietnamophryne 种置于有支持的 Asterophryinae 谱系，并提出该属为 Siamophryne 姐妹。其 12S–16S 线粒体片段未完全解决每条 Asterophryinae 谱系。位置属于受采谱系及比较形态，不是核基因组隔离试验，也不证明后命名属内成员共享每项鉴别测量。原始单雄性比例、颜色及遇见地点保持物种特定，不跨属内物种借用。
title: A new genus and three new species of miniaturized microhylid frogs from Indochina (Amphibia: Anura: Microhylidae: Asterophryinae)

sections: morphology
Twenty-point-five millimetres is the single preserved male
20.5 毫米来自唯一保存雄性

Adult male holotype ZMMU A-5822 is reported at 20.5 mm snout–vent length and in poor preservation condition. Its head is nearly as long as wide, snout shorter than the eye, and first finger 43.0% of finger II length. The small tympanum is near the eye; digit tips are rounded with only toes III–IV weakly enlarged, outer metatarsal tubercle absent, and posterior dorsal tubercles sparse. The diagnosis compares this larger original male with inexpectata and orlovi. It establishes neither a species-wide maximum size nor a female range, and the additional uncollected encounter is not another measured voucher.
成年雄性正模 ZMMU A-5822 报告吻肛长 20.5 毫米、保存状态较差。头长宽近等、吻短于眼，第一指为第二指长 43.0%。小鼓膜近眼，指趾端圆、仅第三第四趾略扩，外跖瘤缺失、后背瘤稀疏。鉴别将这一较大原描述雄性与 inexpectata、orlovi 比较，不确定全物种最大体长或雌性范围，额外未采集遇见也不是另一件测量凭证。
appearance
The live holotype has a bright orange-red underside
活体正模具有鲜橙红腹面

The live holotype is uniformly dark brick-brown above, including the limbs, with sparse darker tubercles and grey posterior pustules. Head sides are almost black without the whitish jaw mottling described for the other original species. The bright orange-red underside carries weak sparse brown marbling, denser on throat and hind limbs; iris is dark brown. These are one male’s live colour observations. They do not establish colour polymorphism, a female pattern, toxicity or warning-colour function, and are kept separate from the later ethanol-preserved appearance.
活体正模背及肢体均匀深砖褐，有稀疏暗瘤和后部灰疱。头侧近黑，没有另外两个原描述种的浅颌斑。鲜橙红腹面有弱稀褐大理石纹，喉及后肢较密，虹膜深褐。这是一只雄性活体颜色观察，不确定多型、雌性色型、毒性或警戒色功能，与后续乙醇保存外观区分。
ecology
Daytime encounters after rain do not establish a fixed daily schedule
雨后白天遇见不确定固定昼夜日程

An uncollected Doi Tung frog was seen under a log around 1,000 m on 10 February 2017. The holotype was collected at 14:00 on 5 April 2017 after heavy rain, at 1,050 m in leaf litter beside a forest trail on a limestone slope, far from streams in the type label. These are two encounters but one deposited voucher. The authors infer concealment in soil or litter; no daily activity budget, burrowing trial or obligatory stream avoidance was measured. The concluding paragraph mistakenly names orlovi when discussing unknown diet and reproduction, so that sentence is not silently treated as newly direct occidentalis evidence.
一只未采集 Doi Tung 蛙于 2017 年二月十日在约 1,000 米腐木下见到。正模于四月五日大雨后 14:00 采于 1,050 米石灰岩坡林道旁枯叶，模式标签称远离溪流。这是两次遇见、一个入藏凭证。作者推测土或枯叶隐蔽，没有测量昼夜活动预算、挖掘试验或必须回避溪流。结尾讨论未知食性及繁殖时误写 orlovi，不静默将该句当作新增直接 occidentalis 证据。
distribution
Doi Tung records do not confirm adjacent Myanmar occupancy
Doi Tung 记录不确认邻近 Myanmar 占据

The 2018 source confirms a single Doi Tung locality in northern Thailand’s Chiang Rai area, with the holotype at about 1,050 m and earlier unvouchered encounter around 1,000 m. The ridge approaches Myanmar’s Shan State, where future occurrence is anticipated rather than observed. Border proximity alone supplies no confirmed cross-border distribution. The original evidence does not establish continuous mountain occupancy, an area-of-occupancy metric or verified absence from other limestone forests.
2018 年来源确认 Thailand 北部 Chiang Rai 地区一个 Doi Tung 地点，正模约 1,050 米，较早未凭证遇见约 1,000 米。山脊接近 Myanmar 的 Shan State，那里的出现属于预期而非观察。近国界本身不提供确认跨境分布。原证据不确定连续山地占据、占据面积指标或其他石灰岩林确认不存在。
conservation
One voucher and one encounter underpin a dated proposal
一个凭证与一次遇见支持有日期建议

The conservation account explicitly bases knowledge on one unvouchered record and the holotype, with range and population status unresolved. It suggests Data Deficient in 2018 and further focused Thai and Myanmar surveys. The proposal is not current Red List verification, a numerical decline or evidence that the species is necessarily absent outside Doi Tung. No calls were recorded during either survey; this evidence gap cannot be used to infer silence, reproductive mode, larval absence or a complete natural history.
保护条目明确以一条未凭证记录和正模为知识基础，分布及种群状态未解决。2018 年建议数据缺乏并进一步定向调查 Thailand、Myanmar。建议不是现行红色名录核实、数值下降或物种必然仅限 Doi Tung 的证明。两次调查都没有录得鸣声；这种缺口不能推断沉默、繁殖模式、没有幼体或完整自然史。

Genus placement is a mitochondrial and morphological hypothesis
属级位置属于线粒体及形态假说

The original study places the three named Vietnamophryne species in a supported Asterophryinae lineage and suggests the genus as sister to Siamophryne. Its 12S–16S mitochondrial fragment does not fully resolve every Asterophryinae lineage. The reported placement belongs to the sampled genealogy and comparative morphology, not a nuclear-genomic isolation test or proof that later named genus members share every diagnostic measurement. sections: morphology
Seven males and four females have overlapping adult sizes
七只雄性与四只雌性成年体长重叠

The examined adult males measure 13.1–17.0 mm snout–vent length, n=7, and females 14.8–16.9 mm, n=4; two fresh metamorphs at 7.4–8.7 mm are separate developmental samples. Male throat asperities form a central stripe widening anteriorly. Rudimentary toe webbing, a covered inconspicuous tympanum, absent eyelid cornicles and comparatively small size contribute to the diagnosis. Maxillary and premaxillary teeth are present, vomerine teeth absent. Neither overlapping size nor one character identifies every specimen; juvenile steindachneri can be superficially similar and requires comparative examination.
检查成年雄性吻肛长 13.1–17.0 毫米、七只，雌性 14.8–16.9 毫米、四只；两只新变态幼体 7.4–8.7 毫米属于另一个发育样本。雄性喉部小突形成向前加宽的中条。退化趾蹼、覆皮不明显鼓膜、没有眼睑角突及较小体型参与鉴别。上颌及前上颌齿存在、犁骨齿缺失。重叠体长或单项特征不能鉴定每件标本；steindachneri 幼体可能外观相似，需要比较检查。
appearance
Live markings vary within the examined series
活体斑纹在检查系列内有变异

The male holotype has dark brown dorsal colour with a broad light brown stripe edged in black and a finer vertebral line, plus scattered orange and white spots. Its throat is dark with white asperities, belly yellow to cream and hind-limb underside pink-orange. The wider series varies in dorsal stripes, spots and interorbital colour; female thighs are generally more vividly orange and female throats lighter than males. These are specimen and sex-associated observations, not invariant markings, a toxicity measurement or warning-colour experiment. Preserved colours remain distinct from photographed live appearance.
雄性正模背深褐，具有黑边宽浅褐条、较细脊线及散布橙白点；喉暗有白突，腹黄至奶油色，后肢腹面粉橙。较广系列在背条、斑及眼间颜色上有变异；雌性股腹面通常橙色更鲜、喉较雄性浅。这是标本及性别关联观察，不是不变斑纹、毒性测量或警戒色实验。保存颜色与摄影活体外观区分。
development
Larval morphology does not establish a growth trajectory
幼体形态不确定生长轨迹

The described larvae have an ovoid body, rounded snout, dorsolateral eyes, a left spiracle and right vent tube. The anteroventral oral disc has papillae along the lower labium but not the upper, with keratodont formula 1/1 + 1//2 as printed and finely serrated jaw sheaths. Body and tail are dark above, the underside unpigmented and fins mostly transparent. The authors qualify the rounded tail tip as possibly unnatural. The paragraph also supplies conflicting statements about maximum tail height relative to body height; these are not harmonized into a certified ratio. This morphological account does not measure larval growth, hatching time or metamorphic survival.
描述幼体身体卵圆、吻圆、眼背侧，有左呼吸孔和右肛管。前腹侧口盘下唇有乳突、上唇没有，角质齿式按原记为 1/1 + 1//2，颌鞘细锯齿。身体及尾背面暗、腹面未着色、鳍主要透明。作者注明圆尾端可能并非自然状态。该段最大尾高与体高关系还存在相冲陈述，不协调为认证比值。形态条目不测量幼体生长、孵化时间或变态存活。
taxonomy
Barcode and longer-fragment distances answer different comparisons
短条码和较长片段距离属于不同比较

Six sequenced arcanus specimens contain two 510-base 16S haplotypes, three specimens each, differing by two substitutions. Distance to mbabo is 1.2% in this barcode but 5.0% in the longer 12S–16S fragment; these marker scopes are not interchangeable. Six arcanus specimens yield eight inferred nuclear RAG1 haplotypes, none shared with mbabo or the other examined species. Inferred allelic haplotypes are not eight independent frogs. This combined evidence supports the study’s delimitation, without a universal distance cutoff, experimental mating test or independent certification of every modern catalogue record.
六件测序 arcanus 标本具有两个 510 碱基 16S 单倍型，各三件、相差两个替换。与 mbabo 在短条码距离 1.2%，较长 12S–16S 片段为 5.0%，标记范围不能互换。六件 arcanus 推断八个核 RAG1 单倍型，与 mbabo 及其他检查物种不共享；推断等位单倍型不是八只独立蛙。组合证据支持研究划分，不提供普遍距离阈值、实验交配试验或每条现代目录记录的独立认证。
behavior
Notes, groups and whole calls retain different durations
音符、组和整声保留不同时长

Afternoon advertisement calls recorded on 5 November 2009 consist of metallic clicking notes; the whole call can last seconds to over a minute. At the reported 17.5 °C, note groups average 1.7 ± 0.1 s and contain 6–8 notes; notes average 12.5 ± 0.1 ms, repetition rate 4.2 ± 0.7 per second and dominant frequency 3.92 ± 0.03 kHz. The source explicitly uses mean ± standard deviation. Repetition accelerates within a call and the group’s last note has higher pitch. These summaries do not turn group duration into whole-call duration or repeated notes into independent frogs, nor establish function beyond the attributed advertisement description.

2009 年十一月五日下午录得招引声，由金属样点击音符组成，整声可长数秒至超过一分钟。报告 17.5 摄氏度条件下，音符组平均 1.7 ± 0.1 秒、每组六至八音符；音符平均 12.5 ± 0.1 毫秒，重复速率每秒 4.2 ± 0.7，主频 3.92 ± 0.03 千赫兹。来源明确采用均值 ± 标准差。整声内速率上升、组末音符音高更高。这些摘要不将组时长变为整声时长，也不将重复音符变为独立蛙，或确定来源招引描述之外的功能。
ecology
Daylight pond encounters support an apparent activity tendency
白天池边遇见支持似然活动趋势

Most observed frogs were jumping in herbaceous vegetation by a small stream pond outside forest, among shrubs and montane grassland. One male was found at night near a stream in escarpment forest. Males called from partly submerged plants with leaves above water and larvae occurred in the pond. The authors infer relatively diurnal activity and possible open-habitat preference; this is not a controlled preference or complete daily schedule. In June 2016 calls at another site were heard but not recorded and no animals seen, so their attribution remains probable rather than a confirmed voucher record.
多数观察蛙在林外小溪池旁草本间跳跃，周围灌丛及山地草地；一只雄性夜间见于陡坡森林溪旁。雄性在部分浸水植物水上叶片鸣叫，池中有幼体。作者推测较偏白天活动、可能喜开阔生境，不是控制偏好或完整日程。2016 年六月另一地点听到但未录鸣声、未见个体，因此归属保留可能性，不提升为确认凭证记录。
distribution
Two Gangirwal sites remain distinct from uncertain older localization
两个 Gangirwal 地点与不精确旧定位区分

The source confirms two Mount Gangirwal sites in the Gotel Mountains on the Cameroon–Nigeria border at 1,940 and 2,250 m, about 1.1 km apart by air. The holotype is from the 2,250 m pond site. A 1988 record published under Phrynobatrachus sp. is not precisely located; its coordinates and 2,300 m label roughly correspond to the studied area. These different label scopes are retained, rather than pooling every value into a verified continuous elevation range. Border-area records do not independently establish occupancy of all neighbouring mountain habitats.

来源确认 Cameroon–Nigeria 边界 Gotel 山的 Mount Gangirwal 两个地点，海拔 1,940 与 2,250 米，直线约相隔 1.1 公里；正模来自 2,250 米池地点。1988 年以 Phrynobatrachus sp. 发表的记录定位不精确，坐标和 2,300 米标签大致对应研究地区。分别保留标签范围，不将全部数值汇为认证连续海拔范围。边界地区记录不独立确定全部邻近山地生境占据。
conservation
The authors recommend Critically Endangered from limited dated evidence
作者依据有限历史证据建议极危

The 2020 account strongly recommends Critically Endangered, citing estimated occupancy below 10 km², extent below 100 km², one location and presumed decline. In the 2016 Gotel survey no Phrynobatrachus specimen was found, although arcanus was possibly heard; small size and dense vegetation were noted as detection difficulties. Non-detection is not a quantified species-specific decline or proof of extinction. The recommendation and area estimates are the study’s dated evidence, not a current independently verified IUCN assessment or a new complete range calculation.
2020 年条目强烈建议极危，依据估计占据面积低于十平方公里、出现范围低于百平方公里、一个位置及推定下降。2016 年 Gotel 调查没有找到 Phrynobatrachus 标本，但可能听到 arcanus；小体型及密植被被列为检出困难。未检出不是量化该种下降或灭绝证明。建议和面积估计是研究有日期证据，不是现行独立核实 IUCN 评估或新的完整分布计算。
title: Evolutionary history of the Cameroon radiation of puddle frogs (Phrynobatrachidae: Phrynobatrachus ), with descriptions of two critically endangered new species from the northern Cameroon Volcanic Line

sections: morphology
Two male sizes are distinct from five adult females
两只雄性体长与五只成年雌性区分

The two examined males measure 14.0 and 14.5 mm snout–vent length; five adult females measure 15.3–17.9 mm. A combined 14.0–17.9 mm diagnosis is not a male-only range. Central male throat asperities, rudimentary webbing and an inconspicuous tympanum resemble arcanus. The comparison adds relatively longer hind limbs and cranial differences, including a more gracile columella and shorter ventral squamosal ramus. Ratios and skeletal features concern examined material; neither combined size nor superficial resemblance identifies every frog, especially juvenile steindachneri collected in syntopy.
两只检查雄性吻肛长分别 14.0、14.5 毫米，五只成年雌性 15.3–17.9 毫米。合并鉴别 14.0–17.9 毫米不是仅雄性范围。雄性中央喉突、退化蹼及不明显鼓膜类似 arcanus，比较另含较长后肢及较纤细耳柱、较短鳞骨腹支等颅差。比值及骨特征针对检查材料；合并体长或表面相似不能鉴定每只蛙，尤其同域采到的 steindachneri 幼体。
appearance
Only the female holotype supplies live colour
活体颜色仅来自雌性正模

The live female holotype has an orange-brown back with darker eyelids and interorbital region, white side spots, a light-yellow belly with a few chest spots and orange hind-limb undersides. Live colour was known only for this female; male and wider-series colour variation in the account comes from preserved specimens. The diagnostic description of female hind limbs as light orange and the holotype account as vivid orange are separate source descriptions, not an invented colour scale. No live male colour or toxin function is supplied.
活体雌性正模背橙褐、眼睑和眼间较暗，体侧白点，浅黄腹有少数胸点、后肢腹面橙。活体颜色仅知这一雌性；条目中雄性及较广系列变异来自保存标本。鉴别将雌性后肢称浅橙，正模条目称鲜橙，两种来源描述分别保留，不编造颜色尺度。没有提供活体雄性颜色或毒素功能。
taxonomy
Three sequenced specimens share one short-fragment haplotype
三件测序标本共享一个短片段单倍型

All three sequenced mbabo specimens share one 510-base 16S haplotype. Distance to arcanus is 1.2% for that barcode and 5.0% across the longer 12S–16S fragment, with additional differences outside the barcode in a hypervariable region. Two inferred nuclear RAG1 haplotypes differ from arcanus. These are different marker comparisons and allelic units, not interchangeable distances or additional individual counts. The combined evidence supports the paper’s distinction while leaving range-wide genomic coverage and independent contemporary concept certification unproven.
三件测序 mbabo 标本共享一个 510 碱基 16S 单倍型。与 arcanus 在短条码距离 1.2%，较长 12S–16S 为 5.0%，条码外高变区有额外差异；两个推断核 RAG1 单倍型与 arcanus 不同。这是不同标记比较及等位单位，不是可互换距离或新增个体数。组合证据支持论文区分，但不证明全分布基因组覆盖或独立现行概念认证。
behavior
An attributed 1972 recording supplies the call account
明确归属的 1972 年录音支持鸣声条目

The call analysis uses J.-L. Amiet’s 24 December 1972 recording, originally Phrynobatrachus sp. 5. Clicking note groups average 2.2 ± 0.3 s with 8–11 notes; notes average 14.8 ± 0.2 ms, repetition 4.8 ± 0.2 per second and dominant frequency 3.51 ± 0.05 kHz, all reported mean ± standard deviation. The last two notes are closer together, about 70 ms versus roughly 170 ms otherwise, and the final note lower pitched. Historical recording attribution is not a new monitored population; repeated notes do not establish frog count, and no recording temperature is invented.

鸣声分析使用 J.-L. Amiet 1972 年十二月二十四日录音，原标 Phrynobatrachus sp. 5。点击音符组平均 2.2 ± 0.3 秒、含八至十一音符；音符平均 14.8 ± 0.2 毫秒、重复每秒 4.8 ± 0.2、主频 3.51 ± 0.05 千赫兹，均按报告均值 ± 标准差。末两个音符约间隔七十毫秒，其他约一百七十，最后音符音高更低。历史录音归属不是新监测种群，重复音符不确定蛙数，也不编造录音温度。
reproduction
Bottle-laid eggs do not determine natural oviposition
采集瓶产卵不确定自然产卵方式

The female holotype laid eggs overnight in a collecting bottle on 28 January 2000, in the middle of the local dry season. The paragraph gives no egg count, diameter, fertilization or hatching result. This capture event does not establish a natural egg substrate, full clutch-size range or species-wide breeding calendar. The source expressly says tadpoles are unknown. Unknown larvae cannot be replaced with arcanus larval traits or used to infer direct development, and the bottle observation supplies no parental-care evidence.
雌性正模于 2000 年一月二十八日夜间在采集瓶中产卵，处当地旱季中段。该段没有卵数、直径、受精或孵化结果。捕获事件不确定自然产卵基质、完整窝卵范围或全物种繁殖日历。来源明确称蝌蚪未知，不能用 arcanus 幼体特征替代或推断直接发育；瓶中观察也不提供亲代照料证据。
ecology
Forest-night specimens and daytime meadow calls have different contexts
森林夜间标本与白天草甸鸣声情境不同

Examined specimens were active near a montane forest stream at about 20:00–21:30 and 20 °C. Other frogs were mixed with superficially similar juvenile steindachneri and not directly distinguished in the field. The cited older call account instead describes swampy meadows and daytime calling. The authors hypothesize that open grassland wetlands are typical and gallery forests visited less often; this is not an experimental habitat preference. Night captures and historical day calls are retained separately rather than turned into an exclusively diurnal or nocturnal rule.
检查标本约 20:00–21:30、20 摄氏度时在山地森林溪旁活动。其他个体与外观相似的 steindachneri 幼体混采，未在野外直接区分。引述旧鸣声条目则描述沼泽草甸及白天鸣叫。作者假设开阔草地湿地为典型环境、较少进入廊道林，不是实验生境偏好。夜捕和历史白天鸣声分别保留，不转为只昼行或只夜行规则。
distribution
The type valley is confirmed; the wider ridge remains possible
模式河谷已确认，更广山脊仍属可能

The source confirms the Tchabal Mbabo type locality in Cameroon’s Adamawa region, about 2,000–2,100 m, with the female type label at 2,060 m. The historical Mayo Yim call locality is essentially the same Yim-stream valley. Occurrence along the roughly fifty-kilometre mountain ridge is suggested but not surveyed confirmation. The approximate locality interval is not a calculated physiological limit or complete mountain occupancy. Accessibility of the type valley helps explain sampling scope rather than establishing absence from less accessible ridge habitat.
来源确认 Cameroon、Adamawa 地区 Tchabal Mbabo 模式地点，约海拔 2,000–2,100 米，雌性模式标签 2,060 米。历史 Mayo Yim 鸣声地点基本是同一 Yim 溪谷。约五十公里山脊沿线出现为建议而非调查确认。近似地点区间不是计算生理限或完整山地占据。模式谷易到达解释采样范围，不确定难到达山脊生境不存在。
conservation
Failure to find specimens in 2016 supports concern, not proved extinction
2016 年未找到标本支持担忧，而非证明灭绝

The paper reports no mbabo found during a June 2016 survey and identifies 2000 as its latest specimen observation within the study evidence. It presumes severe decline by analogy with other highland Phrynobatrachus, and recommends Critically Endangered based on known occupancy below 10 km², one location and presumed decline. These are dated source observations and interpretation, not a current last-seen date, experimentally identified decline cause or proof of extinction. Local zero detections and a category recommendation do not provide a quantified population trajectory or a newly verified current IUCN assessment.
论文报告 2016 年六月调查未找到 mbabo，在研究证据内将 2000 年列为最近标本观察。依据其他高地 Phrynobatrachus 类比推定严重下降，并以已知占据面积低于十平方公里、一个位置和推定下降建议极危。这是有日期来源观察及解释，不是现行最后出现日期、实验确定下降原因或灭绝证明。局部零检出与类别建议不提供量化种群轨迹或新核实现行 IUCN 评估。
title: Evolutionary history of the Cameroon radiation of puddle frogs (Phrynobatrachidae: Phrynobatrachus ), with descriptions of two critically endangered new species from the northern Cameroon Volcanic Line

name: Occidozyga lingnanica
readScope: Occidozyga lingnanica: Two individually attributed Central Vietnamese vouchers, their morphology, live/preserved colours and encounter habitats; selected raw-XML phylogeny and discussion; earlier authored source retained; northern Vietnam occurrence remains predicted; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

PMC13139858 reading-sections section 5 paragraph 0; section 6 paragraph 0

sections: morphology
Two measured adults are not a population size range
两只实测成年不是种群体长范围

The Central Vietnamese account describes male IB A.6489 at 22.31 mm snout–vent length and female IB A.6490 at 25.93 mm. These are individual measurements, not replicated sex-specific ranges. The stocky body has a head slightly longer than wide, laterally directed eyes with diamond-shaped pupils, indistinct tympanic rim and no vomerine teeth. Finger tips are round without discs or webbing; toe tips expand into discs and toes are described as two-thirds webbed. A large elongated inner metatarsal tubercle is present, the outer absent. Rough tuberculate dorsal skin and a smooth underside join the source morphology. Neither the female’s larger measurement nor one external feature establishes a universal sex or identity rule.
Vietnam 中部条目描述雄性 IB A.6489 吻肛长 22.31 毫米、雌性 IB A.6490 为 25.93 毫米。这是个体测量，不是重复采样的分性别范围。粗壮身体头略长于宽，眼侧向、瞳孔菱形，鼓膜缘不明显、无犁骨齿。指端圆无盘无蹼；趾端扩为盘，趾蹼描述为三分之二。内跖瘤大而长，外跖瘤缺失。粗糙瘤状背皮与光滑腹面参与来源形态。雌性一次较大测量或单外部特征不能确定普遍性别或身份规则。
appearance
Live and preserved colour remain different observations
活体与保存颜色保持不同观察

The live account describes a grey-brown dorsum with irregular black mottling, barred limbs and a dark supratympanic fold. The pupil has a yellowish border and iris is brown; the throat is cream with grey mottling, chest and belly creamy white with speckles, and ventral limbs grey-pink. A light-yellow, slightly translucent nuptial pad is also described. Preserved dorsal colour fades towards grey and ventral speckles fade. That preservation change is not a natural seasonal colour shift, a female pattern or proof of population-wide colour constancy. The two vouchers do not supply a colour-variation census.
活体条目描述灰褐背配不规则黑斑、肢横斑及深色鼓上褶。瞳孔黄边、虹膜褐；喉奶油色有灰纹，胸腹奶油白带细点，肢腹面灰粉。另描述浅黄略透明婚垫。保存后背色偏灰，腹点褪淡。这种保存变化不是自然季节色变、雌性色型或全种群颜色恒定证明。两件凭证不提供颜色变异普查。
taxonomy
A mitochondrial comparison supports the authors’ voucher attribution
线粒体比较支持作者的凭证归属

The study uses mitochondrial 16S sequences, with an 800-character alignment in the phylogenetic results. Specimens KP.2023.8 and KKK.2023.80 differ by 0.21–2.78% from the original lingnanica population, and the authors identify them as lingnanica in conjunction with morphology. This reported comparison is not a universal species threshold or nuclear-genomic proof of identity. Other within-species distances and interspecific summaries in the same paragraph have their own taxon scopes and are not substituted for this pair of vouchers. The named record attribution remains the source’s integrative conclusion, not independent certification of every historical occurrence.
研究使用线粒体 16S，系统树结果的比对含八百个字符。KP.2023.8 与 KKK.2023.80 相对原 lingnanica 种群距离为 0.21–2.78%，作者结合形态鉴定为 lingnanica。这种比较不是普遍划种阈值或核基因组身份证明。同段其他种内距离及种间摘要具有自己的类群范围，不替代这一对凭证。具名记录归属保持来源综合结论，不是每条历史出现的独立认证。
distribution
Central Vietnamese vouchers and northern predictions have separate scope
Vietnam 中部凭证与北部预测范围不同

Male IB A.6489, field KP.2023.8, was collected at Kon Plong Commune, Quang Ngai, in April 2023; its label prints elevation “1.180 m,” retained as ambiguous punctuation rather than silently converted into a certified altitude. Female IB A.6490, field KKK.2023.80, came from Kon Ka Kinh National Park, Gia Lai, in May 2023 at 926 m. The paper presents these as a new Vietnam country record and discusses a range from southern China and Hainan to Central Vietnam. Similar northern Vietnamese habitats are predicted future records, not confirmed localities or continuous occupancy between countries. Later current-record claims require their own source verification.

雄性 IB A.6489、野外 KP.2023.8 于 2023 年四月采自 Quang Ngai 的 Kon Plong Commune，标签海拔印为“1.180 m”，保留标点歧义，不静默转为认证海拔。雌性 IB A.6490、KKK.2023.80 于五月采自 Gia Lai 的 Kon Ka Kinh 国家公园，海拔 926 米。论文将它们列为 Vietnam 国家新记录，讨论分布从 China 南部、Hainan 至 Vietnam 中部。Vietnam 北部相似生境为预期后续记录，不是确认地点或国间连续占据。后续现行记录主张需自己的来源核实。
ecology
Puddles and rice-field wetlands do not establish niche separation
小水坑和稻田湿地不确定生态位分化

One specimen occurred in a small puddle in Kon Ka Kinh and the other in a shrub- and grass-rich wetland near rice paddies at Kon Plong; males called at the water surface. The discussion reports syntopy with the newly described nishikawai and calls for research on possible niche segregation. Shared sites do not prove competition, identical ecological needs or measured resource partitioning. Water-surface calling does not provide call duration, pulse rate, egg placement, clutch size or parental-care evidence. Both natural-water and agricultural-neighbourhood records retain their individual habitat context rather than becoming an experimental disturbance-tolerance claim.
一件标本来自 Kon Ka Kinh 小水坑，另一件来自 Kon Plong 稻田附近灌草丰富湿地；雄性在水面鸣叫。讨论报告与新描述 nishikawai 同地出现，要求研究潜在生态位分化。共享地点不证明竞争、生态需求相同或实测资源分割。水面鸣叫不提供时长、脉冲率、卵位置、窝卵数或亲代照料证据。自然水体和农业邻近记录保持个别生境背景，不变为实验干扰耐受主张。
title: A new species of Occidozyga ( Amphibia , Anura , Dicroglossidae ) and new records of O. lingnanica from Central Vietnam

sections: behavior
Urban call detections count paddies, not frogs
城市鸣声检出计数田块，而非蛙

The study labels this frog Dryophytes japonica; this reader retains the pinned Dryophytes japonicus name without changing the source spelling or certifying population identity genetically. Call surveys in Machida, Yokohama and Kawasaki detected the frog at 71 of 104 sites in 2022 and 44 of 102 in 2023. Surveys lasted 5–10 minutes at 19:00–24:00, stopping early after detection; no call within ten minutes was coded absent. These counts represent detected calling presence at sites, not numbers of frogs, true absence, occupancy corrected for detection probability or egg production. The same paddies were broadly targeted but ten differed between years and survey points often shifted.

研究将该蛙写为 Dryophytes japonica；本页保留固定 Dryophytes japonicus 名称，不修改来源拼写或通过遗传认证种群身份。Machida、Yokohama、Kawasaki 鸣声调查在 2022 年 104 地点中 71 地检出，2023 年 102 地点中 44 地检出。调查于 19:00–24:00 进行五至十分钟，检出后可提前结束；十分钟内无鸣声编码为缺失。这些是地点中检出的鸣叫出现，不是蛙数量、真实不存在、校正检出概率的占据或产卵量。大体针对相同田块，但两年十块不同、具体点常变。
ecology
Nearby forest area is associated with detected calling
邻近森林面积与检出鸣叫关联

The selected landscape model found a positive association between call detection and forest area within a 50 m radius. Forest and paddy area were assessed at 50 and 100 m scales from aerial-image polygons; those radii were chosen analysis buffers, not measured dispersal distances or minimum habitat requirements. Spatial clustering led the authors to include a spatial random effect and pool two years with year as a random effect. Their interpretation that forest–paddy connections support nonbreeding and breeding habitat is biologically contextual, not a randomized restoration experiment or a measured individual movement path. The result is limited to this urban survey design.
所选景观模型发现检出鸣声与五十米半径内森林面积正关联。利用航空影像多边形评估五十、一百米尺度森林及稻田面积；半径是所选分析缓冲区，不是实测扩散距离或最低生境需求。空间聚集使作者加入空间随机效应，将两年合并并以年份为随机效应。森林—稻田连接支持非繁殖及繁殖生境属于背景解释，不是随机恢复实验或实测个体移动路线。结果限于这一城市调查设计。
ecology
Retained paddy water predicts detection within the fitted study
在拟合研究内保持田水与检出相关

The microhabitat analysis found a positive association between retained paddy water and calling occurrence. Almost all surveyed sites held water in 2022, whereas roughly half lacked it in 2023. Water status therefore covaries with year, cultivation, fallowing and irrigation timing rather than isolating a single causal water effect. The combined model was not simply the lowest-AIC model for every comparison: the reported final model improved on the landscape model but had slightly higher AIC than the microhabitat model. These associations do not prove a universal water threshold, independence from all soil features or guaranteed breeding success after flooding.
微生境分析发现田块保持水与鸣叫出现正关联。2022 年几乎全部调查地点有水，2023 年约一半缺水。因此水状态与年份、耕作、休耕及灌溉时间共同变化，不隔离单一水因果效应。组合模型也不是每项比较中最低 AIC：报告最终模型优于景观模型，但 AIC 略高于微生境模型。这些关联不证明普遍水阈值、与所有土壤特征无关或灌水后保证繁殖成功。
reproduction
Egg-substrate and seasonal information is cited background
卵基质和季节信息是引述背景

The paper cites earlier accounts for spring-to-summer paddy breeding, May–September male advertisement calling and females appearing mainly during spawning. Its discussion cites eggs on aquatic vegetation and substrates to interpret the water association. Those are referenced natural-history statements, not new clutch observations in the 2022–2023 survey. The study itself did not measure clutch size, egg survival, larval recruitment, mate choice or a complete breeding calendar. Neither a detected call nor a dry survey visit establishes that reproduction succeeded or failed at a paddy throughout the season.
论文引用早期条目说明春夏稻田繁殖、五至九月雄性招引鸣叫及雌性主要产卵时出现。讨论引用卵位于水生植被和基质来解释水关联。这是带引文自然史，不是 2022–2023 调查新窝卵观察。研究本身未测窝卵数、卵存活、幼体补充、择偶或完整繁殖日历。检出鸣声或一次干田调查均不能确定该田整季繁殖成功或失败。
conservation
Two unequal survey seasons cannot establish long-term stability
两个不等调查季不能确定长期稳定

The 2022 survey ran 9 May–4 July and the 2023 survey 8 May–7 June. The authors explicitly note one main survey event per year, shifting points, access restrictions and a shorter second season, although initially dry paddies received additional checks. Their suggestion of stable populations compared with literature around 2000 is an interpretation, not a measured long-term demographic trend. Lower detections in 2023 do not independently quantify decline: calling availability and irrigation schedule can change the result. Forest and water management recommendations remain hypotheses for conservation use rather than verified recovery or a current threat assessment.
2022 年调查期五月九日至七月四日，2023 年五月八日至六月七日。作者明确指出每年一次主要调查、点位变化、进入限制及第二年季节较短，虽对初始干田另有复访。与约 2000 年文献比较而提出种群稳定是解释，不是实测长期人口学趋势。2023 年检出较少不能独立量化下降，鸣叫可检性及灌溉日程可改变结果。森林与水管理建议保持保护应用假说，不是已核实恢复或现行威胁评估。
title: Landscape Structure and Breeding Site Conditions Shape the Urban Distribution of the Two Frog Species, Dryophytes japonica and Rhacophorus schlegelii

sections: behavior
The source’s Rhacophorus name and detected sites retain context
来源 Rhacophorus 名称及检出地点保留背景

The study uses Rhacophorus schlegelii, while the pinned catalogue reader is Zhangixalus schlegelii; the source name is retained in evidence without an independently completed concept-mapping audit. Calling was detected at 35 of 104 sites in 2022 and 46 of 102 in 2023 in the three surveyed Japanese cities. Night visits at 19:00–24:00 lasted up to ten minutes and stopped early after detection; silence was coded absent. These are site-level detected calls, not frog abundance or confirmed breeding success. Two-year site and point changes, and unequal seasonal coverage, prevent treating the totals as repeated census of one fixed independent sample.

研究使用 Rhacophorus schlegelii，固定目录本页为 Zhangixalus schlegelii；证据保留来源名称，不宣称独立概念映射审计已完成。在三个受调查 Japan 城市，2022 年 104 地点中 35 地检出鸣声，2023 年 102 地点中 46 地。19:00–24:00 夜访最长十分钟，检出可提前结束、沉默编码缺失。这是地点层面鸣声检出，不是蛙丰度或确认繁殖成功。两年田块、点位变化和不等季节覆盖，使总数不能当作同一固定独立样本重复普查。
ecology
A hundred-metre forest buffer is an analysis scale
一百米森林缓冲区是分析尺度

The landscape model reports positive association of calling occurrence with forest area within a 100 m radius, compared with 50 m for the other focal species. This is a selected spatial predictor, not a directly measured dispersal distance, home range or minimum forest strip. Models incorporated spatial correlation and a year random effect, and assessed competing forest/paddy variable combinations. The authors interpret forest proximity as linking breeding paddies to other habitat needs. That interpretation does not demonstrate individual commuting routes, causation by a planted forest patch or success of a specific conservation intervention.
景观模型报告鸣叫出现与一百米半径森林面积正关联，相比另一焦点种为五十米。这是所选空间预测量，不是直接测量扩散距离、家域或最小林带。模型纳入空间相关及年份随机效应，比较森林与稻田变量组合。作者将森林邻近解释为联系繁殖稻田和其他生境需要，不证明个体往返路线、植林斑块因果或某项保护干预成功。
ecology
Soil channels and water are correlated habitat features
土沟及水属于相关生境特征

The microhabitat results associate soil channels and retained water with calling occurrence, explicitly describing this association in 2023. The discussion interprets exposed soil and access to water as important reproductive habitat and discusses possible difficulty with concrete channels using earlier work. Neither the survey nor the fitted association randomly tests concrete climbing, larval movement or a soil-channel removal treatment. Soil levees and concrete channels were excluded as explanatory variables in the stated model setup, so nonselection cannot be read as proof that they have no biological effect. Exact habitat requirements and causal contributions remain unmeasured here.
微生境结果将土沟和保持水与鸣叫出现关联，明确描述 2023 年关联。讨论解释裸土及进水通道为重要繁殖环境，并引用早期研究讨论混凝土沟可能难攀。调查或拟合关联都没有随机测试混凝土攀爬、幼体移动或移除土沟处理。土田埂及混凝土沟在所述设置中排除为解释变量，因此未被选择不能证明没有生物效应。此处没有测量精确生境需求和因果贡献。
reproduction
Soil egg placement is an attributed earlier account
土中产卵属于明确引述的早期条目

The paper cites earlier studies for breeding in paddies and irrigation ponds, use of levees outside breeding, and a spring-to-early-summer period described as May–June. Its discussion cites soil egg placement and routes for larvae to enter water to explain the soil-channel association. These are background evidence, not newly observed nests or followed larvae in this call survey. No clutch size, nest depth, foam properties, guarding or hatch-success estimate is supplied by the selected study. A calling-site record alone does not confirm oviposition or establish a universal season across the species range.
论文引用早期研究说明稻田及灌溉池繁殖、非繁殖时利用田埂，以及描述为五至六月的春至初夏繁殖期。讨论引用土中产卵及幼体进入水的路线解释土沟关联。这是背景证据，不是鸣声调查新观察巢或跟踪幼体。所选研究不提供窝卵数、巢深、泡沫性质、守护或孵化成功估计。鸣叫地点记录本身不确认产卵或全分布普遍季节。
conservation
Urban vulnerability is interpreted, not experimentally isolated
城市脆弱性属于解释，未通过实验隔离

The authors interpret dependence on both water and soil channels as making this frog more vulnerable to urban habitat change than the other focal species. The study is observational and cannot isolate development, fallowing, irrigation or detection changes as a measured cause of population decline. Detection increased from 35 to 46 surveyed sites between unequal seasons; this is neither verified population growth nor proof against vulnerability. The authors acknowledge one main visit per year, changed sites, shorter 2023 coverage and access restrictions. Their conservation interpretation is not a new current Red List category or demonstrated recovery after habitat management.
作者将同时关联水和土沟解释为该蛙较另一焦点种更易受城市生境变化影响。研究属观察，不能将开发、休耕、灌溉或检出变化隔离为实测种群下降原因。不等季节间检出从三十五至四十六地点，既不是核实种群增长，也不反证脆弱性。作者承认每年一次主要访问、地点变化、2023 年覆盖较短及进入限制。保护解释不是新现行红色名录类别或生境管理后已证明恢复。
title: Landscape Structure and Breeding Site Conditions Shape the Urban Distribution of the Two Frog Species, Dryophytes japonica and Rhacophorus schlegelii

sections: development
Four egg-string cohorts define this laboratory sample
四个卵串来源队列限定实验室样本

In April 2021, four approximately 30 cm egg-string portions, described as containing 100–150 fertilized eggs, were collected from separate puddles at the University of Tokyo Botanical Gardens in Tochigi. Each string was treated as a sibling cohort without a reported genetic parentage test. Larvae were transferred at Gosner stage 22, before swimming/feeding interactions, to dechlorinated tap or pond water and group or solitary rearing. Group containers held twenty larvae and solitary containers one. After two weeks at 18 °C with a 12:12 dark/light cycle and food provision, stages 30–35 were tested. These are rearing conditions, not natural thermal limits, complete female clutch size, larval growth rate or independent population sampling.

2021 年四月，在 Tochigi 的 University of Tokyo 植物园不同水坑采四段约三十厘米卵串，描述各含 100–150 枚受精卵。每条作为同胞队列处理，没有报告遗传亲子检验。幼体于 Gosner 22 期、游动取食互动前移入除氯自来水或池水、群养或孤养环境。群养容器二十只、孤养一只。18 摄氏度、12:12 明暗周期及供食两周后测试三十至三十五期。这是饲养条件，不是自然温度耐受、完整雌性窝卵数、幼体生长速率或独立种群采样。
behavior
Ninety subjects each faced unfamiliar equal-sized stimulus groups
九十只受试个体各面对同数量陌生刺激群

A total of ninety subject tadpoles were tested once each against unfamiliar sibling and nonsibling stimulus groups, ten larvae per side. Subjects and stimuli had been raised in separate containers. Each trial involved five-minute acclimation and two thirty-minute observation periods with left/right placement reversed, yielding sixty minutes of recorded behaviour. Tracking at one-second intervals measured time on sibling side, neutral zone and nonsibling side. Analysis used individual time proportions rather than treating consecutive seconds as independent animals. Equal-sized groups do not test preference for a larger aggregation, and repeated seconds do not enlarge the ninety-subject sample.
共九十只受试蝌蚪，每只测试一次，对面为陌生同胞及非同胞刺激群、各十只，受试与刺激个体在不同容器饲养。试验含五分钟适应、两段三十分钟观察，并反转左右位置，形成六十分钟行为记录。按秒跟踪计算同胞侧、中性区及非同胞侧时间；分析使用个体时间比例，不将连续秒作为独立动物。相同群量不测试更大聚集偏好，重复秒也不扩大九十只样本。
behavior
No kin-biased side preference was detected in these tests
这些测试未检出亲缘侧偏好

Paired comparisons found no significant sibling-versus-nonsibling time difference in any rearing treatment: reported p-values were 0.680 for tap/group, 0.899 for tap/solitary, 0.966 for pond/group and 0.619 for pond/solitary. This is a lack of detected kin-biased association under the chosen equal-group, unfamiliar-stimulus design, not proof that every formosus larva lacks kin recognition. The discussion proposes insufficient differentiation in odour cues and possible later learned recognition, but neither genetic odour differences nor adult learning was experimentally measured. Nonsignificance does not establish exact equality or universal absence of an effect.
配对比较在四种饲养处理中均未发现同胞侧与非同胞侧时间显著差异：报告 p 值自来水群养 0.680、孤养 0.899，池水群养 0.966、孤养 0.619。这是所选等群量、陌生刺激设计下未检出亲缘聚集偏好，不证明每只 formosus 幼体缺乏亲缘识别。讨论提出气味线索差异不足及后期可能学习识别，但没有实验测量遗传气味差异或成年学习。不显著不确定严格相等或普遍没有效应。
behavior
Isolation affected neutral-zone time in the fitted analysis
拟合分析中孤养影响中性区时间

Solitary-reared larvae spent a greater proportion of time in the neutral zone than group-reared larvae; the reported social-experience term was t=3.155, p=0.002. Models for sibling-side and nonsibling-side proportions did not show significant social-treatment effects. The analysis included clutch as a fixed factor rather than independent observation seconds. More neutral-zone time suggests a changed response to conspecific groups, but general locomotor activity was not measured independently. The study therefore cannot separate reduced social responsiveness from broader movement changes or certify an isolated neural mechanism. Neutral-zone time is not a measured stress-hormone concentration or survival outcome.
孤养幼体在中性区的时间比例高于群养，报告社会经历项 t=3.155、p=0.002。同胞侧及非同胞侧比例模型未显示显著社会处理效应。分析将卵串来源纳为固定因素，不把观察秒当独立单位。中性区时间增加提示对同种群体反应改变，但一般运动活动未独立测量。因此不能分离社会反应减弱和更广运动变化，或认证独立神经机制。中性区时间不是实测压力激素或存活结果。
ecology
Two water treatments do not test every natural water condition
两种水处理不测试全部自然水条件

Larvae were reared in dechlorinated tap water or pond water from Ichijiro Pond and tested in the corresponding water type with similarly reared stimuli. The fitted analyses did not detect a water-type effect on association zones, including neutral-zone p=0.767, or a significant interaction with social treatment. Rearing water and test water were matched rather than independently crossed, so developmental versus immediate cue effects were not separately isolated. No measured microbial, odour or chemical mechanism was demonstrated. These comparisons do not establish identical responses in every pond, pollutant concentration or natural seasonal water regime.
幼体在除氯自来水或 Ichijiro 池水饲养，在相应水型测试、刺激个体同样饲养。拟合分析未检出水型对聚集区域效应，中性区 p=0.767，也无显著社会处理交互。饲养水和测试水对应，而非独立交叉，因此发育水与即时线索效应未分别隔离。没有证明实测微生物、气味或化学机制。这些比较不确定每个池塘、污染浓度或自然季节水条件下反应相同。
behavior
Predator defence and neural explanations remain hypotheses
捕食防御及神经解释仍属假说

The discussion relates aggregation to possible predator avoidance and proposes that group size could outweigh kinship, drawing on other toads and earlier literature. Both stimulus groups here had ten larvae, so the experiment did not manipulate group-size alternatives or measure predation. Comparisons with fish and mice suggest possible neural effects of isolation, but no brain circuitry, neural development or hormone measurement was conducted on these tadpoles. The source’s black-colour/warning interpretation is also background reasoning, not a chemical toxicity or predator-choice experiment in this cohort. Proposed functions remain separate from measured zone occupancy.
讨论联系聚集与可能避捕食，并援引其他蟾蜍及早期文献提出群量可能比亲缘更重要。这里两边刺激群都是十只，没有操纵不同群量选择或测量捕食。与鱼、鼠比较提示孤养可能神经效应，但没有在这些蝌蚪测脑回路、神经发育或激素。来源黑色及警戒解释也是背景推理，不是该队列化学毒性或捕食者选择实验。拟议功能与实测区域停留区分。
lifeHistory
Larval results do not establish persistence after metamorphosis
幼体结果不确定变态后持续效应

The author calls for nonsocial control conditions and follow-up beyond the larval stage. No later adult social response, mate choice, inbreeding avoidance, field fitness or persistence after metamorphosis was measured here. The experiment concerns early rearing followed by stage-30–35 choice behaviour in one local collection, not the full formosus life history or every population. Developed neural or olfactory recognition after metamorphosis is proposed as a possibility, without being added as an established adult trait. The study supplies no new species distribution boundary or current conservation assessment.
作者要求非社会控制条件及幼体期以后的随访。此处没有测量后期成年社会反应、择偶、近交回避、野外适合度或变态后持续性。实验针对早期饲养后、一个地方采集的三十至三十五期选择行为，不是完整 formosus 生活史或每个种群。变态后神经或嗅觉识别发育作为可能性提出，不加入已确定成年特征。研究不提供新物种分布界限或现行保护评估。
title: Social isolation, rather than kinship, influences association behavior in toad tadpoles ( Bufo formosus )

sections: ecology
A three-day survey in one Georgia stream
佐治亚州一条溪流的三天调查

The 2025 study surveyed a small second-order stream in the Savannah River drainage, Stephens County, northeastern Georgia, USA, at approximately 300 m elevation. Sampling took place on three rain-free days between 24 August and 10 September 2024. Riffles were searched by disturbing substrate into a downstream net; captured larvae were identified and returned. Flow was estimated from the travel time of powdered milk over one metre, and mean substrate diameter from ten arbitrarily selected representative rocks in a calibrated photograph. These are site-specific encounter and environmental measurements, not animal movement tracks, a random sediment census or a regional distribution survey.

2025 年研究调查美国佐治亚州东北部 Stephens County、Savannah River 流域约海拔 300 米的一条小型二级溪流。采样在 2024 年 8 月 24 日至 9 月 10 日间三个无雨日进行。研究者扰动急流浅滩底质，由下游网具接取幼体，鉴定后原处释放。流速以奶粉溶液通过一米的时间估算；平均底质颗粒直径来自带标尺照片中任意选择的十块代表性石头。这些是单地点遭遇和环境测量，不是动物移动轨迹、随机沉积物普查或区域分布调查。
health
Parasite cysts served as a locally supported identification proxy
寄生虫囊体作为具有当地依据的鉴定替代指标

These two larvae are morphologically cryptic. Investigators examined the translucent belly for visible Metagonimoides oregonensis metacercariae, assigning cyst-bearing larvae to D. amphileucus and larvae without visible cysts to D. folkertsi. A previous PCR-genotyping study at this stream supported that association; the present survey did not report genotyping every sampled larva. The proxy therefore retains its local validation boundary. It does not establish universal species-specific infection, absence of all parasites in folkertsi, a diagnostic character throughout both ranges or a causal link between infection and flow use.

两种幼体外形难以区分。研究者检查透光腹部是否有可见的 Metagonimoides oregonensis 囊蚴，将有囊体者归为 D. amphileucus，无可见囊体者归为 D. folkertsi。这条溪流此前的 PCR 基因分型研究支持该对应关系；本次调查没有报告逐只对所采幼体进行基因分型。因此该替代指标保留当地验证范围，不能据此判定整个分布区内的物种专属感染、folkertsi 完全无寄生虫，或感染导致流速利用差异。
ecology
Larvae occurred on both sides of the tributary
支流汇入口两侧均检出幼体

Of 51 riffles searched, 44 contained Desmognathus larvae. Folkertsi occurred in 33: sixteen downstream and seventeen upstream of a tributary entering the study stream. Its numbers per occupied riffle averaged 2.125 downstream (range 1–8) and 2.412 upstream (1–5). These are counts within surveyed occupied riffles, not densities per square metre or population estimates. No Desmognathus larvae were found in the sampled pool leaf packs, although other salamander larvae were present. This local non-detection does not establish that folkertsi never uses pools elsewhere or during other seasons.

搜索五十一处急流浅滩，四十四处有 Desmognathus 幼体。folkertsi 出现在三十三处，其中支流汇入口下游十六处、上游十七处。每处有该种的浅滩平均下游 2.125 只（范围 1–8），上游 2.412 只（1–5）。这是调查中已有该种浅滩的数量，不是每平方米密度或种群估计。所查水潭落叶堆没有发现 Desmognathus 幼体，但有其他蝾螈幼体；当地未检出不证明 folkertsi 在别处或其他季节从不利用水潭。
ecology
Flow associations are conditional on occupied riffles
流速关联以已有幼体的浅滩为条件

The analysis discarded riffles without Desmognathus before comparing species. Amphileucus-occupied riffles had mean flow 0.24 ± 0.01 m/s (20 riffles), compared with 0.174 ± 0.014 m/s for folkertsi (33 riffles); these uncertainties are reported standard errors, not standard deviations. Corresponding mean particle diameters were 37.53 ± 0.67 and 37.77 ± 0.39 mm. The model associated species presence with flow (p = 0.005), while particle diameter and larval-count covariates each had p = 0.941. Nine shared riffles occur in both species groups, so the group counts do not represent 53 distinct independent riffles. These encounter means are neither physiological flow limits nor experimentally demonstrated preferred velocities.

比较物种前，分析舍弃没有 Desmognathus 的浅滩。有 amphileucus 的二十处浅滩平均流速为 0.24 ± 0.01 米/秒，有 folkertsi 的三十三处为 0.174 ± 0.014 米/秒；这里的不确定度是文中标准误，不是标准差。对应平均颗粒直径为 37.53 ± 0.67 和 37.77 ± 0.39 毫米。模型中流速与物种出现有关联（p = 0.005），颗粒直径及幼体数量协变量各为 p = 0.941。九处共有浅滩同时计入两组，因此组数量不等于五十三处不同的独立浅滩。这些遭遇环境均值不是生理流速极限，也不是实验确认的偏好速度。
reproduction
Seven females attended upstream nests; developmental duration is cited background
七只雌性在上游照料巢；发育年限来自引述资料

The researchers directly observed seven adult female folkertsi attending nests upstream of the tributary. This is a reproductive attendance observation, without measurements of clutch size, hatching success or experimentally tested benefits of attendance. The Discussion cites an approximately two-year larval period for folkertsi, contrasting it with the cited three-to-four-year period of amphileucus. Neither duration was established by following a cohort during this three-day survey. Active female selection of flow conditions and downstream drift of some larvae are hypotheses rather than tracked nesting decisions or marked-individual movements.
研究者直接观察到七只成年雌性 folkertsi 在汇入口上游照料巢。这是繁殖照料观察，没有测定窝卵数、孵化成功率或实验验证照料收益。讨论引述 folkertsi 约两年的幼体期，与所引 amphileucus 三至四年对照；三个调查日没有追踪队列建立这些年限。雌性主动选择水流条件及部分幼体向下游漂移是解释假说，不是已跟踪的产卵决策或标记个体移动。
ecology
Shared riffles and similar prey do not resolve competition
共享浅滩及相似潜在食物不能判定竞争机制

Both species occurred together in nine of fifteen downstream riffles yielding more than one larva. Counts within shared riffles did not differ significantly in the reported Mann–Whitney comparison (p = 0.6588), which does not prove equal competitive ability or absence of interactions. The authors found no evidence that folkertsi competitively excluded amphileucus upstream. Similar sampled potential-prey assemblages between reaches (Jaccard similarity 0.76) are not stomach-content or feeding-preference evidence. Unmeasured factors, female nesting-site selection and downstream drift remain possible explanations. The study explicitly cautions that results from this single stream may not apply throughout the sympatric region.

下游十五处检出超过一只幼体的浅滩中，九处有两种共存。共有浅滩中两种数量的 Mann–Whitney 比较未达显著（p = 0.6588），不能证明竞争能力相等或没有互动。作者没有发现 folkertsi 竞争排除上游 amphileucus 的证据。两河段所采潜在食物群落相似（Jaccard 相似度 0.76），不等于胃内容物或取食偏好证据。未测因素、雌性产卵地点选择和幼体向下游漂移仍是可能解释。研究明确提醒，单条溪流结果未必适用于整个同域分布区域。

sections: ecology
A three-day survey in one Georgia stream
佐治亚州一条溪流的三天调查

The 2025 study surveyed a small second-order stream in the Savannah River drainage, Stephens County, northeastern Georgia, USA, at approximately 300 m elevation. Sampling took place on three rain-free days between 24 August and 10 September 2024. Riffles were searched by disturbing substrate into a downstream net; captured larvae were identified and returned. Flow was estimated from the travel time of powdered milk over one metre, and mean substrate diameter from ten arbitrarily selected representative rocks in a calibrated photograph. These are site-specific encounter and environmental measurements, not animal movement tracks, a random sediment census or a regional distribution survey.

2025 年研究调查美国佐治亚州东北部 Stephens County、Savannah River 流域约海拔 300 米的一条小型二级溪流。采样在 2024 年 8 月 24 日至 9 月 10 日间三个无雨日进行。研究者扰动急流浅滩底质，由下游网具接取幼体，鉴定后原处释放。流速以奶粉溶液通过一米的时间估算；平均底质颗粒直径来自带标尺照片中任意选择的十块代表性石头。这些是单地点遭遇和环境测量，不是动物移动轨迹、随机沉积物普查或区域分布调查。
health
Parasite cysts served as a locally supported identification proxy
寄生虫囊体作为具有当地依据的鉴定替代指标

These two larvae are morphologically cryptic. Investigators examined the translucent belly for visible Metagonimoides oregonensis metacercariae, assigning cyst-bearing larvae to D. amphileucus and larvae without visible cysts to D. folkertsi. A previous PCR-genotyping study at this stream supported that association; the present survey did not report genotyping every sampled larva. The proxy therefore retains its local validation boundary. It does not establish universal species-specific infection, absence of all parasites in folkertsi, a diagnostic character throughout both ranges or a causal link between infection and flow use.

两种幼体外形难以区分。研究者检查透光腹部是否有可见的 Metagonimoides oregonensis 囊蚴，将有囊体者归为 D. amphileucus，无可见囊体者归为 D. folkertsi。这条溪流此前的 PCR 基因分型研究支持该对应关系；本次调查没有报告逐只对所采幼体进行基因分型。因此该替代指标保留当地验证范围，不能据此判定整个分布区内的物种专属感染、folkertsi 完全无寄生虫，或感染导致流速利用差异。
ecology
A sharp local encounter boundary at a tributary
支流汇入口附近清晰的当地遭遇界限

Amphileucus larvae occurred in twenty riffles, all downstream of the tributary, with one to six individuals per occupied riffle (mean 2.20). None was found in the nineteen upstream riffles searched. Four were captured in one riffle less than ten metres downstream, while folkertsi occupied a suitable riffle within ten metres upstream. The tributary increased stream flow and size, but neither was experimentally manipulated. This narrow local boundary describes detections during the survey, not the complete geographic range, an impassable barrier or proof of permanent absence upstream. Sampled pool leaf packs yielded no Desmognathus larvae.

amphileucus 幼体出现在二十处浅滩，全部在汇入口下游，每处已有该种的浅滩一至六只、均值 2.20。搜索的十九处上游浅滩没有检出该种。距汇入口下游不足十米的一处捕到四只，而上游十米内一处适宜浅滩有 folkertsi。支流使流量和溪流规模增加，但研究没有实验操纵二者。这个狭窄的当地界限描述调查时的检出，不是完整地理分布、不可越过的障碍或上游永久缺失的证明。所采水潭落叶堆也未发现 Desmognathus 幼体。
ecology
Flow associations are conditional on occupied riffles
流速关联以已有幼体的浅滩为条件

The analysis discarded riffles without Desmognathus before comparing species. Amphileucus-occupied riffles had mean flow 0.24 ± 0.01 m/s (20 riffles), compared with 0.174 ± 0.014 m/s for folkertsi (33 riffles); these uncertainties are reported standard errors, not standard deviations. Corresponding mean particle diameters were 37.53 ± 0.67 and 37.77 ± 0.39 mm. The model associated species presence with flow (p = 0.005), while particle diameter and larval-count covariates each had p = 0.941. Nine shared riffles occur in both species groups, so the group counts do not represent 53 distinct independent riffles. These encounter means are neither physiological flow limits nor experimentally demonstrated preferred velocities.

比较物种前，分析舍弃没有 Desmognathus 的浅滩。有 amphileucus 的二十处浅滩平均流速为 0.24 ± 0.01 米/秒，有 folkertsi 的三十三处为 0.174 ± 0.014 米/秒；这里的不确定度是文中标准误，不是标准差。对应平均颗粒直径为 37.53 ± 0.67 和 37.77 ± 0.39 毫米。模型中流速与物种出现有关联（p = 0.005），颗粒直径及幼体数量协变量各为 p = 0.941。九处共有浅滩同时计入两组，因此组数量不等于五十三处不同的独立浅滩。这些遭遇环境均值不是生理流速极限，也不是实验确认的偏好速度。
development
A longer cited larval period motivates an untested nesting hypothesis
较长的引述幼体期支持待检验的产卵假说

The Discussion cites a three-to-four-year larval period for amphileucus and approximately two years for folkertsi. These durations come from earlier literature, not longitudinal measurements in the present study. The authors propose that amphileucus females may choose higher-flow nesting sites because a long aquatic period could increase exposure to drought in smaller stream reaches. They did not document amphileucus nest counts here, experimentally test female flow choice or measure drought survival. General reports of downstream larval drift and studies on other salamanders or fishes do not establish those mechanisms in this sampled population.

Shared riffles and similar prey do not resolve competition
共享浅滩及相似潜在食物不能判定竞争机制

Both species occurred together in nine of fifteen downstream riffles yielding more than one larva. Counts within shared riffles did not differ significantly in the reported Mann–Whitney comparison (p = 0.6588), which does not prove equal competitive ability or absence of interactions. The authors found no evidence that folkertsi competitively excluded amphileucus upstream. Similar sampled potential-prey assemblages between reaches (Jaccard similarity 0.76) are not stomach-content or feeding-preference evidence. Unmeasured factors, female nesting-site selection and downstream drift remain possible explanations. The study explicitly cautions that results from this single stream may not apply throughout the sympatric region.

sections: evolution
Historical stream samples and seven retained microsatellites
历史溪流样本与保留的七个微卫星位点

The 2025 paper analysed 310 newts sampled from ten second- or third-order streams with breeding pools in Hong Kong SAR between August 2013 and January 2014. Seven streams were in the mainland New Territories and three on islands. Each stream was treated as a population because drainage basins differed and the minimum distance between sites was approximately two kilometres. Samples numbered 30–35 animals per site. Nine microsatellite loci were initially amplified; Phon24 and Phon48 were excluded after null alleles were detected, leaving seven for analysis. This is a historical ten-stream genetic sample, not a contemporary census, complete species range or nine-locus final dataset. The paper withholds precise collecting locations because of wildlife-trade concerns.

2025 年论文分析 2013 年 8 月至 2014 年 1 月香港特区十条有繁殖水潭的二级或三级溪流所采 310 只个体；七条在新界陆地，三条在岛屿。流域不同，地点间最小距离约两公里，故各溪流作为一个种群处理。每地点样本三十至三十五只。最初扩增九个微卫星位点，发现无效等位基因后排除 Phon24、Phon48，保留七个分析。这是历史十溪流遗传样本，不是当前普查、完整物种分布或最终九位点数据。论文因野生动物贸易风险未公布精确采集位置。
evolution
Diversity and bottleneck signals describe the sampled markers
多样性及瓶颈信号限定于所采标记

Across retained markers, reported observed heterozygosity ranged from 0.631 to 0.814 (mean 0.748, SD 0.088), and expected heterozygosity from 0.706 to 0.890 (mean 0.839, SD 0.030). Site averages for allele number, allelic richness and observed heterozygosity did not differ significantly; expected heterozygosity was significantly lower only at TPK. The source reports bottleneck evidence at PNS and SM, two of ten sites, using heterozygosity-excess tests under specified stepwise-mutation settings. These results do not measure current abundance, fitness or whole-genome diversity, and nondetection of a bottleneck elsewhere does not prove demographic stability. High marker diversity despite disturbance does not establish that urbanization has no harmful effects.

保留标记中，文中观测杂合度范围 0.631–0.814，均值 0.748、标准差 0.088；期望杂合度 0.706–0.890，均值 0.839、标准差 0.030。地点间等位基因数、等位丰富度及观测杂合度均值未有显著差异；只有 TPK 的期望杂合度显著较低。按指定逐步突变设置进行杂合度过量检验，十地点中 PNS、SM 两处有瓶颈信号。这些结果没有测量当前数量、适合度或全基因组多样性，其他地点未检出瓶颈也不证明人口学稳定。干扰环境下标记多样性较高，不能证明城市化没有危害。
evolution
Four principal genetic clusters are analytical management leads
四个主要遗传簇是分析所得的管理线索

Bayesian clustering selected K = 4 as the principal partition: SP alone, PFL alone, a group of six mainland New Territories populations plus one Hong Kong Island population, and TPK alone. The source also reports some support for K = 9, so four clusters are not an immutable biological count. Most populations showed admixture, compatible with gene flow and shared ancestry rather than complete isolation. AMOVA assigned 92.3% of variation within sites, 2.0% among clusters and 5.7% among populations within clusters. These microsatellite partitions do not by themselves delimit new species or prove adaptive differentiation; their proposed conservation use remains an interpretation of sampled structure.

贝叶斯聚类以 K = 4 为主要划分：SP 单独一簇、PFL 单独一簇、新界陆地六种群及香港岛一种群组成一簇、TPK 单独一簇。来源也报告 K = 9 的部分支持，因此四簇不是不可变的生物学数量。大多数种群表现混合祖源，与基因流及共享祖先相容，不是完全隔离。AMOVA 将 92.3% 变异归于地点内部、2.0% 归于簇间、5.7% 归于簇内种群间。这些微卫星划分本身不能界定新物种或证明适应分化；其保护用途是对所采结构的解释。
evolution
Genetic differentiation is not a measured migration rate
遗传分化不是实测迁移速率

Pairwise FST ranged from 0.003 for PNS versus SM to 0.172 for SP versus TPK; the reported pairwise mean was 0.067, SD 0.038. All pairs except PNS–SM remained significantly above zero after correction. The isolation-by-distance test was nonsignificant (R² = 0.08, p = 0.16), using straight-line site distances. This does not show that distance never matters, that every population exchanges migrants, or a quantified number of migrants per generation. Admixture may reflect shared ancestry or recent/ongoing exchange, and the authors acknowledge that only ten sites were sampled. Land cover, slope, roads and physiological constraints remain further research questions.

两两 FST 从 PNS 对 SM 的 0.003 到 SP 对 TPK 的 0.172；文中两两均值为 0.067、标准差 0.038。除 PNS–SM 外，校正后各对均显著大于零。以地点直线距离进行的距离隔离检验不显著（R² = 0.08，p = 0.16）。这不表明距离永远无影响、所有种群都有迁移交换，也没有量化每代迁移个体数。混合祖源可能反映共享祖先或近期、持续交换，作者承认仅采十地点。土地覆盖、坡度、道路和生理约束仍需进一步研究。
evolution
Marker contrasts and unusual assignments leave historical causes open
标记差异及特殊归簇保留历史成因疑问

A previous three-site AFLP study suggested that a mountain ridge separated two mainland populations more strongly than a sea barrier separated an island population. In this microsatellite study those two mainland sites, PNS and SM, instead had the lowest measured pairwise differentiation, and site elevation did not correlate with diversity. The authors attribute the contrast partly to different marker properties and sampling limitations, rather than certifying one universal barrier rule. TT grouped with mainly mainland populations, while TPK formed its own cluster. Translocation or releases are proposed possible explanations; genetic clustering does not establish the origin or release history of these populations.
此前三地点 AFLP 研究提出，两陆地种群间山脊隔离强于与岛屿种群间海域隔离。本次微卫星研究中这两个陆地点 PNS、SM 反而有最低两两分化，地点海拔也未与多样性相关。作者部分归因于标记性质及采样限制，没有确认通用障碍规则。TT 与主要陆地种群归簇，TPK 单独成簇。移置或放生是可能解释；遗传聚类没有确定这些种群的来源或放生历史。
lifeHistory
Seasonal breeding movements are cited separately from genotyping
季节繁殖移动与基因分型证据分开

The Discussion cites earlier tracking and demographic work describing adults moving between terrestrial habitat and stream breeding pools, repeated returns of known individuals to the same pool, and terrestrial displacement approaching 0.4 km. Some individuals may move between pools or streams. These are attributed earlier observations, not movements measured from the present tail-clip samples, a universal dispersal maximum or an independently tested cause of the observed diversity. The source explicitly leaves unknown why an individual returns to the same pool and how such behaviour maintains genetic variation.
讨论引述较早跟踪及人口学研究：成体往返陆地栖息地与溪流繁殖水潭，已识别个体可重复返回同一水潭，陆地移动接近 0.4 公里；部分个体可能在潭间或溪间移动。这些属于归属明确的既往观察，不是本次尾尖样本测得的移动、普遍扩散上限，或已独立验证的多样性成因。来源明确保留个体为何回同一水潭、该行为如何维持遗传变异的未知。
conservation
Genetically informed relocation is proposed; road effects were not tested
提出遗传信息指导移置；道路影响未测试

The paper recommends considering genetic composition when relocating, translocating or reintroducing newts, treating its four principal clusters as distinct management units while retaining connectivity between mainland clusters. This is a research recommendation, not a tested relocation protocol or a current legal designation. It also describes substantial road mortality in terrestrial nonbreeding habitat, but states that the precise effects of roads on gene flow were not evaluated here. The study does not provide a newly verified conservation category, current population trend or evidence that high microsatellite diversity removes habitat and collection threats.
论文建议迁地、移置或重引入时考虑个体遗传组成，将四个主要簇作为不同管理单元，并保持陆地簇间连通。这是研究建议，不是已测试的移置流程或当前法定划定。论文还描述陆地非繁殖栖息地的较大道路死亡，但明确未在本研究评估道路对基因流的精确影响。研究没有提供重新核实的保护类别、当前种群趋势，也没有证明较高微卫星多样性能消除栖息地及采集威胁。
title: Genetic Diversity and Interpopulation Variability of the Hong Kong Newt ( Paramesotriton hongkongensis ) in an Urbanized and Deforested Landscape
