sections: evolution
A single Vietnamese specimen yielded the reported mitogenome
一个越南标本产生所报告线粒体组装

One anguliceps specimen from Xuan Nha Nature Reserve, Son La Province, Vietnam, supplied liver DNA for short-read Illumina sequencing and MitoZ assembly and annotation. The reported circular mitogenome is 16,720 base pairs, deposited under PX673615; its control region is reported as 736 base pairs. These lengths and accession labels describe that specimen’s published assembly, not an invariant species-wide genome or a sequence independently downloaded and validated here. This collection record adds a sampled locality without supplying a complete geographic range.

越南 Son La 省 Xuan Nha 自然保护区一个 anguliceps 标本提供肝脏 DNA，进行 Illumina 短读长测序及 MitoZ 组装、注释。论文报告环状线粒体基因组 16,720 碱基对，提交编号 PX673615；控制区报告为 736 碱基对。这些长度和编号描述该标本的已发表组装，不是物种内恒定基因组，也不是这里独立下载验证的序列。该采集记录增加一个所采地点，没有提供完整地理分布。
evolution
A conventional mitochondrial gene complement in one assembly
一个组装中的常见线粒体基因组成

Both new assemblies were annotated as containing thirteen protein-coding genes, twenty-two transfer RNAs and two ribosomal RNAs: thirty-seven genes, plus a noncoding control region. Most genes lie on one strand; ND6 and eight tRNAs lie on the opposite strand. The source predicts tRNA secondary structures computationally, including loss of the D-arm in tRNA-Ser2. These are assembly annotations and predicted RNA structures, not experimentally measured gene expression, metabolic performance or a whole nuclear genome. The biological consequences of small sequence and gene-length differences remain unresolved.
两个新组装均注释有十三个蛋白编码基因、二十二个转运 RNA、两个核糖体 RNA，共三十七个基因，另有非编码控制区。多数基因在一条链上，ND6 及八个 tRNA 在另一条链。来源通过计算预测 tRNA 二级结构，包括 tRNA-Ser2 缺少 D 臂。这些是组装注释及预测 RNA 结构，不是实验测定的基因表达、代谢表现或完整核基因组。细微序列及基因长度差异的生物学后果仍未解决。
evolution
Marker-dependent placement within a sparsely sampled genus
属内采样有限且依标记而异的系统位置

A concatenated thirteen-protein-coding-gene analysis placed anguliceps in a clade sharing ancestry with verrucosus and shanjing. The separate 16S–ND2 analysis grouped the sampled anguliceps with other anguliceps and reported a sister relationship to phukhaensis and uyenoi. These describe different marker and taxon samples; they are not interchangeable statements of an exhaustively resolved nearest relative. The paper analysed 21 mitogenomes including outgroups, with genus coverage described as fifteen of forty-three recognized species at publication. Its tree is mitochondrial evidence, not an independent nuclear species tree or certification of all catalogue concepts.

十三个蛋白编码基因串联分析将 anguliceps 放在与 verrucosus、shanjing 共享祖先的一支。另行 16S–ND2 分析把所采 anguliceps 与其他 anguliceps 聚类，并报告与 phukhaensis、uyenoi 的姐妹关系。这些来自不同标记及类群样本，不能互换为全面解决最近亲缘种的结论。论文分析含外群的二十一个线粒体组装，并说明发表时覆盖属内所承认四十三种中的十五种。所得树是线粒体证据，不是独立核物种树，也没有认证所有目录概念。

sections: morphology
Ten southern aquatic adults define the measured sample
十只南方水生型成体限定所测样本

Ten adults labelled aureatus were collected from a stream near DeSoto Falls Recreational Area, Lumpkin County, Georgia, in 2010. They were the southern aquatic group, searched beneath submerged rocks in riffles. Sex was unknown; animals with tail damage or snout–vent length below 50 mm were not collected. Mean snout–vent length at capture was reported as 66.5 ± 0.69 mm, with the Methods explicitly labelling the dispersion standard deviation. This selected sample mean is not a sex-specific adult range or species-wide maximum. Aquatic housing at 15 °C and laboratory feeding do not establish natural thermal limits or measured wild diet.

2010 年在佐治亚州 Lumpkin County、DeSoto Falls Recreational Area 附近溪流采十只标为 aureatus 的成体，为南方水生组，从浅滩水下石块下搜索。性别未知，没有采断尾或吻肛长低于五十毫米的个体。捕获时平均吻肛长报告为 66.5 ± 0.69 毫米，方法明确将离散度称作标准差。这是选择样本均值，不是分性别成体范围或全物种最大值。15 摄氏度水中饲养及实验室供食不确立自然耐温或野外食性。
behavior
Repeated escape trials measured an individual mean fast start
重复逃逸试验测量个体平均快速起动

After eight to twelve weeks in captivity, each animal received three aquatic and three terrestrial trials in randomized order, with at least thirty minutes between trials. Animals acclimated to the camera room at 21–22 °C before a gentle forceps pinch at the tail base. Pinch strength was not measured. Video at 500 frames per second was scored independently by two observers unaware of species and the ecomorph hypothesis. Net velocity was straight-line displacement over the first three trunk undulations, averaged across trials and observers for each animal in each medium. Repeated trials, frames and scorers are not independent animals; the metric is an average initial burst, not maximum sprint speed or sustained endurance.
圈养八至十二周后，每只动物以随机次序接受三次水中及三次陆地试验，试验间至少隔三十分钟。先适应 21–22 摄氏度摄影室，再以镊子轻夹尾基触发逃逸；夹力没有测定。每秒五百帧影像由两位不知物种及生态型假说的观察者独立评分。净速度为前三次躯干摆动的直线位移除以时间，再对每个体每介质平均试验及观察者结果。重复试验、影格和评分者不是独立动物；该指标是平均初始冲刺，不是最大短跑速度或持续耐力。
behavior
The cross-sample trade-off does not quantify this species alone
跨样本的性能权衡不单独量化本种

Across all forty-four animals, aquatic and terrestrial fast-start velocities expressed in body lengths per second were negatively correlated (r = −0.571, p < 0.0001). Northern and southern subset confidence intervals overlapped; a mixed model retained individual identity because every animal was tested in both media. Semi-aquatic groups performed faster on land and aquatic groups faster in water. These are comparative results spanning three named species and an unresolved northern group, not a separately estimated within-species correlation or a universal swimming speed. Body length also affected speed, and the model omitted strongly correlated head and tail lengths.
全部四十四只动物按体长每秒表示的水中与陆地快速起动速度负相关（r = −0.571，p < 0.0001）。北方、南方子集置信区间重叠；因每只均在两介质测试，混合模型保留个体身份。半水生组陆地较快，水生组水中较快。这是跨三种有名物种及一个未解决北方组的比较，不是单独估计的种内相关或普遍游泳速度。体长也影响速度，模型排除高度相关的头长及尾长。
ecology
Functional parallelism is an interpretation with unresolved northern identity
功能平行演化解释保留北方身份疑问

The authors interpret similar aquatic-versus-terrestrial performance contrasts in northern and southern clades as support for functional trade-offs and parallel evolution. The northern semi-aquatic animals were collected in 2010 before later taxonomic revision and treated as Desmognathus sp., potentially mavrokoilius, kanawha or their contact-zone mixture. Their measurements cannot be copied onto either species page. The experiment did not measure successful escape from live predators, survival, mating success, natural habitat choice or an inherited causal mechanism. Comparisons with other newts also use different locomotor metrics, so differences are not a uniform test across genera.
作者将南北支系相似的水中与陆地性能对照解释为功能权衡及平行演化支持。北方半水生动物于 2010 年、后来分类修订前采集，作为 Desmognathus sp. 处理，可能为 mavrokoilius、kanawha 或接触区混合。不能把其测量复制到任一种页面。实验没有测量从活捕食者成功逃逸、存活、交配成功、自然栖息地选择或遗传因果机制。与其他蝾螈的比较也使用不同运动指标，不是跨属统一试验。
title: Trade-offs between aquatic and terrestrial locomotion and functional parallelism in Desmognathus salamanders

Ten adults labelled amphileucus were collected in 2010 near DeSoto Falls Recreational Area, Lumpkin County, Georgia, as the southern semi-aquatic group. Semi-aquatic animals were searched beneath rocks along the stream edge or above water in the channel. Mean capture snout–vent length was 74.9 ± 1.52 mm, dispersion explicitly labelled standard deviation. Sex was unknown, and the collection excluded tail damage and individuals below 50 mm. These adult data concern a different locality, year and stage from the 2024 Stephens County larval microhabitat survey. Neither sample supplies a full sex-specific size range or proof of a shared developmental trajectory.

2010 年在佐治亚州 Lumpkin County、DeSoto Falls Recreational Area 附近采十只标为 amphileucus 的成体，组成南方半水生组，从溪边或水道内高于水面的石块下搜索。捕获时平均吻肛长 74.9 ± 1.52 毫米，离散度明确标为标准差。性别未知，采集排除断尾和低于五十毫米个体。成体数据与 2024 年 Stephens County 幼体微生境调查地点、年份及生命阶段不同。二者均不提供完整分性别体型范围，也没有证明共同发育轨迹。
behavior
Repeated escape trials measured an individual mean fast start
重复逃逸试验测量个体平均快速起动

After eight to twelve weeks in captivity, each animal received three aquatic and three terrestrial trials in randomized order, with at least thirty minutes between trials. Animals acclimated to the camera room at 21–22 °C before a gentle forceps pinch at the tail base. Pinch strength was not measured. Video at 500 frames per second was scored independently by two observers unaware of species and the ecomorph hypothesis. Net velocity was straight-line displacement over the first three trunk undulations, averaged across trials and observers for each animal in each medium. Repeated trials, frames and scorers are not independent animals; the metric is an average initial burst, not maximum sprint speed or sustained endurance.
圈养八至十二周后，每只动物以随机次序接受三次水中及三次陆地试验，试验间至少隔三十分钟。先适应 21–22 摄氏度摄影室，再以镊子轻夹尾基触发逃逸；夹力没有测定。每秒五百帧影像由两位不知物种及生态型假说的观察者独立评分。净速度为前三次躯干摆动的直线位移除以时间，再对每个体每介质平均试验及观察者结果。重复试验、影格和评分者不是独立动物；该指标是平均初始冲刺，不是最大短跑速度或持续耐力。
behavior
The cross-sample trade-off does not quantify this species alone
跨样本的性能权衡不单独量化本种

Across all forty-four animals, aquatic and terrestrial fast-start velocities expressed in body lengths per second were negatively correlated (r = −0.571, p < 0.0001). Northern and southern subset confidence intervals overlapped; a mixed model retained individual identity because every animal was tested in both media. Semi-aquatic groups performed faster on land and aquatic groups faster in water. These are comparative results spanning three named species and an unresolved northern group, not a separately estimated within-species correlation or a universal swimming speed. Body length also affected speed, and the model omitted strongly correlated head and tail lengths.
全部四十四只动物按体长每秒表示的水中与陆地快速起动速度负相关（r = −0.571，p < 0.0001）。北方、南方子集置信区间重叠；因每只均在两介质测试，混合模型保留个体身份。半水生组陆地较快，水生组水中较快。这是跨三种有名物种及一个未解决北方组的比较，不是单独估计的种内相关或普遍游泳速度。体长也影响速度，模型排除高度相关的头长及尾长。
ecology
Functional parallelism is an interpretation with unresolved northern identity
功能平行演化解释保留北方身份疑问

The authors interpret similar aquatic-versus-terrestrial performance contrasts in northern and southern clades as support for functional trade-offs and parallel evolution. The northern semi-aquatic animals were collected in 2010 before later taxonomic revision and treated as Desmognathus sp., potentially mavrokoilius, kanawha or their contact-zone mixture. Their measurements cannot be copied onto either species page. The experiment did not measure successful escape from live predators, survival, mating success, natural habitat choice or an inherited causal mechanism. Comparisons with other newts also use different locomotor metrics, so differences are not a uniform test across genera.
作者将南北支系相似的水中与陆地性能对照解释为功能权衡及平行演化支持。北方半水生动物于 2010 年、后来分类修订前采集，作为 Desmognathus sp. 处理，可能为 mavrokoilius、kanawha 或接触区混合。不能把其测量复制到任一种页面。实验没有测量从活捕食者成功逃逸、存活、交配成功、自然栖息地选择或遗传因果机制。与其他蝾螈的比较也使用不同运动指标，不是跨属统一试验。
title: Trade-offs between aquatic and terrestrial locomotion and functional parallelism in Desmognathus salamanders

sections: morphology
Two North Carolina vouchers underlie the pooled assembly
两个北卡罗来纳凭证标本是混合组装基础

On 20 May 2023, two specimens assigned to the fuscus B3 lineage were collected within approximately three to four metres of each other beneath stream-bank rocks and logs at Bell Branch, Wilkes County, North Carolina. They were a subadult of approximately 32 mm snout–vent length and an adult male of approximately 43 mm, deposited as AMNH A-194068 and A-194069. Blood and liver supplied genomic material, with additional RNA samples. These individual sizes and encounters are not a full adult range, maturity threshold or quantified habitat preference. The assembly pools two animals from one population; it is not one fully phased individual genome or species-wide variation.

2023 年 5 月 20 日，在北卡罗来纳州 Wilkes County 的 Bell Branch 溪岸石块及倒木下，彼此约三至四米处采两个归于 fuscus B3 支系的标本：吻肛长约三十二毫米亚成体和约四十三毫米成年雄性，存为 AMNH A-194068、A-194069。血液及肝脏提供基因组材料，另采 RNA 样本。个体体型与遭遇不是完整成体范围、成熟阈值或量化栖息偏好。组装混合一个种群的两只动物，不是一个完全分相的个体基因组，也不是物种范围变异。
evolution
The 16.1-gigabase result is a purged pooled primary assembly
16.1 十亿碱基结果是去冗余混合主组装

Individual long-read coverage was approximately twelve-fold, insufficient for well-resolved phased haplotypes. Pooling reads increased coverage to approximately twenty-four-fold. An initial 24.0-gigabase pooled assembly included suspected duplicated haplotigs; two rounds of overlap purging reduced it to 16.1 gigabases in 19,632 contigs, with reported contig N50 1.74 megabases and longest contig 27.9 megabases. The primary assembly was labelled aDesFus1-2.1. These are assembly-quality outputs, not a directly measured invariant genome size. The authors allow that unresolved repeats may inflate size and discuss approximately 14–15 gigabases as a possible true size, requiring further work.

个体长读段覆盖约十二倍，不足以充分解析分相单倍型。合并读段后覆盖约二十四倍。最初 24.0 十亿碱基混合组装含疑似重复单倍型片段；两轮去重叠后减至 16.1 十亿碱基、19,632 个 contig，报告 contig N50 为 1.74 百万碱基、最长 27.9 百万碱基。主组装名为 aDesFus1-2.1。这些是组装质量结果，不是直接测得恒定基因组大小。作者允许未解决重复可能使大小膨胀，并讨论实际或约十四至十五十亿碱基，仍需后续工作。
evolution
BUSCO recovery includes fragmented loci
BUSCO 检出包括片段化位点

The merged assembly recovered 4,941 of 5,310 Tetrapoda reference loci, reported as 93.1%: 4,243 single-copy, 370 duplicated and 328 fragmented. Thus the 93.1% identified fraction is not 93.1% complete single-copy loci, and duplicated or fragmented hits remain distinct categories. Transcript assembly counts are not counts of independently validated functional genes. Separate mitochondrial assemblies were reported similar to the earlier reference in length, gene order and composition, with small differences between the two vouchers. These are source-reported comparisons; the underlying sequence files were not independently reanalysed here.
混合组装检出 Tetrapoda 5,310 个参考位点中的 4,941 个，报告为 93.1%：单拷贝 4,243、重复 370、片段化 328。因此检出比例 93.1% 不是完整单拷贝比例，重复和片段类别保持分开。转录组组装数量不等于独立验证功能基因数。两个凭证的线粒体组装报告在长度、基因顺序及组成上与较早参考相近，彼此有小差异。这些属于来源比较，没有在这里独立重新分析底层序列。
reproduction
A separate nest sample supported partial chromosome scaffolding
独立巢样本支持部分染色体支架定位

A nest-guarding female and embryos were collected in August 2021 at Leatherwood Creek, Menifee County, Kentucky, from the B1/B2 lineage, distinct from the North Carolina B3 genomic source. Collection, RNA sequencing and linkage analysis report different embryo counts; they are retained as different or unresolved processing stages rather than one certified clutch size. The linkage analysis describes nineteen offspring, and parentage is presumed. It anchored 4,286 contigs into fourteen primary linkage groups plus two smaller scaffolds spanning 7.5 gigabases, approximately 47% of the assembly and 60% of annotated mRNAs. These are partial chromosome portions, not a fully scaffolded genome. Chromosome preparations separately supported diploid 2n = 28.

2021 年 8 月，在肯塔基州 Menifee County、Leatherwood Creek 采一只守巢雌性及胚胎，属 B1/B2 支系，与北卡罗来纳 B3 基因组来源分开。采集、RNA 测序及连锁分析报告不同胚胎数，保留为不同或未解决处理阶段，不认证为一个窝卵数。连锁分析描述十九后代，亲子身份为推定。分析将 4,286 个 contig 定位到十四主要连锁群及两个较小支架，跨度 7.5 十亿碱基，约主组装 47%、所注释 mRNA 60%。这些是部分染色体片段，不是完全支架化基因组。另有染色体制备支持二倍体 2n = 28。
evolution
Repeat abundance depends on annotation and denominators
重复丰度依赖注释及分母

The primary assembly was estimated as approximately 75% repetitive and 25% single-copy sequence. About 36% of the genome represented LTR elements and 15% LINEs. LTR/Ty3 accounted for approximately 3.8 gigabases, 31% of repeats by sequence coverage and 12% by element count: those denominators are not interchangeable. Around 17% of transposable elements were unclassified, potentially reflecting assembly and annotation limits or novel elements. Relative-divergence landscapes suggest differing historical expansion patterns, but do not independently date activity or identify why this lineage has a smaller genome than some salamanders.
主组装估计约 75% 为重复序列、25% 单拷贝。约全基因组 36% 为 LTR 元件、15% 为 LINE。LTR/Ty3 约 3.8 十亿碱基，按序列覆盖占重复 31%、按元件数量占 12%；这些分母不能互换。约 17% 转座元件未分类，可能反映组装及注释限制或新元件。相对分化景观提示不同历史扩张模式，但没有独立定年活动，也没有确定该支系为何比某些蝾螈基因组小。
evolution
Protein-coding annotation remains a lower-bound estimate
蛋白编码注释仍是下限估计

The annotation identified 12,408 unique entries with a common name in at least one reference database, which the authors treat as a lower bound on protein-coding genes. It is not a complete experimentally verified gene count. RNA-derived evidence came from a restricted set of tissues and animals; additional pipelines were suggested but not evaluated. The printed total isoform count and component mRNA/tRNA counts do not reconcile exactly, and summary gene/exon lengths mix categories affected by small tRNAs. Those inconsistent aggregate counts and length summaries are not converted into definitive species traits here.
注释识别 12,408 个至少在一个参考数据库有通用名称的独特条目，作者将其视为蛋白编码基因下限，不是完整实验验证基因数。RNA 证据来自有限组织及动物，作者提出其他分析流程但未评估。文中总异构体数与 mRNA、tRNA 组成数不能精确对应，基因及外显子长度汇总混合受较小 tRNA 影响的类别。这里不把有矛盾的总数量及长度汇总转成确定物种性状。
evolution
Genome–life-history explanations require broader evidence
基因组与生活史解释需要更广证据

Comparisons to older Desmognathus genome-size estimates are complicated by changed species boundaries, unreported localities and different measurement methods. The authors discuss possible associations among aquatic versus terrestrial development, repeat dynamics and genome size, without directly demonstrating selection or a causal life-history transition in these specimens. Apparent chromosome rearrangements relative to Ambystoma could reflect real differences, scaffold placement error or unplaced conserved blocks. Expanded taxon sampling and more complete chromosome assemblies are proposed ways to distinguish these explanations; the present resource does not resolve them.
与较早 Desmognathus 基因组大小估计比较，受物种界限变化、地点未报告及测量方法不同影响。作者讨论水生与陆地发育、重复动态及基因组大小的可能关系，没有直接证明这些标本中的选择或因果生活史转变。相对 Ambystoma 的表观染色体重排可能是真实差异、支架定位错误或未定位保守区块。扩大类群采样及更完整染色体组装是区分解释的建议；当前资源没有解决这些问题。
title: The first complete assembly for a lungless urodelan with a “miniaturized” genome, the Northern Dusky Salamander (Plethodontidae: Desmognathus fuscus )

sections: health
A long-period opportunistic survey used two detection assays
长期机会性调查使用两种检测方法

The 2024 Japanese study combined 1,012 samples collected in 2011–2023 from 98 sites and 21 amphibian species, including skin swabs and some toe clips. Some same-species, same-locality swabs were pooled, up to four per DNA extraction, so sample/extraction counts cannot automatically be treated as independently tested individuals. Standard PCR and duplex Bd/Bsal quantitative PCR were used. A strict qPCR-positive required both wells to amplify, a sigmoidal fluorescence curve and Ct below 40; single-well signals were retested. These overall study counts are not this species’ sample size or a uniformly sampled annual time series. No supplementary species-level denominator is independently read here.

2024 年日本研究合并 2011–2023 年九十八地点、二十一种两栖动物的 1,012 个样本，含皮肤拭子及部分趾组织。同种、同地点拭子有时合并，每次 DNA 提取最多四个，因此样本或提取次数不能自动等同独立检测个体。使用常规 PCR 和 Bd/Bsal 双重定量 PCR。严格 qPCR 阳性要求两孔均扩增、荧光曲线呈 S 形且 Ct 小于四十；单孔信号重复检测。这些研究总数不是本种样本量，也不是均匀采样的年度序列；这里没有独立读取补充表的物种级分母。
health
Four strict positive samples concern the Okinawan popei form
四个严格阳性样本属于冲绳 popei 型

The source assigns all four strict Bsal qPCR-positive samples to Cynops ensicauda popei from two Okinawa Island localities. Repeated qPCR remained positive in both wells, with values around one genomic equivalent. The present accepted-species page retains that subspecies-level scope rather than transferring the result to all ensicauda populations. No deaths or compatible chytridiomycosis symptoms were observed within the Japanese range where Bsal was detected in this study. This observation does not establish lifelong resistance, absence of subclinical effects or a safe outcome under higher loads or other conditions. Without a verified species/subspecies denominator, these four samples do not define population prevalence.

来源将四个严格 Bsal qPCR 阳性样本全部归于冲绳岛两个地点的 Cynops ensicauda popei。重复 qPCR 两孔持续阳性，约一个基因组当量。当前接受物种页面保留该亚种范围，不把结果扩展至所有 ensicauda 种群。研究在检出 Bsal 的日本范围内未观察到死亡或符合壶菌病的症状。这不确立终生抗性、没有亚临床影响，或高负荷及其他条件下也安全。没有核实的物种或亚种分母，四样本不能定义种群流行率。
health
Low-load signals and short sequences retain diagnostic limits
低负荷信号及短序列保留诊断限制

Across the study, seventeen samples initially had at least one Bsal-positive qPCR well, but only four met the stated strict duplicate-well criteria. Thirteen samples yielded sequenced 160-base-pair amplicons identical to reference KC762295; the paper does not present these as seventeen plus thirteen independent infected animals. An alternative replicate-majority criterion would classify additional positives. The authors acknowledge that low loads prevented the independent diagnostic confirmation they discussed, and that false positives could not be completely excluded. A shared short fungal fragment does not establish a unique strain, whole-genome uniformity, viable fungal isolation or Japan as the proven origin of Bsal.

全研究十七样本最初至少一个 qPCR 孔有 Bsal 阳性信号，但只有四个达到所述严格双孔标准。十三样本产生与参考 KC762295 相同的 160 碱基对扩增子序列；论文没有将其表述为十七加十三只独立感染动物。替代的重复孔多数阳性标准会分类出更多阳性。作者承认低负荷使其讨论的独立诊断确认不能完成，不能完全排除假阳性。共享短真菌片段不能确立唯一菌株、全基因组一致、活真菌分离或证明日本为 Bsal 起源。
conservation
An altered historical site does not establish disease-caused loss
历史地点改变不确立疾病导致消失

At one Okinawa locality positive in the earlier study, repeated visits failed to find newts. The authors presumed major human-mediated habitat alteration as an explanation, rather than demonstrating Bsal-caused extirpation. Their contrasting endemic-versus-introduced pathogen interpretations remain unresolved because short ITS-region fragments provide limited historical information. Recommendations to reduce pathogen spread are proposals, not evidence that a particular intervention worked. The article’s 2024 discussion of collecting and trade laws is not presented here as a current legal statement.
此前研究阳性的一个冲绳地点，多次访问未找到蝾螈。作者推定严重人为栖息地改变为解释，没有证明 Bsal 导致当地消失。来源对病原地方性与引入的不同解释仍未解决，短 ITS 区段提供的历史信息有限。减少病原传播的建议是提案，不是具体干预有效的证据。文章 2024 年对采集及贸易法律的讨论不在这里作为当前法律陈述。
title: Lack of variations in the salamander chytrid fungus, Batrachochytrium salamandrivorans , at its alleged origin: Updating its Japanese distribution with new evidence

The worm’s molecular traits are not salamander traits

The paper revises the diagnosis and molecular placement of the monogenean flatworm Sphyranura euryceae. Listed ribosomal and mitochondrial accessions describe parasites, not the salamander host’s genome. The account places worms on external gills and skin, especially near the leg bases; a host association does not establish exclusive host specificity, physiological tolerance or a measured effect on survival. Parasite prevalence is the proportion of examined hosts carrying worms, whereas intensity is the number of worms on an infected host. sections: evolution
Two mitochondrial markers and one nuclear locus define this study
两个线粒体标记及一个核位点限定研究

The 2012 study combined fieldwork from 2005–2011 with museum tissues, reporting ninety-six individuals from fifty-seven localities across its studied Nanotriton sample. Alignments were 522 bases for 16S, 772 for cytochrome b and 481 for nuclear POMC. POMC alleles were computationally phased; two distinct alleles from one animal are not two independent animals. Separate mitochondrial and nuclear gene trees generally supported four named lineages, but neither an individual locus nor this historical sample certifies every contemporary population or catalogue concept. Contact-zone sampling found no cross-species POMC-allele pairs or mitochondrial–POMC assignment discordance; this is no detected hybrid signature, not proof that hybridization is impossible.

evolution
Low sampled 16S divergence and an occidentalis sister relationship
所采 16S 低分化及与 occidentalis 姐妹关系

Chinanteca had a reported 16S GTR-model distance of 0.004 substitutions per site between its then-known localities. Both mitochondrial and POMC analyses supported its named lineage and a sister relationship to occidentalis. This is a marker-specific comparison, not a genome-wide diversity estimate, reproductive-isolation test or a universal species threshold. The authors argue that this pair’s divergence likely predates the proposed Pliocene seaway at the Isthmus of Tehuantepec, illustrating that a present geographic boundary need not have caused the initial split. The historical tree does not independently determine a precise divergence date for chinanteca.

A single tooth character therefore does not resolve every old identification. Chinanteca and rufescens were reported syntopic in Oaxaca, but only a few samples from that locality were available for hybrid testing. The overall collection included banana-plant outer layers, coffee groves, bromeliads and vegetation; it does not assign every substrate or the pooled elevation statement to chinanteca individually. An inferred Caribbean-draining origin remains sampling-dependent
推断加勒比流域起源依赖采样

Phylomapper 检出谱系与地理距离显著关联，估计祖先地点在 Sierra Madre de Chiapas 东侧。该估计与分布中心有差异（p = 0.045），若干受检替代地点较不可能。AMOVA 也支持所采地理种群间结构。这些分析没有直接观察祖先、确定精确出生地或测量当前扩散速度。作者明确提醒，山脉两侧增加种群可能改变推断。当前太平洋与加勒比分界本身不证明初始物种形成机制。

Plantation encounters do not demonstrate disturbance tolerance

The 2012 study combined fieldwork from 2005–2011 with museum tissues, reporting ninety-six individuals from fifty-seven localities across its studied Nanotriton sample. Alignments were 522 bases for 16S, 772 for cytochrome b and 481 for nuclear POMC. POMC alleles were computationally phased; two distinct alleles from one animal are not two independent animals. Separate mitochondrial and nuclear gene trees generally supported four named lineages, but neither an individual locus nor this historical sample certifies every contemporary population or catalogue concept. 2012 年研究结合 2005–2011 年野外工作及博物馆组织，报告所研究 Nanotriton 样本九十六个体、五十七地点。比对为 16S 五百二十二碱基、细胞色素 b 七百七十二、核 POMC 四百八十一。POMC 等位基因以计算分相，同一动物两个等位不是两只独立动物。线粒体和核基因树总体支持四个具名支系，但单个位点及历史样本不能认证所有当前种群或目录概念。接触区采样未发现跨种 POMC 等位对或线粒体与 POMC 归属不一致；这是未检出杂交信号，不是证明杂交不可能。
distribution
A 2012 reassignment expanded the studied geographic concept
2012 年重归扩大所研究地理概念

The paper assigned sampled populations from eastern Guatemala, Belize and Honduras, formerly included under rufescens, to nympha because their mitochondrial group included the nympha type locality. POMC also supported a named nympha lineage. This expands the source’s concept beyond the original Guatemala type-locality-only description, but it does not establish equivalence of every historical rufescens record or every contemporary nympha population. Confirmed sampled assignments should remain separate from a general regional prediction, especially where morphologically similar species approach one another.

论文将此前纳入 rufescens 的所采 Guatemala 东部、Belize、Honduras 种群归于 nympha，因为其线粒体组含 nympha 模式产地；POMC 也支持具名 nympha 支系。该结果将来源概念扩展至最初仅 Guatemala 模式产地描述以外，但没有建立每个历史 rufescens 记录或每个当前 nympha 种群的等价。已采确认归属与一般区域预测分开，特别在形态相近物种分布接近处。
evolution
Low sampled structure does not confirm a historical bottleneck
所采低结构不确认历史瓶颈

Compared with rufescens and occidentalis, nympha showed lower haplotype diversity and weaker geographic structure, despite sampled occurrence across the Motagua–Polochic fault system. The Discussion proposes a historical range reduction or bottleneck and possible later expansion across that fault. It cites forest modelling at the Last Glacial Maximum as context, not a direct demographic test or a reconstructed continuous movement route. Failure to find a strong break in these markers does not show that the fault is universally permeable or that current populations lack genetic variation. Nor does a historical hypothesis establish a current decline.
相对 rufescens、occidentalis，nympha 单倍型多样性较低、地理结构较弱，尽管所采出现横跨 Motagua–Polochic 断层系统。讨论提出历史范围缩减或瓶颈及随后可能跨断层扩张，并引末次冰盛期森林模型作背景，不是直接人口学测试或连续移动路线重建。这些标记没有强断裂，不表明断层普遍可通或当前种群没有遗传变异；历史假说也不建立当前下降。

evolution
Internal geographic lineages do not mirror one simple isthmus split
内部地理支系不对应单一地峡分裂

The mitochondrial analysis recovered divergent Los Tuxtlas, Mexican/Central American and northwestern Guatemala lineages under the source’s rufescens concept. Samples on opposite sides of the Isthmus of Tehuantepec were not reciprocally monophyletic, and the POMC analysis also separated Los Tuxtlas early from other samples. AMOVA supported differences among populations within regional groups, but not an excess among the three regional groups over its null expectation (p = 0.60). These are sampled genetic patterns, not proof that geography has no effect or a complete current population partition. The source separately reassigned eastern Guatemala, Belize and Honduras samples to nympha.

线粒体分析在来源 rufescens 概念下恢复分化的 Los Tuxtlas、Mexican/Central American 及 Guatemala 西北支系。Tehuantepec 地峡两侧样本不是相互单系，POMC 分析也较早区分 Los Tuxtlas 与其他样本。AMOVA 支持区域组内种群间差异，但三个区域组间未有超过零假设预期的变异（p = 0.60）。这是所采遗传模式，不证明地理无效，也不是完整当前种群划分。来源另将 Guatemala 东部、Belize、Honduras 样本重归 nympha。
evolution
Two rate assumptions produce conditional divergence estimates
两种速率假设产生有条件分化估计

For sampled populations spanning the isthmus, the Results estimated divergence around 3.3 million years with a slower cytochrome-b substitution rate and 1.9 million years with a faster rate. The Discussion instead prints 3.2 for the slower-rate estimate. This source discrepancy is retained without choosing an exact corrected value. The authors lack suitable direct fossil calibrations for the group and compare estimates to a proposed Pliocene seaway. These are rate-dependent lineage estimates, not a measured age of the living species, proof that the seaway caused divergence or an independently verified chronology.
对跨地峡所采种群，结果以较慢细胞色素 b 替换率估计约 3.3 百万年前分化、较快率 1.9 百万年前；讨论却将慢率结果印为 3.2。保留该差异，不选择精确更正值。作者缺乏群内适宜直接化石校准，并与所提上新世海道比较。这是依赖速率的支系估计，不是现生物种实测年龄、海道造成分化的证明或独立验证年代。
taxonomy
An unresolved origin and Los Tuxtlas hypothesis remain distinct
未解决起源与 Los Tuxtlas 假说分开

Although the geographic model placed the ancestral point east of the isthmus, range-centre, northern Oaxaca and Los Tuxtlas alternatives could not be rejected. Long-standing Los Tuxtlas separation and its cited maxillary teeth motivated a suggestion that those populations might warrant a distinct species. The study did not formally establish that new taxon or settle the ancestral location. The variable tooth character and historical name reassignment mean that a familiar rufescens label cannot alone transfer all regional measurements. Such hypotheses remain source-attributed and do not replace the pinned accepted-species hierarchy.

sections: reproduction
Aquatic larvae and metamorphosed offspring vary among studied lineages
所研究支系的水生幼体与变态后代不同

The paper’s northern Iberian background distinguishes larviparity, birth of aquatic larvae, from pueriparity, birth of metamorphosed young. Bernardezi is described as generally pueriparous; fastuosa mostly larviparous but with pueriparous populations; gallaica and bejarae generally larviparous, with insular pueriparous gallaica exceptions. The Discussion reports mixed-mode females in contact areas, drawing partly on earlier and unpublished observations rather than a new controlled breeding cohort. Striped, round-snouted and smaller versus blotched, pointed-snouted and larger morphotypes overlap in admixed areas. These regional descriptions do not establish one species-wide reproductive mode, a standardized body-size range, gestation duration or litter size.

论文的伊比利亚北部背景区分 larviparity，即产水生幼体，与 pueriparity，即产已变态后代。bernardezi 描述为总体产变态后代，fastuosa 多产幼体但有产变态后代种群；gallaica、bejarae 总体产幼体，岛屿 gallaica 有产变态后代例外。讨论记接触区混合繁殖方式雌性，部分来自较早及未发表观察，不是新控制繁殖队列。条纹、圆吻及较小，与斑块、尖吻及较大形态在混合区重叠。这些区域描述不确立全物种统一繁殖方式、标准化体型范围、孕期或每胎数量。
distribution
Three rainy-night contact-zone samples have different denominators
三个雨夜接触区样本具有不同分母

From November 2013 to May 2015, mostly adults and a few larvae were sampled on rainy nights, usually one to three animals per locality, then released. Northern Galicia yielded 129 animals at 86 localities; the Cantabrian Mountains 73 at 38; the Asturias–Cantabria border 123 at 58. After missing-data filtering, paired mitochondrial–nuclear comparisons used 127, 68 and 107 animals respectively, totalling 302. These collection and analytical denominators must remain distinct. The quoted landscape elevation extents describe study-area pixels, not every sampled animal’s elevation or species-wide altitude tolerance. The survey delimits examined contact zones, not the entire Salamandra salamandra range.

2013 年十一月至 2015 年五月在雨夜采主要成体及少数幼体，各地点通常一至三只，采样后释放。Galicia 北部为八十六地点 129 只，Cantabrian Mountains 三十八地点七十三只，Asturias–Cantabria 边界五十八地点 123 只。缺失数据过滤后，线粒体与核配对比较分别用 127、68、107 只，共 302。采集与分析分母必须分开。文中景观海拔跨度描述研究区像元，不是每只采样海拔或全物种耐受。调查限定所查接触区，不是 Salamandra salamandra 全分布。
evolution
Two-cluster assignment and hybrid classes were model choices
双簇归属及杂交类别是模型选择

Mitochondrial cytochrome-b-region sequences were compared with a microsatellite panel. STRUCTURE was deliberately run at K = 2 per contact zone to assign animals between two focal subspecies, not to discover the total number of species-wide clusters. Potential admixture was defined using membership coefficients near 0.1–0.9; NEWHYBRIDS then assigned parental, F1, F2 or backcross categories with posterior probability at least 0.7. These are statistical ancestry and generation-class assignments, not known pedigrees or direct observations of matings. An admixed STRUCTURE label can differ from the subsequent NEWHYBRIDS label.

线粒体细胞色素 b 区段序列与微卫星组比较。每个接触区特意将 STRUCTURE 设为 K = 2，以在两个目标亚种间归属动物，不是发现全物种总簇数。潜在混合以约 0.1–0.9 的成员系数定义，再由 NEWHYBRIDS 以至少 0.7 后验概率归入亲本、F1、F2 或回交类别。这是统计祖源及世代分类，不是已知谱系或直接观察交配；STRUCTURE 混合标签可能与后续 NEWHYBRIDS 不同。
evolution
Broad admixture in two zones contrasts with the mountain sample
两个区域广泛混合与山地样本对照

In northern Galicia, 35 of 127 analysed animals were potential hybrids in STRUCTURE; 29 were assigned F2 by NEWHYBRIDS. At the Asturias–Cantabria border, 50 of 107 were potential hybrids; 38 were assigned F2, while four were subsequently assigned to parental categories. In the Cantabrian sample, only three of 68 initially appeared admixed and all three were then assigned pure bejarae by NEWHYBRIDS. Reported mitochondrial–nuclear discordance was 19%, 16% and 6% respectively. These comparisons support geographically variable introgression, not a uniform hybrid frequency throughout the species or complete reproductive isolation in the mountains. Some individuals remain outside the named high-confidence generation assignments.

Galicia 北部 127 只分析动物中，STRUCTURE 将三十五只视为潜在杂交，NEWHYBRIDS 将二十九归为 F2。Asturias–Cantabria 边界 107 只中五十只潜在杂交，三十八归 F2，四只随后归亲本类别。Cantabrian 样本六十八只中仅三只初显混合，后均由 NEWHYBRIDS 归纯 bejarae。报告线粒体与核不一致比例依次 19%、16%、6%。比较支持地理上不同渐渗，不是全物种统一杂交率或山地完全繁殖隔离。部分个体仍未进入列明的高置信世代归属。
evolution
Mitochondrial history is not the nuclear subspecies tree
线粒体历史不是核亚种树

Quality filtering and trimming produced 302 mitochondrial sequences of about 350 bases, shorter than the approximately 1,100-base amplified region. The authors explicitly warn that the mitochondrial genealogy does not represent the full subspecies relationships: fastuosa groups differently in earlier nuclear phylogenomic evidence. Clock-based estimates used substitution-rate and external divergence priors; they are conditional lineage dates rather than directly observed species origins. Mitochondrial capture, expansion and sex-biased dispersal are possible explanations of discordance, but competing histories remained unresolved. Neither discordance nor an inferred F2 category determines the exact parental route of a particular animal.
质量过滤及截短得到 302 条约三百五十碱基线粒体序列，短于约一千一百碱基扩增区。作者明确提醒线粒体谱系不代表完整亚种关系，fastuosa 在较早核系统基因组证据中归簇不同。分子钟估计使用替换率及外部分化先验，属于有条件支系日期，不是直接观察物种起源。线粒体捕获、扩张及性别偏向扩散可能解释不一致，但竞争历史未解决。不一致或推断 F2 类别不能确定特定动物精确亲本路线。
ecology
Landscape resistance is an association at the analysed scale
景观阻力是在分析尺度上的关联

The models compared geographic distance, environmental difference and landscape resistance, using climate summaries, elevation and seasonal vegetation-index information. Geographic isolation was the strongest selected single predictor in Galicia and Asturias–Cantabria. The Cantabrian zone also supported climate and habitat resistance, with some disagreement between two genetic-distance metrics. NDVI is a vegetation/habitat surrogate, not a directly measured prey supply or breeding substrate. The analysis accounted for shared individuals in pairwise distances, but observational model selection does not experimentally establish a barrier mechanism, individual crossing rate or a physiological climate limit. Topographic complexity alone did not explain the mountain pattern.

模型比较地理距离、环境差异及景观阻力，使用气候汇总、海拔和季节植被指数。Galicia、Asturias–Cantabria 所选最强单预测为地理隔离。Cantabrian 区也支持气候与生境阻力，两种遗传距离指标间有部分差异。NDVI 是植被或生境替代指标，不是直接测定食物供给或产卵基质。分析考虑两两距离共享个体，但观察模型选择没有实验建立障碍机制、个体跨越率或生理气候极限。单独地形复杂度没有解释山地模式。
conservation
Proposed corridors and adaptation require further evidence
所提通道及适应需要进一步证据

The Discussion suggests occasional valley crossings in the mountains and semi-permeable river barriers in the eastern contact zone, but says the data cannot robustly compare crossing rates by reproductive mode. Historical land conversion and fragmentation may affect movement; observed admixture does not show that agricultural or urban habitat is harmless. No support for the tested isolation-by-environment scenario does not exclude latent adaptive divergence. Alternative histories of contact-zone age and range expansion remain possible. These findings guide future research without measuring intervention success, current population trend or a newly verified conservation category.
讨论提出山谷偶尔跨越及东部接触区河流半可透障碍，但说明数据不能稳健比较不同繁殖方式跨越率。历史土地转变及破碎化可能影响移动，已见混合不说明农业或城市生境无害。所测环境隔离情景未获支持，不排除潜在适应分化。接触区年龄与范围扩张仍有替代历史解释。这些发现指导后续研究，没有测量干预成功、当前种群趋势或新核实保护类别。
title: Landscape resistance constrains hybridization across contact zones in a reproductively and morphologically polymorphic salamander

sections: morphology

Table 1 records external-head/osteological counts for Echinotriton andersoni as Okinawa 8/5; Amami 4/3. External heads include soft tissues; skulls use bony landmarks. These dataset counts are not additive unique animals, and external images are not all micro-CT scans. The study mainly used males, except the female E. maxiquadratus holotype photograph. The study extracted liver DNA from one Bolitoglossa chinanteca specimen as part of a sixteen-species, three-genus comparison, targeting ten gigabases of short-read data per species. Repeat analysis randomly sampled merged reads at roughly 0.1-fold coverage. Table 1 gives a genome C-value estimate of 43.7 picograms, based on blood-smear densitometry and species means from earlier genome-size work. evolution
Detected repeat abundance is a method-dependent lower estimate
可检出重复丰度是依赖方法的偏低估计

Table 1 reports 60.2% detectable repeat abundance for Bolitoglossa chinanteca, including uncategorized repeats. Table 2 reports LTRs at 19.17%, and Table 3 separates ERV at 9.42% from Ty3/Gypsy at 9.749%. These are percentages of sampled bases identified by the study's repeat library, not percentages of animals, newly inserted elements or measured gene expression. Mutation can degrade repeats beyond recognition; the authors regard short-read masking as likely underestimating true repetitive content. Rounded table categories need not sum exactly, and uncategorized repeats should not be silently assigned to a known TE superfamily.

重复分化提示相对扩张历史

The study places this species among four Bolitoglossa with ERV peaks at Kimura distances of 11–13, lower than the main peaks in the six larger-genome Bolitoglossa. sections: evolution
One sequenced individual and a separate DNA-content estimate
一个测序个体与另行估计的 DNA 含量

The study extracted liver DNA from one Bolitoglossa macrinii specimen as part of a sixteen-species, three-genus comparison, targeting ten gigabases of short-read data per species. Repeat analysis randomly sampled merged reads at roughly 0.1-fold coverage. Table 1 gives a genome C-value estimate of 81.2 picograms, based on blood-smear densitometry and species means from earlier genome-size work. Picograms of DNA are not gigabases, body mass or a complete genome assembly; the sequenced individual and the species-mean DNA-content estimate have different evidence roles. The sample does not determine variation among sexes, populations or ages.
研究从一个 Bolitoglossa macrinii 标本提取肝 DNA，属于十六种、三个属比较，每种目标十 Gb 短读数据。重复分析随机抽合并读段，约 0.1 倍覆盖。表一基因组 C 值估计为 81.2 皮克，依据血涂片密度测定及较早基因组工作物种均值。DNA 皮克不是 Gb、体重或完整基因组组装；测序个体与物种平均 DNA 含量有不同证据用途。样本不确定性别、种群或年龄变异。
evolution
Detected repeat abundance is a method-dependent lower estimate
可检出重复丰度是依赖方法的偏低估计

Table 1 reports 52.8% detectable repeat abundance for Bolitoglossa macrinii, including uncategorized repeats. Table 2 reports LTRs at 15.37%, and Table 3 separates ERV at 6.643% from Ty3/Gypsy at 8.725%. These are percentages of sampled bases identified by the study's repeat library, not percentages of animals, newly inserted elements or measured gene expression. Mutation can degrade repeats beyond recognition; the authors regard short-read masking as likely underestimating true repetitive content. Rounded table categories need not sum exactly, and uncategorized repeats should not be silently assigned to a known TE superfamily.
表一报告 Bolitoglossa macrinii 可检出重复丰度 52.8%，含未分类重复。表二 LTR 为 15.37%，表三区分 ERV 6.643%、Ty3/Gypsy 8.725%。这是研究重复库鉴认的所抽碱基比例，不是动物比例、新插入元件比例或已测基因表达。突变可使重复退化至无法识别；作者认为短读遮蔽可能低估真实重复含量。四舍五入表类不必精确相加，未分类重复不能默归已知转座超家族。
evolution
Repeat divergence suggests relative expansion histories
重复分化提示相对扩张历史

The authors place this species among six Bolitoglossa with broad ERV divergence peaks at Kimura two-parameter distances of 20–26. Ty3/Gypsy peaks in this group generally occur around 23–28; platydactyla instead has a reported bimodal pattern around 18 and 28. These distances are differences between reads and repeat consensus sequences, not millions of years. No conspicuous ongoing expansion was evident in the larger-genome profiles, which is not proof that all transposition has ceased.
作者把本种列入六个 Bolitoglossa，其 ERV 分化广峰在 Kimura 双参数距离 20–26。该组 Ty3/Gypsy 峰通常约 23–28；platydactyla 则报告约 18 与 28 的双峰。距离是读段与重复共识序列差异，不是百万年。较大基因组谱未显明显持续扩张，不等于全部转座活动已停止。
title: Transposable Element Diversity and Activity Patterns in Neotropical Salamanders

Live and preserved colours are separate evidence

Pale green contrasts with an orange/yellow head, dorsal midline and belly; preservation changes these bright areas to cream against darker tissue. These are the authors’ comparative observations rather than a standardized colour-chart measurement. Colour and specimen counts vary by trait; similar colours recur among species, so a single hue is not a complete identification rule. Preserved appearance should not be substituted for live appearance.
浅绿与橙黄头、背中线及腹对照；保存后鲜区变奶油色并衬暗组织。 这是作者比较观察，不是标准色卡测量。颜色及标本数随变量不同，相近颜色在种间重复，单一色调不是完整鉴定规则。保存外观不能替代活体外观。
behavior
Advertisement-call comparisons use distinct acoustic units
求偶鸣声比较区分声学单位

The note-centred comparison records note groups as Yes (N = 11), attenuated notes as Yes (N = 11), maximum notes per group as 2 (N = 11), and maximum pulses per note as 8 (N = 11). The table’s N counts animals with one or more recorded and analysed calls, not a universal count of notes or complete calls. A call sequence, an isolated note, a note group and a pulse are different units. These observed maxima and presence/absence statements apply to the examined recordings, not invariant limits for every population. Earlier call-centred descriptions may use different units.

conservation
The 2025 assessment separates records, mapped habitat and risk
2025 年评估区分记录、映射生境与风险

The authors’ Table 7 records an observed elevation range of 455–945 metres above sea level for Brachycephalus verrucosus; this is not a physiological altitude tolerance. Extent of occurrence is 4 square kilometres, lower-bound grid area of occupancy 4, and upper-bound AOO ---, with 1 threat-defined location(s). Dashes mark unavailable mapped estimates, not zero occupied area. The study proposes LC under its assessment; this is a dated research assessment, not a freshly checked official Red List category. name: Nanorana laojunshanensis
sections: morphology
Six July 2019 types delimit the measured size sample
2019 年七月六个模式标本限定体长样本

The adult male holotype GXNU YU090314 was collected on 24 July 2019 at Mt. Laojun, Lijiang, Yunnan, at 3,982 metres above sea level. Four adult male paratypes and one adult female came from the same locality and collection event. Table 5 gives male snout–vent lengths of 33.3–38.5 millimetres for five males, including the 36.1-millimetre holotype, and 42.9 millimetres for the single female. This is a type-series sample rather than a population size distribution, growth series or statistical test of female–male size difference.
成年雄性正模 GXNU YU090314 于 2019 年七月二十四日在云南丽江老君山、海拔 3,982 米采集。四个成年雄性副模及一个成年雌性来自同地点、同次采集。表五五雄吻肛长 33.3–38.5 毫米，含正模 36.1 毫米；唯一雌性 42.9 毫米。这是模式系列样本，不是种群体型分布、生长系列或雌雄大小差异统计检验。
morphology
External diagnosis uses a combination of characters
外部诊断使用性状组合

The published diagnosis combines a visible tympanum, distinct vomerine teeth, head wider than long, a slender supratympanic fold, indistinct subarticular tubercles, no dorsolateral fold and absent vocal sac. The holotype has blunt, unexpanded finger tips, nearly equal fingers I and II, and fully webbed toes; head width is 11.3 versus head length 10.7 millimetres. These external traits belong to the examined taxonomic material, not a skeleton or larval diagnosis. The diagnosis says supernumerary tubercles are absent, while the holotype description calls basal finger tubercles small and indistinct; that textual conflict remains unresolved.
出版诊断组合可见鼓膜、明显犁骨齿、头宽大于头长、细鼓上褶、不明显关节下瘤、无背侧褶及无声囊。正模指端钝、不扩张，第一、二指近等长，趾全蹼；头宽 11.3、头长 10.7 毫米。外部性状属于所查分类材料，不是骨骼或幼体诊断。诊断称额外瘤缺失，正模描述却称指基瘤小而不明显，正文冲突仍未解决。
appearance
Brown live pattern and yellow limb venter change in preservation
活体褐纹与黄肢腹色在保存后改变

The living holotype is brown with irregular dark dorsal and lateral patches, darker head bands, and a grey-white venter with yolk-yellow areas beneath the limbs. Its iris is dark with golden-brown mottling. In preservative the dorsum fades toward grey-brown and the venter is described as white. The single female has a dorsal midline stripe and smoother dorsal surface. These observations retain specimen and preservation context; one female does not establish an invariant sex-specific colour rule.
活体正模褐色，背部及体侧有不规则暗斑、头部暗带，腹灰白、肢腹有卵黄黄色区；虹膜暗色伴金褐杂斑。保存后背部褪成偏灰褐，腹描述为白色。唯一雌性有背中线条纹及较光滑背面。观察保留标本与保存背景，单雌不能建立不变性别颜色规则。
reproduction
Male spines suggest a season without documenting spawning
雄性棘提示季节但没有记录产卵

Examined males had nuptial pads and small brown spines on the bases of fingers I and II, paired chest patches, and an M-shaped spine patch along the lower-jaw edge. The authors infer a breeding season around July and August from these male characters and the collection context. They did not collect tadpoles or report direct spawning, clutch size, larval duration or a courtship recording for the new species. The inference should not be rewritten as a year-round breeding calendar or a measured developmental sequence.
所查雄性第一、二指基有婚垫及小褐棘，胸有成对棘斑，下颌缘有 M 形棘斑。作者依据雄性性状及采集背景推测繁殖季约七、八月，但未采到蝌蚪，也未报告本新种直接产卵、卵数、幼期或求偶录音。推论不能改写成全年繁殖历或已测发育序列。
distribution
Known marsh and pond occurrence is restricted to the type site
已知沼泽与池塘记录限定模式地点

At publication in 2023, laojunshanensis was known only from its Mt. Laojun type locality, where it inhabited marshes and ponds. The holotype elevation is a record, not an experimentally measured altitude tolerance or a whole-species elevational range. The authors distinguish this eastern Jinsha River lineage from the Zhongdian Plateau ventripunctata lineage. No comprehensive range census, population trend or verified current conservation category is supplied by this taxonomic account.
2023 年出版时 laojunshanensis 仅知老君山模式地点，栖沼泽、池塘。正模海拔是记录，不是实验海拔耐受或全物种海拔范围。作者区分该金沙江东侧支系与中甸高原 ventripunctata 支系。此分类记述不提供完整分布普查、种群趋势或已验证当前保护等级。
evolution
Three mitochondrial loci and one nuclear locus support a lineage
三线粒体及一核位点支持支系

The study analysed 16S, COI, cytochrome b and RAG-1, with aligned lengths of 575, 674, 965 and 1,189 bases. Both 16S and combined analyses placed the new lineage sister to the ventripunctata–pleskei clade. Table 4 gives 16S p-distances of 1.6% to ventripunctata and pleskei, 2.0% to bangdaensis and 1.6% to parkeri; corresponding COI values differ markedly. These marker distances are not whole-genome divergence, divergence dates or a universal species threshold. The new lineage is supported by combined morphological and molecular evidence rather than a fixed three-percent cutoff.

研究分析 16S、COI、细胞色素 b、RAG-1，比对长分别 575、674、965、1,189 碱基。16S 与合并分析均把新支系放为 ventripunctata–pleskei 支的姐妹。表四 16S p 距离对 ventripunctata、pleskei 均 1.6%，对 bangdaensis 2.0%、parkeri 1.6%；对应 COI 值明显不同。标记距离不是全基因组分化、分化日期或通用种阈值。新支系由形态、分子组合证据支持，不是固定百分之三界线。
morphology
Size-adjusted comparisons distinguish sampled close relatives
体型校正比较区分所采近缘种

The authors measured eight pleskei and eight ventripunctata specimens in addition to the six new-species types. Size-adjusted principal-component analyses included males and females. The comparison with ventripunctata separated samples along PC2, interpreted as narrower upper eyelids, larger eyes and greater nostril–eye distance in laojunshanensis. The pleskei comparison separated along PC1, interpreted as narrower internarial distance and eyelids and longer limbs. Separate pairwise analyses have different axes; they are not direct measures of locomotor performance or a universal identification boundary. Supplementary individual measurements were not independently reanalysed for this page.

作者除六个新种模式外另测八个 pleskei、八个 ventripunctata。体型校正主成分分析含雄、雌。与 ventripunctata 的比较沿 PC2 分样本，解释为 laojunshanensis 上眼睑较窄、眼较大、鼻眼距较大；与 pleskei 比较沿 PC1 分离，解释为鼻间距、眼睑较窄及肢较长。分别的成对分析轴不同，不是直接测运动表现或通用鉴定界线。此页未独立重分析补充个体测量。

sections: distribution

Table 1 includes sequenced ventripunctata material from Xiaozhongdian and Bitahai. Direct comparisons retain specimen and method context

name: Nanohyla albopunctata
sections: morphology
Three male types provide limited and conflicting size evidence
三个雄性模式提供有限且有冲突的体长证据

The holotype ZMMU A-7585 and two male paratypes were collected at Song Hinh Protected Forest, Phu Yen, Vietnam, on 15 January 2021; the type point is at 310 metres above sea level. Females were not recorded. The Diagnosis and Variation give male snout–vent length 18.2–20.2 millimetres for three males, but the holotype description gives 17.6 millimetres. That internal discrepancy prevents certifying one consistent measured range from the text alone. The quoted mean and plus/minus value are not labelled here as standard deviation without the unread supplementary table. This small sample is not a population size distribution.
正模 ZMMU A-7585 与两个雄副模于 2021 年一月十五日在越南富安 Song Hinh 保护林采集，模式点海拔 310 米；未记录雌性。诊断及变异段给三雄吻肛长 18.2–20.2 毫米，正模描述却给 17.6 毫米。内部差别使仅凭正文不能认证统一测量范围。未读补表前，不把所引均值及正负项标为标准差。小样本不是种群体型分布。
morphology
Reduced first finger and expanded discs form part of the diagnosis
退化第一指及扩张指趾盘是诊断的一部分

The examined males have a reduced first finger shorter than half the second, no finger webbing, discs on fingers II–IV, prominent grooved toe discs, two metatarsal tubercles and long hindlimbs. The holotype has no maxillary or vomerine teeth and a single subgular vocal sac. Dorsal skin is tubercular, ventral skin smooth, and a mid-dorsal ridge and large superciliary projections are absent. These external observations do not establish skeletal digit loss or larval anatomy. Palmar-tubercle shapes are reversed between Diagnosis and the holotype description, so the number two is clearer than the disputed shape assignment.
所查雄第一指短于第二一半，指无蹼，第二至四指有盘，趾盘明显且有沟，两个跖瘤、后肢长。正模无上颌、犁骨齿，有单喉下声囊。背皮有瘤、腹皮光滑，无背中嵴及大眼睑突出。外部观察不确立骨骼指缺失或幼体解剖。掌瘤形状在诊断与正模描述间颠倒，因此数量二比有争议的形状归属更清楚。
appearance
White head spots and live colour retain specimen context
白头斑与活体颜色保留标本背景

All three types had distinctive pale spots on the top of the head. The live holotype had five white head spots, a brown-grey dorsum with a darker posterior marking, pale sacral spots, striped hindlimbs and fine grey ventral mottling. Its iris had copper-coloured edging and reticulation. After two years in ethanol the colours darkened or faded, while much of the pattern remained. These descriptions distinguish living and preserved material and do not establish that every future animal has exactly five spots or that colour alone is a complete identification rule.
三个模式头顶均有特色浅斑。活体正模五白头斑，灰褐背伴后方较暗纹、浅骶斑、条纹后肢及细灰腹杂斑；虹膜有铜色缘、网纹。乙醇保存两年后颜色变暗或褪淡，多数图案保留。描述区分活体与保存材料，不确立今后每只都恰五斑，也不使颜色本身成为完整鉴定规则。
behavior
Calling occurs at a small temporary forest-road pool
鸣叫发生在林路小临时水池旁

Males called after 19:00 from leaf litter at the edge of a temporary pool about two metres across on a forest road. Disturbed males jumped into the water, floated and emitted some calls. Groups of two or three males produced overlapping series; the authors suggest social arousal affects timing and pulse repetition. This is local January observation, not a controlled disturbance or acoustic-social experiment. It does not supply a full nightly activity curve, feeding behaviour or a general avoidance response across populations.
雄性在十九时后，于林路直径约两米临时池缘落叶中鸣叫。受扰雄跳水漂浮并发一些鸣声；两三雄组有重叠序列，作者提出社会兴奋影响时序、脉冲重复。这是当地一月观察，不是控制扰动或声学社会实验；不提供完整夜间活动曲线、摄食或跨种群普遍避扰反应。
behavior
Series, calls and pulses are not one acoustic denominator
序列、鸣声与脉冲不是一个声学分母

The detailed account describes series of two to six calls, with one to three pulses in the initial call and a broader reported one-to-thirteen range in subsequent calls. The opening summary gives a different successive-pulse range, and the later comparison labels two to six as pulses per call, although that count earlier described calls per series. These conflicts are preserved instead of selecting a single universal pulse count. The rattling impression and reported low peak frequency do not establish a measured species-wide acoustic limit or complete call duration; supplementary recordings and statistical units were not independently checked.
详细记述称每序列二至六鸣声，初始鸣声一至三脉冲，后续鸣声所报范围更宽为一至十三。开篇给不同后续脉冲范围，后面比较又把二至六写为每鸣声脉冲数，但此前该数描述每序列鸣声数。冲突保留，不挑一个通用脉冲数。听觉颤响印象与所报较低峰频不建立已测全物种声学界限或完整鸣声时长，补充录音及统计单位未经独立核查。
evolution
An integrative sampled lineage is sister to marmorata
整合证据所采支系为 marmorata 姐妹

The study combined a mitochondrial 12S–16S region with nuclear BDNF and earlier references, totalling sixty-five specimens across the dataset. That total is not sixty-five newly collected albopunctata. Bayesian and maximum-likelihood analyses placed the new lineage sister to marmorata, with 16S uncorrected distance reported as 5.3%. Morphological and acoustic comparisons accompany this placement. A marker threshold cited from biodiversity surveys is not an independent universal rule, and the tree does not measure a divergence date, contemporary migration or reproductive isolation.
研究将线粒体 12S–16S 区与核 BDNF、旧参考合并，数据共六十五标本，不是六十五个新采 albopunctata。贝叶斯、最大似然把新支放为 marmorata 姐妹，所报 16S 未校正距离 5.3%，并配形态、声学比较。引用生物多样性调查标记阈值不是独立通用规则；树不测分化日期、当代迁移或繁殖隔离。
morphology
Head ratios and webbing formulae remain disputed in the text
头部比例与蹼公式在正文中仍有争议

The comparison describes a wider head and shorter foot relative to marmorata, but prints an inverted head-length/SVL interval of 29.2–20.8%. Diagnosis and holotype description agree on one toe-webbing formula while the comparison prints another for albopunctata. No corrected head ratio or definitive formula is invented here. The qualitative comparative claim is retained with its limitation, pending the original measurements and specimen-level check, rather than presenting the disputed values as a precise diagnostic test.
比较称相对 marmorata 头较宽、足较短，但打印倒序头长／吻肛长区间 29.2–20.8%。诊断与正模描述一致一个趾蹼公式，比较段却给 albopunctata 另一个。本页不编造校正比例或确定公式。定性比较连同限制保留，待原测量、标本级核对，不把争议值当精确诊断检验。
conservation
Lowland occurrence and a proposed DD category are dated evidence
低地记录与所提 DD 等级是有日期证据

At publication in 2023, the species was known only from its Song Hinh type area, with records around 200–400 metres in low- to mid-elevation tropical forest. The authors report January breeding activity but give no clutch, larval-development or diet data; the actual range is unknown. They provisionally suggest Data Deficient. This is the authors’ dated proposal, not a freshly verified official Red List category, current abundance trend or evidence that all similar forest is occupied. Regional habitat pressure and a conservation call do not measure intervention success.
2023 年出版时仅知 Song Hinh 模式区，记录约 200–400 米低至中海拔热带林。作者报告一月繁殖活动，但无卵数、幼体发育或食性数据，实际范围未知。作者暂建议资料缺乏 DD，是有日期提议，不是刚验证官方红色名录等级、当前丰度趋势或证明类似森林全被占据。区域生境压力及保护倡议不测干预成功。

name: Amolops dafangensis
sections: taxonomy
A 2025 proposal for the Wumeng population
2025 年乌蒙山种群的分类建议

The 2025 paper named the Wumeng population Amolops dafangensis wumengmontis as a new subspecies. Its mitochondrial tree placed this population within A. dafangensis, whereas CO1-based ASAP delimitation favoured species separation. The authors chose subspecies rank to avoid excessive splitting. This page records that dated proposal under the pinned species identity; it does not create a separately accepted COL species or independently certify the proposed rank.
2025 年论文将乌蒙山种群命名为新亚种 Amolops dafangensis wumengmontis。线粒体树将它置于 A. dafangensis 内，基于 CO1 的 ASAP 划界却支持物种分离。作者为避免过度拆分而选择亚种等级。本页在固定物种身份下记录这一有年代的建议，不将它创建为单独的 COL 接受物种，也不独立认证所提等级。
morphology
A four-specimen type series and variable coloration
四件模式标本及颜色变异

The proposed subspecies diagnosis gives three adult males with snout–vent length 43.0–45.5 mm and one adult female at 62.1 mm. It describes vomerine teeth, an indistinct tympanum, glandular dorsolateral folds, no male vocal sacs and white-spined nuptial pads on finger I. Living specimens varied in colour. These four types describe this named population, not the size limits of all A. dafangensis or a statistically tested sexual size difference.
拟议亚种诊断给三只成年雄性吻肛长 43.0–45.5 毫米，以及一只成年雌性 62.1 毫米。特征包括犁骨齿、不明显的鼓膜、腺体形成的背侧褶、雄性无声囊及第一指带白刺婚垫。活体颜色存在变异。这四件模式描述的是该命名种群，不是全部 A. dafangensis 的体长极限，也不是统计检验后的性别体长差异。
distribution
Locality evidence retains collection-date disagreement
地点证据保留采集日期分歧

The account reports streams above 1500 m in Yongshan and Yiliang counties of the Wumeng Mountains, with type localities at 1915 and 1797 m. Methods say six animals were collected in August 2022 and November 2023, with four retained vouchers and two released after sampling. The type account instead dates the holotype and female paratype to July 2021. These dates are inconsistent in the source and remain unresolved. Named sites are not proof of continuous occupancy or a complete contemporary range.
记述报告乌蒙山永善、彝良两县海拔 1500 米以上溪流记录，模式地点为 1915 和 1797 米。方法写 2022 年 8 月及 2023 年 11 月采集六只动物，保留四件凭证标本，另两只取样后释放；模式记述却将正模及雌副模日期写为 2021 年 7 月。来源内部日期不一致，仍未解决。命名地点不能证明连续占据或完整当代分布。
reproduction
July nuptial pads support only a breeding hypothesis
七月婚垫仅支持繁殖假说

The natural-history paragraph reports nuptial pads in July males but no tadpoles or amplexus. The authors interpreted this as an early breeding stage. Nuptial pads alone do not establish the onset, duration or success of breeding. The same paragraph reports sympatry with Leptobrachium boringii and Odorrana margaretae; co-occurrence does not demonstrate predation, diet or competition.
自然史段报告七月雄性有婚垫，但未观察到蝌蚪或抱对。作者将其解释为繁殖早期。婚垫本身不能确立繁殖开始时间、持续期或成功率。同段报告与 Leptobrachium boringii、Odorrana margaretae 同域；共同出现不能证明捕食、食性或竞争。
evolution
Two mitochondrial markers and an untested barrier hypothesis
两个线粒体标记及未检验的屏障假说

The combined 16S–CO1 alignment was 1094 base pairs; reported Wumeng versus type-locality distances were 0.5% for 16S and 2.8% for CO1. ASAP used CO1 alone because 16S differences were considered too small for this analysis. readScope: Boulenophrys hengshanensis: XML Sampling; phylogenetic/morphological results; taxonomic account paragraphs 4–7,13–16,22–24,31,33–38,40; all Discussion paragraphs read; type versus historical sequence concepts distinguished; supplementary measurements and original sequences not independently analysed; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
name: Boulenophrys hengshanensis
sections: taxonomy
Re-examined types separate the old mixed name
重新检查模式分开旧混合名称

The 2025 revision identifies the historical holotype as male, contrary to the original female label. It associates nine newly collected specimens with hengshanensis by morphology of the unsequenced historical types, while fifteen specimens cluster with the 2021 material formerly sequenced as hengshanensis and are assigned to newly described gutu. Type morphology and a historical sequence label therefore have different evidence roles. This is a dated reassessment, not an independently sequenced holotype or a certification of every earlier record.
2025 年修订将历史正模鉴为雄性，与原来的雌性标签不同。依据未测序历史模式形态，将九件新采标本关联于 hengshanensis；另十五件标本与 2021 年曾标 hengshanensis 的测序材料聚类，被分配给新描述 gutu。因此模式形态与历史序列标签证据用途不同。这是有年代的重新评估，不是正模独立测序，也不认证每个较早记录。
morphology
Nine male measurements and one historical female
九个雄性测量及一个历史雌性

The revised diagnosis reports male snout–vent length 34.4–38.0 mm for nine males and 48.4 mm for one female. It combines weak vomerine ridges without teeth, rudimentary toe webbing, narrow toe fringes, heels not meeting under the stated posture, a narrow supratympanic fold and broad dark ventrolateral stripes. These are study-scoped characters; the one-female measurement is not a female population range. Historical formalin-preserved types remain separate from the newly collected ethanol material.
修订诊断报告九雄吻肛长 34.4–38.0 毫米，一雌 48.4 毫米；组合包括弱犁骨棱而无齿、退化趾蹼、窄趾缘、指定姿势下踵不相接、窄鼓上褶及宽暗腹侧条纹。这些性状受研究范围限制，一雌测量不是雌性种群范围。历史福尔马林模式与新采乙醇材料分别保留。
appearance
Live male pattern is not the preserved type colour
活体雄性图案不同于保存模式颜色

The live account is based on nine males and describes brown backs, sometimes with small orange patches; the dorsal pattern may be indistinct or absent. Broad dark abdominal side stripes can merge with central dark patches, and pale lower-abdominal dots have diffuse boundaries. Breeding males have spiny pads on the inner two fingers and an internal subgular vocal sac. These variable male observations do not fix female colours or establish all reproductive behaviour.
活体记述依据九雄，描述褐背，有时有小橙斑，背图案可能不明显或缺失。宽暗腹侧条纹可与中央暗斑融合，浅色下腹点边界弥散。繁殖雄内侧两指有刺婚垫及内部喉下声囊。这些变化的雄性观察不能固定雌色或确立全部繁殖行为。
reproduction
Observed calls and a proposed seasonal barrier
观察鸣声与拟议季节屏障

The ecological account reports stream-side moist forest and scrub on Mt. Hengshan around 700–1100 m, with calls from October to April. Discussion instead gives late September to early April. It reports elevational overlap with gutu but different calling seasons, suggesting a possible prezygotic barrier. The differing month statements remain separate; hearing calls is not observation of all mating or spawning, and seasonal separation was not directly tested as reproductive isolation.
生态记述报告衡山约 700–1100 米溪边湿林及灌丛，十月至四月听到鸣声；讨论则给九月下旬至四月上旬。论文说与 gutu 海拔重叠而鸣叫季不同，提出可能的合子前屏障。月份说法分别保留；听到鸣声不是全部交配、产卵观察，季节分离也未直接检验为繁殖隔离。

readScope: Phyllonastes arutam: XML taxonomic sampling sec5, fieldwork sec6, osteology and molecular assay sec8, phylogenetic results sec11, systematic account sec12, skull sec13, all postcranial/natural-history/risk paragraphs sec14 and discussion/conclusions sec15–16; no independent supplemental raw measurements or sequences reanalysis; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
name: Phyllonastes arutam
sourceConcept: Noblella arutam, original 2024 type-based description; fixed catalogue combination Phyllonastes arutam
sections: taxonomy
The original name and fixed catalogue combination
原始名称与固定目录组合

The 2024 original description uses Noblella arutam for the Río Blanco lineage and female holotype ZSFQ 1882. The pinned catalogue places the name in Phyllonastes. The reader retains both combinations and the source’s northern-clade framework rather than rewriting the original generic treatment. This links the described name to the catalogue entry without certifying every historical voucher or independently revising genus boundaries.
2024 年原始描述以 Noblella arutam 命名 Río Blanco 支系，雌正模为 ZSFQ 1882；固定目录将该名称置于 Phyllonastes。读本同时保留两个组合及来源的北方支系框架，不重写原来的属级处理。描述名称由此关联目录条目，但不认证每件历史凭证或独立修订属界。
morphology
Fourteen types have separate sex and measurement scopes
十四件模式保留性别与测量范围

The type series comprises a female holotype, five female paratypes and eight male paratypes. The diagnosis reports male snout–vent length 13.8–15.1 mm (n=8) and female length 17.3–20.3 mm (n=6). The holotype is measured more precisely as 20.34 mm. That rounding is retained rather than described as a new size conflict. These dimensions are type-series observations, not population extrema; the paper’s nineteen collected animals and further released encounters are different denominators.
模式系列包括一雌正模、五雌副模、八雄副模。诊断报告雄吻肛长 13.8–15.1 毫米（n=8）、雌 17.3–20.3 毫米（n=6）；正模较精细测量为 20.34 毫米。保留这一舍入区别，不称为新的体长冲突。这些尺寸是模式系列观察，不是种群极值；论文十九只采集动物及更多释放的遇见个体属于其他分母。
appearance
Variable live patterns change after preservation
变化的活体图案在保存后改变

Living backs range from light brown through grey-brown to dark brown, with inverted-V or irregular darker markings; a faint pale mid-dorsal stripe may occur. The holotype has a dark lateral band, yellow-to-orange groin and yellow underside with white and brown dots. Ethanol descriptions separately record paler cream ventral areas. Some preserved tubercles and folds become less apparent. Neither one colour nor the absence of a conspicuous preserved tubercle is a complete identification rule.
活体背色从浅褐、灰褐至深褐，带倒 V 或不规则暗纹，可有淡背中线。正模有暗侧带、黄至橙腹股沟及带白褐点的黄腹。乙醇记述另列较浅乳白腹面；部分保存瘤及褶变得不明显。单一颜色或保存后不明显的瘤均不是完整鉴定规则。
morphology
One cleared male supports the skeletal description
一个透明染色雄性支持骨骼描述

The osteological description used adult male ZSFQ 1886. It reports finger phalangeal counts 2-2-3-3, toe counts 2-2-3-4-3, eight presacral vertebrae and terminal phalangeal knobs. The diagnosis describes strongly T-shaped terminal phalanges. Cartilage structures were omitted from the osteological description, and the poorly ossified prepollex was difficult to see. One prepared male does not establish frequencies of skeletal variation, female anatomy or a complete developmental sequence.
骨骼描述用成年雄 ZSFQ 1886，报告指骨数 2-2-3-3、趾骨数 2-2-3-4-3、八枚荐前椎及末端指趾骨结节；诊断形容末端骨明显 T 形。骨骼描述省略软骨结构，骨化不足的前拇指元素难看清。一个处理雄性不能确立骨骼变异频率、雌性解剖或完整发育序列。
ecology
Leaf-litter activity has local observation limits
落叶活动有地方观察限制

The account records Río Blanco and nearby sites at 1720–1890 m in humid montane evergreen forest. Most animals were active at night on the forest floor; three were found in morning leaf litter and four paratypes in pitfall traps. These observations do not yield a complete daily activity budget. No calls were heard during expeditions even though the diagnostic males have vocal slits and an external sac; nondetection does not prove silence.
记述记录 Río Blanco 及邻近海拔 1720–1890 米的湿润山地常绿林地点。多数动物夜间在林地面活动，三只晨间见于落叶，四副模来自陷阱。这些观察不能给完整日活动时间分配。尽管诊断雄性有声裂及外声囊，调查未听到鸣声；未检出不能证明不鸣叫。
ecology
A single stomach documents thirteen prey items
一个胃记录十三个猎物项目

The stomach of male ZSFQ 1886 contained three ant-mimicking rove beetles classified as Staphylinidae: Pselaphinae, two aquatic fly larvae labelled Diptera: Nematocera, and eight ants classified as Formicidae: Myrmicinae. The thirteen items describe one stomach, not a species-wide fixed diet, preference for ants or feeding rate. Their presence does not establish where each prey item was captured or how prey availability varies among seasons.
雄性 ZSFQ 1886 胃内有三只拟蚁隐翅虫，分类标为隐翅虫科蚁甲亚科；两只水生蝇类幼虫，标为双翅目长角亚目；八只蚂蚁，标为蚁科切叶蚁亚科。这十三个项目描述一个胃，不是全物种固定食谱、蚂蚁偏好或摄食速率，也不能确立每个猎物的捕获地点或季节可获得性。
evolution
Long 16S inference remains a single-marker analysis
较长 16S 推断仍是单标记分析

The final phylogenetic matrix was 1104 base pairs for eighty-two new and reference individuals. Although the molecular workflow amplified adjoining mitochondrial genes, the relationship analysis and discussion rely on 16S alone. The lineage was placed in the northern clade with references labelled myrmecoides and an unnamed San Martín lineage. Distances of 6.02–10.53% in the focal comparison are not universal species thresholds, divergence dates or nuclear-genome evidence; the paper calls for more markers.
最终系统矩阵为 1104 碱基对，含八十二个新旧参考个体。尽管分子流程扩增邻接线粒体基因，关系分析及讨论仅依赖 16S。该支系置于北方支系，与标为 myrmecoides 的参考及未命名 San Martín 支系关联。焦点比较的 6.02–10.53% 距离不是通用种阈值、分化日期或核基因组证据；论文呼吁更多标记。
conservation
A dated risk proposal separates occupancy from range extent
有年代的风险建议区分占据与分布范围

The authors propose Critically Endangered under B1ab(iii)+2ab(iii), reporting extent of occurrence 1.70 square kilometres and area of occupancy 8 square kilometres. They treat nearby records as one threat-defined locality and infer habitat decline from mining-related impacts. These are distinct assessment quantities and an attributed 2024 proposal, not a freshly verified official IUCN category or measured population trend. Qualitative local abundance and nineteen collected animals do not certify total population size.
作者依 B1ab(iii)+2ab(iii) 提议极危，报告分布范围 1.70 平方千米、占据面积 8 平方千米。将邻近记录视为一个按威胁定义的地点，依据采矿相关影响推断生境下降。这些是不同评估量及有归属的 2024 年建议，不是新核实官方 IUCN 等级或测定种群趋势。地方较丰富的定性描述及十九只采集动物不能认证种群总量。

有较强支持的姐妹比较使用一个短标记

The newly sampled kungfu lineage was recovered sister to the yunkaiensis reference with reported bootstrap 99 and Bayesian posterior probability 1.00, at mean 16S p-distance 4.9%. The complete matrix was 512 base pairs and contained 110 new and reference samples, including six new kungfu individuals and two outgroups. These are not 110 newly sampled yunkaiensis frogs. name: Centrolene camposi
sections: morphology
A very small male type sample
很小的雄性模式样本

The description rests on male holotype DHMECN 11407 and male paratype DHMECN 11408, collected at La Enramada on 31 March 2015. Their snout–vent lengths are 29.1 and 31.2 mm; females are unknown in this account. The diagnosis combines absent dentigerous vomerine processes, a sloping lateral snout, dorsal warts and spicules, a male humeral spine, and enamelled limb folds. These two males do not establish population extrema, female morphology or a complete identification key.
描述依据雄正模 DHMECN 11407 与雄副模 DHMECN 11408，均于 2015 年 3 月 31 日在 La Enramada 采集，吻肛长分别 29.1、31.2 毫米；记述未知雌性。诊断组合包括带齿犁骨突缺失、侧面斜吻、背疣与小棘、雄肱刺及釉白肢褶。两雄不能确立种群极值、雌形态或完整鉴定检索表。
appearance
Living and ethanol colours remain distinct
活体与乙醇颜色分别保留

The live holotype has a bright green back with lighter warts, a thick pale lip stripe, yellow-green flanks and green bones. In ethanol its back is lavender and underside cream. The paratype has lighter dorsal warts and some dark flecks. The iris background is called white in the definition and grey in the live-holotype account; both descriptions are retained rather than certified as one invariant colour.
活体正模鲜绿背伴较浅疣、粗浅色唇线、黄绿胁及绿骨；乙醇中背淡紫、腹乳白。副模背疣较浅且有一些暗点。定义将虹膜底色称白，活正模记述称灰，两者均保留，不认证一个不变颜色。
reproduction
Heard calls were not recorded or described
听到鸣声但未录制或描述

Both new species vocalized during March 2015 sampling, but no recordings were taken. The diagnoses place calling males on the upper surface of leaves while explicitly leaving advertisement-call properties, fighting, eggs, parental care and tadpoles unknown. Humeral spines and nuptial structures do not fill those missing observations. Neither one month of calling nor the absence of recordings establishes a complete breeding season.
两新种于 2015 年 3 月取样时鸣叫，但未录音。诊断将鸣叫雄性置于叶片上面，同时明确未知求偶鸣声参数、争斗、卵、亲代照护及蝌蚪。肱刺及婚结构不能补足这些缺失观察。一个月鸣叫或没有录音均不能确立完整繁殖季。
distribution
A single stream site and later nondetections
单一溪流地点及后续未检出

The type locality is La Enramada in Azuay, southwestern Ecuador, with the type account at 2950 m and the forest/fieldwork account at 2900 m. These source statements remain separate, not a certified continuous elevation range. The two species occurred in the same steep creek in montane evergreen forest. Only the March 2015 expedition collected them; April 2019 and December 2022 surveys did not. Those nondetections do not prove extinction, absence in other seasons or a complete range boundary.
模式地是厄瓜多尔西南 Azuay 的 La Enramada，模式记述 2950 米、森林／野外记述 2900 米。两说法分别保留，不认证连续海拔范围。两种同现于山地常绿林同一陡溪，仅 2015 年 3 月调查采到；2019 年 4 月、2022 年 12 月未采到。未检出不能证明灭绝、其他季节缺失或完整分布边界。
evolution
Different relatives despite a shared site
共享地点却有不同近亲

The study recovers camposi sister to condor. Results report 12S distance 1.04% with standard error 0.338%, and ND1 distance 6.1–6.5% with separately reported standard errors; discussion cites average 12S distance 1.08%. Those printed summaries remain distinct. The proposed recent trans-Andean history is an interpretation, not a molecular-clock date or directly measured dispersal event.
研究恢复 camposi 为 condor 姐妹。结果报告 12S 距离 1.04%、标准误 0.338%，ND1 距离 6.1–6.5% 另报标准误；讨论引用平均 12S 距离 1.08%。所印汇总分别保留。近期跨安第斯历史是解释，不是分子钟日期或直接测定扩散事件。
conservation
The 2023 Data Deficient proposal
2023 年资料缺乏建议

The authors propose Data Deficient for both new species after limited records and later survey nondetections. They discuss regional forest loss, degradation and fragmentation as concerns. This is a dated author proposal, not a newly verified official IUCN category or measured decline in these species. Three type specimens across two species do not constitute a population census or sufficient monitoring of trends.
作者在有限记录及后续调查未检出后，为两新种提议资料缺乏，并讨论区域林损失、退化、破碎化。这是有年代的作者建议，不是新核实官方 IUCN 等级或两种测定下降。跨两种三件模式不是种群普查，也不足以监测趋势。

name: Centrolene condor
sections: taxonomy
Three voucher labels are treated differently
三个凭证标签采用不同处理

The study identifies QCAZ 72514 as condor from morphology, colour and proximity to the type locality. It reassigns tadpole QCAZ 44896 from an earlier unnamed label to condor by relationship to that reference, while treating earlier condor-labelled QCAZ 47338 as undescribed. These are dated voucher-level interpretations, not certification of every historical condor sequence or a new complete tadpole description.

morphology
Characters compared with camposi

The camposi comparison cites abundant pale and dark dorsal flecks, a cream-yellow iris with fine dark reticulation and present vomerine teeth for condor. The sampled sister relationship and low 12S distance do not erase these morphological differences or provide direct reproductive-isolation evidence.

readScope: Hynobius bambusicolus: XML field sampling; molecular methods; morphometry; egg/larval and acoustic methods; molecular/morphometric results; nomenclature paragraphs 1–13; all Discussion paragraphs; Table4 complete and Table3 caption/selected entries; no independent specimens, original audio, sequence files or model reanalysis; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
name: Hynobius bambusicolus
sections: morphology
Two released adults and four immature vouchers
两只释放成年个体与四件未成熟凭证

Table 4 separates wild adults 22HyF001 and 22HyF002 from four immature type vouchers, 22HyF003–006. The two adults have reported total lengths 191.57 and 196.94 mm and nine and ten costal grooves. Total length includes the tail and is not snout–vent length. The table calls the types juveniles, while nomenclature calls them subadults. Neither two adults nor those immature types establish an age-complete population size range; an adult total-length criterion cannot identify small juveniles by itself.
表 4 将野生成体 22HyF001、22HyF002 与四件未成熟模式凭证 22HyF003–006 分开。两成年所报全长 191.57、196.94 毫米，肋沟九、十条；全长含尾，不是吻肛长。表称模式幼体，命名段称亚成体。两成体及这些未成熟模式均不能确立涵盖全部年龄的种群体长范围；成年全长标准本身不能鉴定小幼体。
appearance
Age-related colour and a model with limited anatomical scope
年龄相关颜色与有限解剖范围模型

The account describes brown juveniles with variable blue dorsal speckles that disappear with age, and dark chocolate adults with pale grey/bluish ventral speckles. Variable vomerine-tooth counts in immature vouchers were not used as a fixed diagnostic character. The downloadable adult model was manually built from photographic references, not a CT-derived internal anatomical specimen or a measured developmental series. Colours and model geometry do not establish all sex-specific variation.
记述描述褐幼体背有变化蓝点，随年龄消失；深巧克力色成体腹有浅灰／蓝点。未成熟凭证变化的犁骨齿数量未用作固定诊断性状。可下载成体模型依据照片参考手工建立，不是 CT 内部解剖标本或测定发育系列。颜色及模型几何不能确立全部性别变异。
reproduction
Egg sacs observed in shallow bamboo-forest pools
竹林浅水池中观察卵袋

The source reports egg sacs in shallow water-filled tyre ruts, with puddles 5–12 cm deep, many sacs near 10 cm depth and 21–27 eggs per sac. Adults were found under cover in wet soil and humus, not observed on the surface even at night during these visits. Field methods report eight pairs of sacs, whereas discussion refers to eight sacs and four females. Those denominators conflict and are not silently converted into a counted breeding population or a species-wide clutch distribution.
来源报告浅积水车辙中的卵袋，水坑深 5–12 厘米，许多卵袋近 10 厘米深，每袋 21–27 卵。成体见于湿土、腐殖质覆盖物下，这些调查即使夜间也未见地表活动。野外方法写八对袋，讨论却写八袋、四雌；分母冲突，不悄然转换为已计数繁殖种群或全物种窝卵分布。
development
Captive larval milestones are temperature-bound observations
人工饲养幼体里程碑受温度条件限制

Larvae were kept at 26 degrees Celsius in prepared water. The paper illustrates free-swimming larvae with balancers at day 16 and later hindlimb development at days 69, 74 and 77. Methods list a later observation at day 87, while the account labels gill regression before metamorphosis at day 84. These timings remain source-specific and inconsistent at the last label; they are not a fixed wild metamorphosis duration. One sampled sac is not a temperature-response experiment or complete development across populations.
幼体在 26 摄氏度处理水中饲养。论文展示第 16 天带平衡器自由游泳幼体，及第 69、74、77 天后肢发育。方法列较晚第 87 天观察，记述却将变态前鳃退化标为第 84 天。时点保留来源限定与最后标签差异，不是固定野外变态时长。一个取样卵袋不是温度响应实验或跨种群完整发育。
behavior
Cannibalism and tail posture were observed in reared animals
饲养动物中观察同类相食与尾姿势

Reared larvae were fed bloodworms, yet some consumed siblings. Recently metamorphosed individuals raised their tails when startled; the proposed diversion of attacks away from vital organs is an interpretation. Captive food and cannibalism do not establish natural diet, feeding preference, wild cannibalism frequency or an experimentally demonstrated protective effect of the posture.
饲养幼体喂摇蚊幼虫，仍有一些吃同胞。新变态个体受惊抬尾；使攻击避开重要器官是提出的解释。人工食物及同类相食不能确立天然食性、摄食偏好、野外同类相食频率或实验展示的姿势保护效果。
behavior
One provoked recording is not a complete call repertoire
一次诱发录音不是完整鸣声类型

A January male sometimes vocalized when probed, and only one recording was obtained while it was partly submerged. The reported duration is 153.40 ms, peak frequency 129.20 Hz and four strong harmonics. The authors suggest alarm, submissive or agonistic functions. This is one provoked sound, not an advertisement-call survey or a controlled functional experiment; the reported amplitude units are not calibrated sound-pressure decibels.
一月雄性受探碰有时发声，仅取得一次部分浸水时录音。所报时长 153.40 毫秒、峰频 129.20 赫兹、四个强谐波。作者提出警报、顺从或冲突功能。这是一次诱发声音，不是求偶鸣声调查或控制功能实验；所报振幅单位不是校准声压分贝。
evolution
Mitochondrial trees disagree about the closest branching order
线粒体树的最近分支次序不同

Three new genetic samples came from two adult swabs and a dead embryo. Single 16S, Cytb and COI trees and a concatenated analysis place the lineage within southern Chinese Hynobius but differ in branching order and support. COI reports sister relationship to amjiensis with posterior probability 97%, while the concatenated placement has weaker 65% support. These linked mitochondrial markers are not independent nuclear evidence or a direct estimate of reproductive isolation, introduction history or gene flow.
三个新遗传样本来自两成体拭子及一死亡胚胎。单 16S、Cytb、COI 树与合并分析将支系置于中国南方 Hynobius 内，但分支次序及支持不同。COI 报告与 amjiensis 姐妹、后验 97%，合并定位支持较弱为 65%。这些连锁线粒体标记不是独立核证据，也不是繁殖隔离、引入历史或基因流的直接估计。
conservation
A small-population scenario is not a census
小种群情景不是普查

The paper considers the known Fujian population potentially Critically Endangered and constructs a breeding-female scenario from few waterbodies and assumed egg-sac numbers. Fewer than 200 breeding animals is an author inference, not a measured census; eight-pair versus eight-sac wording limits the denominator. Historical site drying, bamboo harvest and climate concerns are discussed as threats, without a quantified population trend in this sample. The 2023 interpretation is not a newly verified official IUCN listing. Exact breeding-site details are not reproduced here.
论文认为已知福建种群可能达极危，并以少量水体及假定卵袋数构建繁殖雌性情景。少于 200 繁殖个体是作者推断，不是实测普查；八对与八袋措辞限制分母。历史地点干燥、竹材采收、气候问题讨论为威胁，样本未量化种群趋势。2023 年解释不是新核实官方 IUCN 列表；这里不复制精确繁殖地点细节。
