name: Duttaphrynus melanostictus
sourceConcept: Duttaphrynus melanostictus as identified for five Chinese populations in the 2023 organ-size study; contemporary voucher equivalence not independently certified
readScope: Duttaphrynus melanostictus: XML study sites, collection, body/organ/brain methods, data analysis, all Results and Discussion, Conclusions; Tables1 and5 fully read; individual raw data and voucher identities not independently reanalysed; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sections: morphology
Five sampled populations have different measurement denominators
五个取样种群的测量分母不同

The study collected 153 animals during April–August 2018–2020 from five sites in Yunnan, Guizhou and Hunan. Site counts were 45 Midu, 50 Mouding, 16 Pingjiang, 18 Pingbian and 24 Yuanling. Organ data were reported for 153 animals, brain data for 147; Pingbian had only one male and was excluded from the testis population analysis. These denominators do not mean every animal supplied every reproductive measurement, and the collection methods allow both mature animals and subadults. The sample is not a species-wide census.
研究于2018–2020年四月至八月，从云南、贵州、湖南五地采153只：弥渡45、牟定50、平江16、屏边18、沅陵24。器官数据报告153只，脑数据147只；屏边仅一雄，因此排除其睾丸种群分析。分母不意味每只都提供全部繁殖测量，采集方法允许成熟个体及亚成体。样本不是全物种普查。
morphology
Preserved dry mass, tract length and estimated volume are distinct
保存后干重、消化道长及估计体积分开

Specimens were formalin-fixed and stored for two weeks to two months before organ processing. Most organ sizes were dry masses after 24 h at 60 °C; digestive tract length was measured from photographs. Brain volume was estimated from photographed length, width and height using the study’s geometric formula, with paired structures derived from one hemisphere. These are different assay units, not living wet masses or directly measured three-dimensional volumes, and they do not quantify digestive efficiency or cognition.
标本福尔马林固定，保存两周至两月后处理器官。多数器官大小为60摄氏度干燥24小时后的干重，消化道长度由照片测量。脑体积依照片长宽高及研究几何公式估计，成对结构由一侧半球推算。这是不同测量单位，不是活体湿重或直接测定三维体积，也不量化消化效率或认知。
morphology
Relative organ size is a model residual
相对器官大小是模型残差

The authors define relative organ size as the residual of log10 organ mass, length or volume against log10 snout–vent length. Their body-condition index is a separate body-mass/SVL regression residual. It is not a simple organ/body percentage. Body condition was associated with seven relative organ measures but not tract length or gallbladder size in the reported tests. Different raw units and model-derived residuals should not be merged into one biological percentage.
作者将相对器官大小定义为log10器官质量、长度或体积对log10吻肛长的残差，身体状况指数另为体重／吻肛长回归残差，不是简单器官／体重百分比。所报检验中身体状况与七个相对器官量关联，但与消化道长度或胆囊大小不显著关联。不同原始单位及模型残差不能合并为一个生物学百分比。
reproduction
Testis associations are observational rather than mating experiments
睾丸关联是观察分析而非交配实验

The mixed models reported positive associations of relative testis size with altitude and latitude, both p <0.001. These are associations among the sampled sites, not experimentally increased testes or directly measured sexual-selection intensity, fertility or mating success. Pingbian was excluded from this analysis because it had only one male. Seasonal reproductive state, site histories and contemporary taxonomic identities were not independently resolved here into a causal mechanism.
混合模型报告相对睾丸大小与海拔、纬度正关联，两者p<0.001。这是取样地点间关联，不是实验使睾丸增大或直接测定性选择强度、生育力、交配成功；屏边因只有一雄排除该分析。这里未独立将季节繁殖状态、地点历史及当代分类身份解析为因果机制。
ecology
Population differences do not imply a universal elevation rule
种群差异不意味着普遍海拔规则

All nine relative organ measures differed among populations in the reported GLM, but only testes had significant altitude/latitude associations in Table5. Heart, lung, liver, gallbladder, kidney, spleen, tract and brain tests were not significant for those gradients. Failure to detect association is not proof that environment never affects the organ. Regional site temperatures and rainfall are contextual variables, not measured tolerance limits or independent experimental manipulations.
所报GLM中九个相对器官量均在种群间不同，但表五只有睾丸与海拔／纬度显著关联；心、肺、肝、胆囊、肾、脾、消化道、脑的这些梯度检验不显著。未检出关联不证明环境永不影响器官。地点区域温度、降雨是背景变量，不是测定耐受界限或独立实验操纵。
evolution
Proposed adaptive explanations remain hypotheses
拟议适应解释仍是假说

The authors discuss life-history trade-offs, Hesse’s rule, digestive adaptation and costly-brain hypotheses. Their organ correlations do not directly test natural selection, oxygen uptake, food quality, learning ability or fitness. Five geographic populations are not a complete history of this widely named taxon, and the source’s melanostictus identification is retained without independent reconciliation of every voucher to the pinned contemporary concept.
作者讨论生活史权衡、Hesse规则、消化适应及昂贵脑假说，器官关联不能直接检验自然选择、吸氧、食物质量、学习能力或适合度。五个地理种群不是该广泛使用名称的完整历史；保留来源melanostictus鉴定，不独立认证每件凭证与固定当代概念的协调。

readScope: Hyla sanchiangensis: XML collection; genetic-distance/phylogeny/selection methods; mitogenome structure, distance, phylogeny and selection results; phylogeny/selection discussion; Tables1/4 read fully; original sequence files, supplementary distances and protein models not independently reanalysed; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
name: Hyla sanchiangensis
sections: evolution
Two incomplete mitochondrial sequences
两条不完整线粒体序列

The study generated sequences from Jinxiu, Guangxi and Wencheng, Zhejiang, preliminarily identified by morphology. Both sequences lack part of the control region, although they include thirteen protein-coding genes, two ribosomal genes and twenty-two tRNAs. Reported sequence lengths are 15675 and 15977 bp under those site labels. These are mitochondrial assemblies, not complete nuclear genomes or a population-wide genome-size estimate. Two samples cannot establish all geographic variation.
研究从广西金秀、浙江文成取得依形态初步鉴定的序列。两者均缺部分控制区，但含十三个蛋白编码基因、两个核糖体基因及二十二个tRNA。按这些地点标签报告序列长15675、15977碱基对。这是线粒体组装，不是完整核基因组或种群整体基因组大小估计；两样本不能确立全部地理变异。
taxonomy
Site and accession labels conflict between sections
不同章节的地点与序列号对应冲突

Table1 and the mitogenome Results associate MK388867 with Jinxiu and MK388868 with Wencheng; the genetic-distance paragraph reverses those assignments. The pair of accessions and printed labels remain traceable, but a single corrected correspondence is not certified here without checking the original deposited records. The source identification is not independent confirmation of every voucher’s contemporary taxonomic concept.
表一及线粒体结果将MK388867关联金秀、MK388868关联文成，遗传距离段却颠倒对应。两个序列号及所印标签保留可追溯，但未核查原始存储记录前，这里不认证一个修正对应。来源鉴定不是对每件凭证当代分类概念的独立确认。
evolution
Distance heterogeneity suggests a question, not new accepted species
距离差异提出问题，不产生新接受物种

The source reports 4.4% mitochondrial distance excluding the control region between the labelled Jinxiu sequence and the Wencheng or Lishui references, versus 0.2% between Wencheng and Lishui. It suggests possible cryptic diversity. These are sample comparisons, not a species description, universal divergence threshold or direct reproductive-isolation estimate. Nuclear data, broader sampling and voucher reconciliation remain needed before converting the pattern into new accepted taxa.
来源报告排除控制区后，标金秀序列与文成或丽水参考线粒体距离4.4%，文成与丽水为0.2%，提出可能的隐存多样性。这是样本比较，不是物种描述、通用差异阈值或直接繁殖隔离估计。将模式转为新接受类群前，仍需核数据、更广取样及凭证协调。
evolution
Within-name branching order is inconsistent in the text
名称内分支次序在正文不一致

Results place the Wencheng–Lishui pair with Mingxi before Jinxiu; Discussion instead places the pair with Jinxiu before Mingxi. The shared Wencheng–Lishui relationship is reported in both, while the deeper order remains unresolved from the text alone. A mitochondrial tree is not a dated dispersal map or direct measure of contemporary gene flow.

evolution
Branch-site candidates do not prove cold adaptation
分支位点候选不证明冷适应

The branch-site model reports five candidate alignment sites in mitochondrial Cytb, ND3, ND4 and ND5 for the chosen Hyla/Dryophytes foreground, while broader models did not detect the same signal. These are model-dependent candidates, not experimentally measured protein function or temperature tolerance. The authors explicitly call historical cold adaptation a hypothesis requiring further work. The printed positions are not certified here as local residue numbers within individual proteins.

readScope: Raorchestes chalazodes: XML Sampling, CT processing, all Analysis, Results and Discussion paragraphs and Conclusions read; original meshes, landmark coordinates, supplementary specimen table and cited primary natural-history studies not independently analysed; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
name: Raorchestes chalazodes
sections: morphology
Bamboo-clade skulls in a single-male comparative sample
单雄比较样本中的竹栖支系头骨

The 2023 micro-CT study used one adult male per fifty-five available bush-frog lineages/species and thirty-six three-dimensional skull landmarks. It describes reed-bamboo frogs, including Raorchestes chalazodes, as having relatively broader and dorsoventrally flattened skulls, with posteriorly shifted jaw joints and changes in several bones. These are comparative group patterns, not measured population frequencies, female morphology or a developmental series for this species. Preservation, segmentation and single-individual sampling remain part of the evidence scope.
2023 年微 CT 研究对五十五个可用灌丛蛙支系／物种各用一成年雄及三十六个三维头骨标志点。描述包括 Raorchestes chalazodes 的芦竹栖蛙，具有相对宽而背腹扁头骨、较后移颌关节及若干骨改变。这是比较组模式，不是本种测定种群频率、雌性形态或发育系列；保存、分割及单个体取样仍属证据范围。
evolution
A clade-specific history and model-dependent rate shift
支系特定历史及模型依赖速率转变

The discussion assigns Raorchestes chalazodes to lineage A of the Ochlandrae clade. Lineage A contains chalazodes, flaviocularis and ochlandrae; the former two are described as narrowly distributed high-elevation sisters, whereas ochlandrae has a broader low-to-mid-elevation range. These are cited historical relationships, not new molecular dating or gene-flow tests. The comparative rate-shift result was recovered in ninety-six percent of one hundred randomized-tree iterations; that statistic is not a ninety-six-percent causal probability for bamboo adaptation.
讨论将 Raorchestes chalazodes 置于 Ochlandrae 支系的 A 支。A 支含 chalazodes、flaviocularis、ochlandrae，前两者描述为窄分布高海拔姐妹，ochlandrae 则有较广低至中海拔范围。 这是所引历史关系，不是新分子定年或基因流检验。比较速率转变在一百次随机树迭代的百分之九十六中恢复；该统计不是竹栖适应的百分之九十六因果概率。
reproduction
Bamboo breeding context is cited rather than newly observed here
竹内繁殖背景为引用而非本研究新观察

The paper cites bamboo-internode breeding and egg guarding as life-history context for this clade. Its new data are preserved skull scans, not new observations of egg numbers, care duration or breeding success for this species. A flattened skull could aid passage through narrow openings or blocking intruders, but these proposed functions were not experimentally tested. After phylogenetic correction, the habitat–shape association was not significant (p=0.365), despite a small size–shape association (p=0.021).
论文引用该支系的竹节内繁殖与守卵作为生活史背景。新数据是保存头骨扫描，不是本种新的卵数、照护时长或繁殖成功观察。扁头可能助通过窄开口或阻挡入侵者，但拟议功能未经实验检验。系统关系校正后，生境–形状关联不显著（p=0.365），尽管体型–形状有较小关联（p=0.021）。
ecology
A cited semi-slug meal is not a new species-wide diet sample
被引半蛞蝓摄食不是新的全物种食性样本

The discussion cites an earlier chalazodes observation of feeding on the relatively large semi-slug Satiella dekkanensis. It proposes that a large meal before breeding could help a male during egg care when food may be scarce. This paper did not newly sample chalazodes stomachs or test that nutritional benefit. The cited event is not a fixed diet, preference estimate or demonstrated pattern in all five bamboo-frog species.
讨论引用较早 chalazodes 摄食较大半蛞蝓 Satiella dekkanensis 的观察，提出繁殖前大餐可能帮助雄性在食物或稀缺的守卵期。本论文未新取样 chalazodes 胃或检验营养益处；所引事件不是固定食谱、偏好估计或全部五个竹栖蛙已展示模式。

The study did not recover SWS2 in dendrobatid bait-capture assemblies. For pumilio it also pooled equal RNA concentrations from one eye sample from each of eleven populations into a single transcriptome, recovering RH1, LWS and SWS1 but not SWS2. This is one pooled expression dataset, not eleven independent absence tests. Searches of published and rescaffolded genomes did not identify an SWS2 gene or recognizable pseudogene, including upstream of LWS. Gaps and possible assembly errors in the pumilio scaffold remain acknowledged limitations. Together these observations support gene loss or degradation, rather than proving every individual lacks every possible remnant.

视觉后果部分由较早测量推断

The discussion cites earlier retinal work reporting no green rods in pumilio and a short-wavelength cone absorption peak near 466 nm. It proposes that loss of SWS2 could reduce dim-light colour discrimination and that RH1 might contribute to a middle-wavelength cone receptor. This paper does not newly measure behavioural colour thresholds, cone expression by cell type or visual-pigment absorbance. Similar absorbance curves motivate the RH1 proposal; they do not demonstrate a duplicated RH1 gene or establish the molecular identity of every receptor.

The authors cite earlier studies of maternal-colour imprinting in tadpoles, female colour-assortative preferences and male aggression toward similarly coloured rivals. The published imitator scaffold includes LWS and upstream MECP2, but the authors did not detect SWS2 between them. Searches across the genome also failed to identify a gene or recognizable pseudogene; reciprocal candidate searches returned related opsins rather than SWS2. Positive-control searches could recover SWS2 in other frogs. This supports the proposed ancestral loss, while distinguishing genome-search evidence from the pumilio pooled-eye transcriptome. The proposed 70–40-million-year interval is inherited from dated broader phylogenies, not a directly sequenced deletion date for imitator.

sections: ecology
Locality-specific recordings within a broad species concept
广义物种概念下的地点特定录音

The paper groups Eumseong (25 individuals, 700 notes) and Pyeongtaek (five individuals, 291 notes) as the northern side of Chilgap Mountain, labelled Dryophytes suweonensis in its figures but analysed within D. suweonensis sensu lato. Across five sites it recorded fifty-six individuals and 2,858 notes from evening to midnight. Eumseong recordings date to May–August 2012; the other sites were sampled in May2021 and/or June2022. These are separate recording cohorts, not one simultaneous survey, complete breeding calendars or a population census. Individuals were not captured; this paper does not supply new genetic verification of each caller's correspondence to the fixed accepted concept.

论文将Eumseong（25 个体、700 音符）及 Pyeongtaek（五个体、291 音符）归为 Chilgap 山北侧，图中标为 Dryophytes suweonensis，但分析采用 D. suweonensis 广义概念。五地总计五十六个体、2,858 音符，录于傍晚至午夜。Eumseong 录音在 2012 年五月至八月，其他地点于 2021 年五月及／或 2022 年六月取样。这是不同录音批次，不是一次同步调查、完整繁殖日历或种群普查。研究未捕捉个体，也未新用遗传证据核实每个鸣叫者与固定接受概念对应。
ecology
Population means describe notes rather than species limits
种群均值描述音符而非物种极限

Eumseong and Pyeongtaek maximum-power frequencies averaged 3,079.69±27.59 and 3,194.63±27.34 Hz, respectively; note durations were 0.15±0.001 and 0.14±0.001 seconds. Table2 identifies the quantities after ± as standard errors, not standard deviations or ranges. Frogs were collected near Arkhara in September2022 and gradually cooled from 14–15°C through 8°C and 4°C to 2–3°C. Twenty days after collection, twelve Rana amurensis were split into six controls and six experimental animals. Controls remained at 5–7mg/L dissolved oxygen. The animals were not fed during captivity; the authors explain this by their seasonal wild feeding pattern, not by a new year-round diet study. These conditions delimit a cold-acclimated sample and do not establish tolerance across all temperatures, seasons or populations.
蛙于 2022 年九月在 Arkhara 附近采集，逐渐从 14–15°C 经 8°C、4°C 降至 2–3°C。采后第二十天，十二只 Rana amurensis 分为六对照及六实验个体。对照保持溶氧 5–7mg/L。圈养期间不喂食；作者以季节性野外摄食模式解释，而非新的全年食性研究。条件界定低温驯化样本，不能确定所有温度、季节或种群耐受。

Species experienced different containers and hypoxia endpoints

All six experimental amurensis shared one sealed10.3L container; oxygen declined through respiration, reaching0.1mg/L after seven days. Methods report ten further days at this level before tissue collection, with normal positions and swimming observed daily. Instrument accuracy was0.1mg/L, so this is not a certified absolute-zero oxygen condition. Dybowskii instead occupied individual0.63L containers and reached a much earlier distress endpoint. Different exposure durations, oxygen levels and tank arrangements constrain a matched species-only interpretation.

Tissue concentrations are not metabolic flux measurements
组织浓度不是代谢流量测量

The study extracts metabolites for proton NMR and quantifies peaks against an internal standard. The pathway diagram is a mechanistic proposal
途径图是机制提议

The authors propose diversion of glycolytic products toward alanine, glycerol and2,3-butanediol, potentially changing lactate production and redox balance. Neither a small mitochondrial distance nor overlap in a few PCA axes alone determines accepted species rank.

A preserved female and photographs supply different measurements
保存雌性与照片提供不同测量

KUHE41444 has total length1115mm, snout–vent length698mm and tail417mm; these measurements describe one preserved adult female, not a species maximum or a male range. Live individuals were photographed and total length measured, with detailed examination avoided to reduce physical harm. The description reports broad flattened heads, small tubercles and developed lateral folds, but similar traits occur in other Chinese Andrias. A measured hindlimb value and printed percentage do not agree arithmetically, so that ratio is not independently certified here.
KUHE41444 全长 1115mm、吻肛长 698mm、尾 417mm；测量描述一只保存成年雌性，不是物种最大值或雄性范围。活个体拍照及测全长，为减少损伤避免详细检查。描述报告宽扁头、小疣及发达侧褶，但其他中国 Andrias 也有相近性状。后肢实测值与印出百分比在算术上不一致，因此此比例未独立认证。
morphology
Colour differences do not provide a complete diagnostic key
色差不能提供完整鉴别检索

The examined individuals included strongly contrasted dark/pale-brown colours and a deceased individual described as entirely black. The authors question whether a historical illustration correctly depicts sligoi coloration and request further specimen examination. This is an interpretation of illustrations and a few photographed or preserved individuals, not a measured colour-frequency distribution or proof that all-black animals belong to one species. Small head tubercles support their comparison but are not alone sufficient for identification.
检查个体含强对比深浅棕色及一只描述为全黑的死个体。作者质疑历史插图是否正确描绘 sligoi 颜色，要求进一步检查标本。这是插图与少数照片或保存个体的解释，不是测得颜色频率分布，也未证明全黑动物都属一个物种。小头疣支持比较，但不足以单独鉴定。
distribution
Japanese holdings are introduced records with uncertain Chinese origins
日本持有为输入记录，中国原产地未明

The four individuals were held in Japan, including aquaria, a zoo, a private holding and a museum voucher. Their table entries give unknown Chinese origins; they cannot establish native occurrence at the Japanese holding sites. The authors discuss a Hong Kong ditch discovery behind the original description as possibly an escaped captive, with no known native giant salamanders there. Southern China is a presumed origin region, but the paper explicitly leaves the precise natural range uncertain because human transport has obscured provenance.
四个个体在日本持有，涉及水族馆、动物园、私人持有及博物馆凭证。表中中国来源未知，不能确立日本持有地点的原生出现。作者讨论原始描述所依据香港沟渠发现可能为圈养逃逸，当地无已知原生巨鲵。中国南方为推测来源区域，但论文因人为运输混淆溯源而明确保留精确自然范围不确定。
ecology
A dated captive growth series is not a lifespan experiment
有日期的圈养生长序列不是寿命实验

One male’s historical measurements were305mm/113.8g in1986,890mm/4.6kg in1996 and1220mm/12.4kg in2008; in December2021 it measured1375mm and23.4kg. Another male measured approximately1250mm in March2020. These are particular captive individuals, not a species growth curve, wild maximum or age known from hatching. The paper’s roughly60-year lifespan limit is attributed to unpublished data, so it is not independently established by these measurements.
一雄个体历史测量为 1986 年 305mm/113.8g、1996 年 890mm/4.6kg、2008 年 1220mm/12.4kg；2021 年十二月为 1375mm、23.4kg。另一雄在 2020 年三月约 1250mm。这是特定圈养个体，不是物种生长曲线、野生最大值或自孵化已知年龄。论文约六十年寿命极限援引未发表数据，不能由这些测量独立确立。
conservation
A proposed ex-situ rescue is not a demonstrated recovery
提议迁地救护不是已证实恢复

At the study’s reporting time two identified male sligoi remained alive in captivity; this is not a verified current inventory. The authors propose storing sperm and germ cells and finding additional individuals, especially females, for future reproduction. Those plans are not reported successful cryopreservation, breeding or reintroduction outcomes. Statements about imminent disappearance and absence of new wild F1 sightings are conservation interpretations with incomplete detection and provenance, not proof of extinction in China or Japan.
研究报告时两只鉴定雄 sligoi 仍圈养存活，不是已核实当前清单。作者提议保存精子与生殖细胞、寻找更多尤其雌性个体以供未来繁殖。计划不是已报告成功冷冻保存、繁殖或重引入结果。即将消失及未新见野生 F1 的陈述属于有检出与溯源限制的保护解释，不是中国或日本灭绝证明。

Microsatellites classify a sampled Japanese hybrid assemblage
微卫星划分取样日本杂交组合

Among sixty-eight river samples, fourteen microsatellite loci classified45hybrids and23Chinese-source animals. Hybrids included14F1,22backcrosses and nine ambiguous “other” individuals; no F2 was assigned. NewHybrids used a posterior threshold≥0.8 and reference groups of seven captive davidianus and23japonicus. These are sampled assignments under a two-parent model, not a full estimate of Japanese hybrid prevalence, proof that F2 cannot occur or validation of every Chinese lineage as a separate reference population.
六十八河流样本中，十四微卫星位点划分 45 杂交及 23 中国来源动物。杂交含 14F1、22 回交、九个模糊“其他”，未归为 F2。NewHybrids 使用后验阈值≥0.8，参考组为七圈养 davidianus 与 23japonicus。这是二亲本模型下取样归属，不是日本杂交比例完整估计、F2 不会出现的证明或每个中国谱系独立参考种群验证。
taxonomy
Reference groups and maternal lineages answer different questions
参考组与母系谱系回答不同问题

Andrias davidianus is part of a study comparing Japanese and introduced Chinese giant salamanders. Nuclear PCA of58selected individuals separated japonicus from a Chinese group including davidianus, sligoi and an unnamedU1 lineage, while Chinese groups overlapped in later axes. A mitochondrial lineage can occur in a hybrid, so a maternal sequence alone does not certify unadmixed ancestry. The paper requests broader nuclear and morphological evidence rather than replacing the fixed accepted names with a single distance-based threshold.
Andrias davidianus 纳入日本及输入中国巨鲵比较。58 所选个体核 PCA 将 japonicus 与含 davidianus、sligoi、未命名 U1 的中国组分开，而中国组在后续轴重叠。杂交个体可有特定线粒体谱系，因此母系序列不能独自认证无混合祖先。论文要求更广核与形态证据，不是用一个距离阈值替换固定接受名称。

readScope: Mixophyes australis: XML Results Sec3–5/Table1, Discussion Sec6, Sampling Sec8, AMP characterisation Sec12 and prediction/expression Sec14 read; original assemblies, supplementary peptide sequences, extended methods and expression reads not independently analysed; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
name: Mixophyes australis
sourceConcept: 2024 Mixophyes australis genomic study/comparator; specimen and deposited-resource scope retained
sections: evolution
One adult male provides a genome and six tissue transcriptomes
一成年雄性提供基因组及六组织转录组

A wild-caught adult male sampled in September2021 supplied heart/kidney DNA and RNA from brain, male gonads, dorsal and ventral skin, liver and spleen. PacBio HiFi and Hi-C produced a genome of approximately3.12–3.13Gb, with scaffoldN50 about369.3Mb and over95% in twelve major scaffolds. These are assembly properties, not population genetic diversity or biological evidence from six independent frogs. The twelve scaffolds are inferred chromosome-scale units rather than a newly observed karyotype of this individual.
2021 年九月取样的一只野捕成年雄性提供心／肾 DNA，以及脑、雄性生殖腺、背腹皮肤、肝、脾 RNA。PacBio HiFi 与 Hi-C 产生约 3.12–3.13Gb 基因组，scaffold N50 约 369.3Mb，超过 95% 位于十二主要架段。这是组装性质，不是种群遗传多样性或六只独立蛙的生物学证据。十二架段推断为染色体尺度单位，不是对此个体新观察的核型。
evolution
Completeness depends on the resource and metric
完整度依赖资源及指标

Table1 lists91.3% complete genome BUSCOs, while the Results prose says91.8%; these incompatible values are retained as a reporting conflict. Global-transcriptome BUSCO completeness is96.1%, and annotated proteins score86.0%, measuring different resources. Merqury completeness93.5% andQ60+ are another assessment, not percentages that can be pooled with BUSCO. The mitochondrial scaffold is annotated with21tRNAs, two rRNAs and thirteen protein-coding genes; that count is an assembly annotation rather than proof of a universal species-wide tRNA loss.
表 1 列基因组完整 BUSCO 为 91.3%，结果正文为 91.8%；不一致值保留为报告冲突。全局转录组 BUSCO 完整度 96.1%，注释蛋白为 86.0%，测量不同资源。Merqury 完整度 93.5%、Q60+ 属另一评估，不能与 BUSCO 百分比合并。线粒体架段注释为二十一 tRNA、两个 rRNA、十三蛋白编码基因；计数是组装注释，不是全物种普遍 tRNA 丢失证明。
ecology
Fourteen peptide candidates are sequence-based discoveries
十四肽候选为序列发现

Homology searches identify twelve cathelicidin genes and two beta-defensin genes, with full-length transcripts in the global assembly. Cathelicidins cluster on scaffold5 and defensins on scaffold2. Predicted signal regions and mature cleavage products use computational tools; the actual amphibian cleavage enzyme is unknown. These findings are not fourteen purified secreted peptides, experimentally measured pathogen killing or demonstrated resistance to chytrid disease.
同源搜索识别十二 cathelicidin 基因与两个 beta-defensin 基因，全局组装有全长转录本。Cathelicidin 聚于架段 5、defensin 于架段 2。信号区域与成熟剪切产物使用计算工具预测；实际两栖剪切酶未知。这不是十四个纯化分泌肽、实测病原杀灭或已证明壶菌病抗性。
ecology
Tissue expression is preliminary in one individual
单个体组织表达为初步结果

Transcript-per-million values indicate different candidate expression patterns across six tissues, including skin and internal organs. MA-CATH6 is prominent in liver and MA-CATH7–8 in spleen in the discussion; such patterns were not tested across multiple specimens. TPM values are transcript abundance estimates, not measured peptide concentrations or immune efficacy. The authors explicitly state that replication was unavailable and propose future peptide synthesis and cellular functional assays.
每百万转录本值提示六组织不同候选表达模式，包含皮肤及内部器官；讨论中 MA-CATH6 肝表达突出，MA-CATH7–8 脾突出。模式未在多标本间检验。TPM 为转录本丰度估计，不是实测肽浓度或免疫效力。作者明确说明无重复样本，提出未来肽合成与细胞功能实验。
evolution
Gene-tree clusters do not establish unique genus adaptations
基因树聚类不能确立属独有适应

Some cathelicidins form well-supported species-specific clusters, while several other relationships and the defensin pairing have weak support. Duplication timing and evolutionary isolation are proposed explanations. Other Mixophyes peptide repertoires had not been characterized, so the apparent species-specific clusters could extend more broadly. Greater microbial exposure is another hypothesis, not a measured property of this individual or species. A peptide gene tree is not a complete species phylogeny.
若干 cathelicidin 形成支持较强的物种特定聚类，另一些关系及 defensin 配对支持弱。复制时间与演化隔离为提议解释。其他 Mixophyes 肽库未表征，因此表观物种特定聚类可能更广存在。较多微生物暴露为另一假说，不是此个体或物种实测性质。肽基因树不是完整物种系统树。
conservation
Monitoring applications remain proposed
监测应用仍为提议

The authors propose using the mitochondrial resource to develop metabarcoding markers and clarify the relationship of southern australis and northern balbus ranges. This study does not validate an eDNA assay, measure sensitivity or specificity in field water, or map current range overlap. Its threatened-status language is dated source context rather than an independently verified current listing. Genomic quality alone does not demonstrate population recovery or successful conservation monitoring.
作者提出用线粒体资源开发宏条形码标记、澄清南部 australis 与北部 balbus 范围关系。研究未验证 eDNA 检测、测定野外水样灵敏度或特异性，也未绘制当前范围重叠。受威胁等级表述属于有日期来源背景，不是独立核实当前等级。基因组质量本身不能证明种群恢复或成功保护监测。

The sex and maturity of the descriptive sample matter

The type series consists of a48.5mm-SVL adult female holotype, five adult male paratypes, two other adult females and one immature female. The preserved adult ranges are44.1–48.9mm in five males and48.5–55.4mm in three females; the immature female is not part of that adult denominator. Rounded calliper measurements describe the examined material, not complete population limits, a juvenile growth curve or a statistically established universal sexual size difference.

morphology
Live and preserved colours have different evidence

Examined imawari varied from golden or chestnut brown to dark greenish brown, with different markings. The adult iris was faintly two-coloured, sometimes with a light-dependent bluish-grey tint. Katuran-tepui is proposed as a possible additional occurrence, but the authors require molecular confirmation because the summits are isolated. reproduction
A short observation period does not establish absence of brooding
短期观察不能确定不背负繁殖

During11–16May2011, specimens were active at night on rocks, low vegetation and Brocchinia hechtioides; three hid under rocks during the day. No egg- or juvenile-carrying females were observed, but IRSNB4220 retained a glutinous back patch. That patch is not a directly observed clutch or measured brood success. 2011 年五月十一至十六日，标本夜间在岩、低植被及 Brocchinia hechtioides 活动，三只白天藏岩下。未观察背负卵或幼体雌性，但 IRSNB4220 背保留黏性斑。斑不是直接观察卵团或测得育幼成功。短期雨季访察不能界定完整繁殖日历、无亲代照护或严格夜行。
conservation
The 2024 CR proposal has range and threat assumptions
2024 年 CR 建议具有范围与威胁假设

The authors propose Critically Endangered under criteriaB1 andB2a,b, using very small known occurrence, a single location and projected decline from fires and climate change. They give threshold conditions EOO<100km² andAOO<10km² and describe summit occurrence smaller than3km². These quantities are not interchangeable measured areas; the proposal is not a verified current official Red List entry. 研究在 2018–2020 年四月至八月取样 153 蟾：Midu33 雄／12 雌、Mouding50 雄、Pingjiang8 雄／8 雌、Pingbian1 雄／17 雌、Yuanling24 雄。表 1 雄均值 SVL 为 Midu63.06mm、Mouding61.46mm、Yuanling51.38mm；Pingbian 雌均值 72.82mm，而唯一雄 47.70mm。这是分性别样本概要，不是全物种单调海拔规律或完整成年极限。Pingjiang／Yuanling 海拔在地点正文与表 1 不同，表 1 ± 的不确定性类型也未独立认证。

Bone growth lines supply estimated ages
骨生长线提供估计年龄

Phalange sections stained with haematoxylin supplied lines of arrested growth, treated as age under annual seasonal cycles. The authors report estimated ages1–4in males and1–7in females, one false line, no double lines and no detected endosteal resorption. Age variation with altitude or latitude was nonsignificant in the fitted models; failure to detect a difference does not establish identical age structures everywhere.

morphology
An adjusted altitude association differs from unadjusted sizes
校正海拔关联区别于原始体型

The lone Pingbian male was excluded from statistical analyses. Models used log10SVL or body mass, age and sex covariates and population effects. After age adjustment, Table3 reports positive altitude associations for SVL(p=0.035) and mass(p=0.044), but nonsignificant latitude associations. This is observational model evidence, not a temperature manipulation or demonstrated genetic adaptation. The largest female-heavy sample occurs at1043m rather than the highest sites; its age and sex composition matter, and the printed tiny rounded coefficients do not define a independently reconstructed per-metre growth effect.

Bergmann-rule mechanisms remain interpretations

Preserved external scans of a regional adult sample

The study collected244adults at25Yellow River Basin sites in April–August2022 and grouped them into five reach categories. Caliper measurements and structured-light scans provide different dimensional summaries. Specimens were fixed briefly in formalin before scanning, with a consistent pose and calibrated scanner. These are external preserved-body models, not internal microCT anatomy, living movement or a developmental series. Lengths and volume proportions describe different appendage trends

The Results report increasing relative limb length but decreasing limb-volume/body-volume proportions from upstream to downstream. Thus “larger appendages” can refer to proportional volume rather than longer limbs. The paper describes the high-elevation upper-reach sample as relatively small-bodied, while female–male contrasts vary among reaches. Surface-to-volume ratio and the reported shape index have limits

Relative body surface area is defined asBSA/BV, so it has inverse-length units and is not a dimensionless percentage. Equation4 defines the reported “3D fractal dimension” as3ln(BSA)/ln(BV). Without a documented normalization, taking logarithms of dimensionful area and volume makes this index depend on the chosen units; it is not independently certified as a scale-invariant fractal dimension or a direct skin-roughness measurement. Values derived from these meshes also reflect pose, segmentation and preservation rather than only biological surface texture.
相对体表面积定义为 BSA/BV，单位为长度倒数，不是无量纲百分比。式 4 将所报“3D 分形维数”定义为 3ln(BSA)/ln(BV)。未记录归一化时，对有量纲面积与体积取对数使指数依赖所选单位；未独立认证为尺度不变分形维数或直接皮肤粗糙度测量。网格所得值也反映姿态、分割及保存，不仅生物表面纹理。

The authors match sites to climatic rasters and compare morphological and environmental variables after correlation screening. The Tena River microbasin study in Napo, Ecuador, recorded 38 Boana punctata specimens in ponds during its visual encounter surveys. Scinax cruentomma was seen once during the surveys and was not detected by aquatic eDNA in this study. The authors distinguish this local record from prior records in Napo Province and note that their consulted collections did not previously document it in the sampling area or neighboring areas. name: Pristimantis acerus
sourceConcept: 2023 source-labelled Pristimantis acerus in Tena microbasin monitoring or reference-database assessment
sections: occurrence
A downstream molecular signal is not a local range extension
下游分子信号不等于地方分布扩张

The Tena study assigned water-derived molecular units to Pristimantis acerus without observing the frog at its six monitoring sites. It places this taxon among mountain frogs associated with the higher Colonso-Chalupas exploration area, reported at 1,518 m elevation. The authors interpret the downstream detections as possible signals from outside the sampled sites and call them false positives for site-level presence. They are not new live-animal records establishing a lower elevational range. The paper itself gives inconsistent elevation descriptions for the monitoring area—600–710 m in Study site versus below 600 m in the Discussion—so an exact lower elevation is not certified here.

特纳研究将水样分子单位分配为 Pristimantis acerus，但未在六个监测地观察到活蛙。作者把该类群列入较高 Colonso-Chalupas 探索区的山地蛙，探索地报告海拔 1,518 米。下游检出被解释为可能来自取样地之外的信号，并称为地点活体存在意义上的假阳性。它不是证明海拔下限下降的新活体记录。论文对监测区海拔自身不一致：地点节为 600–710 米，讨论为低于 600 米；这里不认证准确下限。
methods
Transport and contamination remain different explanations
迁移与污染是不同解释

Downstream transport of genetic material is the authors’ preferred explanation for the Pristimantis acerus signal. Rainfall, drainage and slope provide context, but the study did not directly trace DNA from an upstream individual to a downstream sample. Reported negative field, amplification and sequencing controls reduce detected contamination concerns; they do not logically exclude every cross-contamination event, index misassignment or sequencing error. Species assignments used a short 16S match threshold above 97%, an operational rule rather than a universal species-delimitation test.
作者倾向以遗传物质下游迁移解释 Pristimantis acerus 信号。降雨、汇水及坡度提供背景，但研究未直接追踪上游个体 DNA 到下游样本。所报现场、扩增及测序阴性对照降低已检出污染疑虑，却不能逻辑上排除每次交叉污染、索引错配或测序错误。物种分配使用短片段 16S 大于 97% 匹配阈值，是操作规则，不是普遍物种界定检验。

sections: methods
An absent reference sequence limits molecular identification
缺参考序列限制分子鉴定

The authors included Hyloscirtus albopunctulatus in the 62-taxon list considered potentially detectable in the Tena microbasin, but could not compile its 16S reference sequence for their study database. References were available for 59 of those source taxa. This is a documented reference gap at the time of database construction, not a new field detection, proof of local absence or a claim that no sequence exists today. It limits interpretation of an unassigned water signal; a short sequence-match workflow cannot confirm a taxon missing from its references.

sectionLocators: PMC10793111 XML Herpetofauna Sampling and Collection; Results Table 1
PMC10793111 XML Discussion Herpetofauna diversity forest-frog paragraph
sections: occurrence
An effort-bounded Gunung Belumut survey record
取样投入有限的 Gunung Belumut 调查记录

Table 1 records 12 Phrynoidis asper encounters at Gunung Belumut Amenity Forest in Johor, Peninsular Malaysia, or 7.0% of the 172 reported amphibian records. Sampling combined drift-fenced pitfall traps with searches along streams and forest trails in parts of 2022 and February 2023. Most captured animals were released and selected vouchers retained; the article does not document marking that would certify every encounter as a different individual. This is a local survey count, not population density, an elevational limit or complete distribution. The forest’s 1,010 m summit elevation is not assigned as the elevation of every frog record.

表 1 在马来半岛柔佛州 Gunung Belumut 游憩森林记录 12 次 Phrynoidis asper 遭遇，占所报 172 条两栖记录的 7.0%。取样结合围栏陷阱与溪流、林径搜索，时间包括 2022 年部分月份及 2023 年二月。大部分捕获动物放归，选留凭证；论文未记录可认证每次遭遇均为不同个体的标记。因此这是地方调查计数，不是种群密度、海拔限度或完整分布。森林 1,010 米峰顶海拔不能指定为每条蛙记录的海拔。
ecology
Clear rocky streams are a cited association, not a water-quality assay
清澈岩石溪流为被引关联，不是水质检测

The authors discuss Phrynoidis asper as a forest frog associated with clear, swift rocky streams, referring to earlier natural-history sources. Such streams occur in the surveyed forest, and the Discussion broadly mentions animals perched on rocks, vegetation and ground along trails and streams. sections: ecology
A dated multicriteria conservation priority
有日期的多准则保育优先级

The 2024 Chilean assessment assigns Telmatobius fronteriensis a printed conservation-priority index of 2.50 and places it in the high category in Table 4. The study reviews 58 selected species using literature, citizen-science records and government plans, rather than newly censusing every population. Its index combines distribution, threat, population trend, taxonomic uniqueness and body-size scores with a protected-area term. The value is a management ranking under this model, not an extinction probability, a current IUCN assessment or a direct measurement of population size. “Non-priority” and “low” do not mean biologically safe or no need for conservation.

2024 年智利评估在表 4 为 Telmatobius fronteriensis 赋予印刷保育优先指数 2.50，列入高类别。研究使用文献、公民科学记录及政府计划评估所选 58 种，不是对全部种群的新普查。指数结合分布、威胁、种群趋势、分类独特性及体型评分，并加入保护区项。数值是该模型下的管理排序，不是灭绝概率、当前 IUCN 评估或直接种群大小测量。“非优先”或“低”不表示生物学安全或无需保育。
methods
The population and protection scores retain their source limits
种群及保护评分保留来源限制

Table 3 gives Telmatobius fronteriensis a population-trend code of 4 (recent decline) and a land-protection code of 1 (the entire population outside protected areas), using the definitions in Table 2. These are the authors’ ordinal assignments, not newly verified census trajectories or measured protected population fractions. A zero denotes unavailable evidence, not a stable population or zero risk. Threat code 3 is also a grouped source category and cannot identify a specific official status by itself. AOO and EOO scores classify area criteria rather than supplying independently reconstructed occupancy maps; protection coverage does not establish effective management.

ecology
The proposed protection actions are recommendations, not completed recovery
拟议保护行动是建议，不是已完成恢复

The Discussion places Telmatobius fronteriensis among high-priority desert Telmatobius associated with restricted distribution, threats and limited territorial protection. It proposes consideration of Alto Loa reserve expansion, water protection and restoration of mining-damaged habitat. These are management recommendations based on the source assessment, not evidence that boundaries were expanded, threats removed or a population recovered. The underlying occurrence records and current reserve coverage were not independently reconstructed here.

来源编码的发育方式与产卵环境

The Atlantic Forest trait compilation codes Adenomera diptyx as having larval development and its oviposition as terrestrial. A larval-development code does not specify larval duration, all larval habitats or the degree of dependence on standing water; those require additional evidence. These are literature-compiled categories, not newly observed spawning or a developmental experiment for this species. Exact correspondence between the source taxonomy and the current accepted concept remains uncertified.
大西洋森林性状汇编将 Adenomera diptyx 编为有幼体阶段发育，产卵环境为陆生。幼体阶段发育码未规定幼体时长、全部幼体生境或对静水的依赖程度，须另有证据。这是文献汇编类别，不是本种新观察产卵或发育实验。来源分类与当前接受概念的准确对应仍未认证。
ecology
Juvenile habitat and egg-site categories have defined scope
幼体生境及卵位点类别有明确范围

The same row codes juvenile habitat as terrestrial and marks foam nests among the seven oviposition-site categories. The positive category summarizes a broad trait; it does not establish a specific nest architecture, substrate species or oviposition height. A juvenile-habitat code is not automatically an adult habitat preference. The compiled record does not newly establish clutch size, egg dimensions, parental attendance, spawning season or offspring survival.
同一行将幼体生境编为陆生，七个产卵位点类别中标记泡沫巢。阳性类别概括广义性状，未确立特定巢结构、基质物种或产卵高度。幼体生境码不能自动作为成体生境偏好。汇编记录未新确立窝卵数、卵大小、亲代看护、产卵季节或后代存活。
morphology
Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits
汇编长度保留推断及测量限制

The row explicitly marks tibia length as inferred, not an observed measurement from a new specimen. The article fills missing traits with a phylogenetic maximum-likelihood procedure; across the full pool, 139 head widths and 146 tibia lengths were inferred. Body length, head width and tibia length are retained numerically in the row-level evidence snapshot. The Methods use means when available and otherwise maxima, while the workbook length headers do not explicitly state units and do not consistently identify sex or stage. These cells are therefore not presented as new diagnostic millimetre measurements, a sex-specific range or measured species-wide variation. Upstream reference entries are preserved, but their original measurements have not been independently checked.
该行明确标注胫长为推断值，不是新标本观察测量。论文以系统发育最大似然过程补缺；全部物种池中推断头宽 139 个、胫长 146 个。体长、头宽及胫长数值保存在行级证据快照。方法有均值则用均值，否则用最大值；工作簿长度表头未明确单位，也未逐行一致标明性别或阶段。因此不把单元格作为新诊断毫米测量、性别专属范围或测得全物种变异。上游参考条目已保留，但原测量未独立检查。
title: Direct development in Atlantic Forest anurans: What can environmental and biotic influences explain about its evolution and occurrence?

sections: ecology
A source-coded development mode and oviposition environment
来源编码的发育方式与产卵环境

The Atlantic Forest trait compilation codes Aplastodiscus ehrhardti as having larval development and its oviposition as aquatic. A larval-development code does not specify larval duration, all larval habitats or the degree of dependence on standing water; those require additional evidence. These are literature-compiled categories, not newly observed spawning or a developmental experiment for this species. Exact correspondence between the source taxonomy and the current accepted concept remains uncertified.
大西洋森林性状汇编将 Aplastodiscus ehrhardti 编为有幼体阶段发育，产卵环境为水生。幼体阶段发育码未规定幼体时长、全部幼体生境或对静水的依赖程度，须另有证据。这是文献汇编类别，不是本种新观察产卵或发育实验。来源分类与当前接受概念的准确对应仍未认证。
ecology
Juvenile habitat and egg-site categories have defined scope
幼体生境及卵位点类别有明确范围

The same row codes juvenile habitat as aquatic and marks eggs directly in water or on submerged substrate among the seven oviposition-site categories. The positive category summarizes a broad trait; it does not establish a specific nest architecture, substrate species or oviposition height. A juvenile-habitat code is not automatically an adult habitat preference. The compiled record does not newly establish clutch size, egg dimensions, parental attendance, spawning season or offspring survival.
同一行将幼体生境编为水生，七个产卵位点类别中标记卵直接置于水中或水下基质。阳性类别概括广义性状，未确立特定巢结构、基质物种或产卵高度。幼体生境码不能自动作为成体生境偏好。汇编记录未新确立窝卵数、卵大小、亲代看护、产卵季节或后代存活。
morphology
Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits
汇编长度保留推断及测量限制

The row does not carry a head-width or tibia-length inference flag. That absence is not an independent audit establishing how each original value was measured. Body length, head width and tibia length are retained numerically in the row-level evidence snapshot. The Methods use means when available and otherwise maxima, while the workbook length headers do not explicitly state units and do not consistently identify sex or stage. These cells are therefore not presented as new diagnostic millimetre measurements, a sex-specific range or measured species-wide variation. Upstream reference entries are preserved, but their original measurements have not been independently checked.
该行没有头宽或胫长推断标记，但无标记不等于独立审核并确立每个原值如何测得。体长、头宽及胫长数值保存在行级证据快照。方法有均值则用均值，否则用最大值；工作簿长度表头未明确单位，也未逐行一致标明性别或阶段。因此不把单元格作为新诊断毫米测量、性别专属范围或测得全物种变异。上游参考条目已保留，但原测量未独立检查。

Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits

The row explicitly marks head width and tibia length as inferred, not an observed measurement from a new specimen. These cells are therefore not presented as new diagnostic millimetre measurements, a sex-specific range or measured species-wide variation. Upstream reference entries are preserved, but their original measurements have not been independently checked.

sections: ecology
A source-coded development mode and oviposition environment
来源编码的发育方式与产卵环境

The Atlantic Forest trait compilation codes Boana crepitans as having larval development and its oviposition as aquatic. A larval-development code does not specify larval duration, all larval habitats or the degree of dependence on standing water; those require additional evidence. These are literature-compiled categories, not newly observed spawning or a developmental experiment for this species. Exact correspondence between the source taxonomy and the current accepted concept remains uncertified.
大西洋森林性状汇编将 Boana crepitans 编为有幼体阶段发育，产卵环境为水生。幼体阶段发育码未规定幼体时长、全部幼体生境或对静水的依赖程度，须另有证据。这是文献汇编类别，不是本种新观察产卵或发育实验。来源分类与当前接受概念的准确对应仍未认证。
ecology
Juvenile habitat and egg-site categories have defined scope
幼体生境及卵位点类别有明确范围

The same row codes juvenile habitat as aquatic and marks eggs directly in water or on submerged substrate among the seven oviposition-site categories. The positive category summarizes a broad trait; it does not establish a specific nest architecture, substrate species or oviposition height. A juvenile-habitat code is not automatically an adult habitat preference. The compiled record does not newly establish clutch size, egg dimensions, parental attendance, spawning season or offspring survival.
同一行将幼体生境编为水生，七个产卵位点类别中标记卵直接置于水中或水下基质。阳性类别概括广义性状，未确立特定巢结构、基质物种或产卵高度。幼体生境码不能自动作为成体生境偏好。汇编记录未新确立窝卵数、卵大小、亲代看护、产卵季节或后代存活。
morphology
Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits
汇编长度保留推断及测量限制

The row does not carry a head-width or tibia-length inference flag. That absence is not an independent audit establishing how each original value was measured. Body length, head width and tibia length are retained numerically in the row-level evidence snapshot. The Methods use means when available and otherwise maxima, while the workbook length headers do not explicitly state units and do not consistently identify sex or stage. These cells are therefore not presented as new diagnostic millimetre measurements, a sex-specific range or measured species-wide variation. Upstream reference entries are preserved, but their original measurements have not been independently checked.
该行没有头宽或胫长推断标记，但无标记不等于独立审核并确立每个原值如何测得。体长、头宽及胫长数值保存在行级证据快照。方法有均值则用均值，否则用最大值；工作簿长度表头未明确单位，也未逐行一致标明性别或阶段。因此不把单元格作为新诊断毫米测量、性别专属范围或测得全物种变异。上游参考条目已保留，但原测量未独立检查。
title: Direct development in Atlantic Forest anurans: What can environmental and biotic influences explain about its evolution and occurrence?

sections: ecology
A source-coded development mode and oviposition environment
来源编码的发育方式与产卵环境

The Atlantic Forest trait compilation codes Boana marginata as having larval development and its oviposition as aquatic. A larval-development code does not specify larval duration, all larval habitats or the degree of dependence on standing water; those require additional evidence. These are literature-compiled categories, not newly observed spawning or a developmental experiment for this species. Exact correspondence between the source taxonomy and the current accepted concept remains uncertified.
大西洋森林性状汇编将 Boana marginata 编为有幼体阶段发育，产卵环境为水生。幼体阶段发育码未规定幼体时长、全部幼体生境或对静水的依赖程度，须另有证据。这是文献汇编类别，不是本种新观察产卵或发育实验。来源分类与当前接受概念的准确对应仍未认证。
ecology
Juvenile habitat and egg-site categories have defined scope
幼体生境及卵位点类别有明确范围

The same row codes juvenile habitat as aquatic and marks eggs directly in water or on submerged substrate among the seven oviposition-site categories. The positive category summarizes a broad trait; it does not establish a specific nest architecture, substrate species or oviposition height. A juvenile-habitat code is not automatically an adult habitat preference. The compiled record does not newly establish clutch size, egg dimensions, parental attendance, spawning season or offspring survival.
同一行将幼体生境编为水生，七个产卵位点类别中标记卵直接置于水中或水下基质。阳性类别概括广义性状，未确立特定巢结构、基质物种或产卵高度。幼体生境码不能自动作为成体生境偏好。汇编记录未新确立窝卵数、卵大小、亲代看护、产卵季节或后代存活。
morphology
Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits
汇编长度保留推断及测量限制

The row does not carry a head-width or tibia-length inference flag. That absence is not an independent audit establishing how each original value was measured. Body length, head width and tibia length are retained numerically in the row-level evidence snapshot. The Methods use means when available and otherwise maxima, while the workbook length headers do not explicitly state units and do not consistently identify sex or stage. These cells are therefore not presented as new diagnostic millimetre measurements, a sex-specific range or measured species-wide variation. Upstream reference entries are preserved, but their original measurements have not been independently checked.
该行没有头宽或胫长推断标记，但无标记不等于独立审核并确立每个原值如何测得。体长、头宽及胫长数值保存在行级证据快照。方法有均值则用均值，否则用最大值；工作簿长度表头未明确单位，也未逐行一致标明性别或阶段。因此不把单元格作为新诊断毫米测量、性别专属范围或测得全物种变异。上游参考条目已保留，但原测量未独立检查。
title: Direct development in Atlantic Forest anurans: What can environmental and biotic influences explain about its evolution and occurrence?

sections: ecology
A source-coded development mode and oviposition environment
来源编码的发育方式与产卵环境

The Atlantic Forest trait compilation codes Boana stellae as having larval development and its oviposition as aquatic. A larval-development code does not specify larval duration, all larval habitats or the degree of dependence on standing water; those require additional evidence. These are literature-compiled categories, not newly observed spawning or a developmental experiment for this species. Exact correspondence between the source taxonomy and the current accepted concept remains uncertified.
大西洋森林性状汇编将 Boana stellae 编为有幼体阶段发育，产卵环境为水生。幼体阶段发育码未规定幼体时长、全部幼体生境或对静水的依赖程度，须另有证据。这是文献汇编类别，不是本种新观察产卵或发育实验。来源分类与当前接受概念的准确对应仍未认证。
ecology
Juvenile habitat and egg-site categories have defined scope
幼体生境及卵位点类别有明确范围

The same row codes juvenile habitat as aquatic and marks eggs directly in water or on submerged substrate among the seven oviposition-site categories. The positive category summarizes a broad trait; it does not establish a specific nest architecture, substrate species or oviposition height. A juvenile-habitat code is not automatically an adult habitat preference. The compiled record does not newly establish clutch size, egg dimensions, parental attendance, spawning season or offspring survival.
同一行将幼体生境编为水生，七个产卵位点类别中标记卵直接置于水中或水下基质。阳性类别概括广义性状，未确立特定巢结构、基质物种或产卵高度。幼体生境码不能自动作为成体生境偏好。汇编记录未新确立窝卵数、卵大小、亲代看护、产卵季节或后代存活。
morphology
Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits
汇编长度保留推断及测量限制

The row does not carry a head-width or tibia-length inference flag. That absence is not an independent audit establishing how each original value was measured. Body length, head width and tibia length are retained numerically in the row-level evidence snapshot. The Methods use means when available and otherwise maxima, while the workbook length headers do not explicitly state units and do not consistently identify sex or stage. These cells are therefore not presented as new diagnostic millimetre measurements, a sex-specific range or measured species-wide variation. Upstream reference entries are preserved, but their original measurements have not been independently checked.
该行没有头宽或胫长推断标记，但无标记不等于独立审核并确立每个原值如何测得。体长、头宽及胫长数值保存在行级证据快照。方法有均值则用均值，否则用最大值；工作簿长度表头未明确单位，也未逐行一致标明性别或阶段。因此不把单元格作为新诊断毫米测量、性别专属范围或测得全物种变异。上游参考条目已保留，但原测量未独立检查。
title: Direct development in Atlantic Forest anurans: What can environmental and biotic influences explain about its evolution and occurrence?

sections: ecology
A source-coded development mode and oviposition environment
来源编码的发育方式与产卵环境

The Atlantic Forest trait compilation codes Brachycephalus hermogenesi as direct-developing and its oviposition as terrestrial. In the article, direct development means no free-living larval stage, with a froglet hatching rather than a free-living tadpole; it does not mean that embryonic development is absent or that humidity is unnecessary. These are literature-compiled categories, not newly observed spawning or a developmental experiment for this species. Exact correspondence between the source taxonomy and the current accepted concept remains uncertified.
大西洋森林性状汇编将 Brachycephalus hermogenesi 编为直接发育，产卵环境为陆生。论文中的直接发育指无自由生活幼体阶段，孵出幼蛙而非自由生活蝌蚪；不表示无胚胎发育或无需湿度。这是文献汇编类别，不是本种新观察产卵或发育实验。来源分类与当前接受概念的准确对应仍未认证。
ecology
Juvenile habitat and egg-site categories have defined scope
幼体生境及卵位点类别有明确范围

The same row codes juvenile habitat as terrestrial and marks eggs on the ground, rocks or in burrows among the seven oviposition-site categories. The positive category summarizes a broad trait; it does not establish a specific nest architecture, substrate species or oviposition height. A juvenile-habitat code is not automatically an adult habitat preference. The compiled record does not newly establish clutch size, egg dimensions, parental attendance, spawning season or offspring survival.
同一行将幼体生境编为陆生，七个产卵位点类别中标记卵置于地面、岩石或洞穴。阳性类别概括广义性状，未确立特定巢结构、基质物种或产卵高度。幼体生境码不能自动作为成体生境偏好。汇编记录未新确立窝卵数、卵大小、亲代看护、产卵季节或后代存活。
morphology
Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits
汇编长度保留推断及测量限制

The row does not carry a head-width or tibia-length inference flag. That absence is not an independent audit establishing how each original value was measured. Body length, head width and tibia length are retained numerically in the row-level evidence snapshot. The Methods use means when available and otherwise maxima, while the workbook length headers do not explicitly state units and do not consistently identify sex or stage. These cells are therefore not presented as new diagnostic millimetre measurements, a sex-specific range or measured species-wide variation. Upstream reference entries are preserved, but their original measurements have not been independently checked.
该行没有头宽或胫长推断标记，但无标记不等于独立审核并确立每个原值如何测得。体长、头宽及胫长数值保存在行级证据快照。方法有均值则用均值，否则用最大值；工作簿长度表头未明确单位，也未逐行一致标明性别或阶段。因此不把单元格作为新诊断毫米测量、性别专属范围或测得全物种变异。上游参考条目已保留，但原测量未独立检查。

Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits
汇编长度保留推断及测量限制

The row explicitly marks head width and tibia length as inferred, not an observed measurement from a new specimen. The article fills missing traits with a phylogenetic maximum-likelihood procedure; across the full pool, 139 head widths and 146 tibia lengths were inferred. Body length, head width and tibia length are retained numerically in the row-level evidence snapshot. The Methods use means when available and otherwise maxima, while the workbook length headers do not explicitly state units and do not consistently identify sex or stage. These cells are therefore not presented as new diagnostic millimetre measurements, a sex-specific range or measured species-wide variation. Upstream reference entries are preserved, but their original measurements have not been independently checked.

sections: ecology
A source-coded development mode and oviposition environment
来源编码的发育方式与产卵环境

The Atlantic Forest trait compilation codes Cycloramphus migueli as having larval development and its oviposition as terrestrial. A larval-development code does not specify larval duration, all larval habitats or the degree of dependence on standing water; those require additional evidence. These are literature-compiled categories, not newly observed spawning or a developmental experiment for this species. Exact correspondence between the source taxonomy and the current accepted concept remains uncertified.
大西洋森林性状汇编将 Cycloramphus migueli 编为有幼体阶段发育，产卵环境为陆生。幼体阶段发育码未规定幼体时长、全部幼体生境或对静水的依赖程度，须另有证据。这是文献汇编类别，不是本种新观察产卵或发育实验。来源分类与当前接受概念的准确对应仍未认证。
ecology
Juvenile habitat and egg-site categories have defined scope
幼体生境及卵位点类别有明确范围

The same row codes juvenile habitat as terrestrial and marks eggs on the ground, rocks or in burrows among the seven oviposition-site categories. The positive category summarizes a broad trait; it does not establish a specific nest architecture, substrate species or oviposition height. A juvenile-habitat code is not automatically an adult habitat preference. The compiled record does not newly establish clutch size, egg dimensions, parental attendance, spawning season or offspring survival.
同一行将幼体生境编为陆生，七个产卵位点类别中标记卵置于地面、岩石或洞穴。阳性类别概括广义性状，未确立特定巢结构、基质物种或产卵高度。幼体生境码不能自动作为成体生境偏好。汇编记录未新确立窝卵数、卵大小、亲代看护、产卵季节或后代存活。
morphology
Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits
汇编长度保留推断及测量限制

The row does not carry a head-width or tibia-length inference flag. That absence is not an independent audit establishing how each original value was measured. Body length, head width and tibia length are retained numerically in the row-level evidence snapshot. The Methods use means when available and otherwise maxima, while the workbook length headers do not explicitly state units and do not consistently identify sex or stage. These cells are therefore not presented as new diagnostic millimetre measurements, a sex-specific range or measured species-wide variation. Upstream reference entries are preserved, but their original measurements have not been independently checked.

title: Direct development in Atlantic Forest anurans: What can environmental and biotic influences explain about its evolution and occurrence?

来源编码的发育方式与产卵环境

The Atlantic Forest trait compilation codes Dendropsophus rubicundulus as having larval development and its oviposition as aquatic. A larval-development code does not specify larval duration, all larval habitats or the degree of dependence on standing water; those require additional evidence. These are literature-compiled categories, not newly observed spawning or a developmental experiment for this species. Exact correspondence between the source taxonomy and the current accepted concept remains uncertified.
大西洋森林性状汇编将 Dendropsophus rubicundulus 编为有幼体阶段发育，产卵环境为水生。幼体阶段发育码未规定幼体时长、全部幼体生境或对静水的依赖程度，须另有证据。这是文献汇编类别，不是本种新观察产卵或发育实验。来源分类与当前接受概念的准确对应仍未认证。
ecology
Juvenile habitat and egg-site categories have defined scope
幼体生境及卵位点类别有明确范围

The same row codes juvenile habitat as aquatic and marks eggs directly in water or on submerged substrate among the seven oviposition-site categories. The positive category summarizes a broad trait; it does not establish a specific nest architecture, substrate species or oviposition height. A juvenile-habitat code is not automatically an adult habitat preference. The compiled record does not newly establish clutch size, egg dimensions, parental attendance, spawning season or offspring survival.
同一行将幼体生境编为水生，七个产卵位点类别中标记卵直接置于水中或水下基质。阳性类别概括广义性状，未确立特定巢结构、基质物种或产卵高度。幼体生境码不能自动作为成体生境偏好。汇编记录未新确立窝卵数、卵大小、亲代看护、产卵季节或后代存活。
morphology
Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits
汇编长度保留推断及测量限制

The row explicitly marks head width and tibia length as inferred, not an observed measurement from a new specimen. The article fills missing traits with a phylogenetic maximum-likelihood procedure; across the full pool, 139 head widths and 146 tibia lengths were inferred. Body length, head width and tibia length are retained numerically in the row-level evidence snapshot. The Methods use means when available and otherwise maxima, while the workbook length headers do not explicitly state units and do not consistently identify sex or stage. These cells are therefore not presented as new diagnostic millimetre measurements, a sex-specific range or measured species-wide variation. Upstream reference entries are preserved, but their original measurements have not been independently checked.
该行明确标注头宽、胫长为推断值，不是新标本观察测量。论文以系统发育最大似然过程补缺；全部物种池中推断头宽 139 个、胫长 146 个。体长、头宽及胫长数值保存在行级证据快照。方法有均值则用均值，否则用最大值；工作簿长度表头未明确单位，也未逐行一致标明性别或阶段。因此不把单元格作为新诊断毫米测量、性别专属范围或测得全物种变异。上游参考条目已保留，但原测量未独立检查。
title: Direct development in Atlantic Forest anurans: What can environmental and biotic influences explain about its evolution and occurrence?

sections: ecology
A source-coded development mode and oviposition environment
来源编码的发育方式与产卵环境

The Atlantic Forest trait compilation codes Hylodes cardosoi as having larval development and its oviposition as aquatic. A larval-development code does not specify larval duration, all larval habitats or the degree of dependence on standing water; those require additional evidence. These are literature-compiled categories, not newly observed spawning or a developmental experiment for this species. Exact correspondence between the source taxonomy and the current accepted concept remains uncertified.
大西洋森林性状汇编将 Hylodes cardosoi 编为有幼体阶段发育，产卵环境为水生。幼体阶段发育码未规定幼体时长、全部幼体生境或对静水的依赖程度，须另有证据。这是文献汇编类别，不是本种新观察产卵或发育实验。来源分类与当前接受概念的准确对应仍未认证。
ecology
Juvenile habitat and egg-site categories have defined scope
幼体生境及卵位点类别有明确范围

The same row codes juvenile habitat as aquatic and marks eggs directly in water or on submerged substrate among the seven oviposition-site categories. The positive category summarizes a broad trait; it does not establish a specific nest architecture, substrate species or oviposition height. A juvenile-habitat code is not automatically an adult habitat preference. The compiled record does not newly establish clutch size, egg dimensions, parental attendance, spawning season or offspring survival.
同一行将幼体生境编为水生，七个产卵位点类别中标记卵直接置于水中或水下基质。阳性类别概括广义性状，未确立特定巢结构、基质物种或产卵高度。幼体生境码不能自动作为成体生境偏好。汇编记录未新确立窝卵数、卵大小、亲代看护、产卵季节或后代存活。
morphology
Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits
汇编长度保留推断及测量限制

The row does not carry a head-width or tibia-length inference flag. That absence is not an independent audit establishing how each original value was measured. Body length, head width and tibia length are retained numerically in the row-level evidence snapshot. The Methods use means when available and otherwise maxima, while the workbook length headers do not explicitly state units and do not consistently identify sex or stage. These cells are therefore not presented as new diagnostic millimetre measurements, a sex-specific range or measured species-wide variation. Upstream reference entries are preserved, but their original measurements have not been independently checked.
该行没有头宽或胫长推断标记，但无标记不等于独立审核并确立每个原值如何测得。体长、头宽及胫长数值保存在行级证据快照。方法有均值则用均值，否则用最大值；工作簿长度表头未明确单位，也未逐行一致标明性别或阶段。因此不把单元格作为新诊断毫米测量、性别专属范围或测得全物种变异。上游参考条目已保留，但原测量未独立检查。
title: Direct development in Atlantic Forest anurans: What can environmental and biotic influences explain about its evolution and occurrence?

sections: ecology
A source-coded development mode and oviposition environment
来源编码的发育方式与产卵环境

The Atlantic Forest trait compilation codes Leptodactylus cupreus as having larval development and its oviposition as aquatic. A larval-development code does not specify larval duration, all larval habitats or the degree of dependence on standing water; those require additional evidence. These are literature-compiled categories, not newly observed spawning or a developmental experiment for this species. Exact correspondence between the source taxonomy and the current accepted concept remains uncertified.
大西洋森林性状汇编将 Leptodactylus cupreus 编为有幼体阶段发育，产卵环境为水生。幼体阶段发育码未规定幼体时长、全部幼体生境或对静水的依赖程度，须另有证据。这是文献汇编类别，不是本种新观察产卵或发育实验。来源分类与当前接受概念的准确对应仍未认证。
ecology
Juvenile habitat and egg-site categories have defined scope
幼体生境及卵位点类别有明确范围

The same row codes juvenile habitat as aquatic and marks foam nests among the seven oviposition-site categories. The positive category summarizes a broad trait; it does not establish a specific nest architecture, substrate species or oviposition height. A juvenile-habitat code is not automatically an adult habitat preference. The compiled record does not newly establish clutch size, egg dimensions, parental attendance, spawning season or offspring survival.
同一行将幼体生境编为水生，七个产卵位点类别中标记泡沫巢。阳性类别概括广义性状，未确立特定巢结构、基质物种或产卵高度。幼体生境码不能自动作为成体生境偏好。汇编记录未新确立窝卵数、卵大小、亲代看护、产卵季节或后代存活。
morphology
Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits
汇编长度保留推断及测量限制

The row does not carry a head-width or tibia-length inference flag. That absence is not an independent audit establishing how each original value was measured. Body length, head width and tibia length are retained numerically in the row-level evidence snapshot. The Methods use means when available and otherwise maxima, while the workbook length headers do not explicitly state units and do not consistently identify sex or stage. These cells are therefore not presented as new diagnostic millimetre measurements, a sex-specific range or measured species-wide variation. Upstream reference entries are preserved, but their original measurements have not been independently checked.

For the source name Leptodactylus sertanejo, juvenile habitat is coded aquatic. Positive egg-site flags indicate foam nests. Every positive category is retained, including multiple categories where present. Juvenile habitat is not an adult preference, and terrestrial oviposition is distinct from direct development. These broad categories do not establish clutch size, seasonal breeding, parental attendance, nest dimensions or offspring survival. Original references are indexed in the archived row; those upstream studies have not all been independently read.

Leptodactylus sertanejo carries no head-width or tibia-length inference flag in the workbook. Absence of a flag does not independently certify the original measurement procedure. sections: ecology
A source-coded development mode and oviposition environment
来源编码的发育方式与产卵环境

The Atlantic Forest trait compilation codes Leptodactylus labyrinthicus as having larval development and its oviposition as aquatic. A larval-development code does not specify larval duration, all larval habitats or the degree of dependence on standing water; those require additional evidence. These are literature-compiled categories, not newly observed spawning or a developmental experiment for this species. Exact correspondence between the source taxonomy and the current accepted concept remains uncertified.
大西洋森林性状汇编将 Leptodactylus labyrinthicus 编为有幼体阶段发育，产卵环境为水生。幼体阶段发育码未规定幼体时长、全部幼体生境或对静水的依赖程度，须另有证据。这是文献汇编类别，不是本种新观察产卵或发育实验。来源分类与当前接受概念的准确对应仍未认证。
ecology
Juvenile habitat and egg-site categories have defined scope
幼体生境及卵位点类别有明确范围

The same row codes juvenile habitat as aquatic and marks foam nests among the seven oviposition-site categories. The positive category summarizes a broad trait; it does not establish a specific nest architecture, substrate species or oviposition height. A juvenile-habitat code is not automatically an adult habitat preference. The compiled record does not newly establish clutch size, egg dimensions, parental attendance, spawning season or offspring survival.
同一行将幼体生境编为水生，七个产卵位点类别中标记泡沫巢。阳性类别概括广义性状，未确立特定巢结构、基质物种或产卵高度。幼体生境码不能自动作为成体生境偏好。汇编记录未新确立窝卵数、卵大小、亲代看护、产卵季节或后代存活。
morphology
Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits
汇编长度保留推断及测量限制

The row explicitly marks tibia length as inferred, not an observed measurement from a new specimen. The article fills missing traits with a phylogenetic maximum-likelihood procedure; across the full pool, 139 head widths and 146 tibia lengths were inferred. Body length, head width and tibia length are retained numerically in the row-level evidence snapshot. The Methods use means when available and otherwise maxima, while the workbook length headers do not explicitly state units and do not consistently identify sex or stage. These cells are therefore not presented as new diagnostic millimetre measurements, a sex-specific range or measured species-wide variation. Upstream reference entries are preserved, but their original measurements have not been independently checked.
该行明确标注胫长为推断值，不是新标本观察测量。论文以系统发育最大似然过程补缺；全部物种池中推断头宽 139 个、胫长 146 个。体长、头宽及胫长数值保存在行级证据快照。方法有均值则用均值，否则用最大值；工作簿长度表头未明确单位，也未逐行一致标明性别或阶段。因此不把单元格作为新诊断毫米测量、性别专属范围或测得全物种变异。上游参考条目已保留，但原测量未独立检查。

sections: ecology
A source-coded development mode and oviposition environment
来源编码的发育方式与产卵环境

The Atlantic Forest trait compilation codes Odontophrynus americanus as having larval development and its oviposition as aquatic. A larval-development code does not specify larval duration, all larval habitats or the degree of dependence on standing water; those require additional evidence. These are literature-compiled categories, not newly observed spawning or a developmental experiment for this species. Exact correspondence between the source taxonomy and the current accepted concept remains uncertified.
大西洋森林性状汇编将 Odontophrynus americanus 编为有幼体阶段发育，产卵环境为水生。幼体阶段发育码未规定幼体时长、全部幼体生境或对静水的依赖程度，须另有证据。这是文献汇编类别，不是本种新观察产卵或发育实验。来源分类与当前接受概念的准确对应仍未认证。
ecology
Juvenile habitat and egg-site categories have defined scope
幼体生境及卵位点类别有明确范围

The same row codes juvenile habitat as aquatic and marks eggs directly in water or on submerged substrate among the seven oviposition-site categories. The positive category summarizes a broad trait; it does not establish a specific nest architecture, substrate species or oviposition height. A juvenile-habitat code is not automatically an adult habitat preference. The compiled record does not newly establish clutch size, egg dimensions, parental attendance, spawning season or offspring survival.
同一行将幼体生境编为水生，七个产卵位点类别中标记卵直接置于水中或水下基质。阳性类别概括广义性状，未确立特定巢结构、基质物种或产卵高度。幼体生境码不能自动作为成体生境偏好。汇编记录未新确立窝卵数、卵大小、亲代看护、产卵季节或后代存活。
morphology
Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits
汇编长度保留推断及测量限制

The row does not carry a head-width or tibia-length inference flag. That absence is not an independent audit establishing how each original value was measured. Body length, head width and tibia length are retained numerically in the row-level evidence snapshot. The Methods use means when available and otherwise maxima, while the workbook length headers do not explicitly state units and do not consistently identify sex or stage. These cells are therefore not presented as new diagnostic millimetre measurements, a sex-specific range or measured species-wide variation. Upstream reference entries are preserved, but their original measurements have not been independently checked.
该行没有头宽或胫长推断标记，但无标记不等于独立审核并确立每个原值如何测得。体长、头宽及胫长数值保存在行级证据快照。方法有均值则用均值，否则用最大值；工作簿长度表头未明确单位，也未逐行一致标明性别或阶段。因此不把单元格作为新诊断毫米测量、性别专属范围或测得全物种变异。上游参考条目已保留，但原测量未独立检查。
title: Direct development in Atlantic Forest anurans: What can environmental and biotic influences explain about its evolution and occurrence?

sections: ecology
A source-coded development mode and oviposition environment
来源编码的发育方式与产卵环境

The Atlantic Forest trait compilation codes Phyllodytes edelmoi as having larval development and its oviposition as aquatic. A larval-development code does not specify larval duration, all larval habitats or the degree of dependence on standing water; those require additional evidence. These are literature-compiled categories, not newly observed spawning or a developmental experiment for this species. Exact correspondence between the source taxonomy and the current accepted concept remains uncertified.
大西洋森林性状汇编将 Phyllodytes edelmoi 编为有幼体阶段发育，产卵环境为水生。幼体阶段发育码未规定幼体时长、全部幼体生境或对静水的依赖程度，须另有证据。这是文献汇编类别，不是本种新观察产卵或发育实验。来源分类与当前接受概念的准确对应仍未认证。
ecology
Juvenile habitat and egg-site categories have defined scope
幼体生境及卵位点类别有明确范围

The same row codes juvenile habitat as aquatic and marks eggs directly in water or on submerged substrate among the seven oviposition-site categories. The positive category summarizes a broad trait; it does not establish a specific nest architecture, substrate species or oviposition height. A juvenile-habitat code is not automatically an adult habitat preference. The compiled record does not newly establish clutch size, egg dimensions, parental attendance, spawning season or offspring survival.
同一行将幼体生境编为水生，七个产卵位点类别中标记卵直接置于水中或水下基质。阳性类别概括广义性状，未确立特定巢结构、基质物种或产卵高度。幼体生境码不能自动作为成体生境偏好。汇编记录未新确立窝卵数、卵大小、亲代看护、产卵季节或后代存活。
morphology
Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits
汇编长度保留推断及测量限制

The row does not carry a head-width or tibia-length inference flag. That absence is not an independent audit establishing how each original value was measured. Body length, head width and tibia length are retained numerically in the row-level evidence snapshot. The Methods use means when available and otherwise maxima, while the workbook length headers do not explicitly state units and do not consistently identify sex or stage. These cells are therefore not presented as new diagnostic millimetre measurements, a sex-specific range or measured species-wide variation. Upstream reference entries are preserved, but their original measurements have not been independently checked.
该行没有头宽或胫长推断标记，但无标记不等于独立审核并确立每个原值如何测得。体长、头宽及胫长数值保存在行级证据快照。方法有均值则用均值，否则用最大值；工作簿长度表头未明确单位，也未逐行一致标明性别或阶段。因此不把单元格作为新诊断毫米测量、性别专属范围或测得全物种变异。上游参考条目已保留，但原测量未独立检查。
title: Direct development in Atlantic Forest anurans: What can environmental and biotic influences explain about its evolution and occurrence?

sections: ecology
A source-coded development mode and oviposition environment
来源编码的发育方式与产卵环境

The Atlantic Forest trait compilation codes Physalaemus caete as having larval development and its oviposition as aquatic. A larval-development code does not specify larval duration, all larval habitats or the degree of dependence on standing water; those require additional evidence. These are literature-compiled categories, not newly observed spawning or a developmental experiment for this species. Exact correspondence between the source taxonomy and the current accepted concept remains uncertified.
大西洋森林性状汇编将 Physalaemus caete 编为有幼体阶段发育，产卵环境为水生。幼体阶段发育码未规定幼体时长、全部幼体生境或对静水的依赖程度，须另有证据。这是文献汇编类别，不是本种新观察产卵或发育实验。来源分类与当前接受概念的准确对应仍未认证。
ecology
Juvenile habitat and egg-site categories have defined scope
幼体生境及卵位点类别有明确范围

The same row codes juvenile habitat as aquatic and marks foam nests among the seven oviposition-site categories. The positive category summarizes a broad trait; it does not establish a specific nest architecture, substrate species or oviposition height. A juvenile-habitat code is not automatically an adult habitat preference. The compiled record does not newly establish clutch size, egg dimensions, parental attendance, spawning season or offspring survival.
同一行将幼体生境编为水生，七个产卵位点类别中标记泡沫巢。阳性类别概括广义性状，未确立特定巢结构、基质物种或产卵高度。幼体生境码不能自动作为成体生境偏好。汇编记录未新确立窝卵数、卵大小、亲代看护、产卵季节或后代存活。
morphology
Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits
汇编长度保留推断及测量限制

The row explicitly marks head width and tibia length as inferred, not an observed measurement from a new specimen. The article fills missing traits with a phylogenetic maximum-likelihood procedure; across the full pool, 139 head widths and 146 tibia lengths were inferred. Body length, head width and tibia length are retained numerically in the row-level evidence snapshot. The Methods use means when available and otherwise maxima, while the workbook length headers do not explicitly state units and do not consistently identify sex or stage. These cells are therefore not presented as new diagnostic millimetre measurements, a sex-specific range or measured species-wide variation. Upstream reference entries are preserved, but their original measurements have not been independently checked.
该行明确标注头宽、胫长为推断值，不是新标本观察测量。论文以系统发育最大似然过程补缺；全部物种池中推断头宽 139 个、胫长 146 个。体长、头宽及胫长数值保存在行级证据快照。方法有均值则用均值，否则用最大值；工作簿长度表头未明确单位，也未逐行一致标明性别或阶段。因此不把单元格作为新诊断毫米测量、性别专属范围或测得全物种变异。上游参考条目已保留，但原测量未独立检查。
title: Direct development in Atlantic Forest anurans: What can environmental and biotic influences explain about its evolution and occurrence?

来源编码的发育方式与产卵环境

The Atlantic Forest trait compilation codes Physalaemus moreirae as having larval development and its oviposition as aquatic. A larval-development code does not specify larval duration, all larval habitats or the degree of dependence on standing water; those require additional evidence. These are literature-compiled categories, not newly observed spawning or a developmental experiment for this species. Exact correspondence between the source taxonomy and the current accepted concept remains uncertified.
大西洋森林性状汇编将 Physalaemus moreirae 编为有幼体阶段发育，产卵环境为水生。幼体阶段发育码未规定幼体时长、全部幼体生境或对静水的依赖程度，须另有证据。这是文献汇编类别，不是本种新观察产卵或发育实验。来源分类与当前接受概念的准确对应仍未认证。
ecology
Juvenile habitat and egg-site categories have defined scope
幼体生境及卵位点类别有明确范围

The same row codes juvenile habitat as aquatic and marks foam nests among the seven oviposition-site categories. The positive category summarizes a broad trait; it does not establish a specific nest architecture, substrate species or oviposition height. A juvenile-habitat code is not automatically an adult habitat preference. The compiled record does not newly establish clutch size, egg dimensions, parental attendance, spawning season or offspring survival.
同一行将幼体生境编为水生，七个产卵位点类别中标记泡沫巢。阳性类别概括广义性状，未确立特定巢结构、基质物种或产卵高度。幼体生境码不能自动作为成体生境偏好。汇编记录未新确立窝卵数、卵大小、亲代看护、产卵季节或后代存活。
morphology
Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits
汇编长度保留推断及测量限制

The row does not carry a head-width or tibia-length inference flag. That absence is not an independent audit establishing how each original value was measured. Body length, head width and tibia length are retained numerically in the row-level evidence snapshot. The Methods use means when available and otherwise maxima, while the workbook length headers do not explicitly state units and do not consistently identify sex or stage. These cells are therefore not presented as new diagnostic millimetre measurements, a sex-specific range or measured species-wide variation. Upstream reference entries are preserved, but their original measurements have not been independently checked.
该行没有头宽或胫长推断标记，但无标记不等于独立审核并确立每个原值如何测得。体长、头宽及胫长数值保存在行级证据快照。方法有均值则用均值，否则用最大值；工作簿长度表头未明确单位，也未逐行一致标明性别或阶段。因此不把单元格作为新诊断毫米测量、性别专属范围或测得全物种变异。上游参考条目已保留，但原测量未独立检查。
title: Direct development in Atlantic Forest anurans: What can environmental and biotic influences explain about its evolution and occurrence?
