来源编码的发育方式与产卵环境

The Atlantic Forest trait compilation codes Pleurodema alium as having larval development and its oviposition as aquatic. A larval-development code does not specify larval duration, all larval habitats or the degree of dependence on standing water; those require additional evidence. These are literature-compiled categories, not newly observed spawning or a developmental experiment for this species. Exact correspondence between the source taxonomy and the current accepted concept remains uncertified.
大西洋森林性状汇编将 Pleurodema alium 编为有幼体阶段发育，产卵环境为水生。幼体阶段发育码未规定幼体时长、全部幼体生境或对静水的依赖程度，须另有证据。这是文献汇编类别，不是本种新观察产卵或发育实验。来源分类与当前接受概念的准确对应仍未认证。
ecology
Juvenile habitat and egg-site categories have defined scope
幼体生境及卵位点类别有明确范围

The same row codes juvenile habitat as aquatic and marks bubble nests on still water; foam nests among the seven oviposition-site categories. More than one positive site category is retained rather than forcing a single reproductive mode. A juvenile-habitat code is not automatically an adult habitat preference. The compiled record does not newly establish clutch size, egg dimensions, parental attendance, spawning season or offspring survival.
同一行将幼体生境编为水生，七个产卵位点类别中标记静水气泡巢；泡沫巢。保留多个阳性位点类别，不强制合成唯一繁殖方式。幼体生境码不能自动作为成体生境偏好。汇编记录未新确立窝卵数、卵大小、亲代看护、产卵季节或后代存活。
morphology
Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits
汇编长度保留推断及测量限制

The row does not carry a head-width or tibia-length inference flag. That absence is not an independent audit establishing how each original value was measured. Body length, head width and tibia length are retained numerically in the row-level evidence snapshot. The Methods use means when available and otherwise maxima, while the workbook length headers do not explicitly state units and do not consistently identify sex or stage. These cells are therefore not presented as new diagnostic millimetre measurements, a sex-specific range or measured species-wide variation. Upstream reference entries are preserved, but their original measurements have not been independently checked.
该行没有头宽或胫长推断标记，但无标记不等于独立审核并确立每个原值如何测得。体长、头宽及胫长数值保存在行级证据快照。方法有均值则用均值，否则用最大值；工作簿长度表头未明确单位，也未逐行一致标明性别或阶段。因此不把单元格作为新诊断毫米测量、性别专属范围或测得全物种变异。上游参考条目已保留，但原测量未独立检查。
title: Direct development in Atlantic Forest anurans: What can environmental and biotic influences explain about its evolution and occurrence?

Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits

The 2023 Atlantic Forest workbook lists Rhinella abei as having larval development, with aquatic oviposition. Workbook record Rhinella abei: juvenile habitat and egg sites

For the source name Rhinella abei, juvenile habitat is coded aquatic. Positive egg-site flags indicate eggs directly in water or on submerged substrate. Every positive category is retained, including multiple categories where present. Juvenile habitat is not an adult preference, and terrestrial oviposition is distinct from direct development. These broad categories do not establish clutch size, seasonal breeding, parental attendance, nest dimensions or offspring survival. Original references are indexed in the archived row; those upstream studies have not all been independently read.

Workbook record Rhinella abei: inference and length limits
工作簿记录 Rhinella abei：推断及长度限制

Rhinella abei carries explicit inference flags for head width and tibia length in the workbook. The flagged cells are phylogenetically inferred estimates, not new measurements of specimens. Numeric body/head/tibia cells remain in the evidence snapshot. Methods combine available means with otherwise maxima, while length headers do not explicitly state units and rows do not uniformly specify sex or developmental stage. Consequently these values are not restated as diagnostic millimetre ranges or measured population variation. Mapping a historical name does not resolve those measurement limitations.

taxonomy
Workbook record Rhinella abei: an explicit frozen catalogue accepted-link
工作簿记录 Rhinella abei：明确冻结目录接受名链接

COL26.8 dataset 316115 records exact name Rhinella abei as usage 4S7M2, with an explicit accepted-link to Rhinella ornata, ID 4S7PB. The archived query is used for that nomenclatural relation, not as certification that the 2023 authors applied precisely the same biological concept. Misidentifications, later splits and specimen assignments require original evidence. Historical rows sharing one accepted destination retain separate source labels and trait statements; counts of workbook rows are therefore not necessarily counts of distinct accepted species.

来源编码的发育方式与产卵环境

The Atlantic Forest trait compilation codes Vitreorana eurygnatha as having larval development and its oviposition as terrestrial. A larval-development code does not specify larval duration, all larval habitats or the degree of dependence on standing water; those require additional evidence. These are literature-compiled categories, not newly observed spawning or a developmental experiment for this species. Exact correspondence between the source taxonomy and the current accepted concept remains uncertified.
大西洋森林性状汇编将 Vitreorana eurygnatha 编为有幼体阶段发育，产卵环境为陆生。幼体阶段发育码未规定幼体时长、全部幼体生境或对静水的依赖程度，须另有证据。这是文献汇编类别，不是本种新观察产卵或发育实验。来源分类与当前接受概念的准确对应仍未认证。
ecology
Juvenile habitat and egg-site categories have defined scope
幼体生境及卵位点类别有明确范围

The same row codes juvenile habitat as aquatic and marks arboreal eggs attached to plants among the seven oviposition-site categories. The positive category summarizes a broad trait; it does not establish a specific nest architecture, substrate species or oviposition height. A juvenile-habitat code is not automatically an adult habitat preference. The compiled record does not newly establish clutch size, egg dimensions, parental attendance, spawning season or offspring survival.
同一行将幼体生境编为水生，七个产卵位点类别中标记树栖卵附着植物。阳性类别概括广义性状，未确立特定巢结构、基质物种或产卵高度。幼体生境码不能自动作为成体生境偏好。汇编记录未新确立窝卵数、卵大小、亲代看护、产卵季节或后代存活。
morphology
Compiled lengths retain inference and measurement limits
汇编长度保留推断及测量限制

The row explicitly marks head width and tibia length as inferred, not an observed measurement from a new specimen. The article fills missing traits with a phylogenetic maximum-likelihood procedure; across the full pool, 139 head widths and 146 tibia lengths were inferred. Body length, head width and tibia length are retained numerically in the row-level evidence snapshot. The Methods use means when available and otherwise maxima, while the workbook length headers do not explicitly state units and do not consistently identify sex or stage. These cells are therefore not presented as new diagnostic millimetre measurements, a sex-specific range or measured species-wide variation. Upstream reference entries are preserved, but their original measurements have not been independently checked.
该行明确标注头宽、胫长为推断值，不是新标本观察测量。论文以系统发育最大似然过程补缺；全部物种池中推断头宽 139 个、胫长 146 个。体长、头宽及胫长数值保存在行级证据快照。方法有均值则用均值，否则用最大值；工作簿长度表头未明确单位，也未逐行一致标明性别或阶段。因此不把单元格作为新诊断毫米测量、性别专属范围或测得全物种变异。上游参考条目已保留，但原测量未独立检查。
title: Direct development in Atlantic Forest anurans: What can environmental and biotic influences explain about its evolution and occurrence?

readScope: Nanorana quadranus: XML Methods2.1–2.6, Results3.1–3.5, Discussion4.1–4.4 and Conclusions read; supplementary TablesS1–S8, raw histology, sperm images, environmental rasters, model code and upstream comparative studies not independently examined; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
name: Nanorana quadranus
sourceConcept: 2025 source-labelled quadranus regional breeding-season sample, not a certified range-wide taxonomic audit
sections: occurrence
A regional breeding-season sample with distinct analysis subsets
具有不同分析子集的区域繁殖季样本

The study collected 266 Nanorana quadranus in the 2020 and 2021 breeding seasons at 13 sites in mountainous Sichuan, Chongqing, Shaanxi and Gansu, spanning sampled elevations of 586–1,702 m. There were 134 males and 132 females overall, but the testis Methods specify 133 dissected males, sperm-characterization Methods a subset of 56, male analyses ten populations, and female analyses twelve. Those denominators are kept separate. The sampled elevational interval is not the species’ complete range or physiological tolerance, and the field sex counts do not establish an unbiased wild population sex ratio.
研究在 2020、2021 年繁殖季于四川、重庆、陕西及甘肃山地十三地采集 266 只 Nanorana quadranus，取样海拔 586–1,702 米。总体雄性 134、雌性 132，但睾丸方法指定 133 只解剖雄性，精子表征子集 56 只，雄性分析十个种群、雌性十二个。分别保留这些分母。取样海拔区间不是完整分布或生理耐受，现场雌雄计数也未确立无偏野外性比。
methods
Age estimates come from growth lines rather than known birth dates
年龄估计来自生长停滞线而非已知出生日期

All 266 sampled frogs had distinguishable lines of arrested growth in toe-bone sections. The authors describe checks for resorption, double lines and false lines, and cite validation using four marked–recaptured individuals. This supports their age-estimation procedure but is not an independently reconstructed known-age dataset for the current sample. Cross-sectional body-size-versus-age regressions compare frogs of different estimated ages; their slopes are not longitudinal growth trajectories or maximum lifespan estimates.
全部 266 个取样蛙趾骨切片有可区分生长停滞线。作者描述检查重吸收、双线及假线，并引用四只标记重捕个体的验证。它支持作者估龄过程，不是为当前样本独立重建的已知年龄数据。横断面体型与年龄回归比较估计年龄不同的蛙；斜率不是纵向生长轨迹或最大寿命估计。
morphology
The female-biased size contrast is sample-specific
雌性较大体型对比限于该样本

Females had a higher median body mass and longer median snout–vent length than males, with reported p values below 0.001. Their age distributions overlapped with similar medians but females showed greater dispersion. The reported body-length/age slopes were 6.4 for males and 5.25 for females, both significant in the authors’ regression. These differences do not prove fecundity-driven selection, longer female lifespan or a directly measured growth–reproduction trade-off. Individual size ranges and the raw age distributions were not independently checked.
雌性体重中位数较高、吻肛长中位数较长，所报 p 均小于 0.001。雌雄年龄分布重叠、中位数相似，雌性离散更大。作者体长／年龄回归斜率雄性 6.4、雌性 5.25，均显著。差异未证明繁殖力驱动选择、雌性寿命更长或直接测得生长繁殖权衡。个体大小范围及原年龄分布未独立检查。
ecology
Relative testis size varies without establishing mating success
相对睾丸大小变化未确立交配成功

The authors report differences in relative testis size among ten sampled populations, persisting after age and body-length adjustment, and a positive latitude association (r = 0.350, p < 0.001). Wangcang, Wanyuan and Nanjiang are among the populations described as relatively larger. Population identity in an observational model is not an experimentally established driver, and enlarged testes do not directly measure sperm competition, fertilization success or greater energy allocation. The Discussion’s comparative ranking against other amphibians is cited context, not a new standardized survey of more than 130 species.
作者报告十个取样种群相对睾丸大小有差异，调整年龄及体长后仍存在，与纬度正关联（r = 0.350，p < 0.001）。旺苍、万源、南江列于相对较大种群。观察模型中的种群身份不是实验确立驱动因子；较大睾丸也未直接测量精子竞争、受精成功或较多能量分配。讨论与其他两栖类的排序为被引背景，不是对超过 130 种的新标准化调查。
methods
Asymmetry results require both the omnibus and pairwise findings
不对称结果须同时保留整体与成对发现

Paired tests found no significant left–right size difference within the analysed populations, and the omnibus absolute and relative asymmetry tests were nonsignificant (p = 0.195 and 0.180). Nevertheless, LSD comparisons describe greater asymmetry in the 1,518 m population, with 14 frogs, than some other groups. These findings do not establish perfect anatomical symmetry throughout the species. A pairwise exception after nonsignificant overall tests requires caution; the proposed plasticity or developmental-noise explanations were not experimentally distinguished here.
所分析种群成对检验未发现显著左右大小差，整体绝对、相对不对称检验亦不显著（p = 0.195、0.180）。然而 LSD 比较描述海拔 1,518 米、十四只蛙的种群比部分其他组更不对称。结果不能确立全物种完美解剖对称。整体不显著之后的成对例外须谨慎，拟议可塑性与发育噪声未在此实验区分。
morphology
Sperm dimensions are population means from prepared slides
精子尺寸是制片所得种群均值

The reported mean head lengths across the sampled populations range from 27.67 to 55.8 μm, mean tails from 51.1 to 102.61 μm, and total mean sizes from 79.57 to 158.42 μm. The Methods use a subset of 56 males, twenty intact sperm per sample measured in triplicate, after drying, fixation and staining. These intervals concern reported population means, not the full individual-cell range or live sperm speed. A positive sperm-length/testis-size association does not establish a competitive advantage, flagellar performance against stream flow or greater fertilization success.
所报取样种群精子头长均值范围 27.67–55.8 微米、尾长均值 51.1–102.61 微米、总长均值 79.57–158.42 微米。方法使用 56 只雄性子集，每样本二十条完整精子，经干燥、固定、染色后各测三次。区间是所报种群均值，不是全部个体细胞范围或活精子速度。精子长度与睾丸大小正关联不能确立竞争优势、逆溪流鞭毛性能或更高受精成功。
ecology
Adjusted sperm-count results differ from unadjusted comparisons
调整精子数结果区别于未调整比较

Sperm counts differed among populations in the unadjusted analysis, but not after adjusting for body size, age and testis size (reported p = 0.170). The latitude trend was weak and nonsignificant; the Discussion’s interpretation that northern populations prioritize quantity is therefore a hypothesis. Nonsignificance of the sperm-count/length association does not prove that an evolutionary trade-off is absent. The article reports differing analytical degrees of freedom, and the original supplementary rows have not been reconciled to certify the count-analysis denominator or the suspension-based total-count calculation.
未调整分析中种群精子数不同，但调整体型、年龄及睾丸大小后不显著（所报 p = 0.170）。纬度趋势弱且不显著，因此讨论称较北种群优先数量是提议。精子数与长度关联不显著不能证明无进化权衡。论文所报分析自由度不同，原补充行未核对，不能认证精子计数分析分母或悬液总数计算。
ecology
Ovarian ova estimates do not equal successfully laid clutches
卵巢卵估计不等于成功产出的卵窝

The researchers dissected 132 females from twelve populations, counted mature ova in a weighed portion of an ovary and extrapolated to total reproductive output. The Methods also describe absolute investment as total egg volume, while later sections use fecundity and fertility terminology. These related endpoints are retained without equating count, mass and volume. Population differences became nonsignificant after body size, mass and age adjustment, while female mass was positively associated with output (reported r = 0.664). Neither ova estimates nor body-mass correlations establish eggs laid, fertilization, hatch success or experimentally measured energy reserves.
研究者解剖十二种群 132 只雌性，计数称重卵巢部分的成熟卵，外推总繁殖输出。方法另以总卵体积描述绝对投入，后续使用繁殖力、fertility 等术语。保留相关终点，不把计数、质量、体积等同。调整体型、体重及年龄后种群差异不显著，雌性体重与输出正关联（所报 r = 0.664）。卵估计及体重相关均不能确立产出卵数、受精、孵化成功或实验测得能量储备。
ecology
Environmental models leave much reproductive variation unexplained
环境模型仍有许多繁殖变异未解释

The Results report models explaining 34.7% of relative-testis variation, 31.5% of sperm-size variation and 10% of female output variation. The sperm-size Discussion instead states 35%, and its selected predictor lists also differ from those in the Results. These inconsistencies are not silently resolved without the supplementary models. Climate rasters and site covariates establish associations under the authors’ selection procedure, not genetic adaptation, causal rainfall or temperature effects, or a measured reproductive threshold. Sexual selection, resource allocation, sperm motility and mating success were not directly tested.
结果报告模型解释相对睾丸变异 34.7%、精子大小变异 31.5%、雌性输出变异 10%。精子大小讨论却为 35%，所选预测因子列表亦与结果不同。未有补充模型时不擅自解决不一致。气候栅格及地点协变量在作者筛选过程下建立关联，不是遗传适应、降雨温度因果作用或测得繁殖阈值。性选择、资源分配、精子运动及交配成功未直接检验。
ecology
Population-sensitive management is a proposed application
考虑种群差异的管理是拟议应用

The authors recommend protecting habitat mosaics and monitoring reproduction under climate change. Their Near Threatened wording is dated to the 2025 article, not a newly verified official assessment. Smaller versus larger egg strategies and delayed maturation are discussed as interpretations and comparisons; egg-size trade-offs and individual maturation schedules were not resolved by this study. The observations do not certify a climate projection, improved management outcome or future survival of every population.
作者建议保护生境镶嵌并在气候变化下监测繁殖。近危措辞属于 2025 年论文，不是新核实官方评估。大小卵策略及延迟成熟作为解释、比较讨论，本研究未解决卵大小权衡或个体成熟日程。观察不能认证气候预测、管理改善结果或每个种群未来存活。

readScope: Bufo andrewsi: XML Methods Sampling/Environmental/Clutch/Age/Growth/Statistics, Results including Table1 and figure captions, Discussion and Conclusions read; original AppendicesS1/S2, individual LAG sections, clutch photographs, meteorological series and model calculations not independently analysed; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
name: Bufo andrewsi
sourceConcept: 2016 source-labelled andrewsi Hengduan reproductive populations; exact pinned name, not certified cross-revision biological identity
sections: occurrence
A multi-year sample of adults at reproductive sites
繁殖地点的跨年成年样本

The study reports 1,824 Bufo andrewsi from seventeen Hengduan Mountain populations in western China, sampled between 2007 and 2013: 1,346 males and 478 females. Toads were hand-captured on land at night while searching for mates or in amplexus, then released after measurement and toe sampling. The sample therefore concerns reproductively active adults under that capture method, not juveniles or a complete population census. Marking of all released animals is not documented, so the stated individual total is not independently certified as distinct animals across years. Source-name agreement does not certify correspondence across later taxonomic revisions.
研究报告 2007–2013 年中国西部横断山区十七种群的 1,824 个 Bufo andrewsi，雄性 1,346、雌性 478。动物夜间在陆上寻偶或抱对时手捕，测量及趾取样后放归。因此样本是该捕法下繁殖活跃成年体，不包含幼体或完整种群普查。全部放归动物的标记未有记录，所述个体总数未独立认证为跨年不同动物。来源名字一致也不认证后来分类修订间的概念对应。
methods
The inferred growth season uses an unpublished activity threshold
推定生长季使用未发表活动阈值

Growth-season length is defined as the annual number of days with mean ambient temperature above 6 °C, using meteorological data for 2007–2013. The threshold is based on unpublished field observations, and the authors assume this approximates the activity period. Southern Yunnan populations are described as active from early February to early December, versus early May to mid-October in northern Sichuan, with roughly 150 days between the longest and shortest site estimates. These are regional estimates under that definition, not experimentally established thermal tolerance, a uniform emergence temperature or a verified individual activity diary.
生长季定义为 2007–2013 年气象资料中年日均环境温度超过 6 摄氏度的天数。阈值基于未发表野外观察，作者假定近似活动期。云南较南种群描述为二月初至十二月初活动，四川较北为五月初至十月中；最长最短地点估计约差一百五十天。这是在该定义下的区域估计，不是实验热耐受、一致出蛰温度或核实个体活动日志。
ecology
Laid eggs were measured after local laboratory spawning
实际产卵在地方实验室产出后测量

Amplectant toads from ten populations were taken to nearby laboratories in 2008–2013, kept separately as pairs in pond-water tanks, and allowed to spawn. The Methods give 208 amplectant toads but do not independently establish here whether that number denotes animals, pairs or complete analysed clutches. Researchers counted eggs in each laid clutch and photographed 100 randomly selected eggs per clutch to measure diameter excluding jelly, then returned animals and egg strings to collection sites. This is evidence from tank-spawned clutches, not an ovarian-count extrapolation, field clutch-success survey or hatching experiment.
2008–2013 年十个种群的抱对蟾蜍移至附近实验室，按配对分置池水缸并允许产卵。方法给出 208 个抱对蟾蜍，但这里未独立确立该数字指动物、配对还是完整分析卵窝。研究者计数每个产出卵窝，并随机取每窝一百卵拍照，测不含胶膜的直径，再放归动物及卵串。这是缸内产出卵窝证据，不是卵巢计数外推、野外卵窝成功调查或孵化实验。
ecology
Egg size and egg number show an observational trade-off
卵大小与数量显示观察性权衡

The Results and Discussion describe larger eggs and smaller clutches in populations with shorter estimated growth seasons, with female size and geographic covariates considered. Clutch size is positively associated with female size and negatively with egg size; one population, YL, departs from the broad pattern. These associations do not directly measure a fixed energy budget, yolk content, offspring fitness or food limitation. The proposed advantages of larger eggs in cold conditions are interpretations, and the original model outputs and local breeding-water temperatures were not independently examined.
结果及讨论描述估计生长季较短种群卵较大、窝卵数较小，考虑雌性大小及地理协变量。窝卵数与雌性大小正关联、卵大小负关联，YL 一个种群偏离广泛模式。关联未直接测量固定能量预算、卵黄量、后代适合度或食物限制。寒冷条件下较大卵的优势是解释，原模型输出及地方繁殖水温未独立检查。
methods
Estimated age has a smaller sample than body-size sampling
估龄样本小于体型取样样本

The researchers determined LAG-based ages for 1,563 toads, including 1,166 males and 397 females, rather than all 1,824 captured records. They describe resorption checks and differentiation of double and false lines, citing prior validation using four marked–recaptured animals. Known birth dates and the raw bone sections were not independently reconstructed. The youngest and oldest sampled breeding adults are used as proxies for first reproduction and longevity; they are not direct observations of each individual’s first breeding or proof of the species’ maximum lifespan.
研究者为 1,563 个蟾蜍取得生长停滞线年龄，包括雄性 1,166、雌性 397，而非全部 1,824 个捕获记录。论文描述重吸收检查及双线假线区分，引用此前四只标记重捕动物验证。已知出生日期及原骨切片未独立重建。最年轻、最老取样繁殖成年体作为初繁年龄及寿命代理，不是各个体首次繁殖直接观察或物种最大寿命证明。
ecology
Age contrasts concern sampled breeding populations
年龄对比针对取样繁殖种群

Minimum, mean and maximum sampled ages increase as estimated growth seasons shorten, and females have higher ages than males in these comparisons. The Discussion gives earlier reproduction proxies of 1–2 years and mean reproductive age 5.1 years for some long-season populations, versus 3–4 and 7.1 years in some short-season populations. These values describe the source’s sampled groups, not universal maturation ages for every andrewsi. Predation risk, food availability and temperature-dependent metabolism are proposed explanations rather than measured demographic mechanisms in this study.
估计生长季越短，取样最小、平均及最大年龄越高，雌性在比较中年龄较高。讨论给部分长季种群较早初繁代理 1–2 岁、平均繁殖年龄 5.1 岁，部分短季则 3–4 岁及 7.1 岁。数值描述来源取样组，不是每个 andrewsi 普遍成熟年龄。捕食风险、食物可用性及温度相关代谢为提议解释，不是本研究测得人口学机制。
methods
Lifetime activity is a calculated proxy, not tracked life duration
终生活动量是计算代理，不是追踪生命时长

The study defines lifetime activity as estimated age in years multiplied by annual growth-season days. The resulting proxy is higher in females and does not significantly vary with season length, latitude or altitude in the source model. It assumes the estimated annual season represents the animal’s life history, without measuring year-by-year activity or actual lifetime exposure. Its relationship with age also follows from the formula, so it cannot independently establish longevity or the energetic cause of body-size variation.
研究将终生活动量定义为估计年龄年数乘年生长季天数。代理在雌性较高，在来源模型中未随季长、纬度或海拔显著变化。计算假定估计年季代表动物生活史，未测逐年活动或实际终生暴露。与年龄的关系也来自公式，不能独立确立寿命或体型变异能量原因。
morphology
Body size is associated with age and sex rather than a simple geographic cline
体型关联年龄性别而非简单地理梯度

Body length is measured as snout–vent length in millimetres. The study reports sex and age effects on adult size, but no significant prediction from growth-season length, altitude or latitude after adjustment. This is a conditional result in the sampled adults, not proof that temperature never affects body size or that populations are identical. The source does not supply a newly audited complete size range, and the absence of a simple cline does not certify a universal Bergmann rule or its reverse.
体长按毫米吻肛长测量。研究报告性别、年龄影响成年大小，调整后生长季长、海拔或纬度预测不显著。这是取样成年体中的条件结果，不是温度永不影响体型或种群相同的证明。来源未提供新审核完整大小范围；简单梯度缺失不能认证普遍伯格曼规律或反规律。
methods
Growth is fitted from age and size, with conflicting directional summaries
生长由年龄体型拟合，方向概要有冲突

Growth parameters are fitted with a von Bertalanffy size-at-age model, rather than longitudinally measured for every toad. Results say male growth rises and female growth tends to fall as growth seasons shorten; Discussion instead emphasizes relatively faster female growth in short seasons and faster males in long seasons, with further allocation statements that are not consistently aligned. These summaries remain unresolved without the fitted data and parameters. They do not establish a directly measured reproductive-energy trade-off or genetically determined growth adaptation.
生长参数用 von Bertalanffy 年龄体型模型拟合，不是逐只纵向测量。结果称季节缩短时雄性生长升、雌性趋降；讨论则强调短季雌性相对较快、长季雄性较快，后续分配陈述也未一致对齐。未有拟合数据参数时保留概要未解决，不能确立直接测得繁殖能量权衡或遗传决定生长适应。
methods
The conclusion’s mean-age direction conflicts with the Results
结论平均年龄方向与结果冲突

The final Conclusion says longer activity periods have a larger mean age, whereas Results and Discussion describe lower mean age in long-season populations. The Results text also prints a growth-season/clutch-size F value of 4.474 while Table 1 prints 4.046. These discrepancies are not silently corrected or treated as independently reproduced statistics. Geographic variation may involve plasticity and genetic differences; the authors explicitly call for common-garden work, so the field associations do not separate those explanations.
最后结论称较长活动期平均年龄更大，结果及讨论却描述长季种群平均年龄较低。结果正文另印季长与窝卵数 F 为 4.474，表 1 为 4.046。不擅自修正这些差异或视为独立复现统计。地理变异可涉及可塑性及遗传差异，作者明确提出同园研究，因此野外关联不能区分解释。

Soil-cave and highland categories are broad labels, not confirmed burrowing physiology or precise elevations. The paper does not provide individual-level abundance or stage-specific breeding observations for every row. Regional gradients and survey gains do not certify recovery

Table 2 of the 2026 paper attributes 9 records to source-labelled Ameerega parvula in Fátima parish, Pastaza, Ecuador, during September 2013–September 2018. Counts are cumulative records, not an independently certified number of distinct marked animals, population density or a current abundance estimate. Surveys combine daytime/night-time visual and photographic encounters, ten 8 × 8 m quadrats, four 100 × 20 m transects and fifty pitfall traps across six habitats. The site description’s 900–1,100 m gradient and later 2025 weather-summary temperature are not this species’ measured elevation limits or thermal tolerance. Province-wide occurrence and all source identifications have not been independently certified.

2026 年论文表二将厄瓜多尔 Pastaza 的 Fátima 教区 2013 年九月至 2018 年九月期间 9 个记录归于来源名称 Ameerega parvula。计数为累计记录，不是独立认证不同标记动物数、种群密度或当前丰度估计。调查结合昼夜目视、照片遇见，十个八乘八米样方、四条一百乘二十米样线及五十个陷阱，跨六类生境。地点描述九百至一千一百米梯度及较晚 2025 年天气摘要温度不是本种测得海拔限或热耐受。全省出现及全部来源鉴定未独立认证。

Discussion mentions threatened Atelopus and Hyloscirtus in general, while the individual rows for spumarius and phyllognathus are LC; genus-level wording does not override those printed assignments or establish local decline.

methods
Coverage and community turnover do not prove a species trend
覆盖及群落更替不证明物种趋势

sections: morphology
A larval image record with explicit provenance
具有明确来源的幼体图像记录

The 2024 paired-stage shape study includes Alsodes barrioi. Table S1 records its tadpole source as “Photo”, meaning photographs of biological material, and retains the voucher field “FML 04698.1; FML 04594”. A dash denotes no voucher listed in this table, not proof that no specimen ever existed. Across the study, 112 tadpole photographs/drawings represent 83 species, with one or two images per species and Gosner stages 26–41. Thirty-two landmarks were digitized by one person, tail curvature was digitally corrected for fixation artifacts, and species mean shapes were used. This row does not specify each specimen’s exact stage, and the images are not new live developmental trajectories or an independently checked species diagnosis.

2024 年成体与幼体配对形态研究包含 Alsodes barrioi。表 S1 记其蝌蚪来源为“Photo”，即生物材料照片，保留凭证栏“FML 04698.1; FML 04594”。横杠表示本表未列凭证，不证明从无标本。全研究一百一十二幅蝌蚪照片/绘图代表八十三种，每种一或两幅，Gosner 阶段二十六至四十一。由一人数字化三十二地标，针对固定伪影数字纠正尾弯曲，采用物种平均形状。该行未指定每件标本精确阶段；图像不是新活体发育轨迹或独立核实种诊断。
morphology
Adult measurements preserve source type and sex limits
成体测量保留来源类型及性别限制

For Alsodes barrioi, the adult-source field is “ImageJ, figure”: ImageJ measurements from published figures. Its voucher field is “-” and sex field “?” (sex unspecified). This describes the adult record used in the compilation, not a population sex ratio or demonstrated sexual dimorphism. The study selects ten linear measurements, chiefly from male dorsal/lateral images or earlier descriptions, and uses PCA-based imputation for missing values; Table S1 does not flag every imputed cell. Log-shape ratios correct linear measurements other than snout–vent length by their geometric mean. Those values describe image/literature-derived external proportions rather than live performance, internal anatomy or a new sex-specific size range.

对于 Alsodes barrioi，成体来源栏为“ImageJ, figure”，即发表图中的 ImageJ 测量。凭证栏“-”、性别栏“?”（性别未指定）。这描述汇编使用成体记录，不是种群性比或已证实性二型。研究选十个线性测量，主要从雄性背/侧图或早期描述取得，以 PCA 补缺；表 S1 未标出每个填补单元格。对数形状比以几何均值校正吻肛长之外线性测量。值描述图像/文献外部比例，不是活体性能、内部解剖或新性别专属体型范围。
ecology
Larval guild and adult ecomorph are separate source categories
幼体功能群及成体生态型是分开来源类别

The row codes Alsodes barrioi as larval LO (lotic) and adult TER (terrestrial). The two stages are retained separately; the adult code cannot be assigned automatically to tadpoles, or the reverse. Lentic/lotic and torrential labels summarize broad habitat associations rather than quantified flow tolerance, while saxicolous or terrestrial codes do not define an entire geographic range. An endotrophic tadpole category is distinct from direct development and does not remove the larval stage. The authors compiled functional assignments from species accounts rather than experimentally measuring every species’ feeding, hydrodynamics, locomotion or habitat choice.
该行将 Alsodes barrioi 编为幼体 LO（流水）、成体 TER（陆生）。分开保留两个阶段，成体码不能自动用于蝌蚪，反之亦然。静水/流水及急流标签概括广义生境关联，不是量化流速耐受；岩栖或陆生码不定义完整地理分布。内营养蝌蚪类别区别于直接发育，不能消除幼体阶段。作者从物种叙述汇编功能分配，不是实验测每种摄食、流体力学、运动或生境选择。
evolution
Paired-stage comparisons do not establish complete developmental independence
配对阶段比较不确立完全发育独立

Across the sampled species, larval–adult shape dissimilarities show a weak but significant Mantel association (r 0.16, p 0.003), while disparity correlations differ among families. The authors interpret the overall pattern as support for adaptive decoupling; it does not demonstrate zero correlation, genetic independence, an experimentally selected trait or this species’ developmental trajectory. Phylogenetic analyses use 74 of the 83 sampled species, and ancestral shape/time patterns are model reconstructions from extant data rather than newly measured fossil morphology. Adult K 0.44 with p 0.001 describes less close-relative similarity than the reference expectation; the paper’s “not phylogenetically structured” wording cannot mean that the test is nonsignificant. Supplement S3 repeats family N values summing to 112 for both stages, so adult individual denominators and imputed cells remain uncertified without raw matrices.

所采物种间，幼体—成体形状不相似性有弱但显著 Mantel 关联（r 0.16、p 0.003），差异度关联随科而异。作者把总体模式解释为支持适应性解耦，不证明零相关、遗传独立、实验选择性状或本种发育轨迹。系统发育分析使用八十三取样种中七十四种，祖先形状/时间模式是从现存资料模型重建，不是新测化石形态。成体 K 0.44、p 0.001 描述近亲相似性低于参考期望；论文“无系统发育结构”措辞不能意味着检验不显著。补充 S3 在两个阶段重复合计一百一十二的逐科 N 值，未有原矩阵时成体个体分母及填补单元格仍未认证。

sections: morphology
A larval image record with explicit provenance
具有明确来源的幼体图像记录

The 2024 paired-stage shape study includes Alsodes coppingeri. Table S1 records its tadpole source as “Literature”, meaning literature images, and retains the voucher field “-”. A dash denotes no voucher listed in this table, not proof that no specimen ever existed. Across the study, 112 tadpole photographs/drawings represent 83 species, with one or two images per species and Gosner stages 26–41. Thirty-two landmarks were digitized by one person, tail curvature was digitally corrected for fixation artifacts, and species mean shapes were used. This row does not specify each specimen’s exact stage, and the images are not new live developmental trajectories or an independently checked species diagnosis.

2024 年成体与幼体配对形态研究包含 Alsodes coppingeri。表 S1 记其蝌蚪来源为“Literature”，即文献图像，保留凭证栏“-”。横杠表示本表未列凭证，不证明从无标本。全研究一百一十二幅蝌蚪照片/绘图代表八十三种，每种一或两幅，Gosner 阶段二十六至四十一。由一人数字化三十二地标，针对固定伪影数字纠正尾弯曲，采用物种平均形状。该行未指定每件标本精确阶段；图像不是新活体发育轨迹或独立核实种诊断。
morphology
Adult measurements preserve source type and sex limits
成体测量保留来源类型及性别限制

For Alsodes coppingeri, the adult-source field is “ImageJ”: image-based measurements of the listed study material. Its voucher field is “LGE25458” and sex field “M” (male). This describes the adult record used in the compilation, not a population sex ratio or demonstrated sexual dimorphism. The study selects ten linear measurements, chiefly from male dorsal/lateral images or earlier descriptions, and uses PCA-based imputation for missing values; Table S1 does not flag every imputed cell. Log-shape ratios correct linear measurements other than snout–vent length by their geometric mean. Those values describe image/literature-derived external proportions rather than live performance, internal anatomy or a new sex-specific size range.

对于 Alsodes coppingeri，成体来源栏为“ImageJ”，即所列研究材料的图像测量。凭证栏“LGE25458”、性别栏“M”（雄性）。这描述汇编使用成体记录，不是种群性比或已证实性二型。研究选十个线性测量，主要从雄性背/侧图或早期描述取得，以 PCA 补缺；表 S1 未标出每个填补单元格。对数形状比以几何均值校正吻肛长之外线性测量。值描述图像/文献外部比例，不是活体性能、内部解剖或新性别专属体型范围。
ecology
Larval guild and adult ecomorph are separate source categories
幼体功能群及成体生态型是分开来源类别

The row codes Alsodes coppingeri as larval LO (lotic) and adult TER (terrestrial). The two stages are retained separately; the adult code cannot be assigned automatically to tadpoles, or the reverse. Lentic/lotic and torrential labels summarize broad habitat associations rather than quantified flow tolerance, while saxicolous or terrestrial codes do not define an entire geographic range. An endotrophic tadpole category is distinct from direct development and does not remove the larval stage. The authors compiled functional assignments from species accounts rather than experimentally measuring every species’ feeding, hydrodynamics, locomotion or habitat choice.
该行将 Alsodes coppingeri 编为幼体 LO（流水）、成体 TER（陆生）。分开保留两个阶段，成体码不能自动用于蝌蚪，反之亦然。静水/流水及急流标签概括广义生境关联，不是量化流速耐受；岩栖或陆生码不定义完整地理分布。内营养蝌蚪类别区别于直接发育，不能消除幼体阶段。作者从物种叙述汇编功能分配，不是实验测每种摄食、流体力学、运动或生境选择。
evolution
Paired-stage comparisons do not establish complete developmental independence
配对阶段比较不确立完全发育独立

Across the sampled species, larval–adult shape dissimilarities show a weak but significant Mantel association (r 0.16, p 0.003), while disparity correlations differ among families. The authors interpret the overall pattern as support for adaptive decoupling; it does not demonstrate zero correlation, genetic independence, an experimentally selected trait or this species’ developmental trajectory. Phylogenetic analyses use 74 of the 83 sampled species, and ancestral shape/time patterns are model reconstructions from extant data rather than newly measured fossil morphology. Adult K 0.44 with p 0.001 describes less close-relative similarity than the reference expectation; the paper’s “not phylogenetically structured” wording cannot mean that the test is nonsignificant. Supplement S3 repeats family N values summing to 112 for both stages, so adult individual denominators and imputed cells remain uncertified without raw matrices.

所采物种间，幼体—成体形状不相似性有弱但显著 Mantel 关联（r 0.16、p 0.003），差异度关联随科而异。作者把总体模式解释为支持适应性解耦，不证明零相关、遗传独立、实验选择性状或本种发育轨迹。系统发育分析使用八十三取样种中七十四种，祖先形状/时间模式是从现存资料模型重建，不是新测化石形态。成体 K 0.44、p 0.001 描述近亲相似性低于参考期望；论文“无系统发育结构”措辞不能意味着检验不显著。补充 S3 在两个阶段重复合计一百一十二的逐科 N 值，未有原矩阵时成体个体分母及填补单元格仍未认证。
title: Shape Evolution in Two Acts: Morphological Diversity of Larval and Adult Neoaustraranan Frogs

sections: morphology
A larval image record with explicit provenance
具有明确来源的幼体图像记录

The 2024 paired-stage shape study includes Batrachyla taeniata. Table S1 records its tadpole source as “Literature”, meaning literature images, and retains the voucher field “-”. A dash denotes no voucher listed in this table, not proof that no specimen ever existed. Across the study, 112 tadpole photographs/drawings represent 83 species, with one or two images per species and Gosner stages 26–41. Thirty-two landmarks were digitized by one person, tail curvature was digitally corrected for fixation artifacts, and species mean shapes were used. This row does not specify each specimen’s exact stage, and the images are not new live developmental trajectories or an independently checked species diagnosis.

2024 年成体与幼体配对形态研究包含 Batrachyla taeniata。表 S1 记其蝌蚪来源为“Literature”，即文献图像，保留凭证栏“-”。横杠表示本表未列凭证，不证明从无标本。全研究一百一十二幅蝌蚪照片/绘图代表八十三种，每种一或两幅，Gosner 阶段二十六至四十一。由一人数字化三十二地标，针对固定伪影数字纠正尾弯曲，采用物种平均形状。该行未指定每件标本精确阶段；图像不是新活体发育轨迹或独立核实种诊断。
morphology
Adult measurements preserve source type and sex limits
成体测量保留来源类型及性别限制

For Batrachyla taeniata, the adult-source field is “ImageJ”: image-based measurements of the listed study material. Its voucher field is “FML2797” and sex field “?” (sex unspecified). This describes the adult record used in the compilation, not a population sex ratio or demonstrated sexual dimorphism. The study selects ten linear measurements, chiefly from male dorsal/lateral images or earlier descriptions, and uses PCA-based imputation for missing values; Table S1 does not flag every imputed cell. Log-shape ratios correct linear measurements other than snout–vent length by their geometric mean. Those values describe image/literature-derived external proportions rather than live performance, internal anatomy or a new sex-specific size range.

对于 Batrachyla taeniata，成体来源栏为“ImageJ”，即所列研究材料的图像测量。凭证栏“FML2797”、性别栏“?”（性别未指定）。这描述汇编使用成体记录，不是种群性比或已证实性二型。研究选十个线性测量，主要从雄性背/侧图或早期描述取得，以 PCA 补缺；表 S1 未标出每个填补单元格。对数形状比以几何均值校正吻肛长之外线性测量。值描述图像/文献外部比例，不是活体性能、内部解剖或新性别专属体型范围。
ecology
Larval guild and adult ecomorph are separate source categories
幼体功能群及成体生态型是分开来源类别

The row codes Batrachyla taeniata as larval LE (lentic) and adult TER (terrestrial). The two stages are retained separately; the adult code cannot be assigned automatically to tadpoles, or the reverse. Lentic/lotic and torrential labels summarize broad habitat associations rather than quantified flow tolerance, while saxicolous or terrestrial codes do not define an entire geographic range. An endotrophic tadpole category is distinct from direct development and does not remove the larval stage. The authors compiled functional assignments from species accounts rather than experimentally measuring every species’ feeding, hydrodynamics, locomotion or habitat choice.
该行将 Batrachyla taeniata 编为幼体 LE（静水）、成体 TER（陆生）。分开保留两个阶段，成体码不能自动用于蝌蚪，反之亦然。静水/流水及急流标签概括广义生境关联，不是量化流速耐受；岩栖或陆生码不定义完整地理分布。内营养蝌蚪类别区别于直接发育，不能消除幼体阶段。作者从物种叙述汇编功能分配，不是实验测每种摄食、流体力学、运动或生境选择。
evolution
Paired-stage comparisons do not establish complete developmental independence
配对阶段比较不确立完全发育独立

Across the sampled species, larval–adult shape dissimilarities show a weak but significant Mantel association (r 0.16, p 0.003), while disparity correlations differ among families. The authors interpret the overall pattern as support for adaptive decoupling; it does not demonstrate zero correlation, genetic independence, an experimentally selected trait or this species’ developmental trajectory. Phylogenetic analyses use 74 of the 83 sampled species, and ancestral shape/time patterns are model reconstructions from extant data rather than newly measured fossil morphology. Adult K 0.44 with p 0.001 describes less close-relative similarity than the reference expectation; the paper’s “not phylogenetically structured” wording cannot mean that the test is nonsignificant. Supplement S3 repeats family N values summing to 112 for both stages, so adult individual denominators and imputed cells remain uncertified without raw matrices.

所采物种间，幼体—成体形状不相似性有弱但显著 Mantel 关联（r 0.16、p 0.003），差异度关联随科而异。作者把总体模式解释为支持适应性解耦，不证明零相关、遗传独立、实验选择性状或本种发育轨迹。系统发育分析使用八十三取样种中七十四种，祖先形状/时间模式是从现存资料模型重建，不是新测化石形态。成体 K 0.44、p 0.001 描述近亲相似性低于参考期望；论文“无系统发育结构”措辞不能意味着检验不显著。补充 S3 在两个阶段重复合计一百一十二的逐科 N 值，未有原矩阵时成体个体分母及填补单元格仍未认证。
title: Shape Evolution in Two Acts: Morphological Diversity of Larval and Adult Neoaustraranan Frogs

sections: morphology
A larval image record with explicit provenance
具有明确来源的幼体图像记录

The 2024 paired-stage shape study includes Eupsophus emiliopugini. Table S1 records its tadpole source as “Photo, literature”, meaning photographs together with literature images, and retains the voucher field “LGE 25517”. A dash denotes no voucher listed in this table, not proof that no specimen ever existed. Across the study, 112 tadpole photographs/drawings represent 83 species, with one or two images per species and Gosner stages 26–41. Thirty-two landmarks were digitized by one person, tail curvature was digitally corrected for fixation artifacts, and species mean shapes were used. This row does not specify each specimen’s exact stage, and the images are not new live developmental trajectories or an independently checked species diagnosis.

2024 年成体与幼体配对形态研究包含 Eupsophus emiliopugini。表 S1 记其蝌蚪来源为“Photo, literature”，即照片结合文献图像，保留凭证栏“LGE 25517”。横杠表示本表未列凭证，不证明从无标本。全研究一百一十二幅蝌蚪照片/绘图代表八十三种，每种一或两幅，Gosner 阶段二十六至四十一。由一人数字化三十二地标，针对固定伪影数字纠正尾弯曲，采用物种平均形状。该行未指定每件标本精确阶段；图像不是新活体发育轨迹或独立核实种诊断。
morphology
Adult measurements preserve source type and sex limits
成体测量保留来源类型及性别限制

For Eupsophus emiliopugini, the adult-source field is “ImageJ”: image-based measurements of the listed study material. Its voucher field is “LGE25506” and sex field “?” (sex unspecified). This describes the adult record used in the compilation, not a population sex ratio or demonstrated sexual dimorphism. The study selects ten linear measurements, chiefly from male dorsal/lateral images or earlier descriptions, and uses PCA-based imputation for missing values; Table S1 does not flag every imputed cell. Log-shape ratios correct linear measurements other than snout–vent length by their geometric mean. Those values describe image/literature-derived external proportions rather than live performance, internal anatomy or a new sex-specific size range.

对于 Eupsophus emiliopugini，成体来源栏为“ImageJ”，即所列研究材料的图像测量。凭证栏“LGE25506”、性别栏“?”（性别未指定）。这描述汇编使用成体记录，不是种群性比或已证实性二型。研究选十个线性测量，主要从雄性背/侧图或早期描述取得，以 PCA 补缺；表 S1 未标出每个填补单元格。对数形状比以几何均值校正吻肛长之外线性测量。值描述图像/文献外部比例，不是活体性能、内部解剖或新性别专属体型范围。
ecology
Larval guild and adult ecomorph are separate source categories
幼体功能群及成体生态型是分开来源类别

The row codes Eupsophus emiliopugini as larval END (endotrophic) and adult TER (terrestrial). The two stages are retained separately; the adult code cannot be assigned automatically to tadpoles, or the reverse. Lentic/lotic and torrential labels summarize broad habitat associations rather than quantified flow tolerance, while saxicolous or terrestrial codes do not define an entire geographic range. An endotrophic tadpole category is distinct from direct development and does not remove the larval stage. The authors compiled functional assignments from species accounts rather than experimentally measuring every species’ feeding, hydrodynamics, locomotion or habitat choice.
该行将 Eupsophus emiliopugini 编为幼体 END（内营养）、成体 TER（陆生）。分开保留两个阶段，成体码不能自动用于蝌蚪，反之亦然。静水/流水及急流标签概括广义生境关联，不是量化流速耐受；岩栖或陆生码不定义完整地理分布。内营养蝌蚪类别区别于直接发育，不能消除幼体阶段。作者从物种叙述汇编功能分配，不是实验测每种摄食、流体力学、运动或生境选择。
evolution
Paired-stage comparisons do not establish complete developmental independence
配对阶段比较不确立完全发育独立

Across the sampled species, larval–adult shape dissimilarities show a weak but significant Mantel association (r 0.16, p 0.003), while disparity correlations differ among families. The authors interpret the overall pattern as support for adaptive decoupling; it does not demonstrate zero correlation, genetic independence, an experimentally selected trait or this species’ developmental trajectory. Phylogenetic analyses use 74 of the 83 sampled species, and ancestral shape/time patterns are model reconstructions from extant data rather than newly measured fossil morphology. Adult K 0.44 with p 0.001 describes less close-relative similarity than the reference expectation; the paper’s “not phylogenetically structured” wording cannot mean that the test is nonsignificant. Supplement S3 repeats family N values summing to 112 for both stages, so adult individual denominators and imputed cells remain uncertified without raw matrices.

所采物种间，幼体—成体形状不相似性有弱但显著 Mantel 关联（r 0.16、p 0.003），差异度关联随科而异。作者把总体模式解释为支持适应性解耦，不证明零相关、遗传独立、实验选择性状或本种发育轨迹。系统发育分析使用八十三取样种中七十四种，祖先形状/时间模式是从现存资料模型重建，不是新测化石形态。成体 K 0.44、p 0.001 描述近亲相似性低于参考期望；论文“无系统发育结构”措辞不能意味着检验不显著。补充 S3 在两个阶段重复合计一百一十二的逐科 N 值，未有原矩阵时成体个体分母及填补单元格仍未认证。
title: Shape Evolution in Two Acts: Morphological Diversity of Larval and Adult Neoaustraranan Frogs

A larval image record with explicit provenance
具有明确来源的幼体图像记录

The 2024 paired-stage shape study includes Hylodes otavioi. Table S1 records its tadpole source as “Literature”, meaning literature images, and retains the voucher field “-”. A dash denotes no voucher listed in this table, not proof that no specimen ever existed. Across the study, 112 tadpole photographs/drawings represent 83 species, with one or two images per species and Gosner stages 26–41. Thirty-two landmarks were digitized by one person, tail curvature was digitally corrected for fixation artifacts, and species mean shapes were used. This row does not specify each specimen’s exact stage, and the images are not new live developmental trajectories or an independently checked species diagnosis.

2024 年成体与幼体配对形态研究包含 Hylodes otavioi。表 S1 记其蝌蚪来源为“Literature”，即文献图像，保留凭证栏“-”。横杠表示本表未列凭证，不证明从无标本。全研究一百一十二幅蝌蚪照片/绘图代表八十三种，每种一或两幅，Gosner 阶段二十六至四十一。由一人数字化三十二地标，针对固定伪影数字纠正尾弯曲，采用物种平均形状。该行未指定每件标本精确阶段；图像不是新活体发育轨迹或独立核实种诊断。
morphology
Adult measurements preserve source type and sex limits
成体测量保留来源类型及性别限制

For Hylodes otavioi, the adult-source field is “Literature”: measurements taken from literature text or tables. Its voucher field is “-” and sex field “M” (male). This describes the adult record used in the compilation, not a population sex ratio or demonstrated sexual dimorphism. The study selects ten linear measurements, chiefly from male dorsal/lateral images or earlier descriptions, and uses PCA-based imputation for missing values; Table S1 does not flag every imputed cell. Log-shape ratios correct linear measurements other than snout–vent length by their geometric mean. Those values describe image/literature-derived external proportions rather than live performance, internal anatomy or a new sex-specific size range.

对于 Hylodes otavioi，成体来源栏为“Literature”，即文献文字或表中测量。凭证栏“-”、性别栏“M”（雄性）。这描述汇编使用成体记录，不是种群性比或已证实性二型。研究选十个线性测量，主要从雄性背/侧图或早期描述取得，以 PCA 补缺；表 S1 未标出每个填补单元格。对数形状比以几何均值校正吻肛长之外线性测量。值描述图像/文献外部比例，不是活体性能、内部解剖或新性别专属体型范围。
ecology
Larval guild and adult ecomorph are separate source categories
幼体功能群及成体生态型是分开来源类别

The row codes Hylodes otavioi as larval LO (lotic) and adult TOR (torrential). The two stages are retained separately; the adult code cannot be assigned automatically to tadpoles, or the reverse. Lentic/lotic and torrential labels summarize broad habitat associations rather than quantified flow tolerance, while saxicolous or terrestrial codes do not define an entire geographic range. An endotrophic tadpole category is distinct from direct development and does not remove the larval stage. The authors compiled functional assignments from species accounts rather than experimentally measuring every species’ feeding, hydrodynamics, locomotion or habitat choice.
该行将 Hylodes otavioi 编为幼体 LO（流水）、成体 TOR（急流相关）。分开保留两个阶段，成体码不能自动用于蝌蚪，反之亦然。静水/流水及急流标签概括广义生境关联，不是量化流速耐受；岩栖或陆生码不定义完整地理分布。内营养蝌蚪类别区别于直接发育，不能消除幼体阶段。作者从物种叙述汇编功能分配，不是实验测每种摄食、流体力学、运动或生境选择。
evolution
Paired-stage comparisons do not establish complete developmental independence
配对阶段比较不确立完全发育独立

Across the sampled species, larval–adult shape dissimilarities show a weak but significant Mantel association (r 0.16, p 0.003), while disparity correlations differ among families. The authors interpret the overall pattern as support for adaptive decoupling; it does not demonstrate zero correlation, genetic independence, an experimentally selected trait or this species’ developmental trajectory. Phylogenetic analyses use 74 of the 83 sampled species, and ancestral shape/time patterns are model reconstructions from extant data rather than newly measured fossil morphology. Adult K 0.44 with p 0.001 describes less close-relative similarity than the reference expectation; the paper’s “not phylogenetically structured” wording cannot mean that the test is nonsignificant. Supplement S3 repeats family N values summing to 112 for both stages, so adult individual denominators and imputed cells remain uncertified without raw matrices.

所采物种间，幼体—成体形状不相似性有弱但显著 Mantel 关联（r 0.16、p 0.003），差异度关联随科而异。作者把总体模式解释为支持适应性解耦，不证明零相关、遗传独立、实验选择性状或本种发育轨迹。系统发育分析使用八十三取样种中七十四种，祖先形状/时间模式是从现存资料模型重建，不是新测化石形态。成体 K 0.44、p 0.001 描述近亲相似性低于参考期望；论文“无系统发育结构”措辞不能意味着检验不显著。补充 S3 在两个阶段重复合计一百一十二的逐科 N 值，未有原矩阵时成体个体分母及填补单元格仍未认证。
title: Shape Evolution in Two Acts: Morphological Diversity of Larval and Adult Neoaustraranan Frogs

sections: morphology
A larval image record with explicit provenance
具有明确来源的幼体图像记录

The 2024 paired-stage shape study includes Phantasmarana boticariana. Table S1 records its tadpole source as “Photo”, meaning photographs of biological material, and retains the voucher field “CHRP 2826”. A dash denotes no voucher listed in this table, not proof that no specimen ever existed. Across the study, 112 tadpole photographs/drawings represent 83 species, with one or two images per species and Gosner stages 26–41. Thirty-two landmarks were digitized by one person, tail curvature was digitally corrected for fixation artifacts, and species mean shapes were used. This row does not specify each specimen’s exact stage, and the images are not new live developmental trajectories or an independently checked species diagnosis.

2024 年成体与幼体配对形态研究包含 Phantasmarana boticariana。表 S1 记其蝌蚪来源为“Photo”，即生物材料照片，保留凭证栏“CHRP 2826”。横杠表示本表未列凭证，不证明从无标本。全研究一百一十二幅蝌蚪照片/绘图代表八十三种，每种一或两幅，Gosner 阶段二十六至四十一。由一人数字化三十二地标，针对固定伪影数字纠正尾弯曲，采用物种平均形状。该行未指定每件标本精确阶段；图像不是新活体发育轨迹或独立核实种诊断。
morphology
Adult measurements preserve source type and sex limits
成体测量保留来源类型及性别限制

For Phantasmarana boticariana, the adult-source field is “Literature”: measurements taken from literature text or tables. Its voucher field is “-” and sex field “F” (female). This describes the adult record used in the compilation, not a population sex ratio or demonstrated sexual dimorphism. The study selects ten linear measurements, chiefly from male dorsal/lateral images or earlier descriptions, and uses PCA-based imputation for missing values; Table S1 does not flag every imputed cell. Log-shape ratios correct linear measurements other than snout–vent length by their geometric mean. Those values describe image/literature-derived external proportions rather than live performance, internal anatomy or a new sex-specific size range.

对于 Phantasmarana boticariana，成体来源栏为“Literature”，即文献文字或表中测量。凭证栏“-”、性别栏“F”（雌性）。这描述汇编使用成体记录，不是种群性比或已证实性二型。研究选十个线性测量，主要从雄性背/侧图或早期描述取得，以 PCA 补缺；表 S1 未标出每个填补单元格。对数形状比以几何均值校正吻肛长之外线性测量。值描述图像/文献外部比例，不是活体性能、内部解剖或新性别专属体型范围。
ecology
Larval guild and adult ecomorph are separate source categories
幼体功能群及成体生态型是分开来源类别

The row codes Phantasmarana boticariana as larval LO (lotic) and adult TOR (torrential). The two stages are retained separately; the adult code cannot be assigned automatically to tadpoles, or the reverse. Lentic/lotic and torrential labels summarize broad habitat associations rather than quantified flow tolerance, while saxicolous or terrestrial codes do not define an entire geographic range. An endotrophic tadpole category is distinct from direct development and does not remove the larval stage. The authors compiled functional assignments from species accounts rather than experimentally measuring every species’ feeding, hydrodynamics, locomotion or habitat choice.
该行将 Phantasmarana boticariana 编为幼体 LO（流水）、成体 TOR（急流相关）。分开保留两个阶段，成体码不能自动用于蝌蚪，反之亦然。静水/流水及急流标签概括广义生境关联，不是量化流速耐受；岩栖或陆生码不定义完整地理分布。内营养蝌蚪类别区别于直接发育，不能消除幼体阶段。作者从物种叙述汇编功能分配，不是实验测每种摄食、流体力学、运动或生境选择。
evolution
Paired-stage comparisons do not establish complete developmental independence
配对阶段比较不确立完全发育独立

Across the sampled species, larval–adult shape dissimilarities show a weak but significant Mantel association (r 0.16, p 0.003), while disparity correlations differ among families. The authors interpret the overall pattern as support for adaptive decoupling; it does not demonstrate zero correlation, genetic independence, an experimentally selected trait or this species’ developmental trajectory. Phylogenetic analyses use 74 of the 83 sampled species, and ancestral shape/time patterns are model reconstructions from extant data rather than newly measured fossil morphology. Adult K 0.44 with p 0.001 describes less close-relative similarity than the reference expectation; the paper’s “not phylogenetically structured” wording cannot mean that the test is nonsignificant. Supplement S3 repeats family N values summing to 112 for both stages, so adult individual denominators and imputed cells remain uncertified without raw matrices.

所采物种间，幼体—成体形状不相似性有弱但显著 Mantel 关联（r 0.16、p 0.003），差异度关联随科而异。作者把总体模式解释为支持适应性解耦，不证明零相关、遗传独立、实验选择性状或本种发育轨迹。系统发育分析使用八十三取样种中七十四种，祖先形状/时间模式是从现存资料模型重建，不是新测化石形态。成体 K 0.44、p 0.001 描述近亲相似性低于参考期望；论文“无系统发育结构”措辞不能意味着检验不显著。补充 S3 在两个阶段重复合计一百一十二的逐科 N 值，未有原矩阵时成体个体分母及填补单元格仍未认证。
title: Shape Evolution in Two Acts: Morphological Diversity of Larval and Adult Neoaustraranan Frogs

sections: ecology
Observed temperatures at Mariquita: 455 m.a.s.l in forest habitat
Mariquita: 455 m.a.s.l 森林生境的观察温度

For source-labelled Pristimantis gaigei, Table 1 reports n 7 at Mariquita: 455 m.a.s.l in forest habitat. In degrees Celsius, its body-temperature entry is 24.6 ± 1.20 (22.9–25.9); substrate 25.0 ± 1.04 (23.6–26.5); and nearby air 25.2 ± 1.07 (23.9–26.7). Each cell reports mean ± standard deviation with the observed range in parentheses. The body measure is dorsal skin temperature at the encounter, substrate is the surface where the frog was found, and air is measured 20 cm above it. These simultaneous September–December 2018 nocturnal adult records are not preferred temperatures, critical thermal limits, a physiological safety margin or a complete species range.

来源名称 Pristimantis gaigei 在 Mariquita: 455 m.a.s.l 的森林生境，表一报告 n 7。单位摄氏度，体温项 24.6 ± 1.20 (22.9–25.9)；基质 25.0 ± 1.04 (23.6–26.5)；附近空气 25.2 ± 1.07 (23.9–26.7)。每格为均值 ± 标准差，括号内观察范围。体温测量为遇见时背部皮肤温度，基质是发现蛙所在表面，空气在其上方二十厘米测量。这些 2018 年九月至十二月夜间成年同步记录不是偏好温度、临界热限、生理安全裕度或完整物种范围。
methods
Dorsal skin temperature is an assumed internal-temperature proxy
背部皮温是所假设内部温度代理

The Methods compare skin and cloacal temperatures ten times in nine animals from four species and report nonsignificant repeated-measures differences. The authors therefore treat skin temperature as representing internal body temperature. This is not an independently reproduced equivalence test, nor validation for all eleven sampled species, body sizes and field conditions. Six hourly ground-contact loggers sample forest/open conditions at three elevations, but logger positions are not identical to every frog’s substrate. The frog observations cover approximately 18:00–24:00, while plotted nightly logger summaries extend to 06:00; daytime and all-season thermal exposure remain outside this sample.
方法对四种九个动物皮温与泄殖腔温测十次，报告重复测量差异不显著。作者因此把皮温视为内部体温。这不是独立复现等效检验，亦不验证全部十一取样种、体型及野外条件。六个每小时接触地面记录仪取样三海拔森林/开阔条件，但位置不等于每只蛙基质。蛙观察约十八至二十四时，图中夜间记录仪摘要延至六时；白昼及全年热暴露不在样本内。
ecology
Temperature associations do not establish heat-transfer mechanism
温度关联不确立传热机制

The pooled results associate skin temperature more strongly with substrate than nearby air temperature. The authors propose thermoconformity and conductive heat exchange, but do not directly measure heat flux, evaporative loss or behavioral selection for this species. Analyses compare forest/open assemblages and elevations without a phylogenetic model; species composition and microhabitat use differ, so greater elevational association is not proof that ancestry has no influence. The printed Table 2 includes p < 0.000 entries and a low-elevation open-air p > 0.789 despite prose describing significance in all cases. Those probability statements remain unresolved rather than being silently corrected or reproduced as valid zero probabilities.
汇总结果把皮温与基质的关联记为强于附近空气。作者提出热顺应及传导换热，但未为本种直接测热通量、蒸发损失或行为选择。分析比较森林/开阔群落与海拔，无系统发育模型；物种组成及微生境使用不同，更强海拔关联不证明祖源无影响。印出表二含 p < 0.000 项，低海拔开阔空气 p > 0.789，正文却称全部情况显著。概率陈述保留为未解决，不默默修正或重述为有效零概率。
ecology
Open-forest comparisons are bounded field observations
开阔—森林比较是有限野外观察

For the pooled sample, open-habitat body temperatures are higher after size adjustment, but the within-elevation difference is significant only at low and middle elevations; it is nonsignificant at 2,700 m. Body-temperature variance also does not differ significantly by habitat. This is distinct from proving identical distributions or lower thermal tolerance in forest species. Forest canopy above 60% and open canopy up to 40% are source definitions, not every intermediate habitat or this species’ exclusive preference. The Conclusion proposes testing forest thermal specialization; specialization, vulnerability to warming and conservation outcomes were not experimentally established here.

methods
Dorsal skin temperature is an assumed internal-temperature proxy
背部皮温是所假设内部温度代理

The Methods compare skin and cloacal temperatures ten times in nine animals from four species and report nonsignificant repeated-measures differences. The authors therefore treat skin temperature as representing internal body temperature. This is not an independently reproduced equivalence test, nor validation for all eleven sampled species, body sizes and field conditions. Six hourly ground-contact loggers sample forest/open conditions at three elevations, but logger positions are not identical to every frog’s substrate. The frog observations cover approximately 18:00–24:00, while plotted nightly logger summaries extend to 06:00; daytime and all-season thermal exposure remain outside this sample.
方法对四种九个动物皮温与泄殖腔温测十次，报告重复测量差异不显著。作者因此把皮温视为内部体温。这不是独立复现等效检验，亦不验证全部十一取样种、体型及野外条件。六个每小时接触地面记录仪取样三海拔森林/开阔条件，但位置不等于每只蛙基质。蛙观察约十八至二十四时，图中夜间记录仪摘要延至六时；白昼及全年热暴露不在样本内。
ecology
Temperature associations do not establish heat-transfer mechanism
温度关联不确立传热机制

The pooled results associate skin temperature more strongly with substrate than nearby air temperature. The authors propose thermoconformity and conductive heat exchange, but do not directly measure heat flux, evaporative loss or behavioral selection for this species. Analyses compare forest/open assemblages and elevations without a phylogenetic model; species composition and microhabitat use differ, so greater elevational association is not proof that ancestry has no influence. The printed Table 2 includes p < 0.000 entries and a low-elevation open-air p > 0.789 despite prose describing significance in all cases. Those probability statements remain unresolved rather than being silently corrected or reproduced as valid zero probabilities.
汇总结果把皮温与基质的关联记为强于附近空气。作者提出热顺应及传导换热，但未为本种直接测热通量、蒸发损失或行为选择。分析比较森林/开阔群落与海拔，无系统发育模型；物种组成及微生境使用不同，更强海拔关联不证明祖源无影响。印出表二含 p < 0.000 项，低海拔开阔空气 p > 0.789，正文却称全部情况显著。概率陈述保留为未解决，不默默修正或重述为有效零概率。
ecology
Open-forest comparisons are bounded field observations
开阔—森林比较是有限野外观察

For the pooled sample, open-habitat body temperatures are higher after size adjustment, but the within-elevation difference is significant only at low and middle elevations; it is nonsignificant at 2,700 m. Body-temperature variance also does not differ significantly by habitat. This is distinct from proving identical distributions or lower thermal tolerance in forest species. Forest canopy above 60% and open canopy up to 40% are source definitions, not every intermediate habitat or this species’ exclusive preference. The Conclusion proposes testing forest thermal specialization; specialization, vulnerability to warming and conservation outcomes were not experimentally established here.

Qualitative similarity does not erase printed habitat means
定性相似不消除印出生境均值

Discussion calls Rhinella margaritifera body temperatures similar when found in both habitats at the same elevation. 混合来源城市及城郊名册记录

The 2026 Guayaquil checklist lists Hyloxalus infraguttatus in conservation areas; unprotected remnant native vegetation. The source combines January 2008–February 2025 field surveys with museum, database, literature and critically screened secondary records. Its focus includes remnant forests and revegetated parks in the urban/periurban footprint, with selected near-boundary areas retained; it is not a uniform present-day census across all 4,113.89 km² of Guayaquil. Table 3’s presence categories are not individual counts, breeding records, occupancy probabilities or independently checked voucher identifications. The city-center elevation cannot be assigned as every specimen’s collection height.

2026 年瓜亚基尔名册把 Hyloxalus infraguttatus 列于保护地区；未列保护的残存原生植被。来源结合 2008 年一月至 2025 年二月野外调查与馆藏、数据库、文献及严格筛选次级记录。重点含城市/城郊范围残存林、恢复植被公园，并保留部分近边界地区；不是瓜亚基尔全部 4,113.89 平方公里一致当前普查。表三出现类别不是个体数、繁殖记录、占域概率或独立检查凭证鉴定。市中心海拔不能分配为每件标本采集高度。
ecology
Global and Ecuadorian risk categories preserve different scales
全球及厄瓜多尔风险类别保留不同尺度

Table 3 assigns Hyloxalus infraguttatus IUCN NT (Near Threatened) and Ecuadorian Red List VU (Vulnerable). The Methods refer to IUCN 2025 and the national amphibian assessment published in 2021; these are source-reported historical assignments, not independently verified current categories or equivalent local extinction probabilities. LC does not establish urban safety, NE is not demonstrated absence of threat, and DD denotes an information gap. Differences between geographic assessment scales do not alone prove an error or quantify local population decline. The source’s 63 mixed-herpetofauna conservation totals must not be treated as nineteen-amphibian-only counts.

表三为 Hyloxalus infraguttatus 分配 IUCN NT（近危）及厄瓜多尔红名录 VU（易危）。方法引用 IUCN 2025 及 2021 年发表国家两栖评估；这是来源报告历史分配，不是独立核实当前类别或等价地方灭绝概率。LC 不确立城市安全，NE 不证明无威胁，DD 是信息缺口。不同地理评估尺度本身不证明错误或量化地方种群下降。来源六十三混合两栖爬行保育总数不能当十九两栖专属计数。
methods
Presence and land-cover estimates do not demonstrate urban adaptation
出现及土地覆盖估计不证明城市适应

The paper associates urbanization with habitat loss and argues that remaining areas serve as refuges. Its GIS estimates compare 2008 and 2022 land use, while biological records span different dates and sources. This does not experimentally establish pollution tolerance, reproductive success, behavioral plasticity or conservation effectiveness for every listed species. Sampling histories and detectability vary, especially for subterranean taxa. Original specimen accounts and photographs are in supporting appendices that have not been independently inspected here; table figure numbers are locators, not confirmation of a checked photo. Habitat restoration and monitoring recommendations remain proposed actions.
论文把城市化与生境损失关联，提出剩余地区作为庇护所。GIS 估计比较 2008、2022 土地利用，生物记录跨不同日期、来源。这不实验确立每个列出种的污染耐受、繁殖成功、行为可塑性或保护成效。取样历史及可检测性不同，地下类群尤甚。原标本叙述、照片位于本次尚未独立检查补充附录；表格图号是定位符，不确认已核查照片。生境恢复、监测建议仍是拟议行动。
biogeography
A country-endemism flag is distinct from city restriction
国家特有标记区别于城市限制

The Table 3 asterisk marks source-labelled Hyloxalus infraguttatus as endemic to Ecuador. It does not restrict the species to Guayaquil, establish every contemporary occurrence or define an independently mapped area of occupancy. The paper’s six endemic amphibian rows use its 2025 taxonomic framework; correspondence with the frozen catalogue name is an exact-name candidate, not certification of all revised biological concepts.
表三星号将来源名称 Hyloxalus infraguttatus 标为厄瓜多尔特有，不将物种限制于瓜亚基尔、不确立全部当前出现或定义独立地图占域面积。论文六个两栖特有行采用其 2025 分类框架；与冻结目录名称对应为精确名称候选，不认证全部修订生物学概念。

An urban persistence interpretation uses cited evidence
城市持续出现解释使用引用证据

Discussion names Scinax quinquefasciatus among four amphibians recorded in urban parks and proposes resilience, reproductive traits and behavioral plasticity. It also cites earlier Bd incidence reports for those frogs. This checklist does not newly measure infection prevalence, disease resistance, reproduction rate or inherited urban adaptation. Presence across CA/UP/REM categories and a cited pathogen record are distinct evidence streams; neither demonstrates population growth or safety from urban disturbance.
讨论将 Scinax quinquefasciatus 列为城市公园记录四种两栖之一，提出韧性、繁殖性状及行为可塑性，亦引用这些蛙较早 Bd 发生报告。本名册未新测感染流行率、抗病性、繁殖率或遗传城市适应。跨 CA/UP/REM 出现与引用病原记录是不同证据流，均不证明种群增长或不受城市扰动。

出现及土地覆盖估计不证明城市适应

The paper associates urbanization with habitat loss and argues that remaining areas serve as refuges. Its GIS estimates compare 2008 and 2022 land use, while biological records span different dates and sources. This does not experimentally establish pollution tolerance, reproductive success, behavioral plasticity or conservation effectiveness for every listed species. Sampling histories and detectability vary, especially for subterranean taxa. Original specimen accounts and photographs are in supporting appendices that have not been independently inspected here; table figure numbers are locators, not confirmation of a checked photo. Habitat restoration and monitoring recommendations remain proposed actions.
论文把城市化与生境损失关联，提出剩余地区作为庇护所。GIS 估计比较 2008、2022 土地利用，生物记录跨不同日期、来源。这不实验确立每个列出种的污染耐受、繁殖成功、行为可塑性或保护成效。取样历史及可检测性不同，地下类群尤甚。原标本叙述、照片位于本次尚未独立检查补充附录；表格图号是定位符，不确认已核查照片。生境恢复、监测建议仍是拟议行动。

sections: taxonomy
A single captive family under a breeder identification
繁育场鉴定下的单一圈养家系

The 2025 study identifies its juveniles as Andrias davidianus through consultation with the breeding facility, reporting one locally sourced parental pair and no history of crossing with other Andrias species. Animals came from a breeding base in Sangzhi, Hunan, at a reported 471 m. This is the authors’ provenance statement, not genetic verification of the parents, offspring or contemporary species boundaries. The captive family does not represent all wild Chinese giant-salamander lineages, and findings are not assigned to A. sligoi, A. jiangxiensis or A. cheni merely because those names occur in the Introduction.
2025 年研究通过咨询繁育场把幼体鉴定为 Andrias davidianus，报告来自一对当地来源亲本，无与其他大鲵属种杂交历史。动物来自湖南桑植繁育基地，所述海拔 471 米。这是作者来源陈述，不是亲本、后代或现代物种界限的遗传验证。单一圈养家系不代表全部野生中国大鲵谱系；引言提及 A. sligoi、A. jiangxiensis、A. cheni 不意味着实验结果可分配给它们。
methods
Forty juveniles and four artificial light schedules
四十只幼体与四种人工光周期

Forty 16-month-old juveniles had reported body mass 15.89 ± 2.19 g and body length 14.87 ± 1.03 cm; the Animals paragraph does not identify the dispersion statistic for these values. March–April 2024 treatments each contain ten animals: LD12:12 light 07:00–19:00, continuous darkness DD, LD16:8 light 07:00–23:00, and LD8:16 light 07:00–15:00. Animals acclimated to the treatment for seven days. White tanks, shelters, daily water replacement and bloodworms every other day describe husbandry, not wild habitat preferences or a natural diet census. Assignment randomization, sex balance and independent family replication are not established by the read Methods.

四十只十六个月龄幼体所报体重 15.89 ± 2.19 克、体长 14.87 ± 1.03 厘米；动物段未标明这些数值的离散统计量。2024 年三至四月每处理十只：LD12:12 七至十九时亮、DD 持续暗、LD16:8 七至二十三时亮、LD8:16 七至十五时亮。处理适应七日。白色缸、躲避处、每日换水及隔日供血虫描述饲养，不是野生生境偏好或自然食谱普查。所读方法未确立随机分配、性别平衡及独立家系重复。
methods
Reflectance measurements and repeated observation units
反射率测量与重复观察单位

The lamp provided a reported 50–60 lux at the water surface with identical intensity and spectrum across illuminated treatments and instantaneous light transitions. Acclimation water temperature was 12.40 ± 0.86 °C and experimental temperature 17.87 ± 2.12 °C; neither is a critical thermal limit. Spectra were acquired over 200–1100 nm, with analysis restricted to 300–700 nm. A perpendicular probe was positioned 2 mm from dorsal skin, with 600 ms integration and dark/white calibration. Six four-hourly timepoints started at 09:00, on three alternating days; the source calls the resulting eighteen observations 72 h. This wording does not establish a continuously monitored three-day series, and timepoints are repeated measurements rather than eighteen independent animals.

灯在水面所报五十至六十 lux，各亮处理光强光谱一致、明暗瞬时转换。适应水温 12.40 ± 0.86 摄氏度，实验 17.87 ± 2.12 摄氏度；均非临界热限。采集光谱二百至一千一百纳米，分析限三百至七百纳米。探头垂直距背皮二毫米，积分六百毫秒，并校准暗噪声及白参考。九时起每四小时六时点，在三个间隔日测量；来源把十八观察记为七十二小时。此措辞不确立连续监测三日序列，时点是重复测量而非十八个独立动物。
morphology
Daytime darkening in a spectral rather than pigment assay
光谱测定中的白昼变暗

Under the tested schedules, the authors describe dark-brown juveniles in the light phase and lighter brown in darkness. Illuminated spectra have a short-wave peak around 300–320 nm; dark-phase spectra also have a longer-wave peak around 650–700 nm. Mean brightness B2 is mean relative reflectance over 300–700 nm; chroma variables describe relative spectral contributions. Their UV/violet and green/yellow wavelength bands overlap, so these are not independent pigment concentrations. Individual timepoint exceptions are reported, including LD12:12 blue chroma at 17:00 versus 21:00. The Results’ later blanket statement of no daytime differences is broader than the preceding hue-specific tests. The study does not directly quantify melanin, chromatophore counts, hormones or animal visual perception.
测试周期下作者描述亮期幼体深褐、暗期较浅褐。亮期光谱约三百至三百二十纳米有短波峰；暗期另有约六百五十至七百纳米长波峰。平均亮度 B2 是三百至七百纳米平均相对反射率；色度量为相对光谱贡献。紫外/紫及绿/黄波段重叠，故不是独立色素浓度。逐时点有例外，包括 LD12:12 十七时与二十一时蓝色度。结果后文笼统称白昼无差异，比前面色度逐项检验更宽。研究未直接定量黑色素、色素细胞数、激素或动物视觉。
ecology
Fitted daily rhythms do not independently estimate free-running period
拟合日节律不独立估计自由运行周期

All forty animals are reported rhythmic, with the rhythm period defaulting to 24 h in the analysis. Table 1 marks rhythmicity p < 0.001 in its footnote; printed 0.000 values are rounded significance displays, not exact zero probabilities. Mesor is the fitted rhythm average, amplitude half the peak–trough difference and acrophase the fitted peak time. Persistence in DD supports the authors’ interpretation of an endogenous component under this short captive protocol. Because the period was fixed, this is not an independent estimate of free-running period, long-term clock stability or a measured molecular oscillator. Nonsignificant DD versus LD12:12 parameter differences are not an equivalence test.
四十动物均被报告有节律，但分析默认周期二十四小时。表一脚注以 p < 0.001 标节律显著；印出 0.000 是舍入显示，不是精确零概率。Mesor 为拟合节律均值、振幅为峰谷差一半、相位为拟合峰时。DD 中持续变化支持作者在此短期圈养方案下的内源成分解释。周期固定，故不独立估计自由运行周期、长期时钟稳定性或测得分子振荡器。DD 与 LD12:12 参数差异不显著亦非等效检验。
ecology
Printed brightness parameters and an unresolved treatment-label conflict
印出亮度参数与未解决处理标注冲突

Table 1 gives LD12:12 mesor 20.395 ± 1.167, amplitude 7.600 ± 0.989, acrophase 15.905 ± 0.355 h and peak 00:54; DD 20.758 ± 1.023, 8.459 ± 1.165, 15.908 ± 0.462 h, 00:54; LD16:8 18.980 ± 0.622, 6.612 ± 0.594, 17.416 ± 0.443 h, 02:25; LD8:16 22.536 ± 0.873, 10.520 ± 1.182, 15.778 ± 0.211 h, 00:47. The table does not label the ± statistic in its footnote. Results 3.3 initially assigns the 17.416 h/02:25 delayed peak to LD8:16, whereas Table 1, Table 2, Figure 4 caption, later Results and Discussion assign delay to LD16:8. The reader preserves this contradiction without silently correcting the paper. Hours of acrophase are measured from the 09:00 analysis start, not a 17:25 civil-clock peak.
ecology
Proposed mechanisms and functions remain unmeasured
所提机制与功能仍未测量

The Discussion proposes melanosome aggregation/dispersion, melatonin and α-MSH regulation, daytime UV protection and nocturnal energy conservation. These are mechanistic and functional hypotheses informed by cited literature; this experiment does not assay hormones, molecular clock genes, pigment transport, UV injury, metabolic expenditure, predator detection or reproductive success. Similarity to dark substrates does not establish camouflage performance. A stable laboratory light spectrum and abrupt transitions omit twilight and natural irradiance fluctuations; the authors explicitly state that their design cannot distinguish evolutionary adaptation from plasticity induced by artificial lighting. Seasonal observations are not a replicated seasonal experiment, and the results remain limited to captive juveniles.
讨论提出黑素小体聚散、褪黑激素及 α-MSH 调控、白昼紫外防护与夜间节能。这些是引用文献支持的机制和功能假说；实验未测激素、时钟基因、色素运输、紫外损伤、代谢支出、捕食者检测或繁殖成功。类似暗基质不确立伪装表现。稳定实验光谱与瞬时转换省略暮光和自然辐照波动；作者明确称方案无法区分进化适应与人工光诱导可塑性。季节观察不是重复季节实验，结果仍限圈养幼体。

Selected Mexican survey localities, 2017–2018

Figure 1 associates source-labelled Aquiloeurycea galeanae with La Encantada. Researchers searched 26 localities in five Mexican states from March 2017 to November 2018; salamanders were encountered at sixteen. Identification used external size, tail proportions, feet and color pattern. These sites are observed study links, not the species’ complete distribution or proof of present occupancy. methods
Skin swabs describe a filtered bacterial community
皮肤拭子描述经过筛选的细菌群落

For Chiropterotriton magnipes and the other sampled hosts, the study changed gloves between animals, rinsed each with 100 ml sterile water and swabbed the whole body for thirty seconds. A separate ventral-body/tail/leg swab was used for Bd testing. The V4 16S bacterial assay retained forward reads, filtered very rare variants and rarefied to 17,536 reads per sample. It is not a complete skin metagenome, cultured viable-cell census or fungal community survey. Eight environmental swabs represented cave walls; each cave supplied only one wall sample, with no matched forest or karst environmental sampling. Negative bacterial controls did not amplify and were not sequenced, which is not independent proof of absence of contamination.

sourceConcept: One Holocene Ehime vertebra assigned by authors to living japonicus using short cytb; exact-name page, not new PBDB accepted concept
sections: occurrence
Holocene giant-salamander remains in Ehime
爱媛全新世大鲵遗存

A 2025 study re-examines fragmentary giant-salamander bones from the Shikimizu fissure deposits at a quarry in Ozu, Ehime, Shikoku. Older deposit-age interpretation based on mammal composition was Late Pleistocene or Early Holocene; direct dating of one analyzed vertebra instead gives 4,140–3,587 calibrated years BP. This is one bone’s reported calibrated interval, not proof that the entire deposit, every associated animal or all salamander fragments have the same age. It establishes a study-reported historical occurrence, not present occupancy, a species origin time or a complete Japanese fossil distribution.
2025 年研究重新检查四国爱媛大洲采石场 Shikimizu 裂隙堆积的大鲵碎骨。较早依哺乳动物组成把堆积推为晚更新世或早全新世；一枚分析椎骨直接定年却给出距今年代 4,140–3,587 校正年 BP。这是一骨所报校正区间，不证明整个堆积、全部伴生动物或全部大鲵碎片同龄。确立研究报告历史出现，不是当前占据、物种起源时间或完整日本化石分布。
morphology
Genus-level bone evidence has preserved and missing characters
属级骨证据有保留及缺失性状

The authors use large size, lack of spinal-nerve foramina and unicapitate vertebral transverse processes to place the remains in Cryptobranchidae. Vertebral geometry supports an Andrias assignment, and the slender, slightly curved dentary differs from their described scheuchzeri comparator. However, the maxilla and anterior dentary needed for japonicus versus davidianus sensu lato diagnosis are absent. Bone morphology alone therefore remains provisionally genus-level. A reported roughly40° spine–centrum angle also exceeds the same paragraph’s quoted19–37° Andrias reference interval; the reader retains this discrepancy rather than treating it as a fully validated diagnostic threshold.
作者依大体型、椎骨无脊神经孔及单头横突将遗存置于隐鳃鲵科。椎骨几何支持大鲵属分配，细长微弯齿骨不同于所描述 scheuchzeri 比较物。但区分 japonicus 与广义 davidianus 所需上颌骨、齿骨前端缺失，故仅凭骨形态暂留属级。所报约四十度神经棘—椎体角另超过同段引用大鲵属十九至三十七度区间；读本保留差异，不当作完全验证诊断阈值。
methods
Museum elements and an unlinked dated vertebra
馆藏骨元素与未关联编号的定年椎骨

Methods list dentaries OCM-5–7, parietal OCM-8, parasphenoid OCM-9 and five trunk vertebrae OCM-10–14 at Ozu City Museum. The Introduction’s earlier description has three vertebrae and at least four inferred individuals from repeated elements and size differences. That historical summary is not the same element count as the Methods inventory. The read Results say one vertebra yielded collagen and DNA without identifying its OCM number. The reader does not guess which element was dated, equate every fragment to a distinct animal or assign the historical roughly500/900 mm body-length estimates to the sampled vertebra.
方法列大洲市博物馆齿骨 OCM-5–7、顶骨 OCM-8、副蝶骨 OCM-9、五枚躯干椎骨 OCM-10–14。引言较早描述为三椎骨，并依重复元素及体型差推至少四个体。历史摘要不是与方法相同的元素数。所读结果称一椎骨获得胶原及 DNA，未给其 OCM 编号。读本不猜定年元素、不把每碎片等同不同动物，亦不把历史约五百/九百毫米体长估计分配给取样椎骨。
methods
Calibrated dating and short mitochondrial amplification
校正定年与短线粒体扩增

The reported procedure extracts a greater-than30 kDa collagen fraction from a small bone fragment, measures carbon14 by accelerator mass spectrometry and calibrates with CALIB8.2. The calibrated BP interval is not an uncalibrated radiocarbon age; the read text does not supply enough raw measurements and calibration settings to reproduce its probability distribution. The DNA assay targets93 bp of mitochondrial cytochrome b excluding primers, with45 PCR cycles. This is a short maternally inherited marker, not a whole mitochondrial or nuclear genome and not an independently reconstructed population ancestry history.
所报流程从小骨片提取大于三十 kDa 胶原组分，以加速器质谱测碳十四并用 CALIB8.2 校正。校正 BP 区间不是未经校正放射碳年龄；所读文字未给足原测量和校正设定以复现概率分布。DNA 测定靶向不含引物九十三 bp 线粒体细胞色素 b，四十五 PCR 循环。这是短母系标记，不是整个线粒体或核基因组，亦非独立重建种群祖源历史。
evolution
Authors identify the sampled remain with the western japonicus clade
作者把取样遗存鉴定为西部 japonicus 支系

The authors report the short cytb sequence identical to modern japonicus comparisons and recover the remain in the Western Japan clade using maximum likelihood, supporting their species assignment. This conclusion concerns the analyzed sample and the compared marker, not a genomic certification of every bone or proof that no cryptic lineage existed. Extraction took place in a dedicated ancient-DNA facility, negative controls did not amplify and two independent amplifications gave consistent sequences. Shared or split marker groups are not final species boundaries
共享或分裂标记组不是最终物种界限

The literal workbook partitions for Dendropsophus microcephalus include 1 available16S groups and 1 availableCOI groups. Groups shared with other source labels are 16S group25: Dendropsophus anataliasiasi. Sharing a marker cluster does not synonymize the named species, and a within-name split does not by itself establish new species, hybridization or misidentification. Unequal marker availability and sampling affect comparison; qualified source labels remain unresolved. The article’s Pristimantis paragraph says COI resolves three subgroups but lists giorgii5/6, moa44 and latro24, four distinct IDs. Its Rhinella diptycha paragraph refers to Table2 for amphibian groups despite the amphibian data appearing in Table1. These printed wording/locator differences are retained rather than silently certified as reproduced results.

Dendropsophus microcephalus 的字面工作簿分区含 1 个可用 16S 组、1 个可用 COI 组。与其他来源标签共享组为 16S group25: Dendropsophus anataliasiasi。共享标记组不把命名种异名化，同名内部拆分亦不单独确立新种、杂交或误鉴。不等标记可用性及取样影响比较，限定来源标签保持未解决。原文 Pristimantis 段称 COI 三亚组，却列 giorgii5/6、moa44、latro24 四个不同 ID。Rhinella diptycha 段引用表二两栖组，两栖数据却在表一。印出措辞/定位差异保留，不默默认证为复现结果。

Shared or split marker groups are not final species boundaries
共享或分裂标记组不是最终物种界限

The literal workbook partitions for Leptodactylus fuscus include 2 available16S groups and 1 availableCOI groups. Groups shared with other source labels are 16S group16: Leptodactylus vastus; 16S group17: Leptodactylus macrosternum. Sharing a marker cluster does not synonymize the named species, and a within-name split does not by itself establish new species, hybridization or misidentification. Unequal marker availability and sampling affect comparison; qualified source labels remain unresolved. The article’s Pristimantis paragraph says COI resolves three subgroups but lists giorgii5/6, moa44 and latro24, four distinct IDs. Its Rhinella diptycha paragraph refers to Table2 for amphibian groups despite the amphibian data appearing in Table1. These printed wording/locator differences are retained rather than silently certified as reproduced results.

The literal workbook partitions for Leptodactylus macrosternum include 2 available16S groups and 1 availableCOI groups. Groups shared with other source labels are 16S group17: Leptodactylus fuscus; 16S group18: Leptodactylus vastus. Sharing a marker cluster does not synonymize the named species, and a within-name split does not by itself establish new species, hybridization or misidentification. Unequal marker availability and sampling affect comparison; qualified source labels remain unresolved. The article’s Pristimantis paragraph says COI resolves three subgroups but lists giorgii5/6, moa44 and latro24, four distinct IDs.
