The literal workbook partitions for Leptodactylus vastus include 2 available16S groups and 1 availableCOI groups. Groups shared with other source labels are 16S group16: Leptodactylus fuscus; 16S group18: Leptodactylus macrosternum. Sharing a marker cluster does not synonymize the named species, and a within-name split does not by itself establish new species, hybridization or misidentification. Unequal marker availability and sampling affect comparison; qualified source labels remain unresolved. The article’s Pristimantis paragraph says COI resolves three subgroups but lists giorgii5/6, moa44 and latro24, four distinct IDs. Its Rhinella diptycha paragraph refers to Table2 for amphibian groups despite the amphibian data appearing in Table1. These printed wording/locator differences are retained rather than silently certified as reproduced results.

sections: ecology
Adult tapeworm associations in a historical North American checklist
北美历史清单中的成体绦虫关联

The 2023 review includes Anaxyrus americanus among amphibian hosts with records of adult intestinal cestodes. Its named parasite associations are Cylindrotaenia americana, Distoichometra bufonis, Ophiotaenia saphena. These describe compiled host–parasite records, not parasites measured in every member of the species. The scope is adult worms in wild continental North American herpetofauna; larval cestode records are excluded. sections: ecology
Adult tapeworm associations in a historical North American checklist
北美历史清单中的成体绦虫关联

The 2023 review includes Spea intermontana among amphibian hosts with records of adult intestinal cestodes. Its named parasite associations are Distoichometra bufonis. These describe compiled host–parasite records, not parasites measured in every member of the species. The scope is adult worms in wild continental North American herpetofauna; larval cestode records are excluded. An intestinal association alone does not establish disease severity, host mortality, zoonotic transmission or the species’ role in completing every parasite life cycle. Prevalence, intensity, examined-host denominators and experimental susceptibility are not supplied by this host checklist.

methods
How to interpret the compiled parasite evidence
如何理解汇编的寄生证据

The authors assembled literature records into both parasite-first and host-first lists and supplied an identification key using earlier taxonomic works. The host-first list intentionally omits worms identified only to genus; a shorter list there is not evidence that genus-level records do not exist. The article reports 88 named amphibian hosts overall, alongside unresolved and hybrid labels in its host list; that source total is not the number of pinned COL26.8 pages linked here. This page uses only an exact source-name match to the frozen accepted name, without certifying every historical specimen’s identity. The source does not document a dated, reproducible database-query protocol sufficient to treat a missing association as a systematic negative finding.

A corrected historical parasite attribution
更正的历史寄生虫归属

The review explicitly corrects earlier attribution of Cylindrotaenia americana to Spea multiplicata: it interprets the Walton records cited by a later checklist as Distoichometra bufonis instead. This explains the adult parasite assigned to this host in the 2023 list. It is a literature correction, not a newly dissected host or an independent reidentification of archived parasite material.
综述明确更正此前把 Cylindrotaenia americana 归于 Spea multiplicata 的记录：它把后续清单引用的 Walton 记录改归 Distoichometra bufonis。这解释了 2023 年清单中该宿主的成体寄生虫归属。属于文献更正，不是新解剖宿主或独立重鉴保存的寄生虫材料。

sections: ecology
Adult tapeworm associations in a historical North American checklist
北美历史清单中的成体绦虫关联

The 2023 review includes Plethodon cinereus among amphibian hosts with records of adult intestinal cestodes. Its named parasite associations are Cylindrotaenia americana. These describe compiled host–parasite records, not parasites measured in every member of the species. The scope is adult worms in wild continental North American herpetofauna; larval cestode records are excluded. An intestinal association alone does not establish disease severity, host mortality, zoonotic transmission or the species’ role in completing every parasite life cycle. Prevalence, intensity, examined-host denominators and experimental susceptibility are not supplied by this host checklist.

2023 年综述把 Plethodon cinereus 列为有成体肠道绦虫记录的两栖宿主；列出的寄生虫关联为 Cylindrotaenia americana。这些是汇编的宿主—寄生虫记录，不表示该种所有个体都带有这些寄生虫。范围为北美大陆野生两栖及爬行动物中的成虫，排除绦虫幼体记录。肠道关联本身不能确定疾病严重度、宿主死亡、人畜共患传播或该种在每个寄生虫生活史中的完整作用。此宿主清单没有提供感染率、感染强度、检查宿主数量分母或实验易感性。

This page uses only an exact source-name match to the frozen accepted name, without certifying every historical specimen’s identity. sections: ecology
Skin alkaloid measurements retain individuals and assay scope
皮肤生物碱测量保留个体及检测范围

In the 2024 study, Rheobates palmatus is represented by 4 frogs analysed with GC-MS. Table1 reports 1–4 detected alkaloid compounds per individual, with median 1.5. Its printed log-total-integrated-area range is 13.07–14.24, with median 14.00; these are chromatographic signal summaries, not micrograms, tissue concentration or a toxic dose. The logarithm base is not inferred from the column label. Compound counts include the source’s isomer distinctions and should not be read as numbers of independently tested toxins. The phenotype column prints undefended; defended/undefended are prior broad chemical-content bins, not measured predator-deterrence outcomes, while NA is an unassigned source category.

2024 年研究中，Rheobates palmatus 有 4 只蛙接受 GC-MS 分析。表一单个体检出生物碱化合物数为 1–4，中位数 1.5。印出的总积分面积对数范围 13.07–14.24，中位数 14.00；是色谱信号汇总，不是微克、组织浓度或毒剂量，不由列名推断对数底。化合物计数包括来源对异构体的区分，不解读为经过独立实验的毒素数量。表型列印 undefended；defended/undefended 是先前宽泛化学含量分组，不是本次测得的捕食者威慑结果；NA 保留为来源未分配类别。
methods
Collection and chemical interpretation limits
取样与化学解读限制

The GC-MS sample of Rheobates palmatus belongs to the 2014 Ecuador/Colombia collection series. Whole skins were placed in methanol after lidocaine euthanasia; species sample sizes were opportunistic, with random subsets chosen within Epipedobates. Standards were unavailable for most frog alkaloids, so absolute quantities cannot be recovered from these reported signal values. The two instrument/pipeline datasets are not directly comparable. Full-skin GC-MS results were not mass-corrected, and co-eluting compounds with the same base peak could not always be distinguished. The authors did not serially sample each species across seasons and a broad range. Raw chromatograms, vouchers and supplementary individual-level records have not been independently reanalysed here.

Rheobates palmatus 的 GC-MS 样本属于 2014 年厄瓜多尔/哥伦比亚采集系列；lidocaine 安乐死后全皮置甲醇中。物种样本量属机会性取样，Epipedobates 内选随机子集。多数蛙生物碱无标准品，不能由所报信号还原绝对数量。两仪器/流程数据不能直接比较。全皮 GC-MS 结果未按质量校正，共洗脱且同基峰化合物未必可区分。作者未逐种跨季节和广分布作连续取样。此处未独立重分析原始色谱、凭证及逐个体补充记录。
evolution
Passive accumulation remains a mechanistic hypothesis
被动积累仍是机制假说

The paper uses these skin observations in a proposed sequence from dietary toxin exposure and some resistance, through slower elimination and temporary retention, to derived transport or storage associated with sequestration. For Rheobates palmatus, a measured skin profile alone does not establish dietary origin, elimination rate, a binding mechanism or transport specifically to skin. Presence in skin does not by itself distinguish passive retention from specialised sequestration. The proposed ancestral condition and evolutionary sequence require broader sampling and tissue/time-series experiments; they are not direct observations of ancestors or a reconstructed molecular pathway in this sampled species.

Species-specific detections and their evidence limits
物种特定检出及证据限制

All four sampled skins contained detectable alkaloids. One individual represented at least four compound classes: 4,6-disubstituted quinolizidines, 3,5-disubstituted indolizidines, 3,5-disubstituted pyrrolizidines and unclassified compounds. This is not evidence that every individual has all four classes.
四个取样皮肤均检出生物碱。其中一个个体涉及至少四类化合物：4,6-二取代喹诺里西啶、3,5-二取代吲哚里西啶、3,5-二取代吡咯里西啶及未分类化合物。不表示每个个体均有四类。

In the 2024 study, Allobates kingsburyi is represented by 1 frogs analysed with GC-MS. Table1 reports 2 detected alkaloid compounds per individual, with median 2.0. Its printed log-total-integrated-area range is 13.63, with median 13.63; these are chromatographic signal summaries, not micrograms, tissue concentration or a toxic dose. The logarithm base is not inferred from the column label. Compound counts include the source’s isomer distinctions and should not be read as numbers of independently tested toxins. The phenotype column prints undefended; defended/undefended are prior broad chemical-content bins, not measured predator-deterrence outcomes, while NA is an unassigned source category.

2024 年研究中，Allobates kingsburyi 有 1 只蛙接受 GC-MS 分析。表一单个体检出生物碱化合物数为 2，中位数 2.0。印出的总积分面积对数范围 13.63，中位数 13.63；是色谱信号汇总，不是微克、组织浓度或毒剂量，不由列名推断对数底。化合物计数包括来源对异构体的区分，不解读为经过独立实验的毒素数量。表型列印 undefended；defended/undefended 是先前宽泛化学含量分组，不是本次测得的捕食者威慑结果；NA 保留为来源未分配类别。
methods
Collection and chemical interpretation limits
取样与化学解读限制

The GC-MS sample of Allobates kingsburyi belongs to the 2014 Ecuador/Colombia collection series. Whole skins were placed in methanol after lidocaine euthanasia; species sample sizes were opportunistic, with random subsets chosen within Epipedobates. Standards were unavailable for most frog alkaloids, so absolute quantities cannot be recovered from these reported signal values. The two instrument/pipeline datasets are not directly comparable. Full-skin GC-MS results were not mass-corrected, and co-eluting compounds with the same base peak could not always be distinguished. The authors did not serially sample each species across seasons and a broad range. Raw chromatograms, vouchers and supplementary individual-level records have not been independently reanalysed here.

Allobates kingsburyi 的 GC-MS 样本属于 2014 年厄瓜多尔/哥伦比亚采集系列；lidocaine 安乐死后全皮置甲醇中。物种样本量属机会性取样，Epipedobates 内选随机子集。多数蛙生物碱无标准品，不能由所报信号还原绝对数量。两仪器/流程数据不能直接比较。全皮 GC-MS 结果未按质量校正，共洗脱且同基峰化合物未必可区分。作者未逐种跨季节和广分布作连续取样。此处未独立重分析原始色谱、凭证及逐个体补充记录。
evolution
Passive accumulation remains a mechanistic hypothesis
被动积累仍是机制假说

The paper uses these skin observations in a proposed sequence from dietary toxin exposure and some resistance, through slower elimination and temporary retention, to derived transport or storage associated with sequestration. For Allobates kingsburyi, a measured skin profile alone does not establish dietary origin, elimination rate, a binding mechanism or transport specifically to skin. Presence in skin does not by itself distinguish passive retention from specialised sequestration. The proposed ancestral condition and evolutionary sequence require broader sampling and tissue/time-series experiments; they are not direct observations of ancestors or a reconstructed molecular pathway in this sampled species.
文章把这些皮肤观察用于一条提出的过程：食物毒素暴露与某种抗性，经较慢清除和暂时保留，至伴随专门富集的衍生运输或储存。对 Allobates kingsburyi，皮肤化学谱本身不确定食物来源、清除速度、结合机制或向皮肤专门运输。皮肤中出现不能单独区分被动保留与特化富集。所提祖先条件及演化序列需更广取样和组织/时间序列实验，不是直接观察祖先或在该种重建分子通路。

Skin alkaloid measurements retain individuals and assay scope
皮肤生物碱测量保留个体及检测范围

In the 2024 study, Epipedobates tricolor is represented by 2 frogs analysed with GC-MS. Table1 reports 91–114 detected alkaloid compounds per individual, with median 102.5. Its printed log-total-integrated-area range is 18.36–19.07, with median 18.72; these are chromatographic signal summaries, not micrograms, tissue concentration or a toxic dose. The logarithm base is not inferred from the column label. Compound counts include the source’s isomer distinctions and should not be read as numbers of independently tested toxins. The phenotype column prints defended; defended/undefended are prior broad chemical-content bins, not measured predator-deterrence outcomes, while NA is an unassigned source category.

2024 年研究中，Epipedobates tricolor 有 2 只蛙接受 GC-MS 分析。表一单个体检出生物碱化合物数为 91–114，中位数 102.5。印出的总积分面积对数范围 18.36–19.07，中位数 18.72；是色谱信号汇总，不是微克、组织浓度或毒剂量，不由列名推断对数底。化合物计数包括来源对异构体的区分，不解读为经过独立实验的毒素数量。表型列印 defended；defended/undefended 是先前宽泛化学含量分组，不是本次测得的捕食者威慑结果；NA 保留为来源未分配类别。
methods
Collection and chemical interpretation limits
取样与化学解读限制

The GC-MS sample of Epipedobates tricolor belongs to the 2014 Ecuador/Colombia collection series. Whole skins were placed in methanol after lidocaine euthanasia; species sample sizes were opportunistic, with random subsets chosen within Epipedobates. Standards were unavailable for most frog alkaloids, so absolute quantities cannot be recovered from these reported signal values. The two instrument/pipeline datasets are not directly comparable. Full-skin GC-MS results were not mass-corrected, and co-eluting compounds with the same base peak could not always be distinguished. The authors did not serially sample each species across seasons and a broad range. Raw chromatograms, vouchers and supplementary individual-level records have not been independently reanalysed here.

Epipedobates tricolor 的 GC-MS 样本属于 2014 年厄瓜多尔/哥伦比亚采集系列；lidocaine 安乐死后全皮置甲醇中。物种样本量属机会性取样，Epipedobates 内选随机子集。多数蛙生物碱无标准品，不能由所报信号还原绝对数量。两仪器/流程数据不能直接比较。全皮 GC-MS 结果未按质量校正，共洗脱且同基峰化合物未必可区分。作者未逐种跨季节和广分布作连续取样。此处未独立重分析原始色谱、凭证及逐个体补充记录。
evolution
Passive accumulation remains a mechanistic hypothesis
被动积累仍是机制假说

The paper uses these skin observations in a proposed sequence from dietary toxin exposure and some resistance, through slower elimination and temporary retention, to derived transport or storage associated with sequestration. For Epipedobates tricolor, a measured skin profile alone does not establish dietary origin, elimination rate, a binding mechanism or transport specifically to skin. Presence in skin does not by itself distinguish passive retention from specialised sequestration. The proposed ancestral condition and evolutionary sequence require broader sampling and tissue/time-series experiments; they are not direct observations of ancestors or a reconstructed molecular pathway in this sampled species.

COI and16S are both mitochondrial and do not constitute independent nuclear confirmation or reproductive-isolation tests. The authors use neighbor joining to cluster similar sequences, explicitly limiting its use for evolutionary-history inference. Most per-species material came from only one or two localities, and not all GenBank vouchers could be morphologically examined. Reference labels and missing sequences therefore remain evidence limits. Fieldwork took place in May–June2012 and March–April2013; GenBank/BOLD comparison queries refer to the2016 source-library snapshot, not a refreshed present-day database audit.

The six occupy one BIN and ABGD group. Their16S clade also contains GenBank references labelled batesi, schioetzi and diadematus. The authors flag inconsistent labels and a possible species complex rather than certifying those other names as local batesi synonyms. A reference-label problem needs voucher verification; it does not establish new local records of schioetzi or diadematus.
六个占一个 BIN 和 ABGD 组，16S 支还含 GenBank 标 batesi、schioetzi、diadematus 的参考。作者提示标签不一致和可能种复合体，没有认证其他名称为当地 batesi 异名。参考标签问题需凭证核实，不能建立 schioetzi 或 diadematus 当地新记录。
methods
Two mitochondrial markers and uneven references limit inference

For Astylosternus batesi, the study’s identification workflow combines COI BIN/ABGD clustering,16S reference comparison and morphology/type-locality context. COI and16S are both mitochondrial and do not constitute independent nuclear confirmation or reproductive-isolation tests. The authors use neighbor joining to cluster similar sequences, explicitly limiting its use for evolutionary-history inference. Most per-species material came from only one or two localities, and not all GenBank vouchers could be morphologically examined. Reference labels and missing sequences therefore remain evidence limits. Fieldwork took place in May–June2012 and March–April2013; GenBank/BOLD comparison queries refer to the2016 source-library snapshot, not a refreshed present-day database audit.

The five occupy four COI BINs and four ABGD groups within a wider africanus-labelled16S clade with long branches. methods
Two mitochondrial markers and uneven references limit inference
两线粒体标记及不均参考限制推断

For Phrynobatrachus africanus, the study’s identification workflow combines COI BIN/ABGD clustering,16S reference comparison and morphology/type-locality context. COI and16S are both mitochondrial and do not constitute independent nuclear confirmation or reproductive-isolation tests. The authors use neighbor joining to cluster similar sequences, explicitly limiting its use for evolutionary-history inference. Most per-species material came from only one or two localities, and not all GenBank vouchers could be morphologically examined. Reference labels and missing sequences therefore remain evidence limits. Fieldwork took place in May–June2012 and March–April2013; GenBank/BOLD comparison queries refer to the2016 source-library snapshot, not a refreshed present-day database audit.

The three occupy one BIN/ABGD group. Three subsigillata-labelled16S references differ by12–13%, while a fourth Y11975 differs by24–26% and matches ranid-like sequences more closely. The authors suspect misidentification of Y11975; this is a flagged reference problem, not a confirmed reidentification of its voucher or a newly resolved Aubria relationship.
三个占一个 BIN/ABGD 组。三个标 subsigillata 的16S 参考差12–13%，第四个 Y11975 差24–26%并更接近蛙科样序列。作者怀疑 Y11975 误鉴；是被提示的参考问题，不是确认其凭证重鉴或新解决 Aubria 关系。

For Aubria masako, the study’s identification workflow combines COI BIN/ABGD clustering,16S reference comparison and morphology/type-locality context. COI and16S are both mitochondrial and do not constitute independent nuclear confirmation or reproductive-isolation tests. The authors use neighbor joining to cluster similar sequences, explicitly limiting its use for evolutionary-history inference. Most per-species material came from only one or two localities, and not all GenBank vouchers could be morphologically examined. Reference labels and missing sequences therefore remain evidence limits. Fieldwork took place in May–June2012 and March–April2013; GenBank/BOLD comparison queries refer to the2016 source-library snapshot, not a refreshed present-day database audit.

The study reports540 sequenced specimens overall,524COI sequences and52816S sequences, assigned94BINs and85ABGD groups. Methods describe80 first-season LMR and97 second-season specimens, whereas Table1 lists79 and97 sequenced/retained entries; methods also describe275 Congo reference specimens while Table1 locality rows total274. These collection-versus-analysis counts are retained without inventing an exclusion reason. The library’s group counts are not a verified census of current accepted species. Raw traces, BOLD assignments and GenBank accessions were not independently reanalysed here.

For Sclerophrys camerunensis, the study’s identification workflow combines COI BIN/ABGD clustering,16S reference comparison and morphology/type-locality context. COI and16S are both mitochondrial and do not constitute independent nuclear confirmation or reproductive-isolation tests. The authors use neighbor joining to cluster similar sequences, explicitly limiting its use for evolutionary-history inference. Fieldwork took place in May–June2012 and March–April2013; GenBank/BOLD comparison queries refer to the2016 source-library snapshot, not a refreshed present-day database audit.

sections: ecology
Molineid nematodes in a regional literature checklist
区域文献清单中的毛圆线虫关联

The 2025 review lists Boana wavrini as a host in its Molineidae checklist, associating the written host name with Kentropyxia bakeri, Oswaldocruzia chabaudi. These are literature-compiled associations across different studies, rather than a newly examined sample or an infection measured in every member of this species. The entries designate this host as the original type host for Kentropyxia bakeri; this concerns the parasite's description, not the type specimen of the amphibian. The cited reports and archived specimens have not been independently reidentified here. The checklist does not supply this host's examined-animal denominator, prevalence, infection intensity, pathology or mortality.

2025 年综述在 Molineidae 清单中把 Boana wavrini 列为宿主，将这一文字名称与 Kentropyxia bakeri、Oswaldocruzia chabaudi 关联。这些关联汇编自不同研究，不是新检查的样本，也不表示该种所有个体都感染。条目把该宿主列为 Kentropyxia bakeri 的原始模式宿主；这是寄生虫描述中的宿主身份，不是两栖动物的模式标本。这里没有独立重鉴被引报告及保存标本。该清单没有提供本宿主检查动物数的分母、感染率、感染强度、病理或死亡率。
range
Reported parasite localities and their limits
寄生记录地点及其限制

The host entries report these parasite-associated places: Kentropyxia bakeri: Floresta Nacional de Caxiuanã [CAX; Brazil (BRA)]; Oswaldocruzia chabaudi: Floresta Nacional de Caxiuanã [CAX; Brazil (BRA)]. Codes are expanded only when the inspected methods define them; undefined abbreviations remain unresolved. These are host-specific entries, not every country in the parasite's overall distribution. No locality is invented where the row omits one. The observations span historical literature and do not demonstrate current occupancy, the amphibian's complete range, a native versus introduced status, or absence of parasites outside the reported sites. A matching frozen accepted name provides a nomenclatural link, without authenticating every historical host under the current species concept.

宿主条目报告的寄生关联地点为：Kentropyxia bakeri: Floresta Nacional de Caxiuanã [CAX; Brazil (BRA)]；Oswaldocruzia chabaudi: Floresta Nacional de Caxiuanã [CAX; Brazil (BRA)]。仅在已核读的方法段有定义时展开代码，未定义的缩写保留未解决状态。这些是该宿主的条目，不把寄生虫整体分布中的每个国家都归给此宿主；条目缺少地点时不补造。观察跨越历史文献，不能证明今日占据、两栖宿主完整分布、本土或引入状态，也不能证明其他地点没有寄生虫。固定接受名的精确对应提供名称链接，没有认证每个历史宿主都符合当前物种概念。
methods
What the bibliographic survey can establish
文献调查能支持什么结论

The review searched BioOne, ISI, Jstor, PubMed, Scielo, Scopus, Web of Science and monographs for regional molineid literature from 1819–2025. It excluded incomplete records, unpublished theses or meeting data and parasite records not identified to species. The authors also sought species-level molecular records in the literature and GenBank. Search strings and individual database search dates are not documented in the inspected methods, so omission from this list is not a reproducible negative finding. 文献调查能支持什么结论

The review searched BioOne, ISI, Jstor, PubMed, Scielo, Scopus, Web of Science and monographs for regional molineid literature from 1819–2025. It excluded incomplete records, unpublished theses or meeting data and parasite records not identified to species. The authors also sought species-level molecular records in the literature and GenBank. Search strings and individual database search dates are not documented in the inspected methods, so omission from this list is not a reproducible negative finding. The paper covers Caribbean, Panamanian and Neotropical regions using its specified divisions; this page draws on the named host entries, not an independently reconstructed global parasite inventory. Supplementary Table S1, deposited sequences and original source material have not been independently reviewed here.

Molineid nematodes in a regional literature checklist

The 2025 review lists Craugastor fitzingeri as a host in its Molineidae checklist, associating the written host name with Oswaldocruzia costaricensis. These are literature-compiled associations across different studies, rather than a newly examined sample or an infection measured in every member of this species. This host appears in the additional-host entries of the associated parasite accounts. The cited reports and archived specimens have not been independently reidentified here. The checklist does not supply this host's examined-animal denominator, prevalence, infection intensity, pathology or mortality.

range
Reported parasite localities and their limits
寄生记录地点及其限制

The host entries report these parasite-associated places: Oswaldocruzia costaricensis: CR [no matching definition in the inspected locality list], Área de Conservación Guanacaste [ACG; Costa Rica (CRI)]. Codes are expanded only when the inspected methods define them; undefined abbreviations remain unresolved. These are host-specific entries, not every country in the parasite's overall distribution. No locality is invented where the row omits one. The observations span historical literature and do not demonstrate current occupancy, the amphibian's complete range, a native versus introduced status, or absence of parasites outside the reported sites. A matching frozen accepted name provides a nomenclatural link, without authenticating every historical host under the current species concept.

Rejected historical parasite identifications remain separate
被排除的历史寄生虫鉴定单独保留

The discussion rejects the 1925 O. subauricularis report from this historical host label after a later correction by Travassos, without rejecting every other subauricularis record listed for it. It also excludes unconfirmed South American O. filiformis reports, including this host, and does not treat an O. pipiens report identified only as Leptodactylus sp. as species-level evidence for L. latrans. Paraguayan material once called O. mazzai was later assigned to O. proencai. These record-specific corrections do not establish parasite absence or validate every remaining host identification.

What the bibliographic survey can establish

morphology
Gland types describe structure rather than chemical identity

Type I glands are chiefly alveolar, with a small lumen, a single layer of secretory cells and an incomplete myoepithelial covering; they lie near the epidermis. methods
Preserved material, finger numbering and staining
保存材料、指序和染色方法

No new specimens were collected for this study. Its dendrobatoid material comprised 77 specimens representing 36 source species labels; four additional specimens represented three hylodid species, and two Melanophryniscus outgroups were taken from literature. Exact preservation histories were unknown, although the authors understood the specimens to have been formalin-fixed and stored in ethanol. They usually removed one hand, decalcified it in EDTA and made 4.5 micrometre resin sections. Multiple stains tested tissue structure, neutral and acidic mucopolysaccharides, proteins and lipids. Fingers are numbered II–V under a tetrapod homology convention, so finger IV is the third of the four remaining digits. These methods describe the comparative study; they do not supply a species-specific sample size in the inspected main-text table. Appendix S1 and Tables S1–S2 remain unread, and figures were inspected only as captions.

本研究没有新采集标本。箭毒蛙总科材料包括 77 个标本、36 个来源物种标签；另有三个溪蟾科物种的四个标本，以及从文献导入的两个 Melanophryniscus 外群。各标本精确保存史不明，作者理解为经福尔马林固定并保存在乙醇中。通常取一只手，经 EDTA 脱钙后制作 4.5 微米树脂切片，多种染色检测组织结构、中性和酸性黏多糖、蛋白质及脂质。指序依四足动物同源惯例 编为 II–V，因此 IV 指是保留的四指中的第三指。这些是比较研究的方法，已核读的主文表格没有给出该物种单独的样本数。附录 S1 和表 S1–S2 未核读；图仅检查了图注。
ecology
A proposed reproductive role remains untested
提出的繁殖功能仍未验证

The authors suggest that protein-containing specialized hand glands could mediate chemical courtship signals during contact with a female's head. They did not characterize the secretions, identify a pheromone, test female responses or establish whether delivery is olfactory or transdermal. Hand location and stain reactions therefore cannot certify that Allobates insperatus uses a particular chemical mating mechanism, causes ovulation or oviposition, or secretes an adhesive. A lack of these gland types likewise does not prove a species lacks every form of chemical communication. Behavioral observations cited in the discussion come from earlier studies and populations, not new mating experiments in this histological comparison.
作者提出，含蛋白质的特化手部腺体可能在接触雌性头部时传递化学求偶信号。研究没有表征分泌物、鉴定信息素、测试雌性反应，也没有确定嗅觉或经皮传递途径。因此，手部位置与染色反应不能认证 Allobates insperatus 使用某种化学交配机制、引发排卵或产卵，或分泌黏附物。缺少这些腺体同样不能证明该种没有任何化学交流。讨论引用的行为观察来自先前研究和种群，不是此次组织学比较的新交配实验。

sections: morphology
Hand glands in the examined adult-male evidence
所检查成体雄性证据中的手部腺体

In its preserved-specimen comparison, the study lists Anomaloglossus kaiei in the adult-male specialized mucous gland table. Types I are scored present; types II, III, IV are scored absent. These scores concern specialized glands of the hand, not the absence of ordinary mucous or serous glands, and are not prevalence estimates. A zero is a scored condition in the examined material, not proof of absence in all populations, ages or reproductive states. The species-specific specimen numbers, sex/maturity breakdown and localities require Appendix S1 and Tables S1–S2, which were not retrieved here.
研究在保存标本比较中，将 Anomaloglossus kaiei 列入成体雄性特化黏液腺表。I 型评分为存在；II、III、IV 型评分为不存在。评分针对手部特化腺体，不表示普通黏液腺或浆液腺不存在，也不是种群中的性状出现频率估计。零值是所检查材料的评分，不能证明所有种群、年龄或繁殖状态都不存在。各物种标本数、性别及成熟度构成和地点须核查附录 S1、表 S1–S2，这里未取得这些文件。
morphology
Gland types describe structure rather than chemical identity
腺体类型描述结构而非化学身份

Type I glands are chiefly alveolar, with a small lumen, a single layer of secretory cells and an incomplete myoepithelial covering; they lie near the epidermis.  The definitions combine morphology and histochemical reactions; they do not identify a particular secreted molecule or demonstrate a physiological effect.
I 型腺体主要为泡状，腔小，分泌细胞单层，肌上皮覆盖不连续，位置靠近表皮。定义结合形态及组织化学反应，不能鉴定具体分泌分子，也没有证明生理作用。
methods
Preserved material, finger numbering and staining
保存材料、指序和染色方法

No new specimens were collected for this study. Its dendrobatoid material comprised 77 specimens representing 36 source species labels; four additional specimens represented three hylodid species, and two Melanophryniscus outgroups were taken from literature. Exact preservation histories were unknown, although the authors understood the specimens to have been formalin-fixed and stored in ethanol. They usually removed one hand, decalcified it in EDTA and made 4.5 micrometre resin sections. Multiple stains tested tissue structure, neutral and acidic mucopolysaccharides, proteins and lipids. Fingers are numbered II–V under a tetrapod homology convention, so finger IV is the third of the four remaining digits. These methods describe the comparative study; they do not supply a species-specific sample size in the inspected main-text table. Appendix S1 and Tables S1–S2 remain unread, and figures were inspected only as captions.

本研究没有新采集标本。箭毒蛙总科材料包括 77 个标本、36 个来源物种标签；另有三个溪蟾科物种的四个标本，以及从文献导入的两个 Melanophryniscus 外群。各标本精确保存史不明，作者理解为经福尔马林固定并保存在乙醇中。通常取一只手，经 EDTA 脱钙后制作 4.5 微米树脂切片，多种染色检测组织结构、中性和酸性黏多糖、蛋白质及脂质。指序依四足动物同源惯例 编为 II–V，因此 IV 指是保留的四指中的第三指。这些是比较研究的方法，已核读的主文表格没有给出该物种单独的样本数。附录 S1 和表 S1–S2 未核读；图仅检查了图注。
ecology
A proposed reproductive role remains untested
提出的繁殖功能仍未验证

The authors suggest that protein-containing specialized hand glands could mediate chemical courtship signals during contact with a female's head. They did not characterize the secretions, identify a pheromone, test female responses or establish whether delivery is olfactory or transdermal. Hand location and stain reactions therefore cannot certify that Anomaloglossus kaiei uses a particular chemical mating mechanism, causes ovulation or oviposition, or secretes an adhesive. A lack of these gland types likewise does not prove a species lacks every form of chemical communication. Behavioral observations cited in the discussion come from earlier studies and populations, not new mating experiments in this histological comparison.
作者提出，含蛋白质的特化手部腺体可能在接触雌性头部时传递化学求偶信号。研究没有表征分泌物、鉴定信息素、测试雌性反应，也没有确定嗅觉或经皮传递途径。因此，手部位置与染色反应不能认证 Anomaloglossus kaiei 使用某种化学交配机制、引发排卵或产卵，或分泌黏附物。缺少这些腺体同样不能证明该种没有任何化学交流。讨论引用的行为观察来自先前研究和种群，不是此次组织学比较的新交配实验。

sections: evolution
A reference assembly in a comparative genome study
比较基因组研究中的参考组装

The study published online in December2025 and in the 2026 volume lists Discoglossus pictus assembly GCA_033576555.1, with an assembled genome-size summary of 3.87 Gbp and contig N50 3,043.6 Kbp. These describe this listed assembly and its continuity, rather than a direct measurement of DNA per cell, a universally fixed species genome size or a demonstrated ploidy. The source selected NCBI reference assemblies on 29October2024. Original sequence data, assembly quality and specimen identity have not been independently reassessed here.

2025年12月在线发表、收于2026年卷的研究列出 Discoglossus pictus 组装 GCA_033576555.1，其组装基因组大小摘要为 3.87 Gbp，contig N50 为 3,043.6 Kbp。描述的是该组装及其连续性，不是细胞 DNA 含量的直接测量、全种固定基因组大小或倍性的证明。来源在2024年10月29日选择 NCBI 参考组装；这里未独立重查原序列、组装质量及标本身份。
methods
Assembly metadata has limits
组装元数据有其限制

Table1 marks short-read sequencing, long-read sequencing, 3D-structure data for this entry. An unmarked cell is not proof that a technology was never used. The BUSCO caption names compleasm0.2.7 and tetrapoda_odb12, but its five-value score vector is not supplied with component labels in the inspected table. Those percentages are retained in evidence without choosing an assumed completeness category. The study removed three assemblies whose contig N50 was below1kb, retaining61; passing that continuity filter alone does not certify completeness, repeat recovery or a species-level biological measurement.

表 1 为此条目用 X 标记 short-read sequencing、long-read sequencing、3D-structure data。未标记不能证明从未使用某技术。BUSCO 图注提到 compleasm0.2.7 及 tetrapoda_odb12，但已核读表中没有给五值评分向量标出分量类别。百分比保留在证据中，不假定某一分量为完整率。研究排除 contig N50 低于1kb的三个组装，保留61个；仅通过连续性筛选不能认证完整性、重复序列恢复程度或种级生物学测量。
methods
Repeat annotations are computational observations
重复序列注释是计算观察

The authors built species-specific repeat libraries with RepeatModeler2, classified unknown elements with RFSB and supplemented the libraries with vertebrate repeats before applying RepeatMasker. Its hits are termed insertions in the paper, but a hit is not independently demonstrated to be a complete, expressed or mobile element. Superfamily labels can aggregate distinct families. Element counts, total occupied length and genome proportions are separate quantities; overlapping hierarchy categories cannot safely be added as independent fractions. No new repeat annotation or expression experiment for Discoglossus pictus was performed here.
作者用 RepeatModeler2 构建逐种重复库，以 RFSB 分类未知元件，加入脊椎动物重复序列后运行 RepeatMasker。文章把命中称为插入，但一次命中没有独立证明为完整、表达或可移动元件。超家族标签可汇集不同家族；元件数、占据总长度及基因组比例是不同量，层级重叠的类别不能作为独立比例相加。这里没有对 Discoglossus pictus 新做重复序列注释或表达实验。
evolution
Across-species correlations do not prove this species mechanism
跨物种相关性不能证明本种机制

The study compared61 assemblies using phylogenetically adjusted models, an earlier pruned tree, contig-N50 covariates and multiple-comparison correction. Recently active Ty3/DIRS1-associated sequences correlate with genome size across that sample, but recent activity is a divergence-based proxy, not direct observation of current transposition in this species. Length and open-reading-frame similarity filters likewise do not demonstrate active protein expression. The authors' suggested developmental constraints are comparative hypotheses; they do not establish a causal TE effect on this species' larval duration or clutch size.
研究用考虑系统关系的模型、先前裁剪的树、contig-N50 协变量及多重比较校正比较61个组装。在该样本中，近期活跃的 Ty3/DIRS1 关联序列与基因组大小相关，但“近期活跃”是依据序列分歧的代理指标，不是对本种当前转座的直接观察。长度及开放阅读框相似性筛选也不能证明蛋白质正在表达。作者提出的发育限制是比较假说，不能确立 TE 对本种幼体时长或窝卵数的因果作用。
methods

Repeat annotations are computational observations

methods
Repeat annotations are computational observations
重复序列注释是计算观察

The authors built species-specific repeat libraries with RepeatModeler2, classified unknown elements with RFSB and supplemented the libraries with vertebrate repeats before applying RepeatMasker. Its hits are termed insertions in the paper, but a hit is not independently demonstrated to be a complete, expressed or mobile element. Superfamily labels can aggregate distinct families. Element counts, total occupied length and genome proportions are separate quantities; overlapping hierarchy categories cannot safely be added as independent fractions. No new repeat annotation or expression experiment for Gastrophryne carolinensis was performed here.

evolution
Across-species correlations do not prove this species mechanism
跨物种相关性不能证明本种机制

The study compared61 assemblies using phylogenetically adjusted models, an earlier pruned tree, contig-N50 covariates and multiple-comparison correction. Recently active Ty3/DIRS1-associated sequences correlate with genome size across that sample, but recent activity is a divergence-based proxy, not direct observation of current transposition in this species. Length and open-reading-frame similarity filters likewise do not demonstrate active protein expression. The authors' suggested developmental constraints are comparative hypotheses; they do not establish a causal TE effect on this species' larval duration or clutch size.
研究用考虑系统关系的模型、先前裁剪的树、contig-N50 协变量及多重比较校正比较61个组装。在该样本中，近期活跃的 Ty3/DIRS1 关联序列与基因组大小相关，但“近期活跃”是依据序列分歧的代理指标，不是对本种当前转座的直接观察。长度及开放阅读框相似性筛选也不能证明蛋白质正在表达。作者提出的发育限制是比较假说，不能确立 TE 对本种幼体时长或窝卵数的因果作用。

sections: evolution
A reference assembly in a comparative genome study
比较基因组研究中的参考组装

The study published online in December2025 and in the 2026 volume lists Pelobates fuscus assembly GCA_024363595.1, with an assembled genome-size summary of 3.61 Gbp and contig N50 29,412.6 Kbp. These describe this listed assembly and its continuity, rather than a direct measurement of DNA per cell, a universally fixed species genome size or a demonstrated ploidy. The source selected NCBI reference assemblies on 29October2024. Original sequence data, assembly quality and specimen identity have not been independently reassessed here.

2025年12月在线发表、收于2026年卷的研究列出 Pelobates fuscus 组装 GCA_024363595.1，其组装基因组大小摘要为 3.61 Gbp，contig N50 为 29,412.6 Kbp。描述的是该组装及其连续性，不是细胞 DNA 含量的直接测量、全种固定基因组大小或倍性的证明。来源在2024年10月29日选择 NCBI 参考组装；这里未独立重查原序列、组装质量及标本身份。
methods
Assembly metadata has limits
组装元数据有其限制

Table1 marks long-read sequencing, 3D-structure data for this entry. An unmarked cell is not proof that a technology was never used. The BUSCO caption names compleasm0.2.7 and tetrapoda_odb12, but its five-value score vector is not supplied with component labels in the inspected table. Those percentages are retained in evidence without choosing an assumed completeness category. The study removed three assemblies whose contig N50 was below1kb, retaining61; passing that continuity filter alone does not certify completeness, repeat recovery or a species-level biological measurement.

表 1 为此条目用 X 标记 long-read sequencing、3D-structure data。未标记不能证明从未使用某技术。BUSCO 图注提到 compleasm0.2.7 及 tetrapoda_odb12，但已核读表中没有给五值评分向量标出分量类别。百分比保留在证据中，不假定某一分量为完整率。研究排除 contig N50 低于1kb的三个组装，保留61个；仅通过连续性筛选不能认证完整性、重复序列恢复程度或种级生物学测量。
methods
Repeat annotations are computational observations
重复序列注释是计算观察

The authors built species-specific repeat libraries with RepeatModeler2, classified unknown elements with RFSB and supplemented the libraries with vertebrate repeats before applying RepeatMasker. Its hits are termed insertions in the paper, but a hit is not independently demonstrated to be a complete, expressed or mobile element. Superfamily labels can aggregate distinct families. Element counts, total occupied length and genome proportions are separate quantities; overlapping hierarchy categories cannot safely be added as independent fractions. No new repeat annotation or expression experiment for Pelobates fuscus was performed here.
作者用 RepeatModeler2 构建逐种重复库，以 RFSB 分类未知元件，加入脊椎动物重复序列后运行 RepeatMasker。文章把命中称为插入，但一次命中没有独立证明为完整、表达或可移动元件。超家族标签可汇集不同家族；元件数、占据总长度及基因组比例是不同量，层级重叠的类别不能作为独立比例相加。这里没有对 Pelobates fuscus 新做重复序列注释或表达实验。
evolution
Across-species correlations do not prove this species mechanism
跨物种相关性不能证明本种机制

The study compared61 assemblies using phylogenetically adjusted models, an earlier pruned tree, contig-N50 covariates and multiple-comparison correction. Recently active Ty3/DIRS1-associated sequences correlate with genome size across that sample, but recent activity is a divergence-based proxy, not direct observation of current transposition in this species. Length and open-reading-frame similarity filters likewise do not demonstrate active protein expression. The authors' suggested developmental constraints are comparative hypotheses; they do not establish a causal TE effect on this species' larval duration or clutch size.
研究用考虑系统关系的模型、先前裁剪的树、contig-N50 协变量及多重比较校正比较61个组装。在该样本中，近期活跃的 Ty3/DIRS1 关联序列与基因组大小相关，但“近期活跃”是依据序列分歧的代理指标，不是对本种当前转座的直接观察。长度及开放阅读框相似性筛选也不能证明蛋白质正在表达。作者提出的发育限制是比较假说，不能确立 TE 对本种幼体时长或窝卵数的因果作用。
methods
Conflicting source identifiers prevent a repeat-data assignment
来源编号冲突阻止重复数据归属

Main Table1 links Pelobates fuscus to GCA_024363595.1, while supplementary TableS1 row23 labels Pelobates fuscus with GCF_036172605.1. That supplementary accession appears under Glandirana rugosa in main Table1. The species-name and accession correspondence therefore cannot be authenticated by simply joining these tables. The supplementary repeat counts and proportions are retained as conflicting source data, without treating them as verified traits of this accepted species. TablesS2–S3 supply55 clutch and39 larval-period rows by accession without individual provenance or unit labels in their headers; those life-history values are also withheld from species trait assignment pending reconciliation.

主文表 1 把 Pelobates fuscus 链接至 GCA_024363595.1，补充表 S1 第23行却把 Pelobates fuscus 标为 GCF_036172605.1。后一个编号在主文表 1 中属于 Glandirana rugosa。因此不能通过简单合并表格来认证名称与编号对应。补充重复序列数及比例保留为有冲突的来源数据，不当作该接受种已核实性状。S2–S3 按编号提供55行窝卵和39行幼体时长数据，表头没有逐项来源及单位标注；这些生活史值也暂不分配为种级性状，等待对应关系澄清。

跨物种相关性不能证明本种机制

The study compared61 assemblies using phylogenetically adjusted models, an earlier pruned tree, contig-N50 covariates and multiple-comparison correction. Recently active Ty3/DIRS1-associated sequences correlate with genome size across that sample, but recent activity is a divergence-based proxy, not direct observation of current transposition in this species. Length and open-reading-frame similarity filters likewise do not demonstrate active protein expression. The authors' suggested developmental constraints are comparative hypotheses; they do not establish a causal TE effect on this species' larval duration or clutch size.
研究用考虑系统关系的模型、先前裁剪的树、contig-N50 协变量及多重比较校正比较61个组装。在该样本中，近期活跃的 Ty3/DIRS1 关联序列与基因组大小相关，但“近期活跃”是依据序列分歧的代理指标，不是对本种当前转座的直接观察。长度及开放阅读框相似性筛选也不能证明蛋白质正在表达。作者提出的发育限制是比较假说，不能确立 TE 对本种幼体时长或窝卵数的因果作用。

sections: evolution
A reference assembly in a comparative genome study
比较基因组研究中的参考组装

The study published online in December2025 and in the 2026 volume lists Xenopus tropicalis assembly GCA_009364415.1, with an assembled genome-size summary of 1.45 Gbp and contig N50 14,634.3 Kbp. These describe this listed assembly and its continuity, rather than a direct measurement of DNA per cell, a universally fixed species genome size or a demonstrated ploidy. The source selected NCBI reference assemblies on 29October2024. Original sequence data, assembly quality and specimen identity have not been independently reassessed here.

2025年12月在线发表、收于2026年卷的研究列出 Xenopus tropicalis 组装 GCA_009364415.1，其组装基因组大小摘要为 1.45 Gbp，contig N50 为 14,634.3 Kbp。描述的是该组装及其连续性，不是细胞 DNA 含量的直接测量、全种固定基因组大小或倍性的证明。来源在2024年10月29日选择 NCBI 参考组装；这里未独立重查原序列、组装质量及标本身份。
methods
Assembly metadata has limits
组装元数据有其限制

Table1 marks short-read sequencing, long-read sequencing for this entry. An unmarked cell is not proof that a technology was never used. The BUSCO caption names compleasm0.2.7 and tetrapoda_odb12, but its five-value score vector is not supplied with component labels in the inspected table. Those percentages are retained in evidence without choosing an assumed completeness category. The study removed three assemblies whose contig N50 was below1kb, retaining61; passing that continuity filter alone does not certify completeness, repeat recovery or a species-level biological measurement.

表 1 为此条目用 X 标记 short-read sequencing、long-read sequencing。未标记不能证明从未使用某技术。BUSCO 图注提到 compleasm0.2.7 及 tetrapoda_odb12，但已核读表中没有给五值评分向量标出分量类别。百分比保留在证据中，不假定某一分量为完整率。研究排除 contig N50 低于1kb的三个组装，保留61个；仅通过连续性筛选不能认证完整性、重复序列恢复程度或种级生物学测量。
methods
Repeat annotations are computational observations
重复序列注释是计算观察

The authors built species-specific repeat libraries with RepeatModeler2, classified unknown elements with RFSB and supplemented the libraries with vertebrate repeats before applying RepeatMasker. Its hits are termed insertions in the paper, but a hit is not independently demonstrated to be a complete, expressed or mobile element. Superfamily labels can aggregate distinct families. Element counts, total occupied length and genome proportions are separate quantities; overlapping hierarchy categories cannot safely be added as independent fractions. No new repeat annotation or expression experiment for Xenopus tropicalis was performed here.
作者用 RepeatModeler2 构建逐种重复库，以 RFSB 分类未知元件，加入脊椎动物重复序列后运行 RepeatMasker。文章把命中称为插入，但一次命中没有独立证明为完整、表达或可移动元件。超家族标签可汇集不同家族；元件数、占据总长度及基因组比例是不同量，层级重叠的类别不能作为独立比例相加。这里没有对 Xenopus tropicalis 新做重复序列注释或表达实验。

The study published online in December2025 and in the 2026 volume lists Xenopus petersii assembly GCA_032444005.1, with an assembled genome-size summary of 2.88 Gbp and contig N50 15,295.0 Kbp. These describe this listed assembly and its continuity, rather than a direct measurement of DNA per cell, a universally fixed species genome size or a demonstrated ploidy. The source selected NCBI reference assemblies on 29October2024. Original sequence data, assembly quality and specimen identity have not been independently reassessed here.

2025年12月在线发表、收于2026年卷的研究列出 Xenopus petersii 组装 GCA_032444005.1，其组装基因组大小摘要为 2.88 Gbp，contig N50 为 15,295.0 Kbp。描述的是该组装及其连续性，不是细胞 DNA 含量的直接测量、全种固定基因组大小或倍性的证明。来源在2024年10月29日选择 NCBI 参考组装；这里未独立重查原序列、组装质量及标本身份。
methods
Assembly metadata has limits
组装元数据有其限制

Table1 marks long-read sequencing, 3D-structure data for this entry. An unmarked cell is not proof that a technology was never used. The BUSCO caption names compleasm0.2.7 and tetrapoda_odb12, but its five-value score vector is not supplied with component labels in the inspected table. Those percentages are retained in evidence without choosing an assumed completeness category. The study removed three assemblies whose contig N50 was below1kb, retaining61; passing that continuity filter alone does not certify completeness, repeat recovery or a species-level biological measurement.

表 1 为此条目用 X 标记 long-read sequencing、3D-structure data。未标记不能证明从未使用某技术。BUSCO 图注提到 compleasm0.2.7 及 tetrapoda_odb12，但已核读表中没有给五值评分向量标出分量类别。百分比保留在证据中，不假定某一分量为完整率。研究排除 contig N50 低于1kb的三个组装，保留61个；仅通过连续性筛选不能认证完整性、重复序列恢复程度或种级生物学测量。
methods
Repeat annotations are computational observations
重复序列注释是计算观察

The authors built species-specific repeat libraries with RepeatModeler2, classified unknown elements with RFSB and supplemented the libraries with vertebrate repeats before applying RepeatMasker. Its hits are termed insertions in the paper, but a hit is not independently demonstrated to be a complete, expressed or mobile element. Superfamily labels can aggregate distinct families. Element counts, total occupied length and genome proportions are separate quantities; overlapping hierarchy categories cannot safely be added as independent fractions. No new repeat annotation or expression experiment for Xenopus petersii was performed here.
作者用 RepeatModeler2 构建逐种重复库，以 RFSB 分类未知元件，加入脊椎动物重复序列后运行 RepeatMasker。文章把命中称为插入，但一次命中没有独立证明为完整、表达或可移动元件。超家族标签可汇集不同家族；元件数、占据总长度及基因组比例是不同量，层级重叠的类别不能作为独立比例相加。这里没有对 Xenopus petersii 新做重复序列注释或表达实验。
evolution
Across-species correlations do not prove this species mechanism
跨物种相关性不能证明本种机制

The study compared61 assemblies using phylogenetically adjusted models, an earlier pruned tree, contig-N50 covariates and multiple-comparison correction. Recently active Ty3/DIRS1-associated sequences correlate with genome size across that sample, but recent activity is a divergence-based proxy, not direct observation of current transposition in this species. Length and open-reading-frame similarity filters likewise do not demonstrate active protein expression. The authors' suggested developmental constraints are comparative hypotheses; they do not establish a causal TE effect on this species' larval duration or clutch size.
研究用考虑系统关系的模型、先前裁剪的树、contig-N50 协变量及多重比较校正比较61个组装。在该样本中，近期活跃的 Ty3/DIRS1 关联序列与基因组大小相关，但“近期活跃”是依据序列分歧的代理指标，不是对本种当前转座的直接观察。长度及开放阅读框相似性筛选也不能证明蛋白质正在表达。作者提出的发育限制是比较假说，不能确立 TE 对本种幼体时长或窝卵数的因果作用。
methods
Conflicting source identifiers prevent a repeat-data assignment
来源编号冲突阻止重复数据归属

Main Table1 links Xenopus petersii to GCA_032444005.1, while supplementary TableS1 row24 labels Xenopus petersii with GCA_038501925.1. That supplementary accession appears under Phrynoglossus myanhessei in main Table1. The species-name and accession correspondence therefore cannot be authenticated by simply joining these tables. The supplementary repeat counts and proportions are retained as conflicting source data, without treating them as verified traits of this accepted species. TablesS2–S3 supply55 clutch and39 larval-period rows by accession without individual provenance or unit labels in their headers; those life-history values are also withheld from species trait assignment pending reconciliation.

The study published online in December2025 and in the 2026 volume lists Rana kukunoris assembly GCA_036250615.1, with an assembled genome-size summary of 4.83 Gbp and contig N50 1,704.3 Kbp. These describe this listed assembly and its continuity, rather than a direct measurement of DNA per cell, a universally fixed species genome size or a demonstrated ploidy. The source selected NCBI reference assemblies on 29October2024. Original sequence data, assembly quality and specimen identity have not been independently reassessed here.

2025年12月在线发表、收于2026年卷的研究列出 Rana kukunoris 组装 GCA_036250615.1，其组装基因组大小摘要为 4.83 Gbp，contig N50 为 1,704.3 Kbp。描述的是该组装及其连续性，不是细胞 DNA 含量的直接测量、全种固定基因组大小或倍性的证明。来源在2024年10月29日选择 NCBI 参考组装；这里未独立重查原序列、组装质量及标本身份。
methods
Assembly metadata has limits
组装元数据有其限制

Table1 marks short-read sequencing, long-read sequencing for this entry. An unmarked cell is not proof that a technology was never used. The BUSCO caption names compleasm0.2.7 and tetrapoda_odb12, but its five-value score vector is not supplied with component labels in the inspected table. Those percentages are retained in evidence without choosing an assumed completeness category. The study removed three assemblies whose contig N50 was below1kb, retaining61; passing that continuity filter alone does not certify completeness, repeat recovery or a species-level biological measurement.

表 1 为此条目用 X 标记 short-read sequencing、long-read sequencing。未标记不能证明从未使用某技术。BUSCO 图注提到 compleasm0.2.7 及 tetrapoda_odb12，但已核读表中没有给五值评分向量标出分量类别。百分比保留在证据中，不假定某一分量为完整率。研究排除 contig N50 低于1kb的三个组装，保留61个；仅通过连续性筛选不能认证完整性、重复序列恢复程度或种级生物学测量。
methods
Repeat annotations are computational observations
重复序列注释是计算观察

The authors built species-specific repeat libraries with RepeatModeler2, classified unknown elements with RFSB and supplemented the libraries with vertebrate repeats before applying RepeatMasker. Its hits are termed insertions in the paper, but a hit is not independently demonstrated to be a complete, expressed or mobile element. Superfamily labels can aggregate distinct families. Element counts, total occupied length and genome proportions are separate quantities; overlapping hierarchy categories cannot safely be added as independent fractions. No new repeat annotation or expression experiment for Rana kukunoris was performed here.
作者用 RepeatModeler2 构建逐种重复库，以 RFSB 分类未知元件，加入脊椎动物重复序列后运行 RepeatMasker。文章把命中称为插入，但一次命中没有独立证明为完整、表达或可移动元件。超家族标签可汇集不同家族；元件数、占据总长度及基因组比例是不同量，层级重叠的类别不能作为独立比例相加。这里没有对 Rana kukunoris 新做重复序列注释或表达实验。
evolution
Across-species correlations do not prove this species mechanism
跨物种相关性不能证明本种机制

The study compared61 assemblies using phylogenetically adjusted models, an earlier pruned tree, contig-N50 covariates and multiple-comparison correction. Recently active Ty3/DIRS1-associated sequences correlate with genome size across that sample, but recent activity is a divergence-based proxy, not direct observation of current transposition in this species. Length and open-reading-frame similarity filters likewise do not demonstrate active protein expression. The authors' suggested developmental constraints are comparative hypotheses; they do not establish a causal TE effect on this species' larval duration or clutch size.
研究用考虑系统关系的模型、先前裁剪的树、contig-N50 协变量及多重比较校正比较61个组装。在该样本中，近期活跃的 Ty3/DIRS1 关联序列与基因组大小相关，但“近期活跃”是依据序列分歧的代理指标，不是对本种当前转座的直接观察。长度及开放阅读框相似性筛选也不能证明蛋白质正在表达。作者提出的发育限制是比较假说，不能确立 TE 对本种幼体时长或窝卵数的因果作用。
methods
Conflicting source identifiers prevent a repeat-data assignment
来源编号冲突阻止重复数据归属

Main Table1 links Rana kukunoris to GCA_036250615.1, while supplementary TableS1 row40 labels Rana kukunoris with GCA_029574335.1. That supplementary accession appears under Bombina variegata in main Table1. The species-name and accession correspondence therefore cannot be authenticated by simply joining these tables. The supplementary repeat counts and proportions are retained as conflicting source data, without treating them as verified traits of this accepted species. TablesS2–S3 supply55 clutch and39 larval-period rows by accession without individual provenance or unit labels in their headers; those life-history values are also withheld from species trait assignment pending reconciliation.

主文表 1 把 Rana kukunoris 链接至 GCA_036250615.1，补充表 S1 第40行却把 Rana kukunoris 标为 GCA_029574335.1。后一个编号在主文表 1 中属于 Bombina variegata。因此不能通过简单合并表格来认证名称与编号对应。补充重复序列数及比例保留为有冲突的来源数据，不当作该接受种已核实性状。S2–S3 按编号提供55行窝卵和39行幼体时长数据，表头没有逐项来源及单位标注；这些生活史值也暂不分配为种级性状，等待对应关系澄清。

A reference assembly in a comparative genome study
比较基因组研究中的参考组装

The study published online in December2025 and in the 2026 volume lists Spea multiplicata assembly GCF_000004195.4, with an assembled genome-size summary of 1.08 Gbp and contig N50 30.7 Kbp. These describe this listed assembly and its continuity, rather than a direct measurement of DNA per cell, a universally fixed species genome size or a demonstrated ploidy. The source selected NCBI reference assemblies on 29October2024. Original sequence data, assembly quality and specimen identity have not been independently reassessed here.

2025年12月在线发表、收于2026年卷的研究列出 Spea multiplicata 组装 GCF_000004195.4，其组装基因组大小摘要为 1.08 Gbp，contig N50 为 30.7 Kbp。描述的是该组装及其连续性，不是细胞 DNA 含量的直接测量、全种固定基因组大小或倍性的证明。来源在2024年10月29日选择 NCBI 参考组装；这里未独立重查原序列、组装质量及标本身份。
methods
Assembly metadata has limits
组装元数据有其限制

Table1 marks long-read sequencing for this entry. An unmarked cell is not proof that a technology was never used. The BUSCO caption names compleasm0.2.7 and tetrapoda_odb12, but its five-value score vector is not supplied with component labels in the inspected table. Those percentages are retained in evidence without choosing an assumed completeness category. The study removed three assemblies whose contig N50 was below1kb, retaining61; passing that continuity filter alone does not certify completeness, repeat recovery or a species-level biological measurement.

methods
Repeat annotations are computational observations
重复序列注释是计算观察

The authors built species-specific repeat libraries with RepeatModeler2, classified unknown elements with RFSB and supplemented the libraries with vertebrate repeats before applying RepeatMasker. Its hits are termed insertions in the paper, but a hit is not independently demonstrated to be a complete, expressed or mobile element. Superfamily labels can aggregate distinct families. Element counts, total occupied length and genome proportions are separate quantities; overlapping hierarchy categories cannot safely be added as independent fractions. No new repeat annotation or expression experiment for Spea multiplicata was performed here.

evolution
Across-species correlations do not prove this species mechanism
跨物种相关性不能证明本种机制

The study compared61 assemblies using phylogenetically adjusted models, an earlier pruned tree, contig-N50 covariates and multiple-comparison correction. Recently active Ty3/DIRS1-associated sequences correlate with genome size across that sample, but recent activity is a divergence-based proxy, not direct observation of current transposition in this species. Length and open-reading-frame similarity filters likewise do not demonstrate active protein expression. The authors' suggested developmental constraints are comparative hypotheses; they do not establish a causal TE effect on this species' larval duration or clutch size.

Table1 pairs Arthroleptis stenodactylus with the isiZulu name “Umanswininiza onyawo zingamafosholo”. Within this study's compilation, it is one of the 30 names the authors formulated by expanding the documented naming vocabulary. This is a published vernacular naming proposal or revision. 表 1 将 Arthroleptis stenodactylus 与 isiZulu 名称“Umanswininiza onyawo zingamafosholo”对应。在本研究汇编中，它作者通过扩展已记录命名词汇拟定的 30 个名称之一。这是已发表的俗名拟定或修订，不能证明工作坊参与者原已使用这个精确的物种级短语，也不是动物命名法规管理的科学异名。名称保留表中文字拼写，来源上标单独记录，不拼入名称。
methods
Workshop vocabulary and later species naming
工作坊词汇与后续物种命名

The underlying workshop used an opportunity sample of 13 volunteer native isiZulu speakers, aged18–55, from five Zululand areas: ten participants on28November and three on1December2016 at Tembe Elephant Park. Participants viewed frog photographs and discussed names collectively, resolving disagreements by discussion. The six broad names elicited during the workshop did not individually distinguish all58 species. Species-level names were assigned afterwards with Bongani Mkhize, combining this vocabulary with earlier published names and naming guidelines. These group discussions do not supply independent per-person frequencies, dialect-wide agreement, or a test of recognition accuracy for Arthroleptis stenodactylus.

基础工作坊采用机会抽样：来自祖鲁兰五个地区、18–55 岁的 13 位 isiZulu 母语志愿者，2016年11月28日十人、12月1日三人在 Tembe Elephant Park 参与。参与者观看蛙类照片，集体讨论名称，并通过讨论协调分歧。工作坊获得的六个宽泛名称并没有分别区分全部 58 个物种。物种级名称是在工作坊后，由 Bongani Mkhize 协助，结合这些词汇、先前发表的名称及命名指南拟定。群体讨论未提供独立的逐人频率、全方言一致性或对 Arthroleptis stenodactylus 的识别准确率测试。
taxonomy
What a local naming category can establish
地方命名类别能说明什么

The study distinguishes broad folk categories from the scientific species labels used in the compilation. Several folk categories span multiple scientific genera or families; their correspondence was assessed within this regional set, not across all African amphibians. Names referring to habitat, appearance, locality or calls are linguistic choices in this naming exercise. Their wording alone is not a new measurement of habitat preference, coloration, acoustic behavior or geographic restriction for Arthroleptis stenodactylus. The2019 table is also not a current occupancy survey or an exhaustive present-day Zululand checklist. No independent linguistic validation or current community-usage survey is claimed here.

研究区分了宽泛民间类别与汇编所用科学物种标签。若干民间类别跨越多个科学属或科；对应关系只在该地区物种集合中评估，并非覆盖非洲全部两栖动物。涉及栖境、外观、地点或鸣声的名称，是本次命名工作中的语言选择。仅凭措辞不能构成 Arthroleptis stenodactylus 栖境偏好、体色、鸣声行为或地理限制的新测量。2019 年表格也不是当前占据调查或现今祖鲁兰完整名录。这里没有独立语言验证或当前社区使用调查。

sections: taxonomy
A published isiZulu name and its provenance
已发表的 isiZulu 名称及其来源

Table1 pairs Breviceps sopranus with the isiZulu name “Isinana sekhwela/somtshingo”. Within this study's compilation, it is one of the 30 names the authors formulated by expanding the documented naming vocabulary. This is a published vernacular naming proposal or revision. It is not evidence that workshop participants already used this exact species-specific phrase, nor a scientific synonym governed by zoological nomenclature. Spelling is retained from the table, with its superscript provenance marker kept separate from the name.
表 1 将 Breviceps sopranus 与 isiZulu 名称“Isinana sekhwela/somtshingo”对应。在本研究汇编中，它作者通过扩展已记录命名词汇拟定的 30 个名称之一。这是已发表的俗名拟定或修订，不能证明工作坊参与者原已使用这个精确的物种级短语，也不是动物命名法规管理的科学异名。名称保留表中文字拼写，来源上标单独记录，不拼入名称。
methods
Workshop vocabulary and later species naming
工作坊词汇与后续物种命名

The underlying workshop used an opportunity sample of 13 volunteer native isiZulu speakers, aged18–55, from five Zululand areas: ten participants on28November and three on1December2016 at Tembe Elephant Park. Participants viewed frog photographs and discussed names collectively, resolving disagreements by discussion. The six broad names elicited during the workshop did not individually distinguish all58 species. Species-level names were assigned afterwards with Bongani Mkhize, combining this vocabulary with earlier published names and naming guidelines. These group discussions do not supply independent per-person frequencies, dialect-wide agreement, or a test of recognition accuracy for Breviceps sopranus.

基础工作坊采用机会抽样：来自祖鲁兰五个地区、18–55 岁的 13 位 isiZulu 母语志愿者，2016年11月28日十人、12月1日三人在 Tembe Elephant Park 参与。参与者观看蛙类照片，集体讨论名称，并通过讨论协调分歧。工作坊获得的六个宽泛名称并没有分别区分全部 58 个物种。物种级名称是在工作坊后，由 Bongani Mkhize 协助，结合这些词汇、先前发表的名称及命名指南拟定。群体讨论未提供独立的逐人频率、全方言一致性或对 Breviceps sopranus 的识别准确率测试。
taxonomy
What a local naming category can establish
地方命名类别能说明什么

The study distinguishes broad folk categories from the scientific species labels used in the compilation. Several folk categories span multiple scientific genera or families; their correspondence was assessed within this regional set, not across all African amphibians. Names referring to habitat, appearance, locality or calls are linguistic choices in this naming exercise. Their wording alone is not a new measurement of habitat preference, coloration, acoustic behavior or geographic restriction for Breviceps sopranus. The2019 table is also not a current occupancy survey or an exhaustive present-day Zululand checklist. No independent linguistic validation or current community-usage survey is claimed here.
研究区分了宽泛民间类别与汇编所用科学物种标签。若干民间类别跨越多个科学属或科；对应关系只在该地区物种集合中评估，并非覆盖非洲全部两栖动物。涉及栖境、外观、地点或鸣声的名称，是本次命名工作中的语言选择。仅凭措辞不能构成 Breviceps sopranus 栖境偏好、体色、鸣声行为或地理限制的新测量。2019 年表格也不是当前占据调查或现今祖鲁兰完整名录。这里没有独立语言验证或当前社区使用调查。

sections: taxonomy
A published isiZulu name and its provenance
已发表的 isiZulu 名称及其来源

Table1 pairs Afrixalus delicatus with the isiZulu name “Umgqagqa othambile”. Within this study's compilation, it is one of the 30 names the authors formulated by expanding the documented naming vocabulary. This is a published vernacular naming proposal or revision. It is not evidence that workshop participants already used this exact species-specific phrase, nor a scientific synonym governed by zoological nomenclature. Spelling is retained from the table, with its superscript provenance marker kept separate from the name.
表 1 将 Afrixalus delicatus 与 isiZulu 名称“Umgqagqa othambile”对应。在本研究汇编中，它作者通过扩展已记录命名词汇拟定的 30 个名称之一。这是已发表的俗名拟定或修订，不能证明工作坊参与者原已使用这个精确的物种级短语，也不是动物命名法规管理的科学异名。名称保留表中文字拼写，来源上标单独记录，不拼入名称。
methods
Workshop vocabulary and later species naming
工作坊词汇与后续物种命名

The underlying workshop used an opportunity sample of 13 volunteer native isiZulu speakers, aged18–55, from five Zululand areas: ten participants on28November and three on1December2016 at Tembe Elephant Park. Participants viewed frog photographs and discussed names collectively, resolving disagreements by discussion. The six broad names elicited during the workshop did not individually distinguish all58 species. Species-level names were assigned afterwards with Bongani Mkhize, combining this vocabulary with earlier published names and naming guidelines. These group discussions do not supply independent per-person frequencies, dialect-wide agreement, or a test of recognition accuracy for Afrixalus delicatus.

基础工作坊采用机会抽样：来自祖鲁兰五个地区、18–55 岁的 13 位 isiZulu 母语志愿者，2016年11月28日十人、12月1日三人在 Tembe Elephant Park 参与。参与者观看蛙类照片，集体讨论名称，并通过讨论协调分歧。工作坊获得的六个宽泛名称并没有分别区分全部 58 个物种。物种级名称是在工作坊后，由 Bongani Mkhize 协助，结合这些词汇、先前发表的名称及命名指南拟定。群体讨论未提供独立的逐人频率、全方言一致性或对 Afrixalus delicatus 的识别准确率测试。
taxonomy
What a local naming category can establish
地方命名类别能说明什么

The study distinguishes broad folk categories from the scientific species labels used in the compilation. Several folk categories span multiple scientific genera or families; their correspondence was assessed within this regional set, not across all African amphibians. Names referring to habitat, appearance, locality or calls are linguistic choices in this naming exercise. Their wording alone is not a new measurement of habitat preference, coloration, acoustic behavior or geographic restriction for Afrixalus delicatus. The2019 table is also not a current occupancy survey or an exhaustive present-day Zululand checklist. No independent linguistic validation or current community-usage survey is claimed here.
研究区分了宽泛民间类别与汇编所用科学物种标签。若干民间类别跨越多个科学属或科；对应关系只在该地区物种集合中评估，并非覆盖非洲全部两栖动物。涉及栖境、外观、地点或鸣声的名称，是本次命名工作中的语言选择。仅凭措辞不能构成 Afrixalus delicatus 栖境偏好、体色、鸣声行为或地理限制的新测量。2019 年表格也不是当前占据调查或现今祖鲁兰完整名录。这里没有独立语言验证或当前社区使用调查。

A species score for a specified conservation framework
特定保护框架中的物种评分

TableA4 reports DBS2, TBS0, SBS4 and total SI6 for Arthroleptis adolfifriederici. DBS weights the number of represented Rwanda ecozones and national endemism; TBS uses national red-list proposals reported by earlier research, rather than a fresh global IUCN assessment. Its score0 corresponds to LC in Table1. SBS4 corresponds to undisturbed habitats only. These are categorical inputs to this Rwanda index, not experimentally measured physiological tolerances, demonstrated responses to every land use or a newly assigned current threat status. A combined VU/DD score does not distinguish those two categories by itself.

表A4报告 Arthroleptis adolfifriederici 的DBS2、TBS0、SBS4及合计SI6。DBS对卢旺达已记录生态区数及国家特有性加权；TBS采用先前研究报告的国家红色名录建议，不是一次新的全球IUCN评估。其0分在表1对应LC。SBS4对应仅未受干扰栖境。这些是卢旺达指数的分类输入，不是实验测量的生理耐受度、针对所有土地利用的已证实反应或新赋予的当前威胁状态。合并的VU/DD分值本身不能区分这两个类别。
methods
Species Index and site index have different meanings
物种指数与站点指数含义不同

SI is the sum DBS+TBS+SBS for one species. Site RABI sums the SI of every recorded species, without dividing by species richness. Consequently, SI6 for Arthroleptis adolfifriederici is not the RABI of a site containing it, nor a probability of extinction or an effect size. Successive input categories use doubled weights: DBS1/2/4/8, TBS0/1/2/4/8 and SBS0/1/2/4. Those weights express the authors' prioritization design; they are not evidence that extinction risk or ecological sensitivity actually doubles between categories. The positive correlations reported among sub-indices also mean that their inputs are not empirically independent in this sample.

SI为一个物种的DBS+TBS+SBS。站点RABI累加全部已记录物种的SI，不除以物种丰富度。因此 Arthroleptis adolfifriederici 的SI6不是含有它的站点的RABI，也不是灭绝概率或效应量。输入类别采用倍增权重：DBS为1/2/4/8，TBS为0/1/2/4/8，SBS为0/1/2/4。这些权重表达作者的优先排序设计，不能证明灭绝风险或生态敏感度在相邻类别实际翻倍。文中报告子指数间正相关，也说明其输入在该样本中并非经验上的相互独立。
methods
Sampling and transfer limits
采样与迁移应用限制

The51 sites are unevenly distributed among ecozones: EZ1 six, EZ2 twenty-one, EZ3 eight, EZ4 two andEZ5 fourteen. The accumulation curve did not saturate; regional detections are incomplete and missing taxa may affect scores. The index is based on assembled occurrences and literature-informed categories, not a controlled habitat experiment or an independently reanalyzed time series. Applying it elsewhere requires locally defined ecozones, inventories and national threat information, with appropriate category changes. Source-wide differences remain unresolved: Results use54 taxa while Table4 total says55; EZ3 maximum RABI is38 in Results/TableA1 but33 in Table7. No field-data reanalysis, figure-pixel review or current legal protection-status verification is claimed here.

51个站点在生态区分配不均：EZ1六站、EZ2二十一站、EZ3八站、EZ4两站、EZ5十四站。累积曲线未达饱和，地区检出不完整，遗漏类群可能影响评分。指数采用汇总出现记录及文献支持的类别，不是受控栖境实验或独立重分析的时间序列。用于其他地区需地方生态区、物种清单及国家威胁信息，并适当修改类别。来源整体差异尚未解决：结果使用54个类群，表4合计却写55；EZ3最大RABI在结果及表A1为38，表7却为33。这里不声称重分析野外数据、核读图像像素或核实当前法律保护状态。

sections: range
Occurrence counts in the assembled Rwanda sample
卢旺达汇总样本中的出现计数

TableA2 lists Leptopelis bocagii at 8 of the study's51 sites; TableA3 marks EZ1, EZ3, EZ4, EZ5, with a printed total of 4 ecozones. The occurrence compilation draws on earlier studies and a taxonomic revision, using sites repeatedly sampled between2010 and2023. These are detection counts in that assembled sample, not individual abundance, occupancy probability, current site persistence or the complete native distribution. A blank ecozone cell is not demonstrated biological absence.
表A2在研究的51个站点中列 Leptopelis bocagii 于8站出现；表A3标记 EZ1, EZ3, EZ4, EZ5，生态区总数印为4。出现汇编采用先前研究及一次分类修订，站点在2010–2023年间重复采样。这是汇总样本中的检出站点计数，不是个体丰度、占据概率、当前持续存在或完整本土分布。生态区空白格不证明生物学不存在。
ecology
A species score for a specified conservation framework
特定保护框架中的物种评分

TableA4 reports DBS1, TBS0, SBS1 and total SI2 for Leptopelis bocagii. DBS weights the number of represented Rwanda ecozones and national endemism; TBS uses national red-list proposals reported by earlier research, rather than a fresh global IUCN assessment. Its score0 corresponds to LC in Table1. SBS1 corresponds to a few microhabitats in disturbed areas. These are categorical inputs to this Rwanda index, not experimentally measured physiological tolerances, demonstrated responses to every land use or a newly assigned current threat status. A combined VU/DD score does not distinguish those two categories by itself.

表A4报告 Leptopelis bocagii 的DBS1、TBS0、SBS1及合计SI2。DBS对卢旺达已记录生态区数及国家特有性加权；TBS采用先前研究报告的国家红色名录建议，不是一次新的全球IUCN评估。其0分在表1对应LC。SBS1对应干扰地区的少数微栖境。这些是卢旺达指数的分类输入，不是实验测量的生理耐受度、针对所有土地利用的已证实反应或新赋予的当前威胁状态。合并的VU/DD分值本身不能区分这两个类别。
methods
Species Index and site index have different meanings
物种指数与站点指数含义不同

SI is the sum DBS+TBS+SBS for one species. Site RABI sums the SI of every recorded species, without dividing by species richness. Consequently, SI2 for Leptopelis bocagii is not the RABI of a site containing it, nor a probability of extinction or an effect size. Successive input categories use doubled weights: DBS1/2/4/8, TBS0/1/2/4/8 and SBS0/1/2/4. Those weights express the authors' prioritization design; they are not evidence that extinction risk or ecological sensitivity actually doubles between categories. The positive correlations reported among sub-indices also mean that their inputs are not empirically independent in this sample.

SI为一个物种的DBS+TBS+SBS。站点RABI累加全部已记录物种的SI，不除以物种丰富度。因此 Leptopelis bocagii 的SI2不是含有它的站点的RABI，也不是灭绝概率或效应量。输入类别采用倍增权重：DBS为1/2/4/8，TBS为0/1/2/4/8，SBS为0/1/2/4。这些权重表达作者的优先排序设计，不能证明灭绝风险或生态敏感度在相邻类别实际翻倍。文中报告子指数间正相关，也说明其输入在该样本中并非经验上的相互独立。
methods
Sampling and transfer limits
采样与迁移应用限制

The51 sites are unevenly distributed among ecozones: EZ1 six, EZ2 twenty-one, EZ3 eight, EZ4 two andEZ5 fourteen. The accumulation curve did not saturate; regional detections are incomplete and missing taxa may affect scores. The index is based on assembled occurrences and literature-informed categories, not a controlled habitat experiment or an independently reanalyzed time series. Applying it elsewhere requires locally defined ecozones, inventories and national threat information, with appropriate category changes. Source-wide differences remain unresolved: Results use54 taxa while Table4 total says55; EZ3 maximum RABI is38 in Results/TableA1 but33 in Table7. No field-data reanalysis, figure-pixel review or current legal protection-status verification is claimed here.

51个站点在生态区分配不均：EZ1六站、EZ2二十一站、EZ3八站、EZ4两站、EZ5十四站。累积曲线未达饱和，地区检出不完整，遗漏类群可能影响评分。指数采用汇总出现记录及文献支持的类别，不是受控栖境实验或独立重分析的时间序列。用于其他地区需地方生态区、物种清单及国家威胁信息，并适当修改类别。来源整体差异尚未解决：结果使用54个类群，表4合计却写55；EZ3最大RABI在结果及表A1为38，表7却为33。这里不声称重分析野外数据、核读图像像素或核实当前法律保护状态。

Occurrence counts in the assembled Rwanda sample

TableA2 lists Ptychadena porosissima at 10 of the study's51 sites; TableA3 marks EZ3, EZ4, EZ5, with a printed total of 3 ecozones. The occurrence compilation draws on earlier studies and a taxonomic revision, using sites repeatedly sampled between2010 and2023. These are detection counts in that assembled sample, not individual abundance, occupancy probability, current site persistence or the complete native distribution. A blank ecozone cell is not demonstrated biological absence.
表A2在研究的51个站点中列 Ptychadena porosissima 于10站出现；表A3标记 EZ3, EZ4, EZ5，生态区总数印为3。出现汇编采用先前研究及一次分类修订，站点在2010–2023年间重复采样。这是汇总样本中的检出站点计数，不是个体丰度、占据概率、当前持续存在或完整本土分布。生态区空白格不证明生物学不存在。
ecology
A species score for a specified conservation framework
特定保护框架中的物种评分

TableA4 reports DBS2, TBS0, SBS0 and total SI2 for Ptychadena porosissima. DBS weights the number of represented Rwanda ecozones and national endemism; TBS uses national red-list proposals reported by earlier research, rather than a fresh global IUCN assessment. Its score0 corresponds to LC in Table1. SBS0 corresponds to the broadest tolerance category, including multiple microhabitats in disturbed areas. These are categorical inputs to this Rwanda index, not experimentally measured physiological tolerances, demonstrated responses to every land use or a newly assigned current threat status. A combined VU/DD score does not distinguish those two categories by itself.

表A4报告 Ptychadena porosissima 的DBS2、TBS0、SBS0及合计SI2。DBS对卢旺达已记录生态区数及国家特有性加权；TBS采用先前研究报告的国家红色名录建议，不是一次新的全球IUCN评估。其0分在表1对应LC。SBS0对应最宽泛的耐受类别，包括干扰地区的多种微栖境。这些是卢旺达指数的分类输入，不是实验测量的生理耐受度、针对所有土地利用的已证实反应或新赋予的当前威胁状态。合并的VU/DD分值本身不能区分这两个类别。
methods
Species Index and site index have different meanings
物种指数与站点指数含义不同

SI is the sum DBS+TBS+SBS for one species. Site RABI sums the SI of every recorded species, without dividing by species richness. Consequently, SI2 for Ptychadena porosissima is not the RABI of a site containing it, nor a probability of extinction or an effect size. Successive input categories use doubled weights: DBS1/2/4/8, TBS0/1/2/4/8 and SBS0/1/2/4. Those weights express the authors' prioritization design; they are not evidence that extinction risk or ecological sensitivity actually doubles between categories. The positive correlations reported among sub-indices also mean that their inputs are not empirically independent in this sample.

SI为一个物种的DBS+TBS+SBS。站点RABI累加全部已记录物种的SI，不除以物种丰富度。因此 Ptychadena porosissima 的SI2不是含有它的站点的RABI，也不是灭绝概率或效应量。输入类别采用倍增权重：DBS为1/2/4/8，TBS为0/1/2/4/8，SBS为0/1/2/4。这些权重表达作者的优先排序设计，不能证明灭绝风险或生态敏感度在相邻类别实际翻倍。文中报告子指数间正相关，也说明其输入在该样本中并非经验上的相互独立。
methods
Sampling and transfer limits
采样与迁移应用限制

The51 sites are unevenly distributed among ecozones: EZ1 six, EZ2 twenty-one, EZ3 eight, EZ4 two andEZ5 fourteen. The accumulation curve did not saturate; regional detections are incomplete and missing taxa may affect scores. The index is based on assembled occurrences and literature-informed categories, not a controlled habitat experiment or an independently reanalyzed time series. Applying it elsewhere requires locally defined ecozones, inventories and national threat information, with appropriate category changes. Source-wide differences remain unresolved: Results use54 taxa while Table4 total says55; EZ3 maximum RABI is38 in Results/TableA1 but33 in Table7. No field-data reanalysis, figure-pixel review or current legal protection-status verification is claimed here.

51个站点在生态区分配不均：EZ1六站、EZ2二十一站、EZ3八站、EZ4两站、EZ5十四站。累积曲线未达饱和，地区检出不完整，遗漏类群可能影响评分。指数采用汇总出现记录及文献支持的类别，不是受控栖境实验或独立重分析的时间序列。用于其他地区需地方生态区、物种清单及国家威胁信息，并适当修改类别。来源整体差异尚未解决：结果使用54个类群，表4合计却写55；EZ3最大RABI在结果及表A1为38，表7却为33。这里不声称重分析野外数据、核读图像像素或核实当前法律保护状态。

TableA4 reports DBS4, TBS2, SBS4 and total SI10 for Amietia ruwenzorica. methods
Species Index and site index have different meanings

SI is the sum DBS+TBS+SBS for one species. Site RABI sums the SI of every recorded species, without dividing by species richness. Consequently, SI10 for Amietia ruwenzorica is not the RABI of a site containing it, nor a probability of extinction or an effect size. Successive input categories use doubled weights: DBS1/2/4/8, TBS0/1/2/4/8 and SBS0/1/2/4. Those weights express the authors' prioritization design; they are not evidence that extinction risk or ecological sensitivity actually doubles between categories. The positive correlations reported among sub-indices also mean that their inputs are not empirically independent in this sample.

sections: taxonomy
Evidence roles in the Andaman toad description
安达曼蟾蜍描述中的证据角色

The2016 paper uses the source label(s) Blythophryne beryet. Table3 lists sequence entries: Blythophryne beryet: KT991336, KT991347; range/collection-location field India (A&N Islands); reference This study; tree7a/7b/7c membership +/+/+.
