methods
Comparative material does not supply every trait
比较材料并不提供全部性状

The study combines focal-toad field observations, preserved adults and larvae, osteology of selected specimens, earlier literature and mitochondrial sequence comparisons. Only material explicitly annotated as cleared-and-stained or radiographed carries that particular examination label; an unannotated voucher is not inferred to have undergone it. Generic contrasts in the paper cannot automatically become species-specific measurements for every Blythophryne beryet specimen. Historical genus size, distribution and trait summaries belong to the2016 literature context. No present-day population survey, full species diagnosis or new conservation assessment of Blythophryne beryet is established by its inclusion in this comparison.

研究结合焦点蟾蜍的野外观察、保存成体及幼体、选定标本骨骼、先前文献和线粒体序列比较。只有明确标注透明染色或放射影像的材料才保留该检查标签；不推断无标注凭证经过同样处理。文章的属级对比不能自动变成每件 Blythophryne beryet 标本的物种级测量。历史属物种数、分布及性状摘要属于2016年文献背景。纳入比较不能确立 Blythophryne beryet 的现今种群调查、完整物种鉴别或新保护评估。
evolution
Mitochondrial sampling and phylogenetic limits
线粒体采样与系统树限制

The molecular comparison concatenates partial12S and16S mitochondrial regions and uses model-based maximum-likelihood and Bayesian inference. The focal sequences are reported as417bp and551bp, respectively; alignment lengths and raw data were not independently verified. The paper reports43 species across21 genera in Table3, with a36-species broad analysis and selected Asian subtrees. Its closest-to-focal Bufoides placement in the broad tree had relatively low support and changes in restricted sampling must retain their context. Two mitochondrial regions are not independent nuclear evidence of ancestry or reproductive isolation. The paper calls distances “uncorrected k2p”; that wording is retained as a source ambiguity, not silently interpreted as an uncorrected p-distance or a universal genus-delimitation threshold.

分子比较拼接线粒体12S及16S部分区段，并使用基于模型的最大似然与贝叶斯推断。焦点序列分别报告为417bp及551bp；这里未独立验证比对长度及原数据。文章表3报告21属43种，并采用36种的宽泛分析和选定亚洲子树。宽泛树中 Bufoides 与焦点最近的位置支持度较低；缩小采样后的结果变化必须保留背景。两个线粒体区段不是关于祖先关系或生殖隔离的独立核基因证据。文章把距离称为“uncorrected k2p”，这里保留为来源措辞歧义，不静默解作未校正p距离或普适属界定阈值。
taxonomy
Type series and name-bearing specimen
模式系列与承名标本

The name-bearing holotype is female ZSI_A-12521, SVL27.4mm, collected12December2010 near Mt.Harriet at approximately175m in evergreen forest. Nine adult paratypes ZSI_A-12522–12530 and seven larval paratypes WII-115 are listed separately; the larvae came from a Rutland phytotelm. Referred adult WII-113 had an extra toe on both feet and is not described as the usual digit condition. The genus was monotypic when described. Etymology attributes beryet to a Great Andamanese expression for a small frog; the authors’ expectation of prior community knowledge is not an independently documented ethnobiological interview.

承名正模为雌性 ZSI_A-12521，SVL27.4mm，2010年12月12日采自 Mt.Harriet 附近约175m海拔常绿林。九件成体副模 ZSI_A-12522–12530 与七件幼体副模 WII-115 分别列出，幼体来自 Rutland 的植物积水穴。参照成体 WII-113 双足各有额外趾，不能当作通常趾数。属在描述时为单型。词源将 beryet 归于 Great Andamanese 语言中小蛙的表达；作者关于社区先前认识的期待并非独立记录的民族生物学访谈。
morphology
Adult characters and measurement disagreements
成体特征与测量差异

The diagnosis combines small size, a visible tympanum, no cranial ridges or vomerine teeth, elongate paired parotoid glands, webbed fingers/toes and expanded digit tips without circum-marginal grooves. Diagnosis SVL is mean24.0mm, range21.8–27.4mm; the holotype-description paragraph instead opens with mean24.2±0.6mm even though the holotype is one female of27.4mm. Table4 sex-labelled SVLs include female ZSI_A-12527 at22.7mm, below the female25.2–27.4mm range in sec17. These conflicting summaries remain separate. Diagnosis calls the male vocal sac external; the description calls it internal. Neither wording is preferred without further evidence.

鉴别组合包括小体型、可见鼓膜、无头脊或犁骨齿、成对长形耳后腺、指趾蹼及无周缘沟的扩展指趾端。鉴别给出SVL均值24.0mm、范围21.8–27.4mm；正模描述段却以均值24.2±0.6mm开头，虽然正模是单只27.4mm雌性。表4按性别列出的SVL包括22.7mm雌性 ZSI_A-12527，低于sec17雌性25.2–27.4mm范围。这些冲突摘要分别保留。鉴别将雄性声囊称为外声囊，描述却称为内声囊；在获得进一步证据前不选定其一。
morphology
Skeleton and living versus preserved coloration
骨骼及活体与保存体色

The osteological account is based on one paratype, ZSI_A12527: six presacral vertebrae, an arciferal pectoral girdle, no omosternum, a coccyx not fused to the sacrum, finger phalanges2-2-3-3 and toe phalanges2-2-3-4-3. This specimen-based account is not a population survey of skeletal variation. Living adults are described as brown or reddish-brown with variably expressed inverted-V markings; preservation changes the reported dorsal and ventral appearance. The abnormal six-toed referred specimen is explicitly exceptional, rather than a diagnostic extra toe. No stained preparation, radiograph or photograph has been independently reassessed here.
骨骼条目依据一件副模 ZSI_A12527：六枚荐前椎、弧胸型肩带、无前胸骨、尾杆不与荐椎融合，指骨式2-2-3-3、趾骨式2-2-3-4-3。这是标本条目，不是骨骼变异的种群调查。活体成体被描述为褐色或红褐色，倒V形斑纹程度不同；保存改变了报告的背腹体色。六趾参照标本明确为异常，不能把额外趾作为鉴别特征。这里未独立复核染色制备、放射影像或照片。
range
Historical island records and habitat elevations
历史岛屿记录与栖境海拔

The2016 account records SouthAndaman (Mt.Harriet), Rutland, LittleAndaman, Havelock and NorthAndaman (SaddlePeak). Ecology reports forest observations at29–250m and greater commonness above100m; the adult paratype locality account separately gives approximately150–330m. These source ranges are not silently merged into one verified elevational limit. Records characterize the inspected historical account, not current island occupancy or the complete range. The authors’ proposed Endangered status and stated criterion thresholds are recorded as a2016 proposal; no current IUCN assessment, category-threshold reconciliation or population decline is certified here.

2016年条目记录 SouthAndaman（Mt.Harriet）、Rutland、LittleAndaman、Havelock及 NorthAndaman（SaddlePeak）。生态段报告林中观察为29–250m、100m以上更常见；成体副模地点段另给约150–330m。这些来源范围不静默合并成已验证海拔界限。记录针对所核读历史条目，不是当前岛屿占据或完整分布。作者提出的濒危状态及所写标准阈值作为2016年建议记录；这里不认证当前IUCN评估、类别阈值协调或种群下降。
ecology
Leaf-perching and secretion observations
停栖叶片与分泌物观察

Adults were observed on shrub leaves at night and under forest-floor litter by day. Calling males perched about1–1.5m above ground. The article reports a white, viscous, pungent parotoid secretion during handling, and mortality of other frogs confined in the same bag. That is an uncontrolled observation, not an experimentally identified toxin, quantified dose, verified cause of death or demonstration of dietary sequestration. The suggested ecological niche and gland-related evolutionary interpretation are hypotheses; they do not establish competitive exclusion or a tested chemical-defense mechanism.

ecology
A monitored phytotelm cohort
被监测的植物积水穴群体

Axillary amplexus and eggs in rainwater-filled tree holes are reported. One Rutland phytotelm, described as roughly5×3cm across and6cm deep with3cm of water, was monitored in May2011. Seventy-three hatchlings, presumed from one clutch, were counted;25stage20 tadpoles were seen four days later after rain. The missing larvae were hypothesized to have washed out, not individually tracked to death. Stages30/35 were sampled19May and advanced stages sampled25May. This is one observed cohort, not a species-wide clutch-size distribution, survival estimate or complete-development duration. The statement that breeding begins in June must be kept alongside the May cohort, not converted into a June-only season.

Larval characters retain developmental stages

The stage35 description reports a left-sided spiracle, a median vent tube, an anteriorly opening oral disc, marginal papillae and well-developed keratinized jaw sheaths, with no denticle rows. Absence of keratodont rows does not mean absence of the jaw sheaths. Table5 groups seven preserved larvae across stages30/35/41/42/43, with stage-specific millimetre measurements; values across stages are not pooled into a single adult or species-average size. The text labels bracketed variation as standard errors, not automatically standard deviations. Preservation concentration is printed as4%formalin in one Methods passage and5% in another; those descriptions remain unresolved.
35期描述报告左侧出水孔、中央排泄管、朝前开口口盘、缘乳突及发达角质颌鞘，无角质齿列。缺乏角质齿列不等于缺乏颌鞘。表5将七件保存幼体按30/35/41/42/43期分组，提供分期毫米测量；不同发育期数值不合并为一个成体或物种平均体型。文字将括号中变异标为标准误，不能自动当成标准差。方法一段印为4%福尔马林，另一段印为5%，保存说明差异尚未解决。
ecology
An archived call with conflicting temporal units
一段具有时间单位冲突的档案鸣声

One male recorded24November2010 is linked to MacaulayLibrary ML174095. The account reports198pulses in23s and an average8.6pulses/s, with a stated8kHz frequency. It also prints0.3s per pulse and8.5s between pulses, which cannot be treated as consistent with that overall count and rate without reconciliation. The printed −3dB/20kU amplitude lacks the calibration needed for a source-level loudness measurement. These conflicting values are not silently corrected, and no raw-audio reanalysis, population call range or behavioral function experiment is claimed.
2010年11月24日录音的一只雄性链接 MacaulayLibrary ML174095。条目报告23秒内198脉冲、平均每秒8.6脉冲，以及8kHz频率；同时印出每脉冲0.3秒、脉冲间8.5秒，在未协调前不能把这些值视为与总计数及速率一致。印出的−3dB/20kU幅度缺乏声源响度测量所需校准。这些冲突值不静默修正；这里未重分析原音频，也不声称种群鸣声范围或行为功能实验。
biogeography
Alternative island-origin hypotheses remain open
岛屿起源的备选假说仍未确定

The Discussion considers dispersal across a former land connection, overseas dispersal, and survival of an isolated relict lineage. It explicitly notes limited geological evidence and poor sampling of Myanmar mountain toads as barriers to resolving sister-lineage timing and affinity. The partial mitochondrial comparison does not independently date a Cretaceous isolation event or select one route. Broad family-level dispersal proposals cited from earlier literature are not a demonstrated colonization history for this island species.

Mitochondrial sampling and phylogenetic limits

The paper calls distances “uncorrected k2p”; that wording is retained as a source ambiguity, not silently interpreted as an uncorrected p-distance or a universal genus-delimitation threshold.

The2023 study retains Pristimantis floridus among16 named members of its narrower Pristimantis myersi group, for which it proposes Trachyphrynus as a formal subgenus name. It excludes several formerly included clades rather than treating every superficially similar frog as part of this group. This is a source-specific supraspecific hypothesis; frozen accepted species identity and a complete current classification are not independently certified by it. Unnamed candidate lineages are retained under their study labels and are not assigned to Pristimantis floridus.

The2023 study retains Pristimantis leoni among16 named members of its narrower Pristimantis myersi group, for which it proposes Trachyphrynus as a formal subgenus name. It excludes several formerly included clades rather than treating every superficially similar frog as part of this group. This is a source-specific supraspecific hypothesis; frozen accepted species identity and a complete current classification are not independently certified by it. Unnamed candidate lineages are retained under their study labels and are not assigned to Pristimantis leoni.
2023年研究将 Pristimantis leoni 保留于范围缩小的 Pristimantis myersi 群组16个具名成员中，并提出以 Trachyphrynus 作正式亚属名。它排除若干此前纳入的分支，而不是把所有外观相似蛙都归入此群。这是来源特定的种上级假说，不能独立认证冻结接受种身份或完整当前分类。未命名候选谱系保留研究标签，不归属为 Pristimantis leoni。

A group definition is not an individual measurement

The revised group is described by a short snout, robust body, FingerI shorter thanII, ToeV longer thanIII and absent cranial crests, with body-size ranges pooled at group level. The paper states that no unambiguous phenotypic synapomorphies are known. Its female15.8–34.6mm and male12.6–20.5mm SVL ranges are not newly measured ranges for Pristimantis leoni. Digital discs are generally narrow in this definition, with floridus explicitly exceptional; its phylogenetic position remains untested. Group-level low-perching/ground-use statements are not independent observations of every population or life stage.
修订群组描述包括短吻、体躯粗壮、第一指短于第二指、第五趾长于第三趾及无头脊，体型范围在群组层级汇总。文章指出没有已知的无歧义表型共有衍征。雌性15.8–34.6mm及雄性12.6–20.5mm SVL范围不是 Pristimantis leoni 新测得范围。该定义的指盘通常较窄，但 floridus 明确例外，其系统位置尚未测试。群组低位停栖/地面利用陈述不是每个种群或生命阶段的独立观察。

The reported placement must retain the study’s specimen identifications and sampling limits. Analyses use mitochondrial16S and model-based trees, with2% uncorrected p-distance as a candidate-screening heuristic. Some reported candidate comparisons span1.3–2.2% or1.5–2.9%; the rule is not uniformly exceeded by every pair. Reciprocal mitochondrial monophyly and divergence do not alone demonstrate nuclear independence or reproductive isolation. Methods mention760/219 terminals while analyses report742/215; those counts are kept separate. Raw chromatograms, aligned datasets and distance matrices have not been independently inspected here.

The authors sample leoni from six northern-Ecuador localities including Nudo deMojanda topotypes, recovering it as sister to unnamed sp.13. Reported pairwise divergence between them is1.3–2.2%, which overlaps below the paper’s2% candidate threshold. The older leoni-labelled KU218227/EF493684 is reassigned to sp.18, not retained as evidence for the new leoni clade. Results call sp.13 UCC but Discussion calls it CCS; the candidate-confidence difference remains unresolved.

Membership in a revised rainfrog group
修订雨蛙群组中的成员关系

The2023 study retains Pristimantis onorei among16 named members of its narrower Pristimantis myersi group, for which it proposes Trachyphrynus as a formal subgenus name. It excludes several formerly included clades rather than treating every superficially similar frog as part of this group. This is a source-specific supraspecific hypothesis; frozen accepted species identity and a complete current classification are not independently certified by it. Unnamed candidate lineages are retained under their study labels and are not assigned to Pristimantis onorei.
2023年研究将 Pristimantis onorei 保留于范围缩小的 Pristimantis myersi 群组16个具名成员中，并提出以 Trachyphrynus 作正式亚属名。它排除若干此前纳入的分支，而不是把所有外观相似蛙都归入此群。这是来源特定的种上级假说，不能独立认证冻结接受种身份或完整当前分类。未命名候选谱系保留研究标签，不归属为 Pristimantis onorei。

A group definition is not an individual measurement
群组定义不是个体测量

The revised group is described by a short snout, robust body, FingerI shorter thanII, ToeV longer thanIII and absent cranial crests, with body-size ranges pooled at group level. The paper states that no unambiguous phenotypic synapomorphies are known. Its female15.8–34.6mm and male12.6–20.5mm SVL ranges are not newly measured ranges for Pristimantis onorei. Digital discs are generally narrow in this definition, with floridus explicitly exceptional; its phylogenetic position remains untested. Group-level low-perching/ground-use statements are not independent observations of every population or life stage.
修订群组描述包括短吻、体躯粗壮、第一指短于第二指、第五趾长于第三趾及无头脊，体型范围在群组层级汇总。文章指出没有已知的无歧义表型共有衍征。雌性15.8–34.6mm及雄性12.6–20.5mm SVL范围不是 Pristimantis onorei 新测得范围。该定义的指盘通常较窄，但 floridus 明确例外，其系统位置尚未测试。群组低位停栖/地面利用陈述不是每个种群或生命阶段的独立观察。

Single-marker lineages and candidate thresholds
单标记谱系与候选阈值

The reported placement must retain the study’s specimen identifications and sampling limits. Analyses use mitochondrial16S and model-based trees, with2% uncorrected p-distance as a candidate-screening heuristic. Some reported candidate comparisons span1.3–2.2% or1.5–2.9%; the rule is not uniformly exceeded by every pair. Reciprocal mitochondrial monophyly and divergence do not alone demonstrate nuclear independence or reproductive isolation. Methods mention760/219 terminals while analyses report742/215; those counts are kept separate. Raw chromatograms, aligned datasets and distance matrices have not been independently inspected here.
报告位置必须保留研究标本鉴定及采样限制。分析使用线粒体16S及基于模型的系统树，以2%未校正p距离作为候选筛查经验规则。有些候选比较范围为1.3–2.2%或1.5–2.9%，并非每个配对都超过规则。线粒体互惠单系及分歧本身不能证明核基因独立或生殖隔离。方法提到760/219终端，分析却报告742/215，两类计数分别保留。这里未独立检查原峰图、比对数据及距离矩阵。

The sampled onorei includes four locality areas spanning Pichincha, Imbabura and Cotopaxi, including Otonga topotypes. Sympatric lucidosignatus topotypes are intermixed with it; distances between those topotypic labels are0.0–0.3%, while comparisons involving Toisán samples rise to0.9–2.9%. The differing geographic comparisons must not be collapsed into one universal species cutoff. Possible lucidosignatus synonymy remains a hypothesis in this account.

sections: taxonomy
Membership in a revised rainfrog group
修订雨蛙群组中的成员关系

The2023 study retains Pristimantis pyrrhomerus among16 named members of its narrower Pristimantis myersi group, for which it proposes Trachyphrynus as a formal subgenus name. It excludes several formerly included clades rather than treating every superficially similar frog as part of this group. This is a source-specific supraspecific hypothesis; frozen accepted species identity and a complete current classification are not independently certified by it. Unnamed candidate lineages are retained under their study labels and are not assigned to Pristimantis pyrrhomerus.

2023年研究将 Pristimantis pyrrhomerus 保留于范围缩小的 Pristimantis myersi 群组16个具名成员中，并提出以 Trachyphrynus 作正式亚属名。它排除若干此前纳入的分支，而不是把所有外观相似蛙都归入此群。这是来源特定的种上级假说，不能独立认证冻结接受种身份或完整当前分类。未命名候选谱系保留研究标签，不归属为 Pristimantis pyrrhomerus。

A group definition is not an individual measurement
群组定义不是个体测量

The revised group is described by a short snout, robust body, FingerI shorter thanII, ToeV longer thanIII and absent cranial crests, with body-size ranges pooled at group level. The paper states that no unambiguous phenotypic synapomorphies are known. Its female15.8–34.6mm and male12.6–20.5mm SVL ranges are not newly measured ranges for Pristimantis pyrrhomerus. Digital discs are generally narrow in this definition, with floridus explicitly exceptional; its phylogenetic position remains untested. Group-level low-perching/ground-use statements are not independent observations of every population or life stage.

Reciprocal mitochondrial monophyly and divergence do not alone demonstrate nuclear independence or reproductive isolation. Methods mention760/219 terminals while analyses report742/215; those counts are kept separate. Raw chromatograms, aligned datasets and distance matrices have not been independently inspected here.

These are source-level comparative statements based partly on earlier descriptions, not newly checked measurements of every Pristimantis jubatus specimen. Lack of vocal slits is not automatically lack of calling, and a cited arboreal-versus-ground-use contrast is not an experimental test of climbing performance or a species-wide habitat survey.
讨论以较扩展指盘及腹褶将先前加入的verecundus/jubatus分支与较窄myersi群组对比，另指出celator及jubatus缺乏声裂。这是部分依据先前描述的来源比较陈述，不是每件 Pristimantis jubatus 标本的新核读测量。缺乏声裂不自动等于不鸣叫；引用的树栖/地面利用对比也不是攀爬性能实验或全种栖境调查。

Reported donor codes and sequence sources

evolution
Two named donors and an unnamed candidate

sourceConcept: 2020 Abra de Zamora treatment under Rhinella margaritifera; local species-complex identity explicitly unresolved; exact frozen-name match is not full concept authentication

sections: taxonomy
The local identification remains provisional
当地鉴定仍属暂定

The paper uses the name Rhinella margaritifera but explicitly states that the precise identity of the Abra de Zamora population remains to be confirmed because it belongs to a species complex. This page keeps that source label and qualification together. An exact match to a frozen accepted name does not authenticate the local population as the nominal species, and its locality and traits are not transferred to every population bearing the name.
文章使用Rhinella margaritifera名称，但明确说Abra de Zamora种群属于种复合群，精确身份仍待确认。页面同时保留来源标签和限定。与冻结接受名称精确匹配不认证当地种群就是名义种，也不把其地点和特征转移到所有使用该名称的种群。
morphology
Crests, parotoids and dorsal texture used locally
当地用于鉴别的棱脊、腮腺与背部纹理

For identification among the frogs recorded in this area, the authors cite developed canthal, antorbital and supraorbital crests, larger in females, small triangular parotoid glands and granular dorsal skin with many small tubercles. These are the revision’s local comparative characters, partly based on earlier literature. They are not a molecular resolution of the complex, a newly measured toxin profile or a quantified sex difference from a stated sample here.
在该区已记录蛙类之间，作者引用发达吻棱、眼前棱及眼上棱，雌性更大，小型三角腮腺，及有许多小疣的颗粒状背部皮肤。它们是修订的当地比较特征，部分依据先前文献，不是种复合群的分子解决、新测毒素谱或这里有明确样本的定量性别差异。
range
An eastern-slope record under the unresolved label
未解决标签下的东坡记录

The local identification account describes a small frog with whitish or yellowish coloration and pale brown stripes, a yellowish-orange iris and low ridges on the dorsal skin. These characters distinguish it within the reported local assemblage; they are not new measured body-size distributions or proof that each color variant represents a separate lineage.

sections: morphology
Green coloration and expanded finger discs

The authors cite bright green dorsal coloration, a green iris, an acuminate snout, flared lips, serrated cranial crests especially in females, a conical upper-eyelid tubercle and greatly expanded truncate discs on FingersII–IV. These are local comparative identification characters drawn from earlier work. Expanded discs alone do not quantify climbing performance, and the account does not newly measure sex differences or chemical coloration mechanisms.

A record near El Tambo around1900m

Galdi is reported as uncommon on the eastern slope near El Tambo, in evergreen lower montane forest around1900m. The approximate elevation and frequency category are preserved; they are not an exact georeferenced voucher location or standardized abundance estimate. The locality does not define the species’ entire range.

evolution

Methods list galdi among outgroups for the orestes-group tree and the Huicundomantis analysis. This is an analytical role using sequence data, separate from the local natural-history account. sections: taxonomy
A restricted concept and an older Yangana sequence
较窄概念与较早Yangana序列

The revision contrasts female MUTPL342 from Cajanuma, collectedJune2018 about13km south of the type locality, with the widely reused1990 Yangana specimen KU218210 more than60km south. It reports3.1% uncorrected16S distance and treats the Yangana animal as a different undescribed species, using a3% heuristic plus comparative morphology. This does not name that candidate or establish a universal threshold. No type-locality individual was rediscovered; the association of Cajanuma with flavomaculatus remains the authors’ taxonomic interpretation.

修订对比2018年6月采于Cajanuma、距模式地点向南约13公里的雌性MUTPL342，及距模式地点南方逾60公里、被广泛重复使用的1990年Yangana标本KU218210。作者报告未校正16S距离3.1%，以3%经验阈值及比较形态把Yangana个体解释为另一未描述种。它未命名候选，也不确立通用阈值。未再发现模式地点个体；Cajanuma与flavomaculatus的联系仍是作者分类解释。
morphology
Diagnosis and mixed-concept size data
诊断与可能混合概念的体型数据

The diagnosis describes granular-looking shagreen dorsal skin, a low mid-dorsal fold, smooth ventral skin, a distinct tympanum and narrow unexpanded digit tips without circumferential grooves or toe webbing. MUTPL342 lacked discoidal and thoracic folds in life and preservative, unlike nearby candidate populations. Published female34.6–44.2mm (n31) and male24.0–35.2mm (n27) SVL ranges pool several localities and may include cryptic species; they are not certified size limits of the restricted concept.
诊断描述细粒状背皮、低背中褶、光滑腹皮、明显鼓膜、无环沟的狭窄未扩展趾端及无趾蹼。MUTPL342活体及保存状态均无腹褶和胸褶，与附近候选种群不同。所引雌性34.6–44.2毫米（n31）、雄性24.0–35.2毫米（n27）吻肛长来自多个地点，可能混入隐存种，不认证为较窄概念体长界限。
ecology
A handled female’s release-call interpretation
受操作雌性的释放鸣声解释

Female MUTPL342 produced brief low screeches while held in the laboratory to simulate amplexus. Six measured notes lasted0.026–0.041s, with dominant frequency2239.5–3100.8Hz. The authors interpret these as release calls rather than predator-distress calls, partly by comparison with an undescribed species. The six notes come from one female, not six independent animals. The advertisement call remains unknown in the revision; original audio was not independently inspected here.
雌性MUTPL342在实验室被持握模拟抱对时发出短促低尖声。六个测量音持续0.026–0.041秒，主频2239.5–3100.8赫兹。作者部分通过与未描述种比较解释为释放鸣声而非捕食压力鸣声。六个音来自一只雌性，不是六只独立动物。修订中求偶鸣声仍未知；这里未独立核听原录音。
range
Cajanuma and historically broader records
Cajanuma及历史较广记录

DNA-associated presence under the restricted concept is reported only at Cajanuma, in shrub páramo about13km south of Abra de Zamora, with encounter elevations3000–3250m. Yangana, San Lucas/Saraguro, Morona Santiago and Peruvian records are discussed as different or potentially different undescribed taxa, with differing evidence strength. Geographic distance alone is not a completed species diagnosis, and no accepted names are assigned to these candidates.
较窄概念下与DNA关联的出现仅报告于Cajanuma，距Abra de Zamora南方约13公里的灌丛高山草甸，遇见海拔3000–3250米。Yangana、San Lucas/Saraguro、Morona Santiago及秘鲁记录分别讨论为不同或可能不同未描述类群，证据强度不同。地理距离本身不是完整物种诊断，不给候选赋予接受名称。
ecology
Eggs, microhabitat and a dated conservation proposal
卵、微栖境及有日期的保护提议

MUTPL342 emerged from a thick moss bed and contained31large unpigmented eggs; her SVL was42.5mm and body mass8.21g. This is one female’s ovarian count, not a laid clutch or developmental observation. The paper cites44historical type-locality specimens from1968–1984 but no new ones despite searches since2016; low detectability prevents a conclusive decline estimate. Against a cited Data Deficient listing, the authors propose Endangered with EOO/AOO under50km² and suspected losses of locations. That2020 proposal is not a verified current assessment.
MUTPL342从厚苔藓层中出现，体内有31枚大型无色素卵；吻肛长42.5毫米、体重8.21克。这是一只雌性的卵巢计数，不是已产卵窝或发育观察。文章引用1968–1984年模式地点44件历史标本，但2016年以来搜索无新个体；低检出率妨碍确证衰退估计。相对所引数据缺乏等级，作者按EOO/AOO不足50平方公里及疑似地点损失提议濒危。该2020年提议不是已核实当前评估。

evolution
Selected16S distances with exact donor and cell scope

The independently read S3 cells give Cajanuma versus historical Yangana: 1 pair, 3.12%. Values are uncorrected16S pairwise percentages in the source’s stated unit; the page rounds to two decimals while preserving full supplied values and cell addresses in the extraction receipt. Frequent calls under a qualified identification

The2020 name and its type series
2020年名称与模式系列

Female holotype MUTPL357 was collected28June2018 at Cajanuma’s Los Miradores trail,3258m. The paratypes comprise three females, three males and one juvenile from Cajanuma and Abra de Zamora. The publication supplies a ZooBank nomenclatural act and a combined morphological/phylogenetic diagnosis. These published registrations and specimen citations are retained without claiming an independent museum audit.
雌性正模MUTPL357于2018年6月28日采于Cajanuma的Los Miradores步道、3258米。副模含来自Cajanuma与Abra de Zamora的三雌、三雄及一幼体。出版物提供ZooBank命名行为及结合形态/系统发育的诊断。保留发表注册及标本引用，不声称独立馆藏审计。
morphology
Sex-specific sizes and contrasting coloration
分性别体长与颜色对比

Female SVL is17.1–20.7mm (19.3±1.58SD,n4), male14.7–16.9mm (16.0±1.17,n3). The diagnosis combines no tympanic membrane/annulus, evident thoracic/discoidal folds, no dorsolateral folds and only slightly expanded rounded discs. Females are dark brown with irregular white spots and darker venters; sampled males are lighter brown to red without those white spots. These small-sample differences do not establish inheritance or environmental causes of sexual coloration.
雌性吻肛长17.1–20.7毫米（19.3±1.58标准差，n4），雄性14.7–16.9毫米（16.0±1.17，n3）。诊断组合为无鼓膜/鼓环、明显胸褶/腹褶、无背侧褶及仅略扩展圆盘。雌性深褐具不规则白点、腹面较暗；采样雄性较浅褐至红且无这些白点。小样本差异不确立性别颜色的遗传或环境原因。
ecology
Usually two notes, with a recording caveat
通常双音及录音限定

Five males from Abra de Zamora and Cajanuma were recorded in2017–2018. Clicking calls usually have two notes, but MUTPL356’s record had one, possibly an artifact according to the authors. Table2 reports116call-duration measurements averaging0.027±0.008s, five-male rate185.9±25.398calls/min and294dominant-frequency measurements averaging3140.3±144.886Hz. These sampling units differ. Comparisons with vidua and tiktik are descriptive, not controlled temperature-normalized tests or proof of reproductive isolation.
2017–2018年录制Abra de Zamora及Cajanuma五只雄性。点击鸣声通常双音，但MUTPL356录音为单音，作者认为可能是录音伪影。表2报告116次时长测量平均0.027±0.008秒，五雄速率185.9±25.398次/分钟，294次主频测量平均3140.3±144.886赫兹。采样单位不同。与vidua及tiktik比较为描述性，不是温度标准化受控检验或生殖隔离证明。
range
Two neighboring sites and low perches
两个邻近地点与低位停栖

The revision knows the species from Cajanuma and Abra de Zamora about13km north, with encounters2560–3300m in upper montane forest, subpáramo and shrub páramo. Individuals were found at night, often5–20cm above ground in grassy bases, moss beds or shrub leaves. Males called year round, especially on rainy nights; females were found close to calling males. These are field observations, not an observed mating success or a demonstrated exclusive habitat requirement.
修订所知地点为Cajanuma及北方约13公里Abra de Zamora，遇见于2560–3300米上山地林、亚高山草甸及灌丛高山草甸。个体夜间出现，常离地5–20厘米，位于草基、苔藓层或灌木叶。雄性全年鸣叫，雨夜较频繁；雌性遇于鸣叫雄性附近。这是野外观察，不是已观察交配成功或已证明专一栖境需求。
evolution
A supported subgroup but weak closest-relative resolution
获支持亚组与较弱近亲解析

The species is assigned to the simonbolivari subgroup; its apparent closest association with quintanai and an undescribed species has only weak Bayesian support. The paper reports16S distances4.8–6.0% to tiktik and6.7–7.3% to bambu. Subgroup membership and those comparisons do not settle every internal branch or define a universal species threshold.
该种归入simonbolivari亚组；与quintanai及未描述种表观最接近联系只有较弱贝叶斯支持。论文报告与tiktik的16S距离4.8–6.0%，与bambu为6.7–7.3%。亚组归属及比较不解决每个内部分支，也不定义通用物种阈值。
ecology
Near Threatened is the authors’2020 proposal
近危为作者2020年提议

Despite two close localities and an estimated area below50km², the authors recommend Near Threatened because encounters were relatively frequent and most reported population habitat lay inside the national park without major then-observed threats. This combines limited distribution with the authors’ habitat interpretation; it does not certify a current assessment or prove immunity to future habitat loss or disease.
虽只有两个邻近地点及估计不足50平方公里面积，作者因遇见相对频繁、多数报告种群栖境位于国家公园内且当时未见重大威胁，建议近危。这结合有限分布与作者栖境解释，不认证当前评估，也不证明免于未来栖境丧失或疾病。

The diagnosis emphasizes short stocky fingers/toes, absent tympanic membrane/annulus and supratympanic fold, areolate dorsal/ventral skin, lateral digit fringes and males without vocal sac/slits. Restricted local records and unconfirmed historical extensions

DNA-associated presence is reported only in a small part of Abra de Zamora, mostly outside the national park, with recent encounters2800–2820m. The holotype citation is female KU142151 from the crest at2800m, collected22July1971. Only five specimens were encountered during2016–2020. Short digits are proposed adaptations that may improve adhesion, not experimentally tested performance. No calling males were heard and the advertisement call remains unknown; absence of observed calling is not proof of inability to call.

The2020 description designates adult male MUTPL731, collected6August2019 at Abra de Zamora,2815m, as holotype. Seven paratypes comprise four females, two males and one juvenile from that locality and Cajanuma. Published type citations and the ZooBank act anchor the source name; no independent examination of the specimens or registry is certified here.

Size, tympanum and digit proportions

Female SVL is20.8–23.3mm (22.5±1.12SD,n4), male19.9–21.2mm (20.4±0.68,n3); the male holotype is20.2mm and0.50g. The diagnosis combines no tympanic membrane/annulus or supratympanic fold, finely tuberculate dorsal skin, slightly expanded truncate discs and lateral digit fringes. Compared with colodactylus, relative hand and foot lengths are longer in the reported samples, with inner-tarsal folds and no single large heel tubercle. These proportional contrasts do not directly measure locomotor performance.
雌性吻肛长20.8–23.3毫米（22.5±1.12标准差，n4），雄性19.9–21.2毫米（20.4±0.68，n3）；雄性正模20.2毫米、0.50克。诊断组合为无鼓膜/鼓环或鼓上褶、细疣背皮、略扩展截形指趾盘及侧缘。相对colodactylus，报告样本手足相对长度较长，具内跗褶且无单一大跟疣。比例对比不直接测量运动性能。

Bromeliad use and an unknown advertisement call
凤梨科利用与未知求偶鸣声

Individuals were found in or next to terrestrial and arboreal bromeliads by day and night, and retreated into plant-held water when threatened. The authors call the species common in that microhabitat. No calling males were heard; males lack vocal sac/slits and the advertisement call is unknown. These observations do not demonstrate complete life-cycle confinement to bromeliads, inability to vocalize or a quantified abundance relative to all habitats.

The source reports Abra de Zamora and Madrigal about9km south, encounters2770–2960m in subpáramo, and most Abra specimens outside the national park. Variable color and measured adult samples

The diagnosis combines fine dorsal tubercles, evident thoracic/discoidal folds, prominent tympanum, broad elliptical discs, no toe webbing, males without vocal sac/slits but with nuptial pads, and variable brown/green patterning. Female SVL29.4–32.2mm averages30.8±1.40SD (n3); male22.9–25.4mm averages24.0±1.08 (n4). Juveniles may appear coarser. Color variants are individual observations, not proof of distinct taxa or measured genetic control.

Table2 reports109duration measurements averaging0.084±0.006s, four-male rate30.3±3.138calls/min and139dominant-frequency measurements averaging1753.6±80.323Hz. The text separately reports double-note0.403s and five-note1.211s means,6–14pulses/note and mean pulse rate114.58/s. Suggested social triggers and the link between quiet sound and absent sac/slits are hypotheses, not controlled causal tests.

DNA-associated records are reported from Cerro Plateado, Tapichalaca, Lagunas del Compadre, Madrigal, Abra de Zamora and Ramos Urcu, with encounters2440–3380m. Southern Cerro Plateado/Tapichalaca populations differ by about2%16S from type-locality/northern animals and require careful revision. Peruvian records are considered probably different by the authors, not reassigned here. Named record lists and unresolved population boundaries are retained together.

The species was among the most frequently encountered frogs in higher Abra de Zamora. Animals were found at night on vegetation30cm–1.5m high or in bromeliads, and calling males were encountered year round, especially on rainy nights. Relative frequency is not a density estimate; occurrence in bromeliads does not demonstrate specialization identical to colodactylus or matildae.

The main text and inspected main tables are now complemented by independent reading of supplementalS4 acoustic metadata/summaries andS5 inventory rows. Office files were obtained from PLOS, SHA256-recorded and extracted without modifying the originals. Original recordings, voucher specimens and sequence alignments remain independently unreviewed. Eight selected S3 comparisons have now been read; the other matrix values are unreviewed. S2 accession/voucher mappings and the appendix specimens have only been extracted, not authenticated. Supplied acoustic totals are not recomputed audio measurements; source disagreements and qualified population concepts remain explicit.

Supplementary TableS5 lists Pristimantis versicolor on the crest, eastern slope, with “no” under endemic to Abra and nearby areas, historical IUCN column code“LC” and “Yes” for encountered in the last ten years. These are the authors’2020 inventory fields; “yes” endemism is not a global exhaustive search, and “no” is not a demonstrated absence elsewhere. The IUCN column is kept separate from revised conservation proposals in the main text; its codes are not refreshed current assessments. The rolling ten-year label is relative to the source, not to today. Qualified local identities in the main treatment, including margaritifera and andinognomus, remain unresolved despite the exact-name row.

The workbook links four records to FUTPL-A233–236, with only the FUTPL-A234 row giving voucher MUTPL112 and the others “no”. Separate columns retain single-, two- and five-note call duration. The supplied pulse-rate summary is114.58±21.640/s over60measurements across four reported males. Air temperatures13.5–14°C and humidity81.5–83.5% describe recording conditions. They do not authenticate every donor specimen, demonstrate temperature-independent calls or imply60independent animals. Original audio remains unreviewed.

The sampled relationship retains support and label limits

The paper first reports buenaventura’s molecular placement. It falls in a supported wider clade including cariticommatus, griffithsi, wileyi and several later-named or unnamed lineages, but is not sister to geographically closer, morphologically similar griffithsi. The buenaventura–southern aff.cochranae QCAZ-A31340 relationship has low support, so the nearest relative remains unconfirmed. The approximately5Ma split is a secondary-calibrated tree estimate, not a direct fossil date.

sections: taxonomy
The Manduriacu glassfrog description
Manduriacu玻璃蛙的描述

The2019 study describes Nymphargus manduriacu from Río Manduriacu Reserve, Imbabura, Ecuador. Its name refers to that reserve, and its suggested common names are Manduriacu glassfrog and Rana de Cristal de Manduriacu. Morphology and mitochondrial placement support its assignment to Nymphargus under the authors’ generic concept. The printed LSID is a publication identifier, urn:lsid:zoobank.org:pub:E5C0E7E4-9C69-4830-A514-AD1F4B80311C; it is not silently relabelled as a separate nomenclatural-act identifier.

2019年研究描述厄瓜多尔Imbabura的Río Manduriacu保护区Nymphargus manduriacu，名称指此保护区，建议俗名Manduriacu glassfrog及Rana de Cristal de Manduriacu。形态及线粒体位置支持在作者属概念下归Nymphargus。所印LSID为出版标识urn:lsid:zoobank.org:pub:E5C0E7E4-9C69-4830-A514-AD1F4B80311C，不静默改标为另一命名行为标识。
occurrence
The voucher-linked type series
凭证相连的模式系列

The male holotype ZSFQ0466 was collected7February2018 at0.310755°N,78.8569°W,1215m. Male paratype0465 shares those collection data; female0462 andmale0463 were collected6February2018 at another stream,0.310818°N,78.857°W,1230m. Metamorph0464 is referred material. Figure4 labels its illustrated metamorph ZSFQ618, whereas the referred-material paragraph gives0464; those identifiers are retained separately, not assumed equivalent. The paper supplies literature-linked specimen records, not new independent museum authentication.

雄性正模ZSFQ0466于2018年2月7日采于0.310755°N、78.8569°W、1215m。雄性副模0465共享采集数据；雌性0462及雄性0463于2018年2月6日在另一溪流0.310818°N、78.857°W、1230m采集。变态后个体0464为归入材料。图4所示变态个体标ZSFQ618，归入材料段却给0464；分别保留编号，不假定等价。论文提供文献相连标本记录，不是新独立博物馆认证。
morphology
Spotting, membranes and live coloration
斑点、膜与活体彩色

The diagnosis gives greyish-to-olive green dorsal skin with yellow spots, sometimes surrounded by poorly defined black rings called false ocelli. Live bones are green; the iris is light grey with thin dark reticulations and pale yellow around the pupil. Males lack a projecting humeral spine and have dorsal microspicules; the reported female lacks them. The white parietal peritoneum covers roughly one-third to one-half, the pericardium is white and other visceral peritonea are clear. These distinguish the source’s character combination, not an independently tested pigment mechanism.
鉴别给灰绿至橄榄绿背皮及黄斑，有时周围黑环不清，称假眼斑。活体骨绿；虹膜浅灰、有细暗网纹及瞳周浅黄。雄性无突出肱刺且具背部微刺；所报雌性无微刺。白壁腹膜覆盖约三分之一至一半，心包白、其他脏器腹膜透明。它们区分来源性状组合，不是独立测试色素机制。
morphology
Preserved colors and stage differences
保存后颜色与阶段差异

Ethanol-preserved dorsal skin is grey lavender with small white spots rather than the live yellow-spotted green. The holotype male is reported slightly greener than the single female. The metamorph is uniformly green with faint pale spots. Female size and absence of microspicules are based on one examined adult female, so these observations are not a measured frequency of dimorphism across every population. Figure1 is cited in the variation text for the female although the live type-series photographs are Figure3; the citation discrepancy is not silently repaired.
乙醇保存后背皮灰淡紫并有细白点，不同于活体黄斑绿背。报告雄性正模比唯一雌性略绿，变态个体均一绿并具隐约浅点。雌性体型及无微刺基于一只所检成年雌性，不是每个种群性二型频率实测。变异文字为雌性引用图1，而模式系列活体照片为图3，不静默修正引用差异。
morphology
Body size measured in the four adult types
四只成年模式标本的体型测量

Table2 reports male SVL25.3mm forZSFQ0466,25.7 for0463 and24.0 for0465; female0462 is28.8mm. Male tibia lengths are15.0,15.0,14.2mm versus18.0 in the female; head widths9.1,8.8,8.7 versus10.2; third-finger disc widths1.8,1.9,1.7 versus1.8. The male SVL range24.0–25.7mm has n=3, and the female is one individual, not a female range. The printed upper-eyelid value for0466 is2.2. with an extra period, preserved in the table extraction rather than treated as a second measurement.
表2报告雄性ZSFQ0466吻肛长25.3mm、0463为25.7、0465为24.0；雌性0462为28.8。雄性胫长15.0、15.0、14.2mm，雌性18.0；头宽9.1、8.8、8.7，雌性10.2；第三指盘宽1.8、1.9、1.7，雌性1.8。雄性吻肛长24.0–25.7mm为n=3，雌性仅一个体，不是雌性范围。0466上眼睑印值2.2.多一个句点，表提取保留而非作第二测量。
morphology
Contradictory finger order remains explicit
手指次序冲突明确保留

The definition says FingerI slightly longer thanII, but the holotype description givesIII>IV>II>I. Table2 likewise gives FingerI4.1/4.4/4.2/5.4mm versusFingerII5.5/5.2/4.8/6.1mm in the four adults. These printed measurements favor II longer thanI in this series, yet the definition is retained as a source conflict without silently rewriting it. Inner-finger webbing is absent and outer-finger webbing basal; no original specimen or figure-based remeasurement resolves the contradiction here.
定义称第一指稍长于第二指，但正模描述给III>IV>II>I。表2四只成年第一指4.1/4.4/4.2/5.4mm，第二指5.5/5.2/4.8/6.1mm。所印测量支持此系列第二指较长，但定义保留为来源冲突，不静默改写。内侧手指无蹼、外侧指蹼基部；这里没有原标本或依图重测解决矛盾。
ecology
Repeated surveys and season-specific detection
重复调查与季节特定检出

Methods list surveys from2012 through2018, using visual searches along varied forest/stream transects and general searches where vegetation prevented linear routes. Only February2018 regularly yielded the species, during particularly heavy wet-season rain. Earlier surveys produced one uncollected individual on22October2016 at1238m, perched350cm high. This changing detection history is not standardized density, occupancy or proof that abundance is caused by rainfall; effort and habitat searches differed.
方法列2012至2018调查，沿不同林地/溪流样线作视觉搜索，并在植被阻碍线性路线时作一般搜索。仅2018年2月规律检出该种，处于湿季特别强雨时。先前调查只在2016年10月22日1238m记录一未采个体、停栖高350cm。变化的检出史不是标准化密度、占据或降雨导致丰度的证明，努力量和栖境搜索不同。
ecology
Observed perches and nearby streams
所观停栖点与附近溪流

February observations include calling male0463 at280cm andfemale0462 at170cm over a narrow stream; male0465 moving on a leaf220cm high,5m from a larger stream; metamorph0464 at100cm directly above water; andmale0466 at400cm above water. Another uncollected adult was65cm high beside the camp stream. These individual records show variable perch use; they are not an experimental preference for one height or stream width. The metamorph’s reported SVL16.4mm is distinct from the adult type-series range.
2月观察包括窄溪上鸣叫雄性0463高280cm、雌性0462高170cm；雄性0465在距较大溪5m、高220cm叶片上移动；变态个体0464在水面正上100cm，雄性0466在水上400cm；另一个未采成年个体位于营地溪旁65cm。个体记录表明停栖利用有变化，不是偏好一种高度或溪宽的实验。变态个体吻肛长16.4mm与成年模式系列范围不同。
ecology
Egg clutches with incompatible printed counts
所印计数不相容的卵块

The definition reports15–32eggs across four clutches and says males do not attend or contact clutches. Natural history reports the holotype15–30cm from four clutches on upper leaf surfaces, with26–32embryos andmean25.75±7.5883. That mean lies below the stated26 minimum, and the definition supplies a different minimum15. Both entries remain explicit; no corrected clutch count is invented. Male proximity alone does not establish attending behavior, absence of care at every later stage or a experimentally measured parental strategy. Tadpoles remain undescribed in this source.
定义报告四卵块15–32卵，并说雄性不照料或接触卵块。自然史报告正模距叶上表面的四卵块15–30cm，26–32胚胎、均值25.75±7.5883。均值低于所述最小26，定义又给不同最小15。明确保留两条目，不虚构修正计数。雄性邻近本身不确立照料行为、每个后续阶段均无照护或实验测得亲代策略。来源蝌蚪仍未描述。
ecology
Two recorded males and ten measured calls
两只录音雄性与十个实测鸣声

The call account reports two males0465/0466 andten calls: single pulsed chirps0.093–0.118s,mean0.10±0.007s;8–12pulses per note,mean10.33±1.366; dominant frequency4052–4447Hz,mean4267.7±118.3Hz; intercall interval3.9–8.6s,mean5.72±1.82. Methods record44.1kHz/16-bit WAV andFig7 identifies LBE-C-042. The definition prints frequency SD1,18.3 while the call paragraph prints118.3; those forms remain a source transcription issue. Two males andten calls are different replication units, not ten independent animals.

鸣声条目报告雄性0465/0466两只、十个鸣声：单一脉冲啁啾0.093–0.118s、平均0.10±0.007s；每音8–12脉冲、平均10.33±1.366；主频4052–4447Hz、平均4267.7±118.3Hz；鸣间隔3.9–8.6s、平均5.72±1.82。方法给44.1kHz/16位WAV，图7识别LBE-C-042。定义把频率标准差印1,18.3、鸣声段却印118.3；两形式保留为来源转录问题。两雄性与十鸣声是不同重复单位，不是十独立动物。
occurrence
Recording and specimen dates disagree
录音与标本日期不一致

The call paragraph dates the0465/0466 recordings5February2018, whereas type and natural-history accounts place their collection/observation7February2018. The source does not independently reconcile those dates here; neither is silently overwritten. Original audio metadata, field notebooks and voucher collection data would be needed to verify the sequence of events. The reported frequency difference from grandisonae4052–4447 versus3100–4048Hz is a literature comparison, not a new temperature-controlled two-species acoustic experiment.
鸣声段把0465/0466录音定为2018年2月5日，模式及自然史条目却把采集/观察置于2018年2月7日。此处来源未独立协调日期，不静默覆盖任一日期。需原音频元数据、野外笔记及凭证采集数据确认事件顺序。与grandisonae频率4052–4447对3100–4048Hz的差别是文献比较，不是新温度控制两种声学实验。
evolution
A sampled mitochondrial sister relation
采样线粒体姐妹关系

The study recovers manduriacu sister to syntopic balionotus under its12S+16S sampling. Reported uncorrected distance between them is6.4–6.7% for the concatenated matrix, not a16S-only universal cutoff or a dated split. The authors generated31new sequences overall, including three focal individuals462/463/466. Mitochondrial sequences are treated as one inherited unit in the analysis; this does not constitute an independently tested nuclear relationship or reproductive-isolation experiment.
研究在其12S+16S采样下恢复manduriacu与同地点balionotus为姐妹。报告两者拼接矩阵未校正距离6.4–6.7%，不是16S单独通用阈值或测年分化。作者共生成31新序列，含三个焦点个体462/463/466。分析把线粒体序列作一个遗传单位，不构成独立测试核关系或生殖隔离实验。
range
Nearby streams and differing elevation summaries
相邻溪流与不同海拔汇总

The species is reported only from nearby streams at Río Manduriacu Reserve on Ecuador’s Pacific Andean slope. Table1 gives1215–1238m, while the distribution paragraph gives1215–1242m. The reserve’s broader1200–2000m site range is not the measured species range. Local records and intensive nearby historical work inform the authors’ restricted-range interpretation, but do not prove complete absence in every unsurveyed site or provide a newly certified full extent of occurrence.
报告该种仅知于厄瓜多尔安第斯太平洋坡Río Manduriacu保护区相邻溪流。表1给1215–1238m，分布段却给1215–1242m；保护区较宽1200–2000m地点范围不是物种实测范围。当地记录及附近密集历史工作支撑作者限域解释，但不证明每个未调查地点均无种，也不提供新认证完整出现范围。
ecology
A2019 Critically Endangered recommendation
2019年极危建议

The authors recommend CriticallyEndangered usingB2a andB2biii, citing a single known locality and continuing observed/inferred/projected habitat decline. This is their2019 recommendation, not a verified current IUCN listing. Cattle ranching, agriculture, logging and mining are reported habitat threats; contamination is discussed but this article does not supply a species-specific toxicology or water-chemistry experiment. The paper’s legal/company claims and reserve-land plans retain historical source context, without becoming a current legal ruling, corporate status or completed conservation outcome.
作者用B2a及B2biii建议极危，引用一个已知地点及所观/推断/预计持续栖境下降。这是2019年建议，不是核实的当前IUCN名录。畜牧、农业、伐木及采矿为所报栖境威胁；讨论污染但未给该种特定毒理或水化学实验。论文法律/公司主张及保护区土地计划保留历史来源背景，不变为当前法律裁决、企业状态或已完成保护结果。
methods
The evidence read and remaining raw data
已核读证据与尚待核读原数据

Main Introduction/Methods/Results/species-description/Discussion/threats/Conclusion andAppendixI paragraphs, both tables andsupplement caption were read. Maximum-likelihood analysis usesTIM2+F+R5 and1000ultrafast-bootstrap replicates; the paper treats≥95% as significant support. name: Allobates velocicantus
sourceConcept: Exact frozen accepted-name match to the2020 focal description; original vouchers and sequence identities not authenticated
readScope: Allobates velocicantus: Recorded main sections/allfive main tables/captions andAppendixI read;all78 donor-sheet rows and13 type-series measurement rows read preserving celltypes/addresses;allfive depositedFASTAstrings inventoried, noalignment/orientation/distance recomputation;originalGenBank/audio/vouchers/figurepixels unreviewed;no fullarticle certification; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
sections: taxonomy
A type series from southwestern Brazilian Amazonia
巴西亚马孙西南部的模式系列

Souza and colleagues described Allobates velocicantus in 2020. The holotype is male INPAH41342, field APL21398, accession MT446461, collected along highway AC405 in Mâncio Lima, Acre, on 13 January 2019 at 211 m. Eleven paratopotypes comprise eight males and three females; another male, INPAH41350, came from the Cruzeiro do Sul–Guajará road on 15 February at 181 m. These reported type records anchor the description; a frozen accepted-name match does not independently authenticate each museum specimen.

Souza 等于 2020 年描述 Allobates velocicantus。正模为雄性 INPAH41342，野外号 APL21398、登录号 MT446461，于 2019 年 1 月 13 日在 Acre 州 Mâncio Lima 的 AC405 公路沿线海拔 211 米处采集。十一同地副模含八雄三雌；另一雄性 INPAH41350 于 2 月 15 日采于 Cruzeiro do Sul–Guajará 公路海拔 181 米处。这些所报模式记录支撑描述，冻结接受名匹配不独立认证每件博物馆标本。
taxonomy
Allotype code and latitude require source reconciliation
配模编号与纬度需来源协调

The paratopotype paragraph designates INPAH413445 as allotype, whereas figure captions3–5 identify INPAH41345; the listed female series also contains41345. This is retained as a printed code conflict without inventing a corrected museum identifier. The holotype paragraph prints latitude7°38′54″ without a hemisphere, while Methods gives7°38′54″S for AC405. The Methods coordinate can be cited as that source record, but the holotype line is not silently rewritten.
同地副模段把 INPAH413445 指为配模，而图3–5图注给 INPAH41345，雌性系列也列41345。保留所印编号冲突，不虚构修正博物馆号。正模段印纬度7°38′54″而无半球，方法给 AC405 的7°38′54″S。可按方法来源记录引用坐标，但不静默改写正模行。
morphology
Adult size and the limits of the female sample
成体体型及雌性样本边界

The ten measured males had snout–vent lengths14.9–16.2 mm, mean15.4±0.3 mm; three females measured16.0–17.4 mm, mean16.7±0.7 mm. The holotype is15.3 mm. Females were larger on average in this sample, but the authors explicitly withheld statistical confirmation of sexual size dimorphism because only three females were available. These are examined-series measurements rather than complete geographic or age-dependent variation.
十只测量雄性吻肛长14.9–16.2毫米，均值15.4±0.3毫米；三雌16.0–17.4毫米，均值16.7±0.7毫米；正模15.3毫米。在此样本雌性均值较大，但作者因仅三雌而明确未统计确认体型性二态。这是检查系列测量，不是完整地域或年龄变异。
morphology
Granular dorsum, stripes and digital characters
颗粒背面、条纹及指趾特征

Selected diagnostic characters are a mostly light-brown granular dorsum without large dark marks, a dark-brown lateral stripe from snout to groin, an incomplete light ventrolateral stripe, an inconspicuous tympanum, and paired dorsal digital scutes. Finger I is slightly longer than II; finger fringes and hand webbing are absent, with basal toe webbing only between III and IV. The pale dorsolateral stripe can be absent or faint in life and more evident after preservation. These selected characters are not a complete identification key.
选定鉴别特征为以浅褐为主、无大暗斑的颗粒背面，从吻至腹股沟的深褐侧条纹、不完整浅色腹侧条纹、不明显鼓膜及成对指趾背盾片。第一指稍长于第二指，无指侧缘及手蹼，趾基部蹼仅在第三、四趾间。浅色背侧条纹活体可无或微弱，保存后更明显。这些选定特征不是完整鉴定检索表。
morphology
Anatomical prose and summary cells retain anomalies
解剖正文与汇总单元格保留异常

The holotype foot paragraph calls the outer metatarsal tubercle small but also says its diameter is four times the inner tubercle; this wording is not converted to an inferred ratio. Table3 female IN gives2.4±0.1 mm with a printed range2.5–2.5 mm, and female FAL/SVL gives0.2±0.2 with range0.2–0.2. These summaries are retained as source inconsistencies rather than repaired from an unread supplementary measurement spreadsheet.
正模足部段称外跖突小，却又称直径为内跖突四倍，不把此措辞转成推断比值。表3雌性 IN 给2.4±0.1毫米却印范围2.5–2.5毫米，雌性 FAL/SVL 给0.2±0.2却印范围0.2–0.2。保留为来源不一致，不依尚未核读的补充测量表修复。
methods
Eight calling males and pooled acoustic summaries
八只鸣叫雄性与合并声学汇总

Calls were recorded from eight males at24–27.4°C according to Methods; Table4 measured-temperature minimum is24.7°C. Recordings were made06:30–11:00 and15:00–17:30 using44.1-kHz,16-bit WAV, with the microphone about1 m from the frog. The eight Table4 analysed-call counts are5,3,3,2,1,4,2,4, totaling24 calls; this does not mean24 independent males. The table states summary mean, SD and extrema use all analysed calls, so individual-row means and pooled summaries need not have the same range.
方法称八只雄性的录音温度为24–27.4°C，表4测量温度最小值24.7°C。录音时间06:30–11:00及15:00–17:30，44.1-kHz、16位 WAV，麦克风距蛙约1米。表4八行分析鸣声数为5、3、3、2、1、4、2、4，合计24声，不是24只独立雄性。表注称均值、SD及极值使用全部分析鸣声，因此个体行均值与合并汇总不必有相同范围。
ecology
A short trill with many two-pulse notes
含多个双脉冲音节的短颤鸣

Advertisement calls consist of trills of66–138 pulsed notes, emitted through multiple exhalations; each note has two pulses. Text reports duration1.87–2.89 s, mean2.49±0.22 s, inter-call interval31.8–107.2 s, note duration5–13 ms, and inter-note interval10–18 ms. Dominant frequency is5512–6158 Hz, with the first note generally lower at4263–5900 Hz. These measured acoustic traits concern the recorded sample and conditions, not playback-proven mate discrimination or a universal temperature-invariant call.
广告鸣声为66–138个脉冲音节组成的颤鸣，经多次呼气发出，每音节有两个脉冲。正文报告时长1.87–2.89秒、均值2.49±0.22秒，声间隔31.8–107.2秒、音节时长5–13毫秒、音节间隔10–18毫秒。主频5512–6158 Hz，第一音节通常较低，为4263–5900 Hz。这些实测声学特征对应录音样本及条件，不是回放证实的配偶辨别或普遍不随温度变化的鸣声。
ecology
Fast repetition is a sampled comparison
快速重复为采样比较

Table4 repetition rate is38.4–56.8, mean51.2±5.8; the column prints RR without a unit in its header or footnote. The study interprets the call as unusually fast among the documented Allobates calls available in2020, which is a dated comparison rather than a refreshed genus-wide superlative. Call-duration mean and SD differ between text2.49±0.22 s and Table4 rounded2.4±0.3 s; retain both reported summaries until original call-level data reconcile them.
表4重复率为38.4–56.8、均值51.2±5.8，RR列的表头及表注未印单位。研究认为在2020年已有记录的 Allobates 鸣声中异常快速，这是有年代的比较，不是重新核实的全属最高纪录。鸣声时长均值及SD在正文2.49±0.22秒与表4所印2.4±0.3秒之间不同，保留两种汇总，待原逐声数据协调。
ecology
Leaf oviposition and a single observed courtship
叶上产卵与一次求偶观察

Natural-history notes place calling frogs10–30 cm above the ground in leaf litter of primary and secondary lowland open ombrophilous terra firme forest, near or away from small streams. One observed pair used the upper surface of a shrub leaf about20 cm high: cephalic amplexus lasted2 minutes and oviposition40 minutes, leaving13 eggs. The Methods observation date is14 February2019, separate from January type-series collection. One pair and two observed clutches do not define a complete breeding season or clutch-size distribution.
自然史记录把鸣叫蛙置于原生及次生低地开放湿润 terra firme 林落叶层上方10–30厘米，可近或远离小溪。一次观察的配对使用约20厘米高灌木叶上表面，头抱持续2分钟、产卵40分钟，留下13卵。方法给观察日为2019年2月14日，与一月模式系列采集分开。一次配对及两个观察卵团不能定义完整繁殖季或窝卵数分布。
ecology
Male tadpole transport was observed directly
直接观察雄性携运蝌蚪

The second reported clutch contained nine tadpoles ready for transport. Male INPAH41347 entered it and moved in circles while tadpoles climbed onto his back; the loading event lasted5 minutes. This documents male transport behaviour at that locality without establishing its frequency in all populations or subsequent survival. Newly laid eggs had a dark-gray animal pole and white vegetal pole within cloudy jelly. The paper’s leaf-surface and pigment observations are distinct from its untested radiation-protection hypotheses.
第二个所报卵团含九只待携运蝌蚪，雄性 INPAH41347 进入并作圆周动作，蝌蚪爬上背部，装载持续5分钟。这记录当地雄性携运行为，不确立全部种群发生频率或后续存活率。新产卵动物极深灰、植物极白，包在浑浊胶质内。论文的叶面及色素观察与未测试的辐射保护假说分开。
morphology
Larval characters keep their developmental stage
幼体特征保留发育阶段

The detailed tadpole description uses five Gosner-stage34 larvae, not all14 larvae in Table5. Their total length is15.7–18.5 mm, mean17.2±1.07 mm. Selected characters include an ovoid body, left spiracle, right vent tube, an anteroventral oral disc1.4–1.6 mm wide,3–4 short marginal papillae on each anterior lateral margin and16–21 posterior papillae, with keratodont formula2(2)/3(1). Table5 separately covers stages27–37 with stage-specific denominators; those measurements are not pooled into an age-independent species mean.
详细蝌蚪描述采用五只 Gosner34期幼体，不是表5全部14只。其全长15.7–18.5毫米，均值17.2±1.07毫米。选定特征含卵圆体、左出水孔、右泄殖管、宽1.4–1.6毫米的前腹位口盘、前唇每侧缘3–4个短缘乳突及后缘16–21个乳突，角齿公式2(2)/3(1)。表5分别覆盖27–37期并有阶段特定分母，不合并为与年龄无关的物种均值。
morphology
Tooth-row prose and measurements differ
齿行正文与测量不同

Stage34 prose gives A1 length1.1±0.2 mm and A2 length1.1±0.1 mm with a0.5±0.0 mm gap. Table5 stage34 instead gives A1 1.0±0.2 mm, A2 0.9±0.4 mm and GAP0.4±0.1 mm. The tabular summary and anatomical prose remain distinct printed evidence. NA is explicitly “not measured” in this table, not anatomical absence. Original larval measurements are needed before deciding which value or sample definition is correct.
34期正文给 A1 长1.1±0.2毫米、A2 长1.1±0.1毫米及缺口0.5±0.0毫米；表5的34期却给 A1 1.0±0.2毫米、A2 0.9±0.4毫米、GAP0.4±0.1毫米。表格汇总和解剖正文保持不同所印证据。该表明确定义 NA 为“未测量”，不是解剖结构不存在。需原幼体测量才能决定正确值或样本定义。
evolution
A well-supported sampled lineage, a weak sister relationship
强支持采样谱系与弱支持姐妹关系

Five newly sequenced specimens supplied16S accessions MT446458–MT446462. They grouped with GenBank samples MF624181 and KY886579 from Cruzeiro do Sul at reported ML support100%. The concatenated analysis contains79 terminals and5915 bp across four mitochondrial and six nuclear genes where available; it does not imply all ten loci were sequenced for every donor. Carajas is recovered as sister to velocicantus with support only24%, so that particular relationship remains weak. Morphology and calls provide other diagnostic evidence, distinct from the molecular node support.

五只新测序标本提供16S登录号 MT446458–MT446462，与 Cruzeiro do Sul 的 GenBank样本 MF624181、KY886579 聚成所报 ML支持100%的支系。拼接分析含79末端、5915 bp，按可得数据包含四线粒体及六核基因，不代表每供体均测全部十位点。Carajas 被恢复为 velocicantus 姐妹而支持仅24%，该具体关系仍弱。形态及鸣声提供其他鉴别证据，与分子节点支持分开。
evolution
Keep p-distance, K2P and clade labels separate
分开 p 距离、K2P及分支标签

Table2 uses a678-bp16S fragment and prints percent p-distance separately from Kimura2-parameter distance. Its trilineatus A row is6.8%/7.2%, B row6.6%/6.9%, C row6.8%/7.2%; Results instead calls6.6% the smallest distance to clade A. The clade-label conflict is preserved. Results reports average between-species p-distance9.6±1.5% and within-species p/K2P0.3%; these are the study’s sampled summaries, not divergence ages or universal species thresholds.
表2采用678-bp16S片段，分别印百分 p 距离与 Kimura2参数距离。Trilineatus A 行为6.8%/7.2%，B行为6.6%/6.9%，C行为6.8%/7.2%；结果却把6.6%最小距离称为 A分支。保留分支标签冲突。结果报告种间平均 p 距离9.6±1.5%、种内 p/K2P0.3%，这是研究采样汇总，不是分化年代或普遍物种阈值。
ecology
Conservation concerns and radiation hypotheses are dated
保护关注及辐射假说具有年代

The2020 Discussion places the type locality in Japiim Pentecostes and raises threats from logging, cattle ranching and agriculture; these statements are not a current threat assessment or a measured focal population trend. Dark egg pigment and cloudy jelly were proposed as possible protection against sunlight, but the authors explicitly called for physiological tests. Leaf-side, canopy and egg-colour comparisons do not by themselves demonstrate radiation tolerance, embryo mortality reduction or adaptive selection.
2020年讨论把模式产地置于 Japiim Pentecostes，并提出伐木、养牛及农业威胁；这些不是当前威胁评估或焦点种实测种群趋势。暗卵色素及浑浊胶质被提出可能保护免受阳光影响，但作者明确要求生理测试。叶面、林冠及卵色比较本身不证明辐射耐受、胚胎死亡降低或适应性选择。
evolution
Reported donor codes and available loci
所报供体编号及可得位点

taxonomy
The five new accessions have conflicting voucher assignments
五个新登录号的凭证分配有冲突

The main type paragraphs give INPAH41344/MT446460,41345/MT446459,41348/MT446458,41341/MT446462 and holotype41342/MT446461. Supplement S1 rows69–73 instead give41344/MT446458,41345/MT446459,41348/MT446460,41341/MT446461 and41342/MT446462. Only the41345/459 pairing agrees in this comparison. Preserve both assignments without choosing a correct holotype sequence or transferring its measurements to another donor. The five FASTA headers do not contain voucher codes, so they cannot resolve this conflict alone.
morphology
Thirteen individual records clarify the printed female range
十三条个体记录澄清所印雌性范围

Supplement S2 has13 individual rows, ten males and three females. Female INPAH41345 has IN2.5 mm,41344 has2.4 mm and41349 has2.4 mm; these deposited values span2.4–2.5 mm, while main Table3 prints2.5–2.5 mm beside mean2.4±0.1. The deposited row range is reported separately without editing the original main table or claiming independent remeasurement. In the holotype row, HANDI and HANDII are both2.9 mm, whereas main Table3 prints3.0 and2.9 mm and prose says I slightly longer thanII. This rounding/measurement conflict remains unresolved.
补充S2有13个体行，十雄三雌。雌性INPAH41345的IN为2.5毫米、41344为2.4毫米、41349为2.4毫米；存档值跨度2.4–2.5毫米，主表3却在均值2.4±0.1旁印2.5–2.5毫米。分别报告存档行范围，不修改原主表或宣称独立重测。正模行HANDI及HANDII均2.9毫米，主表3却印3.0及2.9毫米，正文说I稍长于II。此舍入/测量冲突仍未解决。
methods
Five FASTA entries are not a reconciled alignment
五条FASTA记录不是已协调比对

The deposited FASTA lists MT446458–MT446462 with printed sequence lengths640,531,614,594 and568 bases respectively, containing only A/C/G/T. This is a file-content inventory, not an alignment, strand-orientation correction or recalculated p-distance. The main comparison uses a678-bp16S fragment; unequal raw entry lengths alone do not establish an error in that aligned analysis or prove all five entries cover the same region. Original GenBank identities and voucher correspondence remain unverified.
存档FASTA列MT446458–MT446462，所印序列长度依次640、531、614、594及568碱基，只含A/C/G/T。这是文件内容清单，不是比对、链方向修正或重新计算p距离。主比较采用678-bp16S片段，原条目长度不同本身不确立该比对分析有错，也不证明五条覆盖相同区域。原GenBank身份及凭证对应仍未核实。
methods
The donor-sheet count differs from the analysis count
供体表计数不同于分析计数

Supplement S1 contains78 data rows after its header, including four named outgroup rows, while Methods reports79 terminals in the concatenated analysis. Original tree/alignment files are needed to reconcile terminal inclusion and data coverage.

Male throat colour in a diagnostic comparison

A single-note arrangement in the reviewed comparison
综述比较中的单音节排列

The2020 description summarizes masniger calls as a single note emitted continuously or irregularly, contrasting them with velocicantus trills of66–138 pulsed notes. This information is attributed to prior acoustic studies cited there; their original recordings, individual counts and temperature conditions have not been reread here. “Single note” describes the reported call unit, not inability to repeat notes or produce other vocalizations.

occurrence
Examined vouchers retain their source localities

A seven-specimen description from Mt. Ailao
哀牢山七标本描述

Tang and colleagues described Amolops ailao in2023 using seven specimens from Mt.Ailao,Xinping,Yunnan. Holotype GXNUYU000004 is an adult male collected12May2019 at23°56′58.20″N,101°29′51.66″E and2043m. Six paratypes include five males andone female KIZ2022041 collected22June2022. The paper proposes Ailao cascade frog and哀牢湍蛙 as common names. These reported type records anchor the source description without independently authenticating the museum specimens or every historical catalogue concept.

Tang等于2023年依据云南新平哀牢山七标本描述Amolops ailao。正模GXNUYU000004为成年雄性，2019年5月12日采于23°56′58.20″N、101°29′51.66″E、2043米。六副模含五雄及2022年6月22日采集的雌性KIZ2022041。论文提出英文名Ailao cascade frog及中文名哀牢湍蛙。这些所报模式记录支撑来源描述，不独立认证博物馆标本或每个历史目录概念。

Six males and one female keep separate size evidence
六雄及一雌保持不同体型证据

Table4 gives six males33.0–35.1mm SVL andone female41.3mm; the holotype is33.6mm. The diagnosis reports HW/SVL0.32–0.35,UEW/SVL0.08–0.10 andTHL/SVL0.52–0.56. The larger single female is one measured individual,not a female size range or statistically established population-wide dimorphism. Male first-finger nuptial pads are reported,while the study supplies no larval measurement sample.
表4给六雄吻肛长33.0–35.1毫米及一雌41.3毫米，正模33.6毫米。鉴别报告HW/SVL0.32–0.35、UEW/SVL0.08–0.10及THL/SVL0.52–0.56。较大单雌为一个测量个体，不是雌性体型范围或统计确立的全种群二态。报告雄性第一指婚垫，但研究无幼体测量样本。
morphology
Glandular folds are distinct from true dorsolateral folds
腺体褶与真正背侧褶不同

The diagnosis andholotype distinguish absence of true dorsolateral folds from the presence of conspicuous folds made of interrupted gland series. Selected characters include absent vomerine teeth,distinct tympanum underhalf eye diameter,absent first-finger-disc circummarginal groove,smooth dorsum without white spines,paired large cloacal-side tubercles andabsence of a vocal sac. These anatomical observations do not imply inability to call or a completed acoustic survey. They are selected diagnosis features rather than a complete identification key.
鉴别及正模把无真正背侧褶与显著间断腺体系列所成褶区分。选定特征含无犁骨齿、明显且小于眼径一半的鼓膜、第一指盘无环缘沟、背平滑无白刺、泄殖孔两侧成对大疣及无声囊。这些解剖观察不代表不能鸣叫或已完成声学调查，是选定鉴别特征而非完整鉴定检索表。
morphology
Toe-webbing descriptions require reconciliation
趾蹼描述需要协调

DiagnosisSec14 states toes fully webbed except thefourth,while holotypeSec15p3 calls theweb two-thirds andprints formulaI1–1.5II1–1.5III1–2IV2–1V. Preserve thediagnostic statement andtheindividual formula separately;no newwebbing score is inferred from an unread foot photograph. The first-finger groove definition in IntroductionSec1p2 says present for thehistorical group,whereas Sec1p3 andthefocal diagnosis state absence. This source wording difference is not silently repaired into a universal group diagnosis.
鉴别Sec14称趾全蹼但第四趾除外，正模Sec15p3却称二分之三蹼并印公式I1–1.5II1–1.5III1–2IV2–1V。分别保留鉴别陈述及个体公式，不依未读足部照片推断新蹼分数。引言Sec1p2对历史群定义说第一指沟存在，Sec1p3及焦点鉴别却说不存在，不静默修复成普遍群鉴别。
morphology
Living and preserved colours differ across individuals
活体及保存颜色在个体间不同

The living holotype has golden-brown dorsal ground with darkbrown andgreen spots,a pale-green lip stripe andorange-yellow webbing; afterpreservation its dorsal colours fade to lightbrown,beigebrown andgrayblue. Four listed individuals including theholotype andfemale have brown dorsal ground,while theotherthree male paratypes have green ground. GXNUYU20160273 lacks large darkbrown dorsal/flank spots. This variation in thetype series prevents treating one photograph’s pattern as thewhole species’ invariant colour.
活体正模背底金褐并有暗褐及绿斑、浅绿唇纹、橙黄蹼；保存后背色褪为浅褐、米褐及灰蓝。包括正模及雌性的四所列个体背底褐，另三雄副模底绿；GXNUYU20160273无背/侧大暗褐斑。模式系列变异不支持把一张照片图案当成全种不变色彩。
ecology
Night-time stream encounters and a tentative breeding window
夜间溪流相遇及暂定繁殖窗口

The2023 account knows ailao only from thetype locality,where adults were seen atnight on leaves orsmall branches less than2m aboveground along a mountain stream fromMay toJuly. Nuptial pads in allmale types andeggs in thefemale motivate a possibleMay–July breeding window; this is an inference from limited observations,not a fullannual breeding survey. No tadpoles were collected,which is a source sampling limit rather than proof of absent larvae.
2023年条目仅知ailao于模式产地，五月至七月夜间在山溪沿岸离地不足2米叶或小枝见成体。全部雄模式婚垫及雌体内卵提出可能五月—七月繁殖窗口，是有限观察推论，不是全年繁殖调查。未采到蝌蚪是来源采样限制，不是无幼体证据。
ecology
Co-occurrence does not establish shared ecology
同域出现不确立共同生态

The survey also encountered tuberodepressus at theailao type locality. Theauthors distinguish thetwo with body size,vomerine teeth andglandular folds. This confirms reported local co-occurrence,not identical microhabitat use,diet,breeding timing orhybridization. Thearticle reports nofocal abundance trajectory,currentIUCN category orspecies-specific physiology experiment; those remainoutside this source’s direct evidence.
调查在ailao模式产地也见tuberodepressus，作者以体型、犁骨齿及腺体褶区分。这确认所报地方同域出现，不确立微栖境利用、食性、繁殖时序相同或杂交。文中无焦点丰度轨迹、当前IUCN等级或物种特定生理实验，均超出此来源直接证据。
evolution
Three mitochondrial loci support a sampled lineage
三个线粒体位点支持采样谱系

The alignments have16S884bp,COI676bp andcytb998bp. Bayesian andML analyses of thecombined dataset recover theAilao samples as a distinct lineage in themantzorum-group clade andas sister toottorum withreported strongsupport. Not every comparison species has allthree loci;ottorum lacks16S andCOI entries in Table1/2,so its5.0% focaldifference inTable3 is cytb. Molecular support is not independently verified GenBank identity,nuclear geneflow orreproductive isolation.
比对含16S884bp、COI676bp及cytb998bp。组合数据贝叶斯及ML分析恢复哀牢样本为mantzorum群支系内独立谱系及ottorum姐妹，作者报告强支持。并非每比较种有全部三位点；表1/2的ottorum缺16S及COI条目，因此表3与焦点5.0%差异为cytb。分子支持不是独立核实GenBank身份、核基因流或生殖隔离。
evolution
Gene-specific distances are not one species threshold
基因特定距离不是一个物种阈值

Selected group comparisons span1.9–8.3% in16S,4.0–14.2% inCOI and5.0–14.4% incytb in thepaper. The16S minimum is sangzhiensis,theCOI minimum nominate-mantzorum andcytb minimum ottorum;largest listed focal values are lifanensis. These genes andsource lineage labels muststay separate. NA andblank triangular cells do not represent0%distance orabsence of a species,gene orpopulation.
论文选定群比较的16S跨度1.9–8.3%、COI4.0–14.2%、cytb5.0–14.4%。16S最小为sangzhiensis，COI最小为指名mantzorum，cytb最小为ottorum，所列焦点最大值为lifanensis。基因及来源谱系标签须分开，NA及三角表空单元格不代表0%距离或物种、基因、种群不存在。
geochronology
A dated estimate uses a secondary calibration
年代估计采用二级校准

BEAST uses asecondary genus-crown calibration25.01±2.2Ma from anearlier study,not a newly examined fossil. Theestimated ailao–ottorum split is2.2Ma with95%HPD1.1–3.37Ma. Proposed rapid group divergences span4.23Ma(2.56–6.1) to1.2Ma(0.53–1.98). These aremodel-conditioned estimates withuncertainty; temporal coincidence withplateau uplift is not a controlledcausal test of uplift-driven speciation. Minutus was notincluded in this phylogeny.
BEAST采用早期研究属冠25.01±2.2Ma二级校准，不是新检查化石。估计ailao–ottorum分离2.2Ma，95%HPD1.1–3.37Ma；提出群快速分化跨度4.23Ma（2.56–6.1）至1.2Ma（0.53–1.98）。这是有不确定性的模型条件估计，与高原抬升时间相合不是抬升驱动成种的因果对照测试；minutus未纳入此系统树。
morphology
PCA describes this comparison sample
PCA描述此比较样本

Size-standardized measurements divide each variable bySVL;ottorum measurements aretaken from its earlier description. Thefirsttwo PCs explain64.035% ofvariance,34.257% and29.778% respectively. PC1loadings includeHW0.808,UEW0.914,ED0.704 andTHL0.893;theauthors report separation onPC1 butnotclear separation onPC2. This comparison doesnotprovide cross-validated classification performance orprove everyfuture specimen canbe identified by aPCA score.
体型标准化把各变量除以SVL，ottorum测量取自早期描述。前两PC解释64.035%变异，分别34.257%及29.778%；PC1载荷含HW0.808、UEW0.914、ED0.704及THL0.893，作者报告PC1分离但PC2无清晰分离。该比较不提供交叉验证分类表现，也不证明每未来标本可依PCA分数鉴定。
taxonomy
Misidentified historical donors remain donor-specific
历史误鉴供体保持供体特定

The paper identifies Zhongdian IOZ4373,previously calledjinjiangensis,as nested withmantzorum ratherthan withDeqin topotypes ofjinjiangensis. Thisis a historical donor reassessment,not automatic reassignment of everyoldjinjiangensis range record. Table1 also printsjinjiangeniss,Amoopsjinjiangensis andquoted“jinjiangensis” labels;unresolved spelling andqualifiedlabels shouldnotbe silently turned intoexactaccepted-speciesaccessions. Originalvouchers remainindependentlyunverified.
论文把先前称jinjiangensis的中甸IOZ4373辨为嵌在mantzorum内而非德钦jinjiangensis地模内。这是历史供体重评，不自动重归每旧jinjiangensis分布记录。表1另印jinjiangeniss、Amoopsjinjiangensis及带引号“jinjiangensis”标签，未解决拼写或限定标签不静默转成精确接受种登录号。原凭证仍未独立核实。
methods
Contradictory comparison sentences remain visible
有矛盾比较句保持可见

ComparisonSec20p7 says complete-series dorsolateral glands,whereas thefocal diagnosis andholotype describe incomplete-series glands. Sec20p13 says focaldorsolateralglandularfolds absent versusabsent in hainanensis/torrentis,contradicting the focalpresent diagnosis andnot supplying a difference inthat sentence. TheYunnan regional summarycalls itsmonticola list eight members butlists nine names. Preserve these source contradictions withoutbuilding a corrected anatomy orcountfrom assumption.
比较Sec20p7称背侧腺体完整系列，焦点鉴别及正模却描述间断系列；Sec20p13称焦点背侧腺体褶不存在、hainanensis/torrentis也不存在，与焦点存在鉴别矛盾且该句不给差异。云南区域汇总称monticola清单八成员，却列九名。保留来源矛盾，不依假设建立修正解剖或计数。

A local cloud-forest occurrence and its elevation

The 2021 Santa Cruz Tepetotutla checklist reports Incilius spiculatus at 600–1760 m above sea level during its 2018–2019 survey. Table 1 compares this with an earlier reported elevation of 800–1689 (Mendelson 1997) and lists photographic catalogue number IBH-RF 607. The locality is in the Chinantla region of Oaxaca, Mexico. This is a reported local occurrence, not a surveyed global range, independent verification of the archived photograph, or evidence of occupancy at every intermediate elevation. Historical elevations are retained as attributed comparisons rather than merged automatically with the new observation.

2021年Santa Cruz Tepetotutla清单报告2018–2019年调查中Incilius spiculatus出现于海拔600–1760米。表1对比早期所报海拔800–1689 (Mendelson 1997)，并列照片目录号IBH-RF 607。地点位于墨西哥Oaxaca的Chinantla地区。这是所报当地出现，不是全球分布调查、档案照片独立认证或每个中间海拔占据证据。历史海拔保留为有归属比较，不自动与新观察合并。
ecology
Interpret the record within the survey design
按调查设计解读记录

Four observers surveyed pristine and managed cloud-forest sites on eleven five-day trips in 2018–2019, in wet and dry seasons. Three daily windows were 09:00–13:00, 15:00–19:00 and 21:00–01:00; the paper reports 2,640 effective field hours for the whole herpetofaunal inventory. Animals were photographed and released, and GPS locations had a reported 5 m error range. The checklist's Incilius spiculatus row establishes presence in that sampling context. Total effort and the nineteen amphibian species are not species-specific detection probabilities, population estimates or trends. The accumulation curve had not reached an asymptote, so a missing record cannot establish local absence.

四名观察者于2018–2019年雨季及旱季开展十一次、每次五天调查，覆盖原生及经营云雾林。每日时段为09:00–13:00、15:00–19:00及21:00–01:00；论文报告整个两栖爬行动物清单有效野外工时2640小时。动物摄影后放归，GPS所报误差范围5米。Incilius spiculatus清单行确立该采样背景下出现。总投入及十九种两栖动物不是物种特定检测概率、种群估计或趋势。累积曲线未达渐近线，因此未记录不能确立当地不存在。
ecology
Dated conservation labels in the checklist
清单中有年代的保护标签

Table 1 prints IUCN category EN, EVS entry M (13), Mexican NOM-059 entry Not included and endemism label Oaxaca SMO for Incilius spiculatus. These are the source's historical labels, not a newly checked current assessment or legal classification. The IUCN and Mexican columns use different frameworks; a “Not included” entry is not evidence of low risk or unrestricted activity. EVS is retained as the printed index entry rather than a measured extinction probability. The study argues that community-conserved forest supports threatened species, but its presence inventory does not isolate the causal effect of management or demonstrate a population increase.

表1为Incilius spiculatus刊出IUCN类别EN、EVS项M (13)、墨西哥NOM-059项Not included及特有性标签Oaxaca SMO。这些是来源的历史标签，不是新核查的当前评估或法律分类。IUCN及墨西哥列使用不同框架；“Not included”不证明低风险或活动不受限制。EVS保留为所印指数项，不是实测灭绝概率。研究主张社区保育林支持受威胁物种，但出现清单不隔离管理因果效应，也不证明种群增长。

种处理报告七个体在溪旁蕨叶上，既见于原生山地云雾林，也见于咖啡及香蕉种植区包围的扰动地。地点1506米，WGS84纬度17.7251°N、经度印作-96.5590°W，距最近引用San Pedro Yolox地点西北15公里。表1给本研究1000–1500米，不包含种处理1506米。作者称种群似较丰富；七次遇见本身不估计密度、长期趋势或耐受阈值。

sections: range
A local cloud-forest occurrence and its elevation
当地云雾林出现及海拔

The 2021 Santa Cruz Tepetotutla checklist reports Pseudoeurycea orchileucos at 1200 m above sea level during its 2018–2019 survey. Table 1 compares this with an earlier reported elevation of 800–1390 (Brodie et al. 2002) and lists photographic catalogue number IBH-RF 616. The locality is in the Chinantla region of Oaxaca, Mexico. This is a reported local occurrence, not a surveyed global range, independent verification of the archived photograph, or evidence of occupancy at every intermediate elevation. Historical elevations are retained as attributed comparisons rather than merged automatically with the new observation.

2021年Santa Cruz Tepetotutla清单报告2018–2019年调查中Pseudoeurycea orchileucos出现于海拔1200米。表1对比早期所报海拔800–1390 (Brodie et al. 2002)，并列照片目录号IBH-RF 616。地点位于墨西哥Oaxaca的Chinantla地区。这是所报当地出现，不是全球分布调查、档案照片独立认证或每个中间海拔占据证据。历史海拔保留为有归属比较，不自动与新观察合并。
ecology
Interpret the record within the survey design
按调查设计解读记录

Four observers surveyed pristine and managed cloud-forest sites on eleven five-day trips in 2018–2019, in wet and dry seasons. Three daily windows were 09:00–13:00, 15:00–19:00 and 21:00–01:00; the paper reports 2,640 effective field hours for the whole herpetofaunal inventory. Animals were photographed and released, and GPS locations had a reported 5 m error range. The checklist's Pseudoeurycea orchileucos row establishes presence in that sampling context. Total effort and the nineteen amphibian species are not species-specific detection probabilities, population estimates or trends. The accumulation curve had not reached an asymptote, so a missing record cannot establish local absence.

四名观察者于2018–2019年雨季及旱季开展十一次、每次五天调查，覆盖原生及经营云雾林。每日时段为09:00–13:00、15:00–19:00及21:00–01:00；论文报告整个两栖爬行动物清单有效野外工时2640小时。动物摄影后放归，GPS所报误差范围5米。Pseudoeurycea orchileucos清单行确立该采样背景下出现。总投入及十九种两栖动物不是物种特定检测概率、种群估计或趋势。累积曲线未达渐近线，因此未记录不能确立当地不存在。
ecology
Dated conservation labels in the checklist
清单中有年代的保护标签

Table 1 prints IUCN category EN, EVS entry H (18), Mexican NOM-059 entry Not included and endemism label Oaxaca SMO for Pseudoeurycea orchileucos. These are the source's historical labels, not a newly checked current assessment or legal classification. The IUCN and Mexican columns use different frameworks; a “Not included” entry is not evidence of low risk or unrestricted activity. EVS is retained as the printed index entry rather than a measured extinction probability. The study argues that community-conserved forest supports threatened species, but its presence inventory does not isolate the causal effect of management or demonstrate a population increase.

表1为Pseudoeurycea orchileucos刊出IUCN类别EN、EVS项H (18)、墨西哥NOM-059项Not included及特有性标签Oaxaca SMO。这些是来源的历史标签，不是新核查的当前评估或法律分类。IUCN及墨西哥列使用不同框架；“Not included”不证明低风险或活动不受限制。EVS保留为所印指数项，不是实测灭绝概率。研究主张社区保育林支持受威胁物种，但出现清单不隔离管理因果效应，也不证明种群增长。
ecology
One salamander after heavy rain
大雨后的一只蝾螈

The treatment reports one individual on a road at01:00h PST after heavy rain, with90% relative air humidity. It was400m from town and100m from the nearest water body amid secondary cloud-forest vegetation. The locality is1280m at WGS84 latitude17.73102°N and longitude printed as -96.56056°W,25.73km west of the cited San Mateo Yetla locality. Table1 instead prints1200m. Keep the clock notation and elevation difference as reported; do not correct the time zone by inference. This single encounter does not establish nocturnal exclusivity, breeding season, physiological humidity limits or road-use preference.
种处理报告大雨后01:00h PST在路上遇一个体，相对空气湿度90%。地点距镇400米、最近水体100米，周围为次生云雾林植被。海拔1280米，WGS84纬度17.73102°N、经度印作-96.56056°W，距引用San Mateo Yetla地点向西25.73公里。表1却印1200米。保留所报时钟记号及海拔差异，不推断修正时区。单次遇见不确立仅夜行、繁殖季、生理湿度限度或道路使用偏好。
