sections: taxonomy
A2021 description from the Teles Pires region
Teles Pires地区的2021年描述

Santana and colleagues described Proceratophrys korekore in 2021 using morphology, calls and mitochondrial evidence. The male holotype ZUFMS-AMP08100 was collected on 8 November 2016 at Jacareacanga, Pará, Brazil (09°19′1.00″ S, 56°46′35.76″ W; 200 m; SAD69). The paper cites earlier concavitympanum usage only in part; it does not equate all historical records with korekore. The epithet means frog in the Munduruku language. Proposed Portuguese names are sapo-korekore and sapo-de-chifre-dos-mundurukus.

Santana等于2021年用形态、鸣声及线粒体证据描述Proceratophrys korekore。雄性正模ZUFMS-AMP08100于2016年11月8日采于巴西Pará的Jacareacanga，09°19′1.00″S、56°46′35.76″W、200米、SAD69基准。部分标本早称concavitympanum，论文仅部分引用该用法，不使所有历史concavitympanum记录等同korekore。种加词在Munduruku语言中意为蛙，来源提出葡语俗名sapo-korekore及sapo-de-chifre-dos-mundurukus。
taxonomy
Type and Appendix localities do not all agree
模式记录与附录地点并非全一致

The paratype paragraph places ZUEC 14950 at Paranaíta, Mato Grosso, but the Appendix lists it under Jacareacanga, Pará. The Appendix also places ZUFMS-AMP8100 under Paranaíta, whereas the holotype paragraph puts 08100 at Jacareacanga. Preserve these record differences without silently correcting voucher identities or localities. Type records mix SAD69 and WGS84 coordinates and elevations of 200 or 270 m; they require datum transformation and voucher review before combining them as normalized points.
副模段把ZUEC14950放在MatoGrosso的Paranaíta，附录却列在Pará的Jacareacanga；附录另把ZUFMS-AMP8100放在Paranaíta，正模段却把08100放在Jacareacanga。这是来源记录差异，不足以静默修正凭证—地点链接。模式系列坐标混用SAD69与WGS84，所报海拔200或270米；未经基准转换及凭证核查，不合成一个点或基准。
morphology
A combination of diagnostic traits
鉴别性状组合

The diagnosis combines small, pointed, fused warts at the upper eyelid border; an eye-diameter/eye–nostril-distance ratio of 1.1–1.3; and one forearm tubercle row of unequal sizes with sparse surrounding tubercles. Korekore lacks a developed long palpebral or rostral appendage and postocular swellings. The holotype has vomerine teeth in two short rows and no hand interdigital webbing. These reported characters and taxonomic comparisons are not independently authenticated histology or proof that one character identifies every age and population.
鉴别组合含上眼睑缘小而尖的融合疣、眼径/眼鼻距比1.1–1.3，以及前臂一列大小不等疣、周边少量额外疣。Korekore没有发育的长眼睑或吻端附器及眼后膨大。正模有两短列犁骨齿，指间无蹼。这是所报形态及分类比较，不是新认证组织学或某单性状能鉴别全龄/全种群的证明。
morphology
Diagnosis andTable1 give different size ranges
鉴别及表1体长范围不同

The diagnosis gives adult male SVL 39.8–44.1 mm and adult female SVL 43.8–57.6 mm. Table 1 instead prints males n=12, mean 43.7, SD 3.6, range 39.8–53.5 mm; and females n=9, mean 48.7, SD 9.3, range 33.0–57.6 mm. Retain both as attributed values rather than choosing a corrected adult range. Range separators in the captured XML are damaged, but numeric endpoints remain legible. The statement that females are larger in the type series does not establish a statistically tested universal sex difference.
鉴别给成年雄吻肛长39.8–44.1毫米、成年雌43.8–57.6毫米。表1却印雄n12、均43.7、SD3.6、范围39.8–53.5毫米；雌n9、均48.7、SD9.3、范围33.0–57.6毫米。两套保留为有归属值，不静默合成修正成年范围。捕获XML的表格范围分隔符损坏，但数值端点可读。正文称模式系列雌较大，这些不同范围不确立经统计检验的普遍性别差异。
morphology
Holotype proportions require source reconciliation
正模比例需协调来源

Table 1 gives holotype SVL 43.35 mm, HL 15.67 mm and HW 21.97 mm; rounded prose gives 43.4, 15.7 and 22.0 mm. The description nevertheless says head length is 70% of SVL, while the printed measurement ratio is approximately 36.1%. DICS is 10.74 in the table but 10.8 in rounded prose, rather than 10.7. Preserve these differences without guessing which variable was intended. Other printed holotype measurements are ED 5.96, END 4.55, THL 18.34 and TL 16.71 mm. Caliper precision does not validate specimen identity or contradictory proportional prose.
表1给正模吻肛长43.35、头长15.67、头宽21.97毫米；四舍五入正文给43.4、15.7、22.0毫米。但描述说头长为吻肛长70%，所印测量比约36.1%。表给DICS10.74，正文却印10.8而非10.7。保留矛盾，不改变作者意指变量。其他所印正模测量含ED5.96、END4.55、THL18.34及TL16.71毫米；卡尺精度本身不验证标本身份或比例正文。
morphology
Preserved colour andindividual wart variation
保存颜色及个体疣变异

The preserved holotype has a brown dorsum with a lighter area inside the ocular-dorsal wart ridge, bordered by four dark triangular marks on each side. Its cream ventral surface has dark mottling and a darker throat. Live and preserved type-series backgrounds vary from light to dark brown, and some individuals lack a complete ocular-dorsal ridge. These variations do not support an invariant colour pattern or universally complete ridge. Captions were read; figure pixels have not been independently inspected.
保存正模背褐，眼背疣脊内区域较浅、每侧四个深三角斑。腹部奶油色伴深色杂斑，喉部更深。活体及保存模式系列背景从浅到深褐变，部分个体眼背疣脊不完整。这些所报变异不支持恒定颜色图案或普遍完整疣脊鉴别。图注已读，但未独立检查像素。
ecology
Eight calls fromone recordedmale
一只录音雄蛙的八次鸣声

The analyzed recording is paratype ZUFMS-AMP13680 at the type locality, around 20:00 h, at 24.3°C air temperature and 86% humidity, recorded as 44.1 kHz/16-bit WAV and archived as MAP-V 329. Eight calls contain a single pulsed note lasting 0.162–0.332 s (mean 0.251±0.053), with 96.4–111.1 pulses/s (mean 103.9±5.9) and dominant frequency 861.3 Hz without observed variation. These are repeated observations of one male. The frequency result is limited by that sample; raw sound and the archived recording have not been independently reanalyzed.

分析录音为模式地点副模ZUFMS-AMP13680，约20:00h、空气24.3°C、湿度86%、44.1kHz/16bitWAV，存档MAP-V329。八次鸣声为单个脉冲音，持续0.162–0.332秒（均0.251±0.053），脉冲率96.4–111.1脉冲/秒（均103.9±5.9），主频861.3Hz、未观察变异。八次鸣声是一雄重复观察，不是八独立雄。未观察频率变异受该样本限制，原声音及存档录音未独立再分析。
ecology
Pulse counts andcomparison wording conflict
脉冲计数及比较措辞冲突

Results and Table 2 give 18–32 pulses per call, mean 25.0±4.4, but the diagnosis and comparison print 18–31. Comparison paragraph 8 calls korekore’s 96.4–111.1 pulses/s lower than moratoi’s 69–86, although those numbers are higher; paragraph 14 says greater and quotes moratoi as 69–103. Preserve the numerical and wording differences without repeating a reversed mathematical contrast. Table 2 labels the locality Jacareacanga, MT, whereas Methods and Holotype place it in Pará. No corrected state or pulse count is silently selected.

结果及表2给每声18–32脉冲、均25.0±4.4，鉴别/比较却印18–31。比较p8称korekore的96.4–111.1脉冲/秒“低于”moratoi的69–86，所印范围却更高；后来p14明确称更大，并引moratoi69–103。保留数值及措辞差异，不复述数学方向相反的比较。表2给korekore地点Jacareacanga,MT，方法及正模的模式地点却是Jacareacanga,Pará。不静默选定修正州名或脉冲数。
evolution
A421bp mitochondrial analysis
421bp线粒体分析

The authors sequenced 16S fragments from three new-species individuals and four strussmannae from its type locality, assembling a 421 bp alignment with other GenBank sequences. BEAST under HKY+I+G ran for 50 million generations; the paper reports ESS above 200. Results places korekore sister to concavitympanum within a supported clade, but deeper nodes have low support. This is one mitochondrial locus, not a validated genome-wide species tree or proof of no introgression. Figure 6’s million-year scale alone does not establish an independently reviewed calibrated divergence date.
作者为三新种个体及四模式产地strussmannae个体测16S片段，与其他GenBank序列合成421bp比对。BEAST用HKY+I+G运行5000万代，论文报告ESS超过200。结果把korekore置为concavitympanum姐妹、在有支持群中，但较深节点支持低。这是单线粒体位点，不是已验证全基因组物种树或无基因渗入证明。图6的百万年尺度本身不是独立核审的校准分离日期。
evolution
Distances andhaplotypes havequalified labels
距离及单倍型带限定标签

Table 3 gives mean uncorrected 16S distances of 4.2% to concavitympanum, 3.5% to ararype, 3.0% to aff. ararype and 10.4% to redacta. The closest printed comparison is a qualified aff. ararype label. Results describes seven mitochondrial lineages without shared haplotypes in the sampled concavitympanum clade. Discussion still requests clarification of the Tocantins aff. ararype population, averaging 1.8% from ararype. These patterns alone do not certify reproductive isolation, universal thresholds or complete current concept reconciliation.

表3给未校正16S均距：concavitympanum4.2%、ararype3.5%、aff.ararype3.0%、redacta10.4%。最近所印比较是有限定aff.ararype，不自动等于接受ararype概念。结果描述采样concavitympanum群七不同线粒体谱系、无共享单倍型。讨论仍要求澄清Tocantins的aff.ararype种群，其与ararype均差1.8%。距离及单倍型模式本身不认证生殖隔离、普遍阈值或完整当前概念协调。
range
Two banks oftheTeles PiresRiver
Teles Pires河的两岸

The 2021 source restricts known occurrence to Jacareacanga, Pará and a few sites across the Teles Pires River at Paranaíta, Mato Grosso. It reports dense ombrophilous forest on both banks. Rainy-season surveys from 18:00–21:00 h, October–June, found males calling from temporary-stream leaf litter and occasionally bare soil near water. Other individuals were observed by day and night or trapped far from water. These records do not establish absence of calling at other times, exclusively aquatic habitat, larval development or thermal tolerances.
2021年来源把已知出现限于Pará的Jacareacanga及河对岸MatoGrosso的Paranaíta少数地点，报告两岸密闭雨林。十月至六月雨季18:00–21:00调查见雄于临时溪岸落叶层、偶见水边裸土鸣叫。其他个体昼夜均见，或于远离水体处陷阱捕获。这不确立其余全年无鸣声、仅水生栖境、幼体发育或成体热耐受。
ecology
Local threats andsympatry aredated observations
当地威胁及同域为有年代观察

The source names Ameerega munduruku, Ceratophrys cornuta and Lithodytes lineatus as sympatric and reports logging, cattle-related clearing, illegal gold mining and hydroelectric fragmentation in the region. Mercury use and fish poisoning are discussed with attributed literature, not a chemical assay of korekore. These dated threats are not a current IUCN category, measured population decline, diet study or proof of interactions among sympatric species. The authors request more surveys and integrative taxonomy.
来源具名同域Ameeregamunduruku、Ceratophryscornuta及Lithodyteslineatus，报告区域伐木、牧牛相关清林、非法金矿及水电碎片化。汞使用及鱼中毒讨论有文献归属，不是korekore独立化学检测。这些2021年威胁不是当前IUCN类别、种群下降估计、食性研究或同域种间相互作用证明。作者要求在欠采样区域增加调查及整合分类。
evolution
Identifiers in the deposited sequence list
存放序列清单中的标识

Document S1 lists ZUFMS-AMP08105 (This study); ZUFMS-AMP 8100 (This study); ZUFMS-AMP 8101 (This study) under Proceratophrys korekore. Its column is headed “Genbank Acession”, but some entries are local specimen identifiers rather than accession numbers. Preserve these strings and cited sources without treating them as independently verified GenBank records. This is a source donor list, not a complete inventory of the species or proof that each identifier represents a distinct authenticated sequence.

Document S1在Proceratophrys korekore下列ZUFMS-AMP08105 (This study); ZUFMS-AMP 8100 (This study); ZUFMS-AMP 8101 (This study)。其列题为“Genbank Acession”，但部分项为当地标本标识而非登录号。保留字符串及引用来源，不视为独立核实的GenBank记录。这是来源供体清单，不是完整物种清单，也不证明每标识代表不同已认证序列。
methods
Supplement labels retain specimen and taxon limits
附录标签保留标本及类群边界

All 77 donor rows of Document S1 were read. Its three korekore entries are ZUFMS-AMP08105, ZUFMS-AMP 8100 and ZUFMS-AMP 8101 in the accession column. Document S2 has forty taxon labels and one aggregated korekore row; thirty-nine focal comparison cells were read, with remaining matrix values unreviewed. Genus-only Odontophrynus JX564880 is not automatically identified as occidentalis, which appears in S2 but lacks that exact named S1 row. Qualified americanus, aff./cf. labels and the criticeps spelling remain distinct.

Document S1的77供体行已核读，三个korekore项在登录号列为ZUFMS-AMP08105、ZUFMS-AMP 8100及ZUFMS-AMP 8101。Document S2有四十类群标签及一个合并korekore行，三十九焦点比较单元格已读、其余矩阵值未核读。属级Odontophrynus JX564880不自动鉴定为occidentalis，后者见于S2却无精确具名S1行。有限定americanus、aff./cf.标签及criticeps拼写保持区分。

sections: morphology
A named character in the2021 comparison
2021年比较中的具名性状

The source attributes a palpebral appendage to this named comparator. Most listed comparators have a long single-cusped appendage; rondonae is explicitly exceptional, with a short multi-cusped appendage. This is an attributed morphological comparison, not a newly verified histological or ontogenetic survey of every population. A single contrast does not replace the full diagnostic character combination.

The comparison reports two well-delimited forearm tubercle rows, against korekore’s one unequal-sized row with sparse bordering tubercles. Upper-eyelid characters in a named contrast
具名对照的上眼睑性状

The2021 description characterizes this comparator’s eyelid tubercles as conical and pointed, against korekore’s small pointed fused warts. These are the authors’ comparative statements, not an invariant all-age diagnosis or an independent reexamination of original types.
